rows.title: HR Systems Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As HR Systems Analyst, you will support the continued development of Oracle HCM and connected HR systems. You will work closely with HR Operations, Payroll, HR Business Partners, and IT to improve the quality, usability and effectiveness of our people systems. This role offers genuine breadth. One day you may be helping to resolve a system configuration issue; the next, you could be supporting to improve onboarding journeys across multiple countries, producing HR reporting, or developing clear operating procedures for our HR Shared Services team.

Responsibilities

What you will do

 Provide functional support for Oracle HCM and related HR technology, investigating user queries, system issues and process failures.  Support HR system changes from initial requirements through testing, implementation, user communications and post-implementation review.  Partner with technical teams to help configure and improve HR processes, including employee and manager self-service, workflows, absence and leave processes, benefits and approvals.  Review HR system data for accuracy, completeness and consistency; identify root causes of issues and help implement sustainable controls and improvements.  Create and maintain recurring and ad hoc HR reports, data extracts and dashboards for HR, Payroll, Finance, leadership and regulatory reporting.  Support data gathering and validation for key workforce reporting, including diversity-related analysis, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data governance.  Work with Payroll and HR Shared Services to understand the downstream impact of system changes and ensure effective data reconciliation and hand-offs.  Help design, document and improve employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, benefits enrolment, leave and family-related processes, organisational changes and employee records.  Develop practical process documentation, standard operating procedures, user guidance and knowledge materials that enable consistent, high-quality HR service delivery.  Support employee and manager communications relating to HR systems, benefits and new processes, ensuring information is accurate, clear and easy to use.  Coordinate with external providers and internal technical teams to track incidents, enhancements, access issues, system configuration and service improvements.  Work across legal entities and countries, identifying where HR processes need local variation while maintaining appropriate global consistency.  Bring a continuous-improvement mindset: challenge manual workarounds, identify recurring themes and recommend practical, scalable solutions. 

Qualifications

What you will bring

Essential Experience And Skills

 Experience in an HR systems, HRIS, HR data, people operations or HR shared-services role.  Experience using and supporting an enterprise HR system; Oracle HCM experience is preferred.  Strong understanding of core HR processes, including employee lifecycle administration, onboarding, benefits, absence or leave and organisational data.  Experience investigating system or data issues and working with technical teams, providers or internal stakeholders to resolve them.  Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, including reviewing large datasets, reconciling information and identifying exceptions or trends.  Experience producing HR reports, management information, data extracts or dashboards.  Experience supporting process mapping, process documentation, SOP development or employee/manager guidance.  Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn technical or policy information into clear, practical content.  Excellent attention to detail, sound judgement and a strong commitment to confidential handling of employee information.  A collaborative style and confidence working with a broad range of stakeholders, including HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, senior leaders and external suppliers. 

Desirable

 Oracle HCM experience across Core HR, Benefits, Absence, Journeys, Helpdesk, reporting, security or workflow.  Experience supporting system configuration, release management, user acceptance testing or regression testing.  Knowledge of HR and payroll interfaces, data reconciliation and system controls.  Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, Jira or case-management technology.  Knowledge of GDPR, HR data governance, data quality controls and audit requirements.  Experience supporting a multi-entity, multi-country or matrix organisation.  Experience designing onboarding journeys, benefits communications or employee-facing HR content.

rows.title: Data Analyst - Safety, Health and Environment
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Data Analyst - Safety, Health and Environment

Business Function: SHE, Supply Chain

Location: Leeds (Local (Inside UK) Relocation Assistance is considered)

Job Purpose

We make some of the UK’s best-known personal care brands in Leeds. Our Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) team keeps our people safe, protects our environment and keeps our site compliant. As our site becomes more data-led, we need sharper, faster ways to turn SHE information into clear insight and action. We’re looking for someone who loves data, problem-solving and making work simpler – and wants to use those skills for something that genuinely matters. You’ll build dashboards, automations and reports that help our leaders see where the real risks are, so we can spend less time chasing information and more time acting on the insights that make our operations safer for people and the environment.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for safety, health and environmental performance Automate the reporting that’s currently manual - using Power Automate, Power Apps, Forms and AI tools such as Copilot Own the quality of our SHE data: collect it, check it, and make sure what we report is right, first time Spot trends and outliers, explain what they mean, and help us decide where to focus next to improve SHE performance Work with operations, engineering, finance and our global SHE teams to turn the data into action 

All About You

What we’re looking for

Strong digital, analytical and data communication skills (or the appetite and evidence that you can get there fast) Confidence working with imperfect data - cleaning, modelling and making it trustworthy Curiosity about how a factory works and a genuine interest in health, safety and sustainability A degree, apprenticeship or demonstrable self-taught capability in data, analytics or a related field 

You don’t need

A SHE qualification – we’ll teach you the safety and environment side Manufacturing experience – we’ll show you the factory floor 

What You’ll Get

Real ownership from day one - this will be your remit, with the autonomy to build tools, improve processes and enable better data-led decisions A development pathway into SHE, data or both, with exposure to global Unilever teams A visible role with our site leadership team The opportunity to work within a fantastic team at a world-class manufacturing facility 

Interested but not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway – tell us what you’d automate first.

What We Offer

Not only do we offer a competitive salary and pension scheme, we also offer an annual bonus, subsidised gym membership, a discounted staff shop and shares. You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with our renowned and exciting brands in a flexible and hybrid working environment.

Whilst the role is advertised on a full-time basis, we would be happy to discuss possible flexible working options and what this may look like for you. We are a key advocate of wellbeing and offer a variety of support for our people including hubs, programmes and development opportunities. We strive to achieve a family-friendly and inclusive workplace and to, above all, create possibilities for all.

Diversity at Unilever is about inclusion, embracing differences, creating possibilities and growing together for better business performance. We embrace diversity in our workforce. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. We are also more than happy to provide reasonable adjustments during our application and interview process to enable you to be present your best self. To find out more, including about our Employee Resource Groups, please click here Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Unilever | Unilever.

Recruitment Fraud

Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. In the most sophisticated cases, they will set up fake websites, which have a similar address to companies like Unilever. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs.  These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate.

How is Unilever tackling this?

Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down.

What can I do?

If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat.

Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

rows.title: Strategy & Insights Analyst – 12-month Fixed-term contract
rows.descriptionText:
Join Barclays as a Strategy & Insights Analyst, where you will support the delivery of the Group Innovation and Partnerships Strategy & Insights agenda through market intelligence, customer and industry research, strategic analysis, and executive-ready insight generation. Working within a highly visible team, you will help shape Barclays' innovation priorities by analysing market and technology trends, producing thought leadership, horizon-scanning and predictive insight papers, and translating complex information into clear, actionable recommendations. This role offers broad exposure across the business, partnering with senior stakeholders to support innovation initiatives, portfolio governance activities, and evidence-based decision making that enables Barclays to identify, assess, and act on emerging opportunities and risks.

Please note that this is a 12-month fixed-term contract.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need


Ability to research market, customer, competitor and technology developments; analyse qualitative and quantitative information; and translate findings into clear, evidence-led recommendations.Ability to communicate complex information concisely, produce high-quality, decision-ready presentations and briefings, and tailor content effectively for senior stakeholders and external partners.Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining effective oversight of actions, risks, controls, decisions and dependencies.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include


Curiosity and practical understanding of AI, digital platforms and emerging technologies, including how they could improve customer outcomes, efficiency, insight or control.Previous exposure to innovation, strategy, market intelligence, commercial analysis, governance, reporting or programme delivery within financial services or a similarly regulated environment.Ability to learn quickly, seek and act on feedback, adapt to new subject areas and proactively build capability over time.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The successful candidate can be based in London (Luke Street) or Glasgow Campus.

Purpose of the role

To collaborate, nurture and drive group innovation with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the bank stays at the forefront of innovation and adapts to the rapidly changing landscape in financial services and increasing customer expectations.

Accountabilities


Collaboration with a range of stakeholders to develop a portfolio of open innovation and strategic initiatives through experimentation, co-creation, access to innovative technology capabilities, products and services and a global innovation ecosystem.Development and delivery of frameworks, ideation, training and tools to build a culture of innovation and knowledge sharing to enable new and creative ideas/solutions that deliver on the bank’s strategy.Provision of a global platform and curated ecosystem of partners to inform strategy, drive connectivity and new insights.Development of the strategic capabilities and programmes for the bank to deliver on its strategy, supporting the exploration, evaluation and execution of innovation and investment opportunities.Management and coordination between external stakeholders/partners and the bank, to successfully deliver joint projects and initiatives.Deliver thought leadership and insights to inform strategic decision making and organisational readiness, in conjunction with regular research, identifying emerging technologies and trends.Development and management of key metrics including key partnerships, innovation initiatives and impact through regular assessments to calculate the return on investment and identify any potential risks and issues.


Analyst Expectations


To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.Partner with other functions and business areas.Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.Escalate breaches of policies/procedure appropriately.Take responsibility for embedding new policies/procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex/sensitive information.Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Process Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Application Deadline: 23 September 2026Department: FundraisingLocation: Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity Compensation: £48,192 / year

Description

Are you an experienced Business or Process Analyst who enjoys untangling complex systems, understanding how data really works and finding better ways to connect the dots?

Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity is looking for a Process Analyst to help us build a clearer, more joined-up understanding of how data moves through our organisation.

This is a hands-on, data-focused role. You'll work across systems, teams and processes to map how information is captured, transformed and used; identify where things break down; and help create clearer rules and more sustainable ways of working.

You'll need to be comfortable getting into the detail of data, asking challenging questions and working closely with technical and non-technical colleagues to turn complexity into practical solutions.

Salary
The salary for this role is £48,192 per annum and this is a 12 month fixed term contract.

We operate a hybrid working policy of a minimum of 2 days per week in the office.

In line with our EDI strategy and Total Reward policy, we calculate our salaries based on benchmarking data across the charity sector. To ensure fairness for existing staff and new joiners, we do not offer salaries above the advertised rate.

Key Responsibilities

Build an end-to-end view of our data landscape, documenting how systems connect, how data moves between them and where key dependencies sit.Map complex data flows and business processes across platforms including Salesforce, Snowflake, Marketing Cloud and other connected systems.Identify duplication, manual workarounds, data quality issues and points of failure, digging into root causes rather than simply fixing individual problems.Help establish clear and consistent business definitions, data rules and governance across areas such as matching, deduplication, consent, retention and data ownership.Work with stakeholders to understand the business need before considering the technology solution, constructively challenging existing assumptions and ways of working.Translate complex business and data requirements into clear process maps, requirements, user stories and documentation that technical teams can use.Work closely with Data Management, Data Engineering, Salesforce and business teams to turn findings into practical improvements across systems and processes.Support new integrations, testing and implementation, ensuring changes work effectively across the whole data lifecycle rather than solving one part of the process in isolation.Create clear documentation that strengthens organisational knowledge and reduces reliance on individual or undocumented technical knowledge.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Experience working as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Data Management Analyst or in a similar role involving complex systems and data.Strong experience mapping and documenting end-to-end business processes, system interactions or data flows.Experience working across integrated systems such as CRM, data warehouse, marketing automation or other enterprise platforms.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate problems, identify root causes and recommend sustainable improvements.An understanding of data management concepts such as data quality, governance, business rules, data lineage and ownership.Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with the confidence to ask challenging questions and constructively challenge established ways of working.Ability to translate between business and technical teams, making complex requirements clear and understandable.Strong documentation and process-mapping skills, with the ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous or complex problems.Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake or Marketing Cloud would be useful, but specific platform expertise isn't essential.DBS - note a basic DBS check is required for this role

How to Apply
Please click on the apply button in the top right-hand corner where you will be taken to a short application form to complete.

Closing date: 23 September 2026

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to close the roles prior to the closing date should suitable applicants be found. Therefore, you are encouraged to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Benefits

30 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) A flexible approach to working arrangements. Access to our enhanced pension scheme Life assuranceAccess to various health and wellbeing schemes, including the employee assistance programme.

rows.title: Intelligence Analyst, Risk & Investigations
rows.descriptionText:
We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.



Job Description

Sportradar Integrity Services is part of the Sportradar Group and the world’s leading supplier of sports integrity solutions. Risk & Investigations is a subunit of Sportradar Integrity Services and supports its partners, which include sports governing bodies, anti-doping organisations, clubs, state authorities, law enforcement agencies and private organisations, in identifying and investigating integrity threats to their organisations and jurisdictions. R&I specialises in providing a robust due diligence programme through vetting individuals and entities, as well as providing intelligence and investigative support to combat doping, online abuse, misconduct, fraudulent behaviour, and broader corruption threats.



The Intelligence Analyst, Risk & Investigations, will be responsible for contributing to all aspects of Sportradar’s intelligence and investigation activity. The role demands a dedicated, forward-thinking intelligence/due diligence professional who will thrive working in a ground-breaking and fast-paced company.

 

THE CHALLENGE 

Lead and conduct due diligence products and complex intelligence-led investigations using an all-source approach.Collect, analyse and evaluate sensitive information and datasets.Perform advanced Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) research and analysis in order to support investigations and due diligence projects.Produce a variety of intelligence products, including both short and extensive written reports.Develop and maintain intelligence holdings and datasets.Contribute to the identification, cultivation and management of Human Intelligence (HUMINT) sources.Work closely across multiple Sportradar functions and departments to protect and enhance Sportradar business operations, including internal and external training and education on sports integrity.  ABOUT YOU

 

Relevant operational experience in research, due diligence, intelligence or investigations from areas such as law enforcement, journalism, corporate intelligence, or financial fraud.Proficiency in OSINT tools, techniques, methodologies, and the analysis of diverse data sources and large datasets.Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify patterns and develop hypotheses.Exceptional attention to detail, organisation, record-keeping, and documentation skills.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly present findings to a variety of audiences.Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.Ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to changing circumstances, and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.High standards of confidentiality, integrity, and professionalism.Self-motivated, inquisitive, and proactive with a continuous learning mindset.Confidence in delivering presentations and facilitating discussions with stakeholders.Broad understanding of global sport and awareness of integrity challenges, including sport-related corruption.Knowledge of sports integrity programmes, initiatives, and investigative practices.Knowledge of HUMINT tradecraft is considered an advantage.Fluency in English is essential; professional proficiency in an additional language is strongly preferred.OUR OFFER:

A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours.While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together.

OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 

Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Hiring Team Interview: Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Assessment: Investigative task to showcase your technical skills. Final Steps: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! 

Additional Information

At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

rows.title: E+ Associate Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.

Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.

We connect. We inspire.

The Department for Education has announced that the British Council is set to take on the role of National Agency for Erasmus+.

In December the UK and EU arrived at a political agreement that the UK would rejoin the Erasmus+ scheme in 2027. That agreement has now been legally formalised under the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement.

The British Council has a longstanding commitment to supporting international exchange. It was a lead partner in the Erasmus+ UK National Agency from 2014-20, where Erasmus+ made a significant contribution to the UK's cultural relations activities, funding 8,091 projects, engaging 583,757 UK participants, and awarding around €1.1 billion to UK organisations.

Job Title: E+ Associate Business Intelligence Analyst

Pay Band: PB7

Contract Duration: 2 Year Fixed Term Contract with possibility of extension

Location: London, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Belfast

Salary : £32,381 annual Gross Salary

Right to Work Requirements: Current right to work in the UK. The British Council is not able to support or sponsor work visa applications.

Closing Date: Applications will close on Wednesday 20th September 2026 7:30 UK time.

We are operating on the basis that any offer is made pending client confirmation of funds.

Role Purpose

The Associate Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst will support the development and delivery of data analysis and data projects, delivering high-quality performance reporting and insight for the Erasmus+ programme. The role involves working closely with the wider data function and aligned to central DEP standards, and support delivery of KPIs data, dashboards, visualisations and management information, under supervision, for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring outputs are accurate, consistent, and timely. The postholder will help the team translate complex data into clear, actionable insights to support performance monitoring, identify risks and opportunities, and drive continuous improvement across the programme.

Main Accountabilities But Not Limited To The Following

Contribute to the development and maintenance of Erasmus+ performance reporting frameworks, ensuring alignment with programme objectives, KPIs, and DfE/EC requirements.Collect, prepare, and manage data from multiple programme systems and delivery partners, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and fitness for purpose.Support the BI and Reporting Analyst in translating complex programme data into clear narratives and actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI) to support programme monitoring and reporting.Support teams in identifying key operational and performance questions, defining data needs to inform decision-making.Conduct analysis on programme delivery, participant journeys, and operational performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.Ensure all data and reporting activities comply with data governance, ethics, and privacy standards.Collaborate with data, digital, and technology teams to improve data quality, integration, and accessibility across Erasmus+.Contribute to wider British Council data best practice and learning, ensuring alignment with central DEP approaches.

INTRODUCTION

At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. This is the core belief that has guided Burberry since it was founded in 1856 and is central to how we operate as a company today.

We aim to provide an environment for creative minds from different backgrounds to thrive, bringing a wide range of skills and experiences to everything we do. As a purposeful, values-driven brand, we are committed to being a force for good in the world as well, creating the next generation of sustainable luxury for customers, driving industry change and championing our communities.

Job Purpose

The Client Experience & Insights Analyst plays a key role in understanding customer sentiment and identifying opportunities to enhance the end-to-end customer experience. Working closely with Customer Service, Global Client, CRM, Digital, IT and other business functions, the role is responsible for transforming customer feedback, operational and commercial data into actionable insights that drive customer satisfaction, loyalty and business performance.

The role is responsible for Customer Experience reporting, Voice of Customer (VoC) programmes and quality monitoring, while supporting customer experience systems, data integrations and transformation initiatives.

This role is based in our London office and requires a minimum of four days per week onsite.

Responsibilities

Customer Experience Insights & Reporting

Own and develop Customer Experience reporting, including NPS, CSAT and Voice of Customer (VoC), providing visibility of customer sentiment, performance and key trends across customer touchpoints.Analyse customer feedback, operational and commercial data to identify trends, root causes and opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, the customer journey and business performance.Own and lead the internal quality monitoring programme across global regions, partnering closely with regional teams to analyse customer insights, identify coaching opportunities and drive continuous improvement in alignment with the established quality framework.Develop and maintain executive dashboards, reports and presentations, translating complex data into clear insights, recommendations and strategic narratives for senior stakeholders.Support the development and enhancement of Tableau dashboards and reporting solutions, leveraging data from multiple business systems and data platforms (e.g. SAP HANA, Databricks) to deliver actionable insights and support customer-centric and commercially driven decision-making.Drive continuous improvement in customer experience measurement, data quality, reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities.

Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership

Partner with Customer Service, Retail, Global Client, CRM, Marketing, Ecommerce, Digital, IT and Technology teams to support strategic initiatives, continuous improvement and customer-centric decision-making.Build strong cross-functional relationships and act as a trusted advisor on customer experience performance and Voice of Customer insights.

Customer Experience Systems & Data

Support the development, integration and optimisation of customer experience systems, platforms and data sources in partnership with IT, Digital, CRM and Customer Service teams.Act as the Voice of Customer subject matter expert for system implementations, integrations, migrations and transformation initiatives, ensuring customer feedback and experience measures are embedded within new solutions.Support the governance and integration of customer experience data across CRM, messaging, contact centre and feedback platforms to enable consistent reporting and actionable insights.Identify opportunities to enhance customer experience measurement, reporting automation and data integration through a strong understanding of customer service technologies and data architecture.

PERSONAL PROFILE

Experience within Customer Experience (CX), NPS, CSAT, Voice of Customer (VoC), customer insight reporting and customer satisfaction programmes.Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, root causes and opportunities, and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to analyse data, create impactful visualisations and deliver executive-level presentations.Experience using customer feedback platforms such as Qualtrics, Medallia or similar Voice of Customer tools.Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using analytics platforms, including Tableau, and translating business requirements into meaningful insights.Strong interest in customer experience technology, data architecture and systems integration, with experience supporting implementation, migration or transformation projects.Experience with Salesforce and customer service technologies is advantageous.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build effective relationships across global cross-functional teams.Proactive, highly organised and adaptable, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Experience within luxury retail, retail, ecommerce or customer service environments, with an understanding of luxury customer expectations and service excellence preferred.

rows.title: Consultant, Business Intelligence
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

FTI Consulting is seeking a highly motivated, Consultant to join its Business Intelligence team in London. The Business Intelligence team conducts corporate investigations, uncovers actionable business intelligence, supports clients in commercial disputes, and provides clear analysis to help decision-makers address and mitigate risk, protect assets and maximise opportunities in a variety of jurisdictions worldwide. Its expertise lies in investigative due diligence, asset tracing, fraud and anti-corruption investigations, litigation support, whistle-blower allegations, third-party integrity screening, political risk assessments and other bespoke engagements.

What You’ll Do 

The Consultant will conduct research on a range of complex and multi-jurisdictional projects, including investigative due diligence, asset traces, fraud investigations and political risk assessments. Consultants are expected to conduct independent, first-class research and analysis, drawing upon the range of search engines and databases generally available, and those available to the company. They will be required to demonstrate flexibility, critical thinking and the ability to identify relevant lines of inquiry.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Preparation of client deliverables via oversight of the desktop research;Contribute to briefings for external resources, such as sub contractors;Maintenance of case deadlines, and verbal and/or written updates to the Client, to ensure the timely reporting of client deliverables;Involvement in overall case project management and administration;Support research and drafting of project proposals and broader business development initiatives;Contribute to identifying and developing resources useful for investigative research; and,Consult with and take direction from case managers and clients on project status, timing, and deliverables.

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need To Succeed

The successful candidate will be an analytically minded researcher with excellent writing skills and a strong work ethic. They must have experience working in a commercial environment. They will be a self-starter who takes initiative in their approach to work and a team player who is able to easily engage with management, other consultants, and clients. A skilled communicator, they will be able to convey complex ideas clearly and nimbly articulate their findings to internal and external audiences. They must exhibit an inquisitive mindset and the ability to think laterally about complex problems. This role is well-suited for a young professional who is enthusiastic about the sector and is eager to hone their research skills and grow their project management skills with the view to establish their career in the business intelligence industry.

As a Consultant in the Business Intelligence team, you will have the opportunity to work on cross-segment projects with other teams within Forensic and Litigation Consulting, such as Forensic Accounting Advisory Services, Financial Services, and Data and Analytics, as well as other practices within FTI Consulting, such as Strategic Communications, Economic and Financial Consulting, and Technology.

Job Description

Working within the Rights & Revenue Protection (RRP) team, the Intelligence Analyst will support investigations relating to the protection of Sportradar's intellectual property and revenue recovery activities across Europe and North America. 

The role focuses on identifying and assessing threats to Sportradar's content, data and commercial interests, including unauthorised data usage, piracy and intellectual property infringement. Using a range of open-source, cyber and commercial data sources, the analyst will deliver intelligence that supports enforcement activity, commercial outcomes and strategic decision-making. 

The position requires a motivated intelligence professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and supports stakeholders across the wider Sportradar Group.

THE CHALLENGE 

Conduct intelligence investigations using an all-source approach across rights protection, enforcement and revenue recovery matters. Collect, analyse and evaluate intelligence from open-source, cyber and commercial sources. Conduct OSINT and CYBINT/DNINT investigations to produce actionable intelligence and recommendations. Identify and investigate unauthorised use of Sportradar data, content and intellectual property. Develop and maintain intelligence holdings relating to organisations, individuals and platforms operating across Europe and North America. Monitor emerging risks and trends relevant to intellectual property protection, piracy, sports betting and revenue recovery. Produce intelligence reports, analytical assessments and stakeholder briefings. Support enforcement and commercial recovery initiatives through intelligence development and research. Work closely across multiple Sportradar functions and departments to protect and enhance Sportradar business operations, including internal and external training and education on sports integrity. ABOUT YOU

2+ years' experience in intelligence, investigations, law enforcement, journalism, cyber security, financial crime, fraud, due diligence or a related analytical field. Experience conducting analytical investigations and producing intelligence-led outputs. Demonstrable expertise in OSINT, HUMINT, CYBINT/DNINT or comparable intelligence methodologies. Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to collect, evaluate and interpret information from multiple sources and produce actionable intelligence. Knowledge of online ecosystems, digital platforms and investigative research techniques. Awareness of data protection legislation and associated implications. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professionalism.Ability to manage changing priorities and work effectively under pressure and to tight deadlines.Fluency in English essential, professional working proficiency in French or another living language strongly preferred. Advantageous 

Experience using intelligence analysis tools such as i2 Analyst's Notebook, Maltego or similar. Knowledge of the international sports betting, gaming, media or anti-piracy landscapes. Professional networks or regional knowledge across Europe and/or North America. Experience conducting investigations relating to intellectual property infringement, brand protection, digital piracy or revenue recovery. Understanding of corporate structures, beneficial ownership research and due diligence methodologies. Experience working with commercial intelligence databases and specialist investigative tools. Relevant intelligence, investigation or analytical certifications. OUR OFFER:

A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours.While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together.

OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 

Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Hiring Team Interview: Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Assessment: Investigative task to showcase your technical skills. Final Steps: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! 

Additional Information

At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

You'll be responsible for reviewing AI-generated outcomes, validating results against available evidence and ensuring decisions are applied fairly, consistently and accurately before they are used in downstream sales and operational processes. rows.title: Business Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As a Business Analyst at MACH, you will act as the critical bridge between our financial services clients and our software development teams. You will be responsible for eliciting, analysing, and translating complex business requirements, particularly across digital assets, tokenisation, and market infrastructure, into clear, actionable user stories and functional specifications that drive delivery.

This role suits a commercially minded analyst who is equally comfortable in client workshops and sprint planning sessions, someone who understands how capital markets and digital asset ecosystems operate, and who can engage credibly with both business stakeholders and engineering teams to ensure solutions are delivered that genuinely meet client needs.

Responsibilities

Job requirements

Lead requirements-gathering sessions with clients, facilitating workshops to elicit, challenge, and validate business needs across digital asset and financial services use cases.Translate business requirements into well-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications suitable for Agile development teams.Document current-state business processes, workflows, and use cases, verifying accuracy with clients and internal teams before baseline sign-off.Identify process improvement opportunities and work with clients and internal stakeholders to design future-state operating models, particularly in the context of digital asset adoption and tokenised workflows.Present and communicate specifications clearly to software development teams, ensuring requirements are understood, estimated, and prioritised appropriately within the product backlog.Act as the client-side voice throughout the development lifecycle, providing ongoing clarification, managing scope, and ensuring delivered functionality remains aligned with original business intent.Support and oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), verifying that software functionality meets agreed requirements and specifications before client sign-off.Support clients in articulating and documenting their own business requirements where needed, acting as a trusted advisor rather than simply an order-taker.Deliver training, presentations, and demonstrations of MACH’s software to clients and internal staff, ensuring adoption and understanding of new functionality.Identify, escalate, and help resolve issues or blockers experienced by clients or internal team members, maintaining clear communication throughout.

Requirements

Fin-Tech, consulting or client-facing experience within financial services, ideally across capital markets, post-trade, or digital assets.Solid understanding of market infrastructure, including trading, clearing, settlement, custody, or tokenisation workflows.Demonstrable experience writing high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications for software development teams.Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and working within cross-functional delivery teams.Sufficient technical literacy to engage meaningfully with software developers, understanding of system integrations, APIs, and data flows, without needing to write code.Excellent client relationship skills with a proven track record of building trust and managing expectations across technical and non-technical stakeholders.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data flows and operational processes and translate them into clear requirements.Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Excel, and process modelling or diagramming software (e.g. Visio, Lucidchart).Capable of producing clear, concise, and well-structured documentation including business requirements documents (BRDs), process maps, and test scripts.

How We Work

Delta Capita is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, colour, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require any reasonable adjustments through your interview process, please inform us.

This is a permanent full-time position. As the selection and interview process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible, if your profile is selected, a member of our team will contact you within 4 weeks.

Who We Are

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. Our mission is to reinvent the financial services value chain providing technology based mutualized services for financial institutions for non-differentiating services.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Ecommerce Analyst &nbs...

Job Title: Ecommerce Analyst

Salary: £36,000 - £41,000 dependant on skills and experiences up to 15% bonus + health + 10% matched pension + bens

Contract Type: Permanent

Location: Office based - Chancery Lane

Role Overview

Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful insight that drives real commercial impact? We’re looking for an ambitious E-commerce Analyst to join a fast-paced, collaborative team where your work will directly shape digital performance and customer experience.

In this role, you’ll sit at the heart of our E-commerce function, owning and analysing website and app performance to unlock growth opportunities. From tracking daily conversion and revenue trends to delivering deep-dive performance insights, you’ll play a critical role in helping the business understand what drives success and where to go next.

What makes this role exciting? You won’t just report on performance, you’ll influence it. You’ll lead insights in weekly trading forums, collaborate with teams across Marketing, Product and CRM, and contribute to the launch of new features, campaigns and A/B tests. Whether it’s uncovering hidden customer behaviours, improving conversion journeys, or calculating the true impact of campaigns, your analysis will directly shape decision-making at a senior level.

You’ll also have the opportunity to refine and advance our testing capability by supporting sophisticated A/B experimentation, analysing long-term performance trends and helping embed a genuinely data-driven culture. This is a role where curiosity, creativity and analytical thinking are rewarded, and where your work can tangibly improve the customer experience.

Minimum Criteria

 Deep knowledge of web analytics platforms (e.g. Adobe Analytics)

Ability to confidently use web analytics tools to interpret end-to-end customer journeys, monitor KPIs, deep-dive into performance fluctuations and surface actionable insights that drive commercial performance.

 Experience supporting a trading-focused commercial team

Proven experience working within an e-commerce or trading environment, translating performance data into clear insights that drive revenue, conversion, and influence testing ideation.

 Advanced knowledge of A/B testing and optimisation

Strong understanding of experimentation methodologies, including test set up, statistical significance, and incrementality, with the ability to evaluate and improve site performance.

 Experience with BI and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI)

Skilled in building and interpreting dashboards to communicate performance trends, ensuring stakeholders have clear, accurate, and actionable reporting.

 Intermediate SQL skills

Comfortable querying large datasets to extract, manipulate, and analyse data, supporting deeper insight generation beyond standard reporting tools.

We believe that everyone is unique and there should be no barriers to entry and no limits to ambition. We are committed to being an inclusive organisation that values diversity and welcomes your application whatever your background or situation.

Under-represented groups such as women, ethnic minorities, people with disabilities & members of the LGBTQIA+ community (those who identify as lesbian, gay, bi, trans and non-binary or those who use a different LGBTQIA+ term), are strongly encouraged to build a career with us. Speak to us about workplace adjustments, part-time and flexible working. Where possible we will support this.

rows.title: Financial Analyst, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services (Structured Products), 2026 Graduate - London
rows.descriptionText:
Business Unit:

Financial And Valuation Advisory

Industry:

Portfolio Valuation

Overview

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.

Financial and Valuation Advisory

Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.

 Structured Products Group

The Structured Products Group resides within Houlihan Lokey’s Financial and Valuation Advisory division. We value instruments from the full universe of structured credit products, including: large portfolios of mortgages, capital relief trades, CLOs, ABS, and bespoke transactions. Our clients are among the largest banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and insurers in the world.

A solid academic grounding, high attention to detail, and the ability to reason from first principles are essential. In addition to performing valuation analysis, our London team is encouraged to build and maintain technology underpinning the various processes that make up much of our work flow (pricing models, cashflow engines, data infrastructure, dashboarding, etc.), in order to increase efficiency while maintaining the highest levels of accuracy and transparency. The instruments we deal in are complex and we often work towards tight deadlines, particularly around busier times of the financial cycle.

Role

Learn structured credit from first principles, and how different levers drive outcomes.Build and refine the data sets and valuation algorithms used to price thousands of securities daily.Analyse client portfolios of structured credit securities.Model bespoke transactions in Excel, Python, and our in-house cashflow modelling tool.Identify and automate process bottlenecks.Handle client queries, engagement, and run product demonstrations.

Candidate Requirements

Must be a 2026 GraduateA strong record in a numerate or hard-science discipline.Curiosity about how financial markets work.Self-directed, comfortable thinking from first principles, and able to operate in a small, demanding team in a highly collegiate environment.

Useful, But Not Required

We do not require prior finance, modelling, or programming experience. However if you have a background applying Excel, Python, or C# to creatively solve problems, we encourage you to mention it in your application.

Interview process

After you apply, you should hear back from us within two weeks if we intend to progress your application. The process below is indicative; stages may shift depending on availability of our team.

Round 1: Remote. You will receive a short Excel task involving a structured finance deal scenario. No finance background is required. You will have 48 hours to return it, though we expect it to only take a couple of hours of focused work. You will then have two interviews via Microsoft Teams with senior members of the team, one of which will focus on your approach to the task.

Round 2: In person, Mayfair office. A half-day in our London office, meeting additional team members for a mix of logic-based problem-solving and conversations about your interests and motivations. Reasonable travel costs covered.

Round 3: In person, Mayfair office. A final conversation with senior members of the group covering fit, motivation, and any outstanding questions on either side.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

CI Projects is a boutique business consultancy committed to helping businesses continuously improve by enabling the true convergence of people, processes, and technology. We work closely with clients to define the issue, the destination, and how to get there – and then provide the tools and confidence so they can keep improving long after we’ve gone.

rows.title: Process Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Application Deadline: 23 September 2026Department: FundraisingLocation: Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity Compensation: £48,192 / year

Description

Are you an experienced Business or Process Analyst who enjoys untangling complex systems, understanding how data really works and finding better ways to connect the dots?

Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity is looking for a Process Analyst to help us build a clearer, more joined-up understanding of how data moves through our organisation.

This is a hands-on, data-focused role. You'll work across systems, teams and processes to map how information is captured, transformed and used; identify where things break down; and help create clearer rules and more sustainable ways of working.

You'll need to be comfortable getting into the detail of data, asking challenging questions and working closely with technical and non-technical colleagues to turn complexity into practical solutions.

Salary
The salary for this role is £48,192 per annum and this is a 12 month fixed term contract.

We operate a hybrid working policy of a minimum of 2 days per week in the office.

In line with our EDI strategy and Total Reward policy, we calculate our salaries based on benchmarking data across the charity sector. To ensure fairness for existing staff and new joiners, we do not offer salaries above the advertised rate.

Key Responsibilities

Build an end-to-end view of our data landscape, documenting how systems connect, how data moves between them and where key dependencies sit.Map complex data flows and business processes across platforms including Salesforce, Snowflake, Marketing Cloud and other connected systems.Identify duplication, manual workarounds, data quality issues and points of failure, digging into root causes rather than simply fixing individual problems.Help establish clear and consistent business definitions, data rules and governance across areas such as matching, deduplication, consent, retention and data ownership.Work with stakeholders to understand the business need before considering the technology solution, constructively challenging existing assumptions and ways of working.Translate complex business and data requirements into clear process maps, requirements, user stories and documentation that technical teams can use.Work closely with Data Management, Data Engineering, Salesforce and business teams to turn findings into practical improvements across systems and processes.Support new integrations, testing and implementation, ensuring changes work effectively across the whole data lifecycle rather than solving one part of the process in isolation.Create clear documentation that strengthens organisational knowledge and reduces reliance on individual or undocumented technical knowledge.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Experience working as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Data Management Analyst or in a similar role involving complex systems and data.Strong experience mapping and documenting end-to-end business processes, system interactions or data flows.Experience working across integrated systems such as CRM, data warehouse, marketing automation or other enterprise platforms.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate problems, identify root causes and recommend sustainable improvements.An understanding of data management concepts such as data quality, governance, business rules, data lineage and ownership.Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with the confidence to ask challenging questions and constructively challenge established ways of working.Ability to translate between business and technical teams, making complex requirements clear and understandable.Strong documentation and process-mapping skills, with the ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous or complex problems.Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake or Marketing Cloud would be useful, but specific platform expertise isn't essential.DBS - note a basic DBS check is required for this role

How to Apply
Please click on the apply button in the top right-hand corner where you will be taken to a short application form to complete.

Closing date: 23 September 2026

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to close the roles prior to the closing date should suitable applicants be found. Therefore, you are encouraged to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Benefits

30 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) A flexible approach to working arrangements. Access to our enhanced pension scheme Life assuranceAccess to various health and wellbeing schemes, including the employee assistance programme.

rows.title: Strategy & Insights Analyst – 12-month Fixed-term contract
rows.descriptionText:
Join Barclays as a Strategy & Insights Analyst, where you will support the delivery of the Group Innovation and Partnerships Strategy & Insights agenda through market intelligence, customer and industry research, strategic analysis, and executive-ready insight generation. Working within a highly visible team, you will help shape Barclays' innovation priorities by analysing market and technology trends, producing thought leadership, horizon-scanning and predictive insight papers, and translating complex information into clear, actionable recommendations. This role offers broad exposure across the business, partnering with senior stakeholders to support innovation initiatives, portfolio governance activities, and evidence-based decision making that enables Barclays to identify, assess, and act on emerging opportunities and risks.

Please note that this is a 12-month fixed-term contract.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need


Ability to research market, customer, competitor and technology developments; analyse qualitative and quantitative information; and translate findings into clear, evidence-led recommendations.Ability to communicate complex information concisely, produce high-quality, decision-ready presentations and briefings, and tailor content effectively for senior stakeholders and external partners.Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining effective oversight of actions, risks, controls, decisions and dependencies.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include


Curiosity and practical understanding of AI, digital platforms and emerging technologies, including how they could improve customer outcomes, efficiency, insight or control.Previous exposure to innovation, strategy, market intelligence, commercial analysis, governance, reporting or programme delivery within financial services or a similarly regulated environment.Ability to learn quickly, seek and act on feedback, adapt to new subject areas and proactively build capability over time.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The successful candidate can be based in London (Luke Street) or Glasgow Campus.

Purpose of the role

To collaborate, nurture and drive group innovation with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the bank stays at the forefront of innovation and adapts to the rapidly changing landscape in financial services and increasing customer expectations.

Accountabilities

To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.Partner with other functions and business areas.Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.Escalate breaches of policies/procedure appropriately.Take responsibility for embedding new policies/procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex/sensitive information.Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Behavioural Analyst (UKSBA Membership Required)
rows.descriptionText:
ABOUT PSG 
We have a long and proud history of transforming the lives of children, young people and adults with learning disabilities, autism, and mental health difficulties.
We are the largest provider of Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) commissioned by the NHS.
We also work in provider organisations in community settings.
Our goal is to give individuals, their parents / carers, and network of professionals the knowledge, skills, and motivation they need to provide the best possible support and to increase their quality of life in sustainable and long-lasting ways.
We achieve these incredible outcomes by developing evidence-based, contextually fit models of support for individuals and their support networks in the various settings they live.
We are a team of value-driven Behaviour Analysts and PBS Practitioners. We embody our values in everything we do.
PSG VALUES
Passionate – To be fully committed to the work that we do and take a vested interest in the successes of our clients and the company.
Authentic – To be our honest, true, and best selves at work.
Courageous – To push through discomfort and adversity to realise our values and cultivate courageous cultures in our workplace and networks.
Collaborative – To share our ambitions and achieve them together.
Trustworthy – To be arbiters of the truth, modelling integrity and applying our expertise effectively.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Salary £35,000 - £40,000 d.o.e.
The Behaviour Analyst is responsible for managing a caseload of complex clients, delivering assessments and interventions that lead to positive changes for the individual, their families, and wider support networks. This will require flexibility in approach and delivery across a variety of settings—including schools, hospitals, community environments, and supported living services. The role demands a solution-focused, values-led mindset with the resilience to navigate complex situations. To be successful in this role, employees will:
Have a high degree of empathy and a strong value-base.
Communicate calmly and effectively in situations which may be emotionally or physically challenging.
Collaboratively engage a client and their network in the process of our support and identify quality of life goals.
Collaborate with stakeholders to remove barriers impacting an individual’s quality of life.
Undertake functional behaviour assessments (FBA) and / or practical functional assessments to develop formulations for clients.
Write high-quality FBA reports and present findings to clients, their families / carers and network.
Plan interventions based on FBA report findings.

Responsible for the development and execution of analyses that address specific client issues or initiatives. The Consultant liaises directly with client services, network development, and operational personnel, and engages directly with clients to ensure the appropriateness of underlying assumptions and interpretations, and to provide expert direction on client analytics solutions/services, both internally and externally.

Lead the development and delivery of client analytics and reporting activities, driving client relationship building, and managing the overall project lifecycle of externally focused analytic deliverables.Independently develop and refine methodologies, tools, and templates to allow for the successful execution of analytic deliverables. Candidate will have at least 2 years of experience in analytics/reporting, with a strong focus on client-facing roles or significant project ownership. Successful candidates may bring experience from an agency, client, or consulting environment. Bachelor’s degree required.

Proven ability to utilize and expand prospective business models.Technical Abilities - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (including advanced functions, VBA), and strong experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, MicroStrategy) for dashboard development and data visualization. Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation is required. Builds strong networks and acts as a trusted advisor.Organizing and Planning - Demonstrated ability to independently plan, organize, and prioritize multiple complex projects, effectively balancing resources, skills, priorities, and timescales to achieve objectives.Adaptability - Adaptable and proactive in responding to changing circumstances, effectively managing, solving problems, and providing innovative solutions in ambiguous environments.Communicating Effectively – Written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to adjust messaging to fit diverse audiences and deliver compelling presentations that drive action.Team Player – Proven ability to manage strong working relationships within the company, and actively contribute to team knowledge sharing, mentorship, and best practices.Critical Thinking – Strong in using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to complex problems.Plan for Contingencies – Proactively identifies potential problems and independently creates robust contingency plans or “work-arounds” to ensure project success.Understanding the Business – Knows the mission-critical technical and functional skills needed; understands various types of business propositions and how businesses operate. Always improve, Always Advance - Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen
