rows.title: Customer Insights & Modelling Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Caffè Nero operates around 1,000 coffee houses in the UK, the Republic of Ireland, the US, Poland, Cyprus, Turkey, the Middle East and Sweden and is Europe’s leading independent premium coffee house. Now employing circa 10,000 employees, since we opened in 1997 we have been providing exceptional, hand-crafted Italian coffee and fresh, high-quality food to customers seeking an authentic, Italian experience. The UK Caffè Nero Group comprises of Caffè Nero UK, Harris + Hoole, FCB Coffee, 200 Degrees and Coffee#1.
The role:We are looking for a Customer Insights & Modelling Executive at Caffè Nero. The role is based at our offices in Covent Garden, Central London.
Reporting to the Senior Customer Marketing Manager, the Customer Insights & Modelling Executive will analyse and interpret customer-level data to generate actionable insight that improves CRM effectiveness, loyalty engagement and customer value.
The role will work across first-party transactional and loyalty data, brand tracking, CRM performance and customer experience survey data to understand customer behaviour, identify growth opportunities and support more effective targeting. Working with our data agency and internal development teams, they will help develop segmentation, propensity models and lifecycle targeting that support activation, growth, retention and reactivation.
Key accountabilities for this role include:
Customer insight and analysisAnalyse customer data across transactional, loyalty, CRM, brand tracking and experience survey sources.Identify actionable insight around customer frequency, spend, product preferences, loyalty participation, attachment, lifecycle stage, lapse risk and reactivation opportunity.Translate customer data into clear recommendations that support CRM planning, campaign targeting, product opportunities and commercial decision-making.
Segmentation, modelling and agency collaborationWork with the nominated data agency to develop and maintain customer segmentation frameworks and propensity models.Support models including likelihood to lapse, likelihood to respond, likelihood to buy specific products and likelihood to increase frequency.Turn segmentation and model outputs into practical audience recommendations for CRM campaigns and lifecycle journeys.
CRM operations and automationSupport the development, implementation and optimisation of CRM flows, automations and customer journeys.Develop audience selections, campaign logic, targeting rules and suppression criteria using available customer data and segmentation.Ensure CRM activity is correctly configured, tested, launched and monitored, with strong QA, scheduling, controls and reporting discipline.
Campaign measurement and optimisationMeasure the performance of CRM campaigns, lifecycle journeys and customer marketing activity across engagement, conversion, visit behaviour, revenue and incremental uplift where possible.Support test-and-learn activity including A/B testing, control groups, offer testing and journey optimisation.Identify what is working, what is underperforming and what should be scaled, changed or stopped.
The right person:Caffè Nero is a company with a very special culture and an open and friendly style of working. It operates at pace and is a high-energy, invigorating environment. It attracts people with warmth and a positive outlook who genuinely enjoy working with people.
Whichever country you’re in, Caffè Nero has a culture in which close-knit relationships and trust are at its heart. At Caffè Nero, you truly feel part of a kind and caring family.The Customer Insights & Modelling Executive will be analytical, commercially curious and highly practical. They will enjoy finding the useful signal in complex customer data and turning it into clear decisions, better targeting and more effective customer journeys.
The successful candidate will have:Experience analysing customer, loyalty, CRM, transactional or behavioural data in a consumer-facing business.Strong analytical capability, with confidence interpreting data, identifying patterns and translating analysis into practical recommendations.Experience working with segmentation, propensity models, lifecycle targeting or customer value analysis.Understanding of CRM campaign planning, journey logic, audience selection, testing, QA and performance reporting.Ability to work with agencies, data teams and non-technical stakeholders to turn business questions into usable insight outputs.Strong attention to detail and operational discipline, particularly around campaign setup, measurement and data quality.Experience with loyalty programmes, marketing automation platforms, BI tools, SQL, Python, retail or hospitality data would be an advantage.
Being part of the Caffè Nero Team:A wonderful place to work, right in the middle of bustling Covent Garden (our Head Office Teams are currently working a minimum of 3 days a week in the office).Access to our benefits platform, giving discounts at the touch of a button.25 days holiday per annum (plus bank holidays), rising with service.Bonus scheme.50% employee discount on handcrafted drinks and 40% employee discount on food.Private medical care through Vitality.Medicash (cash plan healthcare scheme).Supporting our team members to achieve their professional goals is important to us, so alongside your day to day work you may have an opportunity to complete a professional qualification with our learning partners.Free hand-crafted drinks whilst you’re in the office - in your first week you’ll have Barista training, so you’ll know how to make the very best Caffè Nero coffee.

rows.title: AI Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At Bionic, we're on a mission to make it radically easier to run a small business. As the UK's leading business comparison and switching service, we help thousands of small and medium-sized businesses save time and money on essentials like energy, broadband, insurance, and finance. We combine smart technology with real human support to match our customers with the best deals - quickly and effortlessly. With trusted partnerships including Compare the Market, USwitch for Business, MoneySuperMarket and Confused.com, we're committed to help SMEs get the best deals for their business essentials every time. The role 
We're looking for detail-oriented and analytical AI Operations Analysts to play a critical role in supporting the governance and quality assurance of AI-driven processes across Bionic. As part of our Business Excellence function, you'll sit at the intersection of Operations, Compliance and AI Innovation. You'll be responsible for reviewing AI-generated outcomes, validating results against available evidence and ensuring decisions are applied fairly, consistently and accurately before they are used in downstream sales and operational processes. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with AI technologies while helping shape how AI is used responsibly in a fast-growing business. If you're naturally curious, highly organised and enjoy solving problems through evidence-based decision making, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities 
AI Validation & Quality Assurance Validate AI-generated outcomes across Energy and Insurance before they are used in business processes. Review call recordings, transcripts and AI rationale to determine whether outcomes are accurate and appropriately applied. Identify true fails, false fails, accepted exceptions and potential technical issues. Ensure validation activities are completed accurately and consistently against agreed criteria. Analysis & Reporting Update system records and validation fields to ensure reporting remains accurate and reliable. Support monthly reporting cycles through completion of validation reviews and challenge processes. Conduct periodic sampling activities to identify potential false-pass trends and support ongoing assurance. Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for validation decisions and escalations. Continuous Improvement Track recurring validation themes, process gaps and AI tool limitations. Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and reporting accuracy. Escalate technical issues and recurring system challenges to relevant stakeholders. Contribute insights that support the ongoing evolution of AI-supported workflows and governance. Support the fair, transparent and evidence-led use of AI outputs across the organisation. Build strong working relationships across technical and operational teams to drive positive outcomes. 
About you 
We're looking for people who combine strong analytical thinking with exceptional attention to detail. You'll be comfortable working with data, applying defined criteria consistently and making objective decisions based on evidence. You'll likely have: Excellent attention to detail and a highly accurate approach to work. Strong judgement and the ability to make fair, evidence-based decisions. The ability to identify patterns, trends, process issues and root causes. Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly document decisions. Confidence in escalating complex, unclear or high-risk issues when required. Experience working with multiple stakeholders across operational, compliance or technical teams. The ability to manage competing priorities while meeting important deadlines. A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive information. Required skills & experience Strong IT literacy with experience using business systems and learning new technologies quickly. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Teams. Experience working with structured data and reporting outputs. Ability to identify and document technical issues, data gaps and process failures. Desirable Skills & Experience Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms. Experience using Tableau or other reporting and analytics tools. Experience reviewing customer interactions, call recordings or transcripts. Exposure to AI tools, speech analytics, quality monitoring or automated evaluation systems. Experience within compliance, quality assurance, audit, sales support or operational controls environments. Knowledge of the Energy and/or Insurance sectors. 
The interview process 
Initial one-way video interview Final stage in person interview with the Hiring Manager 
About Bionic Group 
Bionic has over 600 people working across three office locations and four businesses; Bionic - London, Bionic Outbound - Luton, Think Business Loans - Chelmsford, Utility Bidder - Corby and Smart - Field based agents. We have a high energy work environment wherever the location; you can feel the passion the moment you walk through our door! Our work environments are packed with amazing people and energy, hubs of collaboration, creativity and fun! We're one team, we get stuck in, we roll our sleeves up and we care about helping each other out wherever we can. We set the highest standards and show up every day to be the best version of ourselves. Working at Bionic means provides you many opportunities to advance your career, with incredible progression, recognition, and reward. Benefits 
We know that our employees are what sets us aside from our competitors, our benefits are just part of the way we say thanks. Enhance your health & wellbeing 🌱 Private healthcare cover Employee Assistance Programme, including a virtual GP service, priority physio & talking therapies Eyecare scheme Taking time away from work 🏖️ 25 days annual leave plus the 8 UK bank holidays, increasing with tenure 1 paid family/religious day of leave per year - following successful probation period 1 paid charity volunteering day per year Option to buy/sell up to an additional 3 days leave per year  Family matters: for the special moments 🏠 Enhanced maternity, paternity or shared parental leave 2 days off for your wedding upon joining, and up to 5 days after 2 years' service Flexible working options & a hybrid work approach Financial wellbeing 💸 Auto-enrolled salary sacrifice pension scheme Life assurance Season ticket Loans, salary advances & loans to buy/rent a home - based on tenure Cycle to work scheme Recognition 🌟 Highflyers incentive, a VIP experience for our high performers across Bionic group to celebrate success Company summer & Christmas party celebrations, business and local zonely & annual awards and recognition Long service awards

rows.title: Consultant, Business Intelligence
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

FTI Consulting is seeking a highly motivated, Consultant to join its Business Intelligence team in London. The Business Intelligence team conducts corporate investigations, uncovers actionable business intelligence, supports clients in commercial disputes, and provides clear analysis to help decision-makers address and mitigate risk, protect assets and maximise opportunities in a variety of jurisdictions worldwide. Its expertise lies in investigative due diligence, asset tracing, fraud and anti-corruption investigations, litigation support, whistle-blower allegations, third-party integrity screening, political risk assessments and other bespoke engagements.

What You’ll Do 

The Consultant will conduct research on a range of complex and multi-jurisdictional projects, including investigative due diligence, asset traces, fraud investigations and political risk assessments. Consultants are expected to conduct independent, first-class research and analysis, drawing upon the range of search engines and databases generally available, and those available to the company. They will be required to demonstrate flexibility, critical thinking and the ability to identify relevant lines of inquiry.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Preparation of client deliverables via oversight of the desktop research;Contribute to briefings for external resources, such as sub contractors;Maintenance of case deadlines, and verbal and/or written updates to the Client, to ensure the timely reporting of client deliverables;Involvement in overall case project management and administration;Support research and drafting of project proposals and broader business development initiatives;Contribute to identifying and developing resources useful for investigative research; and,Consult with and take direction from case managers and clients on project status, timing, and deliverables.

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need To Succeed

The successful candidate will be an analytically minded researcher with excellent writing skills and a strong work ethic. They must have experience working in a commercial environment. They will be a self-starter who takes initiative in their approach to work and a team player who is able to easily engage with management, other consultants, and clients. A skilled communicator, they will be able to convey complex ideas clearly and nimbly articulate their findings to internal and external audiences. They must exhibit an inquisitive mindset and the ability to think laterally about complex problems. This role is well-suited for a young professional who is enthusiastic about the sector and is eager to hone their research skills and grow their project management skills with the view to establish their career in the business intelligence industry.

As a Consultant in the Business Intelligence team, you will have the opportunity to work on cross-segment projects with other teams within Forensic and Litigation Consulting, such as Forensic Accounting Advisory Services, Financial Services, and Data and Analytics, as well as other practices within FTI Consulting, such as Strategic Communications, Economic and Financial Consulting, and Technology.

Basic Qualifications

Consultants should have at least one year of experience of conducting business intelligence and investigations.Demonstrated track record as an analyst on a range of projects, including pre-transactional due diligence, asset traces and fraud investigationsKnowledge of relevant research tools and databasesProven commercial writing style and analytical skillsExcellent written and oral English-language communication skills and knowledge of additional foreign languagesAbility to reliably meet deadlines and manage time sensitive matters.A sound understanding of legal, financial, AML, KYC and anti-bribery principles, as well as an interest in international affairs

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Italian, Polish, Russian, Swedish, Turkish or Arabic would be an advantageExperience living or working abroad is desirableExperience of using i2 mapping software is desirable 

FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

When you join us you will be providing world-class customer insights for our clients. Utilising the Nectar data to understand how we can personalise the customer experience and drive business impact, this role is a fantastic opportunity to apply and develop your analytical capabilities.

The role is based in our London office on average 1 day a week, with home working expected the remainder of the time. Occasional travel to our FMCG clients is required.

What will you be doing? 

You'll analyse Nectar, Sainsbury's and supplier data to maximise understanding of customer behaviour and provide impactful insights and recommendations. You'll take responsibility for delivering end-to-end analytical projects, using SQL to interrogate large datasets and combining multiple sources including Sainsbury's transactional data, ranging data and customer profiling information. You'll build your analytical and technical expertise as you deliver projects across a wide variety of topics, such as customer journeys, segmentation, ranging, promotions and campaign effectiveness. You'll be expected to work confidently with large datasets, developing efficient and accurate SQL solutions to answer complex business questions. You’ll take a proactive role in delivering increasing revenue for Nectar360, such as experimenting with new methods and data to enhance analytics, and improving our analytics efficiencies. You should be able to look beyond the data to find relevant and actionable insights that are useful and interesting to stakeholders. You’ll be responsible for making your insight actionable; explaining complex analytics to non-technical audiences and making clear recommendations on how stakeholders should be using the insight you’re providing. You’ll be expected to confidently & independently create well formatted PowerPoint documents and Tableau dashboards that explain the analysis that you have generated, presenting findings to internal & external stakeholders in an engaging and enthusiastic manner.

An innovative mind and a passion for solving problems. Technical confidence and statistical understanding to manipulate and interpret datasets using Excel and SQL, R or Python. Experience of BI tools (e.g. Tableau or Business Objects) and AWS/Snowflake would be advantageous. Excellent communication skills and experience in collaborating with peers or colleagues.

You’re looking to grow your career in a fast paced, commercial environment. You’re looking to work autonomously in a client-facing environment. You’ll take accountability for your analytical projects and build strong collaborative partnerships with both Sainsbury’s suppliers and internal teams. You thrive on excellence all the way. You will need to deliver high-quality insight with attention to detail. You’re looking for variety and new challenges. We work with a wide range of contacts across Nectar360 and Sainsbury’s, providing analytical advice to multiple business units. No two questions are the same, so you’ll need to be analytically creative whilst thinking on your feet to understand the real question we need to answer and implementing the best analytical techniques to do so.

location.linkedinText: City Of London, England, United Kingdom

rows.descriptionText:
Business Analyst (Operations, Commercial & Product)Overchain | Full-Time | London, Aldgate | HybridTeam: Operations, Commercial & Product
About OverchainOverchain is the settlement layer for global businesses moving money across fiat and stablecoins. We provide the infrastructure that allows financial institutions, payment service providers, brokerages, fund administrators, and large corporates to receive, convert, and settle value at institutional speed and standards, with compliance built in from the ground up.
We sit at the intersection of traditional finance and digital assets. Our founders come from institutional FX and payments, and the business is run with the same discipline: deep banking integrations, reliable execution, OTC depth, and white-glove service for clients that move serious money.
As we take on more institutional volume, we need a clearer picture of how our own operations run. We are hiring a Business Analyst in London to document that, find where processes break down, and help us plan the next phase of growth.
The RoleYou’ll document how the business currently works and turn that into requirements the product and engineering teams can build from. That means working across operations, compliance, sales, and product to understand existing processes and find where they fail.
Day to day you’ll interview people, write up current processes, and identify where manual work, settlement gaps, or weak controls create risk. What you find feeds directly into what we build next.
You’ll work closely with the Head of Product and Engineering, alongside teams in sales, compliance, and operations. The role is hybrid, based out of our Aldgate office in London.
This is an early career role, likely to suit someone in their first or second business analyst, operations analyst, or product analyst position.
Key ResponsibilitiesInterview people across sales, compliance, and operations, and document current workflows, commercial processes, and legacy spreadsheets as clear process maps.Set out who owns each decision and handoff, and separate what the business intended from what an external provider reports and what the product can safely conclude.Record missing information, exceptions, and approval points rather than leaving them assumed.Work with the Head of Product and Engineering to turn operational problems into written requirements and delivery plans.Find where manual errors, settlement gaps, or compliance risks occur, and design processes that cope when something goes wrong.Map operational capacity, bottlenecks, and handovers so leadership can plan for new institutional flows and partners.Use LLMs and AI tools to speed up documentation, synthesis, and research, and check the output before relying on it.
RequirementsEarly experience in a business analyst, operations analyst, or product analyst role, or another analytical role you can evidence.You ask the awkward questions, spot the steps missing from a process, and do not accept “because we have always done it that way”.You work in a structured, visual way. You turn messy conversations into clear diagrams, decision tables, and documentation people will actually read, without being asked to.You already use AI in your daily work to get through things faster, and you know how to check the output and discard what is not good enough.You work well in a scale-up where the day to day changes, priorities move, and you are expected to create order out of ambiguity.Bonus points for familiarity with digital assets or crypto, Gherkin/BDD syntax, or process mapping tools such as Miro, BPMN, or Lucidchart.

What We OfferA role that covers operations, compliance, sales, and product, so you see how the whole business works.Regular contact with leadership across product, engineering, and finance, and room to grow the role as we scale.Ownership of your own discovery work and a real say in how we operate and build.Practical exposure to payments infrastructure, digital assets, and fintech operations.Hybrid working from our Aldgate office in London.£45,000 to £65,000 base salary, dependent on experience.Support for professional development and ongoing training.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

In our Retail & Consumer Business Unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI and use it to help leading retailers, consumer brands, marketplaces, and digital commerce businesses navigate a rapidly evolving landscape.

We develop and embed AI solutions that help organisations better understand their customers, optimise operations, improve forecasting and decision-making, and unlock new opportunities for growth. From supply chains and merchandising to marketing, personalisation, and customer experience, we work with clients to deliver measurable commercial impact through AI. We are proud to combine technical excellence with practical deployment, ensuring solutions create value in complex, real-world environments.

About The Role

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse Retail & Consumer clients.

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working closely with clients and cross-functional teams, you’ll ensure the technical feasibility and successful delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems that drive tangible business outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of AI and machine learning systems across retail and consumer use cases.Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product teams, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility, scalability, and commercial impact.Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning systems in production.Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts into actionable business outcomes.Applying machine learning to challenges such as demand forecasting, customer analytics, personalisation, pricing, marketing optimisation, inventory management, and operational efficiency.Supporting clients in adopting AI capabilities that improve customer experiences and drive sustainable growth.

Who We’re Looking For

You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.You’ve worked with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale.You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, experimentation, and common machine learning techniques.Experience working with retail, consumer, ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, or customer data is beneficial but not essential.You’re an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders.You thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve challenging problems, and deliver impactful solutions.

Our interview process

Talent Team Screen (30 mins)Pair Programming Interview (90 mins)System Design Interview (90 mins)Commercial Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

rows.title: Data Privacy Analyst (12 month FTC)
rows.descriptionText:
Hello, we're Starling. We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. We're a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We're a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. Starling Bank is powered by Engine, the banking platform we built ourselves and which we are now rolling out to other banks around the world. We employ more than 3,500 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices.

To support our ongoing growth we're looking to recruit a Privacy Analyst who will be responsible for promoting and assisting the DPO with data protection compliance across the Bank. You will support and report directly into the Data Protection Officer (DPO) and will have significant exposure across the Bank. The role represents a fantastic opportunity to join a vibrant institution and to shape the Bank's attitude and approach to data protection.

This role is a 12 month fixed term contract.

Responsibilities:

Technical Compliance & Oversight: You will be working with senior team members on/or the subject matter expert for technology-driven privacy issues. This involves all of the matters within the GDPR including Article 28 and Article 32 GDPR compliance, vendor due diligence, managing Article 30 ROPA, and advising the Business areas on data privacy by design & default and the Digital & Tech teams on complex areas like cookies, data retention, and automated processingStrategic Risk Management: You will support the DPO and senior team members by leading DPIAs (Data Protection Impact Assessments) and assisting with or managing personal data breaches. This includes calculating risk severity and recommending corrective actions to prevent future incidentsAssurance & Reporting: Close and continuous review of the matters brought to team's attention through various channels and deep dives with advice and operational know-how delivered with a pragmatic business focussed lens while at the same time ensuring processes and actions are in line with the law, guidance and practice. You will conduct deep dives of the matters that relate to data protection review patterns and gaps in compliance consultation with the DPO, following up known issues, monitor internal controls, contribute to Committee level papers, produce Management Information (MI) to track the Bank's compliance healthCollaborative Advisory: You will act as a proactive consultant for the business in whichever area or project you are engaged with in an advisory, DPIA or assurance activity, including Cybersecurity, Vendor Management, and HR. Your goal is to embed "Privacy by Design" across the business through training, awareness campaigns, and direct project advice. Where relevant or necessary you liaise and engage closely with more senior colleagues in the DP team. Horizon Scanning: You contribute to Starling staying ahead of the curve, monitoring the regulatory landscape for changes in UK GDPR/DPA 2018 to ensure the Bank remains compliant as laws evolve

Requirements

A recognised Privacy qualification is preferred (e.g. CIPP, CIPM etc.) or a legal background, e.g. a law degree. Working towards a CIPP qualification or equivalent will be considered for in-house talent. Around 2-4 years relevant experience. Knowledge of data protection laws and regulations,with the ability to express complex ideas or legislation in easily understandable ways is preferred but not essentialAbility to read and digest data protection legislation and summarise key pointsAbility to analyse privacy problems and communicate solutions to a wide range of audiencesExcellent communication skills and writing skills. Experience with spreadsheets would be an advantage, as would the ability to produce accurate and timely management information and dashboards

Benefits

25 days holiday (plus take your public holiday allowance whenever works best for you)An extra day's holiday for your birthdayAnnual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off16 hours paid volunteering time a yearSalary sacrifice, company enhanced pension schemeLife insurance at 4x your salaryPrivate Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and PelotonGenerous family-friendly policiesPerkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perksAccess to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships

About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can't accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren't sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway.

We're on a mission to radically reshape banking - and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we're proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

Starling Bank is an equal opportunity employer, and we're proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment at Starling Bank are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

By submitting your application, you agree that Starling Bank may collect your personal data for recruiting and related purposes. Our Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over our use of your personal information.

Location: Leeds (Local (Inside UK) Relocation Assistance is considered)

Job Purpose

We make some of the UK’s best-known personal care brands in Leeds. Our Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) team keeps our people safe, protects our environment and keeps our site compliant. As our site becomes more data-led, we need sharper, faster ways to turn SHE information into clear insight and action. We’re looking for someone who loves data, problem-solving and making work simpler – and wants to use those skills for something that genuinely matters. You’ll build dashboards, automations and reports that help our leaders see where the real risks are, so we can spend less time chasing information and more time acting on the insights that make our operations safer for people and the environment.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for safety, health and environmental performance Automate the reporting that’s currently manual - using Power Automate, Power Apps, Forms and AI tools such as Copilot Own the quality of our SHE data: collect it, check it, and make sure what we report is right, first time Spot trends and outliers, explain what they mean, and help us decide where to focus next to improve SHE performance Work with operations, engineering, finance and our global SHE teams to turn the data into action 

All About You

What we’re looking for

Strong digital, analytical and data communication skills (or the appetite and evidence that you can get there fast) Confidence working with imperfect data - cleaning, modelling and making it trustworthy Curiosity about how a factory works and a genuine interest in health, safety and sustainability A degree, apprenticeship or demonstrable self-taught capability in data, analytics or a related field 

You don’t need

A SHE qualification – we’ll teach you the safety and environment side Manufacturing experience – we’ll show you the factory floor 

What You’ll Get

Real ownership from day one - this will be your remit, with the autonomy to build tools, improve processes and enable better data-led decisions A development pathway into SHE, data or both, with exposure to global Unilever teams A visible role with our site leadership team The opportunity to work within a fantastic team at a world-class manufacturing facility 

Interested but not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway – tell us what you’d automate first.

What We Offer

Not only do we offer a competitive salary and pension scheme, we also offer an annual bonus, subsidised gym membership, a discounted staff shop and shares. You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with our renowned and exciting brands in a flexible and hybrid working environment.

Whilst the role is advertised on a full-time basis, we would be happy to discuss possible flexible working options and what this may look like for you. We are a key advocate of wellbeing and offer a variety of support for our people including hubs, programmes and development opportunities. We strive to achieve a family-friendly and inclusive workplace and to, above all, create possibilities for all.

Diversity at Unilever is about inclusion, embracing differences, creating possibilities and growing together for better business performance. We embrace diversity in our workforce. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. We are also more than happy to provide reasonable adjustments during our application and interview process to enable you to be present your best self. To find out more, including about our Employee Resource Groups, please click here Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Unilever | Unilever.

Recruitment Fraud

Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. In the most sophisticated cases, they will set up fake websites, which have a similar address to companies like Unilever. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs.  These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate.

How is Unilever tackling this?

Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down.

What can I do?

If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat.

Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

Business Data Reporting Analyst – Permanent - £50,000 

Join us and be part of a mission-driven, independent publisher. You’ll work with a diverse group of people who share a passion for empowering researchers, educators, and institutions to shape the future.

About Sage

Sage is a global academic publisher of books, journals, and library resources with a growing range of technologies to enable discovery, access, and engagement. Believing that research and education are critical in shaping society, Sara Miller McCune founded Sage in 1965. Today, we are controlled by a group of trustees charged with maintaining our independence and mission indefinitely. 

Our Guaranteed Independence Means We’re Free To

Do more – supporting an equitable academic future, furthering disciplines that drive social change, and helping social and behavioural science make an impactWork together – building lasting relationships, championing diverse perspectives, and co-creating resources to transform teaching and learningThink long-term – experimenting, taking risks, and investing in new ideas

About Our Team

You’ll be joining a small, growing team of three who sit at the heart of Sage’s global Research Pillar Editorial function. The team partners closely with colleagues across Editorial, Open Access Operations, Production, and our wider data community to bring clarity, insight and confidence to decision-making. Their purpose is simple but powerful: to transform complex data into meaningful stories that help our publishing teams understand performance, spot opportunities, and remove bottlenecks. As the team expands, so does its ambition, to elevate data culture, modernise reporting, and empower colleagues with intuitive analytics.

Could you be our new Business Data Reporting Analyst? Are you?

Someone who thrives in collaboration to create clear, user-friendly reports and visualisations?Skilled in Microsoft Office 365, with strong Excel capabilities and hands-on experience in Power BI, DAX, and Power Query?Confident working with structured and unstructured data, and ideally familiar with SQL servers and API integrations?Experienced in applying analytical thinking to real-world business problems, ideally in a data-focused role?An effective communicator, able to translate complex information into accessible insights for colleagues at all levels?Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously?Comfortable navigating competing priorities and negotiating with stakeholders?Curious about publishing workflows or eager to learn with an interest in how data can illuminate performance, revenue opportunities, and process bottlenecks?Motivated by problem solving, continuous learning, and the fulfilment of delivering data insights that make a real difference?

Your New Role

As our Business Data Reporting Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how data is used, understood, and valued across the Editorial departments. You’ll build, maintain, and evolve reporting solutions that illuminate the full publishing journey and help teams make informed, timely decisions. No two days look the same: one moment you’re solving a data puzzle, the next you’re designing a Power BI dashboard that becomes crucial to a publisher’s workflow. You can expect support as you grow, with opportunities to take ownership of products, deepen your technical skills, and develop your voice as an analytical storyteller.

Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reporting solutions so Editorial teams can quickly understand journal performance and make confident, data driven decisions. Develop a deep understanding of internal and external data channels to ensure every report is accurate, consistent, and trusted across the organisation. Troubleshoot and improve existing reports to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and create more reliable, automated insights. Partner with Editorial and core publishing teams to design strategic reporting that supports portfolio growth, operational efficiency, and long-term planning. Prioritise and manage multiple data requests to deliver high quality insights that arrive on time and support colleagues when they need them most. Document and refine reporting processes to strengthen data integrity and create smoother, more efficient ways of working across the Pillar. Deliver training and support to business users so colleagues feel confident using data tools and empowered to explore insights independently. Contribute to global analytics communities to share knowledge, improve data culture, and help build guidelines across Sage. 

Overview Of Benefits

25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with 2 additional floating personal days. Hybrid working up to 2 days per week in office and a home working allowance. Life assurance, income protection, and travel insurance. Private medical cover and access to the company doctor. Tuition scheme and support for pursuing professional qualifications, including access to Sage books and journals. Variety of snacks and beverages available in the office. Healthy lifestyle reimbursement and anniversary trips. Access to Company loans (season ticket loan, rental deposit loan, cycle loan). 

We’re a Disability Confident Employer (Level 1). If you’d like to apply under this scheme, please let us know in your application.

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and inclusive. If you’d like to request reasonable adjustments, please email humanresources@sagepub.co.uk. Please note we only accept applications via email if an adjustment has been agreed.

Closing date for applications: Thursday 10th September 2026 

To ensure we can give each application the attention it deserves, we may consider bringing the closing date forward. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible to ensure it is considered.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and to sustaining a culture that celebrates diversity, encourages authenticity, and builds a deep sense of belonging. We encourage applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion, or belief as crafting value through diversity is what makes us strong.

The EMEA Transactional Business Planning & Insights Analyst plays an important role in supporting data-driven decision-making across Sony Pictures' International Home Entertainment business.

Working alongside the Senior Managers, the Analyst provides analytical support through the preparation of reports, dashboards, forecasting models and commercial insights that enable informed business decisions across EMEA.

This role is ideally suited to an inquisitive and technically capable analyst who enjoys working with large datasets, identifying trends and solving business problems through data. The successful candidate will help maintain the reporting and analytical infrastructure that supports Business Planning & Insights while continually looking for opportunities to improve reporting, automate processes and uncover new commercial insights.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, EMEA Transactional Business Planning & Insights, the Analyst will work closely with Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Research and Global colleagues to ensure accurate, timely and insightful analysis that supports forecasting, planning and retailer engagement.

Whilst knowledge of the Home Entertainment industry is beneficial, the role is primarily focused on analytical capability, technical skills and a proactive approach to problem solving. Industry knowledge and forecasting methodologies can be developed through experience within the role.

Reporting & Analytics

Data Management & Business Intelligence

Forecasting & Commercial Support

Process Improvement & Automation

Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting processes through automation and simplification.Develop more efficient reporting solutions using Excel, Tableau, SQL, Power BI or other analytical tools.Explore emerging technologies, including AI-assisted analytical tools, that could improve efficiency and insight generation.Support continuous improvement initiatives across reporting, forecasting and analytical processes.

Collaboration & Global Alignment

Build effective relationships across Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Research and Global teams.Support Senior Managers by preparing analysis and presentations for business reviews and customer meetings.Share insights and analytical findings clearly with colleagues across the business.Contribute to a collaborative culture focused on continuous improvement and data-driven decision-making.

rows.title: Senior Marketing Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Role: Senior Marketing Executive Location: London, UKJob type: Full time, Permanent – Hybrid
This position offers a hybrid work model, allowing flexibility between working from home and our office. Typically, employees are expected to work 2 days in the office per week.
Why QS?
At QS, we believe that work should empower you. That’s why we foster a flexible working environment that encourages every employee to own their career whilst thriving personally and professionally. Our company values underpin everything we do – we collaborate, respect and support each other.
It’s our mission to empower motivated people around the world to fulfil their potential through higher education, ensuring that everyone has access to opportunities that change lives.
Our diversity makes us stronger. By sharing our experiences, we learn from one another and achieve more together, driving progress across the sector.
At QS, you’ll be responsible for implementing real change in the international higher education landscape. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that see a positive impact across the business and the wider sector.
We’re confident you’ll feel right at home here. QS was named as one of Newsweek’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® in the UK (October 2023) – recognition of the respect, trust and appreciation that drive our culture every day and as a gold-accredited Investors in People organisation – putting us among the top 28% of workplaces globally – it’s official: QS is a place where everyone can thrive.
As a Senior Marketing Executive, this is what you’ll be doing:
At QS, you will turn audience insight into timely, useful communications for 13 conferences and summits and our publication portfolio, including Midweek Brief, QS NewsBites and QS Insights Magazine.You will connect strategy with delivery: building emails and audience segments in HubSpot, creating dashboards, briefing creative and paid-media activity, and coordinating colleagues across Content, Social, PPC, Creative, Events and Delegate Sales.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys moving between strategic campaign planning and detailed execution. Your work will help the right audiences discover QS B2B conferences and content, strengthen registration and engagement, and give teams clear evidence for better decisions - supporting our mission to help people fulfil their potential through higher education.
Role responsibilities:
You will take ownership of the following responsibilities:
Campaign ownership: Own integrated marketing planning and delivery across 13 conferences and summits and recurring publications, balancing portfolio priorities, registration goals and audience needs.Email marketing: Plan, build, schedule, test and optimise responsive emails in HubSpot, including personalisation, links, mobile rendering, accessibility, consent and deliverability checks.Audience segmentation: Build reusable active and static lists using combinations of contact and company data, interests, geography, job role and seniority, lifecycle, event history, form activity, page and email engagement, and recency; apply exclusions and suppression rules accurately.Dashboards and insight: Create and maintain HubSpot dashboards and reports covering email, audience growth, registrations and sources, website and landing-page conversion, PPC, cost per lead or registration, and campaign readiness; turn findings into clear recommendations and tests.Creative and content briefing: Develop clear, original briefs for Content, Creative, Social and PPC, defining the objective, audience insight, proposition, message hierarchy, deliverables, specifications, call to action, timings and success measures.PPC and channel coordination: Partner with paid-media and social specialists on targeting, messaging, creative, landing pages and UTM tracking; review performance and recommend practical improvements.Event and delegate communications: Manage event communications across Cvent or similar platforms, event apps, websites and email journeys, including launch, speaker and sponsor, visa, venue, weeks-to-go, survey and post-event activity.CRM and audience growth: Maintain data hygiene, list quality, audience growth and enrichment, and use survey and engagement data to support retention, future-event marketing and ROI reporting.Hands-on delivery: Complete detailed operational tasks such as email assembly, list building, link checks, tracker updates, asset follow-up, folder administration and reporting while contributing to campaign strategy.Cross-team collaboration: Work closely with Content, Social, PPC, Creative, Events and Sales teams to coordinate assets, approvals, deadlines and readiness; identify risks early and solve problems constructively.Responsible AI use: Form an independent point of view and a sound brief before using ChatGPT or other generative AI; use AI to accelerate ideation, drafting, analysis and QA while challenging outputs, verifying facts and logic, protecting data and retaining final accountability.Any other duties that fall within the purpose and scope of the role.
Key skills and experience
We welcome applicants from different professional, educational and career pathways. What matters most is clear evidence that you can apply the following skills:Strong hands-on HubSpot capability, including the email builder, forms, properties, active and static lists, multi-field segmentation, exclusions and suppressions, dashboards and reporting.Proven ability to build and quality-assure responsive, personalised emails and diagnose deliverability, engagement and conversion issues.Ability to translate complex audience criteria and contact behaviours into clear, accurate segment logic, including consent and suppression requirements.Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills: you frame problems, test assumptions, interpret incomplete or conflicting information, explain trade-offs and recommend evidence-based action.Ability to develop useful creative and campaign briefs independently, combined with an innovative and practical approach to problem solving.Confident, responsible use of ChatGPT or comparable generative AI, with disciplined prompting, verification, iteration, privacy judgement and ownership of the final output.Working knowledge of integrated digital marketing, including email, PPC, social, landing pages, conversion metrics and UTM tracking.
Useful, but not essentialExperience marketing to higher-education audiences, institutions or sector partners.Experience with conferences or summits, delegate communications, Cvent or event apps, publications or newsletters.
So, who are we and what do we do?
QS is the world leader in higher education services, analytics, insights and intelligence. From consultancy to student mobility, academic partnerships to branding solutions, our services power both institutional and individual success.
We’re behind the world’s most widely read university rankings (Meltwater 2023). Our QS World University Rankings® reach hundreds of millions, shaping decisions and guiding futures.
Since launching in 1990, our impact and influence have only grown. Today, we work with more than 2,000 of the world’s leading higher education institutions, over 12,000 employers, and governments seeking change and socioeconomic development through higher education.
Join QS and you’ll join an 800-strong community of problem-solvers, creators, collaborators and change-makers based in 40+ countries and 11 international offices, including Australia, Malaysia, India, Romania, Singapore, France, Germany, the USA and our headquarters in London.
With every talented new hire, business acquisition and bold initiative, we’re strengthening our reach and delivering even greater value to institutions and learners worldwide. Are you ready to shape the future of higher education?
We take investing in our people very seriously.
As standard you will have:
Competitive base salaryAccess to an annual bonus scheme (for qualifying roles only)25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays – increasing to 27 days after 5 years’Access to a Buy Holiday scheme allowing you to buy up to 5 additional holiday days per yearEnhanced maternity and paternity leaveGenerous pension through Royal LondonComprehensive private medical insurance and wellness scheme through VitalityCycle to work schemeA vibrant social environment and multicultural and multinational culture
But that’s not all. Outside of these standard benefits we also offer resources to allow professional growth and wellness initiatives to nurture a healthy mindset:
Free subscription to the Calm App – the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxationA focus on welfare which is led by our global wellness team, with mental health first aiders globallyAccess to a variety of diversity and inclusion initiatives and groupsStrong recognition and reward programs – including a peer-to-peer recognition platform, quarterly and annual QS Applaud Awards, Connect with your Career annual PD eventSupport for volunteering and study leaveFree subscription to LinkedIn learning – with over 5000 courses and programmes at your fingertipsOptions to join our outstanding global Mentorship programme
Equal opportunities
QS Quacquarelli Symonds is proud to be a fair and equal organisation where everyone has the same opportunity to achieve their full potential, irrespective of their background or personal attributes. We celebrate our diversity and believe through sharing our experiences we can learn from one another, be stronger together, and enable our business to thrive.

rows.title: Senior CRM Executive (Lifecycle)
rows.descriptionText:
Stylish, grounded, uplifting – these values live through everything we do at Boden. Without the collaboration, honesty and friendship between our teams, we wouldn’t be where we are today. We curate a world of beauty that’s ethical, inclusive – and importantly – good fun. We inspire you to live your best life. We are Boden.

Overview

This Senior CRM (Lifecycle) role sits within the CRM team and is responsible for the end‑to‑end operational delivery of lifecycle CRM journeys across email and SMS. These journeys play a critical role in strengthening customer loyalty, improving engagement, and driving long‑term value through timely, relevant, and personalised communications.

The Senior CRM Executive (Lifecycle) owns the build, QA, optimisation, and reporting of always‑on CRM journeys, ensuring they operate reliably at scale while continuously improving through structured test‑and‑learn activity. The role combines hands‑on execution with strong ownership of workflow management, data accuracy, QA rigour, and performance reporting.

This role partners closely with Brand, Creative, Insights, and CRM stakeholders to deliver lifecycle campaigns aligned to customer priorities, while identifying opportunities to improve templates, processes, and journey logic to support scalability and performance.

Location: 3 days per week at our North Acton office, 2 days working from home.

What You Will Do

Deliver high-impact lifecycle journeys that strengthen customer loyalty and improve experience across key moments — onboarding, engagement, retention, and reactivation.Own and prioritise the weekly lifecycle build and optimisation schedule, balancing new journey development, BAU maintenance, and optimisation work in line with agreed priorities.Build and QA lifecycle campaigns within Ometria to a high technical and brand standard, using approved templates, modular components, and best-practice journey structures.Partner with CRM Managers, Brand & Creative, and Insights teams during briefing to ensure lifecycle objectives, audiences, triggers, test hypotheses, and success metrics are clearly defined and accurately translated into journey logic and segmentation.Maintain operational excellence across all lifecycle delivery, consistently achieving high QA pass rates, maintaining clear documentation and checklists, and reducing manual effort and risk through continuous process improvement.Monitor live journey performance and campaign data health, proactively identifying underperformance, deliverability risks, or data issues and escalating with clear recommendations.Produce weekly performance reports and analyse journey results against objectives, surfacing actionable insights, clear test outcomes, and optimisation opportunities, ensuring learnings feed back into future iterations and lifecycle strategy.Support A/B testing setup across messaging, timing, cadence, and content, ensuring tests are correctly implemented, documented, and QA'd.

What We Are Looking For

An experienced CRM Executive with hands‑on experience hands‑on experience delivering lifecycle or triggered CRM campaigns within an ESP or CRM platform (Ometria experience preferred).Highly detail‑oriented, with a strong track record of delivering accurate, reliable, always‑on CRM activity and high QA standards.Comfortable managing complex journey logic and multiple priorities, balancing BAU delivery with optimisation and improvement work.Collaborative and relationship‑driven, with experience working closely with Brand, Creative, and Insight teams.Data‑literate and insight‑driven, confident interpreting lifecycle performance metrics and test results to drive optimisation.Process‑minded and improvement‑focused, with an interest in scaling lifecycle activity through better templates, automation, and ways of working.Proactive and accountable, with strong ownership over journey performance, data quality, and operational standards.Customer‑focused and commercially aware, motivated by delivering CRM that adds long‑term value for both customers and the business.

Our Behaviours

 At Boden, how we work matters just as much as what we deliver. We keep things simple. We say what we mean, keep each other in the loop, and follow through on what we’ve said we’ll do. We care about doing a good job - and we care about each other. We’re always kind, often honest, and we will push for high standards without making it heavy. We know what we’re good at, we lean on each other when needed, and we show up as a team - taking ownership and getting things done together.

What We Offer

Competitive salary & targeted annual bonus scheme.Generous Boden clothing allowance!30% discount on all current clothing ranges.25 days Holiday annually, plus Bank Holidays.Online Portal with an array of discounts on retail & entertainment.Virtual GP Service for you and your household!Free onsite parking and subsidised café.

We want Boden to be the place everyone wants to work. Friendly, open and tolerant. A best-of-British company with diverse teams, equal opportunities, and fair working and recruitment practices. We believe in hiring the best person for the job whoever they are, helping them thrive in it and celebrating their individuality.

We would like to encourage people from a diverse range of backgrounds to apply for our roles. If you need any reasonable adjustments or additional support during your application process, please do not hesitate to let us know.

These principles guide everything we do. All our pieces are crafted ethically in Europe using the finest sustainably sourced materials. The Role As DeMellier’s CRM Executive, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution and optimisation of our broadcast and automated CRM activity, working closely with the Senior CRM & Omnichannel Clienteling Manager to bring the wider CRM and customer retention strategy to life.You will play a key role in ensuring CRM activity is delivered accurately, efficiently and in line with the wider marketing and commercial calendar. You will also support customer segmentation, lifecycle activity, retention initiatives and CRM reporting, helping the business better understand and engage its customers across digital and retail touchpoints.You will be a key champion of the customer within the business, helping ensure CRM activity is relevant, accurate and informed by customer behaviour and insight.
Responsibilities:Email & SMS Marketing Support the Senior CRM & Omnichannel Clienteling Manager in implementing the CRM strategy through the execution of agreed segmentation, lifecycle and customer journey initiatives.Support and execute the day-to-day CRM campaign schedule, ensuring all campaigns are planned, built, tested and delivered in accordance with the marketing calendar.Plan CRM activity 1–2 months in advance, working closely with relevant teams to ensure email and SMS content aligns with wider marketing, trading and product priorities.Support ongoing testing across creative, messaging, send strategy, segmentation and personalisation, ensuring test objectives and results are clearly documented and communicated.Support the day-to-day administration of Klaviyo and other CRM platforms, ensuring campaigns, templates, audiences and automations are maintained effectively.Own the day-to-day management and optimisation of automated flows and triggered communications, proactively identifying opportunities for testing and improvement.Work collaboratively with Creative, Digital, Trading, Brand Marketing, E-commerce and Customer Services to ensure CRM campaigns are delivered accurately and on time.Consistently follow the CRM QA process across campaigns, flows, segmentation and reporting, ensuring customer-facing activity and data are accurate before deployment or circulation.Proactively identify and escalate campaign, data, resource or delivery risks to the Senior CRM & Omnichannel Clienteling Manager, raising blockers early and recommending appropriate solutions.
Customer Retention Support the Senior CRM Manager & Head of Brand with our retention programme (Loyalty) as we continuously evolve.Use customer data and agreed CRM insights to support the execution of targeted retention, reactivation and loyalty activity.Support loyalty activity through campaign delivery, segmentation, reporting and operational implementation.Support the execution of agreed customer lifecycle initiatives designed to increase repeat purchase, engagement and retention.
Customer Insights Support the Head of Brand to deliver customer research, collate the outcome and share them with the wider team in monthly meetingsWork with the Senior CRM & Omnichannel Clienteling Manager and relevant teams to implement automated customer surveys and support the ongoing analysis of results.Collate customer insight and research findings into clear, easy-to-understand outputs for the wider business.Support the translation of customer insight into practical CRM activity, including segmentation, personalisation and lifecycle communications.

rows.title: Renewals Manager, EMEA
rows.descriptionText:
About Mixpanel

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.

About The Renewals Team

Mixpanel's Renewals team partners with customers across EMEA to help them turn product data into decisions that drive growth. Renewals sits at the heart of our revenue engine, making sure customers keep realizing value from Mixpanel and that we retain and grow our recurring revenue base in the region.

About The Role

As a Renewal Manager for EMEA, you'll own the renewal process for an assigned book of business, working closely with Customer Value Managers, Sales, and Finance to protect Mixpanel's recurring revenue. You'll handle most renewals independently, following established playbooks and pricing guidance, while escalating complex negotiations, competitive risk, or unusual contract structures to senior teammates. You'll lean on data, dashboards, and AI tools to stay ahead of risk across a high-volume territory, and you'll know when to move fast with a standard motion versus when an account needs a more personal touch. This is a strong opportunity to build deep commercial and renewals expertise while learning what drives retention across different customer segments.

Responsibilities

Manage the renewal process for your assigned territory, tracking quote-to-close with accuracy and following up consistently across a high volume of accounts without letting details slipUse Salesforce, dashboards, and health scores, along with AI tools such as Claude, to analyze account data, flag renewal risk early, prioritize where to focus, and keep your forecast accurateNegotiate standard contract renewals using established pricing and packaging guidance, bringing in a manager or senior teammate for complex or high-risk dealsReach out to key stakeholders early in the renewal cycle to understand budget timing, approval processes, and potential blockersSpot early risk signals and loop in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, or Sales when a renewal needs cross-functional supportPresent pricing and packaging options to customers based on templates and guidance from the broader Renewals teamCommunicate Mixpanel's value clearly in writing and in conversation, escalating competitive pressure to senior teammates when neededContribute to the team's playbooks and automated workflows, including email cadences and segmentation, based on what you learn from your own renewalsShare what you're learning about customer objections and renewal patterns to help the team refine its approach

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

Experience in renewals, customer success, account management, or sales, ideally managing a high-volume book of businessThe organization to track many renewals at once, balancing competing priorities without things slippingComfort using Salesforce, spreadsheets, dashboards, and health scores, plus AI tools like Claude, to analyze customer data, prioritize accounts, and build accurate forecastsAn understanding of pricing and negotiation, and how to protect gross revenue retention (GRR) while spotting expansion opportunitiesA sense of ownership over their book of business, proactively surfacing risk and driving renewals to a clear outcomeAn interest in building repeatable playbooks and automated workflows that make the renewal motion more scalableClear, direct written communication, especially over email and other digital channelsA collaborative approach, building relationships across Sales, Customer Success, Deal Desk, Support, and Finance to keep the renewal experience seamlessComfort adapting to shifting priorities and a heavy workload in a fast-paced environment

Bonus Points For

Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini to improve efficiency, analyze data, and support decision-makingFamiliarity with Mixpanel itself — building cohorts, configuring alerts, creating dashboards, and using product usage data to spot renewal risk and opportunityExperience in product analytics, data tooling, or developer-facing SaaSFamiliarity with Gong or similar conversation intelligence toolsAdditional European language skills

Benefits And Perks

Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental CareMental Wellness BenefitGenerous Vacation Policy & Additional Company HolidaysEnhanced Parental LeaveVolunteer Time OffAdditional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Breakplease note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.
