rows.title: Data Strategy Associate Director
rows.descriptionText:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

2102 - Data Strategy Associate Director - UK

Role Summary and Impact

EssenceMediacom is a new breed of media agency. Grounded in analytics & insights and powered by data & technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data & technology, built for people & algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test & learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.

Data Strategy Associate Director 

EssenceMediacom is seeking a Data Strategy Associate Director to join our growing Data, Technology & Analytics team, reporting into the Data, Tech & Analytics Lead. The team focuses on maximising the value and impact of all data types on a client’s business, and how we effectively measure the performance to help make brands become more valuable to the world.

You will be working with one of the leading retailers in the UK, Boots, to harness their data and improve the performance of their campaigns, developing and deploying media measurement solutions. Communication with client stakeholders and effective management of assigned tasks is critical in this role. You will be joining a team which has doubled in resource over the past 12 months, with an ever-expanding remit to put data at the heart of the marketing function.

Part of The Boots Group, Boots is the UKs authority in beauty, wellness and healthcare with 176 years of trusted heritage and innovation behind it. Boots consistently delivers strong retail and pharmacy sales quarter after quarter in a hugely competitive market. Boots are hungry to keep striving and prioritise great teamwork and true partnership with their agencies to achieve their ambitions.

They are a client who embrace change, encourage innovation, are leaders in data-led planning to fully understand the impact of media in the wider business system and always make time to appreciate achievements and say thank you. They challenge us to deliver world class media planning and activation and enjoy getting recognition for great work we achieve together.

We have invested in giving you the tools to make you as successful as possible, including training/development, full access to relevant tools/platforms and a wider global community of analysts and data scientists.

Role Summary & Impact

Responsible for transforming data into actionable insights that drive superior client outcomes. Data Strategy involves transforming the way our clients think about, organize and orchestrate data & technology to deliver more timely, engaging and meaningful brand experience for their customers. Boots is a data rich client and that combined with clients willingness to test and evolve makes for opportunities to do great work. The Project Lead will optimise audience-driven strategies, identify growth opportunities, and deliver measurable business impact.

Skills And Experience

Data-led audience & bidding strategy and enablement;

Using the data-sets and technology available to Boots, understand the audiences and support in the delivery of test, trial and strategy recommendations across paid media campaigns on addressable channels.Work with internal teams, Boots clients and partner teams to define, justify and request future signals and data products which can drive the clients business goals.

Strategic Project Ownership;

You won’t be just doing campaign based work and will play a significant role in defining the strategic work-streams that will have the most business impact for Boots. Two key examples here are;Data Partnerships: oversee strategic partnerships, ensuring their data is fully integrated and leveraged within our platforms to deliver maximum value for the client.Agentic AI: guiding the wider DTA team on what personas and agents need to be built to deliver valuable insights for the clients.

Cross-functional Collaboration;

Work closely with stakeholders to identify and deliver on technology opportunities that drive growth and optimise outcomes for the clients business. This includes our internal MarTech team and the CRM team at BootsFoster collaboration between technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment on project goals and client objectives.

Co-own Boots Data Strategy testing workstream;

Work with internal testing leads and activation teams to bring forward robust testing methodologies for Data & Tech focused tests.Produce collateral for client facing case studies and share more widely with the business.

Data Governance and Compliance

Boots, being a Pharmacy (and so have sensitive data sets), is a privacy first advertiser. As a result, they have a process for utilizing new partners on plans - you will be owning this process to ensure any new partners on plan have the correct Boots and WPP approvals before use.Updating any partner changes and reflecting this in internal documents and with client.

A Bit About Yourself

Deep interest in Media & Technology: An understanding of and desire to learn more about data products, technology, and trends within the advertising and marketing industry with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Customer Focus: A relentless focus on client success, with a passion for delivering exceptional client experiences and driving long-term relationships.Communication Skills: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, as this role hinges on effective interaction with clients and agency partners.Experience managing multiple stakeholders in a matrixed environmentDigital working agency-side working on a data-led role within Data & Tech or Activation, with a strong emphasis on audience-based buying, audience data management and segmentation.Highly developed interpersonal, team building and relationship management skillsStrong analytical skills and a natural affinity for numbers is key; You must be able to analyse raw data, draw conclusions and develop actionable recommendations.Understanding of the importance of privacy first media and what that means for how we need to do things differently

Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

rows.title: Associate Analyst – Nectar360 Supplier Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
At Sainsbury’s, data sits at the heart of how we operate, innovate and serve our customers. Our Data & Analytics team is building a technically advanced, commercially focused and impactful capability, powering our Next Level Strategy and helping to create a Sainsbury’s powered by industry leading AI algorithms. We use data, technology and advanced analytics to drive better decisions across the business, from forecasting and optimisation to experimentation, personalisation and machine learning. With one of the richest retail datasets I n the UK and a portfolio spanning Sainsbury’s, Argos, Habitat and Nectar, the opportunity to innovate is huge. Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges at scale, create measurable impact and grow quickly alongside brilliant colleagues. People who thrive with us combine business understanding, technical expertise and curiosity, with a natural instinct for problem-solving. Join us and help shape the future of retail through data and AI.

Based in the Sainsbury’s Office in London, we’re recruiting an ambitious Associate Analyst to work alongside stakeholders in Nectar360 & Sainsbury’s to drive our media and consultancy proposition to FMCG and GM clients. Nectar360 is the company behind Nectar, the UK’s largest loyalty programme, with over 27m members across the country.

Do you take satisfaction in seeing your recommendations implemented in the ‘real world’? Are you analytically creative and motivated by new challenges? Do you have a passion for working with data to drive insight and improve customer understanding?

When you join us you will be providing world-class customer insights for our clients. Utilising the Nectar data to understand how we can personalise the customer experience and drive business impact, this role is a fantastic opportunity to apply and develop your analytical capabilities.

The role is based in our London office on average 1 day a week, with home working expected the remainder of the time. Occasional travel to our FMCG clients is required.

What will you be doing? 

You'll analyse Nectar, Sainsbury's and supplier data to maximise understanding of customer behaviour and provide impactful insights and recommendations. You'll take responsibility for delivering end-to-end analytical projects, using SQL to interrogate large datasets and combining multiple sources including Sainsbury's transactional data, ranging data and customer profiling information. You'll build your analytical and technical expertise as you deliver projects across a wide variety of topics, such as customer journeys, segmentation, ranging, promotions and campaign effectiveness. You'll be expected to work confidently with large datasets, developing efficient and accurate SQL solutions to answer complex business questions. You’ll take a proactive role in delivering increasing revenue for Nectar360, such as experimenting with new methods and data to enhance analytics, and improving our analytics efficiencies. You should be able to look beyond the data to find relevant and actionable insights that are useful and interesting to stakeholders. You’ll be responsible for making your insight actionable; explaining complex analytics to non-technical audiences and making clear recommendations on how stakeholders should be using the insight you’re providing. You’ll be expected to confidently & independently create well formatted PowerPoint documents and Tableau dashboards that explain the analysis that you have generated, presenting findings to internal & external stakeholders in an engaging and enthusiastic manner. 

Essential Criteria

An innovative mind and a passion for solving problems. Technical confidence and statistical understanding to manipulate and interpret datasets using Excel and SQL, R or Python. Experience of BI tools (e.g. Tableau or Business Objects) and AWS/Snowflake would be advantageous. Excellent communication skills and experience in collaborating with peers or colleagues. 

This role will suit you if:

You’re looking to grow your career in a fast paced, commercial environment. You’re looking to work autonomously in a client-facing environment. You’ll take accountability for your analytical projects and build strong collaborative partnerships with both Sainsbury’s suppliers and internal teams. You thrive on excellence all the way. You will need to deliver high-quality insight with attention to detail. You’re looking for variety and new challenges. We work with a wide range of contacts across Nectar360 and Sainsbury’s, providing analytical advice to multiple business units. No two questions are the same, so you’ll need to be analytically creative whilst thinking on your feet to understand the real question we need to answer and implementing the best analytical techniques to do so. 

What we offer 

Colleague discount across the multi-brands – Sainsbury’s, Argos and Habitat Holiday allowance Bonus scheme Pension plan Special offers on gym memberships, restaurants, holidays, retail vouchers and more 

You’ll also benefit from being part of the wider Data & Analytics community at Sainsbury’s. We have Big Data with a great culture and huge learning and development opportunities.

Flexible working and job share conversations are encouraged. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer that champions a diverse and inclusive culture. If you’re reading this, even if you’re not 100% sure you’re there with your experience, we’d still love to hear from you. 

#DataAndAnalytics

#Analytics

We are committed to being a truly inclusive retailer, so youll be welcomed whoever you are and wherever you work. Around here, theres always the chance to try something new - whether thats as part of an evolving team or somewhere else across the business - and we take development seriously and promise to support you. We also recognise and celebrate colleagues when they go the extra mile and, where possible, offer flexible working. When you join our team, well also offer you an amazing range of benefits. Here are some of them: Starting off with colleague discount, you'll be able to get 10% off at Sainsbury's, Argos, TU and Habitat after 4 weeks. This increases to 15% off at Sainsburys every Friday and Saturday and 15% off at Argos every pay day. We've also got you covered for your future with our pensions scheme and life cover. You'll also be able to share in our success as you may be eligible for a performance-related target bonus of up to 5% of salary (which may vary for Nectar360), depending on how we perform. Your wellbeing is important to us too. You'll receive an annual holiday allowance and you can buy additional holiday. We also offer other benefits that will help your money go further such as season ticket loans, cycle to work scheme, health cash plans, pay advance (where you can access some of your pay before pay day) as well access to a great range of discounts from hundreds of other retailers. And if you ever need it there is also an employee assistance programme. Moments that matter are as important to us as they are to you which is why we give up to 26 weeks pay for maternity or adoption leave and up to 4 weeks pay for paternity leave. Please see www.sainsburys.jobs for a range of our benefits (note, length of service and eligibility criteria may apply). Please note, due to the volume of applications we receive, our roles may close early.

rows.title: Martech Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Your team: You will join a highly collaborative team dedicated to delivering data-driven personalisation across our core brands. Our purpose is to enable editorial, marketing, and product teams to provide audiences with exceptional, tailored experiences across digital products and communications. Embedded within a brand team, you will work cross-functionally to unlock capabilities in content recommendations, next-best-action models, and churn prevention. You will report directly to the Senior Manager – Martech & Personalisation within our central data technology team.
Your role: As a brand-aligned Martech Manager, you will act as the vital bridge between our central data engine and iconic media brands, including The Times, The Sun, talkSPORT, and Virgin Radio. Embedded directly within a brand team, you will collaborate cross-functionally to turn complex customer data and AI capabilities into seamless, highly personalised user experiences that foster audience loyalty, boost engagement, and support business growth.
Day to day you will:

What we're looking for from you:
Digital & Media Background: Proven background working in digital consumer environments (such as media, subscriptions, or ad-supported platforms) with a solid understanding of how audience engagement drives growth.Martech & CDP Ecosystems: Hands-on experience using marketing technology tools and customer data platforms (CDPs) to execute audience segmentation and multi-channel campaigns.Personalisation & AI Knowledge: Clear understanding of how customer models work in practice, including recommendation engines, next-best-action logic, and churn modelling.Project Roadmap & Dependency Management: Strong organisational ability to manage cross-team dependencies and keep initiatives moving smoothly across central tech and brand squads.Data & Technical Literacy: Foundational understanding of complex data structures and SQL concepts to comfortably converse with technical teams and sense-check data flows.Collaborative Communication: Clear, approachable communication style with the talent to translate technical ideas into straightforward concepts for non-technical partners.

Private medical insurance including coverage for pre-existing conditionsDiscounted gym memberships, free ClassPass at Home, weekly in person/ virtual exercise classes‘Bikes for Work’ and ‘Electric Car’ schemeUp to 60% discount on Harper Collins booksMaternity leave up to 18 weeks full basic salary & paternity leave up to 2 weeksAccess to exclusive events and competitions with exciting brands such as talkSPORT, Virgin Radio UK & The Times. If you require reasonable adjustments due to a disability or health condition at any stage of your application or interview, please let us know. rows.title: Digital Marketing and Data Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Digital Marketing and Data Executive at a growing, popular law firm. London-based with hybrid working
A growing and highly regarded law firm is looking for a Digital Marketing & Data Executive to join its close-knit Business Development team. You will join an ambitious digital marketing function that is helping shape how the firm uses data, analytics, and emerging AI technologies to strengthen its brand, engage audiences, and improve marketing performance.
This is much more than a traditional digital marketing role. You will have the opportunity to combine your marketing expertise with analytics, business intelligence, automation and AI, working on projects that have a genuine impact across the firm.
Key Duties of the Digital Marketing and Data Analytics Executive Include:Analyse the performance of SEO, website, social media, email marketing and paid mediaDevelop and maintain interactive dashboards using Power BI.Support integration of marketing data to aid data automation and workflowsSupport campaign planning through audience segmentation Update the Intranet and firm’s website

Experience in marketing analytics or business intelligence is highly sought after. You must have experience developing Power BI dashboards and using tools such as Google Analytics. Experience within a professional services environment is essential.

rows.title: Digital Marketing Executive

Digital Marketing Executive 
We are an award-winning mortgage platform, created for our customers, designing better ways to buy-to-let. Our vision is to become the ‘go-to’ funding partner in the private rental sector. We’re a specialist buy-to-let lender working exclusively through brokers. Everything we build — our products, our systems and our communications — exists to make brokers’ lives easier. This role owns a key part of how that happens, from CRM and website activity through to campaigns and paid media.  Join Landbay and you’ll be part of a growing, ambitious, and supportive team, where everyone is encouraged to contribute, regardless of age or experience. Our team, our community, and the wider world matter to us, as much as the work we do. We’re building a company we love, and we hope you’ll love it too.  For more information about Landbay please visit our website: https://landbay.co.uk/about-us 
Role Details  
Landbay, Marketing Team — reporting to the Head of Marketing. 
Working closely with the marketing team you’ll: 
Become the main lead for product launches with support, including website and digital sales asset updates, briefing and assisting with marcomms, with a view to rapidly taking on greater ownership as experience develops. Work with the Senior Digital Marketing manager to develop, manage, and maintain CRM customer lifecycle journeys, including campaign planning and build, workflow logic, segmentation, and data hygiene. User-centric mindset, placing the user experience first to create effective lifecycle journeys. Logical thinker, comfortable with workflow logic, branching and troubleshooting. Strong attention to detail, with the ability to take a step back to spot inconsistencies and errors. Takes initiative and is comfortable prioritising workload across multiple projects with support. Team player who is able to flag blockers as they arise. Enthusiastic and curious, with a genuine interest in rapid change across marketing technology and the practical use of AI. 
Desired Skills & Experience  
Basic grounding in CRM platforms and marketing automation. Experience working with a website CMS, keeping a broad range of key content up to date. Working knowledge of Google Analytics, GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Data-led approach, using multiple sources to make recommendations. Some experience tagging and publishing campaign assets while following agreed processes. Ideally, a familiarity with digital ad platforms such as Adform, Google Ads and LinkedIn. A keen interest in AEO as a new channel. Comfortable learning to create custom workflows using AI as support.  Location & Logistics   Position is based in Victoria, central London, reporting to the Head of Marketing.  The Application Process 
Those that are successful and shortlisted for the role will have three stage recruitment process containing a HR Screening, a second stage interview and a final interview.

rows.title: Membership Strategy Manager
rows.descriptionText:
The Role..

The Membership Strategy Manager is responsible for delivering Soho House’s global membership strategy across a set of key Houses, translating centrally designed frameworks into locally relevant plans that protect and grow membership revenue. Houses and areas of focus are assigned by the Global Membership Strategy Manager and Chief Membership Officer according to what the role’s base geography allows, and may change over time in line with business need.

Reporting to the Global Membership Strategy Manager, the role takes agreed global strategy — across retention and engagement, intakes and applications, and new House openings — and leads its execution across its assigned Houses in partnership with the Regional Membership Director, House Membership teams and the Soho Support Member Success function.

The role is the strategic link between global strategy and local delivery. It applies global frameworks to the specific conditions of its assigned Houses, manages the data and performance cycle behind each initiative, and feeds on-the-ground insight, barriers and opportunities back into global planning.

The role is responsible for the delivery and success of membership strategy across its assigned Houses. Accountability for regional membership performance sits with the Regional Membership Director and their teams.

Key Accountabilities..

Delivery of Global Strategy Across Assigned Houses

Take agreed global membership initiatives and objectives and lead their delivery across its assigned Houses, translating global frameworks into practical local plans with membership and operations teams.Prioritise and sequence global initiatives according to House-level risk, opportunity and operational capacityFeed on-the-ground insight, local nuance and delivery barriers back into global strategy development.Act as the primary point of contact across its assigned Houses for global membership strategy, ensuring House teams understand what is being asked of them and why.

Retention, Churn & Engagement

Deliver its assigned Houses’ contribution to the global membership retention target.Localised: design and run churn toolboxes that reduce churn among high-risk member groups across its assigned Houses, tracking and evolving these approaches as performance data emerges.Centralised: drive engagement against the globally defined attrition indicators, closing the gap between local execution and target.Data: manage pre and post-initiative data for its assigned Houses, adjusting continually with local teams to protect the retention goal.Strengthen onboarding and first-three-year engagement across its assigned Houses, using behavioural insight to intervene at the highest-risk stages of membership.Partner with the Data Team and the Soho Support Member Success function so that proactive intervention is targeted where it delivers the greatest impact across its assigned Houses.

Intakes & Applications

Partner with local teams to track and deliver budgeted intakes for its assigned Houses, de-risking revenue shortfall from missed intake targets.Leverage seasonality and local cultural calendars to maximise application volumes.Execute acquisition strategies that deliver the required Every House mix across its assigned Houses.Run scenario-based local offers, adapting approaches proven elsewhere in the group.Identify emerging risk to intake or revenue early and escalate to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global) with a recommended recovery plan.

New Openings & Hypercare

Apply the global opening framework to pre-opening acquisition and membership success planning for openings within its assigned Houses.Lead membership-side opening implementation and hypercare across its assigned Houses.Partner with pre-opening, marketing and House teams so that application, intake and early engagement targets are met at opening.Capture what worked and what did not at each opening and feed it back into the global opening playbook.

Data, Insight & Performance

Track and report performance across its assigned Houses, spanning onboarding, engagement, retention, renewals, applications and intakes.Translate House-level data into clear, commercially focused recommendations for both local teams and global strategy.Partner with the Data Team on member segmentation and predictive churn models, ensuring local nuance is reflected.Present regional performance and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Partnership & Cross-Functional Working

Partner with the Regional Membership Director, who holds accountability for regional membership performance, to ensure strategy is delivered effectively across its assigned Houses.Work with House Membership teams, Member Relations, Operations, Marketing, Communications and Digital to remove barriers to retention and acquisition across its assigned Houses.Provide clear prioritisation and targeting guidance so House teams can execute global initiatives consistently.Act as escalation point across its assigned Houses for retention performance, cohort risk and engagement challenges.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify and test improvements to member engagement, retention and acquisition across its assigned Houses.Measure effectiveness and hand successful approaches to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global) for scaling across other regions.Champion a culture of continuous improvement within its assigned Houses’ membership teams.

Benefits…

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to grow your career.

Annual Every House Membership50% off Food & Drink, 7 days a weekStaff Room RatesPrivate Health and Dental CareWeekly PayLife AssuranceUp to 50% Staff Discount on Cowshed & Soho HomeIn Office Dog Policy on FridaysSeason Ticket LoanChristmas Office ClosureIn conjunction with Soho Impact, take 2 days paid a year to support a charity of your choice.Free Counselling SessionsCookhouse & House Tonic: Our Cookhouse & House Tonic programmes offer unique food and drink trainings, events and opportunities to inspire and educate.Continuous training to develop yourself personally and professionallyExclusive access to our benefits platform with hundreds of discounts on shopping, gym memberships, holidays, insurance and much moreTeam Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to

rows.title: CRM Executive - Retail
rows.descriptionText:
This position will be part of the Central CRM team, composed of 18+ specialists in CRM, dedicated to executing campaigns for the UK as well as supporting global strategic initiatives. The team collectively strives to expand our subscriber base and enhance engagement metrics, with a primary focus on retaining Deliveroo customers. Serving as the voice of the customer, the CRM team directs efforts toward enhancing personalised user experiences, activating best-in-class CRM and supporting marketing initiatives.

What You’ll Be Doing

We're on a mission to revolutionise retail e-commerce. As a tech-driven company, we're committed to delivering innovative solutions that redefine the shopping experience for customers worldwide. We're at the forefront of a rapidly evolving industry, and we're looking for a CRM Executive to help shape the future of customer engagement across our Retail business.

As the CRM Executive for Retail, you will play a key role in planning, building, and executing CRM campaigns. Working closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Data Analytics, Creative, Product, and Engineering, you'll help deliver highly personalised customer communications that support both commercial objectives and customer needs.

You'll be part of a UK-based Central CRM team focused on delivering the right message, at the right time, through the right channel. Together, you'll develop and optimise customer journeys, test new ideas and channels, and use data-driven insights to continuously improve campaign performance.

We are looking for a passionate, data-driven, and technically savvy CRM executive who puts the customer at the center of execution. You are someone who checks campaign metrics immediately after launch, thrives on experimenting with new channels and new ideas, and brings data-backed inspiration to every kickoff meeting.

Deliveroo is a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and data-driven business. Reporting to the Head of CRM, you'll work with teams across the organisation to deliver engaging customer experiences while helping shape the future of CRM at Deliveroo.

Own the strategy, execution, optimisation & reporting of all automated and bespoke campaigns, across channels such as email & push, to deliver customer growthBe comfortable with data targeting, segmentation & analysis - pulling it, manipulating it and interpreting itCollaborate with the UKI CRM Manager, UK Marketing Team and other stakeholders to support the UKI Marketing calendar through CRM channelsCollaborate with Retail marketing manager to create & deploy an effective test and learn strategy, including A/B testing, to optimise campaign performanceProactively report on all campaigns to stakeholders & propose/manage changes where necessaryManage multiple projects at once, prioritising effectively across competing issues

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience2-4 years email application experienceCRM / campaign management platform experienceStrong problem-solving and analytical skillsGood communication and stakeholder management skillsExperience building automated CRM programmesExperience using data visualisation tools & reportingHighly computer literate with:AI utilisationHTML, SQL, or scripting familiarity

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, You’ll Do Work That Matters, Solving Real-world Problems In a Three-sided Marketplace That’s Constantly Evolving. We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here You Can Expect To

🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

rows.title: Business Development Executive

Acxiom is looking for an ambitious and commercially minded Business Development Executive to join our Omnicom Agency partnership team. This is a focused audience sales role - you will be responsible for selling Acxiom's premium audience data products into Omnicom's media agencies, helping Omnicom’s planning and investment teams activate smarter, more targeted campaigns for their advertiser clients.
Working alongside senior members of the Omnicom Partnerships team (including Acxiom’s Client Partner as well as Acxiom’s Data Analysts and Data Guru team), you will develop relationships with media planners, audience strategists, and data leads across Omnicom media agencies including OMD, PHD, Hearts & Science, MGOMD, UM, Initiative and Mediahub. You will become a trusted resource for these teams - helping them understand how Acxiom data can improve campaign targeting, reach high-value consumers, and deliver measurable results for their clients. This role offers strong mentorship, clear progression, and the chance to build genuine expertise in the audience data and media marketplace.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Audience Sales into Media AgenciesOpen up new opportunities and briefs and drive revenue by selling Acxiom's audience data products - including consumer segments, modelled audiences, and custom audience solutions - into Omnicom media agencies experience selling into following companies : EssenceMediacom, OMD UK, Starcom, Wavemaker, Carat, MIndshare, Zenith, havas Media, iProspectDevelop relationships with media planners, audience and data leads, and investment teams who are the primary buyers and recommenders of audience data within agency teams.Respond to agency briefs and proactively pitch Acxiom audience solutions that align with client campaign objectives across digital, CTV, programmatic, and addressable channels.Support and, over time, lead conversations with agency teams to recommend the right Acxiom audience products for specific client verticals, campaign types, and media environments.

Agency Enablement & EducationHelp agency teams build familiarity and confidence with Acxiom's audience portfolio - through regular touchpoints, product updates, and informal education sessions.Develop and maintain up-to-date one-pagers, audience cards, and pitch materials that make it easy for agency planners to recommend Acxiom audiences to clients.Stay current with Acxiom's audience product roadmap and communicate new segments, capabilities, or partnerships to agency contacts in a timely way.Gather feedback from agency teams on audience performance, gaps, and wish-list segments - and feed this back into Acxiom's product and data teams.
Internal CollaborationWork closely with Acxiom's audience product, data, and campaign delivery teams to ensure agency and client needs are met from brief through to activation.Coordinate with the broader Agency Partnerships team to ensure a joined-up approach across Omnicom agencies and avoid duplication of effort.Share market intelligence on agency audience buying trends, competitor activity, and emerging client priorities with internal stakeholders.

Required Experience
2-4 years of experience in a media sales, audience data sales, account management, or agency-facing role within media, AdTech, or data.Familiarity with how media agencies plan and buy audience-targeted campaigns - ideally with experience selling into or working alongside media planning or investment teams.Some understanding of audience data concepts: consumer segmentation, demographic and behavioural targeting, modelled audiences, and activation across digital channels.Experience managing a sales pipeline or commercial relationships, with a track record of hitting or contributing to revenue targets.Comfortable using Salesforce CRM or similar tools to manage opportunities and activity.
Skills & Competencies
A genuine passion for audience data and media - you find it interesting how brands use data to find and reach the right consumers.Confident communicator who can explain audience products clearly to media planners and buying teams with varying levels of data literacy.Commercially motivated, with the drive to grow revenue and build lasting agency relationships.Well-organised and responsive - agency teams move fast, and this role requires someone who keeps on top of briefs, follow-ups, and deadlines.Collaborative and curious, with a willingness to learn and develop expertise in Acxiom's audience products and the broader data marketplace.
Preferred QualificationsPrior experience selling audience data, third-party segments, or data solutions into media agencies or programmatic buying teams.Existing relationships within Omnicom media agencies are a strong advantage.Familiarity with programmatic and addressable media ecosystems - DSPs, DMPs, CTV, and how audience data is activated in these environments.Exposure to audience data providers, data marketplaces, or identity platforms (e.g. LiveRamp, The Trade Desk, Adobe Audience Manager).A degree in business, marketing, media, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience.

rows.title: Data Analyst Intern (TikTok-LIVE) - 2027 Start
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

About the Team

The Regional LIVE Operation Strategy Team leads various cross-functional projects. Our key initiatives include developing strategic plans to drive widespread adoption of LIVE at scale among creators, localising new product features, creating user engagement strategies, ensuring a positive creator experience through education on the Community Guidelines and best practices, and providing ad hoc analysis and support to cross-functional partners.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Internship Overview

We're looking for a Data Analyst project intern to join our dynamic LIVE team. In this role, you’ll uncover insights and deliver data-driven recommendations that directly impact how we grow and support our creator ecosystem. You'll work cross-functionally with product, strategy, and operations teams to shape our growth priorities using data and analytical thinking.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-mid term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Examples Of Problems You’ll Be Solving

 What are the best content verticals for us to focus our creator recruitment on? How can we build a predictive model to identify high-potential creators early? What are the right leading and lagging indicators to measure success against our key OKRs? How can we segment creators and users to better personalise support and growth strategies? When and how should we educate creators to maximise their long-term retention and performance? How can we simplify complex data sets using statistical tools to better diagnose issues and recommend scalable solutions?

Key Responsibilities

 Analyse local and global content and user trends to identify growth opportunities within the EU LIVE ecosystem. Participate in the growth and exploration of future AI implementation and direction and be responsible for the data analysis of core business modules. Create, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards to track performance, OKRs, and key strategic initiatives. Develop data models and perform in-depth analyses to support content strategy, creator segmentation, and user engagement. Translate complex data into actionable insights for regional teams and leadership. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., Creator Management, Product, Strategy) to inform decision-making. Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to influence business strategy.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate degree in Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline. Experience with SQL, Python or another related programming language To succeed in the role, you need to be a proactive, self-driven and impact driven person Be able to work with cross-functional teams in a fast speed environment Demonstrated ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences Comfortable working with large datasets and drawing actionable conclusions under ambiguity Fast learner with the ability to quickly grasp new tools, concepts, and workflows, then apply them effectively to practical business problems Strong analytical thinking and ability to turn ambiguous business questions into structured analysis

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with visualisation platforms (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) and narrative based story telling with data is a plus Social Media content creation experience and familiarity with live-streaming platforms is strongly preferred Familiarity with statistical concepts such as segmentation, regression, or predictive modelling Previous internship, academic project, or work experience involving data analysis or business analytics Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation frameworks Familiarity with OKR frameworks or performance metric design

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

rows.title: CRM Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Manager

Department: Direct to Consumer (DTC)

Location: London – Hybrid (4 days office-based, 1 day remote)

Contract:Full time, permanent

About The Role

We're looking for a CRM Manager to take ownership of customer engagement at Derek Rose. This is a newly established function with strong foundations already in place — regular reporting, RFM segmentation, automated lifecycle flows and a live loyalty/VIP programme — and we need someone with the analytical rigour and creative drive to take it further.

You'll own the CRM strategy end-to-end: turning customer insight, segmentation and reporting into personalisation that drives retention, frequency and lifetime value across every touchpoint. Working closely with Marketing, eCommerce, Retail and Client Experience, you'll keep our communications consistent, data-led and commercially sharp — ideal for someone who enjoys sharpening what's already working, testing new ideas, and turning insight into impact.

What You’ll Be Doing

Customer Insight & Reporting

– Maintain and evolve our regular reporting suite to track customer behaviour, lifetime value and retention trends.

– Own and evolve our customer segmentation strategy (including RFM), identifying opportunities to leverage segments to increase engagement and revenue.

– Champion the voice of the customer across the business, using insight to influence strategy and decision-making.

– Present clear, actionable insights that inform marketing, trading and brand activity.

CRM & Retention Strategy

– Own the ongoing development and delivery of the CRM strategy, building on the foundations already in place to drive retention, frequency and lifetime value.

– Own our automated flows and lifecycle programmes, from welcome to win-back, continuously optimising them for relevance and performance.

– Develop the email marketing strategy and calendar, working with the Marketing Manager to deliver high-quality, on-brand communications that resonate with distinct customer segments.

– Own the day-to-day CRM communications plan, balancing trade and brand objectives.

– Run a clear testing framework and performance tracking approach to continuously improve engagement and conversion.

rows.title: Senior Staff Research Scientist | Voice
rows.descriptionText:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the Team

DeepL Voice is defining the future of real-time multilingual communication. Built on the foundation of DeepL’s world-leading translation quality, the Voice Track brings together cross-functional teams across Research, Engineering, and Product to push the boundaries of what is possible in speech-to-speech interpretation.

In just two years, we have launched our first customer-facing features and built reliable real-time systems for meetings, live communication, and developer integrations. We are now scaling up our research efforts to invent the next generation of audio, speech, and multimodal translation technologies.

What Will You Be Doing At DeepL Voice

We’re looking for a Senior Staff Research Scientist to lead scientific innovation across our speech and translation models. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for a research leader who can define long-term scientific strategy, prototype rapidly, run large-scale experiments, and drive breakthroughs all the way into production.

You will work across ASR, MT, TTS, streaming inference, and large speech models—leading both cascaded and emerging end-to-end internationalized speech-translation approaches.

Your Responsibilities

Lead hands-on research and development across ASR, MT, TTS, and speech-to-speech translation for real-time voice products.Design, train, and optimize large-scale ASR models for multilingual accuracy, robustness, and ultra-low-latency streaming.Improve cascaded translation pipelines end to end: segmentation, ASR→MT interfaces, streaming MT inference, and incremental decoding.Develop and refine real-time TTS models with natural prosody, stable speaker characteristics, and fast inference.Build and experiment with end-to-end and LLM-based speech-to-speech translation systems, including streaming and one-shot approaches.Own the full lifecycle of model delivery: prototyping, ablations, training, evaluation, optimization, and production deployment.Work closely with engineering teams to integrate models into real-time systems, ensuring reliability, uptime, and quality at scale.Drive improvements in inference efficiency, model serving, voice UX, and robustness to real-world acoustic conditions.Establish strong practices for evaluation, reproducibility, monitoring, and continuous model improvement in production.Mentor researchers and engineers, promote hands-on collaboration, and raise the bar for model quality and operational excellence.

What We’re Looking For

Deep expertise in speech, audio, or multilingual ML, particularly in ASR, MT, TTS, end-to-end ST, or large speech models.A hands-on builder who enjoys training models, running experiments, debugging pipelines, and integrating ML systems into production.Strong understanding of real-time streaming constraints and how to design models that operate reliably at low latency.Experience shipping ML models to production, maintaining them at scale, and working with engineers on deployment, monitoring, and serving.Ability to lead complex research efforts while staying grounded in product impact, user experience, and real-world performance.Strong coding and experimentation skills (Python, PyTorch/JAX, audio processing libraries).Ability to communicate clearly, collaborate across teams, and align research work with product and engineering priorities.Proven experience mentoring others and elevating technical quality across a fast-moving, applied research team.

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

rows.title: Revenue Management Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
The Revenue Management Analyst is responsible for managing car rental pricing and availability for Hertz. What You’ll Strive For:
Advance key department focus areas, contributing to targets such as revenue growth, pricing optimisation, forecast accuracy, and improved utilisation.Deliver strong individual performance by producing high‑quality analysis, actionable insights, and accurate reporting that supports commercial decision‑making.Achieve targeted Revenue per Unit (RPU) and Revenue per Day (RPD) through effective pricing recommendations and demand analysis.Maintain strong forecast accuracy, reducing variance between projected and actual demand, revenue, and utilisation.Improve utilisation and reduce revenue leakage, ensuring capacity is optimised and pricing controls are consistently applied.

rows.title: Community Manager (m/f/d)

rows.title: CRM Manager
rows.descriptionText:
About ThriveCart:
ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.
We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.
Location:
Hybrid - UK (up to 3 days a week)
Job Overview:
We're looking for an experienced, strategic CRM Manager to lead the next phase of our customer lifecycle and email marketing strategy. As CRM becomes increasingly central to how we engage, retain, and grow our customer base, you'll own the development of a sophisticated strategy that moves beyond campaign-based email to data-driven customer journeys across the full lifecycle.
You'll shape how we communicate with customers from onboarding and activation through engagement, retention, renewal, and win-back — using segmentation, automation, and experimentation to ensure the right message reaches the right customer at the right moment. Retention and churn reduction are a particular focus.
This is a chance to build and evolve a high-impact CRM function, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Tasks
What Your Work Will Entail:

Own and develop the CRM and lifecycle marketing strategy, with a focus on engagement, retention, and churn reduction.
Build and optimize customer journeys across onboarding, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, renewal, and win-back.
Evolve email as a strategic communication channel, keeping messaging aligned with the business and customer lifecycle.
Create customer segments based on behavior, lifecycle stage, product usage, subscription status, and other signals.
Design automated lifecycle programs and triggered communications that drive activation, adoption, and retention.
Partner with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Data to deliver a cohesive customer experience.
Run a structured testing program across messaging, cadence, timing, segmentation, offers, and journeys.
Use customer and product data to identify churn signals and opportunities for targeted communication.
Define and track CRM metrics: activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn, reactivation, and customer lifetime value.
Build reporting that connects CRM activity to measurable business outcomes.
Improve CRM processes, technology, automation, and data capabilities to support growth.
Ensure customer communications meet privacy, consent, and data protection requirements, including GDPR.

Requirements
What You Bring To This Role:

Significant experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, ideally within a SaaS or subscription business.
Track record of building CRM strategy — not just executing email campaigns.
Strong understanding of subscription lifecycles and CRM's role in retention and churn reduction.
Experience building automated journeys, behavioral triggers, and customer segmentation.
Strong grasp of email strategy: deliverability, personalization, experimentation, and optimization.
Comfortable using customer, behavioral, and product data to inform decisions.
Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and customer engagement platforms.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn performance data into actionable recommendations.
Experience collaborating across Product, Customer Success, Marketing, and Data.
Commercial mindset — understands how CRM drives retention, lifetime value, and growth.
Strong knowledge of GDPR and best practices for customer communications in the UK and Europe.
Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

Experience in a SaaS or technology company operating a recurring subscription model.
Experience evolving CRM strategy during a transition to or expansion of subscription-based offerings.
Experience with product-led growth, customer activation, or usage-based lifecycle marketing.
Experience designing churn-prevention and win-back strategies.
Familiarity with CRM platforms and data ecosystems that enable advanced segmentation, personalization, and automation.
Experience helping build or mature a CRM/lifecycle function as a company scales.

What Success Looks Like
You'll turn CRM into a strategic growth and retention channel — building a clear lifecycle strategy, more sophisticated segmentation and automation, more relevant customer communications, and measurable programs that increase engagement, strengthen retention, and reduce churn.
Most importantly, you'll help define the next era of customer communication for the business: a CRM approach that is scalable, data-driven, customer-centric, and closely connected to commercial outcomes.
Learn More About ThriveCart:
Our Values are:

Commit to Excellence
Find a Way
Help Each Other
Keep Growing
Data First

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

Sales Representative - Eastpak UK

Role: Permanent, Full time

Start: ASAP

Location/Travel: Primarily field based, with use of our London Showroom

Package: £30,000 - £40,000 + Bonus + company car + benefits

UK Packs (Eastpak) is looking for an exceptional Sales Representative to join our UK sales team, based in London, United Kingdom.

In this full-time role, you will be responsible for driving the commercial development of a selected distribution channel.

Let’s Talk About The Role

As a Sales Representative, you will be a key member of the UK Packs (Eastpak, Kipling & JanSport) sales team, with full ownership of the commercial development of your assigned channel and customer portfolio. This position will work closely with the UK sales and VM team and the central Business Planning and Merchandising teams.

How You Will Make a Difference

You will drive engagement, growth, and sales performance of Eastpak products in line with our strategic priorities. You will achieve this by:

Developing sustainable and profitable sales of Eastpak Brand through effective management of an assigned portfolio of customersPlanning and executing business activities to deliver against sales, distribution, and segmentation targetsIdentifying, opening, and developing new accounts while ensuring optimal territory management and distribution aligned with brand strategyVisiting existing customers at least once per season and conducting Pre-Book selling meetings from the London showroom to build long-term partnershipsDelivering compelling and professional product presentations to your account base, grounded in a strong understanding of the Eastpak Go-To-Market strategyRunning seasonal staff training sessions (formal and informal), ensuring partner teams are knowledgeable, engaged, and motivated to sell the brandEnsuring strong in-store visibility and premium product presentation, in line with brand guidelines, using appropriate signage and POS materialsCollaborating closely with your channel marketing partner to support the development and execution of impactful trade marketing campaignsMonitoring and analysing weekly sell-through data to support order management, drive in-season reorders, and optimise future range planning 

Skills For Success

Minimum 3 years’ experience in Sales with proven track record (preferably within luggage of accessory background). Strong interpersonal skills. You need to be confident and capable of building good relationships with high levels of communication. A self-starter who can work independently. Data driven with a quantitate and qualitative outlook. Good organization skills and a solution orientated approach. Deep appreciation for brands and team culture. Computer literate and good knowledge of MS Office packages. This role will require extensive travel up to 70% in UK with occasional trips in EMEA and you should enjoy being in the market. You will also need a clean driving license.

rows.descriptionText:
Business Unit:

Financial And Valuation Advisory

Industry:

Portfolio Valuation

Overview

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.

Financial and Valuation Advisory

Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.

 Structured Products Group

The Structured Products Group resides within Houlihan Lokey’s Financial and Valuation Advisory division. We value instruments from the full universe of structured credit products, including: large portfolios of mortgages, capital relief trades, CLOs, ABS, and bespoke transactions. Our clients are among the largest banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and insurers in the world.

A solid academic grounding, high attention to detail, and the ability to reason from first principles are essential. In addition to performing valuation analysis, our London team is encouraged to build and maintain technology underpinning the various processes that make up much of our work flow (pricing models, cashflow engines, data infrastructure, dashboarding, etc.), in order to increase efficiency while maintaining the highest levels of accuracy and transparency. The instruments we deal in are complex and we often work towards tight deadlines, particularly around busier times of the financial cycle.

Role

Learn structured credit from first principles, and how different levers drive outcomes.Build and refine the data sets and valuation algorithms used to price thousands of securities daily.Analyse client portfolios of structured credit securities.Model bespoke transactions in Excel, Python, and our in-house cashflow modelling tool.Identify and automate process bottlenecks.Handle client queries, engagement, and run product demonstrations.

Candidate Requirements

Must be a 2026 GraduateA strong record in a numerate or hard-science discipline.Curiosity about how financial markets work.Self-directed, comfortable thinking from first principles, and able to operate in a small, demanding team in a highly collegiate environment.

Useful, But Not Required

We do not require prior finance, modelling, or programming experience. However if you have a background applying Excel, Python, or C# to creatively solve problems, we encourage you to mention it in your application.

Interview process

After you apply, you should hear back from us within two weeks if we intend to progress your application. The process below is indicative; stages may shift depending on availability of our team.

Round 1: Remote. You will receive a short Excel task involving a structured finance deal scenario. No finance background is required. You will have 48 hours to return it, though we expect it to only take a couple of hours of focused work. You will then have two interviews via Microsoft Teams with senior members of the team, one of which will focus on your approach to the task.

Round 2: In person, Mayfair office. A half-day in our London office, meeting additional team members for a mix of logic-based problem-solving and conversations about your interests and motivations. Reasonable travel costs covered.

Round 3: In person, Mayfair office. A final conversation with senior members of the group covering fit, motivation, and any outstanding questions on either side.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

rows.title: Graduate Marketing Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter.

About The Role

We're looking for a Graduate Marketing Scientist to join Fospha's Marketing Science team in London.

Fospha builds marketing measurement products for ecommerce brands — attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact measurement. Marketing Science owns the applied end of that: designing and delivering incrementality tests and MMM engagements for clients, and standing behind the numbers when a client challenges them.

This is the entry point into the function, and it is a hands-on one. You'll work on live test and MMM delivery under supervision from the start, and you'll be the first person looking at a client's data when a number doesn't behave the way it should. It's a role for someone who wants to learn causal measurement properly, in a business where it's the product rather than a side project.

Team: Marketing Science

Level: Graduate — Entry (Data Science Career Development Framework)

Location: London

Salary: max £35,000

What You'll Do

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) & Testing Services

Assemble and validate test data — geo-level spend and conversion series, checking pre-period parity between treatment and control, spotting the coverage gaps that invalidate a design before it launchesSupport test design under review — market matching and control selection, power and minimum detectable effect sanity checks, and identifying contamination risks such as geo-targeting settings that don't behave the way the platform's documentation claimsRun analysis and read the results honestly — pre-treatment fit diagnostics, lift estimates with their intervals, and what a null result does and doesn't tell youQualify client data for MMM — spend coverage across channels, whether there's enough variation in spend to identify an effect at all, series length and granularity, collinearity between channels, and gaps that will bias the resultAssemble and validate model input datasets, and investigate the discrepancies that surface when you doSupport model runs and read the diagnostics — fit, residuals, convergence, and whether a channel's estimated contribution is plausibleContribute to output-extension work under review — building on an existing MMM result, for example forecasting or budget scenario work derived from itCompare results across methods — where MMM, incrementality, and platform-reported figures disagree, understanding why is the interesting part of the job

Model Trust and Diagnostics

First and second line on client trust queries — investigating why a number changed, working in SQL against client data to isolate the causeDistinguish a bug from a methodology change — attribution window changes, model recalibration, data feed gaps, and platform reporting shifts all look similar from the outside and have very different signatures underneathTriage PSPs on model trust, resolve what you can, and escalate what turns out to be a genuine model problem with a clear diagnosis attachedReconcile platform-reported figures against our measurement — why walled-garden ROAS disagrees with ours is the hardest recurring question in the business, and you'll be learning it from the insideLog and tag incidents consistently, so recurring failure patterns become visible and can be automated away rather than repeatedly handled

Client Communication and Enablement

Run templated explainer sessions under review, walking clients through how our measurement worksDraft documentation and presentations above the core explainer content, and feed recurring query themes back into the source materialFact-check methodology claims in product marketing collateral before it goes out

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for someone with a strong foundation in maths and stats with clear communication who is looking to grow their skillset.

Technical

Working proficiency in SQL — you can investigate a discrepancy yourself rather than asking someone else to pull the dataPython, or a demonstrated ability to pick it up quickly. Most of our analysis tooling sits there.Grounding in inferential statistics — hypothesis testing, uncertainty, statistical power, and what a null result meansSome exposure to experimental design — randomisation, control groups, confounding, and why a badly designed test is worse than no testStrong AI fluency — you use AI tools to get moving on unfamiliar problems and plug gaps in your own knowledge, and you QA the output before you rely on it

Communication

Clear, concise written communication — a large share of this job is explaining something technical to someone who isn'tComposure in client-facing conversation, including when the client is unhappy with a numberReal attention to detail, and the discipline to log things consistently even when it's dullHigh agency — you'll be given ownership as fast as you demonstrate you can hold it

Nice to Have

Exposure to marketing, ecommerce, or advertising dataFamiliarity with Bayesian methods and/or modellingExperience with cloud data toolingExperience presenting to or supporting external stakeholders

How You'll Grow

Level doesn't gate what you're allowed to attempt. It scales how much support you get doing it. A Graduate can work on MMM output-extension work; it just carries heavier review than it would for a Mid.

Incrementality delivery: Triages test type and routes to Product where self-serve applies. Prepares and validates test data. Supports design and analysis under review.MMM delivery: Qualifies client data. Assembles model inputs. Contributes to output-extension work under heavy review.Model trust & PSPs: First and second line on trust queries. Triages PSPs, attempts resolution, escalates genuine model problems with a diagnosis.Client sessions: Runs templated explainer sessions under review.Documentation & enablement: Drafts documentation and presentations above the core explainer. Feeds recurring query themes back into explainer content. Fact-checks methodology claims in product marketing collateral.Automated trust workflows: Logs and tags trust incidents consistently so recurring failure patterns are visible. Surfaces themes from the query queue into workflow design.Supervision: Detailed instruction; works closely with senior colleagues. Development time protected against product and consultancy workload.Upskilling is funded, not assumed. A named share of entry-tier capacity is held for development work and protected against the support queue. Nobody upskills in the gaps between tickets, so we don't pretend otherwise.The step to Junior is independence: running templated sessions and first-line triage unaccompanied, and resolving the full range of inbound queries with only moderate senior input.The step to Mid runs through one of two routes — owning a piece of MMM output-extension work, or taking a recurring trust problem you already handle manually and turning it into automated monitoring that alerts an account manager before the client notices. Both are genuinely technical, and both are allocated deliberately rather than first-come-first-served. From Mid, you own MMM and incrementality delivery with senior sign-off.

Why Fospha

Causal measurement is the product. Geo experiments, MMM, difference-in-differences, and Bayesian attribution are what the business sells. You'll be working on them, not adjacent to them.Live client work early. You'll be on real test and MMM delivery in your first months, with review rather than distance.Structured support, not sink-or-swim. Session allocation rules, a maintained escalation list, and protected development time exist so that being new isn't a liability.A published ladder. You'll know what the next level requires and what evidences readiness for it from your first week.
