rows.descriptionText:
This is a hands-on technical role. The successful candidate must be able to analyse business requirements, design technical solutions and actively develop, test and support applications, integrations, automations and reporting solutions. Strong software development skills are essential.
Job Function:As a key member of the IT team, the IT Solutions Developer & Analyst will identify and analyse business needs, define appropriate technology solutions and support their delivery. The role combines business analysis, solution definition, data analysis and IT initiative delivery, with a focus on practical problem solving, user outcomes and operational improvement.
The analyst will evaluate business requirements and determine the most appropriate solution using existing Bank capabilities, automation, internally developed applications, low-code platforms, approved AI-assisted development tools or third-party products and services. The role combines business analysis with hands-on solution delivery: understanding the business problem, defining the appropriate solution and using the Bank’s available development architecture and tools to turn that definition into working applications.
Key Objectives:Business Analysis & Problem Definition: Engage with stakeholders to understand objectives, processes and challenges; identify the underlying problem and intended outcome; and gather, analyse and document the requirements needed to define an effective solution.Solution Design & Development: Assess technology options and define solution behaviour, business rules, workflows, data requirements and controls. Use Bank-approved low-code, automation and AI-assisted development capabilities to prototype and develop solutions where appropriate. The role requires sufficient technical capability to use the Bank’s development architecture, platforms and AI-assisted tools to design, build, test and refine applications, supported by a practical understanding of software logic, data structures, integrations and development concepts.Data Analysis & Dashboards: Analyse data from relevant sources and create clear, actionable dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI to support business and management decision-making.IT Initiative Delivery: Manage or coordinate IT initiatives from requirements through implementation and handover, maintaining appropriate plans, risks, dependencies and stakeholder engagement. Support testing, user acceptance and post-implementation review.Governance, Security & Compliance: Incorporate applicable regulatory, security, data protection and internal control requirements into solution design and delivery, following Bank policies, procedures and approved technology standards.IT Operations Support: Ensure handovers of new or changed solutions into the operational environment. Work with the Operations team during deployment and early-life support to analyse issues, support resolution and promote stable operation.Training & User Adoption: Provide appropriate user guidance, documentation and training for newly implemented solutions and support their effective adoption.
Specific Responsabilities:Solution Assessment & Design: Research, test and recommend proportionate technology solutions considering functionality, complexity, cost, maintainability, security and strategic alignment.Documentation & Reporting: Maintain appropriate documentation for IT solutions, projects, software inventories and relevant third-party arrangements. Provide IT Management with clear status, risk and improvement information.Third-Party Coordination: Work with external providers to communicate requirements, coordinate installations, upgrades and maintenance, monitor delivery and support timely issue resolution.Solution Validation: Review prototypes, internal solutions and AI-assisted outputs against agreed requirements, expected behaviours and applicable technical and control standards. Escalate matters that require specialist development, architecture, infrastructure or security expertise.Continuous Improvement: Monitor the effectiveness and use of implemented solutions and identify opportunities to improve processes, user experience, data quality and business outcomes.

rows.title: Process Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Application Deadline: 23 September 2026Department: FundraisingLocation: Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity Compensation: £48,192 / year

Description

Are you an experienced Business or Process Analyst who enjoys untangling complex systems, understanding how data really works and finding better ways to connect the dots?

Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity is looking for a Process Analyst to help us build a clearer, more joined-up understanding of how data moves through our organisation.

This is a hands-on, data-focused role. You'll work across systems, teams and processes to map how information is captured, transformed and used; identify where things break down; and help create clearer rules and more sustainable ways of working.

You'll need to be comfortable getting into the detail of data, asking challenging questions and working closely with technical and non-technical colleagues to turn complexity into practical solutions.

Salary
The salary for this role is £48,192 per annum and this is a 12 month fixed term contract.

We operate a hybrid working policy of a minimum of 2 days per week in the office.

In line with our EDI strategy and Total Reward policy, we calculate our salaries based on benchmarking data across the charity sector. To ensure fairness for existing staff and new joiners, we do not offer salaries above the advertised rate.

Key Responsibilities

Build an end-to-end view of our data landscape, documenting how systems connect, how data moves between them and where key dependencies sit.Map complex data flows and business processes across platforms including Salesforce, Snowflake, Marketing Cloud and other connected systems.Identify duplication, manual workarounds, data quality issues and points of failure, digging into root causes rather than simply fixing individual problems.Help establish clear and consistent business definitions, data rules and governance across areas such as matching, deduplication, consent, retention and data ownership.Work with stakeholders to understand the business need before considering the technology solution, constructively challenging existing assumptions and ways of working.Translate complex business and data requirements into clear process maps, requirements, user stories and documentation that technical teams can use.Work closely with Data Management, Data Engineering, Salesforce and business teams to turn findings into practical improvements across systems and processes.Support new integrations, testing and implementation, ensuring changes work effectively across the whole data lifecycle rather than solving one part of the process in isolation.Create clear documentation that strengthens organisational knowledge and reduces reliance on individual or undocumented technical knowledge.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Experience working as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Data Management Analyst or in a similar role involving complex systems and data.Strong experience mapping and documenting end-to-end business processes, system interactions or data flows.Experience working across integrated systems such as CRM, data warehouse, marketing automation or other enterprise platforms.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate problems, identify root causes and recommend sustainable improvements.An understanding of data management concepts such as data quality, governance, business rules, data lineage and ownership.Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with the confidence to ask challenging questions and constructively challenge established ways of working.Ability to translate between business and technical teams, making complex requirements clear and understandable.Strong documentation and process-mapping skills, with the ability to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous or complex problems.Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake or Marketing Cloud would be useful, but specific platform expertise isn't essential.DBS - note a basic DBS check is required for this role

How to Apply
Please click on the apply button in the top right-hand corner where you will be taken to a short application form to complete.

Closing date: 23 September 2026

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and we reserve the right to close the roles prior to the closing date should suitable applicants be found. Therefore, you are encouraged to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Benefits

30 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) A flexible approach to working arrangements. Access to our enhanced pension scheme Life assuranceAccess to various health and wellbeing schemes, including the employee assistance programme.

rows.title: Strategy & Insights Analyst – 12-month Fixed-term contract
rows.descriptionText:
Join Barclays as a Strategy & Insights Analyst, where you will support the delivery of the Group Innovation and Partnerships Strategy & Insights agenda through market intelligence, customer and industry research, strategic analysis, and executive-ready insight generation. Working within a highly visible team, you will help shape Barclays' innovation priorities by analysing market and technology trends, producing thought leadership, horizon-scanning and predictive insight papers, and translating complex information into clear, actionable recommendations. This role offers broad exposure across the business, partnering with senior stakeholders to support innovation initiatives, portfolio governance activities, and evidence-based decision making that enables Barclays to identify, assess, and act on emerging opportunities and risks.

Please note that this is a 12-month fixed-term contract.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need


Ability to research market, customer, competitor and technology developments; analyse qualitative and quantitative information; and translate findings into clear, evidence-led recommendations.Ability to communicate complex information concisely, produce high-quality, decision-ready presentations and briefings, and tailor content effectively for senior stakeholders and external partners.Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining effective oversight of actions, risks, controls, decisions and dependencies.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include


Curiosity and practical understanding of AI, digital platforms and emerging technologies, including how they could improve customer outcomes, efficiency, insight or control.Previous exposure to innovation, strategy, market intelligence, commercial analysis, governance, reporting or programme delivery within financial services or a similarly regulated environment.Ability to learn quickly, seek and act on feedback, adapt to new subject areas and proactively build capability over time.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The successful candidate can be based in London (Luke Street) or Glasgow Campus.

Purpose of the role

To collaborate, nurture and drive group innovation with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the bank stays at the forefront of innovation and adapts to the rapidly changing landscape in financial services and increasing customer expectations.

Accountabilities


Collaboration with a range of stakeholders to develop a portfolio of open innovation and strategic initiatives through experimentation, co-creation, access to innovative technology capabilities, products and services and a global innovation ecosystem.Development and delivery of frameworks, ideation, training and tools to build a culture of innovation and knowledge sharing to enable new and creative ideas/solutions that deliver on the bank’s strategy.Provision of a global platform and curated ecosystem of partners to inform strategy, drive connectivity and new insights.Development of the strategic capabilities and programmes for the bank to deliver on its strategy, supporting the exploration, evaluation and execution of innovation and investment opportunities.Management and coordination between external stakeholders/partners and the bank, to successfully deliver joint projects and initiatives.Deliver thought leadership and insights to inform strategic decision making and organisational readiness, in conjunction with regular research, identifying emerging technologies and trends.Development and management of key metrics including key partnerships, innovation initiatives and impact through regular assessments to calculate the return on investment and identify any potential risks and issues.


Analyst Expectations


To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise.Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise.They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.Partner with other functions and business areas.Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.Escalate breaches of policies/procedure appropriately.Take responsibility for embedding new policies/procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex/sensitive information.Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. rows.title: E+ Associate Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.

Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.

We connect. We inspire.

The Department for Education has announced that the British Council is set to take on the role of National Agency for Erasmus+.

In December the UK and EU arrived at a political agreement that the UK would rejoin the Erasmus+ scheme in 2027. That agreement has now been legally formalised under the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement.

The British Council has a longstanding commitment to supporting international exchange. It was a lead partner in the Erasmus+ UK National Agency from 2014-20, where Erasmus+ made a significant contribution to the UK's cultural relations activities, funding 8,091 projects, engaging 583,757 UK participants, and awarding around €1.1 billion to UK organisations.

Job Title: E+ Associate Business Intelligence Analyst

Pay Band: PB7

Contract Duration: 2 Year Fixed Term Contract with possibility of extension

Location: London, Cardiff, Edinburgh, Belfast

Salary : £32,381 annual Gross Salary

Right to Work Requirements: Current right to work in the UK. The British Council is not able to support or sponsor work visa applications.

Closing Date: Applications will close on Wednesday 20th September 2026 7:30 UK time.

We are operating on the basis that any offer is made pending client confirmation of funds.

Role Purpose

The Associate Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst will support the development and delivery of data analysis and data projects, delivering high-quality performance reporting and insight for the Erasmus+ programme. The role involves working closely with the wider data function and aligned to central DEP standards, and support delivery of KPIs data, dashboards, visualisations and management information, under supervision, for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring outputs are accurate, consistent, and timely. The postholder will help the team translate complex data into clear, actionable insights to support performance monitoring, identify risks and opportunities, and drive continuous improvement across the programme.

Main Accountabilities But Not Limited To The Following

Contribute to the development and maintenance of Erasmus+ performance reporting frameworks, ensuring alignment with programme objectives, KPIs, and DfE/EC requirements.Collect, prepare, and manage data from multiple programme systems and delivery partners, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and fitness for purpose.Support the BI and Reporting Analyst in translating complex programme data into clear narratives and actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI) to support programme monitoring and reporting.Support teams in identifying key operational and performance questions, defining data needs to inform decision-making.Conduct analysis on programme delivery, participant journeys, and operational performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.Ensure all data and reporting activities comply with data governance, ethics, and privacy standards.Collaborate with data, digital, and technology teams to improve data quality, integration, and accessibility across Erasmus+.Contribute to wider British Council data best practice and learning, ensuring alignment with central DEP approaches.

Requirements Of The Role

Role Specific Skills:

Data visualisation (Awareness): Develop and use appropriate data visualisations to tell meaningful stories and address relevant to set goals.Applying statistical and analytical tools and techniques (Awareness): Support the development of statistical and analytical insights and reports.Communicating between the technical and non-technical (Awareness): Explain complex analysis clearly to diverse internal and external stakeholders.Data ethics and privacy (Awareness): Identify appropriate channels to discuss ethical issues, with support.Data management (Awareness): Follow governance standards, policies, and procedures for data access, sharing, and protection.Data preparation and linkage (Awareness): Clean, prepare, and link data, resolving data quality issues and ensuring reproducibility.Developing code for analysis (Awareness): Write and document analysis code to support reproducible, reliable reporting and insights.Managing a data project (Awareness): Deliver intended outcomes for small data projects.

Minimum/essential

Role Specific Knowledge and Experience:

Significant experience in BI analysis or data analysis.Data visualisation skills, with experience creating dashboards and reports.Strong quantitative analysis skills, with proficiency in tools such as Excel, Power BI, analytics platforms and SQL.Experience maintaining and tracking metrics for programme performance and audiences.Ability to translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.Understanding of data privacy and security principles.Ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, for diverse audiences.Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Desirable

Qualification(s) in data analysis or equivalent.Familiarity with visualisation tools such as Power BI.Experience working in a global or multicultural context.Understanding of Agile ways of working and product development cycles.Experience analysing Google Analytics (GA4) data.

Language Requirements

Education

Degree or equivalent work experience.

Requirements

Please note that candidates must have the pre-existing, legal right to work in the listed locations at the time of application.

This is a hybrid role – primarily working from the office (3 days a week) with home working flexibility.

Mobility / relocation / visa sponsoring support will not be provided.

British Council supports working in new ways such as hybrid working, subject to full approval by line management and conditional upon our ability to provide the appropriate level of service. This may not be appropriate for all roles but can be explored at interview

A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.

Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent. We guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities.

Safeguarding Statement

The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989. Appointment to positions where there is direct involvement with vulnerable groups will be dependent on thorough checks being completed in line with legal requirements and with the British Council’s Safeguarding policies for Adults and Children.

rows.descriptionText:

For this role we offer the hybrid working approach with 3 days a week onsite in Osterley campus.

Develops, analyses and reports on Audience Segmentation/Models to inform Sky’s Business commercial or revenue strategy Work closely with Marketing Operations to ensure effective campaign activation and performance measurement. Apply now to build an amazing career and be part of a brilliant team. We can’t wait to hear from you.

To find out more about working with us, search on social media. A job you love to talk about.

rows.title: Business Analyst

You will be responsible for eliciting, analysing, and translating complex business requirements, particularly across digital assets, tokenisation, and market infrastructure, into clear, actionable user stories and functional specifications that drive delivery.

This role suits a commercially minded analyst who is equally comfortable in client workshops and sprint planning sessions, someone who understands how capital markets and digital asset ecosystems operate, and who can engage credibly with both business stakeholders and engineering teams to ensure solutions are delivered that genuinely meet client needs.

Responsibilities

Job requirements

Lead requirements-gathering sessions with clients, facilitating workshops to elicit, challenge, and validate business needs across digital asset and financial services use cases.Translate business requirements into well-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications suitable for Agile development teams.Document current-state business processes, workflows, and use cases, verifying accuracy with clients and internal teams before baseline sign-off.Identify process improvement opportunities and work with clients and internal stakeholders to design future-state operating models, particularly in the context of digital asset adoption and tokenised workflows.Present and communicate specifications clearly to software development teams, ensuring requirements are understood, estimated, and prioritised appropriately within the product backlog.Act as the client-side voice throughout the development lifecycle, providing ongoing clarification, managing scope, and ensuring delivered functionality remains aligned with original business intent.Support and oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), verifying that software functionality meets agreed requirements and specifications before client sign-off.Support clients in articulating and documenting their own business requirements where needed, acting as a trusted advisor rather than simply an order-taker.Deliver training, presentations, and demonstrations of MACH’s software to clients and internal staff, ensuring adoption and understanding of new functionality.Identify, escalate, and help resolve issues or blockers experienced by clients or internal team members, maintaining clear communication throughout.

Requirements

Fin-Tech, consulting or client-facing experience within financial services, ideally across capital markets, post-trade, or digital assets.Solid understanding of market infrastructure, including trading, clearing, settlement, custody, or tokenisation workflows.Demonstrable experience writing high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications for software development teams.Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and working within cross-functional delivery teams.Sufficient technical literacy to engage meaningfully with software developers, understanding of system integrations, APIs, and data flows, without needing to write code.Excellent client relationship skills with a proven track record of building trust and managing expectations across technical and non-technical stakeholders.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data flows and operational processes and translate them into clear requirements.Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Excel, and process modelling or diagramming software (e.g. Visio, Lucidchart).Capable of producing clear, concise, and well-structured documentation including business requirements documents (BRDs), process maps, and test scripts.

Who We Are

Delta Capita Group (a member of the Prytek Group) is a global managed services, consulting, and solutions provider with a unique combination of experience in Financial Services and technology innovation capability. rows.title: Behavioural Analyst (UKSBA Membership Required)
rows.descriptionText:
ABOUT PSG 
We have a long and proud history of transforming the lives of children, young people and adults with learning disabilities, autism, and mental health difficulties.
We are the largest provider of Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) commissioned by the NHS.
We also work in provider organisations in community settings.
Our goal is to give individuals, their parents / carers, and network of professionals the knowledge, skills, and motivation they need to provide the best possible support and to increase their quality of life in sustainable and long-lasting ways.
We achieve these incredible outcomes by developing evidence-based, contextually fit models of support for individuals and their support networks in the various settings they live.
We are a team of value-driven Behaviour Analysts and PBS Practitioners. We embody our values in everything we do.
PSG VALUES
Passionate – To be fully committed to the work that we do and take a vested interest in the successes of our clients and the company.
Authentic – To be our honest, true, and best selves at work.
Courageous – To push through discomfort and adversity to realise our values and cultivate courageous cultures in our workplace and networks.
Collaborative – To share our ambitions and achieve them together.
Trustworthy – To be arbiters of the truth, modelling integrity and applying our expertise effectively.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Salary £35,000 - £40,000 d.o.e.
The Behaviour Analyst is responsible for managing a caseload of complex clients, delivering assessments and interventions that lead to positive changes for the individual, their families, and wider support networks. This will require flexibility in approach and delivery across a variety of settings—including schools, hospitals, community environments, and supported living services. The role demands a solution-focused, values-led mindset with the resilience to navigate complex situations. To be successful in this role, employees will:
Have a high degree of empathy and a strong value-base.
Communicate calmly and effectively in situations which may be emotionally or physically challenging.
Collaboratively engage a client and their network in the process of our support and identify quality of life goals.
Collaborate with stakeholders to remove barriers impacting an individual’s quality of life.
Undertake functional behaviour assessments (FBA) and / or practical functional assessments to develop formulations for clients.
Write high-quality FBA reports and present findings to clients, their families / carers and network.
Plan interventions based on FBA report findings.
Apply Behaviour Analysis and PBS principles and technologies to develop effective, function-based interventions and behaviour support plans (BSP).
Collect data and analyse progress towards identified goals.
Train mediators in interventions outlined in the client’s BSP.
Inspire networks to actively commit to client support.
Participate in CeTR panels, contributing clinical insights on risk and care planning.
Deliver internal and external training on a range of clinical best-practice topics.
Hold accountability for ensuring clients and mediators are aligned with the agreed intervention plan, devising solutions to any barriers.
Follow all policy and procedures in relation to safeguarding, health and safety, and risk management.
Maintain the highest standards of record keeping including electronic data entry and recording through professional self-governance in accordance with professional codes of practice, data security requirements and GDPR principles.
Hold up to date knowledge of legislation, national and local policies, and issues in relation to both the specific client group, Behaviour Analysis and Positive Behaviour Support.
Adhere at all times to PSG safeguarding policies, procedures, and codes of conduct, and act in the best interests of children and young people.
Maintain a clear understanding of safeguarding responsibilities, including recognising, responding to, and escalating concerns in line with organisational procedures.
Qualifications & Experience:
Behaviour Analysts must be in good standing with the UKSBA(cert).
Working with children, young people and / or adults with learning disabilities, autism, and / or mental health difficulties.
Managing own caseload of clients with complex needs.
Conducting FBAs and developing function based BSPs.
Planning and implementing evidence-based programmes to achieve positive outcomes for clients.
Developing, implementing, and overseeing data collection systems to monitor client progress towards their goals.
Training others in behaviour support techniques.
Report writing and sharing with key stakeholders (e.g., client, mediators, and network).
BENEFITS
A competitive salary, dependant on experience and qualifications.23 days paid holiday plus bank holidays, increasing every year up to 28 days.Your birthday off.Physical and mental well-being support.Seasonal benefits and staff socials.Hybrid working and flexibility.Comprehensive clinical supervision package through on-going individual and group supervision, and monthly company-wide learning lunches.Company culture that supports you with professional development through performance management and appraisals.Multiple and varied learning and development opportunities, including a personal budget for continuing education and BACB® and UK-SBA renewal fees.Employee Assistance ProgrammeTax-Efficient PensionWeekly Wellbeing HourHealth Cash PlanEnhanced Maternity payReferral bonusTraining including PROACT-SCIP

rows.title: Analyst, Risk Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Sony Corporation of America, located in New York, NY, is the U.S. headquarters of Sony Group Corporation, based in Tokyo, Japan. Sony's principal U.S. businesses include Sony Electronics Inc., Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC, Sony Music Entertainment, Sony Music Publishing and Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc. With some 900 million Sony devices in hands and homes worldwide today, a vast array of Sony movies, television shows and music, and the PlayStation Network, Sony creates and delivers more entertainment experiences to more people than anyone else on earth. To learn more: www.sony.com/en.

Sony is seeking a Senior Analyst, Risk Analytics to join Sony’s Corporate Information Security Division in London, UK. In this role, you’ll partner across the global information security, IT, and business landscape to design, implement, and evolve a data-driven Global Information Security Risk Analytics platform. Reporting to the Director of Risk Analytics, you will help transform diverse and complex datasets into objective, actionable insights that support senior leadership decision-making and monitor the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Sony assets. You’ll work closely with technical and non-technical teams to understand operational challenges, uncover meaningful data patterns, build analytical and engineering solutions, and translate results into intuitive, compelling stories. This is a hands-on role that blends data engineering, data analysis, and stakeholder engagement to mature Sony’s enterprise-wide security risk intelligence capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Build, refine, and maintain ETL pipelines that integrate data from multiple sources while ensuring quality, consistency, and trustworthiness.Develop tools, scripts, and automation to streamline data processing, risk measurement, and platform operations.Develop and maintain analytics, metrics, and dashboards that measure information security performance, risk exposure, remediation progress, and control effectiveness.Analyze large volumes of security, IT, and business data to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks.Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling material for executives and operational stakeholders.Contribute to the design and evaluation of metrics, models, and dashboards used to monitor information security performanceCollaborate with cross‑functional teams to understand requirements, frame analytical problems, and deliver actionable insights.Provide excellent stakeholder support, including communication, requirements definition, and delivery of reports and dashboards that meet evolving needs.Document solutions, workflows, and procedures to help ensure consistency, accuracy, and knowledge sharing.


Required Qualifications And Experience

Advanced understanding of statistics, data analysis, and data visualization.Working knowledge of common information security and IT concepts, such as vulnerability management, patching, endpoint security, cloud security, identity and access management, asset inventory, logging/monitoring, or risk management.Ability to analyze large and complex security, IT, and business datasets to identify trends, anomalies, data quality issues, and emerging risks.Experience with data modeling (star/snowflake schema, dimensional modeling).Proficiency with relational database (SQL) and programming/scripting (Python or R).Typically 2 years of relevant experience in information security, IT, data analysis, statistics, or related field. Strong problem‑solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.Interest in both deep technical data exploration and high‑quality stakeholder engagement.Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Understanding of data quality frameworks (validation, profiling, anomaly detection). 


Preferred Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Analysis, or a mathematics/information security field.Hands-on experience with cybersecurity or IT data sources, such as vulnerability scanners, endpoint detection tools, CMDBs, cloud platforms, identity systems, SIEM/logging platforms, or ticketing systems.Experience with version control tools (e.g., Git/GitHub/Gitlab) o Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Domo).


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation.

rows.title: Consultant, Advanced Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Rakuten International is a division of Rakuten Group, Inc., a Japanese global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Headquartered in San Mateo, California with more than 4,000 employees worldwide, the Rakuten International business portfolio includes market leaders in e-commerce, digital marketing, advertising, communications and entertainment. We create products and services that provide exceptional value by aligning members and the businesses that want to engage them in a shared community.

Rakuten Advertising provides advertising technology and consumer insights to the world’s leading brands and retailers. Working with agencies and brands around the world, Rakuten Advertising unites technology, client strategy and consumer insights to deliver advertising experiences that drive increased brand awareness and marketing performance. With access to Rakuten’s diverse media properties and audiences, combined with an award-winning performance network and proprietary consumer research, Rakuten Advertising creates the right conditions to reach new customers and sustain long-lasting loyalty.

Job Summary:

Responsible for the development and execution of analyses that address specific client issues or initiatives. This role proactively identifies trends and issues utilizing a comprehensive range of analytic techniques and tools, translating complex business questions into actionable analytical solutions. The Consultant liaises directly with client services, network development, and operational personnel, and engages directly with clients to ensure the appropriateness of underlying assumptions and interpretations, and to provide expert direction on client analytics solutions/services, both internally and externally.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the development and delivery of client analytics and reporting activities, driving client relationship building, and managing the overall project lifecycle of externally focused analytic deliverables.Independently develop and refine methodologies, tools, and templates to allow for the successful execution of analytic deliverables. Proactively identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency.Support the ongoing development of the Advanced Analytics group capabilities by sharing innovative approaches and solutions with the broader team, and actively mentor junior team members.Participate in various activities to support the growth of the Advanced Analytics group including:Developing and delivering training content to Account Management and other internal functions.Leading the development and maintenance of appropriate documentation regarding advanced analytic approaches, metric definitions, etc.Proactively identify client business needs and translate them into robust analytical questions and solution designs.Present complex analytical findings and strategic recommendations directly to clients, influencing their decision-making processes.
Specific tasks:

Client Insights & Solution Design:Lead client discussions to define analytical objectives and scope, guiding them towards the most impactful solutions.Design and execute advanced custom analyses leveraging internal tools/databases (e.g., benchmarking, publisher optimization, program performance analysis), delivering comprehensive insights and strategic recommendations.Develop and optimize complex trend analyses and performance dashboards, ensuring they align with evolving client needs and provide actionable intelligence.Data Quality & Operational Excellence:Oversee and ensure the integrity and accuracy of recurring reports and data pipelines, proactively resolving complex data discrepancies.Manage and adapt reporting structures to accommodate complex client requirements, including fiscal calendar challenges.Investigate and resolve complex discrepancies between dashboards and manual reports, implementing long-term solutions for data consistency.Strategic Support:Independently assess and forecast sales potential for prospects based on comprehensive data analysis and market insights, providing strategic input to sales teams.Contribute to the strategic development of new analytical products and services based on client needs and market trends.
Qualifications and Minimum Requirements:

Candidate will have at least 2 years of experience in analytics/reporting, with a strong focus on client-facing roles or significant project ownership. Successful candidates may bring experience from an agency, client, or consulting environment. Bachelor’s degree required.

Advanced Analytical Skills – Expert in analyzing and synthesizing complex information to understand issues, identify root causes, and propose optimal solutions. Demonstrated ability to independently translate ambiguous business requirements into precise analytical questions and comprehensive solution designs. Proven ability to utilize and expand prospective business models.Technical Abilities - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (including advanced functions, VBA), and strong experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, MicroStrategy) for dashboard development and data visualization. Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation is required. Familiarity with Python or R for advanced analytics and automation is highly beneficial.Client & Stakeholder Management – Proven ability to independently manage diverse client and internal stakeholder relationships, effectively communicating complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Builds strong networks and acts as a trusted advisor.Organizing and Planning - Demonstrated ability to independently plan, organize, and prioritize multiple complex projects, effectively balancing resources, skills, priorities, and timescales to achieve objectives.Adaptability - Adaptable and proactive in responding to changing circumstances, effectively managing, solving problems, and providing innovative solutions in ambiguous environments.Communicating Effectively – Written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to adjust messaging to fit diverse audiences and deliver compelling presentations that drive action.Team Player – Proven ability to manage strong working relationships within the company, and actively contribute to team knowledge sharing, mentorship, and best practices.Critical Thinking – Strong in using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to complex problems.Plan for Contingencies – Proactively identifies potential problems and independently creates robust contingency plans or “work-arounds” to ensure project success.Understanding the Business – Knows the mission-critical technical and functional skills needed; understands various types of business propositions and how businesses operate. Continuously learns new methods and technologies.

Five Principles for Success

Our worldwide practices describe specific behaviors that make Rakuten unique and united across the world. We expect Rakuten employees to model these 5 Shugi Principles of Success.

Always improve, Always Advance - Only be satisfied with complete success - Kaizen

Passionately Professional - Take an uncompromising approach to your work and be determined to be the best

Hypothesize - Practice - Validate – Shikumika - Use the Rakuten Cycle to succeed in unknown territory

Maximize Customer Satisfaction - The greatest satisfaction for our teams is seeing their customers smile

Speed!! Speed!! Speed!! - Always be conscious of time - take charge, set clear goals, and engage your team

rows.title: GTM Business Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Soldo is here to change the way businesses spend, for the better. So every employee, department, and team is more productive and successful at work. Soldo connects company cards with a powerful management platform so finance teams can distribute money instantly, while staying in control of who spends, how much, where, and on what. With Soldo, budgeting, payments, reporting and reconciliation are simple and efficient.
We’re both a financial services and a software company and one of Europe’s fastest growing fintech companies. Operating in the UK, Italy and Ireland, we’re over 350 employees (from 26 nationalities) strong.
We’re a place where anyone can thrive. We’re all about doing the right things for the right reasons, high standards, ambition, drive and focus.
What’s in it for you
Competitive salaryPrivate healthcare for you and your familyPension schemeFlexible working options including working from home or our Marylebone office60 days’ work anywhere, even outside the UK if you want25 days off a year, plus public holidays as well as Christmas Eve and New Years' Eve, 2 volunteering days and an extra day off on your birthdayGenuine career development opportunities, including our mentoring scheme, your own annual £500 learning budgetEmployee Assistance Programme and wellbeing portal
The role
The GTM Business Operations Analyst plays a key role in designing, improving, and scaling the operational processes that power Soldo’s GTM organisation.
As part of the GTM Business Operations team, you will work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Onboarding, Pricing & Billing to identify operational inefficiencies, redesign processes, and help implement scalable solutions that improve the customer and employee experience.
This is a highly hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys solving operational problems, improving how teams work, and driving meaningful change in a fast-moving SaaS environment.
Key Responsibilities
Process Design & OptimisationContinuously identify opportunities to improve GTM processes across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Onboarding, Pricing & Billing, and related operational areas.Support process redesign initiatives, analyse existing workflows, partnering with stakeholders to simplify, remove friction, and improve scalability.Operations MonitoringAnalyse operational data, workflows, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.Support the development of business cases and recommendations for operational change.Exception ManagementIdentify operational exceptions, process breakdowns, and recurring points of friction across GTM workflows.Establish sustainable operational controls and standardised processes to reduce recurring issues over time.Special Projects & New InitiativesSupport the launch of new GTM motions, operational models, and cross-functional initiatives.Support project delivery from problem definition through implementation, coordinating activities across stakeholders and workstreams.
Must Have
Relevant experience in a Business Operations, Operations Analyst, Business Analyst, RevOps, Consulting, or similar role.Strong process-oriented mindset with an ability to identify inefficiencies and design scalable improvements.Experience working cross-functionally in fast-paced operational environments.Strong problem-solving and organisational skills, with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.Experience working with operational systems and technology platforms such as Salesforce or similar business systems.Ability to translate business problems into structured operational solutions.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across both business and technical teams.Experience documenting and mapping business processes using flowcharts, process maps, or similar techniques.Experience working with spreadsheets, reporting tools, and operational datasets to investigate problems and quantify opportunities.Interest in operational excellence, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and scalable SaaS operations.Experience supporting process implementation, transformation projects, or operational change initiatives is preferred. Familiarity with Revenue Operations, GTM processes, or SaaS commercial operations is advantageous.

rows.title: Customer Insights & Modelling Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Caffè Nero operates around 1,000 coffee houses in the UK, the Republic of Ireland, the US, Poland, Cyprus, Turkey, the Middle East and Sweden and is Europe’s leading independent premium coffee house. Now employing circa 10,000 employees, since we opened in 1997 we have been providing exceptional, hand-crafted Italian coffee and fresh, high-quality food to customers seeking an authentic, Italian experience. The UK Caffè Nero Group comprises of Caffè Nero UK, Harris + Hoole, FCB Coffee, 200 Degrees and Coffee#1.
The role:We are looking for a Customer Insights & Modelling Executive at Caffè Nero. The role is based at our offices in Covent Garden, Central London.
Reporting to the Senior Customer Marketing Manager, the Customer Insights & Modelling Executive will analyse and interpret customer-level data to generate actionable insight that improves CRM effectiveness, loyalty engagement and customer value.
The role will work across first-party transactional and loyalty data, brand tracking, CRM performance and customer experience survey data to understand customer behaviour, identify growth opportunities and support more effective targeting. Working with our data agency and internal development teams, they will help develop segmentation, propensity models and lifecycle targeting that support activation, growth, retention and reactivation.
Key accountabilities for this role include:
Customer insight and analysisAnalyse customer data across transactional, loyalty, CRM, brand tracking and experience survey sources.Identify actionable insight around customer frequency, spend, product preferences, loyalty participation, attachment, lifecycle stage, lapse risk and reactivation opportunity.Translate customer data into clear recommendations that support CRM planning, campaign targeting, product opportunities and commercial decision-making.
Segmentation, modelling and agency collaborationWork with the nominated data agency to develop and maintain customer segmentation frameworks and propensity models.Support models including likelihood to lapse, likelihood to respond, likelihood to buy specific products and likelihood to increase frequency.Turn segmentation and model outputs into practical audience recommendations for CRM campaigns and lifecycle journeys.
CRM operations and automationSupport the development, implementation and optimisation of CRM flows, automations and customer journeys.Develop audience selections, campaign logic, targeting rules and suppression criteria using available customer data and segmentation.Ensure CRM activity is correctly configured, tested, launched and monitored, with strong QA, scheduling, controls and reporting discipline.
Campaign measurement and optimisationMeasure the performance of CRM campaigns, lifecycle journeys and customer marketing activity across engagement, conversion, visit behaviour, revenue and incremental uplift where possible.Support test-and-learn activity including A/B testing, control groups, offer testing and journey optimisation.Identify what is working, what is underperforming and what should be scaled, changed or stopped.
The right person:Caffè Nero is a company with a very special culture and an open and friendly style of working. It operates at pace and is a high-energy, invigorating environment. It attracts people with warmth and a positive outlook who genuinely enjoy working with people.
Whichever country you’re in, Caffè Nero has a culture in which close-knit relationships and trust are at its heart. At Caffè Nero, you truly feel part of a kind and caring family.The Customer Insights & Modelling Executive will be analytical, commercially curious and highly practical. They will enjoy finding the useful signal in complex customer data and turning it into clear decisions, better targeting and more effective customer journeys.
The successful candidate will have:Experience analysing customer, loyalty, CRM, transactional or behavioural data in a consumer-facing business.Strong analytical capability, with confidence interpreting data, identifying patterns and translating analysis into practical recommendations.Experience working with segmentation, propensity models, lifecycle targeting or customer value analysis.Understanding of CRM campaign planning, journey logic, audience selection, testing, QA and performance reporting.Ability to work with agencies, data teams and non-technical stakeholders to turn business questions into usable insight outputs.Strong attention to detail and operational discipline, particularly around campaign setup, measurement and data quality.Experience with loyalty programmes, marketing automation platforms, BI tools, SQL, Python, retail or hospitality data would be an advantage.
Being part of the Caffè Nero Team:A wonderful place to work, right in the middle of bustling Covent Garden (our Head Office Teams are currently working a minimum of 3 days a week in the office).Access to our benefits platform, giving discounts at the touch of a button.25 days holiday per annum (plus bank holidays), rising with service.Bonus scheme.50% employee discount on handcrafted drinks and 40% employee discount on food.Private medical care through Vitality.Medicash (cash plan healthcare scheme).Supporting our team members to achieve their professional goals is important to us, so alongside your day to day work you may have an opportunity to complete a professional qualification with our learning partners.Free hand-crafted drinks whilst you’re in the office - in your first week you’ll have Barista training, so you’ll know how to make the very best Caffè Nero coffee.

rows.title: AI Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At Bionic, we're on a mission to make it radically easier to run a small business. As the UK's leading business comparison and switching service, we help thousands of small and medium-sized businesses save time and money on essentials like energy, broadband, insurance, and finance. We combine smart technology with real human support to match our customers with the best deals - quickly and effortlessly. With trusted partnerships including Compare the Market, USwitch for Business, MoneySuperMarket and Confused.com, we're committed to help SMEs get the best deals for their business essentials every time. The role 
We're looking for detail-oriented and analytical AI Operations Analysts to play a critical role in supporting the governance and quality assurance of AI-driven processes across Bionic. As part of our Business Excellence function, you'll sit at the intersection of Operations, Compliance and AI Innovation. You'll be responsible for reviewing AI-generated outcomes, validating results against available evidence and ensuring decisions are applied fairly, consistently and accurately before they are used in downstream sales and operational processes. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with AI technologies while helping shape how AI is used responsibly in a fast-growing business. If you're naturally curious, highly organised and enjoy solving problems through evidence-based decision making, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities 
AI Validation & Quality Assurance Validate AI-generated outcomes across Energy and Insurance before they are used in business processes. Review call recordings, transcripts and AI rationale to determine whether outcomes are accurate and appropriately applied. Identify true fails, false fails, accepted exceptions and potential technical issues. Ensure validation activities are completed accurately and consistently against agreed criteria. Analysis & Reporting Update system records and validation fields to ensure reporting remains accurate and reliable. Support monthly reporting cycles through completion of validation reviews and challenge processes. Conduct periodic sampling activities to identify potential false-pass trends and support ongoing assurance. Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for validation decisions and escalations. Continuous Improvement Track recurring validation themes, process gaps and AI tool limitations. Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and reporting accuracy. Escalate technical issues and recurring system challenges to relevant stakeholders. Contribute insights that support the ongoing evolution of AI-supported workflows and governance. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with Business Excellence, AI Innovation, Sales Leadership and Legal & Compliance teams. Support the fair, transparent and evidence-led use of AI outputs across the organisation. Build strong working relationships across technical and operational teams to drive positive outcomes. 
About you 
We're looking for people who combine strong analytical thinking with exceptional attention to detail. You'll be comfortable working with data, applying defined criteria consistently and making objective decisions based on evidence. You'll likely have: Excellent attention to detail and a highly accurate approach to work. Strong judgement and the ability to make fair, evidence-based decisions. The ability to identify patterns, trends, process issues and root causes. Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly document decisions. Confidence in escalating complex, unclear or high-risk issues when required. Experience working with multiple stakeholders across operational, compliance or technical teams. The ability to manage competing priorities while meeting important deadlines. A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive information. Required skills & experience Strong IT literacy with experience using business systems and learning new technologies quickly. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Teams. Experience working with structured data and reporting outputs. Ability to identify and document technical issues, data gaps and process failures. Desirable Skills & Experience Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms. Experience using Tableau or other reporting and analytics tools. Experience reviewing customer interactions, call recordings or transcripts. Exposure to AI tools, speech analytics, quality monitoring or automated evaluation systems. Experience within compliance, quality assurance, audit, sales support or operational controls environments. Knowledge of the Energy and/or Insurance sectors. 
The interview process 
Initial one-way video interview Final stage in person interview with the Hiring Manager 
About Bionic Group 
Bionic has over 600 people working across three office locations and four businesses; Bionic - London, Bionic Outbound - Luton, Think Business Loans - Chelmsford, Utility Bidder - Corby and Smart - Field based agents. We have a high energy work environment wherever the location; you can feel the passion the moment you walk through our door! Our work environments are packed with amazing people and energy, hubs of collaboration, creativity and fun! We're one team, we get stuck in, we roll our sleeves up and we care about helping each other out wherever we can. We set the highest standards and show up every day to be the best version of ourselves. Working at Bionic means provides you many opportunities to advance your career, with incredible progression, recognition, and reward. Benefits 
We know that our employees are what sets us aside from our competitors, our benefits are just part of the way we say thanks. Enhance your health & wellbeing 🌱 Private healthcare cover Employee Assistance Programme, including a virtual GP service, priority physio & talking therapies Eyecare scheme Taking time away from work 🏖️ 25 days annual leave plus the 8 UK bank holidays, increasing with tenure 1 paid family/religious day of leave per year - following successful probation period 1 paid charity volunteering day per year Option to buy/sell up to an additional 3 days leave per year  Family matters: for the special moments 🏠 Enhanced maternity, paternity or shared parental leave 2 days off for your wedding upon joining, and up to 5 days after 2 years' service Flexible working options & a hybrid work approach Financial wellbeing 💸 Auto-enrolled salary sacrifice pension scheme Life assurance Season ticket Loans, salary advances & loans to buy/rent a home - based on tenure Cycle to work scheme Recognition 🌟 Highflyers incentive, a VIP experience for our high performers across Bionic group to celebrate success Company summer & Christmas party celebrations, business and local zonely & annual awards and recognition Long service awards

rows.title: Consultant, Business Intelligence
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

FTI Consulting is seeking a highly motivated, Consultant to join its Business Intelligence team in London. The Business Intelligence team conducts corporate investigations, uncovers actionable business intelligence, supports clients in commercial disputes, and provides clear analysis to help decision-makers address and mitigate risk, protect assets and maximise opportunities in a variety of jurisdictions worldwide. Its expertise lies in investigative due diligence, asset tracing, fraud and anti-corruption investigations, litigation support, whistle-blower allegations, third-party integrity screening, political risk assessments and other bespoke engagements.

What You’ll Do

POSITION OVERVIEWYou'd be joining Incite's Atlantic Practice, working with major US and global businesses. This isn't a role where you simply keep projects on track. You'll shape the thinking, advise clients directly, and influence the strategic direction of the work.One of our biggest clients is MetLife – a major US-based financial services company that offer group benefits, insurance, retirement products and other financial services. Every year, MetLife asks a big question: what do working people need to do their best work, and what are employers getting wrong? The answer becomes the Employee Benefit Trends Study (EBTS), one of the most widely cited pieces of thought leadership in the benefits world.The EBTS programme sits at the centre of the role. It's research of the best kind: big questions about how the workplace is changing, genuine involvement in shaping the themes before any fieldwork begins, and findings that get published and quoted rather than filed away. It is about much more than insurance; it is about understanding how human needs are evolving, what businesses need to succeed, and where the world of work is going next.Beyond MetLife, you'll work across other clients as well, spending approximately 70% of your time on MetLife projects and the other 30% on other clients – with many opportunities to solve interesting strategic challenges and make meaningful impact.

Design research approach, from questionnaires and discussion guides to innovative methods, ensuring the right question gets asked in the right wayTurn data into Insight - work across quantitative and qualitative evidence to uncover the "so what" in the data. Conduct complex analysis, ensure data reliability, and synthesise large datasets into insights worth publishing. Collaborate with analytics specialists when deeper expertise is neededCraft Compelling Narratives - moving beyond data presentation to narrative impact, ensuring findings are matched by strong storytellingBuild Trusted Client Relationships - manage day-to-day relationships with senior stakeholders, positioning as a solutions-focused trusted advisor. 25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays (Christmas closure – 3 days additional to entitlement – discretionary and non-contractual leave)Flexible, hybrid working options – we expect you to be at the office 3 days a weekA contributory group personal pension scheme, to which we contribute 4% of Qualified Banded earnings to each team member’s gross salary after an initial 3 months service4-week sabbatical after 4 years continuous service on top of 25 days holiday2 volunteering paid days per year (under a formal program for a registered charity)A Health cash planLife assurance scheme at 4 x salaryCycle to work scheme following successful completion of probation

Job Title: Data Analyst - Safety, Health and Environment

Business Function: SHE, Supply Chain

Location: Leeds (Local (Inside UK) Relocation Assistance is considered)

Job Purpose

We make some of the UK’s best-known personal care brands in Leeds. Our Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) team keeps our people safe, protects our environment and keeps our site compliant. As our site becomes more data-led, we need sharper, faster ways to turn SHE information into clear insight and action. We’re looking for someone who loves data, problem-solving and making work simpler – and wants to use those skills for something that genuinely matters. You’ll build dashboards, automations and reports that help our leaders see where the real risks are, so we can spend less time chasing information and more time acting on the insights that make our operations safer for people and the environment.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for safety, health and environmental performance Automate the reporting that’s currently manual - using Power Automate, Power Apps, Forms and AI tools such as Copilot Own the quality of our SHE data: collect it, check it, and make sure what we report is right, first time Spot trends and outliers, explain what they mean, and help us decide where to focus next to improve SHE performance Work with operations, engineering, finance and our global SHE teams to turn the data into action 

All About You

What we’re looking for

Strong digital, analytical and data communication skills (or the appetite and evidence that you can get there fast) Confidence working with imperfect data - cleaning, modelling and making it trustworthy Curiosity about how a factory works and a genuine interest in health, safety and sustainability A degree, apprenticeship or demonstrable self-taught capability in data, analytics or a related field 

You don’t need

A SHE qualification – we’ll teach you the safety and environment side Manufacturing experience – we’ll show you the factory floor 

What You’ll Get

Real ownership from day one - this will be your remit, with the autonomy to build tools, improve processes and enable better data-led decisions A development pathway into SHE, data or both, with exposure to global Unilever teams A visible role with our site leadership team The opportunity to work within a fantastic team at a world-class manufacturing facility 

Interested but not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway – tell us what you’d automate first.

What We Offer

Not only do we offer a competitive salary and pension scheme, we also offer an annual bonus, subsidised gym membership, a discounted staff shop and shares. You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with our renowned and exciting brands in a flexible and hybrid working environment.

Whilst the role is advertised on a full-time basis, we would be happy to discuss possible flexible working options and what this may look like for you. We are a key advocate of wellbeing and offer a variety of support for our people including hubs, programmes and development opportunities. We strive to achieve a family-friendly and inclusive workplace and to, above all, create possibilities for all.

Diversity at Unilever is about inclusion, embracing differences, creating possibilities and growing together for better business performance. We embrace diversity in our workforce. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. We are also more than happy to provide reasonable adjustments during our application and interview process to enable you to be present your best self. To find out more, including about our Employee Resource Groups, please click here Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Unilever | Unilever.

Recruitment Fraud

Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. In the most sophisticated cases, they will set up fake websites, which have a similar address to companies like Unilever. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs.  These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate.

How is Unilever tackling this?

Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down.

What can I do?

If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat.

Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

About Sage

Sage is a global academic publisher of books, journals, and library resources with a growing range of technologies to enable discovery, access, and engagement. Believing that research and education are critical in shaping society, Sara Miller McCune founded Sage in 1965. Do more – supporting an equitable academic future, furthering disciplines that drive social change, and helping social and behavioural science make an impactWork together – building lasting relationships, championing diverse perspectives, and co-creating resources to transform teaching and learningThink long-term – experimenting, taking risks, and investing in new ideas
