The Role

This industry analyst role provides the successful candidate with an opportunity to research technology and services for ESG and sustainability data management ,reporting and performance improvement.

Excelling in the role requires an enthusiasm for understanding how technology can improve business outcomes, experience in producing high-quality written deliverables, and the ability to contribute to client-facing engagements. Successful candidates will have the ambition to undertake a wide range of qualitative and quantitative research in collaboration with other analysts.

Our analysts benefit from our structured ‘Analyst Training Framework’ which offers 24-months of tailored learning which will equip high performers to progress to more senior analyst positions at Verdantix.

Salary opportunity is £45k-£47k depending on experience level, plus a very competitive quarterly bonus scheme.

This is a hybrid role which requires 3 days a week in the office during probationary period, and will decrease to 2 days upon successful completion.

What You'll Be Doing

Conducting research on ESG and sustainability software and services based on the established portfolio of Verdantix methodologies.Undertaking interviews with senior managers at corporations and financial firms, as well as executives at technology vendors to produce reports and gain an understanding on the wider market.Building quantitative models to size and forecast software and services markets in order to produce reports on technology vendors based on technology briefings.Working with our in-house advisory team to support client workshops and consulting projects on topics such as sustainability growth strategies and product marketing thought leadership.Attending industry events to help raise the profile of Verdantix in the market.Developing trusted relationships with Verdantix clients and senior industry decision makers.Supporting marketing efforts by writing blogs and engaging in social media activities.

About You

An educational background within sustainability. A master’s level degree is desirable but not essential.Ideal candidates will have at least 2 years’ experience working in a professional services firm or a corporate sustainability role, with a preference for a background working with sustainability data management and reporting software.Experience in conducting research interviews and contributing to the development of research reports is a plus.Strong analytical mindset with the ability to solve problems and come up with new ideas.Proven ability to present publicly and host workshops, whilst also producing a number of reports and presentations; familiarity with MS office suite (including PowerPoint) would be hugely beneficialQuantitative skills and knowledge of Excel to manipulate large data sets and apply basic mathematical concepts.Interest in the future of ESG & Sustainability and technology/AI

Additional Benefits We Offer

Competitive salary (with annual review)Performance-driven quarterly bonus schemePension with enhanced employer contributionGenerous holiday entitlement, accruing an extra day with every year worked (local capping applies)Quarterly employee recognition schemeHybrid working option, with the aim of promoting flexibility and work-life balancePrivate medical insurance, including online GP service, mental health support and discounted gym membershipsEnhanced family-friendly benefitsWeekly ‘flexi-hour’ to extend a lunch break or finish early on your day of choiceCycle to work scheme - tax-efficient purchase of a bike, bike accessories, or bothTime off for volunteering when done through our partner OnHand: an app for local volunteering and climate actionMultiple social events throughout the year, including Company Ramble & Sports DayStrong focus on learning and development with career plans for all employeesDog-friendly officeFantastic colleagues with a great sense of humour!

Who We Are

Verdantix is a trusted intelligence platform. We combine 18 years of independent research with a purpose-built AI platform, giving the world's most innovative corporations, technology and services vendors, and investors insights they can act on. Our team is a curious, collaborative group of expert analysts, data engineers, commercial specialists, creative professionals and thought leaders working together to help clients achieve their most important goals.

Why Verdantix

At Verdantix, innovation, technology, and human insight come together to solve problems that really matter. We are an AI‑enabled organisation where advanced analytics, data, and emerging technologies are embedded in everyday work, shaping how we research, analyse, and deliver insights that help organizational leaders harness innovation and meet the challenges of a changing world.

Every day, our teams generate analysis and intelligence that some of the world’s most innovative companies rely on. Across areas including AI, EHS and quality, ESG and sustainability, industrial transformation, operational risk, and real estate and the built environment, we use AI and data to interpret fast‑moving technological change and translate it into insights that can be understood, applied, and acted on.

At the heart of our work is a belief that real big-picture thinking depends on a mastery of detail.

Success at Verdantix depends on curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to continuously learn as technologies evolve. We look for people who are excited by how AI can enhance thinking, sharpen analysis, and amplify impact, while remaining accountable for quality, judgment, and outcomes. Individuals who thrive here bring a strong work ethic, a desire to be challenged, a competitive mindset, and a collaborative spirit, all underpinned by a sense of humour and enjoyment in the work we do together.

Our culture is transparent, high‑trust, and performance‑driven. Career development is grounded in achievements, skills, and behaviours, with regular feedback and reviews that keep both individuals and the firm moving forward. We recognise that everyone at Verdantix has a meaningful role to play in our growth, which is why we share openly how the business is performing and involve our people in major decisions - from growth strategies to new product launches.

What unites us is a shared belief that innovation, powered by AI, expertise, and curiosity, can help shape a better world. If you want to work at the intersection of technology, insight, and real‑world impact, Verdantix is the place to do it.

Join our Data Engineering team and help shape the data, analytics and reporting capabilities that support investment oversight, research, portfolio construction and manager selection.

Required Qualifications

Prior experience in data analytics, quantitative development or reporting within investment management or financial services, with strong knowledge of investment data, portfolio analytics, performance attribution and risk.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field.

Advanced proficiency in Python, R and Structured Query Language (SQL), together with experience using database platforms.

Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate across functions and locations.

Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deliver high-quality work to deadlines and demonstrate initiative, intellectual curiosity and a practical problem-solving mindset.

Ability to research market, customer, competitor and technology developments; analyse qualitative and quantitative information; and translate findings into clear, evidence-led recommendations.Ability to communicate complex information concisely, produce high-quality, decision-ready presentations and briefings, and tailor content effectively for senior stakeholders and external partners.Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining effective oversight of actions, risks, controls, decisions and dependencies.

rows.title: HR Systems Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As HR Systems Analyst, you will support the continued development of Oracle HCM and connected HR systems. You will work closely with HR Operations, Payroll, HR Business Partners, and IT to improve the quality, usability and effectiveness of our people systems. This role offers genuine breadth. One day you may be helping to resolve a system configuration issue; the next, you could be supporting to improve onboarding journeys across multiple countries, producing HR reporting, or developing clear operating procedures for our HR Shared Services team.

Responsibilities

What you will do

 Provide functional support for Oracle HCM and related HR technology, investigating user queries, system issues and process failures.  Support HR system changes from initial requirements through testing, implementation, user communications and post-implementation review.  Partner with technical teams to help configure and improve HR processes, including employee and manager self-service, workflows, absence and leave processes, benefits and approvals.  Review HR system data for accuracy, completeness and consistency; identify root causes of issues and help implement sustainable controls and improvements.  Create and maintain recurring and ad hoc HR reports, data extracts and dashboards for HR, Payroll, Finance, leadership and regulatory reporting.  Support data gathering and validation for key workforce reporting, including diversity-related analysis, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data governance.  Work with Payroll and HR Shared Services to understand the downstream impact of system changes and ensure effective data reconciliation and hand-offs.  Help design, document and improve employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, benefits enrolment, leave and family-related processes, organisational changes and employee records.  Develop practical process documentation, standard operating procedures, user guidance and knowledge materials that enable consistent, high-quality HR service delivery.  Support employee and manager communications relating to HR systems, benefits and new processes, ensuring information is accurate, clear and easy to use.  Coordinate with external providers and internal technical teams to track incidents, enhancements, access issues, system configuration and service improvements.  Work across legal entities and countries, identifying where HR processes need local variation while maintaining appropriate global consistency.  Bring a continuous-improvement mindset: challenge manual workarounds, identify recurring themes and recommend practical, scalable solutions. 

Qualifications

What you will bring

Essential Experience And Skills

 Experience in an HR systems, HRIS, HR data, people operations or HR shared-services role.  Experience using and supporting an enterprise HR system; Oracle HCM experience is preferred.  Strong understanding of core HR processes, including employee lifecycle administration, onboarding, benefits, absence or leave and organisational data.  Experience investigating system or data issues and working with technical teams, providers or internal stakeholders to resolve them.  Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, including reviewing large datasets, reconciling information and identifying exceptions or trends.  Experience producing HR reports, management information, data extracts or dashboards.  Experience supporting process mapping, process documentation, SOP development or employee/manager guidance.  Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn technical or policy information into clear, practical content.  Excellent attention to detail, sound judgement and a strong commitment to confidential handling of employee information.  A collaborative style and confidence working with a broad range of stakeholders, including HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, senior leaders and external suppliers. 

Desirable

 Oracle HCM experience across Core HR, Benefits, Absence, Journeys, Helpdesk, reporting, security or workflow.  Experience supporting system configuration, release management, user acceptance testing or regression testing.  Knowledge of HR and payroll interfaces, data reconciliation and system controls.  Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, Jira or case-management technology.  Knowledge of GDPR, HR data governance, data quality controls and audit requirements.  Experience supporting a multi-entity, multi-country or matrix organisation.  Experience designing onboarding journeys, benefits communications or employee-facing HR content.

We make some of the UK’s best-known personal care brands in Leeds. Our Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) team keeps our people safe, protects our environment and keeps our site compliant. As our site becomes more data-led, we need sharper, faster ways to turn SHE information into clear insight and action. We’re looking for someone who loves data, problem-solving and making work simpler – and wants to use those skills for something that genuinely matters. You’ll build dashboards, automations and reports that help our leaders see where the real risks are, so we can spend less time chasing information and more time acting on the insights that make our operations safer for people and the environment.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for safety, health and environmental performance Automate the reporting that’s currently manual - using Power Automate, Power Apps, Forms and AI tools such as Copilot Own the quality of our SHE data: collect it, check it, and make sure what we report is right, first time Spot trends and outliers, explain what they mean, and help us decide where to focus next to improve SHE performance Work with operations, engineering, finance and our global SHE teams to turn the data into action 

All About You

What we’re looking for

Strong digital, analytical and data communication skills (or the appetite and evidence that you can get there fast) Confidence working with imperfect data - cleaning, modelling and making it trustworthy Curiosity about how a factory works and a genuine interest in health, safety and sustainability A degree, apprenticeship or demonstrable self-taught capability in data, analytics or a related field

A SHE qualification – we’ll teach you the safety and environment side Manufacturing experience – we’ll show you the factory floor

What We Offer

Not only do we offer a competitive salary and pension scheme, we also offer an annual bonus, subsidised gym membership, a discounted staff shop and shares. You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with our renowned and exciting brands in a flexible and hybrid working environment.

Whilst the role is advertised on a full-time basis, we would be happy to discuss possible flexible working options and what this may look like for you. We are a key advocate of wellbeing and offer a variety of support for our people including hubs, programmes and development opportunities. We strive to achieve a family-friendly and inclusive workplace and to, above all, create possibilities for all.

Diversity at Unilever is about inclusion, embracing differences, creating possibilities and growing together for better business performance. We embrace diversity in our workforce. Recruitment Fraud

Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. In the most sophisticated cases, they will set up fake websites, which have a similar address to companies like Unilever. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs.  These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate.

How is Unilever tackling this?

Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down.

What can I do?

If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat.

Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

rows.title: Analyst, Risk Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Sony Corporation of America, located in New York, NY, is the U.S. headquarters of Sony Group Corporation, based in Tokyo, Japan. Sony's principal U.S. businesses include Sony Electronics Inc., Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC, Sony Music Entertainment, Sony Music Publishing and Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc. With some 900 million Sony devices in hands and homes worldwide today, a vast array of Sony movies, television shows and music, and the PlayStation Network, Sony creates and delivers more entertainment experiences to more people than anyone else on earth. To learn more: www.sony.com/en.

Sony is seeking a Senior Analyst, Risk Analytics to join Sony’s Corporate Information Security Division in London, UK. In this role, you’ll partner across the global information security, IT, and business landscape to design, implement, and evolve a data-driven Global Information Security Risk Analytics platform. Reporting to the Director of Risk Analytics, you will help transform diverse and complex datasets into objective, actionable insights that support senior leadership decision-making and monitor the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Sony assets. You’ll work closely with technical and non-technical teams to understand operational challenges, uncover meaningful data patterns, build analytical and engineering solutions, and translate results into intuitive, compelling stories. This is a hands-on role that blends data engineering, data analysis, and stakeholder engagement to mature Sony’s enterprise-wide security risk intelligence capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Build, refine, and maintain ETL pipelines that integrate data from multiple sources while ensuring quality, consistency, and trustworthiness.Develop tools, scripts, and automation to streamline data processing, risk measurement, and platform operations.Develop and maintain analytics, metrics, and dashboards that measure information security performance, risk exposure, remediation progress, and control effectiveness.Analyze large volumes of security, IT, and business data to identify trends, anomalies, and emerging risks.Translate analytical findings into clear, compelling material for executives and operational stakeholders.Contribute to the design and evaluation of metrics, models, and dashboards used to monitor information security performanceCollaborate with cross‑functional teams to understand requirements, frame analytical problems, and deliver actionable insights.Provide excellent stakeholder support, including communication, requirements definition, and delivery of reports and dashboards that meet evolving needs.Document solutions, workflows, and procedures to help ensure consistency, accuracy, and knowledge sharing.


Required Qualifications And Experience

Advanced understanding of statistics, data analysis, and data visualization.Working knowledge of common information security and IT concepts, such as vulnerability management, patching, endpoint security, cloud security, identity and access management, asset inventory, logging/monitoring, or risk management.Ability to analyze large and complex security, IT, and business datasets to identify trends, anomalies, data quality issues, and emerging risks.Experience with data modeling (star/snowflake schema, dimensional modeling).Proficiency with relational database (SQL) and programming/scripting (Python or R).Typically 2 years of relevant experience in information security, IT, data analysis, statistics, or related field. Strong problem‑solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.Interest in both deep technical data exploration and high‑quality stakeholder engagement.Ability to translate business questions into analytical approaches and present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Understanding of data quality frameworks (validation, profiling, anomaly detection). 


Preferred Qualifications And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Analysis, or a mathematics/information security field.Hands-on experience with cybersecurity or IT data sources, such as vulnerability scanners, endpoint detection tools, CMDBs, cloud platforms, identity systems, SIEM/logging platforms, or ticketing systems.Experience with version control tools (e.g., Git/GitHub/Gitlab) o Hands-on experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Domo).


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation.

Disability Accommodation for Applicants to Sony Corporation of America

Sony Corporation of America provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in job application procedures. For reasonable accommodation requests, please contact us by email at careers@sonyusa.com or by mail to: Sony Corporation of America, People Experience Department, 25 Madison Avenue, New York, NY 10010. Please indicate the position you are applying for.

rows.title: Burberry Client Experience & Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
INTRODUCTION

At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. This is the core belief that has guided Burberry since it was founded in 1856 and is central to how we operate as a company today.

We aim to provide an environment for creative minds from different backgrounds to thrive, bringing a wide range of skills and experiences to everything we do. As a purposeful, values-driven brand, we are committed to being a force for good in the world as well, creating the next generation of sustainable luxury for customers, driving industry change and championing our communities.

Job Purpose

The Client Experience & Insights Analyst plays a key role in understanding customer sentiment and identifying opportunities to enhance the end-to-end customer experience. Working closely with Customer Service, Global Client, CRM, Digital, IT and other business functions, the role is responsible for transforming customer feedback, operational and commercial data into actionable insights that drive customer satisfaction, loyalty and business performance.

The role is responsible for Customer Experience reporting, Voice of Customer (VoC) programmes and quality monitoring, while supporting customer experience systems, data integrations and transformation initiatives.

This role is based in our London office and requires a minimum of four days per week onsite.

Responsibilities

Customer Experience Insights & Reporting

Own and develop Customer Experience reporting, including NPS, CSAT and Voice of Customer (VoC), providing visibility of customer sentiment, performance and key trends across customer touchpoints.Analyse customer feedback, operational and commercial data to identify trends, root causes and opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, the customer journey and business performance.Own and lead the internal quality monitoring programme across global regions, partnering closely with regional teams to analyse customer insights, identify coaching opportunities and drive continuous improvement in alignment with the established quality framework.Develop and maintain executive dashboards, reports and presentations, translating complex data into clear insights, recommendations and strategic narratives for senior stakeholders.Support the development and enhancement of Tableau dashboards and reporting solutions, leveraging data from multiple business systems and data platforms (e.g. SAP HANA, Databricks) to deliver actionable insights and support customer-centric and commercially driven decision-making.Drive continuous improvement in customer experience measurement, data quality, reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities.

Stakeholder Management & Business Partnership

Partner with Customer Service, Retail, Global Client, CRM, Marketing, Ecommerce, Digital, IT and Technology teams to support strategic initiatives, continuous improvement and customer-centric decision-making.Build strong cross-functional relationships and act as a trusted advisor on customer experience performance and Voice of Customer insights.

Customer Experience Systems & Data

Support the development, integration and optimisation of customer experience systems, platforms and data sources in partnership with IT, Digital, CRM and Customer Service teams.Act as the Voice of Customer subject matter expert for system implementations, integrations, migrations and transformation initiatives, ensuring customer feedback and experience measures are embedded within new solutions.Support the governance and integration of customer experience data across CRM, messaging, contact centre and feedback platforms to enable consistent reporting and actionable insights.Identify opportunities to enhance customer experience measurement, reporting automation and data integration through a strong understanding of customer service technologies and data architecture.

PERSONAL PROFILE

Experience within Customer Experience (CX), NPS, CSAT, Voice of Customer (VoC), customer insight reporting and customer satisfaction programmes.Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, root causes and opportunities, and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to analyse data, create impactful visualisations and deliver executive-level presentations.Experience using customer feedback platforms such as Qualtrics, Medallia or similar Voice of Customer tools.Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using analytics platforms, including Tableau, and translating business requirements into meaningful insights.Strong interest in customer experience technology, data architecture and systems integration, with experience supporting implementation, migration or transformation projects.Experience with Salesforce and customer service technologies is advantageous.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and build effective relationships across global cross-functional teams.Proactive, highly organised and adaptable, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Experience within luxury retail, retail, ecommerce or customer service environments, with an understanding of luxury customer expectations and service excellence preferred.

Burberry is an Equal Opportunities Employer and as such, treats all applications equally and recruits purely on the basis of skills and experience.

rows.title: Claims Analytics Analyst - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract
rows.descriptionText:
Role: Claims Analytics Analyst

Location: London

Position: Full time, 12 month fixed-term contract

The Claims Analytics Analyst is responsible for helping Claims provide a robust, reliable and governed 'one version of the truth' across claims data. You will make that data readily accessible through self-service tools and regular reporting, helping the business extract valuable insights, make better decisions and embed best practice in claims analytics.

You will deliver accurate and insightful reporting that helps Claims Managers understand performance, oversee their portfolios and achieve consistently strong outcomes for our clients and the business, in line with MS Amlin's values.

Working with the Chief Claims Officer, the Head of Claims Optimisation and the Claims Leadership Team, you will help deliver the Claims management information strategy and wider modernisation objectives. You will use the latest tools and techniques to maximise the value of our claims data and support a suite of accessible, self-service dashboards and reports.

The role sits within Claims Optimisation and provides an important link between Claims colleagues, specialist data teams and our strategic delivery partners.

About The Job

While there is rarely a typical day, here's a snapshot of some of the key parts of the job:

Act as a focal point for the Claims team and wider business stakeholders, ensuring that known and ad hoc claims data requirements are delivered in a robust, standardised and timely format.Act as the Claims focal point for company-wide data and analytics projects and initiatives, representing Claims on appropriate steering groups and forums, ensuring that Claims requirements are understood and delivered.Act as the data governance representative and data steward for ClaimsProduce claims report templates and commissioned ad hoc analysis and reports in a timely way. These currently include Claim Portfolio Reports, the Claim Deep Dive Report, the Open Large Loss Report, CAT and other regulatory reports, and the Large Movement Report.Work with the Chief Claims Officer, the Head of Claims Optimisation and others where delegated to create and implement the strategic deliverables for Claims management information.Collaborate with colleagues across Claims, our strategic partner and other functions to deliver management information and data requests, prioritising work so that Claims Analytics resources are used effectively.Oversee and manage large-loss reporting tools, including the Open Large Loss Report, CAT Report and Claims Watchlist, and provide the resulting analysis and insights.Support the Claims Analytics Manager in assessing the Claims department's management information and analytics training needs, working with the Claims Business Manager through the Claims Professional of the Future initiative to make relevant training and resources available.Identify ways to continuously improve and future-proof claims datasets, reporting tools and outputs so they remain fit for purpose and extract as much value as possible from our data.Support the Claims Manager with the ongoing oversight and performance of claims data and analytical services provided by Genpact.Deliver appropriate self-service reporting, data and analytics tools, and help the department use them effectively.Participate proactively in claims initiatives as required.Support delivery of the Claims management information strategy by applying a strong technical understanding of Claims and management information and analytics tools to provide robust, accessible data as 'one version of the truth'.Provide a London-hours point of contact for claims data questions and time-sensitive reporting or dashboard issues, working directly with business users when an immediate response is needed.Create and improve Power BI dashboards and views, as well as helping colleagues use them with confidence.Investigate discrepancies in London market claims data, market messages and downstream systems, working with the relevant teams to understand and resolve the issue.

In addition to your key responsibilities, you will be expected to:

Be data-oriented and analytically minded, using data to generate useful insights.Communicate clearly and effectively, influencing decisions, collaborating, negotiating confidently and listening actively, both face-to-face and through virtual media.Build trust and manage strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.Break down complex problems and identify trends, patterns and interdependencies.Exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions, including under time pressure.Bring a high-performance mindset, with the self-motivation, energy and determination to deliver outcomes in a fast-paced environment of business transformation.Demonstrate a growth mindset, seeking continuous improvement for yourself, the team and the claims service, and remaining flexible as client and business needs evolve.

What You'll Need

Experience:

Proven experience in management information data analysis and relevant management information systems.Strong working knowledge of data and analytics tools and systems, including Microsoft Office, Excel and ECF, together with hands-on Power BI experience creating dashboards and views.Knowledge of claims operations, technical claims lifecycles and reserving practices is desirable.Experience of Lloyd's or London market claims data, including an understanding of market messaging and downstream systems such as Subscribe.A CII or similar professional qualification is desirable.Willingness to travel when required.Experience of Lloyd's or London market claims data, including an understanding of market messaging and downstream systems such as Subscribe.

We are stronger together because of our common interests and rich differences. You may be the strength we didn't know we needed. Believe in yourself, and click apply today!

What Can You Expect From Us?

As well as a competitive base salary and performance-related discretionary bonus, here is a link to our employee benefits - Benefits of working at MS Amlin | MS Amlin

Hybrid Working

At MS Amlin we operate a hybrid working model to empower our people with flexibility to blend where they work. We value collaboration and believe that we work better together, and our teams typically spend 3 days a week in the office.

About MS Amlin

MS Amlin is a leading (re)insurer and part of the global MS&AD Group, with operations across Lloyd's of London, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. With over 120 years of experience, we support businesses facing complex and demanding risks, providing continuity in an uncertain world. Our expertise covers Property, Casualty, Marine, Crisis Management, Natural Resources and Reinsurance, backed by strong underwriting capabilities and deep sector knowledge. At the core of our claims service is TRUST: Transparency, Responsiveness, Understanding, Solution-driven thinking and Technical expertise. This defines how we manage claims and build lasting relationships.

We will build a workplace where all talent is welcomed, and everyone has the opportunity to influence how the business works. We have dedicated employee resource groups that support our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion goals.

rows.title: Audience Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Salary: Up to £41,440 per annum based on skills and experienceFull time; 40 hours per weekPermanent positionBased in: Covent Garden, London.

The Royal Ballet and Opera, situated in our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.

The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.

We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To Demonstrate

Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skillsStrong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detailThe ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefsStrong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter expertsClear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.

An Understanding Of The Below Will Be Beneficial And Highly Regarded So Please Do Reflect These In Your Application If You Have

Experience with ticketing or CRM dataExperience working across multiple data setsExperience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environmentExperience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

rows.title: Data Analyst - 8 Month FTC
rows.descriptionText:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Data is a key asset to Allica and is deeply embedded in all our teams and products. With data, we assist and work with Finance, Operations, Credit Risk, Product and management.

We are looking for ambitious and curious people who can help us understand our data better, contribute to facilitating the discussions between engineering and the data stakeholders and have an impact on the business by telling stories around the insights they generate.

You will be an integral part of the newly formed business intelligence team, building and developing the analytics and insights capabilities of the Bank.

Role Description

Data is a key asset to Allica and is deeply embedded in all our teams and products. With data, we assist and work with Finance, Operations, Credit Risk, Product and management.

We are looking for ambitious and curious people who can help us understand our data better, contribute to facilitating the discussions between engineering and the data stakeholders and have an impact on the business by telling stories around the insights they generate.

You will be an integral part of the newly formed business intelligence team, building and developing the analytics and insights capabilities of the Bank.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

rows.title: Consultant, Business Intelligence
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

FTI Consulting is seeking a highly motivated, Consultant to join its Business Intelligence team in London. The Business Intelligence team conducts corporate investigations, uncovers actionable business intelligence, supports clients in commercial disputes, and provides clear analysis to help decision-makers address and mitigate risk, protect assets and maximise opportunities in a variety of jurisdictions worldwide. Its expertise lies in investigative due diligence, asset tracing, fraud and anti-corruption investigations, litigation support, whistle-blower allegations, third-party integrity screening, political risk assessments and other bespoke engagements.

What You’ll Do 

The Consultant will conduct research on a range of complex and multi-jurisdictional projects, including investigative due diligence, asset traces, fraud investigations and political risk assessments. Consultants are expected to conduct independent, first-class research and analysis, drawing upon the range of search engines and databases generally available, and those available to the company. They will be required to demonstrate flexibility, critical thinking and the ability to identify relevant lines of inquiry.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Preparation of client deliverables via oversight of the desktop research;Contribute to briefings for external resources, such as sub contractors;Maintenance of case deadlines, and verbal and/or written updates to the Client, to ensure the timely reporting of client deliverables;Involvement in overall case project management and administration;Support research and drafting of project proposals and broader business development initiatives;Contribute to identifying and developing resources useful for investigative research; and,Consult with and take direction from case managers and clients on project status, timing, and deliverables.

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need To Succeed

The successful candidate will be an analytically minded researcher with excellent writing skills and a strong work ethic. They must have experience working in a commercial environment. They will be a self-starter who takes initiative in their approach to work and a team player who is able to easily engage with management, other consultants, and clients. A skilled communicator, they will be able to convey complex ideas clearly and nimbly articulate their findings to internal and external audiences. They must exhibit an inquisitive mindset and the ability to think laterally about complex problems. This role is well-suited for a young professional who is enthusiastic about the sector and is eager to hone their research skills and grow their project management skills with the view to establish their career in the business intelligence industry.

As a Consultant in the Business Intelligence team, you will have the opportunity to work on cross-segment projects with other teams within Forensic and Litigation Consulting, such as Forensic Accounting Advisory Services, Financial Services, and Data and Analytics, as well as other practices within FTI Consulting, such as Strategic Communications, Economic and Financial Consulting, and Technology.

Basic Qualifications

Consultants should have at least one year of experience of conducting business intelligence and investigations.Demonstrated track record as an analyst on a range of projects, including pre-transactional due diligence, asset traces and fraud investigationsKnowledge of relevant research tools and databasesProven commercial writing style and analytical skillsExcellent written and oral English-language communication skills and knowledge of additional foreign languagesAbility to reliably meet deadlines and manage time sensitive matters.A sound understanding of legal, financial, AML, KYC and anti-bribery principles, as well as an interest in international affairs

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Italian, Polish, Russian, Swedish, Turkish or Arabic would be an advantageExperience living or working abroad is desirableExperience of using i2 mapping software is desirable 

FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

rows.title: AI Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At Bionic, we're on a mission to make it radically easier to run a small business. As the UK's leading business comparison and switching service, we help thousands of small and medium-sized businesses save time and money on essentials like energy, broadband, insurance, and finance. We combine smart technology with real human support to match our customers with the best deals - quickly and effortlessly. With trusted partnerships including Compare the Market, USwitch for Business, MoneySuperMarket and Confused.com, we're committed to help SMEs get the best deals for their business essentials every time. The role 
We're looking for detail-oriented and analytical AI Operations Analysts to play a critical role in supporting the governance and quality assurance of AI-driven processes across Bionic. As part of our Business Excellence function, you'll sit at the intersection of Operations, Compliance and AI Innovation. You'll be responsible for reviewing AI-generated outcomes, validating results against available evidence and ensuring decisions are applied fairly, consistently and accurately before they are used in downstream sales and operational processes. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with AI technologies while helping shape how AI is used responsibly in a fast-growing business. If you're naturally curious, highly organised and enjoy solving problems through evidence-based decision making, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities 
AI Validation & Quality Assurance Validate AI-generated outcomes across Energy and Insurance before they are used in business processes. Review call recordings, transcripts and AI rationale to determine whether outcomes are accurate and appropriately applied. Identify true fails, false fails, accepted exceptions and potential technical issues. Ensure validation activities are completed accurately and consistently against agreed criteria. Analysis & Reporting Update system records and validation fields to ensure reporting remains accurate and reliable. Support monthly reporting cycles through completion of validation reviews and challenge processes. Conduct periodic sampling activities to identify potential false-pass trends and support ongoing assurance. Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for validation decisions and escalations. Continuous Improvement Track recurring validation themes, process gaps and AI tool limitations. Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and reporting accuracy. Escalate technical issues and recurring system challenges to relevant stakeholders. Contribute insights that support the ongoing evolution of AI-supported workflows and governance. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with Business Excellence, AI Innovation, Sales Leadership and Legal & Compliance teams. Support the fair, transparent and evidence-led use of AI outputs across the organisation. Build strong working relationships across technical and operational teams to drive positive outcomes. 
About you 
We're looking for people who combine strong analytical thinking with exceptional attention to detail. You'll be comfortable working with data, applying defined criteria consistently and making objective decisions based on evidence. You'll likely have: Excellent attention to detail and a highly accurate approach to work. Strong judgement and the ability to make fair, evidence-based decisions. The ability to identify patterns, trends, process issues and root causes. Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly document decisions. Confidence in escalating complex, unclear or high-risk issues when required. Experience working with multiple stakeholders across operational, compliance or technical teams. The ability to manage competing priorities while meeting important deadlines. A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive information. rows.title: Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.



Job Description

Working within the Rights & Revenue Protection (RRP) team, the Intelligence Analyst will support investigations relating to the protection of Sportradar's intellectual property and revenue recovery activities across Europe and North America. 

The role focuses on identifying and assessing threats to Sportradar's content, data and commercial interests, including unauthorised data usage, piracy and intellectual property infringement. Using a range of open-source, cyber and commercial data sources, the analyst will deliver intelligence that supports enforcement activity, commercial outcomes and strategic decision-making. 

The position requires a motivated intelligence professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and supports stakeholders across the wider Sportradar Group.

THE CHALLENGE 

Conduct intelligence investigations using an all-source approach across rights protection, enforcement and revenue recovery matters. Collect, analyse and evaluate intelligence from open-source, cyber and commercial sources. Conduct OSINT and CYBINT/DNINT investigations to produce actionable intelligence and recommendations. Identify and investigate unauthorised use of Sportradar data, content and intellectual property. Develop and maintain intelligence holdings relating to organisations, individuals and platforms operating across Europe and North America. Monitor emerging risks and trends relevant to intellectual property protection, piracy, sports betting and revenue recovery. Produce intelligence reports, analytical assessments and stakeholder briefings. Support enforcement and commercial recovery initiatives through intelligence development and research. Work closely across multiple Sportradar functions and departments to protect and enhance Sportradar business operations, including internal and external training and education on sports integrity. ABOUT YOU

2+ years' experience in intelligence, investigations, law enforcement, journalism, cyber security, financial crime, fraud, due diligence or a related analytical field. Experience conducting analytical investigations and producing intelligence-led outputs. Demonstrable expertise in OSINT, HUMINT, CYBINT/DNINT or comparable intelligence methodologies. Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to collect, evaluate and interpret information from multiple sources and produce actionable intelligence. Knowledge of online ecosystems, digital platforms and investigative research techniques. Awareness of data protection legislation and associated implications. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professionalism.Ability to manage changing priorities and work effectively under pressure and to tight deadlines.Fluency in English essential, professional working proficiency in French or another living language strongly preferred. Advantageous 

Experience using intelligence analysis tools such as i2 Analyst's Notebook, Maltego or similar. Knowledge of the international sports betting, gaming, media or anti-piracy landscapes. Professional networks or regional knowledge across Europe and/or North America. Experience conducting investigations relating to intellectual property infringement, brand protection, digital piracy or revenue recovery. Understanding of corporate structures, beneficial ownership research and due diligence methodologies. Experience working with commercial intelligence databases and specialist investigative tools. Relevant intelligence, investigation or analytical certifications. OUR OFFER:

A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours.While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together.

OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 

Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Hiring Team Interview: Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Assessment: Investigative task to showcase your technical skills. Final Steps: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! 

Additional Information

At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex/sensitive information.Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. rows.title: Quantitative Risk Analyst (Analytics)
rows.descriptionText:
Hybrid working pattern (3/2)
An opportunity has arisen for a Risk Analyst to join a leading global energy trading organisation based in London.
This role since within the analytics team which constantly strives to improve risk procedures through automation, therefore a significant aspect of the role would be to contribute to the development of software to streamline daily processes and assist front office with system trading, using a variety of techniques including machine learning and artificial intelligence.
Alongside the automation elements, you will also be responsible for the daily analysis of the trading activities (PnL and position reporting) of the gas desk, as well as providing ad hoc support to other desks as required, notably Crude Oil Derivatives, LNG, and Power & Emissions. 
Main Responsibilities:
Preparing and reviewing daily P&L and risk reports, monitoring limits, and proactively resolving any issues in coordination with the relevant teams. Support front office in obtaining approval for new and non-standard products. Assisting in identifying significant risks within the business and ensuring they are transparent to senior management. Provide information and commentary for the bi-weekly Risk Committee meetings. Review and approve any relevant changes to the main ETRM system (Endur). Guarantee compliance for trading procedures with relevant controls and support when necessary internal and external audit requests. Participate in the enhancement of reporting and the development of reporting systems. 
Skills and Experience Required:
University degree in a numerate discipline (e.g. economics, mathematics, pure science, finance, engineering or similar). c.2 years’ experience in a similar Analyst / Risk role within commodity trading companies, ideally with a focus on gas & power. Strong knowledge of risk metrics such as VaR, stress-testing, scenario analysis. Good knowledge of derivatives and options. Strong knowledge of MS Office suite including Excel and VBA. SQL and Python would be a strong advantage. Knowledge of the Endur ETRM system would be an advantage. Strong organization skills with good attention to detail and the ability to work to tight deadlines. Strong communication skills, able to communicate concisely with senior management in the market risk function and with all stakeholders. Fluent level of English.

rows.title: Trading Data & AI Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Why work for us?

A career at Janus Henderson is more than a job, it’s about investing in a brighter future together.

Our Mission at Janus Henderson is to help clients define and achieve superior financial outcomes through differentiated insights, disciplined investments, and world-class service. We will do this by protecting and growing our core business, amplifying our strengths and diversifying where we have the right.

Our Values are key to driving our success, and are at the heart of everything we do:

Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!

Your opportunity

We are looking for someone who is already deep into AI, not just familiar with it, to join our EMEA Equity Trading team. You will analyse trading data, automate desk outputs and build tools that seek to improve our processes. This is a technical role, not a trading role: you will learn the domain from one of the most experienced equity trading teams in the industry, but you need to arrive with genuine AI and data capability from day one.

If you are the kind of person who builds things before being asked, picks up new tools fast and is not satisfied with how things were done yesterday, this is worth reading on.

You Will

 Own the AI and automation agenda for the team. You will have the freedom to identify where AI tooling can replace manual processes, design the solution and build it. This is not a role where you execute someone else's backlog; you are expected to bring ideas, test them quickly and ship what works.  Work directly with Traders and Portfolio Managers to understand how they consume data, where their pain points are and what would change their workflow. The tools you build will be used by the most senior investment professionals in the firm, so everything you deliver needs to be clear, well designed and grounded in how the desk actually operates.  Analyse trading datasets using Python and AI tooling to surface trends, inefficiencies and opportunities. You will encounter execution analytics, Transaction Cost Analysis, Algo Wheel configuration, market microstructure and European regulatory requirements. You do not need to arrive as an expert in all of these, but you need to be comfortable working with complex, domain-specific data and learning fast.  Modernise the desk's day-to-day outputs from a consumable content standpoint so they are automated, visually sharp and worthy of readership.  Help the wider team build confidence with AI tooling. Run demos, share practical examples, explain what works and why. The goal is not just for you to stay current with new tools and techniques, but to bring the rest of the desk along so the whole team's capability rises, as well as your own.  Contribute to the firm's wider community of AI practitioners, sharing what works on the desk, learning from other teams & experts and evolving best practice for AI adoption across the organisation. 

What to expect when you join our firm

 Hybrid working and reasonable accommodations  Generous Holiday policies  Excellent Health and Wellbeing benefits including corporate membership to ClassPass  Paid volunteer time to step away from your desk and into the community  Support to grow through professional development courses, tuition/qualification reimbursement and more  Maternal/paternal leave benefits and family services  Complimentary subscription to Headspace – the mindfulness app  All employee events including networking opportunities and social activities  Lunch allowance for use within our subsidized onsite canteen 

Must have skills

 A degree in a technical or quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience. No specific degree subject is required; capability and aptitude matter more than the title on the certificate.  Python and AI-assisted development. You will write code with AI, not without it. Comfortable working alongside agents and AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or similar) to build, debug and iterate. Enough engineering judgement to ensure what you produce is safe, reliable and fit for production use on the desk and in an enterprise environment.  AI proficiency. Prompt engineering, LLM-assisted analysis, agentic workflows, tool orchestration. You should be the person your peers come to when they want to know what is possible.  Numerically sharp. Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and spotting when outputs do not make sense. This role sits on a trading desk, therefore absent of coding you will need good communication skills and fluent with numbers.  Delivery mindset. Builds things that work and last, whether handed to a technology team to productionise or owned and maintained on the desk.  Stakeholder communication. Can explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences.  2-3+ years in a technical, data or analytics environment. Financial services exposure is a plus, not a prerequisite. 

Nice to have skills

 Demonstrated personal interest in AI beyond the workplace. Candidates who actively explore AI in their own time, whether through side projects, experimentation with new models, or automating real-world problems outside of work, tend to bring a level of curiosity and initiative that is difficult to teach. This will be explored during the interview process.  Financial knowledge. Exposure to equity markets, trading, execution analytics, algorithmic trading or market microstructure. Interest in developing this knowledge (e.g. CFA study) is also valued.  SQL and data platforms. Comfortable querying structured data, ideally with experience in Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses.  Data visualisation and design. Experience with dashboarding or visualisation tools (e.g. Streamlit, Power BI or similar). An eye for how information is presented to a senior audience.  Platform-level automation. Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g. n8n, Copilot Studio), MCP, LLM observability tools (e.g. Langfuse), or managed model APIs (Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Anthropic).  Modern development practices. Familiarity with any of: Docker, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Git.  Agent orchestration frameworks. Experience with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or similar is a plus. The team is moving towards more sophisticated agentic workflows. 

Supervisory responsibilities

 No 

Potential for growth

 Mentoring  Leadership development programs  Regular training  Career development services  Continuing education courses 

You will be expected to understand the regulatory obligations of the firm, and abide by the regulated entity requirements and JHI policies applicable for your role.

rows.title: Associate Analyst – Nectar360 Supplier Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
At Sainsbury’s, data sits at the heart of how we operate, innovate and serve our customers. Our Data & Analytics team is building a technically advanced, commercially focused and impactful capability, powering our Next Level Strategy and helping to create a Sainsbury’s powered by industry leading AI algorithms. We use data, technology and advanced analytics to drive better decisions across the business, from forecasting and optimisation to experimentation, personalisation and machine learning. With one of the richest retail datasets I n the UK and a portfolio spanning Sainsbury’s, Argos, Habitat and Nectar, the opportunity to innovate is huge. Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges at scale, create measurable impact and grow quickly alongside brilliant colleagues. People who thrive with us combine business understanding, technical expertise and curiosity, with a natural instinct for problem-solving. Join us and help shape the future of retail through data and AI.

Based in the Sainsbury’s Office in London, we’re recruiting an ambitious Associate Analyst to work alongside stakeholders in Nectar360 & Sainsbury’s to drive our media and consultancy proposition to FMCG and GM clients. Nectar360 is the company behind Nectar, the UK’s largest loyalty programme, with over 27m members across the country.

Do you take satisfaction in seeing your recommendations implemented in the ‘real world’? Are you analytically creative and motivated by new challenges? Do you have a passion for working with data to drive insight and improve customer understanding?

When you join us you will be providing world-class customer insights for our clients. Utilising the Nectar data to understand how we can personalise the customer experience and drive business impact, this role is a fantastic opportunity to apply and develop your analytical capabilities.

The role is based in our London office on average 1 day a week, with home working expected the remainder of the time. Occasional travel to our FMCG clients is required.

What will you be doing? 

You'll analyse Nectar, Sainsbury's and supplier data to maximise understanding of customer behaviour and provide impactful insights and recommendations. You'll take responsibility for delivering end-to-end analytical projects, using SQL to interrogate large datasets and combining multiple sources including Sainsbury's transactional data, ranging data and customer profiling information. You'll build your analytical and technical expertise as you deliver projects across a wide variety of topics, such as customer journeys, segmentation, ranging, promotions and campaign effectiveness. You'll be expected to work confidently with large datasets, developing efficient and accurate SQL solutions to answer complex business questions. You’ll take a proactive role in delivering increasing revenue for Nectar360, such as experimenting with new methods and data to enhance analytics, and improving our analytics efficiencies. You should be able to look beyond the data to find relevant and actionable insights that are useful and interesting to stakeholders. You’ll be responsible for making your insight actionable; explaining complex analytics to non-technical audiences and making clear recommendations on how stakeholders should be using the insight you’re providing. You’ll be expected to confidently & independently create well formatted PowerPoint documents and Tableau dashboards that explain the analysis that you have generated, presenting findings to internal & external stakeholders in an engaging and enthusiastic manner. 

Essential Criteria

An innovative mind and a passion for solving problems. Technical confidence and statistical understanding to manipulate and interpret datasets using Excel and SQL, R or Python. Experience of BI tools (e.g. Tableau or Business Objects) and AWS/Snowflake would be advantageous. Excellent communication skills and experience in collaborating with peers or colleagues. 

This role will suit you if:

You’re looking to grow your career in a fast paced, commercial environment. You’re looking to work autonomously in a client-facing environment. You’ll take accountability for your analytical projects and build strong collaborative partnerships with both Sainsbury’s suppliers and internal teams. You thrive on excellence all the way. You will need to deliver high-quality insight with attention to detail. You’re looking for variety and new challenges. We work with a wide range of contacts across Nectar360 and Sainsbury’s, providing analytical advice to multiple business units. No two questions are the same, so you’ll need to be analytically creative whilst thinking on your feet to understand the real question we need to answer and implementing the best analytical techniques to do so. 

What we offer 

Colleague discount across the multi-brands – Sainsbury’s, Argos and Habitat Holiday allowance Bonus scheme Pension plan Special offers on gym memberships, restaurants, holidays, retail vouchers and more 

You’ll also benefit from being part of the wider Data & Analytics community at Sainsbury’s. We have Big Data with a great culture and huge learning and development opportunities.

Flexible working and job share conversations are encouraged. We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer that champions a diverse and inclusive culture. If you’re reading this, even if you’re not 100% sure you’re there with your experience, we’d still love to hear from you. 

#DataAndAnalytics

#Analytics

We are committed to being a truly inclusive retailer, so youll be welcomed whoever you are and wherever you work. Around here, theres always the chance to try something new - whether thats as part of an evolving team or somewhere else across the business - and we take development seriously and promise to support you. We also recognise and celebrate colleagues when they go the extra mile and, where possible, offer flexible working. When you join our team, well also offer you an amazing range of benefits. Here are some of them: Starting off with colleague discount, you'll be able to get 10% off at Sainsbury's, Argos, TU and Habitat after 4 weeks. This increases to 15% off at Sainsburys every Friday and Saturday and 15% off at Argos every pay day. We've also got you covered for your future with our pensions scheme and life cover. You'll also be able to share in our success as you may be eligible for a performance-related target bonus of up to 5% of salary (which may vary for Nectar360), depending on how we perform. Your wellbeing is important to us too. You'll receive an annual holiday allowance and you can buy additional holiday. We also offer other benefits that will help your money go further such as season ticket loans, cycle to work scheme, health cash plans, pay advance (where you can access some of your pay before pay day) as well access to a great range of discounts from hundreds of other retailers. And if you ever need it there is also an employee assistance programme. Moments that matter are as important to us as they are to you which is why we give up to 26 weeks pay for maternity or adoption leave and up to 4 weeks pay for paternity leave. Please see www.sainsburys.jobs for a range of our benefits (note, length of service and eligibility criteria may apply). Please note, due to the volume of applications we receive, our roles may close early.

rows.title: Bordereaux Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Tokio Marine Kiln (TMK) is recruiting for a permanent Bordereaux Analyst to join our Data Management team in London. Reporting to the Bordereaux Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the management of binder data, ensuring the business has accurate and timely information to facilitate reporting, analysis and operational decision-making. You will work closely with Underwriters, Claims teams, Coverholders and Brokers to maintain data quality, process bordereaux and support the effective administration of delegated authority business.

Key responsibilities include:

 Accurately processing risk, premium and claims bordereaux data into TMK's systems in a timely manner. Submitting bordereaux to the Bordereaux Management System for data processing and validation. Creating and maintaining risk and premium mapping templates for new and existing binders. Conducting validation checks on binder data and resolving data quality issues, escalating where appropriate. Working with Brokers, Coverholders, Underwriters and Claims colleagues to improve bordereaux data quality and completeness. Supporting the administration of claims bordereaux, including monitoring submissions and liaising with Claims teams regarding outstanding information. Performing quality control reviews of mapping templates produced by outsourced service providers. Assisting with the management of team inboxes and responding to data-related queries. Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, streamline processes and enhance data management practices. Supporting ad hoc projects and tasks across the Data Management function as required.  Experience mapping and processing risk and premium bordereaux within a bordereaux management system. Knowledge of risk, premium and claims bordereaux, including Lloyd's V5.2 standards. A sound understanding of delegated authority business and the London Insurance Market. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify and resolve data quality issues. Good communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with a range of stakeholders. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate and timely outputs. Experience working within the London Insurance Market would be advantageous. Knowledge of Delegated Data Manager (DDM/Tide) and Tokio Marine systems would be beneficial. Experience working with outsourced service providers would be advantageous.

Why apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative and highly regarded Data Management team at TMK. The role offers the chance to contribute to process improvement initiatives, build strong market relationships and play an important part in delivering accurate, high-quality data that supports business performance and decision-making across TMK.

The successful candidate will be welcomed into the TMK family to help us further our purpose of enabling our clients to fulfil their ambitions whilst benefiting society and our people.
