If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge and connections to shape your career.

Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. To put it simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next.

Our graduates are a vital part of our success and we welcome applications from people from all walks of life. Whoever you are and wherever you want to join us, if you’re curious, creative and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

Why the Quantitative Analytics Associate Graduate Programme?

Our industry-leading group provides model development, analytics and valuable quantitative advice to businesses across the bank.

Applying to our programme means the opportunity to join one of our specialist teams, including:

Markets Quants

Consisting of specialised modellers and developers, the team directly supports the Capital Markets division of the bank. Team members are responsible for researching, innovating, developing, testing, implementing and supporting all quantitative models used for front-office pricing, valuation adjustments, along with market and counter-party credit risk management across all asset classes.

Joining a group that partners with trading, structuring and risk management functions across the bank, you’ll gain broad exposure to a variety of classic and contemporary financial engineering modelling techniques and markets instruments to help drive business strategy.

Statistical Modelling Quants 

Comprised of data scientists, developers, data engineers and researchers. The team directly supports the Finance, Treasury, Fraud Surveillance, Stress Testing, Climate Risk, as well as the Wholesale and Retail Credit Risk operations within the bank.

Team members deliver solutions to develop, test, implement and support all statistical and econometrics models for the estimation of default probabilities, recovery rates, exposures at default, forecasting models for net revenue, balance sheet projections, scenario generation/expansion, operational risk, climate change, economic capital models and machine learning models for fraud detection, all while using the latest model development approaches and advancements in technology.

The chance to make an impact

As a Quantitative Analytics Graduate, your experience at Barclays will begin with several weeks of intensive training, covering product and business knowledge as well as other skills you’ll need for a successful start. After training, you’ll join a specific desk and collaborate with colleagues on active projects, giving you ample opportunities to grow and learn.

Quantitative Analytics at Barclays

Barclays Quantitative Analytics team is a global organisation of highly specialised modellers and developers responsible for researching, innovating, developing, testing, implementing, and supporting all quantitative models used for valuation and risk management across all asset classes.

Who We're Looking For

To be considered for this programme, you must have completed (or be in the final year of) a postgraduate qualification, Masters or higher, in a technical discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Economics, Statistics, Calculus, Computer Science, or other STEM subjects.

Ideally, You Would Also Have


Mathematical and programming skills (ideally in C++, or Python)Logical thinking and problem-solving abilitiesExcellent communication skills and a team-oriented attitudeFluent written and spoken EnglishPassion to learn about the banking sector, financial services industry, and capital markets 


Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa. Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from either February OR August 2027 (the month which will apply to you will be dependent on your chosen intake date) to August 2028.

Working in London

If you love the buzz of city life, our global HQ is the place to be. Our London hub is in Canary Wharf, at the heart of London’s financial district. Here, you won’t just be perfectly placed to explore the nation’s capital; you’ll be in a place where you can explore all the many functions and opportunities of a global financial giant. And if you’re technically minded, you’ll get more from your tech career by collaborating with other brilliant minds on game-changing innovations that are redefining the future of finance.

Purpose of the role

Bringing quantitative and analytical expertise to bear across the full spectrum of our Markets and Risk businesses. Our Early Careers colleagues are expected to play an important role in the design and development of risk management and trading strategies, through the use of quantitative analysis, mathematical modelling, and technology, with the aim of optimising trading processes, development practices, systems and infrastructure as well as identifying growth and investment opportunities.

Accountabilities


Develop and implement quantitative models and strategies to enhance decision-making, pricing, and risk management. Design and maintain high-performance trading platforms and risk systems, integrating new features to improve reliability and user experience. Conduct research and data analysis to uncover market trends and drive innovation through advanced methodologies and technologies. Collaborate with traders, sales teams, and stakeholders in Risk and Finance to deliver customized solutions and translate business needs into scalable tech tools. Work cross-functionally with compliance, IT, and strategy teams to resolve system issues and continuously improve trading infrastructure.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes.If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc). to solve problems creatively and effectively.Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Associate, Fixed Income Quant Data Operations
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

The Role

Fixed Income Quantitative Research Services provides analytic solutions and data management services to teams in quantitative research, portfolio management, and senior leadership roles across Asset Management. This specialized team leads development efforts to expand and enhance the technical infrastructure and reporting capabilities associated with single security fixed income analytics, multi-factor model risk forecasting, big data analytics, and performance attribution. Together with their partners in the technology and research divisions, members of this organization work as an integral part of small project teams to deliver innovative data visualization and analytic tools capable of illustrating current and time series investment themes, portfolio exposures, and factors driving fund performance. In addition to their project work, associates are also responsible for the oversight, maintenance, quality assurance and operational support of analytic and reporting environments to ensure timely and accurate investment intelligence is delivered for direct use within the portfolio management process.

The Experience And Skills You Bring

A Bachelor’s degree in finance, math, accounting, engineering, or computer science. Master’s Degree and/or CFA Charter are strongly desired.2 plus years of experience in an investment data analytics capacity with a focus on Fixed Income.Develop deep understanding across all aspects of Fixed Income quant research including model construction, factor definitions, factor calculations, security analytics and translating output statistics into meaningful information used within the portfolio management function.Perform business, systems, and data analysis, process design, and acceptance testing across projects that require new research content, investment analytics, and/or produce additional reporting capabilities for investment professionals. Oversee daily/weekly/monthly production reporting cycles across the analytic environments. Ensure all required input data is available, processes run successfully, statistical output is accurate, and reports are generated properly. Respond to ad-hoc data analysis requests in support of projects performed by Quantitative Research Analysts in addition to frequent high priority inquiries from other senior investment professionals.Contribute to the continued development and incorporation of non-traditional and/or unstructured data as well as data science applications to enhance the research and investment process.Advanced level SQL and ability to traverse a wide array of database schemas across diverse content sets. Experience programming in Python or R with the ability to develop customized quantitative tools.Highly analytical with the ability to quickly comprehend large data sets in order to develop new processes, perform calculations, identify anomalies, and/or produce new reporting capabilities.Familiarity with quantitative analytics, including fund and index performance measurement, predictive risk modeling, alpha research, stock selection models, and performance attribution.Hands-on project leadership skills with the drive to complete projects as a part of small teams within an extremely fast paced environment. Capability to liaise with investment professionals to gather requirements and manage deliverables of technical development teams.Working knowledge of fixed income securities, corporate actions, financial statement analysis, street estimates, pricing and performance data.Highly proactive, collaborative and self-motivated with the ability to meet objectives under minimal supervision.Strong written and verbal communication; able to communicate effectively with key stakeholders on deliverablesDemonstrated history as a top performer working in a data analysis role where technical skills were required. Successfully led small to medium sized projects in a fast-paced environment.

The Team

As part of the Fixed Income Quant Services team, you will work on improving the analytics and risk platform as well as quant processes by collaborating across teams and driving the engagement. You will leverage your strong technology and domain skills to understand business requirements, partner with quant analysts in testing model prototypes and work with technology partners in driving the implementation of said models. You will also use your analytical skills to actively monitor the quality of the security and fund level analytics and reports.

Accepting Applications Until

Job Description

We are Global

At Global, we think big, work hard, and never stand still. We’re the proud home of the best media and entertainment, driven by our talented and passionate people. Our mission? To make everyone’s day brighter — our Globallers, our audiences, our partners, and our communities. Whether we’re in the studio, building world-class technology, or securing record Outdoor advertising partnerships, we make sure we’re doing it as a team.

Your Role: Audience Insight Assistant

As an Audience Insight Assistant at Global, you’ll support the delivery of brand and audience insight across Global, helping our Programming and Producer teams to make the best radio and podcasts they can. You’ll work closely with the Brand and Audience Insight team to help programmers better understand our radio stations and podcasts, and with the Marketing team to evaluate and improve the campaigns that support our brands. You’ll also support our Strategy and Senior Programming teams to help shape our products of the future.

Key Responsibilities

As an Audience Insight Assistant at Global, you will:

Insight delivery (40%): Help the Insight team deliver insight requests, providing clear, concise and relevant outputs to internal stakeholders, turning data into actionable recommendations.Music testing (30%): Manage and support the music testing process across our radio stations to help ensure we are playing the best possible songs for our audiences.Audience and market analysis (30%): Use RAJAR, digital listening data, Spotify and radio plays data to understand audience behaviour, track what’s happening in the music market and highlight areas for improvement.

What You’ll Love About This Role

Think Big: Work on some of the largest radio brands in the country, reaching millions of people every week, and help develop our video and podcast strategy.

Own It: Take responsibility for key parts of our music testing and audience analysis processes, ensuring insight is robust, timely and useful.

Keep it Simple: Turn complex data into clear stories and straightforward recommendations that support decision-making across Programming and Marketing. Better Together: Collaborate with some of the most interesting and creative people in the business, building strong relationships with Programming, Marketing and Strategy teams.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months, you’ll have:

Become familiar with key insight tools, data sources and practices.Learnt how to manage our music testing processes.Started to build strong relationships with Programming and Marketing teams.Become proficient in our audience analysis systems and data sources.Developed confidence in communicating insight findings and recommendations to stakeholders.

What You’ll Need

Communication skills: Ability to explain data and insight clearly to different audiences.Data confidence: Comfortable working with data and turning findings into clear, actionable recommendations.Stakeholder management: Ability to build effective working relationships and manage multiple requests and priorities.Organisation and attention to detail: Strong organisational skills with a focus on accuracy and data quality.Insight and media interest: Interest in, or experience of, brand/audience insight, analytics, research, media, marketing or a data-led environment.Collaboration and learning mindset: A proactive, collaborative approach with a willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.Technical skills: Ideally some experience of Excel, Word and PowerPoint.Passion for our content: A love of music, radio and podcasts.

Creating a place we all belong at Global

We are dedicated to creating a place where different voices are represented, amplified and celebrated. We know that we can’t serve our diverse audiences without first celebrating it in our people, which is why we’re passionate about creating an inclusive culture where every Globaller can belong. So, no matter who you are or where you are from, you can find your place at Global.

rows.title: Influencer Marketing Assistant
rows.descriptionText:
At Wonderskin, we believe beauty should be effortless, long-lasting, and transformative and we have built a brand that proves it. Powered by patented Wonder Blading technology, we have cracked the code on long-wear beauty, delivering bold, flawless results that speak for themselves.

We're a fast-growing brand with a passionate global community, and we thrive on creativity, experimentation, and pushing the boundaries of traditional beauty. Now we're looking for an Influencer Marketing Assistant to help power our creator partnerships and content pipeline, someone who is organised, relationship-driven, and knows how to turn great creators into great content.

If you're passionate about influencer marketing, love building relationships with creators, and want to be part of a brand where science meets self-expression, you might just be our kind of person.

This role is based at our HQ in Nine Elms, Monday to Thursday, with Fridays worked from home.

What You Will Do

Reporting to the Head of Partnerships, you'll work closely with the wider marketing team. In your role as Influencer Marketing Assistant, you will be expected to perform the following key duties:

Creator Outreach & Partnerships

Manage outreach to identify and connect with suitable creators for the brand.Build and nurture strong, ongoing relationships with creators, ensuring every touchpoint reflects the Wonderskin brand and tone.Assist with influencer and partnership coordination across campaigns and always-on activity.

UGC Sourcing & Content Pipeline

Source UGC (User Generated Content) from creators and the wider community.Manage the flow of incoming content, keeping an organised pipeline from brief through to delivery.Ensure a steady, reliable stream of content that supports campaigns, launches, and brand priorities.

Quality Control

Conduct a first review of all incoming content, checking it against the brief and Wonderskin's standards for quality, tone, and brand alignment. All content must be approved by the Head of Partnerships before final use.Manage feedback and revisions with creators, then submit the final version to the Head of Partnerships for sign-off.Support brand consistency across all creator-generated content.

Product Send-Outs & Seeding

Organise product send-outs to content creators and PR lists, ensuring the right products reach the right people at the right time.Keep accurate records of who has received what, and follow up to maximise content return.

Requirements

1–2 years' experience in influencer marketing, PR, social media, or a similar marketing role (beauty/lifestyle highly preferred).Eager to learn and grow — this is an ideal role for someone early in their career looking to build a future in influencer marketing.Strong relationship-building skills and confidence reaching out to and working with creators.Excellent written communication, with the ability to write clear, engaging content briefs.A sharp eye for content quality and a strong sense of brand tone and visual identity.Highly organised, proactive, and able to juggle multiple creators, send-outs, and deadlines at once.Comfortable managing logistics, stock, and admin with accuracy and attention to detail.Calm under pressure and quick-moving when deadlines are tight.

What You Will Gain

From day one, you will be hands-on in one of the most exciting spaces in beauty marketing right now, building creator relationships, shaping content, and seeing your work come to life. This isn't a role where you'll be watching from the sidelines, instead you will get:

Hands-on experience across influencer marketing, PR, UGC, and content coordinationExposure to a high-growth, globally recognised beauty brand with a passionate and engaged audienceThe creative freedom to bring your own ideas forward and see them come to life at scaleA career path to progress into Influencer Marketing, Social, Brand, or Content rolesThe chance to grow alongside a brand that's still writing its story

This is a fast-paced, relationship-driven role with genuine progression opportunities, built for someone ready to make their mark and grow with us.

Our Commitment to You

At Wonderskin, we are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the world we live in. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or family status.

About DS.EWe are DS.Emotion, an independent place branding, marketing and activation agency. In simple terms, we help town centres, shopping destinations and mixed-use places across the UK attract visitors, build communities and stay relevant.
For over 30 years, we’ve worked with developers, landowners, local authorities and destination teams to create authentic place brands and bring them to life through social media, campaigns, events and on-the-ground activations. 
Our work helps places thrive both commercially and socially, creating destinations that people genuinely want to visit, spend time in and return to.

The teamWe’re a creative, strategic and collaborative agency, offering expertise across brand consultancy, strategy, creative campaigns, digital, events and physical activations.

You'll get involved in:Creating original short form content across TikTok, Instagram and emerging platformsDeveloping creative concepts that people genuinely want to watch and shareGetting out across London to film and capture spontaneous contentSpotting emerging food, wellness, social and cultural trendsCreating pop ups, sampling campaigns, events and real world brand activationsDeveloping collaborations with cafés, creators, founders, wellness businesses and other interesting partnersComing up with unconventional ideas and creative stunts that get the brands noticedBuilding communities around the brandsSupporting product launches, shoots and campaignsWorking alongside Sales to identify interesting commercial and partnership opportunitiesLooking at what's working, learning quickly and making the next idea even betterYou'll be trusted to take projects from the initial spark through to execution.
Who are we looking for?
Challenger brand experience matters.You'll have at least two years' relevant marketing experience and have worked directly within a challenger food, drink, wellness, lifestyle or closely related consumer brand.You understand the energy, resourcefulness and pace required to build a brand without enormous advertising budgets or endless agency support.Beyond that, we're looking for someone with genuine creative instinct.You're naturally curious about brands and culture.You spend far too much time on TikTok and Instagram, but can legitimately claim it's research.You know what's getting attention right now and have good judgement about which trends a brand should actually touch.You're comfortable picking up a phone and filming.You're happy appearing in content when it makes sense.You can approach someone you've never met and start a conversation.You're interested in London's food, café, wellness and cultural scene.You have opinions about which brands are doing brilliant work.And you've got examples of things you've personally created, launched or made happen.Creative ideas are only half the job.You'll also need to deliver them.
We're looking for someone proactive, organised and dependable enough to take an idea from:“Wouldn't it be cool if…”to“It's happening next Thursday.”
You'll have plenty of freedom, but you'll also be trusted to manage your own projects, follow through on commitments and work collaboratively with the wider team.The original brief describes the ideal person as both an “ideas person and a doer”, with the confidence and independence to execute without being constantly chased.Why this could be a brilliant career moveYou'll have real creative ownership.You'll work closely with a small, ambitious marketing team.You'll be encouraged to experiment.You'll spend time where consumers actually are.You'll be able to see your ideas come to life quickly.And you'll have the opportunity to help shape the personality and cultural relevance of two growing challenger brands.
For someone who eventually wants to become a Brand Manager, Creative Lead, Head of Brand or Marketing Director within the challenger FMCG world, there's a huge amount of experience to be gained here.
Paying up to £40,000
📍 Based in Central London with regular activity across London
Interested?We're much more interested in what you've made happen than receiving the world's most polished CV.
So alongside your application, we'd love to see examples of your work.Content you've created.Activations you've delivered.Brands you've helped grow.Ideas you're proud of.And if you've got a slightly ridiculous marketing idea you've always wanted a brand to be brave enough to try, we'd probably like to hear that too.
If you're currently working for a challenger brand and reading this thinking “this sounds like my kind of job”, apply or message me directly.
All conversations will be treated confidentially.

rows.title: Social Editor
rows.descriptionText:
About us: 
Who is GBM Group I hear you ask? Well, you probably already know who we are, without realising it! 
GBM is a social-first creative powerhouse that acts as both a publisher and an agency built for how young audiences actually consume content today: fast, native and culture-led. 
We have numerous pages including Great British Memes, That Girl Page, That Student Page and MORE, which across all social channels reach over 500 million every month. The vast majority of our social following also comes from within our home market - the UK. 
At GBM, we take pride in what we do and make sure the client's needs are met while considering the needs and wants of our nurtured communities/audiences. All campaigns have a lot of care and attention to detail with nothing going live unless the GBM team are 100% happy with everything. 
So to sum it up for ya, we are a young start-up who are chronically online making organic and paid memes and video content for the masses… 
Sound like a bit of you? Read below! 

The role: This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about social media, digital culture and creating content that people actually want to watch and share.
You’ll work closely with our Social Media & Editorial team, freelance creators and wider GBM team to support the day-to-day running of our social channels. You’ll help source and publish content, keep up with trends, support content creators and contribute ideas across the GBM network.
This is a hands-on role, so no two days will necessarily look the same. One day you could be helping schedule content, the next you could be out on a shoot, finding a reactive trend, helping edit a video or coming up with an idea for one of our pages.
We’re looking for someone who is curious, organised, proactive and genuinely obsessed with social media. You don’t need to know everything already – we’re looking for someone who wants to learn, get stuck in and develop their skills within a fast-growing social media business.
You’ll support the management of pages across the GBM network, helping ensure consistent posting and high-quality output, while gaining experience across content creation, editorial, analytics, shoots and social strategy.
This role is focused on producing engaging, relatable content and may include supporting retained clients, branded campaigns and internal creative projects.
You’ll also have the opportunity to work alongside experienced members of the team and learn how a large social publisher operates across multiple platforms and communities.
This role is office-based at the London Bridge address and will require you to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week, with the remaining 2 days working from home. As the business continues to grow, the number of office days may increase to 4.
Key responsibilities include:
Supporting the Social Media & Editorial team with the day-to-day delivery of content across the GBM networkStay ahead of competitors by proactively researching trending stories, viral videos or news.Adopt and explore new methods for audience growth across our social channels. Bring creativity, fresh ideas and proactive suggestions to the team.Helping ensure content is posted consistently and accurately across designated social channelsAssisting with the management and organisation of content calendarsSupporting freelance content creators and helping ensure content is delivered on time and to the required standardKeeping up to date with social media trends, viral formats, memes and wider digital cultureIdentifying interesting and reactive opportunities and bringing ideas to the wider teamActively posting on designated channels, which may include occasional weekend posting when requiredSupporting the planning, attendance and execution of shootsSupport live events and breaking news coverage as it happens.Assisting with filming, content creation and basic video editing where requiredHelping source interesting, relevant and engaging content for GBM pagesSupporting the growth and development of GBM’s social pagesMonitoring basic page performance and flagging interesting trends, issues or opportunities to the wider teamAssisting with weekly channel updates and analytics trackingHelping ensure content follows platform guidelines and GBM’s editorial standardsSupporting the team with branded campaigns and internal creative projectsRepresenting GBM positively when working with partners, contributors and at industry events where applicableBeing willing to get stuck in and support the wider team wherever needed
This is not an exhaustive list and you may be required to undertake additional duties as needed.
What we are looking for:
A genuine passion for social media, content and digital cultureA positive, can-do attitude and willingness to learnSomeone who is naturally curious about what is trending and why content worksExperience working in a newsroom, social publishing or digital agency environment.Understanding of what makes stories perform across social. Examples of social posts or campaigns that delivered strong audience engagement.Experience in running & posting on large social media pages (over 50K followers)Strong communication skills, both written and verbalGood organisational skills and an ability to manage multiple tasksExperience using social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube and RedditExperience creating social content and/or managing social media pagesA basic understanding of social media trends, formats and audience behaviourAn understanding of what makes content engaging, relatable and shareableBasic knowledge of Canva and/or other content creation toolsBasic analytical skills and an interest in understanding how content performsComfortable being in front of the camera when requiredA proactive mindset and willingness to put forward ideasComfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quicklyA collaborative attitude and willingness to support the wider teamStrong attention to detailA willingness to attend shoots and occasionally work outside of the usual office environmentAny experience with long-form content, video editing or production would be a bonus, but is not essentialMost importantly, we’re looking for someone who lives and breathes the internet.
Sound like a bit of you? Apply now.

Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

rows.title: Growth manager
rows.descriptionText:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilitiesUnderstand. Build deep knowledge of your product, its business model, and the key levers driving growth.Analyze. Use AI, automation, and advanced analytics to explore high-performing campaigns, identify patterns in user and product data, and generate actionable insights.Ideate. Turn insights, experiment results, competitor research, and AI-assisted exploration into hypotheses and identify opportunities to improve growth and monetization.Test. Design and run rigorous experiments with real users, partnering closely with designers, engineers, and analysts to bring ideas to life and iterate quickly based on results.Scale. Roll out winning ideas broadly, and use learnings from each experiment to shape the next cycle of discovery and testing.

What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

rows.title: Talent & Brand Executive
rows.descriptionText: GTN is a specialist talent and brand consultancy working across entertainment, sport and culture. We are looking for a highly organised, ambitious Talent & Brand Executive to join our growing team.This is a hands-on role combining administration, project coordination, talent research, new business support and content. You'll work closely with a small senior team across live client projects and have the opportunity to grow quickly as the business develops.The roleYou'll support the team across:Developing talent lists and researching talent against client briefsCreating new business presentations, research and prospect listsMaintaining project trackers, spreadsheets and internal systemsSupporting the coordination and administration of live client projectsAttending client calls and managing actions and follow-upsResearching brands, agencies, talent and cultural opportunitiesSupporting VIP programmes, talent campaigns and eventsManaging the weekly operation of GTN's Substack media platform, FRONTEDCoordinating weekly LinkedIn and Instagram contentSupporting the wider team wherever required in a fast-moving businessAbout youWe're ideally looking for someone with 2–3 years' relevant experience across talent, entertainment, PR, advertising, influencer marketing or brand partnerships.You'll be highly organised, proactive and culturally switched-on, with excellent written and verbal English and exceptional attention to detail.You should be confident communicating professionally with clients and industry contacts, comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and presentations, and interested in using AI and digital tools to work smarter.Most importantly, we're looking for someone with a positive attitude, high standards and a genuine appetite to work hard, learn and build their career in the talent and brand industry.Working at GTNGTN is a small, entrepreneurial and fast-moving business. Everyone gets stuck in, and the successful candidate will gain significant exposure to clients, talent representatives and senior industry contacts.The role is hybrid. GTN has a central London office alongside remote working flexibility. The exact working pattern can be discussed.

rows.title: Brand marketing manager - FTC 13 months
rows.descriptionText:
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.

Why we need this role

We're looking for an experienced Brand Marketing Manager to join us on a 13-month fixed-term contract to cover maternity leave.

As a key member of our Brand and Content team, you'll help shape how our brand is experienced, understood and remembered by customers, partners and colleagues globally. This is an exciting opportunity to step into an established role at a time of continued growth and transformation, helping us tell a consistent, compelling story while making sure our brand remains distinctive, relevant and impactful across every touchpoint.

Collaboration sits at the heart of this role. You'll work closely with colleagues across marketing, strategy, sales, product and communications, building strong relationships and bringing people together around a shared vision for the brand. You'll act as a trusted advisor, helping teams create work that not only delivers business results but also strengthens the long-term value of the brand.

As the way we create and deliver marketing continues to evolve, you'll also play an important role in embracing new technologies, including artificial intelligence, to improve efficiency, scale brand activity and enhance creativity. From helping teams create on-brand content more effectively to exploring new ways to maintain consistency of tone, messaging and customer experience, you'll use modern tools and approaches to help our brand work smarter while staying true to who we are.

Ultimately, this role is about bringing our brand to life in ways that inspire confidence, create connection and drive meaningful impact, both inside and outside the business.

What You Will Do

Contribute to our evolving global brand strategy, ensuring a consistent and compelling brand experience across all channelsAct as the guardian of the brand, providing guidance and approvals to make sure brand standards are maintainedManage and evolve brand guidelines, resources and tools that help teams apply the brand consistentlySupport internal engagement with the brand through training, communications and brand resourcesPlan and deliver integrated marketing campaigns across digital and offline channelsWork with specialist teams and agency partners to create high-quality, impactful marketing activitySupport the ongoing development of our brand positioning and messaging framework, aligning to our market offeringsWork closely with the PR and Social team to ensure a consistent and engaging external presenceBuild strong relationships with stakeholders across the business, helping align brand activity with wider goals and prioritiesTake ownership of our brand research process from end to end. Use customer insights, research and campaign performance data to inform decisions and improve future activityPresent recommendations, insights and campaign results to senior stakeholders and wider teams so they can action itIdentify opportunities to strengthen our brand and improve the effectiveness of our marketing activityManage marketing budgets responsibly and make sure projects are delivered on time and within budget

Must Haves

What we're looking for

Experience developing and delivering successful brand strategies within a business-to-business environmentProven experience leading integrated marketing campaigns across a range of channelsStrong understanding of brand management, including positioning, messaging and visual identityExperience working with creative agencies and managing campaigns from concept through to deliveryExcellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to build credibility across all levels of an organisationConfidence using research, customer insights and performance data to guide decision-makingExperience managing budgets and measuring marketing performance against agreed objectivesExcellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to build understanding of the value of brand across the businessStrong organisation and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple prioritiesExperience working effectively in a complex, international organisation

Might Haves

Experience working with a global brandExperience supporting brand transformation or repositioning programmesKnowledge of reputation-building and thought leadership activityExperience creating internal brand engagement or training programmesExperience managing AI prompts and familiarity with AI agentsFamiliarity with brand tracking and customer research methodsExperience delivering campaigns across multiple regions or markets

What We Offer You

Looking to make a mark?

At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.

Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.

Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.

We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.

Diversity and inclusion

Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

Most Recently We Have

Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action PlanTrained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First AidersPlease speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.

Benefits

Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.

Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.Global Family Leave Policy.Employee Assistance Program.Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

A global network

When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

rows.title: Manager, Digital & Social Activation
rows.descriptionText:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience .

Manager, Digital & Social Activation – Job Summary

The Real Chemistry Global Activation team is a growing group of digital specialists helping healthcare clients unlock new opportunities across social media, digital and emerging channels. As we continue to expand our global capabilities, we’re looking for a digital and social media specialist to help deliver integrated digital strategies for leading healthcare clients.

We're looking for someone who combines strong digital expertise with a genuine curiosity for what's next. Whether it's AI-powered content creation, generative search optimisation (GEO), emerging platforms or new approaches to healthcare engagement, you'll enjoy exploring opportunities that help clients connect with audiences more effectively.

Working closely with senior specialists and cross-functional teams across global social, digital and omnichannel programmes, you'll help shape the continued evolution of our activation capabilities while developing your own expertise across broader digital activation strategy.

A strong understanding of paid social media is essential, particularly across Meta and LinkedIn. You'll have hands-on experience planning, launching, optimising and reporting on campaigns, translating client objectives into audience targeting, budget allocation and content recommendations.

Key Responsibilities

Act as day-to-day digital and social lead across client accounts.Plan, execute, optimise and report on paid social campaigns, particularly across Meta and LinkedIn.Manage project timelines, budgets, deliverables and quality control processes to ensure high-quality execution.Translate audience insights and performance data into actionable recommendations across digital strategy, channel planning and campaign optimisation.Partner with creative, analytics, paid media and strategy teams to deliver integrated programmes.Support new business through research, insight generation and presentation development.Stay ahead of industry trends and platform developments across social media, search, AI and digital engagement, identifying opportunities to evolve client programmes and activation capabilities.Support and mentor junior colleagues.Manage workload and resource allocation effectively.

Required Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on paid social experience across Meta and LinkedIn (essential) including audience targeting, budgeting, optimisation and performance reporting.Understanding of content strategy and creative best practices across a range of channelsConfidence in day-to-day client management and presentation delivery.Ability to interpret data and turn insights into actionable recommendations.Experience across key digital and social platforms including Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit and search, with an understanding of the role different channels play within an integrated activation strategy.Strong organisation, attention to detail and project management skills.Collaborative, proactive and adaptable mindset.Agency and/or healthcare experience preferred.

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

rows.title: Social Media & PR Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Daintie Delicates, PODBOSS & LVP Fulltime | Onsite | LondonPermanent employed role only. No freelancers, contractors or agencies please.We are looking for a Social Media & PR Manager who can help get our brands seen, talked about, filmed, sampled, trusted and remembered.
About UsWe're an entrepreneurial Aussie family, originally from Melbourne, running quite a few businesses across the US, Australia and now the UK and Europe. We're not an agency, but you'll get to work across a genuinely diverse range of products and brands. You'll primarily be working in the office of Dacie Clean, the detergent company of the family, run by Dakota (a small brunette in her late twenties with a big passion for dancing and an even bigger one for solving laundry problems nobody else wants to talk about).She opened the London office at Westbourne Studios in January 2026 to push some of our brands from the US into the UK & Europe. So we're still very much early days.. You'll be the second of our London creative crew, soon joined by our Ecommerce Manager and Content Strategist & Copywriter.We're hoping to find the right people to grow with and build a really fun, supportive and kind culture.
This is a role in a startup, so it needs initiative, resourcefulness, curiosity and a healthy ability to just get things done, with plenty of variety and room to make an impact. We like people who think creatively, find resourceful solutions, and occasionally achieve surprisingly good results with little more than determination and a decent WiFi connection.
We're after someone full time, but we offer up to 2 months a year remote work if you want to travel... and we'll even shout you the coworking space fees while you're off adventuring!
Bring your mates too!After three years adapting our US products for Europe, they're finally arriving in the UK (hooray!!.. it's been a long process). So that means its time to ramp up the team!
As part of this expansion, we are also currently hiring for:
Ecommerce ManagerContent Strategist/Copywriter
If you know talented people who would be a great fit, please mention it in your application that you would like to recommend or work alongside them.
The RoleGet the brand seen, talked about, filmed, sampled, trusted and remembered.
Daintie Delicates is a laundry detergent that removes period stains. It's both gentle, effective and stigma breaking. (https://daintiedelicates.com/).. we won a shiny silver award last year.PODBOSS is wholesale, convenience sized and bulk detergent. (https://thepodboss.com/)LVP sells the laundry vending machines that Podboss goes inside of as well as other laundrette supplies. (https://laundryvendingproducts.com/)Across all three we're building niche, practical consumer and trade brands with clear positioning and growth potential.
Beyond detergents, our wider family of products spans some pretty diverse industries from caravans and arborist machinery to concrete mixers and medical/lab products so over time there may be chances to support other brands in the family too. (the laundry rack and readymixer will take most of your time for this side of the company
https://thelaundryrack.com/ https://readymixer.com/https://blueridgecampers.com/https://tooltrailerusa.com/
You will help build awareness, credibility and recognition across Daintie, PODBOSS and LVP through content, partnerships, PR, sampling, creator relationships and brand building initiatives.
This role has two main functions:
Brand Partnerships & PRSocial Media
For Daintie and PODBOSS, you will help oversee organic content across TikTok, Instagram and Facebook. For LVP, the focus is more trade visibility, LinkedIn presence, industry relationships and B2B awareness among laundrette owners and operators.
Your time will not be split equally across the brands. Daintie will take up the largest share of the role, PODBOSS will need regular attention, and LVP will be more occasional and trade focused.
You will work closely with the Founder, Brand Designer, Ecommerce Manager and Brand Strategist/Copywriter, as well as our US videographer, freelance scriptwriter and two on call UK videographers for more professional campaigns.
You do not need to have done every single part of this role before, but you do need to be curious, socially confident, quick to learn and comfortable making things happen.
What you'll actually do:Make content. take prefilmed content, or film and edit shortform video on your phone: TikTok, Reels, LinkedIn. Lowfi, fast, native. Product demos, founder content, customer stories, trend formats. Shot in laundromats, hostels, hotels, trade shows... wherever the products live.Get us talked about. Pitch journalists, podcasts and trade press. Find the story angles (founder stories, award wins, weird distribution channels).Get product into the right hands. Run sampling and gifting: lingerie stores, women's health communities and maternity spaces for Daintie; laundromats, hostels and hotels for PODBOSS and LVP. Turn one off placements into relationships.Build the creator pipeline. Recruit and brief UGC creators, manage deliverables, run TikTok Shop affiliates, and spot when a comment or customer quote could become a brand moment.Show up. Trade shows, partner venues, events. Staff the stand, interview laundrette owners on camera, capture the chaos.You'll work with the Founder, Brand Designer, Ecommerce Manager and Brand Strategist/Copywriter, plus videographers in the US and UK for bigger campaigns. Strong footage gets passed to the Ecommerce Manager for ads and listings... you own organic.You don't need to have done all of this before. You need to be curious, socially confident, quick, and the kind of person who makes things happen without being handed them.
What We're Looking ForBe a chaser, a go getter. You're running the show and we are following youUnderstands modern brand building beyond just social media, and is energised by people, places and real momentsConfident filming, editing and posting short form content (CapCut, Canva, and a scheduler we previously used Plan)Comfortable appearing on camera, and even more comfortable putting other people on itExperience managing organic brand channels and working with creators, influencers or UGCStrong, charismatic communication: captions, outreach messages, brand copy, and walking up to strangers at trade showsCan juggle multiple brands and projects without blurring their identities or needing constant supervisionHighly responsiveSpots opportunities without being handed them: a journalist request, a local event, a viral comment, a laundrette partnership
Nice to have: PR or media relations experience; TikTok Shop, affiliates or creator marketplaces; content for physical products; background in consumer goods, wellness, beauty, hospitality or trade; sampling, gifting or partnership programmes; coordinating videographers.
Who This Role Is Not ForThis isn’t a role where you manage a social team from above. You’ll have support: brand design, copywriting, scriptwriting, videography... but it’s hands on. You are not a cog you are the wheel.
We need energy, appetite and comfort being visible. Someone proactive who’ll get out there, film things, talk to people, test ideas and capture real moments like trade show chaos and founder led experiments.
Not someone who wants to stay quiet behind the scenes.
We need charismatic confidence, warmth and a sense of humour, because the best content comes from making ordinary moments feel human, engaging and funny. Honestly, once you see how big our fluffy mascot is next to our 5'3 founder, the content writes itself.
With this job sometimes you'll be filming onsite in a hostel laundry, or interviewing a local laundrette owner. Sometimes it’s the imperfect, non polished side of running a biz or building a brand... like covering a tradeshow and the Founder deciding she could probably rewire our broken down claw machine five minutes before doors open, with absolutely no experience. Finding the funny in the raw.
You don’t need to be an influencer or a professional presenter. Just socially confident, curious, a great storyteller and willing to give things a go.
LocationFulltime, onsite in London (Westbourne Studios, W10), with some travel within the UK for shoots.Up to 2 months a year remote work if you want to travel with coworking fees on us.
How to ApplyCV: If you would prefer to attach a portfolio rather than a CV, that is totally okay. Just make sure somewhere in there is the word detergent so we know you read this. Feel free to include examples of content, campaigns, partnerships, PR activity or brand building work you've created or contributed to."Cover Letter": Please do not send a traditional corporate cover letter... have fun with it. Make us laugh!We're much more interested in who you are, how you think, what gives you energy, and why this role genuinely interests you. Think FaceTime voicenote energy rather than a formal CV. Bonus points if you use your worst Hinge prompt (professionally). Send your intro as a one page PDF, short presentation, Notion style page, a literal video, or any format that feels natural. Don't overthink it.We'd love to know things like:What you enjoy doing and are naturally good atWhat people usually rely on you forWhat kind of work makes you come aliveWhy this role caught your attentionA bit of your personality... we want to get a feel for the person behind the CV
Finally, include a short answer to one of the following (your choice):Tell us about a campaign, piece of content, partnership or PR initiative you created or contributed to that was niche and extremely out of the box.If you were launching a new laundry product into the UK market with a limited budget, what would be your first three brand-awareness activities?

rows.title: Digital Marketing Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Digital Marketing Executive 
We are an award-winning mortgage platform, created for our customers, designing better ways to buy-to-let. Our vision is to become the ‘go-to’ funding partner in the private rental sector.  At Landbay, we focus on the customer, and we bring together the best people and partners, leveraging our data, technology, and market expertise – to give people what they really need. Today we are the UK’s leading prime buy-to-let marketplace mortgage lender, having lent circa £4bn in partnership with our funding partners.  We’re a specialist buy-to-let lender working exclusively through brokers. Everything we build — our products, our systems and our communications — exists to make brokers’ lives easier. This role owns a key part of how that happens, from CRM and website activity through to campaigns and paid media.  Join Landbay and you’ll be part of a growing, ambitious, and supportive team, where everyone is encouraged to contribute, regardless of age or experience. Our team, our community, and the wider world matter to us, as much as the work we do. We’re building a company we love, and we hope you’ll love it too.  For more information about Landbay please visit our website: https://landbay.co.uk/about-us 
Role Details  
Landbay, Marketing Team — reporting to the Head of Marketing. 
Working closely with the marketing team you’ll: 
Become the main lead for product launches with support, including website and digital sales asset updates, briefing and assisting with marcomms, with a view to rapidly taking on greater ownership as experience develops. Work with the Senior Digital Marketing manager to develop, manage, and maintain CRM customer lifecycle journeys, including campaign planning and build, workflow logic, segmentation, and data hygiene. Continually optimise user lifecycle campaigns, identify new KPIs and incremental improvements through testing and asset revision. Maintain website content for products, criteria, and the solicitor panel, monitor performance, and assist in developing our ongoing AEO strategy. Track campaign outcomes across sales and marketing activity, defining reporting requirements. Create automated follow-up tasks and reporting for the sales and TSO teams. Liaise with stakeholders, product teams, third-party partners, and vendors to support campaign delivery and create digital assets including forms, banners, landing pages, and integrations. Support and help execute paid media campaigns across trade and agency partners, building towards ownership of paid media strategy and channel decisions. 
The Type of Person  
User-centric mindset, placing the user experience first to create effective lifecycle journeys. Logical thinker, comfortable with workflow logic, branching and troubleshooting. Strong attention to detail, with the ability to take a step back to spot inconsistencies and errors. Takes initiative and is comfortable prioritising workload across multiple projects with support. Team player who is able to flag blockers as they arise. Enthusiastic and curious, with a genuine interest in rapid change across marketing technology and the practical use of AI. 
Desired Skills & Experience  
Basic grounding in CRM platforms and marketing automation. Experience working with a website CMS, keeping a broad range of key content up to date. Working knowledge of Google Analytics, GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Data-led approach, using multiple sources to make recommendations. Some experience tagging and publishing campaign assets while following agreed processes. Ideally, a familiarity with digital ad platforms such as Adform, Google Ads and LinkedIn. A keen interest in AEO as a new channel. Comfortable learning to create custom workflows using AI as support.  Location & Logistics   Position is based in Victoria, central London, reporting to the Head of Marketing.  The Application Process 
Those that are successful and shortlisted for the role will have three stage recruitment process containing a HR Screening, a second stage interview and a final interview.
Benefits  Regular Social events Generous holiday entitlement Share options Ability to work from home up to 3 days per week Generous pension scheme Health insurance Enhanced maternity/paternity leave Life Insurance Cycle to work scheme

rows.title: Marketing Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Marketing Manager – BEAR Snacks & Peter’s Yard Crackers
Lotus Natural Foods, the healthy snacking division of Lotus Bakeries and a portfolio of 5 incredible brands; BEAR, TREK, nakd. Kiddylicious and Peter’s Yard, all having their own distinct proposition and role within our business.We have great ambitions for all our brands, ensuring that as a business we deliver sustainable growth over the long-term. We believe that taste and quality are 100% of what underpins us as brand leaders within our categories, and what pulls us apart from our competitors. All of our brands started right here in the UK, as the first market for distribution, but over the years we can now be found across the globe, our ranges have got bigger, along with us as a business.To date we have achieved so much, but there is still plenty of room to grow further and that means we need more brilliant people, those that share an ambition for making a difference and want to join us in delivering the next chapter of growth. Fancy getting involved, then read on…
About the Role
This is a unique marketing role within the UK business that involves working closely with, and serving as the main point of contact for, the BEAR global marketing team, while also having direct responsibility for all elements of the marketing mix for Peter's Yard Crackers.
Key focus areas of the role itself and where you will spend the majority of your time: 
BEAR:
Be the main point of contact between the global team and UK sales team, ensuring to keep the UK market requirements front and centre when in development and challenging the global teams where appropriate.Develop an annual plan in collaboration with sales that addresses our key issues and builds our KPIs for growth.Keep consumer insight at the heart of brand strategy whilst also applying a commercial lensContinually analyze portfolio performance and keep the brand proposition ahead of the competition, ensuring the optimum range on the shelf in channel, incl. formats and sub ranges.Execute EPD and NPD with excellence, through from sell-ins to activating on social and with influencers. Driving both visibility and talkability to ultimately drive penetration and conversion.Work in collaboration with the global team on the optimum execution of our digital first strategy (paid media) and instore activation with clear evaluation and the ability to recommend how to build upon the plan.Manage our digital and social brand presence delivering relevancy and meaningfulness to our consumers.The ability to define and build a ‘community’ that is executed with excellence locally, whether that be events, partnerships, collaborations.Manage the marketing budget and its reporting to ensure the team is always spending efficiently.Responsibility for 2 direct reports at Brand Manager level who will drive execution of the strategic plan.
PETERS YARD
Peter’s Yard is a UK focussed brand where ownerships sits within the UK.Peter’s Yard is a growing sourdough bakery business that combines Swedish tradition with British craft and natural, quality ingredients to create its hand-baked sourdough crackers. The company was founded in 2008, acquired in 2022 by Lotus Bakeries and is now listed in Waitrose, Sainsbury’s, Tesco, Ocado, Booths, Wholefoods and 3,000 independent farm shops and delis. The company has ambitious growth plans to expand the business and build the brand in the UK.As such you also will be responsible for the following:Own the end-to-end marketing mix, leading products from insight and concept development through to packaging, launch execution and integrated campaigns that build awareness, drive trial and deliver growth.
Reporting intoManaging Director – BEAR Snacks and Peter’s Yard Crackers
About You
You are an energetic and experienced Marketing Manager who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is motivated by the opportunity to make a real commercial impact. You will take ownership of the BEAR and Peter’s Yard brands in the UK, driving strategic growth, leading best-in-class execution and influencing stakeholders across the business and with external partners.
Ideally, you will be a BEAR or Peter’s Yard fan, with a genuine passion for food, healthy lifestyles and consumer trends. Highly organised and proactive, you are ready to take the next step in your career and play a key role in shaping the next phase of growth for a dynamic and ambitious business.
Alongside living our Lotus TOP Values of Team Spirit, Open Dialogue and Passion, the most important things we’re looking for from you are: 
To be commercially savvy, know what good looks like and instill best practice in everything that we do.Experience owning and delivering brand growth within competitive FMCG or consumer marketsEnjoy having autonomy and being accountable for building the brand.Passion for brands, consumer trends, food and healthy lifestylesAttention to detail, being 110% over all formatting. Being accountable for delivering best in class presentations and communication on the brand, both internally and externally.Understanding of the retailer landscape.A positive can-do attitude that seeks out solutions and looks at how we can do things differently.Experience collaborating with a Global team on brand projects to ensure consistency and effective brand building activities across markets.Have experience in bringing products to market using every element of the marketing mix, including positioning, pricing, packaging, promotion and launch execution.Excellent strategic thinker with desire to create an impact.Ability to influence stakeholders with confidence.Strong understanding of media planning ATL/BTL and management of agencies to ensure strength in the communication plan.Enjoys collaboration and enjoys building relationships across departments and with agencies, proactive team player who contributes to a strong and collaborative culture
Other key requirements:Right-To-Work within the UK (without sponsorship)To be degree educated with a minimum of 6 years’ relevant marketing experience
Team Be a team player, we all get stuck in to achieve results here at Lotus Natural Foods and we love our team to look beyond their own role to amplify the overall results.Culture is hugely important to us here at Lotus Natural Foods and we look to our employees to positively contribute to that.
Please note this role is a full-time position at our beautiful offices in St Albans, with four days a week spent on-site. Please only proceed if this works for you.

rows.title: Senior Social Media Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Our Head Office department is in the heart of Piccadilly and occupies the 5th & 6th floor of our beautiful flagship store. This central London location offers so much to explore including restaurants, bars, cultural sites, shopping and more, and only a short walk from the Green Park Tube Station and plenty of bus stops.
The Senior Social Media Executive is a creative and varied role supporting the social team in organic content delivery across social media platforms. The role is key to not only growing awareness of the brand but also sustaining conversation with our global audience. We are looking for our next social media superstar, we are looking for someone creative to support the creation of original content (video & imagery), scheduling across multiple social channels and monitoring performance. You will need to be aware of the commercial goals of the business and will play a pivotal role in the wider brand marketing team. rows.title: Freelance, Social Media Publisher (Talent Community)

Job Description

Closing date: 18/09/26

The purpose of this role is to support the publishing of content across McLaren Formula 1’s social media channels, with a focus on delivering against our business objectives, ultimately driving continuous engagement and channel growth.

Principal Accountabilities

Publishing of content across all social media channels in line with McLaren’s overarching social media strategy. Executing a quick turnaround and real-time publishing of live content that’s delivered over a race weekend. Support in the execution of partner and licensing content across McLaren Racing’s social channels in line with contractual rights. Support in updating driver folders of imagery over a race weekend. 

Qualifications

Experience in social media publishing and community engagement at a professional sports team. On the ground experience operating in a high-pressure live sports environment is essential. Excellent copywriting, proofreading and editing skills, demonstrating a clear understanding of social media tone of voice. Demonstrable passion for social media community engagement and an understanding of the role that social media plays in sports fan engagement. A demonstrable interest and understanding of Formula 1 is essential. Proficient social media platform knowledge, including an understanding of best practices across every social media channel with the ability to articulate this when educating internal and external stakeholders. Positive, optimistic mindset with a "can-do" attitude. Trustworthy team player. Ability to perform under pressure. Open to feedback to continuously develop. A drive to consistently deliver work to the highest standards.

Success in racing comes from bringing together talented people with different skills, perspectives and experiences. We're committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels supported and empowered to deliver their best work.

Every role has the potential to drive high performance. You'll be part of a team united by a shared ambition to push boundaries and embody our racing mindset. We invest in our people through opportunities to develop and grow, creating an environment where individuals and teams can thrive.

Alongside a range of wellbeing initiatives and development opportunities, we're committed to helping you build a rewarding career and make your mark at McLaren Racing.
