rows.title: Graduate Marketing Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter.

About The Role

We're looking for a Graduate Marketing Scientist to join Fospha's Marketing Science team in London.

Fospha builds marketing measurement products for ecommerce brands — attribution, marketing mix modelling, incrementality testing, and brand impact measurement. Marketing Science owns the applied end of that: designing and delivering incrementality tests and MMM engagements for clients, and standing behind the numbers when a client challenges them.

This is the entry point into the function, and it is a hands-on one. You'll work on live test and MMM delivery under supervision from the start, and you'll be the first person looking at a client's data when a number doesn't behave the way it should. It's a role for someone who wants to learn causal measurement properly, in a business where it's the product rather than a side project.

Team: Marketing Science

Level: Graduate — Entry (Data Science Career Development Framework)

Location: London

Salary: max £35,000

What You'll Do

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) & Testing Services

Assemble and validate test data — geo-level spend and conversion series, checking pre-period parity between treatment and control, spotting the coverage gaps that invalidate a design before it launchesSupport test design under review — market matching and control selection, power and minimum detectable effect sanity checks, and identifying contamination risks such as geo-targeting settings that don't behave the way the platform's documentation claimsRun analysis and read the results honestly — pre-treatment fit diagnostics, lift estimates with their intervals, and what a null result does and doesn't tell youQualify client data for MMM — spend coverage across channels, whether there's enough variation in spend to identify an effect at all, series length and granularity, collinearity between channels, and gaps that will bias the resultAssemble and validate model input datasets, and investigate the discrepancies that surface when you doSupport model runs and read the diagnostics — fit, residuals, convergence, and whether a channel's estimated contribution is plausibleContribute to output-extension work under review — building on an existing MMM result, for example forecasting or budget scenario work derived from itCompare results across methods — where MMM, incrementality, and platform-reported figures disagree, understanding why is the interesting part of the job

Model Trust and Diagnostics

First and second line on client trust queries — investigating why a number changed, working in SQL against client data to isolate the causeDistinguish a bug from a methodology change — attribution window changes, model recalibration, data feed gaps, and platform reporting shifts all look similar from the outside and have very different signatures underneathTriage PSPs on model trust, resolve what you can, and escalate what turns out to be a genuine model problem with a clear diagnosis attachedReconcile platform-reported figures against our measurement — why walled-garden ROAS disagrees with ours is the hardest recurring question in the business, and you'll be learning it from the insideLog and tag incidents consistently, so recurring failure patterns become visible and can be automated away rather than repeatedly handled

Client Communication and Enablement

Run templated explainer sessions under review, walking clients through how our measurement worksDraft documentation and presentations above the core explainer content, and feed recurring query themes back into the source materialFact-check methodology claims in product marketing collateral before it goes out

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for someone with a strong foundation in maths and stats with clear communication who is looking to grow their skillset.

Technical

Working proficiency in SQL — you can investigate a discrepancy yourself rather than asking someone else to pull the dataPython, or a demonstrated ability to pick it up quickly. Most of our analysis tooling sits there.Grounding in inferential statistics — hypothesis testing, uncertainty, statistical power, and what a null result meansSome exposure to experimental design — randomisation, control groups, confounding, and why a badly designed test is worse than no testStrong AI fluency — you use AI tools to get moving on unfamiliar problems and plug gaps in your own knowledge, and you QA the output before you rely on it

Communication

Clear, concise written communication — a large share of this job is explaining something technical to someone who isn'tComposure in client-facing conversation, including when the client is unhappy with a numberReal attention to detail, and the discipline to log things consistently even when it's dullHigh agency — you'll be given ownership as fast as you demonstrate you can hold it

Nice to Have

Exposure to marketing, ecommerce, or advertising dataFamiliarity with Bayesian methods and/or modellingExperience with cloud data toolingExperience presenting to or supporting external stakeholders

How You'll Grow

Level doesn't gate what you're allowed to attempt. It scales how much support you get doing it. A Graduate can work on MMM output-extension work; it just carries heavier review than it would for a Mid.

Incrementality delivery: Triages test type and routes to Product where self-serve applies. Prepares and validates test data. Supports design and analysis under review.MMM delivery: Qualifies client data. Assembles model inputs. Contributes to output-extension work under heavy review.Model trust & PSPs: First and second line on trust queries. Triages PSPs, attempts resolution, escalates genuine model problems with a diagnosis.Client sessions: Runs templated explainer sessions under review.Documentation & enablement: Drafts documentation and presentations above the core explainer. Feeds recurring query themes back into explainer content. Fact-checks methodology claims in product marketing collateral.Automated trust workflows: Logs and tags trust incidents consistently so recurring failure patterns are visible. Surfaces themes from the query queue into workflow design.Supervision: Detailed instruction; works closely with senior colleagues. Development time protected against product and consultancy workload.Upskilling is funded, not assumed. A named share of entry-tier capacity is held for development work and protected against the support queue. Nobody upskills in the gaps between tickets, so we don't pretend otherwise.The step to Junior is independence: running templated sessions and first-line triage unaccompanied, and resolving the full range of inbound queries with only moderate senior input.The step to Mid runs through one of two routes — owning a piece of MMM output-extension work, or taking a recurring trust problem you already handle manually and turning it into automated monitoring that alerts an account manager before the client notices. Both are genuinely technical, and both are allocated deliberately rather than first-come-first-served. From Mid, you own MMM and incrementality delivery with senior sign-off.

Why Fospha

Causal measurement is the product. Geo experiments, MMM, difference-in-differences, and Bayesian attribution are what the business sells. You'll be working on them, not adjacent to them.Live client work early. You'll be on real test and MMM delivery in your first months, with review rather than distance.Structured support, not sink-or-swim. Session allocation rules, a maintained escalation list, and protected development time exist so that being new isn't a liability.A published ladder. You'll know what the next level requires and what evidences readiness for it from your first week.

– Own our automated flows and lifecycle programmes, from welcome to win-back, continuously optimising them for relevance and performance.

– Run a clear testing framework and performance tracking approach to continuously improve engagement and conversion.

– Review and refine the programme’s strategy and structure as it matures, keeping it aligned with both brand positioning and commercial goals.

rows.descriptionText:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Agoda's Brand Marketing team is looking for an Analyst to scale our digital marketing & brand research efforts.

As a part of the Brand Media & Measurement team, you will manage digital campaign planning, A/B testing, and reporting across key digital channels like Meta, Twitter, YouTube etc., and also be responsible for management & analysis of brand research projects.

This person will have the opportunity to learn and grow with the global Brand Marketing team based in Thailand. They will play a key role in analyzing all kind of campaign & research data to deliver insights that will shape the team’s strategy and fulfil our ambition of creating an engaging and meaningful brand in the tech-and-travel space.

This role is based out of Agoda’s Global Operations Center in Bangkok, Thailand, giving the successful applicant the once-in-a-lifetime chance to work in one of the world’s most exciting and fast-paced cities, close to some of the most iconic travel destinations, with a fun and talented team. We provide complete relocation for you and your family and excellent benefits.

About The Brand Team

We are the guardians of the Agoda brand, with a mission to make Agoda a trusted name in global travel. Our scope is broad and encompasses various projects and collaborations with other departments at Agoda. In any given week, we could be working on campaign creation and activation (including consumer research, strategy, agency management, media planning, measurement, and testing), producing assets for Agoda’s various marketing channels and our website and app, or designing official Agoda merch for our offices around the globe. We ensure the brand is always looking and sounding its best in everything we do, whether on the world stage or in a company newsletter.

The Brand team is diverse, representing strategists, media planners, project managers, brand managers, creatives, and more, from different walks of life. We have in common a love of travel (and travel deals) and a passion for finding fun and innovative ways to bring the Agoda brand to the world.

In this role, you’ll get to:

Experiment: Conduct A/B testing on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, TikTok and YouTube, as well as brand research in-house & with external agencies to demonstrate the impact of campaign activity on brand awareness.Execute: Own the performance of digital & social campaigns, optimize critical campaign metrics, and keep an eye on data to ensure that media is delivering against the plan.Learn: Communicate test results & campaign learnings to the team and broader stakeholders through comprehensive analysis, reporting and data visualization. Develop key learnings for different media platforms and markets. Analyse: Delve into data from digital tests & research studies to gather useful insights for optimization of brand campaigns. Collaborate: Liaise with external media partners (e.g. Google, Meta) for planning, analysis and execution, and consolidate media data and analysis with digital activity being run in-house.

rows.title: HR Systems Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As HR Systems Analyst, you will support the continued development of Oracle HCM and connected HR systems. You will work closely with HR Operations, Payroll, HR Business Partners, and IT to improve the quality, usability and effectiveness of our people systems. This role offers genuine breadth. One day you may be helping to resolve a system configuration issue; the next, you could be supporting to improve onboarding journeys across multiple countries, producing HR reporting, or developing clear operating procedures for our HR Shared Services team.

Responsibilities

What you will do

 Provide functional support for Oracle HCM and related HR technology, investigating user queries, system issues and process failures.  Support HR system changes from initial requirements through testing, implementation, user communications and post-implementation review.  Partner with technical teams to help configure and improve HR processes, including employee and manager self-service, workflows, absence and leave processes, benefits and approvals.  Review HR system data for accuracy, completeness and consistency; identify root causes of issues and help implement sustainable controls and improvements.  Create and maintain recurring and ad hoc HR reports, data extracts and dashboards for HR, Payroll, Finance, leadership and regulatory reporting.  Support data gathering and validation for key workforce reporting, including diversity-related analysis, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data governance.  Work with Payroll and HR Shared Services to understand the downstream impact of system changes and ensure effective data reconciliation and hand-offs.  Help design, document and improve employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, benefits enrolment, leave and family-related processes, organisational changes and employee records.  Develop practical process documentation, standard operating procedures, user guidance and knowledge materials that enable consistent, high-quality HR service delivery.  Support employee and manager communications relating to HR systems, benefits and new processes, ensuring information is accurate, clear and easy to use.  Coordinate with external providers and internal technical teams to track incidents, enhancements, access issues, system configuration and service improvements.  Work across legal entities and countries, identifying where HR processes need local variation while maintaining appropriate global consistency.  Bring a continuous-improvement mindset: challenge manual workarounds, identify recurring themes and recommend practical, scalable solutions. 

Qualifications

What you will bring

Essential Experience And Skills

 Experience in an HR systems, HRIS, HR data, people operations or HR shared-services role.  Experience using and supporting an enterprise HR system; Oracle HCM experience is preferred.  Strong understanding of core HR processes, including employee lifecycle administration, onboarding, benefits, absence or leave and organisational data.  Experience investigating system or data issues and working with technical teams, providers or internal stakeholders to resolve them.  Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, including reviewing large datasets, reconciling information and identifying exceptions or trends.  Experience producing HR reports, management information, data extracts or dashboards.  Experience supporting process mapping, process documentation, SOP development or employee/manager guidance.  Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn technical or policy information into clear, practical content.  Excellent attention to detail, sound judgement and a strong commitment to confidential handling of employee information.  A collaborative style and confidence working with a broad range of stakeholders, including HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, senior leaders and external suppliers. 

Desirable

 Oracle HCM experience across Core HR, Benefits, Absence, Journeys, Helpdesk, reporting, security or workflow.  Experience supporting system configuration, release management, user acceptance testing or regression testing.  Knowledge of HR and payroll interfaces, data reconciliation and system controls.  Experience with Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, Jira or case-management technology.  Knowledge of GDPR, HR data governance, data quality controls and audit requirements.  Experience supporting a multi-entity, multi-country or matrix organisation.  Experience designing onboarding journeys, benefits communications or employee-facing HR content.

rows.title: Strategy & Insights Analyst – 12-month Fixed-term contract
rows.descriptionText:
Join Barclays as a Strategy & Insights Analyst, where you will support the delivery of the Group Innovation and Partnerships Strategy & Insights agenda through market intelligence, customer and industry research, strategic analysis, and executive-ready insight generation. Working within a highly visible team, you will help shape Barclays' innovation priorities by analysing market and technology trends, producing thought leadership, horizon-scanning and predictive insight papers, and translating complex information into clear, actionable recommendations. This role offers broad exposure across the business, partnering with senior stakeholders to support innovation initiatives, portfolio governance activities, and evidence-based decision making that enables Barclays to identify, assess, and act on emerging opportunities and risks.

Please note that this is a 12-month fixed-term contract.

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Need


Ability to research market, customer, competitor and technology developments; analyse qualitative and quantitative information; and translate findings into clear, evidence-led recommendations.Ability to communicate complex information concisely, produce high-quality, decision-ready presentations and briefings, and tailor content effectively for senior stakeholders and external partners.Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining effective oversight of actions, risks, controls, decisions and dependencies.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include


Curiosity and practical understanding of AI, digital platforms and emerging technologies, including how they could improve customer outcomes, efficiency, insight or control.Previous exposure to innovation, strategy, market intelligence, commercial analysis, governance, reporting or programme delivery within financial services or a similarly regulated environment.Ability to learn quickly, seek and act on feedback, adapt to new subject areas and proactively build capability over time.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The successful candidate can be based in London (Luke Street) or Glasgow Campus.

Purpose of the role

To collaborate, nurture and drive group innovation with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the bank stays at the forefront of innovation and adapts to the rapidly changing landscape in financial services and increasing customer expectations.

Accountabilities


Collaboration with a range of stakeholders to develop a portfolio of open innovation and strategic initiatives through experimentation, co-creation, access to innovative technology capabilities, products and services and a global innovation ecosystem.Development and delivery of frameworks, ideation, training and tools to build a culture of innovation and knowledge sharing to enable new and creative ideas/solutions that deliver on the bank’s strategy.Provision of a global platform and curated ecosystem of partners to inform strategy, drive connectivity and new insights.Development of the strategic capabilities and programmes for the bank to deliver on its strategy, supporting the exploration, evaluation and execution of innovation and investment opportunities.Management and coordination between external stakeholders/partners and the bank, to successfully deliver joint projects and initiatives.Deliver thought leadership and insights to inform strategic decision making and organisational readiness, in conjunction with regular research, identifying emerging technologies and trends.Development and management of key metrics including key partnerships, innovation initiatives and impact through regular assessments to calculate the return on investment and identify any potential risks and issues.


Analyst Expectations

Job Title: Data Analyst - Safety, Health and Environment

Business Function: SHE, Supply Chain

Location: Leeds (Local (Inside UK) Relocation Assistance is considered)

Job Purpose

We make some of the UK’s best-known personal care brands in Leeds. Our Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) team keeps our people safe, protects our environment and keeps our site compliant. As our site becomes more data-led, we need sharper, faster ways to turn SHE information into clear insight and action. We’re looking for someone who loves data, problem-solving and making work simpler – and wants to use those skills for something that genuinely matters. You’ll build dashboards, automations and reports that help our leaders see where the real risks are, so we can spend less time chasing information and more time acting on the insights that make our operations safer for people and the environment.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for safety, health and environmental performance Automate the reporting that’s currently manual - using Power Automate, Power Apps, Forms and AI tools such as Copilot Own the quality of our SHE data: collect it, check it, and make sure what we report is right, first time Spot trends and outliers, explain what they mean, and help us decide where to focus next to improve SHE performance Work with operations, engineering, finance and our global SHE teams to turn the data into action 

All About You

What we’re looking for

Strong digital, analytical and data communication skills (or the appetite and evidence that you can get there fast) Confidence working with imperfect data - cleaning, modelling and making it trustworthy Curiosity about how a factory works and a genuine interest in health, safety and sustainability A degree, apprenticeship or demonstrable self-taught capability in data, analytics or a related field 

You don’t need

A SHE qualification – we’ll teach you the safety and environment side Manufacturing experience – we’ll show you the factory floor 

What You’ll Get

Real ownership from day one - this will be your remit, with the autonomy to build tools, improve processes and enable better data-led decisions A development pathway into SHE, data or both, with exposure to global Unilever teams A visible role with our site leadership team The opportunity to work within a fantastic team at a world-class manufacturing facility 

Interested but not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway – tell us what you’d automate first.

What We Offer

Not only do we offer a competitive salary and pension scheme, we also offer an annual bonus, subsidised gym membership, a discounted staff shop and shares. You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with our renowned and exciting brands in a flexible and hybrid working environment.

Whilst the role is advertised on a full-time basis, we would be happy to discuss possible flexible working options and what this may look like for you. We are a key advocate of wellbeing and offer a variety of support for our people including hubs, programmes and development opportunities. We strive to achieve a family-friendly and inclusive workplace and to, above all, create possibilities for all.

Diversity at Unilever is about inclusion, embracing differences, creating possibilities and growing together for better business performance. We embrace diversity in our workforce. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. We are also more than happy to provide reasonable adjustments during our application and interview process to enable you to be present your best self. To find out more, including about our Employee Resource Groups, please click here Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Unilever | Unilever.

Recruitment Fraud

Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. In the most sophisticated cases, they will set up fake websites, which have a similar address to companies like Unilever. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs.  These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate.

How is Unilever tackling this?

Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down.

What can I do?

If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat.

Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

INTRODUCTION

At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. This is the core belief that has guided Burberry since it was founded in 1856 and is central to how we operate as a company today.

rows.title: Associate
rows.descriptionText:
ABOUT COMPANYSTRAT7 is a data, analytics, and strategy consultancy that helps clients solve complex business challenges. We combine cutting-edge technology with deep industry expertise to deliver actionable insights that drive growth and transformation. As a group, we bring together experts in data science, AI, consumer insight, commercial strategy, and research methods to provide clients with a complete solution to their business challenges. We embrace agile methodologies across our organization, allowing us to respond quickly to changing market conditions and client needs while delivering high-quality solutions efficiently.

POSITION OVERVIEWYou'd be joining Incite's Atlantic Practice, working with major US and global businesses. This isn't a role where you simply keep projects on track. It is genuinely consultative and needs a true problem solver. You'll shape the thinking, advise clients directly, and influence the strategic direction of the work.One of our biggest clients is MetLife – a major US-based financial services company that offer group benefits, insurance, retirement products and other financial services. Every year, MetLife asks a big question: what do working people need to do their best work, and what are employers getting wrong? The answer becomes the Employee Benefit Trends Study (EBTS), one of the most widely cited pieces of thought leadership in the benefits world.The EBTS programme sits at the centre of the role. It's research of the best kind: big questions about how the workplace is changing, genuine involvement in shaping the themes before any fieldwork begins, and findings that get published and quoted rather than filed away. It is about much more than insurance; it is about understanding how human needs are evolving, what businesses need to succeed, and where the world of work is going next.Beyond MetLife, you'll work across other clients as well, spending approximately 70% of your time on MetLife projects and the other 30% on other clients – with many opportunities to solve interesting strategic challenges and make meaningful impact.

Design research approach, from questionnaires and discussion guides to innovative methods, ensuring the right question gets asked in the right wayTurn data into Insight - work across quantitative and qualitative evidence to uncover the "so what" in the data. Conduct complex analysis, ensure data reliability, and synthesise large datasets into insights worth publishing. Collaborate with analytics specialists when deeper expertise is neededCraft Compelling Narratives - moving beyond data presentation to narrative impact, ensuring findings are matched by strong storytellingBuild Trusted Client Relationships - manage day-to-day relationships with senior stakeholders, positioning as a solutions-focused trusted advisor. 25 days holiday plus UK bank holidays (Christmas closure – 3 days additional to entitlement – discretionary and non-contractual leave)Flexible, hybrid working options – we expect you to be at the office 3 days a weekA contributory group personal pension scheme, to which we contribute 4% of Qualified Banded earnings to each team member’s gross salary after an initial 3 months service4-week sabbatical after 4 years continuous service on top of 25 days holiday2 volunteering paid days per year (under a formal program for a registered charity)A Health cash planLife assurance scheme at 4 x salaryCycle to work scheme following successful completion of probation

DISCLOSURESTRAT7 is an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences and backgrounds, who share a passion for research. rows.title: AI Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At Bionic, we're on a mission to make it radically easier to run a small business. As the UK's leading business comparison and switching service, we help thousands of small and medium-sized businesses save time and money on essentials like energy, broadband, insurance, and finance. We combine smart technology with real human support to match our customers with the best deals - quickly and effortlessly. With trusted partnerships including Compare the Market, USwitch for Business, MoneySuperMarket and Confused.com, we're committed to help SMEs get the best deals for their business essentials every time. The role 
We're looking for detail-oriented and analytical AI Operations Analysts to play a critical role in supporting the governance and quality assurance of AI-driven processes across Bionic. As part of our Business Excellence function, you'll sit at the intersection of Operations, Compliance and AI Innovation. You'll be responsible for reviewing AI-generated outcomes, validating results against available evidence and ensuring decisions are applied fairly, consistently and accurately before they are used in downstream sales and operational processes. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with AI technologies while helping shape how AI is used responsibly in a fast-growing business. If you're naturally curious, highly organised and enjoy solving problems through evidence-based decision making, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities 
AI Validation & Quality Assurance Validate AI-generated outcomes across Energy and Insurance before they are used in business processes. Review call recordings, transcripts and AI rationale to determine whether outcomes are accurate and appropriately applied. Identify true fails, false fails, accepted exceptions and potential technical issues. Ensure validation activities are completed accurately and consistently against agreed criteria. Analysis & Reporting Update system records and validation fields to ensure reporting remains accurate and reliable. Support monthly reporting cycles through completion of validation reviews and challenge processes. Conduct periodic sampling activities to identify potential false-pass trends and support ongoing assurance. Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for validation decisions and escalations. Continuous Improvement Track recurring validation themes, process gaps and AI tool limitations. Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and reporting accuracy. Escalate technical issues and recurring system challenges to relevant stakeholders. Contribute insights that support the ongoing evolution of AI-supported workflows and governance. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with Business Excellence, AI Innovation, Sales Leadership and Legal & Compliance teams. Support the fair, transparent and evidence-led use of AI outputs across the organisation. Build strong working relationships across technical and operational teams to drive positive outcomes. 
About you 
We're looking for people who combine strong analytical thinking with exceptional attention to detail. You'll be comfortable working with data, applying defined criteria consistently and making objective decisions based on evidence. You'll likely have: Excellent attention to detail and a highly accurate approach to work. Strong judgement and the ability to make fair, evidence-based decisions. The ability to identify patterns, trends, process issues and root causes. Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly document decisions. Confidence in escalating complex, unclear or high-risk issues when required. Experience working with multiple stakeholders across operational, compliance or technical teams. The ability to manage competing priorities while meeting important deadlines. A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive information. Required skills & experience Strong IT literacy with experience using business systems and learning new technologies quickly. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Teams. Experience working with structured data and reporting outputs. Ability to identify and document technical issues, data gaps and process failures. Desirable Skills & Experience Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms. Experience using Tableau or other reporting and analytics tools. Experience reviewing customer interactions, call recordings or transcripts. Exposure to AI tools, speech analytics, quality monitoring or automated evaluation systems. Experience within compliance, quality assurance, audit, sales support or operational controls environments. Knowledge of the Energy and/or Insurance sectors. 
The interview process 
Initial one-way video interview Final stage in person interview with the Hiring Manager 
About Bionic Group 
Bionic has over 600 people working across three office locations and four businesses; Bionic - London, Bionic Outbound - Luton, Think Business Loans - Chelmsford, Utility Bidder - Corby and Smart - Field based agents. rows.title: Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.

Job Description

Working within the Rights & Revenue Protection (RRP) team, the Intelligence Analyst will support investigations relating to the protection of Sportradar's intellectual property and revenue recovery activities across Europe and North America.

The role focuses on identifying and assessing threats to Sportradar's content, data and commercial interests, including unauthorised data usage, piracy and intellectual property infringement. Using a range of open-source, cyber and commercial data sources, the analyst will deliver intelligence that supports enforcement activity, commercial outcomes and strategic decision-making.

The position requires a motivated intelligence professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and supports stakeholders across the wider Sportradar Group.

THE CHALLENGE

Conduct intelligence investigations using an all-source approach across rights protection, enforcement and revenue recovery matters.Collect, analyse and evaluate intelligence from open-source, cyber and commercial sources.Conduct OSINT and CYBINT/DNINT investigations to produce actionable intelligence and recommendations.Identify and investigate unauthorised use of Sportradar data, content and intellectual property.Develop and maintain intelligence holdings relating to organisations, individuals and platforms operating across Europe and North America.Monitor emerging risks and trends relevant to intellectual property protection, piracy, sports betting and revenue recovery.Produce intelligence reports, analytical assessments and stakeholder briefings.Support enforcement and commercial recovery initiatives through intelligence development and research.Work closely across multiple Sportradar functions and departments to protect and enhance Sportradar business operations, including internal and external training and education on sports integrity.

About You

2+ years' experience in intelligence, investigations, law enforcement, journalism, cyber security, financial crime, fraud, due diligence or a related analytical field.Experience conducting analytical investigations and producing intelligence-led outputs.Demonstrable expertise in OSINT, HUMINT, CYBINT/DNINT or comparable intelligence methodologies.Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills.Ability to collect, evaluate and interpret information from multiple sources and produce actionable intelligence.Knowledge of online ecosystems, digital platforms and investigative research techniques.Awareness of data protection legislation and associated implications.High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professionalism.Ability to manage changing priorities and work effectively under pressure and to tight deadlines.Fluency in English essential, professional working proficiency in French or another living language strongly preferred.

Advantageous

Experience using intelligence analysis tools such as i2 Analyst's Notebook, Maltego or similar.Knowledge of the international sports betting, gaming, media or anti-piracy landscapes.Professional networks or regional knowledge across Europe and/or North America.Experience conducting investigations relating to intellectual property infringement, brand protection, digital piracy or revenue recovery.Understanding of corporate structures, beneficial ownership research and due diligence methodologies.Experience working with commercial intelligence databases and specialist investigative tools.Relevant intelligence, investigation or analytical certifications.

Our Offer

A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding.Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy.A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks.Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants.Global Employee Assistance Programme.Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience).Online training videos.Flexible working hours.

While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together.

Our Recruitment Process

Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations.Hiring Team Interview : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit.Assessment : Investigative task to showcase your technical skills.Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer!

Additional Information

At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

rows.title: Consultant, Business Intelligence
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are  

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

About The Role

FTI Consulting is seeking a highly motivated, Consultant to join its Business Intelligence team in London. The Business Intelligence team conducts corporate investigations, uncovers actionable business intelligence, supports clients in commercial disputes, and provides clear analysis to help decision-makers address and mitigate risk, protect assets and maximise opportunities in a variety of jurisdictions worldwide. Its expertise lies in investigative due diligence, asset tracing, fraud and anti-corruption investigations, litigation support, whistle-blower allegations, third-party integrity screening, political risk assessments and other bespoke engagements.

What You’ll Do 

The Consultant will conduct research on a range of complex and multi-jurisdictional projects, including investigative due diligence, asset traces, fraud investigations and political risk assessments. Consultants are expected to conduct independent, first-class research and analysis, drawing upon the range of search engines and databases generally available, and those available to the company. They will be required to demonstrate flexibility, critical thinking and the ability to identify relevant lines of inquiry.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Preparation of client deliverables via oversight of the desktop research;Contribute to briefings for external resources, such as sub contractors;Maintenance of case deadlines, and verbal and/or written updates to the Client, to ensure the timely reporting of client deliverables;Involvement in overall case project management and administration;Support research and drafting of project proposals and broader business development initiatives;Contribute to identifying and developing resources useful for investigative research; and,Consult with and take direction from case managers and clients on project status, timing, and deliverables.

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

What You Will Need To Succeed

The successful candidate will be an analytically minded researcher with excellent writing skills and a strong work ethic. They must have experience working in a commercial environment. They will be a self-starter who takes initiative in their approach to work and a team player who is able to easily engage with management, other consultants, and clients. A skilled communicator, they will be able to convey complex ideas clearly and nimbly articulate their findings to internal and external audiences. They must exhibit an inquisitive mindset and the ability to think laterally about complex problems. This role is well-suited for a young professional who is enthusiastic about the sector and is eager to hone their research skills and grow their project management skills with the view to establish their career in the business intelligence industry.

As a Consultant in the Business Intelligence team, you will have the opportunity to work on cross-segment projects with other teams within Forensic and Litigation Consulting, such as Forensic Accounting Advisory Services, Financial Services, and Data and Analytics, as well as other practices within FTI Consulting, such as Strategic Communications, Economic and Financial Consulting, and Technology.

Basic Qualifications

Consultants should have at least one year of experience of conducting business intelligence and investigations.Demonstrated track record as an analyst on a range of projects, including pre-transactional due diligence, asset traces and fraud investigationsKnowledge of relevant research tools and databasesProven commercial writing style and analytical skillsExcellent written and oral English-language communication skills and knowledge of additional foreign languagesAbility to reliably meet deadlines and manage time sensitive matters.A sound understanding of legal, financial, AML, KYC and anti-bribery principles, as well as an interest in international affairs

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Italian, Polish, Russian, Swedish, Turkish or Arabic would be an advantageExperience living or working abroad is desirableExperience of using i2 mapping software is desirable 

FTI Consulting is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

Better content. Better products. And better careers.  

 

Working in Tech, Product or Data at Sky is about building the next and the new. From broadband to broadcast, streaming to mobile, Sky Stream to Sky Glass, we never stand still. We optimise and innovate. We turn big ideas into the products, content and services millions of people love. And we do it all right here at Sky. 

Role/Team overview 

Our Tech Strategy & Business Ops Planning team is an integral part of the Global Streaming Technology organisation which delivers market leading products and capabilities across Sky Group. We are looking for passionate, committed individuals to join our team and opportunity abounds for the right candidates!

As a Planning Analyst within the Tech Strategy & Business Operations team, you will play a key role in driving operational excellence and strategic insight across our technology portfolio. You will work closely with Finance, Portfolio Delivery, and Development teams to ensure accurate forecasting, resource tracking, and data-driven decision-making. We’re on the hunt for someone who’s not just great with data, but thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and always looking for smarter ways to work. If you're a natural problem solver with a passion for making things better, we’d love to hear from you!

Benefits and perks

We've adopted a hybrid working approach to give more flexibility on where and how we work. The hybrid working expectations for this role are 2 days in the office per week. 

 

Your office base

rows.title: Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.



Job Description

Working within the Rights & Revenue Protection (RRP) team, the Intelligence Analyst will support investigations relating to the protection of Sportradar's intellectual property and revenue recovery activities across Europe and North America. 

The role focuses on identifying and assessing threats to Sportradar's content, data and commercial interests, including unauthorised data usage, piracy and intellectual property infringement. Using a range of open-source, cyber and commercial data sources, the analyst will deliver intelligence that supports enforcement activity, commercial outcomes and strategic decision-making. 

The position requires a motivated intelligence professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and supports stakeholders across the wider Sportradar Group.

THE CHALLENGE 

Conduct intelligence investigations using an all-source approach across rights protection, enforcement and revenue recovery matters. Collect, analyse and evaluate intelligence from open-source, cyber and commercial sources. Conduct OSINT and CYBINT/DNINT investigations to produce actionable intelligence and recommendations. Identify and investigate unauthorised use of Sportradar data, content and intellectual property. Develop and maintain intelligence holdings relating to organisations, individuals and platforms operating across Europe and North America. Monitor emerging risks and trends relevant to intellectual property protection, piracy, sports betting and revenue recovery. Produce intelligence reports, analytical assessments and stakeholder briefings. Support enforcement and commercial recovery initiatives through intelligence development and research. Work closely across multiple Sportradar functions and departments to protect and enhance Sportradar business operations, including internal and external training and education on sports integrity. ABOUT YOU

2+ years' experience in intelligence, investigations, law enforcement, journalism, cyber security, financial crime, fraud, due diligence or a related analytical field. Experience conducting analytical investigations and producing intelligence-led outputs. Demonstrable expertise in OSINT, HUMINT, CYBINT/DNINT or comparable intelligence methodologies. Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to collect, evaluate and interpret information from multiple sources and produce actionable intelligence. Knowledge of online ecosystems, digital platforms and investigative research techniques. Awareness of data protection legislation and associated implications. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professionalism.Ability to manage changing priorities and work effectively under pressure and to tight deadlines.Fluency in English essential, professional working proficiency in French or another living language strongly preferred. Advantageous 

Experience using intelligence analysis tools such as i2 Analyst's Notebook, Maltego or similar. Knowledge of the international sports betting, gaming, media or anti-piracy landscapes. Professional networks or regional knowledge across Europe and/or North America. Experience conducting investigations relating to intellectual property infringement, brand protection, digital piracy or revenue recovery. Understanding of corporate structures, beneficial ownership research and due diligence methodologies. Experience working with commercial intelligence databases and specialist investigative tools. Relevant intelligence, investigation or analytical certifications. OUR OFFER:

A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours.While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together.

OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 

Initial Screening: A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Hiring Team Interview: Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Assessment: Investigative task to showcase your technical skills. Final Steps: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! 

Additional Information

At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

Job Description:
This is a Research Analyst position to join the Asia-Pacific team as part of the Night Shift team that covers Australia and New Zealand.
Research Analysts are the core of the Chambers research process. Through effective interview techniques they gather feedback on the legal market from clients and lawyers. The role involves the close analysis of interviews and submissions to develop an accurate ranking table as a result of this research.
This role will require night shift work for a total period of 12 weeks out of 52, during the Spring/Summer (typically April-July), as well as early mornings during the rest of the Asia-Pacific cycle (Feb-Aug). Work is carried out in three 4-week night shift periods. You will receive additional compensation during night-shift and early-morning blocks.
This is a hybrid role with the expectation of being office-based two days per week (London) and working the rest of the week from home. During the seasonal evening shifts you can be fully home-based.
Key Responsibilities:
Background research to understand their assigned practice areas and jurisdictions.With the support of the Research Manager, determining which lawyers to contact for interview.Conducting probing interviews with lawyers, asking open-ended questions.Interviewing in-house counsel and other third-party experts by telephone or via an online questionnaire.Accurately logging communications and continually assessing progression of their research.Pursuing research leads gained via materials provided by the Chambers team, or through their own research.Building an understanding of, and relationships with, the key market participants.Analysing the data collected during the research phase to create accurate and impartial ranking tables that reflect the market.Producing an informative, business-focused editorial for the Chambers website and our guides.
Why You Should Apply:
Develop core research, analysis and editorial skills within a global, market-leading organisationGain direct exposure to senior legal professionals across international marketsBuild confidence conducting interviews and producing clear, concise written outputClear internal progression path - our Research team exclusively promotes from within
Skills and Experience:
Excellent communication skills (verbal & written)Degree educated with an interest or experience in conducting research and analysis across the APAC regionComfortable speaking on the phone to people from varying backgroundsStrong writing skills, particularly the ability to write clearly and conciselyHigh attention to detail.Organised and methodical.Demonstrates the ability to meet set deadlines.Intellectually curious
About us:
Chambers and Partners is the world’s leading legal rankings and insights intelligence company.For over 30 years, Chambers has differentiated the very best legal talent by identifying and ranking law firms and lawyers globally.
The Chambers’ research methodology is unrivalled in accuracy, depth and quality, delivering indispensable data insights based on rankings that truly reflect ability and talent.
Over the past 12 months, Chambers has embarked on a business transformation project, with the goal of building on its reputation as the gold standard in legal rankings and directories to develop a world class range of digital products and data analytics services.
Our Purpose is to differentiate the best legal talent for when it really matters. Our Mission is to independently research the global legal market, to champion exceptional talent and deliver indispensable insights. And our Vision? is a world where important legal matters are always addressed with the best intelligence and professional expertise, wherever it exists.
We continue to invest and innovate to deliver data-led platforms, enabling law firms to provide the right services and in-house counsel to partner with the right firms.
Equal Opportunity Statement:
Chambers is the leading legal data and intelligence partner for lawyers, firms, and in-house teams.
We conduct over 350,000 research interviews and surveys with in-house counsel every year, and receive 62,000 submissions from 9,000 firms worldwide, giving us unrivalled insight into the legal sector.
This research powers Chambers Rankings - the definitive guide to the best legal talent - and our Intelligence, which delivers the insights helping firms and in-house teams to succeed.
Our independent, rigorous research identifies the exceptional and charts the path to success, enabling legal professionals to see with clarity, decide with confidence, and plan with ambition.

Business Unit:

Financial And Valuation Advisory

Industry:

Portfolio Valuation

Overview

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.

Financial and Valuation Advisory

Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.

 Structured Products Group

The Structured Products Group resides within Houlihan Lokey’s Financial and Valuation Advisory division. We value instruments from the full universe of structured credit products, including: large portfolios of mortgages, capital relief trades, CLOs, ABS, and bespoke transactions. Our clients are among the largest banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and insurers in the world.

A solid academic grounding, high attention to detail, and the ability to reason from first principles are essential. In addition to performing valuation analysis, our London team is encouraged to build and maintain technology underpinning the various processes that make up much of our work flow (pricing models, cashflow engines, data infrastructure, dashboarding, etc.), in order to increase efficiency while maintaining the highest levels of accuracy and transparency. The instruments we deal in are complex and we often work towards tight deadlines, particularly around busier times of the financial cycle.

Role

Learn structured credit from first principles, and how different levers drive outcomes.Build and refine the data sets and valuation algorithms used to price thousands of securities daily.Analyse client portfolios of structured credit securities.Model bespoke transactions in Excel, Python, and our in-house cashflow modelling tool.Identify and automate process bottlenecks.Handle client queries, engagement, and run product demonstrations.

Candidate Requirements

Must be a 2026 GraduateA strong record in a numerate or hard-science discipline.Curiosity about how financial markets work.Self-directed, comfortable thinking from first principles, and able to operate in a small, demanding team in a highly collegiate environment.

Useful, But Not Required

We do not require prior finance, modelling, or programming experience. However if you have a background applying Excel, Python, or C# to creatively solve problems, we encourage you to mention it in your application.

Interview process

After you apply, you should hear back from us within two weeks if we intend to progress your application. The process below is indicative; stages may shift depending on availability of our team.

Round 1: Remote. You will receive a short Excel task involving a structured finance deal scenario. No finance background is required. You will have 48 hours to return it, though we expect it to only take a couple of hours of focused work. You will then have two interviews via Microsoft Teams with senior members of the team, one of which will focus on your approach to the task.

Round 2: In person, Mayfair office. A half-day in our London office, meeting additional team members for a mix of logic-based problem-solving and conversations about your interests and motivations. Reasonable travel costs covered.

Round 3: In person, Mayfair office. A final conversation with senior members of the group covering fit, motivation, and any outstanding questions on either side.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Provide IT Management with clear status, risk and improvement information.Third-Party Coordination: Work with external providers to communicate requirements, coordinate installations, upgrades and maintenance, monitor delivery and support timely issue resolution.Solution Validation: Review prototypes, internal solutions and AI-assisted outputs against agreed requirements, expected behaviours and applicable technical and control standards. rows.title: Construction Data & Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

When you join Hines, you will embark on a career journey fueled by vision and guided by leaders who set the standards of our industry. Responsibilities

The Construction Data & Research Analyst will report to Tim Gates (Director - Preconstruction) and will be a member of the Conceptual Construction Group, supporting the European Region and our investors. The Construction and Data Research Analyst will work closely with the Conceptual Construction team in Europe, Asia and Americas. The role will also be a critical link with the wider European Country Teams acquiring, assimilating, managing data to provide insights to support our development projects from pre-investment through to the completion and operation of the project.

The Construction Data & Research Analyst will be responsible for developing and maintaining structured data that includes construction costs, soft costs, scheduling (programme) information, lessons learnt and key project summary data which will be sourced from all projects. The Construction Data and Research Analyst will support the Conceptual Construction team in using and developing analytical tools to interpret the data and produce forecasted project costs and programmes to inform future strategic investment decisions. The role will include the tracking of key industry factors such as inflation and construction material costs across the European region.

The Construction Data & Research Analyst will support the wider Conceptual Construction team with maintaining records of key building performance data as well as cost.

Drive data collection of construction information from all projects across Europe. There will be a large portfolio of projects that require attention at any given time.Develop a set of consistent definitions, coding and structure for collected construction data across all projects.In conjunction with the wider Conceptual Construction team develop a list of key metrics and critical data required for European projects.Develop and implement tools to utilize historic construction cost and schedule data for forward projections.Attend project meetings with the Conceptual Construction team to understand projects and lead construction data collection, management and processing.Provide knowledge insights and relevant data to the relevant Conceptual Construction project leader.Provide all data and benchmark details available specifically related to each project and assist the Conceptual Construction team to ensure that projected schedules are attainable, and costs are accurate.Assist with the standardization / consistency of budget formats on all projects allowing the data to be utilized in financial modelling and for a 2-way communication process to be established with investment teams.Support some and lead some specific topics in design meetings as needed to determine the progress of each project and areas that require attention.Willingness to travel to our European locations, as required, and exceptionally to Houston, USA

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

Project experience in development projects design, procurement and construction process.Degree qualification required in a relevant Engineering or Construction related field.A master’s qualification in a related discipline may be seen as beneficial.Possess or working towards a formal industry qualification, such as RICS or similar may be seen as beneficial.The candidate must have strong curiosity and interest in data and data analytics and specifically an interest in construction cost data & schedule information.Computer literacy is essential for this role. A working knowledge of programs and tools such as, PowerBI, common data environments (CDE’s) and a strong curiosity with the application of AI is essential.Analytical skills are essential, combined with good communication skills, both oral and written.A solid understanding of the preconstruction process will be an added plus for this position.Strong emotional intelligence including diplomacy and influencing skills is essential to successfully communicate effectivelyA person who has the highest ethics and a strong work ethic.The successful candidate must have dedication to, and enjoyment of, the position and a thorough understanding of the complexity of the tasks that must be performed.Be a proactive, strategic and critical thinker, a thought leader.Knowledge of European languages, as well as English, is an advantage.

 Closing 

At Hines, we strive for excellence as a leading global real estate investment manager, driven by our by our belief that real estate is fundamentally about people. Our diverse portfolio spans $93.2 billion¹ of assets across such property types as living, office, retail, mixed-use, logistics and life science projects – all designed to enhance value, connection and inspiration. Our strategic approach integrates local expertise with global knowledge, taking calculated risks aligned with our convictions to exceed expectations and tailor solutions to our clients' needs.

While our projects are renowned for enhancing cities and pioneering sustainable practices, we recognize that the true driving force behind Hines' success is our 5,000 dedicated employees in 30 countries who draw on our 65-year history to build the world forward. This is why we prioritize investing in our people, offering comprehensive training, competitive compensation, robust benefits and generous vacation packages. By centering our focus on the growth and wellbeing of our team, we cultivate an inclusive environment where everyone, including our clients, can thrive.

Hines is proud to be named to Fast Company’s prestigious annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2024. ¹Includes both the global Hines organization and RIA AUM as of December 31, 2023.

We are an equal opportunity employer and support workforce diversity.

rows.title: Research Analyst - Later Hours
