Job Description

Goldman Sachs Marketing

Led by the firm’s first Chief Marketing Officer, the marketing function at Goldman Sachs is backed by momentum and a broad imperative to unify the discipline, helping to codify a business-critical function seen as core to the firm’s future growth. As such, GS is focused on building out a data-and-technology enabled team of growth marketers, delivering value for the brand and the business. The organization will consist of a number of key COE roles in areas such as Brand, Media, and Marketing Strategy, as well as marketing leads for each of our revenue divisions. Together, this team will collaborate to build a unified, scalable, and consistent approach to marketing the brand and its offerings. Our mission is to be a demonstrable force multiplier for the businesses we serve.

Within the Global Marketing function but aligned to the Global Banking and Markets division, sits the Transaction Banking marketing team, responsible for end-to-end marketing strategies and programs for the entirety of the division. Working across the core elements of the franchise -- the team leads messaging strategy, content creation, client engagement strategy, digital marketing, and marketing analytics.

TRANSACTION BANKING (TxB)

We aim to build a modern and digital-first transaction banking solution to serve our clients. Our business combines the strength, heritage, and expertise of a 150-year-old firm with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a tech start-up. Our goal is to provide a best-in-class digital product that helps clients to succeed by giving them a holistic view of their business. Through the use of modern technology built on the cloud, we are the alternative to legacy platforms. We’re a team of diverse experts helping our clients to build the future of their Treasury.

Job Summary And Responsibilities

We are looking for an intellectually ambitious, driven, entrepreneurial Associate to support the Transaction Banking marketing team. They will partner across the divisional marketing team, product and coverage teams to develop and execute content creation, digital marketing, conferences and events, paid media, social media, analytics, and design to support the commercial objectives of the business.

Responsibilities

This person will also help develop content ideas and distribution strategies to drive engagement with clients and prospective clients. This person will also have a hand in measurement and analytics as we translate our team’s work into commercial impact for key stakeholders. The position also involves project management, budget management, production oversight, regulatory compliance, stakeholder management. Responsibilities include:

Work closely with product and coverage teams to develop and execute bespoke marketing content around TxB products Lead and project manage external agencies for the end-to-end creation, design, and amplification of key marketing assets. rows.title: Senior VMware Virtualization Support Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

CGI is seeking a Senior VMware Virtualization Support Engineer who will be a key member of the Americas Infrastructure Virtualization team, providing advanced operational support, platform maintenance, incident management, and continuous improvement for the enterprise VMware virtualization environment.

The role supports a highly available, business-critical virtualization platform currently based on VMware Cloud Foundation 8 (VCF 8) and will actively participate in the planned migration and transition to VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9).

Working as part of a regional and global infrastructure support organization, the engineer is responsible for maintaining platform stability, availability, performance, security, and operational readiness. The position provides Tier 2/3 technical support, participates in the 24×7×365 on-call rotation, troubleshoots complex infrastructure incidents, performs lifecycle and patching activities, and contributes to automation and AI-enabled operational improvements.

The environment includes VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere, NSX-T, vSAN, Aria Operations, vRealize Log Insight (VRLI), vRealize Network Insight (VRNI), and associated enterprise storage and networking technologies.

This position is located in the New York, NY or Jersey City area (Hybrid)

Your future duties and responsibilities

Platform Support & Maintenance

 Provide Tier 2/3 operational support for the VMware virtualization platform as part of the Americas Infrastructure Virtualization team. Maintain the existing VCF 8 environment and participate in the planning, testing, migration, and operational transition to VCF 9. Support and maintain VMware technologies including vSphere, NSX-T, vSAN, Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI. Perform routine platform health checks, troubleshooting, maintenance, configuration changes, and lifecycle management activities. Monitor platform availability, capacity, performance, and infrastructure health to ensure services meet established SLAs. Work within established architecture, engineering, security, and operational standards.

Incident & Problem Management

 Respond to production incidents and service requests involving VMware virtualization infrastructure. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for compute, storage, networking, performance, and availability issues. Participate in major incident management and collaborate with application, network, storage, security, and other infrastructure teams to restore services. Document incidents, root causes, corrective actions, known errors, and operational procedures. Identify recurring incidents and contribute to problem-management initiatives designed to eliminate or reduce repeat failures. Escalate complex product issues to VMware/Broadcom and other technology vendors as required.

VCF 8 to VCF 9 Migration

 Participate as a technical member of the team responsible for migrating the existing VCF 8 platform to VCF 9. Support readiness assessments, compatibility reviews, upgrade planning, testing, implementation, and post-migration validation. Assist with migration activities while minimizing service disruption and maintaining compliance with enterprise security standards. Validate platform health, application connectivity, performance, monitoring, backup, and operational processes following migration activities. Develop and update operational documentation and support procedures for the VCF 9 environment.

Monitoring & Capacity Management

 Configure, maintain, and tune monitoring thresholds, alarms, dashboards, and reporting within Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI. Perform proactive monitoring to identify capacity, availability, latency, and performance issues before they impact production services. Review infrastructure utilization and recommend VM rightsizing and capacity optimization opportunities. Support capacity planning across compute, memory, storage, and network resources. Participate in the implementation of anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and intelligent capacity-management capabilities.

Automation & Operational Improvement

 Develop and maintain automation using PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, and VMware APIs. Automate repetitive operational activities including health checks, provisioning, patching, reporting, configuration validation, and lifecycle management. Maintain and improve automated operational runbooks and remediation procedures. Contribute to self-healing capabilities for well-understood infrastructure events where automated remediation can be implemented safely. Explore and implement practical AI-assisted operations capabilities, including incident triage, alert correlation, log analysis, knowledge retrieval, and root cause analysis. Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve platform reliability and support efficiency.

Change, Release & Lifecycle Management

 Participate in change and release management activities for the VMware virtualization environment. Perform VMware software upgrades, firmware updates, security patches, and infrastructure maintenance through approved change processes. Develop implementation, validation, rollback, and recovery procedures for infrastructure changes. Ensure changes comply with enterprise standards, security requirements, and VMware recommended practices. Participate in maintenance windows and after-hours implementation activities when required.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

 Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution for workloads hosted on the virtualization platform. Participate in scheduled DR exercises and document results, issues, and remediation actions. Support platform capabilities required to meet established business RPO and RTO requirements, including critical workload targets of RPO ≤ 5 seconds and RTO ≤ 15 minutes, where applicable. Maintain operational documentation and recovery procedures required to support business continuity.

Operational Support

 Participate in the 24×7 on-call support rotation for production virtualization services. Perform morning and end-of-day platform health checks using dashboards, monitoring platforms, and automated scripts. Investigate infrastructure alerts and take appropriate corrective or escalation actions. Support OS, hypervisor, firmware, storage, and VMware platform patching activities. Maintain accurate support documentation, knowledge articles, troubleshooting procedures, and operational runbooks. Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to other members of the infrastructure support team.

Collaboration & Service Management

 Work closely with application owners and infrastructure teams to understand requirements and support the delivery of standardized virtual infrastructure services. Collaborate with networking, storage, security, backup, cloud, and hardware teams to troubleshoot cross-platform issues. Coordinate with VMware/Broadcom and other technology vendors for technical support, product defects, upgrades, and complex incidents. Work with regional and global IT teams to maintain consistent platform standards and operational processes. Support the virtualization service catalogue and provide input into service consumption, capacity, cost, and performance reviews.

Reporting & Governance

 Provide operational reporting covering platform availability, incidents, capacity, performance, SLA compliance, patching, and infrastructure health. Contribute to dashboards and metrics used by infrastructure management to evaluate service performance. Track automation benefits, operational improvements, capacity savings, and incident trends. Participate in operational reviews, problem-management meetings, change reviews, and service improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

 10+ years of overall IT experience, with significant experience supporting enterprise infrastructure environments. 5–7+ years of hands-on VMware experience supporting large-scale environments using technologies such as vSphere 8+, VMware Cloud Foundation, NSX-T, and vSAN. Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting production VMware environments. Experience participating in VMware platform upgrades or migrations, preferably involving VMware Cloud Foundation. Experience supporting an existing VCF 8 environment and/or migration to VCF 9 is highly desirable. Strong troubleshooting skills across virtualization, compute, storage, networking, and operating-system layers. Strong automation skills using technologies such as PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, and VMware APIs. Hands-on experience with Aria Operations, VRLI, and VRNI or equivalent monitoring, logging, and network-visibility platforms. Solid understanding of enterprise storage technologies, including SAN, NAS, iSCSI, vSAN, and platforms such as Dell/EMC, Isilon, Pure Storage, and NetApp. Strong networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, DNS, load balancing, and NSX-T concepts such as micro-segmentation and distributed firewalls. Experience working within formal incident, problem, change, and release management processes. Understanding of infrastructure security, vulnerability remediation, patching, and VMware security-hardening practices. Experience with AI/AIOps concepts such as anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, alert correlation, automated RCA, and intelligent capacity forecasting is desirable. Experience identifying VM rightsizing, capacity optimization, and infrastructure cost-reduction opportunities. Ability to troubleshoot complex production incidents under time-sensitive conditions. Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with regional and global technical teams. Ability to participate in a 24×7 production support/on-call rotation. Strong organizational skills with experience working in Agile and/or ITIL-based operational environments.

Desired Certifications & Skills

 VMware Certified Professional (VCP) certification. VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Cloud Management and Automation certification. Advanced VMware certification such as VCAP is desirable. ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional. Experience with Aria Operations APIs and custom automation. Experience developing operational dashboards, automated health checks, and infrastructure reporting. Exposure to AIOps, LLM-assisted operations, ChatOps, or automated incident-management solutions is beneficial.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Position Summary

The Associate, Owned Media is a hands-on owned media role responsible for building, QA'ing, deploying, measuring, and optimizing customer-facing batch campaigns across email, SMS, and app push. This is a builder's role at its core — the majority of the work is in the platform, constructing campaigns, assembling content modules, configuring audience and personalization logic, and pressure-testing every element before it reaches a customer.

What differentiates this role is where that build effort is pointed: toward media optimization. Operating in a CDP-enabled environment that is actively introducing new technologies to support AI-driven content decisioning, the associate is responsible for making owned media placements work harder — ensuring the right content appears in the right position, for the right customer, at the right moment. Personalization here is practical and placement-driven: it is about content relevance and module-level sequencing within each send, not simply inserting a first name.

The role is focused exclusively on delivering personalized batch communications — including promotional, campaign-driven, and calendar-based email, SMS, and app push messages. It requires hands-on build experience, strong operational discipline, attention to detail, analytical thinking, campaign QA rigor, and the ability to connect customer data, audience logic, content placement, and channel execution to drive engagement, retention, spend per customer, and long-term value. High-quality execution is the foundation; optimization is the outcome.

Great brands reflect culture. The best ones help shape it. At Foot Locker, we’re rooted in sport, powered by style, and driven by the communities that move both. From Foot Locker and Kids Foot Locker to Champs Sports, WSS, and atmos, our brands sit at the intersection of sport, style, and self-expression.

As part of the DICK’S Sporting Goods family, you’re backed by the resources, reach, and career opportunities of a world-class sports company. That unleashes Foot Locker to keep pushing forward with the agility and edge that define the brand. We’re looking for great people who want to influence culture and the generation that is shaping what’s next.

Whether you’re building strategy, shaping innovations, or creating unforgettable customer moments, you’ll contribute to decisions and experiences that define our brands’ impact in the communities we serve.

Come change the game with us. Apply today!

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Hands-On Batch Campaign Build & Execution

Serve as a primary builder — hands-on-keyboard in campaign platforms to construct, QA, schedule, deploy, and support batch campaigns across email, SMS, and app push.Translate campaign briefs, marketing calendars, audience requirements, creative assets, CDP/platform inputs, and stakeholder direction into accurate batch deliverables.Assemble templates, modules, and content blocks with deliberate attention to placement, hierarchy, and sequencing — building sends so that the most relevant content occupies the highest-value real estate for each audience.Coordinate execution across campaigns, and customer segments — managing timelines, dependencies, approvals, asset intake, and deployment readiness.Partner with CRM, lifecycle, eCommerce, brand, creative, analytics, marketing technology, mobile/app, legal/compliance, and platform/vendor teams.


CDP, Audience & Segmentation Support

This position from time to time will play a support role in segmentation, supporting audience creation, segmentation, targeting, and validation with CRM strategy, analytics, CDP, and marketing technology stakeholders.Define, document, and QA audience logic across segments including acquisition, active, lapsing, lapsed, reactivated, loyalty/member, high-value, and behavior-based groups.Validate suppressions, exclusions, consent requirements, personalization rules, and targeting logic to ensure the right message — and the right content within that message — reaches the right customer through the right channel.


Campaign QA & Customer Experience

Own cross-channel QA including links, images, copy, subject lines, preheaders, SMS character limits, push copy, personalization, dynamic and AI-selected content, audience logic, tracking, rendering, send timing, quiet hours, and compliance language.Identify and resolve campaign risks — content inconsistencies, broken links, rendering issues, tracking gaps, targeting concerns, or approval needs — before deployment.Maintain high standards for accuracy, customer experience, and brand presentation across all owned media channels.


Personalization, Content Placement & AI Decisioning

Drive personalization through relevant content placement — determining which offers, products, categories, and creative modules appear for which audiences, and in what order, to maximize the value of every placement in a send.Build and maintain the dynamic content, rules, and variable logic that power personalized placements at scale, so that a single batch send delivers meaningfully different experiences across segments.Maintain operational understanding of how decisioning rules, content libraries, eligibility criteria, and fallback/default content behave, and QA AI-generated or AI-selected content for accuracy, brand alignment, and compliance before deployment.Document configurations, test cases, and execution standards for new tools, and help translate vendor and platform capabilities into repeatable operational processes.Partner with marketing technology, data, analytics, and vendor teams to troubleshoot issues, validate outputs, and improve decisioning performance over time.


Testing, Measurement & Optimization

Execute A/B and multivariate tests across batch campaigns and channels — including content placement, module ordering, offer relevance, and decisioning tests — covering setup, QA, monitoring, and documentation.Treat each send as media inventory to be optimized — analyzing placement-level and module-level performance to understand what content earns engagement, and applying those learnings to future builds.Partner with analytics and strategy teams to translate insights into future optimizations and close the feedback loop between planning, execution, and outcomes.


Compliance, Governance & Best Practices

Ensure campaigns follow legal, compliance, privacy, brand, and data protection guidelines across email, SMS, and push.Maintain working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, TCPA, SMS consent, opt-out handling, quiet hours, state-by-state requirements, and applicable privacy standards.Promote repeatable execution standards, process documentation, and scalable cross-channel operations.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate across Owned Media, Brand, eCommerce, CRM Strategy, Loyalty, Analytics, Creative, Marketing Technology, Mobile/App, Legal/Compliance, and vendor partners.Communicate clearly on campaign status, risks, QA findings, approval needs, and performance insights.Act as a bridge between strategy, data, technology, creative, and execution.


Qualifications

Qualifications

2-3 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, email, SMS/push marketing, campaign operations, or a related digital marketing role.Demonstrated hands-on build experience — personally constructing, QA'ing, and deploying campaigns at volume across one or more owned media channels.Familiarity with email/SMS/push platforms, CRM tools, CDPs, campaign management systems, and emerging AI/content decisioning technologies.Experience with segmentation, audience targeting, dynamic content, content placement and personalization logic, or AI-assisted content decisioning tools preferred.Understanding of owned media KPIs: delivered volume, open/click rate, conversion, revenue, engagement, opt-outs, and customer value metrics.Familiarity with A/B testing, campaign reporting, and translating results into recommendations.A media optimization mindset — the instinct to treat owned channels as inventory, to question why a placement underperformed, and to pair that curiosity with disciplined, error-free execution.Knowledge of compliance and privacy concepts: CAN-SPAM, TCPA, consent, suppressions, GDPR, and data handling best practices.Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, analytical mindset, and communication skills.Collaborative, curious, customer-focused, and comfortable in cross-functional environments.Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; retail, eCommerce, DTC, or omnichannel experience preferred.Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, or related field preferred.

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

As a Content marketer at Watershed, you'll own the brand and educational content that show how our platform drives climate outcomes for customers—including through longform content for demand generation, webinar programming, and short-form content for awareness. You'll work closely with our Head of Content Strategy to plan, produce, and distribute content across formats, and you'll run the operational side of content: a tracking system and reporting practice that keeps the team's output on schedule and visible.

You will:

Write longform demand-gen content based on interviews with internal experts and customers, webinar recordings, and internal documentation like policy guidesOwn social content and strategy: Write posts and create multi-media assets for Linkedin that highlights Watershed's work, customers, and team, including developing an employee activation strategy for LinkedInWrite content optimized for search through SEO and AEOWrite all supporting copy to promote core assets across key channelsRepurpose longform and case study content into short-form social and blog postsBuild and maintain a content tracking system covering customer stories, social, longform gated assets, and blog posts, reviewed weekly with the Head of Content StrategyTrack and report on content performance with the Head of Content StrategyCreate and edit multimedia content, primarily audio and video

In any given month, the types of projects you'll work on may include:

Developing a longform piece built for demand genWriting copy for an interactive web assetCreating a batch of social posts in a variety of formats repurposed from source contentUpdating the content tracker on a weekly basis or giving a performance readout on content performanceWriting interview questions for a panel discussion on a webinar

You might be a fit if you have:

Experience creating and maintaining a social presence for a B2B companyStrong longform and shortform writing skills, with experience translating interviews, webinar recordings, or technical documentation into demand-gen contentBasic video and audio editing skillsExperience repurposing longform content into social and blog formatsComfort owning a content calendar or tracking system and reporting on its performanceProject management skills to coordinate interviews and reviews across multiple stakeholders—subject matter experts., customers, and leadershipComfort responsibly using artificial intelligence in your workflows, with an interest in learning and building agentic workflows to support content productionWhile not required for this role, experience with sustainability is a plus

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

rows.title: Development Coordinator/Manager

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Harlem Grown is an independent, 501(c)(3) non-profit organization whose mission is to inspire youth to lead healthy and ambitious lives through mentorship and hands-on education in urban farming, sustainability and nutrition. We operate local urban farms, increase access to and knowledge of healthy food for Harlem residents, and provide farm-based development programs to Harlem youth.

Founded in 2011 by Tony Hillery with one school partnership, one urban farm and an idea to help Harlem children, today Harlem Grown’s farms and greenhouses are used as classrooms and as venues to cultivate a connection to the environment and food among young people. Harlem Grown operates 14 urban agricultural sites featuring soil-based urban farms, hydroponic greenhouses, and a mushroom chamber. All of our sites are located between 122nd and 152nd Streets in Central Harlem, Manhattan.

 Our Programs 

Harlem Grown cultivates deep community roots by growing fresh food, strong youth, and lasting relationships. We meet children where they live, learn, and grow—offering opportunities that extend beyond our farms to the classroom and into their futures. Through Food and Farm Education, we help youth build healthy habits, leadership skills, and a deeper connection to their community. Our urban farms provide free produce and nutritious meals for families while creating joyful spaces for connection and support. Through 14 urban farms and year-round programming, we provide free produce, nutritious meals, and cooking lessons while creating joyful spaces for connection and support. In addition, our programs increase economic opportunity for families and develop leadership and advocacy skills so participants can drive transformational change in their communities.

At Harlem Grown, we grow healthy children and communities through hands-on education, access to resources, and long-term youth support. Our Food and Farm Education —including summer camp, in-school and after-school programs, mobile education, service learning, and farm tours—delivers farm-based lessons to children in our community. We offer free community resources like farmstands, Saturdays on the farm, and events that provide fresh food and create spaces for support and connection. Through academic support, internships, and career readiness programs, we help our young people build confidence and skills to thrive from elementary school through adulthood.

 Modality:  On-site

 Position type:  Full-time

We are currently hiring for multiple positions. Position level and placement will be determined based on each candidate's qualifications, experience, and overall fit for the organization.*

Position Summary

Harlem Grown seeks an organized and strategic Development Coordinator/ Manager to support fundraising efforts across the full donor lifecycle — from donor relations, donor engagement, and corporate benefits delivery, to gift processing and acknowledgement, donor data management, and donor qualification. The Coordinator/ Manager provides the donors in Harlem Grown's community with an exceptional experience that inspires continued and growing support of our mission, while also ensuring accurate, timely, and well-documented operational processes in close collaboration with finance and operations staff. Collaborative and strategic, the Coordinator/ Manager makes the highest and best use of organizational resources, continually building efficiency in processes, and is responsive to the needs of leadership and frontline fundraisers.

Key Responsibilities

 Donor Relations & Engagement 

 Answer incoming donor inquiries, via phone and email, providing exceptional 'customer service'.  Develop, document, and continually enhance systems and procedures related to donor relations and engagement.  Maintain the department's donor engagement plan and calendar through collaboration with colleagues across the department.  Project-manage implementation of the donor engagement plan, making highest and best use of the team's time and resources.  Coordinate experiences in the donor engagement plan, such as: site visits, cultivation events, impact reports, and special mailings.  Maintain and manage the organization’s grant calendar.  Other duties as assigned. 

 Marketing Assistance 

 Maintain the social media and marketing calendar.  Implement the social media strategy overseeing storytelling.  Design marketing collateral for donor engagement opportunities.  Other duties as assigned. 

 Corporate Benefits Delivery 

 Maintain up-to-date corporate benefits and sponsorship packages.  Project-manage fulfillment of corporate benefits and sponsorship packages and maintain the corporate benefits delivery calendar, making highest and best use of the team's time and resources.  Coordinate experiences for corporate partners, such as site visits, cultivation events, volunteer days, and lunch & learns.  Develop, document, and continually enhance systems and procedures related to corporate benefits delivery.  Other duties as assigned. 

 Gift Processing & Acknowledgement 

 Process all donations accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner.  Provide all donors with timely, accurate gift/tax acknowledgements and update communications on a regular cadence.  Coordinate special acknowledgement of gifts by leadership, frontline fundraisers, and/or volunteers.  In collaboration with finance, develop, document, and continually enhance systems and procedures for gift processing and acknowledgement.  Coordinate with key members of the Development and Finance Team to handle complex gifts (e.g., pledges and restricted gifts) and manage budgets for grants.  Other duties as assigned. 

 CRM Management 

 Serve as primary administrator for the Fundraising app in Salesforce, Harlem Grown's CRM.  Develop, document, and continually enhance systems and procedures for Salesforce.  Oversee data clean-up processes and projects that enhance data integrity.  In collaboration with leadership and frontline fundraisers, continually evolve the CRM 'playbook' to ensure that all team members can manage portfolios effectively in Salesforce.  Train fundraisers on how to use Salesforce for portfolio management, in accordance with the 'playbook'.  Develop and continually refine reports at the direction of leadership.  Maintain expertise in all software platforms used by the department, contributing to continual optimization and integration.  Other duties as assigned. 

 Lead Generation 

 Develop, document, and continually enhance systems and procedures for lead generation, including: regular data screenings and analyses, donor segmentation, and donor qualification/research.  Conduct routine data screening, analysis, and segmentation in Salesforce.  Surface high-potential donors/prospective donors for frontline fundraisers to engage. Job Title: Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator

Location: New York

Company: BritBox International

Reporting to: Senior Manager, Lifecycle Marketing

Contract Type: Full Time

About Us

BBC Studios’ Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) business brings premium content directly to North American audiences through two distinctive streaming brands: BritBox and BBC Select.

BritBox, the ultimate streaming destination for British TV. We offer an unparalleled collection of thoughtfully curated entertainment—cleverly crafted and full of the charm, wit, and heart that define British storytelling.

Born from the BBC, our mission is to bring authentic British stories to our audiences. Launched in 2017, we are a small but mighty streamer that punches above our weight—available on every major platform and even featured among the bright lights of Times Square—and we’re just getting started.

BBC Select is a documentary streaming service that has been successfully operating since February 2021. It has established itself as the third-largest documentary streaming service in the US. With plans to expand through original commissions, territorial premieres, and new distribution platforms, BBC Select continues to serve a highly engaged audience that values educational, high-quality content. The integration of BBC Select into the DTC organization presents a strong opportunity to leverage shared capabilities, insights, and expertise to accelerate growth and enhance overall customer experience.

If you’re passionate about entertainment, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to play a meaningful role in our growth journey, this is your opportunity to be part of a dynamic Direct-to-Consumer business within BBC Studios, bringing the very best of British TV to fans everywhere.

Job Purpose

You’ll work on all parts of lifecycle operations, encompassing email, push, pre-roll and more: managing the lifecycle calendar to optimal contact frequency, preparing email templates that hero our shows, segmenting to the right audience, continually applying best practices and suggesting new tests and optimizations to run, and assisting with regular reporting on lifecycle initiatives.

The right person for this role is very comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, able to multi-task and prioritize while maintaining an obsessive level of attention to detail.

S/he should have a strong understanding of direct marketing techniques such as email or push, knowing how to maintain healthy deliverability, what tactics will boost engagement, and an innate desire to deep-dive into everything from lifecycle journey building, to personalization engines to sophisticated user segmentation.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

Related Companies is seeking a Network Engineer I to join the Hudson Yards Infrastructure & Operations team. This is a highly technical, hands-on role responsible for supporting the installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and ongoing operation of the campus-wide Cisco enterprise network, including wired and wireless infrastructure, converged networks, and connected building systems.

Reporting to the Director of Information Technology at Hudson Yards, this role will work closely with senior network engineers, internal technology teams, building operations, external vendors, and system integrators to support the diverse technology platforms operating across the campus.

The Hudson Yards network supports a wide range of critical building systems and services, including Wi-Fi, HVAC and energy management, access control, elevators, life safety systems, turnstiles, and voice services. The Network Engineer I will help ensure these environments remain reliable, secure, and properly integrated while supporting day-to-day operations, troubleshooting efforts, infrastructure upgrades, and future technology initiatives across the campus.

The successful candidate will be proactive, technically curious, highly motivated to learn, and comfortable working in a complex, fast-paced environment.

 Key Responsibilities: 

 Install, configure, maintain, and support Cisco enterprise network equipment, including switches, routers, and wireless infrastructure.  Monitor network availability, performance, and capacity; troubleshoot and resolve connectivity, routing, switching, and wireless issues.  Support Layer 1, Layer 2, and Layer 3 infrastructure, including fiber, copper, VLANs, IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, and spanning tree.  Support enterprise wireless (Cisco/Meraki) and network connectivity for building systems — HVAC, access control, cameras, elevators, life safety, and IoT devices.  Assist with firewall configurations, ACLs, network segmentation, and VPN connectivity in coordination with Cybersecurity.  Maintain accurate network diagrams, documentation, device inventories, and configuration records.  Support network upgrades, migrations, and modernization projects alongside senior engineers, vendors, and system integrators.  Communicate incidents, planned maintenance, and technical issues clearly to internal and external stakeholders. 

Compensation:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. In addition to a competitive base salary, you will be eligible to receive discretionary bonus incentives and a comprehensive benefits package.

Anticipated base salary range: $90,000 - $100,000 / year

Actual base salary within the anticipated range will be determined by several components including, but not limited to, the individual's experience, skills, qualifications, and market factors.

Qualifications

 Key Skills & Background Required 

 1–3 years of experience working in a Cisco environment.  Intermediate knowledge of switching, routing, and wireless technologies (particularly Cisco), including 9K, 7K, and 5K network fabrics.  Working knowledge of networking technologies and methodologies (MPLS, VRF, VPC, etc.).  Knowledge of VoIP/QoS design and deployment.  Intermediate knowledge of Layer 1 infrastructure (fiber, copper, RF).  Experience with Layer 2 and Layer 3 network infrastructure, best practices, and principles.  Knowledge of network cybersecurity best practices for firewalls, firewall configurations, and ACLs.  Proven ability to work effectively with team members and business stakeholders across diverse roles and experience levels.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Strong diagramming and documentation skills.  Strong organizational skills.  Highly developed interpersonal skills.  Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.  Motivated to learn. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 CCNA and/or CompTIA Network+ certification, or similar.  Experience with Cisco and Meraki technologies.  Working knowledge of IoT architecture, security, management, and device integrations.  Experience with EIGRP, HSRP, BGP, VPC, VRF, VLAN tagging, Spanning Tree, WAN, firewalls, and VPN.  Analytics and/or data science skills.  Experience with SolarWinds.  Knowledge of Palo Alto firewalls a plus. 

 Education & Professional Qualifications 

 BS/BA in Computer Science or information Systems Management from an accredited university, or equivalent experience.  Comfortable working in a matrixed environment, with a proactive approach to problem solving.  A creative mind, excellent interpersonal skills, and a sense of humor are a must for this position. 

Benefits:

 Personalized Health Care: Multiple medical, dental, and vision plan options; Employee Assistance Program  Financial Benefits: Competitive salary and incentive packages; matching 401(k); FSAs and HSA; employer-paid life and AD&D insurance; paid leave & disability programs  Social Wellness: 19+ days of PTO; mental health counseling & resources; fertility, surrogacy, and adoption assistance; volunteer days and donation matching  Career Development: Learning & training programs; tuition & certification reimbursement; internal advancement opportunities 

Overview

Formed in 1972, Related is the most prominent privately-owned real estate firm in the United States. Headquartered in New York City, the company has offices and major developments across the world. Related owns and manages a premier portfolio of assets valued at over $100 billion, including the 28-acre Hudson Yards neighborhood on Manhattan’s West Side.

Related believes in investing in its talent and cultivates a positive, team-oriented environment where every voice is valued. Employees are encouraged to boldly take on new challenges, transcend the status quo, and demonstrate strong entrepreneurial spirit. In its relentless commitment to excellence, Related works to foster an innovative approach in its team members so that they can positively impact the communities in which they conduct business. Learn more about Related at  www.related.com .

MADE HMBL Gym is a premier basketball player development facility in Fort Greene, Brooklyn, built in partnership between MADE Hoops and HMBL. If you want to learn what it actually takes to market a brick-and-mortar business from the ground up, this is that opportunity.

Help fill our training sessions and grow the gym's reputation in Brooklyn. rows.title: Membership Strategy Manager
rows.descriptionText:
The Role…

The Membership Strategy Manager is responsible for delivering Soho House’s global membership strategy across a set of key Houses, translating centrally designed frameworks into locally relevant plans that protect and grow membership revenue. Houses and areas of focus are assigned by the Global Membership Strategy Manager and Chief Membership Officer according to what the role’s base geography allows, and may change over time in line with business need.

Reporting to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global), the role takes agreed global strategy — across retention and engagement, intakes and applications, and new House openings — and leads its execution across its assigned Houses in partnership with the Regional Membership Director, House Membership teams and the Soho Support Member Success function.

The role is the strategic link between global strategy and local delivery. It applies global frameworks to the specific conditions of its assigned Houses, manages the data and performance cycle behind each initiative, and feeds on-the-ground insight, barriers and opportunities back into global planning.

The role is responsible for the delivery and success of membership strategy across its assigned Houses. Accountability for regional membership performance sits with the Regional Membership Director and their teams.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery of Global Strategy Across Assigned Houses

Take agreed global membership initiatives and objectives and lead their delivery across its assigned Houses, translating global frameworks into practical local plans with membership and operations teams.Prioritise and sequence global initiatives according to House-level risk, opportunity and operational capacity.Feed on-the-ground insight, local nuance and delivery barriers back into global strategy development.Act as the primary point of contact across its assigned Houses for global membership strategy, ensuring House teams understand what is being asked of them and why.

Retention & Engagement

Deliver its assigned Houses’ contribution to the global membership retention target.Localised: design and run toolboxes that reduce turnover among high-risk member groups across its assigned Houses, tracking and evolving these approaches as performance data emerges.Centralised: drive engagement against the globally defined attrition indicators, closing the gap between local execution and target.Data: manage pre- and post-initiative data for its assigned Houses, adjusting continually with local teams to protect the retention goal.Strengthen onboarding and first-three-year engagement across its assigned Houses, using behavioural insight to intervene at the highest-risk stages of membership.Partner with the Data Team and the Soho Support Member Success function so that proactive intervention is targeted where it delivers the greatest impact across its assigned Houses.

Intakes & Applications

Partner with local teams to track and deliver budgeted intakes for its assigned Houses, de-risking revenue shortfall from missed intake targets.Leverage seasonality and local cultural calendars to maximise application volumes.Execute acquisition strategies that deliver the required Every House mix across its assigned Houses.Run scenario-based local offers, adapting approaches proven elsewhere in the group.Identify emerging risk to intake or revenue early and escalate to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global) with a recommended recovery plan.

New Openings & Hypercare

Apply the global opening framework to pre-opening acquisition and membership success planning for openings within its assigned Houses.Lead membership-side opening implementation and hypercare across its assigned Houses.Partner with pre-opening, marketing and House teams so that application, intake and early engagement targets are met at opening.Capture what worked and what did not at each opening and feed it back into the global opening playbook.

Data, Insight & Performance

Track and report performance across its assigned Houses, spanning onboarding, engagement, retention, renewals, applications and intakes.Translate House-level data into clear, commercially focused recommendations for both local teams and global strategy.Partner with the Data Team on member segmentation and predictive churn models, ensuring local nuance is reflected.Present regional performance and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Partnership & Cross-Functional Working

Partner with the Regional Membership Director, who holds accountability for regional membership performance, to ensure strategy is delivered effectively across its assigned Houses.Work with House Membership teams, Member Relations, Operations, Marketing, Communications and Digital to remove barriers to retention and acquisition across its assigned Houses.Provide clear prioritisation and targeting guidance so House teams can execute global initiatives consistently.Act as escalation point across its assigned Houses for retention performance, cohort risk and engagement challenges.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify and test improvements to member engagement, retention and acquisition across its assigned Houses.Measure effectiveness and hand successful approaches to the Membership Strategy Manager (Global) for scaling across other regions.Champion a culture of continuous improvement within its assigned Houses’ membership teams.

Requirements/ Qualifications

Significant experience in membership strategy, retention, customer success, loyalty or lifecycle marketing within a membership, hospitality or premium customer environment.Proven experience delivering engagement and retention strategies that improve customer or member lifetime value.Experience delivering acquisition as well as retention — intake or sales targets, offer design and funnel management.Experience supporting new site, venue or market openings in a hospitality, retail or membership environment.Experience operating in a matrixed international business, delivering centrally designed strategy through local teams without direct authority over them.Strong analytical capability, with experience using CRM platforms (ideally Salesforce) and customer data to inform decisions.Experience working with behavioural insight, segmentation and predictive models to influence customer engagement.Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into commercially focused recommendations.Proven experience working across multiple business functions and influencing stakeholders at all levels.Strong presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.Highly organised, commercially minded and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.Knowledge of the assigned Houses’ membership landscape and cultural calendar.Confident using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work – e.g. building and interrogating performance reporting, structuring data analysis, and preparing decks and presentations for senior stakeholders.

Why work with us...

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career.

Health Care + 401K: Full time employees are eligible for full benefits; Medical, Dental & Vision as well as Retirement fund with a 2% matchPaid Time Off: Full- Time Employees have sick day's + vacation daysCareer Development: Soho House can progress your career domestically or internationally as well as managerially or technicallySoho Impact: Empowering the Soho House Community to make positive change, through mentoring, apprenticeship, local outreach and sustainabilityLearning & Development: An extensive range of internally and externally run courses are available for all employees.Cookhouse & House Tonic: Celebrating our passion for food and drink. Check out our monthly calendars and get involved in trips, training's and events. Available to all.Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.Team Meal: Whilst on duty in our Houses & Restaurants you will be provided with a substantial meal free of charge.

In accordance with New York law, the salary range for this role if filled within New York is listed below. The range for the position in other geographies may vary based on market differences. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

Pay Range

$80,000—$85,000 USD

rows.title: Market Research Analyst or Senior Analyst, Technology Practice

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology . We stay ahead of what ’ s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas . We ’ re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges — in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming . Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

 Do what you love. With conviction.  Where discovery lives. And impact drives.  Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .  Big thinking. Collectively inspired.  Embrace the journey. Be human. 


 The Opportunity 

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

 Your Impact 

 Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.  Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.  Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.  Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.  Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.  Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling. 


Who We're Looking For

 Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .  Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.  Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You’re constantly asking “what’s changing?” and “what’s next?”—especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.  Consumer-to-market translator – You’re skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: “So what does this mean for our technology clients ?”  Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.  Data-driven critical thinker – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured ( i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured ( i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint .  Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis ) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required .  AI-curious and capable – You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance—not replace—insight work.  Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered . You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.  Clear and proactive communicator – You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.  Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.  Great team member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.  Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome! 


 Position Type 

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

 Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York  Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s  Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans  401K with company match  Generous paid Parental Leave  Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases  Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities  Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)  Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building  NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program  Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties  Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options 


 Our Commitment 

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Compensation

rows.title: Global Supply Chain Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
The Impact You'll Make

As a Data Scientist – Demand Planning Analytics, you will help shape smarter supply chain decisions by transforming data into actionable insights that improve forecast accuracy, identify emerging demand shifts, and strengthen customer delivery performance. Your work will directly support informed planning and decision-making across a rapidly growing business.

You will develop analytics, forecasting models, and demand insights that help the organization anticipate risk earlier, reduce uncertainty, and respond more effectively to changing customer needs. By improving visibility into order patterns and demand signals, you will help teams make confident decisions that balance customer expectations and operational realities.

Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, collaboration, and the ability to translate complex findings into meaningful business actions. You will work across functions, lead through influence, embrace continuous improvement, and demonstrate the Danfoss behaviors while fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives contribute to better outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing
Develop demand forecasting models and analytical methods/tools that improve forecast accuracy, bias visibility, and exception management. Analyze customer order book quality, order changes, cancellations, pull-ins, pushouts, abnormal demand signals, and forecast volatility. Build demand-risk dashboards, alerts, and scenario views to support SIOP, S&OE, and customer escalation discussions. Partner with the SIOP & S&OE / Demand Planning Leader to translate model outputs into practical planning actions. Support segmentation logic by product family, line of business, customer, region, volume, volatility, and service impact. Collaborate with IT/data teams to define source-data requirements, governed datasets, data quality checks, and refresh logic. Validate model performance, document assumptions, monitor drift, and improve model reliability over time. Convert complex analytical findings into clear explanations for planners, materials managers, OFRs, and leadership. Support process improvements that reduce manual reporting, improve decision speed, and strengthen demand planning standard work. Maintain documentation for models, metrics, data definitions, and user guidance. 

What We're Looking For
Experience developing forecasting, statistical, machine learning, or business analytics solutions that drive operational decision-making. Strong skills in data analysis, data modeling, visualization, and communicating complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences. Proficiency with analytics and data tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, or similar platforms used to generate business insights. Understanding of demand planning, forecasting, supply chain operations, or related business processes where analytics support planning decisions. Demonstrated ability to influence across teams, solve problems collaboratively, and embody the Danfoss behaviors through inclusive leadership and continuous improvement. 

What You'll Get From Us
The opportunity to influence strategic supply chain decisions through advanced analytics and data-driven insights. Exposure to cross-functional and global stakeholders, enabling you to expand both your business and technical expertise. A collaborative and inclusive environment where innovation, curiosity, and diverse perspectives are encouraged. Opportunities for professional development through complex analytical challenges, continuous learning, and global career growth. The chance to help build more resilient, responsive, and customer-focused supply chain capabilities through data and technology. Competitive annual base salary ranging from USD 95,000 to USD 149,000 , based on experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

rows.descriptionText:
Our mission at Too Good To Go is to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. It’s a big mission, and that’s where you come in!At Too Good To Go, you’ll join a team that cares about developing strategic partnerships, making value-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to the world’s food waste crisis. You’ll become part of an elite team to elevate our growth in North America and collaborate daily with world-class minds, while doing work that’s both high-impact and deeply meaningful.The RoleAs the Sales Tax Analyst, you will collaborate closely with both Group Tax and Operations to contribute to tax matters specific to Too Good To Go’s operations in North America, primarily sales tax but also matters relating tax reporting, and State/Federal tax matters. You will be responsible for your own portfolio of tax projects and provide first line support to US and Canadian account teams and external stakeholders.Reporting directly to the North America Finance Business Partner and with a strong dotted line to the Global Head of Tax, this position offers a high degree of autonomy and the chance to make an impact on our North American operations. You will be part of a collaborative Global Finance team of approximately 40 colleagues, predominantly based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Core Responsibilities As our Sales Tax Analyst, you will be responsible for overseeing and driving tax matters pertaining to Too Good To Go's operations in the United States and Canada. Sales tax matters are the primary focus of this role, but the portfolio also consists of routine tax related to corporate income tax, tax reporting, tax accounting and State tax matters. Your key responsibilities will include:Act as primary internal advisor on US and Canadian sales tax matters, providing direct guidance to internal teams and external stakeholdersCollaborate closely with our internal tech engineers based in Denmark to maintain and continuously develop robust procedures for the accurate calculation and remittance of sales tax across the Too Good To Go Marketplace in the US and CanadaCoordinate the timely and accurate filing of sales tax, State, and Federal tax returns in conjunction with external tax advisors Provide support to US and Canadian account teams and engage in direct dialogue with Key Accounts on sales tax mattersMonitor and provide first-line partner support in relation to Form 1099-K (US), Part XX information returns (Canada), and other relevant tax formsMonitoring and communicating legislative developments in the North American tax space with relevance to TGTGAct as main contact for US and Canadian federal and local tax authorities Ad hoc tasks to support the development of Finance, Tax and the businessRequirementsWe are seeking a motivated and operationally-driven professional with experience in Tax or Operational Finance. This role demands a hands-on individual contributor who thrives on optimizing processes and proactively addressing challenges. We value a candidate who brings operational sales tax experience but also an attitude for growth and impactful execution. You have prior experience with US sales tax matters and an operational approach to problem solving. You also possess an inherent appetite for continuous learning and professional development, embracing new challenges and evolving tax landscapes with enthusiasm. We value curiosity and the appetite to impact your role description. You have proven experience working effectively in an international setting, adept at managing relationships and collaborating with multiple stakeholders across diverse countries and functions.The ideal candidate has the following skillset:Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Law or other relevant subjectWhile not mandatory, a CPA background is considered a significant advantage, reflecting a strong understanding of accounting principles and tax complianceOperational experience with US sales tax mattersExcellent communication and interpersonal skills Analytical mindset – you will be building processes and structureA can-do attitude to problem solvingWhat it takes to succeedWe are looking for people who are energized by the opportunity and driven by the discipline it takes to achieve it. Too Good To Go is building a high performing team where the right people thrive by holding themselves and each other to these standards. If you are looking for a place to grow, own your work, and make an impact—you’ll fit right in.To succeed here, you’ll need to embody these four principles:Choose Excellence over Ease: You take initiative and prioritize long-term impact over short-term comfort, consistently pushing for exceptional quality rather than settling for "good enough."Demonstrate Integrity and Responsibility: You do the right thing when no one is watching. You recognize your own agency to influence outcomes and take responsibility —meeting setbacks with solutions and humility rather than excuses.Seek Honesty: You ask questions and prioritize truth over comfort, welcoming candid feedback, and addressing performance directly to ensure we never stop improving.Bring Energy and Joy to the Journey: You take responsibility for the energy you bring to the team, finding meaning in the work while celebrating our shared wins and lessons.BenefitsAgility & AutonomyModern Hybrid Model: Maintain a high-performance rhythm with a balance of focused remote work and collaborative office days (3x a week) in our New York hub.Dedicated Time to Recharge: 20 days of paid vacation plus additional paid volunteer time through our Shareback program.Parental Support: Comprehensive paid parental leave with top-up support to ensure you can be present for life’s most significant milestones.Holistic Wellbeing & SecurityPremium Health Coverage: 100% employer-paid medical (EPO), dental, and vision options for employees.Comprehensive Support: Access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health care, legal and financial advisory, and family support.Active Lifestyle: Stay energized with monthly ClassPass credits and our dedicated bike mobility program.Financial Future: Plan for long-term security with RRSP matching.Community & BelongingGlobal Connectivity: Engage with our international team through various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), including P.R.I.D.E., Women in the Workplace, Global Majority Voices, and Functionally Diverse groups.Vibrant Workspace: Experience a welcoming office environment with curated snacks, premium coffee, and regular team celebrations that foster a true sense of community.How to applyWe take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.Submit your CV and Cover letter in English.Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.Certain US states/jurisdictions require Too Good To Go to include a reasonable estimate of the salary range for this role. A reasonable estimate of the range for new joiners for this role in the United States is a base salary of ~ $95,000 - $115,000 Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, an individual's assigned work location, experience, and expertise.   A Movement for Everyone

rows.title: Optimization Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, they’re often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement they’re entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. We’re building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About The Role

We're looking for an Optimization Analyst to help with our fast growing team!

Our Payor Optimization team sits between our clients, Client Success, and payors—working to ensure providers receive accurate and timely reimbursement following IDR determinations. Our rapidly growing business is hiring an analyst to triage CS escalations and close the loop on claims that need follow-through.

With rapid scale comes rapid growth. This means real greenfield: low-hanging fruit you can knock out for quick wins, processes that don't exist yet, and a direct hand in shaping what payor compliance looks like as it matures. The IDR world comes with a learning curve; we'll teach you that part. What we can't teach is curiosity, data instincts, and the people skills to work a problem across teams. We look forward to hearing from you!

What You'll Do

Be the go-to for Client Success: When CS has a payor compliance question, you're their person, on tickets and on calls. You'll own the daily flow of the Asana Payor Compliance queue, dig into the client and payor situations CS flags, and pull claims data from Metabase to uncover the real root cause. Lead deep-dive payor reviews: You'll investigate payors to find what's actually blocking payment, whether it's routing issues, INN processing, or eligibility gaps. Then you'll document what you learn and communicate a plan through data storytelling. Be our voice with payors: Working from the team's analysis, you'll serve as our first point of contact on outreach campaigns. That means prepping emails, managing payor inboxes, tracking responses and keeping the Payor Outreach Tracker fresh at every milestone. Shape the playbook: You'll build CS-facing materials, sharpen our SOPs as workflows evolve, and spot the patterns that turn into bigger wins. Around here, small, consistent wins compound, and you'll be the one stacking them. 

Who You Are

You've spent 1 to 3 years in healthcare operations, revenue cycle, managed care, consulting (highly preferred), or an analyst role in finance or healthcare. Excel is home turf, pivot tables included. People energize you. You're warm, personable, and quick to build trust, with genuine customer-service instincts in every conversation with CS and payors. You write with clarity and confidence. Your findings and rationale become the language CS takes straight to clients. You're the reliable one: detail-oriented and organized under volume, following every thread to the finish even with a full ticket queue and multiple reviews in motion. 

Extra Credit Experience

Familiarity with the No Surprises Act, the NSA IDR process, or health insurance TPA/payor structuresSQL, data storytelling, or dashboard know-how in Metabase, Power BI, or similarComfort with Asana, Notion, or similar workflow tools

Why You'll Love the Role

Be here for the beginning: You'll be one of the first analysts on a growing team, with low-hanging fruit ready for quick wins from day one. Your work pays off — literally: What you find determines whether clients collect on legitimate IDR claims. Grow with a great team behind you: You'll partner closely with the Payor Optimization Strategist and a genuinely strong Client Success org, at a company invested in developing its analysts. Bottom Line: If you love people, get jazzed working with data and have a passion for building out awesome processes, this is the role for you. 

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We’re a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubs–Los Angeles and New York–we remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If you’re excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

Competitive compensation, including equityFull health, dental, and vision coverageRetirement savings plan through 401(k)Flexible time offOpportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and let’s transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Work Authorization

Equal Employment Opportunity

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
