parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Salary Range $72,000 - $89,000*

Job Description

WHO WE ARE:

Saks Global is the largest multi-brand luxury retailer in the world, comprising Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman and Saks OFF 5TH. Powered by our talented colleagues, we are redefining luxury shopping by offering each customer a personalized experience across our store network and e-commerce platforms. Through strong partnerships with the world’s most esteemed brands, cutting-edge technology and the industry’s most comprehensive luxury customer data, Saks Global is shaping the future of retail.

You Will Be

We are seeking an analytical, trend-attuned Brand Strategy Analyst to shape the positioning and performance of our multi-brand luxury portfolio, inclusive of Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus and Bergdorf Goodman. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of luxury fashion, consumer insights, and retail analytics. You will evaluate brand performance, uncover high-net-worth consumer behaviors, analyze complex retail data sets and translate market trends into actionable commercial and brand strategies. The ideal candidate blends rigorous data analysis with a deep passion for the luxury, fashion, and lifestyle sectors—bringing the critical thinking and narrative clarity needed to influence merchandising, marketing, and client experience teams.

You Will Do

Market & Consumer Insights:

Monitor and analyze macro market trends, competitive shifts, and industry benchmarks to identify emerging brand opportunities and risks.Maintain a close understanding of changing consumer trends, demand in luxury fashion.Support the design and execution of primary research initiatives (surveys, focus groups, customer interviews) and synthesize secondary research.Analyze and synthesize actionable insights from large sets of qualitative and quantitative data.Provide strategic recommendations based on insights to optimize brand, marketing & creative initiatives.

Team Support & Collaboration

Work closely with brand strategy team members and collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing, merchandising, digital, stores, and creative to support brand initiatives and campaigns.Communicate effectively across teams to ensure seamless execution of brand projects and initiatives.

Brand Vision, Purpose & Positioning Support

Support the execution of brand vision, purpose, and positioning for Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus, and Bergdorf Goodman, ensuring consistency across all marketing and customer-facing channels.Collaborate with cross functional partners to refine brand expression and ensure alignment with the brands’ unique identities, values, and market opportunities.Ensure that brand positioning is consistently reflected across all internal and external communications, campaigns, and touchpoints through regular audits of touchpoints.

Brand Strategy Implementation

Support the execution of integrated brand strategies that drive customer engagement, awareness, and loyalty for Saks, Neiman Marcus, or Bergdorf Goodman.Support the delivery of strategic insights to inform cross-functional programs, designed to elevate the brands’ presence and engage key customer segments.Participate in the development of creative briefs and ensure campaigns align with the overarching business & brand strategy.

You Will Bring

Required Qualifications (Minimum Requirements):

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.2-3+ years of experience in brand strategy, business analytics, marketing, or a related field, preferably within a consumer business.Experience designing and executing consumer and market research, and analyzing large sets of quantitative and qualitative data to identify actionable insights.Ability to drive analyses that diagnoses drivers of business performance across various dimensions: customer segment, product, selling channel, media channel, etc.Ability to concisely explain insights coming from complex data analyses through effective verbal/written communication and compelling data visualizationsProven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work autonomously with minimal supervisionStrong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and channels, including digital, stores, marketing and creative.Passion for luxury retail and an understanding of Saks, Neiman Marcus, and Bergdorf Goodman’s customer base and market positioning.Exceptional standards for quality and strong attention to detailExtensive knowledge of Excel is required

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in crafting insight-driven creative briefsExperience with Snowflake or equivalent Experience with Tableau

Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)An amazing employee discount

The Analyst II will support the administration, optimization, integration, and continuous improvement of ACV's human resources technology environment. The Analyst II will have strong technical and analytical abilities and will support complex configuration, reporting, integrations, system administration, troubleshooting, and performance monitoring across HR technology applications. Perform other duties as assigned.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Business Unit / Role Specific Info 

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.

At American Express, we empower technologists to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As a Cybersecurity Analyst in Enterprise Technology Services, you’ll join a full-time graduate program and contribute to work that helps protect American Express information systems, customer data, colleague experiences, and digital assets.

Cybersecurity teams help identify, reduce, monitor, and respond to technology and information security risks. In this role, you may support cybersecurity operations, security architecture, identity and access management, endpoint protection, application security, security monitoring, cloud security, documentation, and AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows while collaborating with cybersecurity teams, product partners, software development teams, operations teams, and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

 Supports in monitoring security systems and events using a variety of tools, alerts, and logs to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring timely detection and prevention of security or operational issues  Triages and investigates security or operational issues to determine root causes, impacts, and potential mitigation strategies, helping to prevent future incidents and minimize damage  Support secure network, endpoint, identity, access management, application security, and cloud security activities under guidance from experienced engineers.  Assist with security documentation, assessment findings, remediation tracking, reporting, and control implementation activities that support compliance and security posture improvements.  Collaborate with software development and product teams to help integrate security into the software development lifecycle and support secure coding practices.  Research emerging cyber threats, security technologies, AI-enabled security risks, and control approaches to support team knowledge and decision-making.  Use AI-enabled cybersecurity tools to support threat detection, alert triage, analysis, documentation, and investigation activities while validating outputs before escalation or implementation.  Support security control implementation and monitoring approaches for cloud-based, AI-enabled, or enterprise technology services.  Apply structured prompt design techniques when using AI agent-enabled security tools, including clear context, objectives, constraints, and security requirements.  Collaborate across cybersecurity, engineering, product, risk, operations, and business teams to strengthen secure technology delivery and enterprise risk reduction. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications 

 Must have earned a Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Engineering, or another technical field before the full-time start date.  Foundational understanding of cybersecurity, information security, application security, network security, cloud security, or technology risk concepts.  Foundational knowledge of network protocols, security fundamentals, identity and access management, data privacy, data protection, or secure software development concepts.  Interest in scripting or automation using languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.  Strong communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, discretion, attention to detail, and learning agility with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027.  Coursework, projects, internships, labs, competitions, research, or extracurricular experience in cybersecurity, information security, artificial intelligence, machine learning, software development, cloud, data, networking, or technology risk.  Awareness of security standards, regulatory compliance, data privacy, data protection, security governance, and risk management concepts.  Familiarity with security monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, endpoint protection, network security, or identity and access management concepts.  Exposure to security tools, platforms, or operational processes used to investigate alerts, analyze threats, document findings, or support remediation activities.  Interest in application security, secure coding, DevSecOps, cloud security, IAM, data security, network security, or AI security.  Awareness of AI-enabled cybersecurity capabilities and emerging risks such as prompt injection, model misuse, data exposure, AI-assisted security operations, and automation-enabled analysis.  Interest in cybersecurity certifications or continued learning; certifications are not required for early-career consideration.  Strong problem solving, curiosity, ownership, professionalism, ethical judgment, and comfort learning new technologies in a fast-paced environment. 

Our team reviews applications on a rolling basis. We appreciate your patience while we consider your application and will contact qualified candidates regarding next steps.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. rows.title: Healthcare Data Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About AirPay

AirPay automates dental insurance verification and revenue cycle workflows for dental practices. We process millions of eligibility and benefit transactions annually, sourcing data from payer portals, EDI pipelines, and direct connections. Our data team sits at the intersection of scraper engineering, payer operations, and product, turning raw benefit data into actionable outputs for practices and their patients.

The Role

We’re looking for someone whose job is to find what’s silently wrong or missing in our benefit data, before a practice or a patient does. This isn’t a reporting role and it isn’t a dashboard role: the deliverable is catching the problem everyone else’s tidy summary missed. Coverage that reads “active” but lapsed last month. A field that comes back blank and gets quietly treated as “no benefit.” A payer whose data looks clean until you notice an entire location’s records are null. You’ll own a slice of our verification pipeline (a set of payers, a data domain, a monitoring surface) and run it: surface what actually matters, with evidence, without needing every anomaly pointed out to you first. You’ll report to the Head of Data and work as a peer-level collaborator with engineering, customer success, and operations.

What You’ll Own

Data quality investigations: Run structured investigations into benefit data anomalies across 100+ payers. Triggers are both scheduled (cohort comparisons between data sources: portal-scraped vs EDI vs internal estimates) and signal-driven (customer escalations, operational reports). Output is engineer-actionable findings documents: what’s broken, where, what evidence, and critically, what’s wrong that nobody flagged. Common patterns include coverage-percentage inversions, blank-fill in returned data passed off as a real answer, frequency-normalization gaps (such as “12 months” vs “1 service year”), and stale data carrying across plan changes.Completeness and accuracy monitoring: Own a monitoring surface and define what “healthy” looks like for it, then catch when reality drifts from it. The hard part isn’t building the dashboard; it’s noticing the gap the dashboard doesn’t show.Customer issue triage analysis: Own the weekly pattern analysis on customer-issue tickets. Categorize ticket types, track volume trends, identify recurring root causes, and surface signal that drives parser fixes, product changes, or QA process updates.Ad hoc investigations: When a payer behaves unexpectedly or a hypothesis needs checking, you scope and run the investigation and write up the findings, starting from a vague “something looks off,” not a pre-scoped ticket.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

Required

3 to 5 years where finding what’s missing or wrong was the job: data quality, completeness and validation, data audit, reconciliation, or investigative analytics. If your prior work was producing clean reports and dashboards, this is a different role. We’re hiring the person who finds what those reports leave out.Healthcare data, payer analytics, insurance operations, or RCM background: Dental not required, but you need to understand how benefit structures work (coinsurance, deductibles, frequency limits, network tiers).Strong data skills: comfortable in SQL and Excel/Sheets, can write a structured query, build a pivot, and sanity-check a dataset without hand-holding. More important than tooling breadth is the instinct to distrust a clean-looking result and dig until you know why it’s clean.Self-directed ownership of an area. Point you at a payer, a domain, or a surface, and you run it: scope the questions, find the issues, frame them for a business audience, without per-step direction.Clear written communication: Output is findings documents and structured reports, not just raw data.

Strong Plus

EDI X12 familiarity (270/271 eligibility transactions especially).Experience at a health tech company, payer, or benefits administrator.Comfort with Python or scripting for data manipulation.Experience with parser output, portal data, or unstructured benefit text.

Growth Path

This is the first analyst hire on a growing data team. Several surfaces you’d eventually own, such as the data quality scorecard, deeper engineering interfaces, and the team’s operating rhythm, are still being built. You’d help shape them rather than inherit fully-formed processes. The role anchors day-one as a data-quality specialist owning a defined slice of the pipeline, with specialization paths opening as the team matures: EDI and payer-depth analysis, customer-facing analytics delivery, or clinical/dental content expertise.

Why This Role

High-signal, low-noise work: you’ll see anomalies across the entire benefit landscape before anyone else does, and you’re the one trusted to catch them.Direct impact: your findings drive parser fixes, product features, and QA standards.Small team with high ownership: no queuing behind a data engineering backlog.Comp: competitive for mid-level healthcare data roles in NYC.

We are on a mission to revolutionize employment by building the infrastructure that powers every facet of work . To do this, we're looking for individuals who think about problems holistically and in-depth, who are relentlessly curious, self-starters, and determined to drive ideas from inception through to completion.

Finch is a Series B company backed by a fantastic set of firms, angels, and our developers including General Catalyst, Menlo Ventures, Homebrew, BoxGroup, YCombinator, Charley (1st business hire at Plaid), Sima (ex-Head of Biz Dev at Plaid), Henrique + Pedro (co-CEOs at Brex), Jeff + Wayne (co-CEOs at Digits), Immad (CEO at Mercury), Sam (CEO at Vouch Insurance), Karim (CTO at Ramp), and more.

We're a team of problem solvers who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We value velocity, curiosity, empathy, and diverse perspectives. Everyone on the team is excited about the scope of the problems we address and the potential impact our work can have on the global workforce. We realize that the value we provide comes with great responsibilities, and therefore make security and privacy our highest priorities.

We come from a diverse set of backgrounds and each member brings different skills to the group. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and potential will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns.

About The Role

We're looking for a data-driven Product Analyst to support SLA monitoring and tracking, provider expansion, and automation initiatives. This role owns operational workflows end-to-end with a strong emphasis on metrics, tracking, and identifying where processes are off track. This individual will partner closely with product, integrations, and engineering to move work from manual support toward scalable automation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with product, integrations, engineering, and operations teams to identify opportunities to move workflows from manual support to scalable automationCommunicate progress, blockers, and risks clearly to stakeholders across functions

Independent Execution

Independently run with ambiguous or evolving problems, owning ongoing processes without heavy oversightSet a high bar for execution, both in terms of quality and speedDrive follow-through on initiatives from identification through resolution

Data-driven, analytical, and operationally minded, with a track record of using metrics to identify and resolve process issuesComfortable working in ambiguous, evolving processes where the path isn't always fully definedStrong reporting and analytics skills, with experience building and interpreting operational metricsProven experience handling structured data (Excel, CSV, JSON, etc.)Comfortable working in process-heavy, operational environments with multiple moving partsAble to independently manage and set clear deadlines across multiple simultaneous projectsStrong written communication skills and ability to clearly document processes so they can be optimized over timeComfortable coordinating with multiple parties and building relationships both internally and externallyComfortable working with SQL to locate the right data sources, join tables, and build dashboards you can verify and trust — 1+ years of experience working across multiple datasets preferred. Working knowledge of Python for data analysis, scripting, or automation2–4 years of experience in business operations, product operations, business/data analysis, or a related analytical role at a financial, tech, or fintech company.

rows.title: Optimization Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, they’re often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement they’re entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. We’re building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About The Role

We're looking for an Optimization Analyst to help with our fast growing team!

Our Payor Optimization team sits between our clients, Client Success, and payors—working to ensure providers receive accurate and timely reimbursement following IDR determinations. Our rapidly growing business is hiring an analyst to triage CS escalations and close the loop on claims that need follow-through.

With rapid scale comes rapid growth. This means real greenfield: low-hanging fruit you can knock out for quick wins, processes that don't exist yet, and a direct hand in shaping what payor compliance looks like as it matures. The IDR world comes with a learning curve; we'll teach you that part. What we can't teach is curiosity, data instincts, and the people skills to work a problem across teams. We look forward to hearing from you!

What You'll Do

Be the go-to for Client Success: When CS has a payor compliance question, you're their person, on tickets and on calls. You'll own the daily flow of the Asana Payor Compliance queue, dig into the client and payor situations CS flags, and pull claims data from Metabase to uncover the real root cause. Lead deep-dive payor reviews: You'll investigate payors to find what's actually blocking payment, whether it's routing issues, INN processing, or eligibility gaps. Then you'll document what you learn and communicate a plan through data storytelling. Be our voice with payors: Working from the team's analysis, you'll serve as our first point of contact on outreach campaigns. That means prepping emails, managing payor inboxes, tracking responses and keeping the Payor Outreach Tracker fresh at every milestone. Shape the playbook: You'll build CS-facing materials, sharpen our SOPs as workflows evolve, and spot the patterns that turn into bigger wins. Around here, small, consistent wins compound, and you'll be the one stacking them. 

Who You Are

You've spent 1 to 3 years in healthcare operations, revenue cycle, managed care, consulting (highly preferred), or an analyst role in finance or healthcare. Excel is home turf, pivot tables included. People energize you. You're warm, personable, and quick to build trust, with genuine customer-service instincts in every conversation with CS and payors. You write with clarity and confidence. Your findings and rationale become the language CS takes straight to clients. You're the reliable one: detail-oriented and organized under volume, following every thread to the finish even with a full ticket queue and multiple reviews in motion. 

Extra Credit Experience

Familiarity with the No Surprises Act, the NSA IDR process, or health insurance TPA/payor structuresSQL, data storytelling, or dashboard know-how in Metabase, Power BI, or similarComfort with Asana, Notion, or similar workflow tools

Why You'll Love the Role

Be here for the beginning: You'll be one of the first analysts on a growing team, with low-hanging fruit ready for quick wins from day one. Your work pays off — literally: What you find determines whether clients collect on legitimate IDR claims. Grow with a great team behind you: You'll partner closely with the Payor Optimization Strategist and a genuinely strong Client Success org, at a company invested in developing its analysts. Bottom Line: If you love people, get jazzed working with data and have a passion for building out awesome processes, this is the role for you. 

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We’re a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubs–Los Angeles and New York–we remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If you’re excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

Competitive compensation, including equityFull health, dental, and vision coverageRetirement savings plan through 401(k)Flexible time offOpportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and let’s transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Employment Information

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Reasonable Accommodations

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Background Checks

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

At-Will Employment

Employment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

Job Description

Goldman Sachs Marketing

Led by the firm’s first Chief Marketing Officer, the marketing function at Goldman Sachs is backed by momentum and a broad imperative to unify the discipline, helping to codify a business-critical function seen as core to the firm’s future growth. As such, GS is focused on building out a data-and-technology enabled team of growth marketers, delivering value for the brand and the business. The organization will consist of a number of key COE roles in areas such as Brand, Media, and Marketing Strategy, as well as marketing leads for each of our revenue divisions. Together, this team will collaborate to build a unified, scalable, and consistent approach to marketing the brand and its offerings. Our mission is to be a demonstrable force multiplier for the businesses we serve.

Within the Global Marketing function but aligned to the Global Banking and Markets division, sits the Transaction Banking marketing team, responsible for end-to-end marketing strategies and programs for the entirety of the division. Working across the core elements of the franchise -- the team leads messaging strategy, content creation, client engagement strategy, digital marketing, and marketing analytics.

TRANSACTION BANKING (TxB)

We aim to build a modern and digital-first transaction banking solution to serve our clients. Our business combines the strength, heritage, and expertise of a 150-year-old firm with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a tech start-up. Our goal is to provide a best-in-class digital product that helps clients to succeed by giving them a holistic view of their business. Through the use of modern technology built on the cloud, we are the alternative to legacy platforms. We’re a team of diverse experts helping our clients to build the future of their Treasury.

Job Summary And Responsibilities

We are looking for an intellectually ambitious, driven, entrepreneurial Associate to support the Transaction Banking marketing team. They will partner across the divisional marketing team, product and coverage teams to develop and execute content creation, digital marketing, conferences and events, paid media, social media, analytics, and design to support the commercial objectives of the business.

Responsibilities

This person will also help develop content ideas and distribution strategies to drive engagement with clients and prospective clients. This person will also have a hand in measurement and analytics as we translate our team’s work into commercial impact for key stakeholders. The position also involves project management, budget management, production oversight, regulatory compliance, stakeholder management. Responsibilities include:

Work closely with product and coverage teams to develop and execute bespoke marketing content around TxB products Lead and project manage external agencies for the end-to-end creation, design, and amplification of key marketing assets. Create and author briefs, storyboards, scripts, Q&As, ensuring they are clear and actionable.Measure marketing impact through the use of data analytics tools and feedback from senior leadershipCreate and oversee channel plans and creative elements, authoring social posts and emails, developing creative assets, and creating mock-ups.Support comprehensive planning and execution of industry conference participation. Track client meetings, create internal briefing documents, develop panel proposals, and lead speaker preparation.Support planning and execution of in-person and virtual client events, including agenda development, collateral creation, and speaker preparation. Manage a dedicated budget line item for content marketing initiatives, ensuring resources are allocated efficiently and effectively.Manage approvals across legal and compliance, leadership, stakeholders, and business lines, where applicable, ensuring all content meets regulatory, compliance, and brand standards. Understand Transaction Banking Products (Liquidity, Payments, FX, Channels) and clients (corporate, FIs, etc.)

Qualifications

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

Job Description

Business Unit / Role Specific Info 

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.

At American Express, we empower technologists to learn, innovate, and make an impact from day one. As a Cybersecurity Analyst in Enterprise Technology Services, you’ll join a full-time graduate program and contribute to work that helps protect American Express information systems, customer data, colleague experiences, and digital assets.

Cybersecurity teams help identify, reduce, monitor, and respond to technology and information security risks. In this role, you may support cybersecurity operations, security architecture, identity and access management, endpoint protection, application security, security monitoring, cloud security, documentation, and AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows while collaborating with cybersecurity teams, product partners, software development teams, operations teams, and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

 Supports in monitoring security systems and events using a variety of tools, alerts, and logs to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring timely detection and prevention of security or operational issues  Triages and investigates security or operational issues to determine root causes, impacts, and potential mitigation strategies, helping to prevent future incidents and minimize damage  Support secure network, endpoint, identity, access management, application security, and cloud security activities under guidance from experienced engineers.  Assist with security documentation, assessment findings, remediation tracking, reporting, and control implementation activities that support compliance and security posture improvements.  Collaborate with software development and product teams to help integrate security into the software development lifecycle and support secure coding practices.  Research emerging cyber threats, security technologies, AI-enabled security risks, and control approaches to support team knowledge and decision-making.  Use AI-enabled cybersecurity tools to support threat detection, alert triage, analysis, documentation, and investigation activities while validating outputs before escalation or implementation.  Support security control implementation and monitoring approaches for cloud-based, AI-enabled, or enterprise technology services.  Apply structured prompt design techniques when using AI agent-enabled security tools, including clear context, objectives, constraints, and security requirements.  Collaborate across cybersecurity, engineering, product, risk, operations, and business teams to strengthen secure technology delivery and enterprise risk reduction. 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications 

 Must have earned a Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Engineering, or another technical field before the full-time start date.  Foundational understanding of cybersecurity, information security, application security, network security, cloud security, or technology risk concepts.  Foundational knowledge of network protocols, security fundamentals, identity and access management, data privacy, data protection, or secure software development concepts.  Interest in scripting or automation using languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.  Strong communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, discretion, attention to detail, and learning agility with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Students must have a graduation date between December 2026 and June 2027.  Coursework, projects, internships, labs, competitions, research, or extracurricular experience in cybersecurity, information security, artificial intelligence, machine learning, software development, cloud, data, networking, or technology risk.  Awareness of security standards, regulatory compliance, data privacy, data protection, security governance, and risk management concepts.  Familiarity with security monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, endpoint protection, network security, or identity and access management concepts.  Exposure to security tools, platforms, or operational processes used to investigate alerts, analyze threats, document findings, or support remediation activities.  Interest in application security, secure coding, DevSecOps, cloud security, IAM, data security, network security, or AI security.  Awareness of AI-enabled cybersecurity capabilities and emerging risks such as prompt injection, model misuse, data exposure, AI-assisted security operations, and automation-enabled analysis.  Interest in cybersecurity certifications or continued learning; certifications are not required for early-career consideration.  Strong problem solving, curiosity, ownership, professionalism, ethical judgment, and comfort learning new technologies in a fast-paced environment.

We're seeking a Credit Risk Analyst who will be part of our growing Portfolio Management Group. You will handle credit coverage for clients in the Technology, Media, and Telecom (TMT) sector for investment grade, non-investment grade public, and privately owned corporate borrowers. Job Description

This position can be performed in New York City, Chicago, or San Francisco depending upon which location the applicant chosen for the role is currently residing.    

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. 

 

At LinkedIn we believe that marketing is what accelerates business growth and that nearly all the levers of business growth are driven by marketing. Because of this, we are passionate about helping marketers unlock growth for their companies and seeing them thrive. We work with our customers to empower them to make more effective marketing and business decisions with insights leveraging one of the richest proprietary data sets in the world. 

 

Join us in advancing our vision to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce by helping organizations thrive and grow through marketing excellence. The LinkedIn Marketing Solutions (LMS) Marketing Science and Technology team is seeking a dynamic, visionary Strategic Analyst with a strong technical background and proven expertise in insights, marketing analytics and measurement innovations to join our global team of marketing measurement and insights experts. This team is responsible for developing and scaling leading-edge marketing measurement and insights solutions to support our LMS sales teams with deepening strategic relationships with our customers and driving commercial outcomes powered by the experiences of LinkedIn’s 1B+ members spanning over 200 countries and territories. 

 

As a Strategic Analyst, you’ll be at the forefront of providing data driven insight and driving measurement excellence for our clients and agency partners. Partnering across sales, product, and marketing, you will lead the adoption of advanced analytics and measurement strategies, harnessing industry-leading data to unlock actionable insights and maximize advertising impact across digital platforms.    

 

Responsibilities: 

Client Leadership: Partner closely with Sales to translate data-driven insights and measurement into actionable strategies that improve business performance for our clients and agency partners Insights & Influence: Synthesize complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior technical and non-technical stakeholders Measurement Strategy & Execution: Design and lead advanced measurement initiatives (experimentation, incrementality, attribution, clean rooms) to optimize marketing performance Advanced Analytics: Apply SQL, Python, and visualization to analyze LinkedIn and third-party data at scale Innovation & Product Influence: Advise cross-functional partners to identify innovation opportunities including, but not limited to new product features, measurement capabilities, and go-to-market strategies. Thought Leadership: Drive POV on the future of B2B measurement and represent the company externally Project Delivery: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, custom projects Data Governance: Uphold best practices in data privacy, security, and coding standards 

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications 

8+ years' experience in analytics, marketing science, measurement, or consulting, with direct client-facing leadership. 5+ years' experience using SQL or similar querying language    5+ years' experience in a consultative or advisory role 3+ years' experience in project or program management Bachelor's degree in quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics or related analytic field). 

Preferred Qualifications 

10+ years analytics, marketing science, measurement, or consulting, with direct client-facing leadership. 6+ years' experience using SQL or similar querying language 6+ years' experience in a consultative or advisory role 4+ years' experience in project or program management Experience in digital marketing and AdTech ecosystems, including agency landscape Demonstrated expertise in measurement methodologies (e.g. incrementality, attribution, MMM, experimentation, CAPI) Experience working with large-scale datasets and advanced analytics tools Experience applying AI / LLM techniques in analytics workflows 

 

Suggested Skills 

Digital and Performance Marketing     Stakeholder Management SQL/Python Consulting

Anchored by a strong permanent capital base, we provide businesses with private capital solutions to drive long-term growth and offer institutional investors, individual investors, and insurance companies differentiated alternative investment opportunities that aim to deliver strong performance, risk-adjusted returns, and capital preservation.

Together with over 1,380 experienced professionals globally, Blue Owl brings the vision and discipline to create the exceptional. To learn more, visit www.blueowl.com

This role is in office Monday to Thursday.

The Role

As part of the Global Client Marketing function, this role will support both Private Wealth and Institutional Capital businesses by driving centralized operational execution across client engagement initiatives. This position is designed to standardize and scale high-volume workflows across event execution, travel coordination, calendar management, event and budget reporting, and sales support. This role will partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to ensure consistency, efficiency, and a high-quality experience across all client-facing activities. The successful candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, with strong project management capabilities and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Responsibilities

Provide project management and administrative support across the Client Engagement teams supporting both Institutional Capital and Private Wealth businesses, ensuring key initiatives, events, and deliverables remain organized and on track.Manage event calendars, coordinate speaker meetings, and oversee all speaker travel commitments for industry and proprietary events.Maintain event reporting and dashboards, track attendee engagement and meeting activity, compile post-event reporting, and support data management across internal systems.Manage inventory of branded merchandise, promotional materials, and event collateral, including ordering, fulfillment, storage, and distribution across both businesses.Support budget administration by maintaining expense trackers, processing invoices, monitoring conference and event spend, reconciling expenses, and assisting with budget reporting across both businesses.Partner with Sales, Marketing, Compliance, and Corporate Events teams to support conference participation, client meeting coordination, event communications, attendee management, and the successful execution of client engagement initiatives.Support the planning and execution of proprietary events and third-party conferences by managing registrations, internal rooming lists, vendor coordination, merchandise and collateral fulfillment, and distribution of event-related information.Maintain and enhance operational processes, documentation, and tracking tools to promote consistency, efficiency, and scalability across the Client Engagement function.

Qualifications

OGC is a boutique research and consulting agency specializing in data-driven strategy, quantitative analytics, and Customer Experience (CX) program design and optimization. We partner with some of the world’s leading organizations across Financial Services, Specialty Retail, Telecommunications, Hospitality, and Software, helping them gain a deeper understanding of their customers, translate research into actionable insights, and improve business processes and customer experiences.
One of our leading telecommunications clients is seeking an adaptable, detail-oriented Market Research Analyst to join our team during an upcoming high-volume period. In this role, you will serve as a key operational bridge between our Operations, Research, and UX teams, helping to coordinate research activities, support project execution, and ensure that insights and deliverables move efficiently from research through to implementation.
This position is ideal for an "all-around player" who understands the nuances of primary and secondary research, excels at data evaluation, and feels comfortable navigating CX and research platforms. You will manage daily research work streams, validate survey data, and ensure seamless cross-functional execution across projects. This position is for 6 Months with potential extension based on workload demands.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Bridge: Serve as a central liaison connecting Operations, UX, and Research teams to align project goals and streamline workflows.Workstream & Data Management: Execute daily research workstreams, pull routine dataset reports, and validate survey and data outputs using Excel and internal toolCross-Functional Multitasking: Manage competing priorities and switch gears smoothly between different research and operations tasks during high-volume periods.Data Quality & Reporting: Review data critically to ensure accuracy, synthesize findings into clear reports, and share actionable, logical recommendations with stakeholders.

rows.title: Social Media Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Who are Coolr?

We’re an independent social media agency and team of creatives, social experts, content publishers and change makers. Completely wired into popular culture, our work connects brands with their audiences at scale.

With clients such as Burger King, Lidl, and Harvest Snaps (to name drop a few) our aim is to be the biggest social agency in the world. The agency is growing at a rapid rate, but we’re only just getting started… In 2026, we have ambitious plans to truly become the stand-out social agency in the US, the UK, and beyond.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Social Media Analyst to join our US team and turn social and influencer performance data into clear, actionable insights. You’ll analyse campaign, organic, influencer and community data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate findings into strategic recommendations for clients.

Working closely with our strategy and client teams, you’ll develop reporting, measurement frameworks and test-and-learn plans, while building real-time dashboards to streamline performance tracking.

This is a great opportunity for someone who loves social, data and strategy, and wants to turn numbers into stories that drive better creative and business decisions.

The job 💻

Role

Every role at Coolr plays a vital part in the work we do. Here are some of the key areas of responsibility for this role:

Collating and processing high volumes of social-first performance data (Engagement, Views, CTR, CPM, etc.)Monitoring and reporting on performance for social-first campaigns, always-on organic content activity, influencer partnerships and community engagementDistilling clear actions and insight from the data, making strategic recommendations, optimization plans, and presenting findings in a clear, client-facing presentations and reportsCrafting clear performance analysis and narratives in reportingClosely working alongside a team of strategists to develop qualitative and quantitative research for both current clients and new business prospectsCreating automated social dashboards to help aid and manage reporting across the agency. These will be client specific and update in real time to pull results efficientlyDeveloping measurement frameworks and test and learn plans that define ‘which metrics matter’ based on client goals, allowing optimizations and strategic pivots to be grounded in dataCreating data driven insights for the agency as well as working these into white papers and articles for the agency to publish with external media sources

What we are looking for 👀

Skills

Whilst we appreciate, you’re not just your CV and skills are transferable, these are some of the skills and experiences we think would set you up for success in this role:

Experience in an analyst or insights role within an agencyHighly skilled in Excel (Pivot tables, custom formulas)Experienced in building custom audience segments in Consumer Insights platforms (Global Web Index, MRI Simmons, etc.) and the analysis of the data against hypotheses.Proficient with a wide suite of social reporting platforms (Brandwatch, Sprout, Sprinklr, Amplify, Meltwater, Talkwater etc.)Proficient with native social media reporting tools (Meta Ads manager, Facebook Ads manager, TikTok insights etc.)Passionate about social media, brands, and the world of communicationUp to date with latest news and trends that are going on in the industryAble to work to tight deadlinesCurious about brands, culture, data and how the three interact

A Coolr Offer

Benefits

We appreciate all the hard work that our teams deliver every day — here are some of the benefits and perks you’ll enjoy while working at Coolr:

💰 Competitive salary reflective of your experience and aligned with our internal salary bands.

🤸‍♂️Flexible Hybrid working. We work 3 days in the office and 2 from home

🌴 Enjoy 20 days of paid time off (PTO), in addition to all U.S. Federal Holidays.

🎉 Birthday Day off – an extra day to celebrate your big day

💆 Wellbeing day off — one additional day off plus a $50 voucher to support your wellbeing.

➕ Private Healthcare cover, Tech scheme + more

♣ Coolr weekly socials - we get together every week to connect as a team

A competitive, benchmarked salary ranging from $70,000 to $85,000, based on your experience and level.

Coolr Culture

We are one team. Regardless of what you work on at the agency, we will help and support each other on everything. The goal is to turn our clients into rockstars by creating ground-breaking, award-winning and impactful campaigns for them. The team culture is to push out of our comfort zones to strive for excellence whilst allowing everyone to embrace their true selves and tap into their potential.

Coolr DE&I 🌎

Our approach to DE&I at Coolr is simple: create a safe and inclusive environment for people to be authentically themselves. By embracing this culture, it gives space to people to be more creative, innovative, and successful which will drive us in our mission of becoming the world’s best social media agency. Whilst we are proud of our current position and the work we do to support a thriving and diverse workplace, we always know we can do more to not only create change here at Coolr, but in our industry as a whole.

rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking talented and committed individuals with strong analytical and critical thinking skills to join our Primary Market Research (PMR) practice area as Summer Associates. With a primary focus on PMR responsibilities, the PMR Summer Associates will interact closely with other staff, management, and leadership to deliver actionable and insight driven solutions for clients. This environment provides Summer Associates with exposure to a wide variety of primary market research methods and an opportunity to gain in depth knowledge of how PMR insights drive commercial decision making in the life sciences industry. On each project, Summer Associates help gather information, create and interpret analyses, and develop presentations of research findings. Their work is the base upon which our strategic recommendations that drive our client’s decisions are ultimately grounded. Summer Associates develop their skills through undergoing comprehensive formal and informal training, as well as receiving mentorship that encourages them to stretch their skills.

This is a 9-week, in-person summer internship and the program will run from June 14-August 13, 2027. Interns will be paid $35/hour and can expect to work 40 hours/week.

Draft materials for research (screeners, discussion guides, stimuli, surveys)Support field work and recruiting of PMR respondentsAnalyze qualitative and quantitative primary market research dataHelp craft takeaways and implications for the client based on study findingsDevelop a highly visual PowerPoint presentation of study findings

The internship program is reserved for rising seniors or students who have 1 year left in their studies.

Trinity powers the future of life sciences commercialization through the fusion of human and artificial intelligence. By blending deep therapeutic expertise and trusted human ingenuity with a purpose-built technology platform, Trinity accelerates clarity and confidence at every step of the commercialization journey—from pre-launch to scale to loss of exclusivity. During that time, Trinity expanded from its first office in Waltham, MA to 1,300 professionals across 14 offices and five continents, setting new industry standards in quality, responsiveness, and client partnership. rows.title: Analyst - Technology, Media & Telecom (TMT)

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? 

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

The selected colleague will work at an MUFG office or client sites four days per week and work remotely one day. A member of our recruitment team will provide more details.

We're seeking a Credit Risk Analyst who will be part of our growing Portfolio Management Group. You will handle credit coverage for clients in the Technology, Media, and Telecom (TMT) sector for investment grade, non-investment grade public, and privately owned corporate borrowers. You'll prepare detailed credit analyses and the required credit applications which include the evaluation of corporate, regulatory and industry risk, historical operating performance, projected operating performance, and capital structure.

As an Analyst you'll assess risk factors associated with each credit and determine the appropriate risk ratings based on established policies and guidelines. You will support active credit management and new transaction underwriting utilizing solid credit and analytical skills, analyzing risks and mitigants, including monitoring credits for potential upgrades, downgrades or general credit deterioration with the goal of maximizing the bank’s net income while minimizing credit costs.

Responsibilities

Perform due diligence on new transactions as well as regularly scheduled evaluation of the existing loan portfolio.Coordinate and communicate account information across various constituencies.Responsible for building and maintaining knowledge of country/risk factors and all current events within the TMTS industry vertical in the assigned portfolio utilizing internal and external sources.Attend client and bank meetings when appropriate via phone, video or occasionally in-person.Participate in special projects as assigned.

Advanced Credit/Underwriting Solutions

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. Because of this, we are passionate about helping marketers unlock growth for their companies and seeing them thrive. The LinkedIn Marketing Solutions (LMS) Marketing Science and Technology team is seeking a dynamic, visionary Strategic Analyst with a strong technical background and proven expertise in insights, marketing analytics and measurement innovations to join our global team of marketing measurement and insights experts. This team is responsible for developing and scaling leading-edge marketing measurement and insights solutions to support our LMS sales teams with deepening strategic relationships with our customers and driving commercial outcomes powered by the experiences of LinkedIn’s 1B+ members spanning over 200 countries and territories. 

 

As a Strategic Analyst, you’ll be at the forefront of providing data driven insight and driving measurement excellence for our clients and agency partners. Partnering across sales, product, and marketing, you will lead the adoption of advanced analytics and measurement strategies, harnessing industry-leading data to unlock actionable insights and maximize advertising impact across digital platforms.

Client Leadership: Partner closely with Sales to translate data-driven insights and measurement into actionable strategies that improve business performance for our clients and agency partners Insights & Influence: Synthesize complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior technical and non-technical stakeholders Measurement Strategy & Execution: Design and lead advanced measurement initiatives (experimentation, incrementality, attribution, clean rooms) to optimize marketing performance Advanced Analytics: Apply SQL, Python, and visualization to analyze LinkedIn and third-party data at scale Innovation & Product Influence: Advise cross-functional partners to identify innovation opportunities including, but not limited to new product features, measurement capabilities, and go-to-market strategies. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Blue Owl (NYSE: OWL) is a leading asset manager that is redefining alternatives®.

With over $319 billion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026, we invest across three multi-strategy platforms: Credit, Real Assets and GP Strategic Capital. Anchored by a strong permanent capital base, we provide businesses with private capital solutions to drive long-term growth and offer institutional investors, individual investors, and insurance companies differentiated alternative investment opportunities that aim to deliver strong performance, risk-adjusted returns, and capital preservation.

Together with over 1,380 experienced professionals globally, Blue Owl brings the vision and discipline to create the exceptional. To learn more, visit www.blueowl.com

This role is in office Monday to Thursday.

The Role

As part of the Global Client Marketing function, this role will support both Private Wealth and Institutional Capital businesses by driving centralized operational execution across client engagement initiatives. This position is designed to standardize and scale high-volume workflows across event execution, travel coordination, calendar management, event and budget reporting, and sales support. This role will partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to ensure consistency, efficiency, and a high-quality experience across all client-facing activities. The successful candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, with strong project management capabilities and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

Responsibilities

Provide project management and administrative support across the Client Engagement teams supporting both Institutional Capital and Private Wealth businesses, ensuring key initiatives, events, and deliverables remain organized and on track.Manage event calendars, coordinate speaker meetings, and oversee all speaker travel commitments for industry and proprietary events.Maintain event reporting and dashboards, track attendee engagement and meeting activity, compile post-event reporting, and support data management across internal systems.Manage inventory of branded merchandise, promotional materials, and event collateral, including ordering, fulfillment, storage, and distribution across both businesses.Support budget administration by maintaining expense trackers, processing invoices, monitoring conference and event spend, reconciling expenses, and assisting with budget reporting across both businesses.Partner with Sales, Marketing, Compliance, and Corporate Events teams to support conference participation, client meeting coordination, event communications, attendee management, and the successful execution of client engagement initiatives.Support the planning and execution of proprietary events and third-party conferences by managing registrations, internal rooming lists, vendor coordination, merchandise and collateral fulfillment, and distribution of event-related information.Maintain and enhance operational processes, documentation, and tracking tools to promote consistency, efficiency, and scalability across the Client Engagement function.

Qualifications

Minimum of 2-3 years of experience, with a focus on investment products or alternative asset classes preferred.Leverage AI as a tool to drive efficiency.Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.Creative and strategic thinker with the ability to develop innovative event concepts and solutions.Proficiency in project management software and tools.Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines.Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

The base annual salary range for this New York-based position will be $85,000 to $100,000. Actual salary offered will be based on the candidate’s skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

Benefits for this role include Health, Dental and Vision insurance, 401(k), Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Short Term Disability insurance, Long Term Disability Insurance, Family Planning Support, Paid Time Off, and Leave of Absences. All such benefits are subject to the terms/conditions of the Company’s benefits plans and policies.

Position Summary: 

The Senior Analyst, Social Media will report to the Senior Manager, Social Media and will play a pivotal role in optimizing JetBlue’s social media strategies to help build compelling marketing content. This role collaborates cross functionally, building and maintaining relationships with individuals at all levels within the organization. The Senior Analyst is an effective communicator, has a strong sense of strategic direction and understanding of the digital/social eco-system.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead partnerships with internal stakeholders, including Product, Promotions, Customer Support, Crewmembers, Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and Impact, and other business teams, translating business priorities into effective social content plans. Own the planning, development, and maintenance of JetBlue's organic social content calendar, proactively identifying always-on content opportunities, key business moments, and campaign priorities. Serve as project manager for day-to-day social initiatives, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and ensuring projects remain on schedule from intake through publishing. Find novel ways to express our brand to drive greater engagement and advocacy across our social media channels. Act as the team's subject matter expert on social platform best practices, including channel strategy, copy optimization, link strategy, calls-to-action, and evolving platform features. Own JetBlue's internal employee ambassador program (BlueCreators), including recruitment, engagement, content coordination, and ongoing program optimization to strengthen employee advocacy. Own analytical reports and utilize insights to guide content strategy and identify areas of opportunity. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Harmonic is the startup discovery engine.

It pains us to see great startup opportunities consistently go unfunded not because of lack of talent, but lack of signal.

We're fixing that by mapping the entire startup landscape and building the tools that put the right companies in front of the right people at the right time. Investors, corporate development, and GTM teams use us to find breakout companies before they're obvious and turn that discovery into action. Whether that's a check, an acquisition, partnership or won business.

We’re growing revenue at a rate of 100%+ annually, backed by $30M from Craft, Floodgate, and Sozo Ventures. We're committed to ensuring hundreds of billions of dollars find the right founders, so the innovations that matters most flourish. If that resonates, let's talk.

About The Team

We're looking for a full-time Growth Analyst to support our continued growth. The role is critical because no deal gets closed until it's created, and we give GAs a high degree of ownership. It's a team of high energy, hungry people looking to build their sales muscles and their networks. Previous GAs have sourced leading investors from Khosla to Founders Fund, global enterprises, and rocketships like Anthropic and Ramp.

It's also a fantastic springboard into further impact. We've benefited tremendously from promoting hardworking GAs into roles across the organization, including sales, account management, data, operations, and marketing.

Who You Are:

A desire to work in person. Most of our NYC team comes in person every day, out of our new office in Flatiron (skyline views of the city!)A track record of excelling in whatever you set your mind toA scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves mentality. You'll help us refine what great looks likeComfort with ambiguity and rapidly changing environmentsExcellent communication skills. You can speak to a variety of users, from sales to engineers to data scientists

$90k OTE + equity depending on level

rows.descriptionText:
This role requires a hybrid schedule and will be based in our New York City office (Tuesday through Thursday) and work fully remotely on Mondays and Fridays each week.

The Points Guy is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Analyst to oversee the full lifecycle of advertising on our platform. In this role, you will serve as the critical link between sold media campaigns and live campaign delivery, ensuring that every campaign is launched accurately, paced appropriately, and concluded on schedule. This is a highly cross-functional position that requires both operational rigor and the ability to build scalable processes in a dynamic media environment. You will work on high-impact projects that directly influence business outcomes, with the opportunity to own complex, ambiguous problems from initial approach through final recommendation.

A key dimension of this role is a forward-thinking approach to artificial intelligence. The Analyst will be expected to actively integrate AI tools into day-to-day workflows and serve as an internal champion for AI adoption across the broader organization, helping teams identify opportunities to work more efficiently and intelligently.

For The Points Guy website click here. Curious how The Points Guy fits into Red Ventures? Click here.

What You’ll Do

Manage end-to-end QA, launch, and takedown of all custom ad units across The Points GuyLead the implementation and adoption of AI tooling across ad operations, establishing best practices, training team members, and ensuring new tools are embedded effectively into existing processesOversee QA, launch, pacing, and takedown of all ROS and 100% Share of Voice display media campaignsExecute and QA link wrapping across campaigns to ensure accurate tracking and attributionPartner with sales, editorial, and external stakeholders to ensure campaigns are delivered on time and in accordance with established specificationsDevelop and implement scalable, automated workflows that reduce manual effort and minimize the risk of launch errorsIdentify, evaluate, and integrate AI-powered tools into ad operations workflows to increase efficiency, reduce error rates, and accelerate campaign turnaround timesServe as an internal thought leader and resource on AI adoption, partnering with teams across the business to identify process improvement opportunities and lead implementation effortsOwn projects that involve solving complex, ambiguous problems—defining the right approach, executing against it, and delivering clear recommendationsTake ownership of your work and proactively identify opportunities to leverage technology, data, and innovative thinking to improve outcomesTranslate data and campaign findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the business

What We’re Looking For

Entrepreneurial mindset — demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments, exercise sound judgment independently, and establish clear processes where none previously existedStrong problem-solving skills — proven ability to navigate ambiguity and structure a path forward on undefined or complex challengesExceptional attention to detail — a consistent track record of accuracy across high-volume, deadline-driven workstreamsStrong written and verbal communication skills — able to analyze, synthesize, and communicate insights effectively, aligning stakeholders and surfacing issues proactivelyAbility to manage multiple concurrent initiatives — proven experience prioritizing effectively and executing across several campaigns simultaneously without compromising qualityExperience working with data — familiarity with SQL, Excel, Tableau, or similar tools to analyze and interpret campaign and business dataMinimum of one year of hands-on experience with Google Ad Manager — including trafficking, targeting, and campaign troubleshootingDemonstrated interest in AI and emerging technologies — hands-on experience preferred, along with genuine curiosity about how data and AI can drive better decisions and business outcomesA proactive, scrappy, and self-motivated mindset — energized by fast-paced, performance-driven environments

Red Ventures is a global portfolio of high-growth companies — spanning several U.S. businesses, a joint venture in the health services industry, and strategic investments in Europe. Their businesses include The Points Guy, Lonely Planet, Bankrate, the Allconnect Platform, RV Home Client Growth, RV Growth & Transformation, Sage Home Loans Corporation, and more. The successful candidate is expected to adhere to Agile methodologies, continuous delivery practices, and change management processes to ensure high-quality and timely software delivery.

Partner with senior developers and architects to propose, review, and implement scalable technical designs. Estimate development effort, manage priorities, and ensure timely and high quality delivery of assigned initiatives. Develop robust, well tested, maintainable code aligned with internal engineering standards. Actively follow CI/CD pipelines, release orchestration, and change management processes. Provide 2nd and 3rd level production support, including incident analysis and resolution in a trading time sensitive context. This position is right for you if you have 3-5 years of active duty military leadership experience with a strong preference for combat arms and a passion to start a career in finance and commercial banking.

We offer a full time Military SkillBridge Internship to take you from military service to the finance industry. Our program identifies veterans who have a desire to cut their chops in finance, arms them with an industry-leading financial modeling certification, and places them in finance roles with screened and qualified firms looking for transitioned veterans.

Our certified financial modeling program gives you the skills expected of those entering the financial world on day 1:

Model the three financial statements; Format and color code cells to industry standard; Increase your operating speed in Excel

After passing the financial modeling certification, you will start an internship with a leading reginal commercial bank as a Credit Analyst in training. A commercial banking credit analyst's role involves analyzing financial data, assessing risk, assigning credit scores, preparing reports, and communicating findings to make informed lending decisions that balance the bank's profitability and risk exposure.

Key Responsibilities Of a Credit Analyst

Financial Analysis: Credit analysts evaluate the financial health of businesses by analyzing their financial statements, cash flow, and other relevant data. They assess factors like revenue trends, profit margins, debt levels, and liquidity to determine the borrower's ability to repay loans.Risk Assessment: These analysts assess the risk associated with lending to a particular borrower. They consider industry trends, market conditions, and the borrower's credit history to determine the likelihood of repayment. By identifying potential risks, they help the bank make informed lending decisions.Credit Scoring: Credit analysts use various scoring models to quantify the creditworthiness of applicants. They assign credit scores based on factors such as payment history, credit utilization, and length of credit history. These scores assist in standardizing the evaluation process.Report Preparation: Credit analysts compile their findings into detailed reports that outline their assessment of the applicant's creditworthiness. These reports often include financial ratios, risk analysis, and recommendations for loan terms or credit limits. These reports help senior decision-makers in the bank approve or decline loan applications.Communication: Effective communication is crucial in this role. Credit analysts interact with borrowers to gather additional information, clarify financial details, and discuss potential concerns. They also collaborate with colleagues, such as loan officers and underwriters, to ensure a comprehensive evaluation of each application.

The Ideal Candidate Profile Looks Like

 This position is right for you if you have 3-5 years of active duty military leadership experience (preference for combat arms, but not required) and a passion to start a career in finance and commercial banking. Honorable service and exemplary service evaluations Desire for leadership opportunities in the finance world after you prove your ability to "run through walls" in the short term Willing to virtually attend a no-cost financial modeling certification program and test prior to transition.
