rows.title: Senior IT/OT Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Stellix

The Stellix Group of companies share a common mission of providing transformative solutions at the intersection of science and technology that enable our customers to deliver a healthier and more sustainable future. Our unique portfolio of companies is focused on helping life sciences and industry manufacturers build, connect, and transform operations and IT to make real progress in breakthrough therapeutics, food, energy, and more.

About The Role

Stellix is seeking a Senior IT/OT Engineer to design, build, and secure converged IT/OT environments for clients across Life Sciences and Critical Infrastructure. This is a client-facing delivery and consulting role: you will lead technical architecture, hands-on implementation, and commissioning of industrial control systems, virtualization platforms, and OT cybersecurity controls.

As a senior member of the team, you will balance deep technical execution with mentorship, proposal support, and standardization of repeatable engineering practices. The ideal candidate is a genuine IT/OT generalist — equally comfortable in a control system cabinet, a hypervisor console, and a network segmentation design review.

Key ResponsibilitiesIndustrial Control Systems (ICS)

Design, configure, and commission distributed control and SCADA systems, including DeltaV and FactoryTalk environments.Lead and document Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) in line with ASTM E2500 and client validation requirements.Integrate control systems with plant historians, OT networks, and supervisory layers while preserving system integrity and validated states.

Virtualization & Infrastructure

Architect and deploy virtualization and hyperconverged infrastructure using Proxmox VE and VMware, including cluster design, storage, and high availability.Specify and stand up server and network hardware (e.g., Dell PowerEdge R660 class) for industrial and edge deployments.Develop standardized, repeatable build guides, networking diagrams, and configuration baselines for client and internal use.

OT Cybersecurity

Assess and harden OT environments against recognized frameworks, including SANS ICS Critical Controls and IEC 62443.Design and implement network segmentation, secure remote access, patch and backup strategies, and asset inventory practices for OT.Support OT cybersecurity assessments and roadmap development, translating findings into prioritized, qualified remediation plans

Client Delivery & Consulting

Serve as a technical lead on client engagements, from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and handover.Contribute to proposals, statements of work, and technical estimates for Life Sciences and Critical Infrastructure opportunities.Produce clear, audit-ready documentation and present technical findings to client stakeholders ranging from plant engineers to IT leadership.

Leadership & Standardization

Mentor junior engineers and review technical deliverables for quality and consistency.Drive reusable engineering standards, templates, and tooling that improve delivery efficiency and accuracy.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.7+ years of combined IT and OT engineering experience, including hands-on work in industrial or regulated environments.Demonstrated experience with industrial control systems such as DeltaV and FactoryTalk.Proven experience with virtualization platforms (Proxmox, VMware) and server/network infrastructure.Working knowledge of OT cybersecurity frameworks (SANS ICS Critical Controls, IEC 62443) and network segmentation principles.Strong documentation skills and experience with structured testing methodologies (FAT/SAT, ASTM E2500).Excellent communication skills and the ability to lead client-facing technical discussions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering projects in Life Sciences (GMP/validated environments) or Critical Infrastructure sectors.Familiarity with hyperconverged infrastructure design and edge computing deployments.Relevant certifications (e.g., GICSP, CISSP, Cisco/CCNA, VMware VCP, or vendor ICS certifications).Experience with automation, scripting, or AI-assisted tooling for engineering documentation.

What Success Looks Like

In the first year, this engineer will lead the technical delivery of multiple client engagements, establish or refine reusable build and assessment standards, and serve as a trusted technical advisor across both the internal team and client stakeholders.

T

Here’s What You’ll Get

Highly competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision InsuranceFlexible Spending or Health Savings AccountsUnlimited Vacation Time10 Paid Holidays12 Paid Weeks Birthing Parent LeavePet InsuranceRetirement Savings: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership PlanEmployee Referral BonusProfessional Development ReimbursementCompany Paid STD, LTD, and Life Insurance

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $110,000 to $150,000, based on experience and qualifications. The role is also eligible for a variable compensation plan.

The posted salary range represents a good faith estimate of the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and business needs.

On-Site Requirements

This position requires a full on-site presence 5 days per week during the first 4–6 months. Following that period, the role will be on-site four days per week, including Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with the fourth on-site day alternating between Tuesday or Friday depending on business needs.

Must be currently authorized to work in the United States.

rows.title: Merchandising Manager, Sport
rows.descriptionText:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

YOUR MISSION:

The Sport Merchandising Manager role develops and manages the successful execution of Wholesale and DTC merchandising strategy by combining consumer insights and business acumen to reach productivity and financial goals, while aligning to brand direction and objectives. In this role, the merch manager, serves as the expert on Footwear and Apparel within marketplace, including its consumers, business performance and product needs. The candidate serves as critical partner to Sales, Marketing and PUMA’s key accounts, in developing growth-driving merchandising strategies to increase sales and profitability for the brand and its customers.

Merchandising Strategy

 Develop and lead wholesale product and marketplace strategies that support brand priorities, drive growth, maximize profit, and provide a positive consumer experience. Product Range Management and Administration Curate seasonal range assortments that optimize global product assets and leverage brand stories Identify and qualify regional product opportunities to serve local market needs and support key account and segmentation strategies; create comprehensive product briefings that deliver product solutions for gaps. Oversee regional product developments from briefing to product sign off. Manage range administration – set pricing, establish product flow and lifecycle, complete ranging exercises and build and maintain GTM documents and seasonal line plans. Own sample ordering for pre-line meetings, sales meetings and sales reps adhering to seasonal sample targets and KPIs.

Sales and Account Collaboration

 Lead the education of the sales team on seasonal merchandising strategies and products. Own and execute the seasonal account pre-line process to validate key concepts, ensure range coverage and identify critical gaps. Assist in go-to-market activities for seasonal sell in meetings inclusive of product set up and presentation support. Build relationships with key buyers to gain account insights, identify opportunities and gain product feedbacks. Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to align on seasonal marketing strategies and product activations.

Business Planning and Forecasting

 Build seasonal forecast plans by business unit, product classification and gender that align with net sales goals. Contribute to the financial planning process by sharing category and gender insights to inform on trends and shifts in range emphasis.

Market Analysis and Insight

 Perform ongoing sell-through analysis for categories, channels, and key accounts to stay ahead of market needs. Travel to relevant markets and accounts to gain insights on current trends, consumer behaviors and channel and account opportunities.

YOUR TALENT:

 Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Retail Merchandising, or a related field preferred 5+ years of experience in Merchandising or Product Management in either Wholesale or Retail organization Successful record and reputation of exceeding performance expectations, with progressive levels of responsibility and accountability Strong business orientation, analytical aptitude, and retail math knowledge Strong collaboration skills required to work cross-functionally with sales, product marketing, planning and ops teams. Comprehensive business knowledge of the US marketplace and consumer goods practices including distribution channels, pricing, segmentation strategy, regional variances, product sourcing, planning, forecasting, design, development, and sales. Thrives in a challenging environment with short timelines and changing priorities. Flexible, solution-oriented, a skilled communicator and a relationship builder Fully proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Power BI Ability to travel 20-30%, domestically and international.

The hiring range base pay for this position is $57,000 - 91,200 + Bonus + Benefits

(Benefit Summary Corporate)

Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

rows.title: Fund Development Associate
rows.descriptionText:
Part-Time (Hybrid) | 20–25 hours per week | Potential to Transition to Full-TimeExempt

Position Summary

The Development Associate will lead and manage the day-to-day execution of Boston Islamic Seminary’s fundraising and donor engagement efforts. This role will oversee donor relations, community engagement, fundraising events and initiatives, private dinners, khutbah fundraisers, Taraweeh appeals, and digital fundraising campaigns.

The Development Associate will serve as the primary point person for development activities, working closely with BIS leadership, staff, board members, volunteers, Marketing, and external consultants to implement fundraising strategies and achieve revenue goals. While the role will receive support and collaboration from across the organization, the Associate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, managing, tracking, and following through on the majority of BIS fundraising activities.

Key Responsibilities

Fundraising & Campaign Management

Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of BIS’s annual and ongoing fundraising initiatives, including khutbah appeals, Taraweeh/Ramadan campaigns, community appeals, digital campaigns, and other fundraising opportunities.Develop campaign workplans, timelines, outreach strategies, materials, and follow-up plans; monitor goals and identify opportunities to increase revenue.Partner with Marketing, leadership, board members, faculty, alumni, volunteers, and community members to leverage networks and maximize fundraising opportunities.

Donor Relations & Community Engagement

Serve as a primary point of contact for current and prospective donors, managing cultivation, solicitation, acknowledgment, stewardship, and ongoing follow-up.Build and maintain relationships with donors, masjids, Islamic centers, community organizations, businesses, alumni, faculty, and other partners to strengthen BIS’s fundraising pipeline and community presence.Identify and develop new donor, partnership, sponsorship, and community-based fundraising opportunities.

Events & Relationship-Based Fundraising

Lead the planning and execution of private donor dinners, fundraising events, presentations, donor meetings, and other in-person fundraising activities.Manage invitations, guest lists, RSVPs, logistics, donor research, solicitation opportunities, and pre- and post-event cultivation and follow-up.Track attendance, donor engagement, commitments, and revenue to strengthen future fundraising efforts.

Development Operations, CRM & Digital Fundraising

Manage the day-to-day donor CRM and maintain accurate records of donors, prospects, gifts, pledges, interactions, events, campaigns, and stewardship activities.Maintain donor lists, segmentation, calendars, reports, workflows, templates, and development procedures; coordinate with Finance on gift tracking and reconciliation.Lead digital fundraising efforts in partnership with Marketing, providing fundraising goals, messaging, audiences, timelines, and content requirements while monitoring campaign performance.

Grants, Reporting & Performance

Research and track foundation, corporate, grant, sponsorship, and other funding opportunities; support applications, reporting, and funder stewardship.Track fundraising revenue, donor acquisition and retention, campaign and event performance, prospect pipeline, and other key metrics.Prepare regular reports and forecasts for leadership and the Board and use results to recommend improvements to fundraising strategies and activities.

2–3 years of experience in fundraising, development, nonprofit administration, community engagement, or a related field.Experience managing fundraising campaigns, donor relationships, events, or community-based initiatives.Experience using donor databases/CRMs and maintaining accurate constituent records.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Excellent organization, project management, follow-through, and attention to detail.Strong relationship-building skills and comfort communicating with donors and community leaders.Ability to independently manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities.Comfortable making calls, conducting outreach, coordinating meetings, and directly engaging prospective donors.Familiarity with digital fundraising, email marketing, and social media.Experience working within a Muslim community or faith-based nonprofit environment strongly preferred.

rows.title: Complex Revenue Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Yearly

 Highgate Hotels 

Highgate is a leading real estate investment and hospitality management company with over $15 billion of assets under management and a global portfolio of more than 400 hotels spanning North America, Europe, the Caribbean, and Latin America. With a 30-year track record as an innovator in the hospitality industry, this forward-thinking company provides expert guidance through all stages of the property cycle, from planning and development through recapitalization or disposition. Highgate continues to demonstrate success in developing a diverse portfolio of bespoke lifestyle hotel brands, legacy brands, and independent hotels and resorts, featuring contemporary programming and digital acumen. The company utilizes industry-leading revenue management tools that efficiently identify and predict evolving market dynamics to drive outperformance and maximize asset value. With an executive team of seasoned hospitality leaders and corporate offices worldwide, Highgate is a trusted partner for top ownership groups and major hotel brands. www.highgate.com

 Location 

Studio Allston is situated in, you guessed it, Allston, a unique neighborhood of Boston, MA.Home to elite universities, nationally recognized music venues, and amazing restaurants and bars, Allston is a hub for the inventive spirit and energy that has made Boston an international destination.

Overview

The Revenue Analyst is integral to the success of the Hotel's Revenue Management team. The position will be responsible for the preparation of revenue reports that will assist the Director of Revenue in implementing the Hotel's yield strategies . In addition, the Revenue Analyst will be required to r eview and analyze reports such as Demand 360, STR, Agency 360 and other measurement tools and present revenue opportunities for the hotel.

Responsibilities

 Maintain a warm and friendly demeanor at all times.  Must be able to effectively communicate both verbally and written, with all level of employees and guests in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service oriented manner.  Must be effective at listening to, understanding, and clarifying concerns raised by employees and guests.  Must be able to multitask and prioritize departmental functions to meet deadlines.  Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.  Attend all hotel required meetings and trainings.  Participate in M.O.D. coverage as required.  Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Highgate Hotel Standards, as required by scheduling, which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.  Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing nametags.  Comply with Highgate Hotel Standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.  Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in implementing solutions.  Must be effective in handling problems, including anticipating, preventing, identifying and solving problems as necessary.  Must be able to understand and evaluate complex information, data, etc. from various sources to meet appropriate objectives.  Must be able to maintain confidentiality of information.  Perform other duties as requested by management.  Accurate preparation and distribution of daily, weekly, monthly revenue reports. The reports include market segmentation analysis, production reports, source contribution analysis, daily pick-up reports, preferred guest program analysis, etc.  Assist with ensuring all rates are loaded and inventory maintenance is correct.  Perform audits and maintenance on all systems such as PMS, CRS, RMS, and Sales & Catering Systems to ensure content and information is correct.  Communicate strategies and procedures to other departments as required.  Maintain group pick-up reports and communicate with Sales regarding upcoming groups cut-offs.  Must be knowledgeable of all rates, room types, and hotel product.  Participate in weekly revenue management meetings.  Prepare Revenue Management Report information for all related meetings.  Monitor and analyze the competition daily / weekly through shop reports and the Internet to identify selling strategies and market trends.  Act as the Director of Revenue in their absence.  Assist in preparing short and long term forecasts.  Provide administrative support for the Revenue Management Team.  Review and analyze reports such as OTA Insights, STR, Demand 360, and other measurement tools and present revenue opportunities.  Update MAR's in Delphi (or other Sales & Catering System) as required under the guidance of the Revenue Managers to ensure optimal use by sales team  Analyze local events and activities and project the effect of opportunities they create.  Prepare 14 Day Forecast for distribution to Management team so proper staffing levels are achieved.  Conduct Group audit checks (at least monthly) to ensure Delphi and the Property Maintenance System are in balance.  Place test calls to Central Reservation Office (CRO) and property to ensure accuracy of rate quoting, restrictions and selling approach.  Ensure accuracy from the daily Flash Report.  Be knowledgeable of all special rates and promotions. 

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

 Minimum of 1 year experience in the Hospitality, preferably in Hotel Management  Bachelor’s Degree  Knowledge of all industry reports such as STR, Demand 360, OTA Insights, etc.  Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point  Ability to work quickly in a high-pressure & high stress environment  Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing  Excellent time management skills  Exceptional with details and follow up 

Physical Requirements

 Flexible and long hours sometimes required.  Light work - Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.

rows.title: CRM & Loyalty Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Talbots is a leading omni-channel specialty retailer of women's clothing, shoes and accessories. Established in 1947, we are known for modern classic style that's both timeless and timely, fine quality craftsmanship and gracious service. At Talbots relationships are the key to our business, we hire individuals who bring new ideas to the table, understand smart risk taking and can enhance an already thriving culture. With a commitment to offer modern classic style for every body type, through a full range of sizes, inclusive to every woman in your life.

About The Role

The CRM & Loyalty Analyst coordinates and executes the loyalty and CRM program strategy, translating customer growth goals into campaigns, offers and lifecycle journeys that build long term customer value. In this role you own the day to day forward motion of the loyalty program and CRM calendar: briefing and building campaigns, running the test agenda, chasing down dependencies across Marketing, Digital, Stores, IT and external partners, and turning results into clear recommendations. You bring business analysis acumen and are comfortable interrogating customer data and performance reporting to explain what moved and why, without needing to build the models yourself. You will work across functions and across altitudes of influence, from hands on execution with production and email teams through to briefing senior leadership on program performance. As the successful candidate you will be organized, curious, self-motivated and energized by owning a program end to end.

The impact you can have 

Own execution of the loyalty and CRM calendar end to end: briefs, audience requests, offer setup, QA, launch and post-launch readout across email, direct mail, SMS, app and in-store touchpoints.Coordinate loyalty program mechanics including tier benefits, points and rewards, enrollment, member communications and member servicing escalations, keeping the member experience consistent across channels.Translate customer growth goals into program plans. Partner with the Director, CRM and Loyalty on segmentation, contact strategy and lifecycle journeys (welcome, onboarding, reactivation, win-back, VIP).Track member and segment KPIs (enrollment, retention, frequency, spend, tier migration) and explain the drivers behind the movement, not just the movement itself.Own the test agenda. Design, document and land A/B and holdout tests, supporting a culture of fail cheaply, learn often and succeed quickly.Work across functions and altitudes of influence, keeping Brand Marketing, Merchandising, Creative, E-Commerce, Stores, Customer Service, IT and Analytics aligned on what is shipping and when.Manage external partners and vendors across loyalty platform, print and fulfillment deliverables, holding them to timeline and quality.Support development and tracking of the loyalty and CRM marketing budget, including offer liability and reward cost.Maintain working knowledge of the competitive and loyalty landscape, and bring forward program enhancement recommendations.

You’ll bring to the role 

College Degree2+ years of relevant loyalty, rewards or strategic CRM program experienceStrong project management and coordination skills, comfortable owning timelines and chasing dependencies across teamsBusiness analysis acumen. Able to read customer performance data, form a hypothesis and make an actionable recommendation. Strong Excel; SQL, CDP or Web Analytics exposure a plusStrong verbal and written communication skills, able to brief a production team and a senior leader on the same dayAbility to thrive in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple projects simultaneouslyRetail or direct-to-consumer experience/passion a plus

Benefits

You will be eligible to receive a merchandise discount at select KnitWell Group brands, subject to each brand’s discount policies.Support for your individual development plus opportunities for career mobility within our family of brands. A culture of giving back – local volunteer opportunities, annual donation and volunteer match to eligible nonprofit organizations, and philanthropic activities to support our communities.* Medical, dental, vision insurance & 401(K).* Employee Assistance Program (EAP).Time off – paid time off & holidays.*The target salary range for this role is: $50,000 - $60,000Any job offer will consider factors such your qualifications, relevant experience, and skills. Eligibility of certain benefits and associate programs are subject to employment type and role.On-site: This position works on-site at least 4 days per week consistent with the needs of the business at our Talbots office location in Hingham, MA. 

Applicants to this position must be authorized to work for any employer in the US without sponsorship. We are not providing sponsorship for this position.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Flights Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. Data analysis: Analyze massive amounts of data generated in experiments, build dashboards and make actionable recommendations Pricing: Experiment with different pricing frameworks across channels to grow the businessPerformance marketing: Scale our performance marketing channels (e.g., metasearch, ads etc.)Strategy: Work with cross-functional stakeholders to arrive at investment plan for markets and channels

rows.title: Business Analyst I (Growth Marketing)
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Business Analyst I to support the Growth Analytics team by delivering high-quality analysis and insights that drive efficient member acquisition through performance marketing. This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is eager to build a strong analytical foundation, partner closely with Growth Marketing stakeholders, and learn how data informs paid media strategy and growth decisions at scale. Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Responsibilities

Campaign Performance Analysis: Analyze campaign performance across paid marketing channels (search, social, display, affiliate) and dimensions such as geography, platform, and audience to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and generate actionable insights.Growth Marketing Partnership: Partner closely with the Growth Marketing team to analyze media performance, answer key business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that inform optimization and budget allocation decisions.Experimentation & Measurement: Assist in the design, execution, and analysis of marketing experiments, including incrementality testing, platform lift studies, and other measurement initiatives that evaluate growth investments.Marketing Data & Reporting: Build and maintain trusted datasets, dashboards, and recurring reporting that provide consistent visibility into marketing performance and acquisition efficiency across paid channels.Insights & Recommendations: Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations by identifying performance trends, growth opportunities, and areas for further investigation with guidance from senior team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role; relevant internships or project experience will also be considered.Experience writing SQL queries or demonstrated ability to quickly develop SQL proficiency.Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.Exposure to digital marketing, paid media, or performance marketing analytics.Strong analytical curiosity and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, iterate, and receive feedback.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

rows.title: Analyst, TA Realty (TAAP)
rows.descriptionText:
About TA Realty LLC

Founded in 1982, TA Realty is an experienced and established real estate investment management firm. Since its inception, through June 30, 2025, TA Realty has acquired, invested and/or managed over $44 billion of real estate assets through core, core plus and value-add strategies and customized separate/advisory accounts. Leveraging deep expertise in acquiring, developing, managing, and selling real assets in the U.S., we focus on delivering value to investors and communities.

TA Realty manages core, core plus and value-add strategies and customized separate/advisory accounts for U.S. and non–U.S. investors.

For more information visit: www.tarealty.com

Program Description

The TA Realty Analyst Program (TAAP)  is an opportunity for new or recent graduates with 0-2 years of working experience to learn all core areas of the Real Estate Private Equity business, while gaining exposure to multiple product types. Analysts will be assigned to our Valuations team where they will have the opportunity to provide cross-functional support to Asset Management, Acquisitions, Portfolio Management, and Dispositions. Analysts will have opportunities to gain exposure to other functions of the business, including Investor Relations, Debt Capital Markets, Research, and ESG, through secondary assignments and special projects. 

TAAP is open to students graduating in 2027 with their bachelor’s degree from an accredited university, as well as entry-level candidates with 1-2 years of relevant work experience. Analysts selected will commit to a 2-year program contract and be based in our headquarters in Boston.

Essential Job Functions: 

Prepare sophisticated financial models in underwriting investment opportunities and reporting to the Acquisition Team in the viability of potential acquisitions.Conduct market research and compile internal and external data for deal analysis.Provide information during the acquisition and disposition phases of an asset (generating reports, analyzing data, communicating with stakeholders, preparing and/or presenting materials).Assist in preparation of presentation materials and detailed investment memoranda.Assist in transaction execution and the due diligence process for various product types.Develop, improve, refine and implement valuation models to support asset management forecasting scenarios.Develop, monitor, analyze and adjust budgets throughout the year; in conjunction with annual budget process, update Argus cash flow models to reflect leasing and operational activities.Run quarterly valuations updates as well as coordinate with the third-party appraisal process: guidance on market rents, status of lease rollover, capital projects, etc.Produce monthly, quarterly and semi-annual analysis on asset acquisitions, hold/sell analytics and fund portfolio analytics.Prepare regular reports and complete special projects as requested.Partner with asset management, property managers and brokers on leases, market analysis, risks, expenses and valuations using a variety of metrics.Interface with business, joint venture, development, and operating partners in addition to lenders, lawyers and investment sales/brokerage community.

Requirements

TAAP is open to students graduating in 2027 from an accredited university, as well as entry-level candidates with 1-3 years of relevant work experience. Demonstrated interest in Commercial Real Estate through classwork, internships or other relevant experience, required. Advanced proficiency in Excel/Microsoft Office suite.ARGUS certification a plus but not required.Must have strong quantitative and analytical skills. Ability to interpret and evaluate financial data.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Must be extremely detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities and deadlines. Works effectively in a fast-paced, deadline orientated, collaborative team environment.Demonstrates a high level of organizational skill and customer service.Low-ego, self-motivated and thrives in an entrepreneurial work environment. Intellectually curious with a strong desire to learn.

TA provides a generous benefits package as well as a competitive salary based on skills and experience.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

TA Realty does not discriminate against candidates and employees on the basis of race, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other protected status under law.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Job Description:

This job is responsible for supporting credit underwriting and monitoring for moderately complex client relationships. Key responsibilities include completing and reviewing credit analysis, evaluating risks, and preparing financial analysis using advanced tools and systems. Job expectations include assessing financials, projections, industry data, covenant compliance, collateral, and policy requirements to ensure alignment with the bank’s risk appetite.

Embedded across the bank’s eight lines of business, the Global Infrastructure Credit team reflects the bank’s initiative to fuel the global economy, build trust and credibility with communities, and represents a company that people want to work for, invest in, and do business with. The Global Infrastructure Credit team supports the continued growth in sustainable and infrastructure finance and further deliver on Bank of America’s Critical Infrastructure Finance Initiative. The Global Infrastructure Credit Team covers transactions for Project Finance, Tax Equity and Corporate Lending through involvement in the origination and underwriting of transactions.

Responsibilities:

Analyzes client financial information, identification/mitigation of potential risks, compliance with regulatory requirements and evaluation of collateral in determination of credit worthinessCompletes monitoring activities via analysis of clients’ financial performance and collateral evaluation to ensure appropriate requirements are metReviews completed client requests to ensure compliance with policy and proceduresUnderstands how credit data is used internally and provided to regulatory partnersAssists with periodic portfolio reviewsParticipates in loan structure conversations and completion of loan documentationPerform financial, business industry, and transaction analyses, conduct research, and prepare supporting documentation for transaction credit approval.Performs intensive qualitative and quantitative due diligence on transaction structures, stress scenarios, financial models, engineer reports, and terms and conditionsParticipate in the underwriting and documentation of project finance and other credit facilities designed to meet both client and investor needs as well as balance the bank's internal risk/return requirementsReview the credit profile of key transaction counterparties (e.g. borrowers, servicers, sponsors and off-takers)Engage with various partners including GCIB Enterprise Credit Officers for recourse obligors, Enterprise Credit Risk, and Global Markets Risk

Experience in project finance/tax equity/structured credit with a focus in energy, power, infrastructure, or data center financingsStrong technical skills including quantitative financial modelingFormal credit training program at financial institutionMaster’s Degree or equivalent work experience

rows.title: Business Analyst I (Growth Marketing)
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Business Analyst I to support the Growth Analytics team by delivering high-quality analysis and insights that drive efficient member acquisition through performance marketing. This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is eager to build a strong analytical foundation, partner closely with Growth Marketing stakeholders, and learn how data informs paid media strategy and growth decisions at scale. Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Responsibilities

Campaign Performance Analysis: Analyze campaign performance across paid marketing channels (search, social, display, affiliate) and dimensions such as geography, platform, and audience to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and generate actionable insights.Growth Marketing Partnership: Partner closely with the Growth Marketing team to analyze media performance, answer key business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that inform optimization and budget allocation decisions.Experimentation & Measurement: Assist in the design, execution, and analysis of marketing experiments, including incrementality testing, platform lift studies, and other measurement initiatives that evaluate growth investments.Marketing Data & Reporting: Build and maintain trusted datasets, dashboards, and recurring reporting that provide consistent visibility into marketing performance and acquisition efficiency across paid channels.Insights & Recommendations: Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations by identifying performance trends, growth opportunities, and areas for further investigation with guidance from senior team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role; relevant internships or project experience will also be considered.Experience writing SQL queries or demonstrated ability to quickly develop SQL proficiency.Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.Exposure to digital marketing, paid media, or performance marketing analytics.Strong analytical curiosity and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, iterate, and receive feedback.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

rows.title: Capabilities & Insights Analyst - Life Sciences, Market Access
rows.descriptionText:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will join McKinsey’s Boston office as part of our Life Sciences Intelligence (LSi) team in North America. This is a hybrid role, with 2-3 days per week working in-person from McKinsey’s Boston office and potential travel to additional McKinsey or client offices based on project needs.

The LSi team is part of McKinsey’s global Client Capabilities Network (CCN) with more than 3,500 colleagues delivering distinctive client impact and fueled by a culture of innovation. The CCN is our platform for innovating our service to Life Sciences clients, building intellectual property, digital assets, and consistent approaches for delivering high-quality client service.

Within the CCN, our Life Sciences team is the second largest industry group in the firm, with 100+ professionals across major hubs in Boston, Lisbon, Poland, India, Japan, and China. In this role, you will have opportunities for high levels of interaction with Life Sciences consultants and the rest of the LSi team.

In this role, you will work with McKinsey colleagues and clients on Life Sciences Commercial topics, including a mix of client projects and time spent on knowledge and capability building for the Practice. You can expect to spend at least 50% of your time on market access-related work, with additional work on commercial topics such as go-to-market and modern marketing.

You will be working with McKinsey colleagues and clients to scope business questions and understand, disaggregate, and prioritize their information needs in client engagements. You will problem-solve across various international, cross-functional knowledge & intelligence teams to determine the most appropriate solutions to key issues, effectively balancing quality, availability, timelines, and cost factors.

Your day-to-day work will include generating insights through a range of analytical approaches and tools (e.g., Excel, R, Generative AI tools) from licensed third-party data (e.g., patient-level claims data) and proprietary McKinsey data sets, bringing perspectives based on your personal expertise and background, and leveraging external and McKinsey-developed Generative AI tools to automate processes and derive insights. You will then communicate insights and deliver end products to clients and McKinsey consulting teams in a variety of formats, including memos, PowerPoint presentations and tables.

We believe the Life Sciences Commercial practice has exciting years ahead. As we expand our portfolio of offerings in, and change the way we work to incorporate, new tech-enabled capabilities. You will be core to this work and will help to meaningfully develop and advance our portfolio of proprietary analytical and knowledge assets.

In addition to working with consulting teams and clients, you will continuously develop your knowledge and skills in Life Sciences Commercial topics. Together with LSi colleagues and Life Sciences Commercial leadership, you will analyze new topics and trends and integrate them into our existing capabilities infrastructure or potentially develop new offerings.

Your Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., business, finance, economics, biology) with a consistent outstanding academic record is required; master’s degree is a plus and preferred1+ years of experience and strong interest in pharmaceutical, MedTech, or biotech commercial topics such as launch planning, market access, commercial strategy, marketing strategy and impact tracking; in-field pharmaceutical sales experience is not requiredSolid understanding of the U.S. Healthcare system and interest in health policyExperience with crafting clear, effective, and relevant prompts for Generative AI modelsHigh level of proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and data manipulationAbility to accomplish work in a fast paced and dynamic work environment, including balancing multiple priorities or projects at the same timeExcellent problem-solving skills including the ability to structure a problem, disaggregate issues, identify root causes and recommend solutionsPossesses high quality standards, a commitment to completing tasks within deadlines, and the ability to work under pressureSolid understanding of financial, economic and general business concepts and terminologyDemonstrated business research experience in an academic or business setting is preferredNo immigration sponsorship offered. Must be authorized to work in the U.S. indefinitely.Excellent written and verbal communications skills

rows.title: Finance Rotational Program
rows.descriptionText:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

About the Job

Skills

We have an exciting opportunity to join our Finance Rotation Program. This is a full-time position for approximately 2 years where your experiences will vary depending on the needs of the department and your individual interests. During your time in the program, you will rotate through multiple businesses and functional groups within Finance. You will have opportunities to gain exposure to the broad operations of Bose through a variety of rotations with hands-on learning and development opportunities designed to expand your skills as a global finance professional. Possible opportunities include:

Business partner supporting Sales, Marketing, G&A, R&D, Product, Supply Chain or AutomotiveCorporate Financial Planning & AnalysisAccounting Global Internal AuditTreasury

Each assignment will offer a unique opportunity to support the Bose enterprise in achieving its strategic objectives. You will be expected to contribute within each assignment while gaining experience and developing your business and technical skills with the goal of completing the program and transitioning to a longer-term position within our finance department.

About You

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related fieldMinimum of 0-2 years’ work experienceNatural curiosity, including a willingness to learn/understand technical aspects of Bose products, category strategies, the competitive landscape, and other parts of the businessProficiency of intermediate Excel/PowerPointAbility to work independently and as part of a team

Ideal candidates will be graduating in May 2027 with a start date of Summer 2027

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $56,800-$78,100.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary. In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

rows.title: User Experience Researcher II
rows.descriptionText:

WHOOP is hiring a User Experience Researcher II to join WHOOP Labs in Boston. In this role, you will conduct research that helps shape the future of WHOOP products and member experiences across hardware, software, machine learning, and emerging technologies. Working closely with Product, Design, Machine Learning Research, and Hardware teams, you will uncover insights that inform product decisions and advance WHOOP’s mission to unlock human performance and healthspan.

We are looking for a curious, adaptable researcher who thrives in diverse problem spaces and enjoys learning new methods, tools, and approaches. You will support a wide range of initiatives, from foundational product experiences to exploratory research that informs future innovations. This role is ideal for someone who is energized by methodological rigor, excited to experiment responsibly with new research approaches, and motivated to help strengthen the foundation of research practice across WHOOP.

This role is expected to work in-person from WHOOP HQ in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary.

Responsibilities

Execute end-to-end user research projects across the product development lifecycle, from study planning and participant engagement through analysis, synthesis, and reporting.Select and apply appropriate qualitative and quantitative research methods to answer product and business questions, including interviews, usability studies, surveys, diary studies, concept evaluations, and field research.Partner with Product, Design, Machine Learning Research, Hardware, and other cross-functional stakeholders to align on research objectives and support evidence-based decision-making.Synthesize research findings into clear insights and actionable recommendations that inform product development and member experience improvements.Lead sequential research projects while maintaining high-quality execution, clear communication, and stakeholder alignment.Explore and evaluate emerging research methods, tools, and AI-enabled workflows, helping expand the team’s methodological toolkit and improve research effectiveness while maintaining research rigor.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in User Experience Research, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Anthropology, Sociology, or a related field.2+ years of experience conducting user research in product, technology, healthcare, or other customer-focused environments.Experience independently conducting mixed methods research studies, including study design, moderation, analysis, and synthesis.Strong communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to translate research findings into actionable insights for diverse audiences.Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Demonstrated ability to build productive relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.Experience using data and evidence to inform decisions, challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities for improvement.Passion for health, human performance, behavior change, and WHOOP’s mission to unlock human performance and healthspan.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

rows.title: CRM & Loyalty Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Talbots is a leading omni-channel specialty retailer of women's clothing, shoes and accessories. Established in 1947, we are known for modern classic style that's both timeless and timely, fine quality craftsmanship and gracious service. At Talbots relationships are the key to our business, we hire individuals who bring new ideas to the table, understand smart risk taking and can enhance an already thriving culture. With a commitment to offer modern classic style for every body type, through a full range of sizes, inclusive to every woman in your life.

About The Role

The CRM & Loyalty Analyst coordinates and executes the loyalty and CRM program strategy, translating customer growth goals into campaigns, offers and lifecycle journeys that build long term customer value. In this role you own the day to day forward motion of the loyalty program and CRM calendar: briefing and building campaigns, running the test agenda, chasing down dependencies across Marketing, Digital, Stores, IT and external partners, and turning results into clear recommendations. You bring business analysis acumen and are comfortable interrogating customer data and performance reporting to explain what moved and why, without needing to build the models yourself. You will work across functions and across altitudes of influence, from hands on execution with production and email teams through to briefing senior leadership on program performance. As the successful candidate you will be organized, curious, self-motivated and energized by owning a program end to end.

The impact you can have 

Own execution of the loyalty and CRM calendar end to end: briefs, audience requests, offer setup, QA, launch and post-launch readout across email, direct mail, SMS, app and in-store touchpoints.Coordinate loyalty program mechanics including tier benefits, points and rewards, enrollment, member communications and member servicing escalations, keeping the member experience consistent across channels.Translate customer growth goals into program plans. Partner with the Director, CRM and Loyalty on segmentation, contact strategy and lifecycle journeys (welcome, onboarding, reactivation, win-back, VIP).Track member and segment KPIs (enrollment, retention, frequency, spend, tier migration) and explain the drivers behind the movement, not just the movement itself.Own the test agenda. Design, document and land A/B and holdout tests, supporting a culture of fail cheaply, learn often and succeed quickly.Work across functions and altitudes of influence, keeping Brand Marketing, Merchandising, Creative, E-Commerce, Stores, Customer Service, IT and Analytics aligned on what is shipping and when.Manage external partners and vendors across loyalty platform, print and fulfillment deliverables, holding them to timeline and quality.Support development and tracking of the loyalty and CRM marketing budget, including offer liability and reward cost.Maintain working knowledge of the competitive and loyalty landscape, and bring forward program enhancement recommendations.

You’ll bring to the role 

College Degree2+ years of relevant loyalty, rewards or strategic CRM program experienceStrong project management and coordination skills, comfortable owning timelines and chasing dependencies across teamsBusiness analysis acumen. Able to read customer performance data, form a hypothesis and make an actionable recommendation. Strong Excel; SQL, CDP or Web Analytics exposure a plusStrong verbal and written communication skills, able to brief a production team and a senior leader on the same dayAbility to thrive in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple projects simultaneouslyRetail or direct-to-consumer experience/passion a plus

Benefits

You will be eligible to receive a merchandise discount at select KnitWell Group brands, subject to each brand’s discount policies.Support for your individual development plus opportunities for career mobility within our family of brands. A culture of giving back – local volunteer opportunities, annual donation and volunteer match to eligible nonprofit organizations, and philanthropic activities to support our communities.* Medical, dental, vision insurance & 401(K).* Employee Assistance Program (EAP).Time off – paid time off & holidays.*The target salary range for this role is: $50,000 - $60,000Any job offer will consider factors such your qualifications, relevant experience, and skills. Eligibility of certain benefits and associate programs are subject to employment type and role.On-site: This position works on-site at least 4 days per week consistent with the needs of the business at our Talbots office location in Hingham, MA. 

Applicants to this position must be authorized to work for any employer in the US without sponsorship. We are not providing sponsorship for this position.

In this role, your skillset matters, but your mindset matters just as much. 
Responsibilities Work collaboratively with integrated media team across all traditional (TV, Radio, Print, OOH) and digital (programmatic, SEM, ecommerce, organic and paid social, influencers) media to support the development and execution of media plans by helping to:Select media channels and make recommendations based on client campaign goalsEvaluate media kit information, client proposals and costs; Provide POVsNegotiate rates and makegoods as neededDevelop and manage media flowcharts and budget allocation/reconciliationMonitor campaign pacing and analyze/report on campaign performance with recommendations on inventory, channel and creative shifts; stay abreast of reporting schedules established using the Tableau dashboard to create client reportsManage influencer relationships from discovery through deliveryCoordinate with creative and account services to schedule promoted posts and oversee community management on organic social contentCollaborate with account, production, and data/analytics teams for creative rotation and production team for deadlines and specs, along with media team for proper campaign set up and trackingParticipate in regular internal and client meetings Proactively bring new ideas to solve media and creative challenges, both big and small

rows.title: Business Analyst I (Growth Marketing)
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Business Analyst I to support the Growth Analytics team by delivering high-quality analysis and insights that drive efficient member acquisition through performance marketing. This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is eager to build a strong analytical foundation, partner closely with Growth Marketing stakeholders, and learn how data informs paid media strategy and growth decisions at scale. Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Responsibilities

Campaign Performance Analysis: Analyze campaign performance across paid marketing channels (search, social, display, affiliate) and dimensions such as geography, platform, and audience to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and generate actionable insights.Growth Marketing Partnership: Partner closely with the Growth Marketing team to analyze media performance, answer key business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that inform optimization and budget allocation decisions.Experimentation & Measurement: Assist in the design, execution, and analysis of marketing experiments, including incrementality testing, platform lift studies, and other measurement initiatives that evaluate growth investments.Marketing Data & Reporting: Build and maintain trusted datasets, dashboards, and recurring reporting that provide consistent visibility into marketing performance and acquisition efficiency across paid channels.Insights & Recommendations: Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations by identifying performance trends, growth opportunities, and areas for further investigation with guidance from senior team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role; relevant internships or project experience will also be considered.Experience writing SQL queries or demonstrated ability to quickly develop SQL proficiency.Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.Exposure to digital marketing, paid media, or performance marketing analytics.Strong analytical curiosity and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, iterate, and receive feedback.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team: 

The Marketing team at Agoda is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale, measurable marketing programs designed to improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers. The team combines a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists and data scientists, collectively building a team that thrives on data, creative ideas and technology. . The Marketing leadership fosters a great learning environment, providing the opportunity to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a diverse variety of backgrounds from across the globe.

Due to continued expansion, there are multiple analyst roles within the marketing team across different marketing channels. While the scope will vary depending on these channels, here are some examples: 

Experimentation and optimizing campaign performance: Experiment with ads/campaign structures and bidding& pricing strategies on partners such as Google, Bing, Tripadvisor, Trivago and other search engines. rows.title: Business Analyst I (Growth Marketing)
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is hiring a Business Analyst I to support the Growth Analytics team by delivering high-quality analysis and insights that drive efficient member acquisition through performance marketing. This role is ideal for an early-career analyst who is eager to build a strong analytical foundation, partner closely with Growth Marketing stakeholders, and learn how data informs paid media strategy and growth decisions at scale. Your analyses will directly influence marketing investment decisions, improve acquisition efficiency, and help WHOOP continue scaling member growth.

Responsibilities

Campaign Performance Analysis: Analyze campaign performance across paid marketing channels (search, social, display, affiliate) and dimensions such as geography, platform, and audience to identify trends, measure effectiveness, and generate actionable insights.Growth Marketing Partnership: Partner closely with the Growth Marketing team to analyze media performance, answer key business questions, and provide data-driven recommendations that inform optimization and budget allocation decisions.Experimentation & Measurement: Assist in the design, execution, and analysis of marketing experiments, including incrementality testing, platform lift studies, and other measurement initiatives that evaluate growth investments.Marketing Data & Reporting: Build and maintain trusted datasets, dashboards, and recurring reporting that provide consistent visibility into marketing performance and acquisition efficiency across paid channels.Insights & Recommendations: Translate analyses into clear, actionable recommendations by identifying performance trends, growth opportunities, and areas for further investigation with guidance from senior team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Business, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar analytical role; relevant internships or project experience will also be considered.Experience writing SQL queries or demonstrated ability to quickly develop SQL proficiency.Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.Exposure to digital marketing, paid media, or performance marketing analytics.Strong analytical curiosity and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a willingness to learn, iterate, and receive feedback.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000 - $110,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.
