rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

CGI is a global IT and business consulting services firm that partners with organizations to solve complex challenges and deliver measurable outcomes. Our collaborative culture brings together diverse expertise, industry insight, and technology capabilities to create lasting value for clients and communities.

Join CGI as a Senior Data Analyst supporting complex data, analytics, and information management initiatives within the healthcare payer domain. In this role, you will partner with business leaders, technical teams, and external vendors to translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions, strengthen data quality, and deliver actionable insights. You will independently design and execute analyses, develop technical and functional documentation, support solution testing, and help resolve complex data and production issues.

This position is located in our Canton, MA office, however a hybrid working model is acceptable.

Your future duties and responsibilities

 Collaborates with internal business and external vendor constituents to conduct analytic assignments in support of requested business solution(s). Creates a technology roadmap in support of a business strategy with business leadership across multiple departments. Ensures that appropriate requirements, associated business rules and data standards, and technical specifications for requested solutions are documented. Develops design recommendations commensurate of requested solution, ensuring recommendations comply with corporate architectural standards and federal and state regulations and/or mandates pertaining to the privacy and security of the company's core data assets. Facilitates review of design with governing committees. Plans, develops, and implements solution designs of significant scope and complexity. Solutions may include application or extract program code, production reports and analytic finding reports. Independently develops solutions of considerable scope and complexity. Develops and trains IT and business personnel on test strategies, plans, and scripts and executes test procedures to ensure compliance of developed solution with documented specifications. Reports test results to project stakeholders. Collaborates to maintain core reference domain content via master data management tools. Monitors core dataset quality thresholds to identify dataset content issues that require resolution. Initiates and manages constituent specific data remediation projects to resolve prioritized issues. Monitors production processes of previously implemented information management solutions to proactively achieve error free performance standards. Performs analysis to establish root cause(s) of identified issues through implementation and documentation of necessary modifications. Perform out of the box thinking, collaborate with others, and make a difference every day! Independently develop SAS and/or SQL queries, Excel pivot tables, and other analytic tools to explore and summarize results Conduct other analyses as needed to support the identification of gaps, variation, and other key performance indicators of reimbursement trends Demonstrate problem solving aptitude through critique of analytic methodologies and studies Demonstrate strong business problem comprehension, by developing analytic use cases (Who? What? Why?) that accurately capture business needs Apply a high level of QA rigor, proactively leveraging peer review and external validation sources Develop documentation and methodologies for analyses and deliverables Meets assigned timelines and escalates risks/barriers as needed Establish strong business relationships, and interface with stakeholders collaboratively

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

 Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field 7+ years of data analysis experience within a healthcare payer environment Advanced SQL, PL/SQL, and Oracle skills, including experience developing complex queries and analytical solutions 5+ years of hands on ETL and data engineering experience 5+ years of experience working with Teradata 7+ years of experience performing functional analysis, gap analysis, and business requirements definition Experience developing technical specifications, analytical use cases, test cases, and test plans Strong quality assurance, problem solving, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Our client, a leading global biopharmaceutical organization, is seeking an experienced Data Scientist to join their Process Development division in Lexington, Massachusetts. This role is focused on bridging the gap between complex biological data and actionable insights to enhance the development of life-saving therapeutics.
In this position, you will be responsible for integrating diverse data streams and expanding the team capabilities in modeling and visualization. You will work closely with laboratory scientists and technical staff to ensure that data from various experimental conditions is translated into clear, strategic information that drives process improvements and scientific breakthroughs.
Key Responsibilities
Create and maintain automated workflows to integrate data from various scientific sources.
Design and deploy interactive dashboards and visualization tools to track process performance and identify trends.
Build predictive and statistical models to guide decision-making throughout the biotherapeutics development lifecycle.
Perform deep-dive analysis on complex datasets to identify anomalies and optimization opportunities.
Act as a technical consultant and trainer for internal teams regarding data science tools and methodologies.
Collaborate with cross-functional project teams to define data requirements and ensure timely delivery of analysis.
Represent the department in external technical collaborations and knowledge transfer initiatives.
Candidate Requirements
A PhD in Data Science or a related quantitative field is preferred, though a Masters degree with at least 6 years of experience or a Bachelors degree with at least 8 years of experience will be considered.
Demonstrated background in data cleaning, integration, and management within a scientific or manufacturing environment.
Advanced proficiency in building dashboards and data visualizations for technical stakeholders.
Proven experience developing machine learning or statistical models applied to laboratory or process data.
Familiarity with the systems and software typically used in biopharmaceutical development and manufacturing.
Ability to work independently under general direction while providing mentorship to more junior staff members.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex findings to senior management and diverse technical audiences.
Compensation and Environment
The anticipated base salary range for this role is 116,000 to 182,270 USD. Final compensation will be determined by the specific qualifications, education, and relevant experience of the candidate. This is a full-time, regular employee position offering a comprehensive benefits package and a collaborative, innovative work culture.
If you are a data professional passionate about using your skills to advance medical research and process efficiency, we encourage you to apply.

Our clients are global, and so are we. Our local presence and global collaboration allow us to deliver actionable business insights and an unmatched continuum of support across the full corporate and product lifecycle. Our major hubs are located in Barcelona, Basel, Bologna, London, Munich, Milan, Paris, and Verona across Europe, Toronto in Canada, and the Boston Area in the US.

About The Consulting Practice

Alira Health’s Consulting Practice supports clients across the full healthcare value chain — from market access and pricing to evidence generation and commercial strategy.

Within PAE (Pricing, Access, and Evidence), our teams specialize in Market Access and Pricing (MAP), Real-World Evidence (RWE), and Patient Evidence & Narrative (PEN). We help clients generate insights, build strategies, and deliver solutions that connect clinical, economic, and patient perspectives.

As part of this multidisciplinary environment, Analysts play a key role in supporting project execution, developing analyses, and contributing to deliverables across therapy areas and geographies.

THE ANALYST ROLE 

The Analyst will work as part of cross-functional project teams delivering consulting and research engagements for global healthcare clients. Analysts support the design, execution, and delivery of analyses that inform payer, access, and evidence strategies.

This is a hands-on, learning-intensive role designed to provide exposure to multiple project types and therapeutic areas. High-performing Analysts are well positioned to progress toward Associate Consultant roles within the PAE team.

Key Responsabilities

Project Execution (100%)

Conduct secondary research and quantitative analyses to support client projects in areas such as market access, pricing, patient engagement, real-world evidence, and health economics. Contribute to the preparation of deliverables, including slide decks, reports, and models, under the guidance of senior team members. Participate in internal problem-solving discussions and support hypothesis development and validation. Assist in organizing and conducting interviews with payers, clinicians, and other stakeholders, as well as the interpretation and synthesis of qualitative insights. Collaborate with project managers, consultants, and subject matter experts across MAP, RWE, and PEN to ensure analytical rigor and strategic coherence. Support the drafting of proposals, project documentation, and client communications as needed. Demonstrate attention to detail, structured thinking, and ownership of assigned workstreams. Develop knowledge about the environment and stakeholders involved in the overall framework of global healthcare systems. 

Desired Qualification & Experience

Master’s degree (or near completion) in life sciences, economics, public health, business, or a related quantitative or healthcare field. 0–2 years of professional experience, ideally in consulting, healthcare, or related analytical environments. Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to synthesize complex information clearly. Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage. 

Techinical Competences & Soft Skills

Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with data visualization or analytical tools is a plus. Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative data, interpret findings, and build logical, evidence-based recommendations. Effective time and task management skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Adaptability and an ability to learn quickly and apply new knowledge. Working knowledge of healthcare markets, payers, or life sciences data sources is a plus. Ability to work with teams based in different countries. 

RETRIBUTION

$35/hour

Data Science Internship/Co-Op - Fall Starting January 2027 - Position is in-office, Boston MA

This position will be critical in advancing our mission to drive profit-focused technical excellence and innovation within the Plymouth Rock Group of Companies. The position will be responsible for research and development of new predictive models and new analytical techniques around insurance pure premiums, customer lifetime value, customer buying behaviors and other related topics utilizing internal and external data. This work will be used in setting pricing, underwriting and product strategies for the Plymouth Rock group of Companies. The analysis and modeling will be tested via implementation both broadly and on a pilot basis to allow us to learn and refine our approaches in rapid succession.

Data Analysis

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

The Data Science Intern/co-op will work with internal and external data to understand key drivers of expected insurance losses and lifetime customer value. This will require that the Intern acquires an understanding of various internal and external data sources, is able to illicit hypothesis from internal personnel regarding key variables and test those hypotheses using available data.

Modeling

The Data Science Intern/co-op will help develop and enhance models used in a variety of contexts within the product management structure of Plymouth Rock. The Intern/Co-op will be responsible for advancing the modeling capabilities within Plymouth Rock and transferring those advancements to other product management personnel.

Implementation

The Data Science Intern/co-op will work with the product community to facilitate the application of models developed considering the regulatory and competitive contexts within which we operate. This will include ensuring that models are well understood, the implications are appropriately assessed, implementation plans are defined, validation of results are undertaken, and adjustments are made rapidly.

Qualifications

Graduate Student from a program (doctoral preferred) in the areas of economics, statistics, or a related field (background in Bayesian statistics preferred).Practical experience in Econometrics and Statistics, preferably in a business context.Strong written and oral communication skills and an ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.High standards for the work products delivered.Creative thinker with the ability to synthesize information from various sources and apply that information to concrete business problems.Flexibility and resiliency characteristic of a professional.Knowledge of, and experience with, the technical aspect of insurance is a plus.Proficiency with modeling programming language (SQL, R, SAS, Python). 

Why Work For Us

Friendly and collaborate work cultureFree On-site gym accessFree Coffee and SnacksCompany social eventsLunch and Learn Leadership programBusiness Casual (Can wear jeans and sneakers!)Convenient Location – across from South Station!

About The Company

The Plymouth Rock Company and its affiliated group of companies write and manage over $2 billion in personal and commercial auto and homeowner’s insurance throughout the Northeast and mid-Atlantic, where we have built an unparalleled reputation for service. rows.title: Interoperability Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Zus is a shared health data platform designed to accelerate healthcare data interoperability by providing easy-to-use patient data via API, embedded components, and direct EHR integrations. Founded in 2021 by Jonathan Bush, co-founder and former CEO of athenahealth, Zus partners with HIEs and other data networks to aggregate patient clinical history and then translates that history into user-friendly information at the point of care. Zus's mission is to catalyze healthcare's greatest inventors by maximizing the value of patient insights - so that they can build up, not around.

What We're Looking For

Every customer on the Zus network should have access to the most comprehensive clinical data possible and should understand exactly what they have. As Interoperability Operations Analyst, you'll build the metrics, intelligence, and tooling that make that possible. You'll dig into where coverage is strong and where it's thin, surface the reasons why, and partner with support and solutions teams to close the gaps. When the right fix is a query, you'll write it. When it's an automated workflow, you'll build it.

This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a SQL editor and a Python script, gets genuinely curious about unexplained patterns in data, and is excited about using AI tools to work faster and smarter. You'll sit at the intersection of data, operations, and product. Your insights will shape how the network grows and how we serve our customers

As part of our team, you will be focused on...

Coverage IntelligenceBuild and maintain the metrics and dashboards that track clinical data coverage across the Zus network — by geography, network, data type, and customerIdentify coverage gaps and anomalies, investigate root causes, and communicate findings clearly to customers and internal stakeholdersDeliver the regular coverage intelligence that helps every customer understand the depth and breadth of their data — and what's driving any gaps
Operations Partnership

Work closely with support and solutions teams to translate coverage findings into operational actions — escalations, network outreach, configuration changesDevelop and maintain playbooks for recurring coverage issues, turning one-off investigations into repeatable processesContribute to onboarding quality by flagging patterns in new participant data that suggest connectivity or configuration problems

Tooling & Automation

Build internal tools, scripts, and automated workflows that reduce manual analysis and surface insights fasterExperiment with AI tools (including Claude) and BI platforms to accelerate how the team operatesPartner with engineering and product to ensure the systems we rely on generate the signals we need

Product Feedback Loop

Translate operational data into product requirements — if a coverage gap is systematic, you'll articulate why it's a product problem and what solving it would requirePartner with UX and engineering to shape internal and customer-facing experiences that make coverage intelligence intuitive and actionable

You're a good fit because you have...

SQL fluency: You write queries naturally and reach for them first when you have a question about data. Experience with BI tools (Looker, Metabase, Tableau, etc.) is a plusAutomation instinct: You don't accept manual work as permanent. You're comfortable in Python and curious about AI-assisted workflows — you'd rather build a system than repeat a taskAnalytical curiosity: You notice when numbers don't add up and you follow the thread. You're comfortable sitting with ambiguous data and forming hypothesesClear communicator: You can translate a coverage analysis into a crisp, jargon-free narrative for a customer or an executiveHealthcare interest: Prior exposure to clinical data formats (FHIR, HL7, C-CDA) or the provider/EMR ecosystem is a plus, but a genuine interest in how healthcare data flows is what matters most

Why this role matters...

Data coverage is one of the most tangible levers for customer value at Zus and right now, the infrastructure for understanding and improving it is still being built. You'll have real ownership over that build: the metrics, the tooling, and the feedback loops that help the network get better over time. The work compounds.

We will offer you…

Competitive compensation that reflects the value you bring to the team a combination of cash and equityRobust benefits that include health insurance, wellness benefits, 401k with a match, unlimited PTOOpportunity to work alongside a passionate team that is determined to help change the world (and have fun doing it)

Please Note: Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don’t apply unless they meet 100% of the job criteria. While we have worked to consolidate the minimum qualifications for each role, we aren’t looking for someone who checks each box on a page; we’re looking for active learners and people who care about disrupting the current healthcare system with their unique experiences.

We do not conduct interviews by text nor will we send you a job offer unless you've interviewed with multiple people, including the Director of People & Talent, over video interviews. Job scams do exist so please be careful with your personal information.

rows.title: Reporting Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Position OverviewThe Data/Reporting Analyst plays a critical role in supporting the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and ensuring regulatory adherence across Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) operations. This individual will manage, analyze, and report on large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential discrepancies related to Fraud, Waste, and Abuse (FWA). The analyst will maintain recurring government and client reporting, ensuring that all data submitted to CMS, State Medicaid agencies, and health plan partners is highly accurate and compliant. Key ResponsibilitiesSIU Program Support Analyze trip logs, billing records, and driver credentialing data to identify suspicious patterns, anomalies, or compliance breaches that require SIU investigation.Regulatory & Client Reporting Develop, generate, and maintain recurring and ad-hoc reports required by CMS, State Medicaid programs, and managed care organization (MCO) clients.Data Integrity & Quality Assurance Perform regular data validation checks to ensure the accuracy and consistency of operational and financial data across internal systems.Trend Analysis Proactively identify operational trends, cost drivers, or service discrepancies, transforming raw data into actionable insights for the compliance and operations teams.Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with operations, network credentialing, and IT teams to resolve data discrepancies and improve data collection processes.

 QualificationsCore Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and demonstrated ability to manage large, complex datasets.Desirable Technical Skills Hands-on experience with SQL and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, QuickSight) is highly preferred.Analytical Aptitude Exceptional attention to detail with strong critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.Communication Strong written communication skills with the ability to distill complex data findings into clear, concise executive summaries.Industry Experience (Plus) Previous experience in healthcare, Medicare/Medicaid reporting, NEMT, or corporate compliance/audit functions.

rows.title: Associate, Process Manager
rows.descriptionText:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Gateway & Network Billing Specialist to manage, optimize, and reconcile our payment gateway and card network billing operations. In this role, you will be responsible for tracking, auditing, and processing complex transaction fee structures from major card networks (Visa, Mastercard) and payment gateways (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, Authorize.net). You will ensure accurate revenue settlement, eliminate billing leaks, and partner with finance, engineering, and product teams to optimize processing costs.

General Responsibilities: 

Network & Gateway Fee Auditing: Review, reconcile, and audit complex monthly invoices from payment gateways, acquiring banks, and card networks (interchange fees, assessment fees, gateway processing fees). Transaction Billing & Settlement: Oversee end-to-end payment gateway transaction billing, ensuring accurate fee application, payout reconciliation, and revenue assurance across all payment methods. Discrepancy & Dispute Resolution: Identify, investigate, and resolve billing anomalies, interchange downgrades, chargeback fees, and unexpected network penalties alongside processor account managers. Financial Reporting & Analytics: Build and maintain financial dashboards to track processing cost trends, cost-per-transaction metrics, and margin impacts to present actionable insights to leadership. Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate current payment routing and fee schedules to recommend cost-reduction strategies and eliminate manual reconciliation workflows. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product, and Finance to ensure new billing features, payment methods, or gateway integrations are configured correctly for accurate fee tracking. Compliance & Governance: Ensure all billing practices and data handling conform to PCI-DSS standards and relevant financial compliance regulations. 

Basic Qualifications: 

High School Diploma, GED or equivalent certification At least 1 year of experience with Microsoft Office or G Suite At least 1 year of process management experience 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Bachelors DegreeLean, Agile, Six Sigma, Business Process Management, or Project Management certification

rows.title: Senior Business Analyst - AI Strategy & Tooling
rows.descriptionText:
Join the team redefining credit analytics through AI! At Capital One, our credit policies are powered by data, and our future is driven by the transformative potential of AI. We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to act as a pioneer in our AI tooling space, maximizing the impact of large language models and generative technologies within Card analytics. You won’t just be using AI; you’ll be the architect of how our organization adopts it, establishing the frameworks for how we integrate tools like Gemini, Claude, and our AI Platform into the daily workflows of our analysts. As a trailblazer on this front, you will be responsible for setting the standard for AI usage and disseminating breakthrough learnings across the department.

This role blends product vision with hands-on execution. Beyond defining the roadmap for our next generation of credit tools, you will actively drive their development - gathering deep user context, leveraging Claude to engineer new workflows, and partnering with Business Analysts to ensure seamless enterprise adoption. Our team currently manages a sophisticated suite of tools that predict account performance and pinpoint risky populations, and your mission is to push these boundaries further. You will identify and operationalize untapped use cases that keep our analytical ecosystem streamlined, thorough, and ahead of the curve.

We are looking for a strong communicator with a rigorous analytical mindset and a genuine interest in emerging technology. While deep technical expertise is not required, you must possess the technical curiosity to navigate our data environments and the ingenuity to experiment with new AI capabilities as they are released. If you are a trailblazer eager to shape the future of analytics, we want you to help us build what’s next.

General Responsibilities:

Analysis: Identify business challenges and opportunities for improvement and solve for them using analysis to make strategic or tactical recommendationsProduct: Perform modeling/analytics to assist new product and pricing strategies for various lending productsMarketing: Support direct-to-consumer marketing efforts for select products, and strategic intent for products distributed through the retail channel. Help build targeted insights to inform the design and development of new customer experiences, as well as breakthrough technology and concepts designed to deliver on new go to market strategiesCredit Risk: Support step-change improvements in credit performance by connecting drivers of future consumer credit trends to historical behavior, creating risk models, and testing hypotheses using rigorous monitoring and analysisExecution: Involve problem frame-works, develop hypotheses, test and analysis, solution development, scope operational feasibility, lead implementation efforts and develop a monitoring planPartnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One including: IT, Sales, Operations, Finance and others to drive improvement in quality, volume, service, and profitabilityStrategic & analytic orientation: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the business is based on rigorous analytic marketing & credit risk managementStrong business judgment, leadership and integrity: He/she should be a tenacious decision maker, able to bring a healthy, aggressive, yet responsible approach to businessStrong communication skills: Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skillsClear results orientation: display an intense focus on achieving both short and long term goals. Previous consulting experience is a plus

rows.descriptionText:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 50% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems has an immediate opening for a Senior Manager to lead Business Development Operations and Customer Engagement Coordination. Location in the Mclean, VA Northrop Grumman Defense Systems site. Considerable travel is required.

Reporting directly to the Director of Strategy and Market Development, for the C2 and Weapons Integration Division, this individual serves as the central lead of team operations and is responsible for establishing and implementing processes to support global capture and business development, coordinates senior customer engagement, assists in development of communications and messaging, as well as serves as a point of contact in cross-functional support. This individual often serves as the Delegate of Authority for the Director at executive level meetings and reviews.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities Include

Capture and Business Development Support

Support business opportunity pipeline by developing and updating Salesforce dashboards and graphics to communicate the business pipeline’s healthConduct analysis and assessments of business opportunity pipeline and make recommendations for improving capture and win ratesAssist in development of presentations and coordination of inputs across the strategy, business development, and capture teamsLeads and coordinates contributions to internal reviews such as Corporate, Sector, and Division Monthly Pipeline Reviews, Capture Health and update reviews, priority win reviewsMaintain awareness of significant policy, program, budget and legislative initiatives effecting corporate goals

Customer Engagement Planning and Preparations

Coordinate, integrate and synchronize division customer engagements in alignment with sector and corporate customer engagement processPrior to customer engagements, ensure senior leaders are prepared with meeting objectives, background, talking points, and logistical details.Assist in planning trade show participation and sponsorship, customer engagements, logistics, and preparation.Ensure division customer engagements are captured in Salesforce with appropriate notes in accordance with NG policy.Support division, sector, and corporate teams in the design, construction and execution of customer analysis plans, strategic customer approach plans, and customer contact plans.

Communications and Messaging

Assists in the development of strategic communications and messaging to customersCreate presentations to articulate processes and plans for the teamHelp develop annual team strategic goals and objectives and present to broader team

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree with 8 years of experience related to Department of War (DoW) business or programs; or Master's Degree with 6 years of experience related to Department of War (DoW) business or programs.The ability to analyze a broad range of issues, and a demonstrated ability in strategic thinking to best influence senior DoW civilian and military decision-makersExperience communicating clearly and succinctly salient details of complex subjects to a senior audienceBusiness development, capture, or technical experienceKnowledge of DoW acquisition, requirements, and budget policies and processesStrong Salesforce and Tableau skills—specifically with dashboard creation and Salesforce data analysisActive Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in Business Development or government relations related roleIntegrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) and/or Command and Control (C2) domain, program, or operational experience10 years of experience related to Department of War (DoW) programsKnowledgeable in Customer Relationships Management (CRM) tools (e.g. Salesforce)Proven success with leading project teams or peopleExperience working in a matrix organization or environmentActive Top Secret clearance

rows.title: Social Media Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Company Overview

XPECT Solutions, LLC has built a strong reputation by supporting our clients in meeting their strategic goals and mission objectives. We provide high quality resources for a wide range of IT and security solutions at best-value pricing. Our success is built on a solid foundation of well-vetted, highly technical personnel, a disciplined project management approach, and an overarching commitment to customer service. We develop, test, deploy, and support exceptional solutions that enhance system functionality, while maximizing reliability and availability, and ensure the tightest security.

Job Overview

The Social Media Coordinator executes day-to-day social media posting for the our Federal Government customer's brand across every channel, working within Creative Studio under the direction of the Social Media Manager. This is a hands-on execution role centered on caption writing and scheduling/posting in Hootsuite. The Coordinator is the primary driver of daily social media execution, responsible for getting approved content live across all channels in a timely, accurate, and brand-compliant manner.

Own day-to-day social media execution across all channels Write captions and schedule/post content using Hootsuite Maintain the social content calendar Support the Social Media Manager on major campaign and event content 

Core Responsibilities

Execute day-to-day social media posting and scheduling using Hootsuite across all channels. Write engaging, on-brand captions for scheduled posts. Maintain and update the social content calendar. Support the Social Media Manager in preparing posts for major campaign moments (e.g., the event launch, event coverage). Monitor comments and direct messages for routine engagement, escalating sensitive to the Social Media Manager. Coordinate with the Multi-Media Specialists and Copywriter to keep the posting calendar stocked with ready assets. Track and log basic post-performance metrics to support reporting Ensure quality assurance check is run before posting. Experienced at tagging, link validation, accessibility checks (alt text, captions, etc.). Maintaining brand consistency and adherence to communication standards. 

Requirements

1-4 years of experience in social media coordination, content, or marketing. Hands-on experience with Hootsuite or a comparable social media scheduling platform. Experience posting on behalf of a government, federal, or other highly regulated brand. Experience with recruitment marketing or employer branding content. Strong caption writing and copywriting skills. Comfortable executing a content calendar under direction from a manager. Ability to assist with posting campaign development and the implementation of the approved plan. Ability to manage postings under expedited conditions and extreme pressure deadlines. Maintaining 508 compliance. Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred; or 6 years of equivalent professional experience in lieu of degree. Able to obtain a security clearance. U.S. citizenship required. 

Preferred Additional Skills And Qualifications

Preferred Additional Skills 

Managing a multi-platform posting calendar at scale. Basic social media analytics/reporting experience. Using of Hootsuite Analytics or comparable tools. Applying basic image/video assets. Applying accessibility and digital content standards. 

Preferred Certifications 

Hootsuite Social Marketing Certification Hootsuite Platform Certification HubSpot Social Media Marketing Certification Meta Certified Digital Marketing Associate or current Meta social media credential Google Analytics Certification (GA4) for basic performance tracking and reporting LinkedIn Marketing Labs Certification 

Benefits

Xpect Solutions, LLC is a one-of-a-kind employer with a talented team that is cleared at various levels and is certified in dozens of industry-recognized certifications. Our talented staff are the key to our success. They bring the knowledge, experience and technical skills to deliver the best solutions to our customers.

We support our team by providing open communication, win-win partnerships with clients and vendors, a team-oriented culture, and a focus on professional development and growth for a long-lasting and happy career.

We offer a benefits package that is designed to keep our most important assets - our employees - healthy, happy, energized and moving forward. Our philosophy is simple - empower our employees with the benefits, resources and the financial incentives they need to be successful.

Benefits And Perks

A competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision planRetirement Savings PlanLife InsuranceAD&D InsuranceShort Term and Long Term Disability Insurance3 weeks of annual PTO11 days of Holiday PTOPerformance AwardsReferral Bonus Plan (of up to $5,000/year)Education Reimbursement/Training (of up to $2,500/year)

rows.title: Manager Marketing of Strategy & Operations
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Join Nestlé USA's Center for Demand Generation (CDG) as a Marketing Manager, Strategy & Operations. In this highly visible role, you will help shape and drive key enterprise marketing priorities, including marketing transformation, Trust & Transparency initiatives, and functional operations. Working across marketing, corporate affairs, and other cross-functional teams, you will translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, aligned execution, and scalable tools and processes that strengthen marketing effectiveness and help drive growth across Nestlé's Food & Beverage portfolio.

This role is ideal for a marketer, strategist, or business operations leader who enjoys driving organizational effectiveness, leading cross-functional initiatives, and translating complex business priorities into action across a large, matrixed organization.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic One Marketing and CDG Operations

Lead core One Marketing and Center for Demand Generation routines, helping establish priorities, enable decision-making, and maintain the operating rhythm required to drive execution.Drive alignment on key initiatives by shaping agendas and content, engaging the right stakeholders, and ensuring decisions and actions move forward effectively.Continuously evolve team routines and engagement approaches based on business priorities, organizational learnings, and seasonal needs to improve effectiveness, focus, and collaboration.Support brand and business planning processes by translating strategic priorities into actionable plans, cross-functional alignment, and clear next steps.

Trust & Transparency

Lead implementation of Nestlé USA's Trust & Transparency strategy by partnering with technical and content experts to shape priorities, tailor workstreams, and enable execution through playbooks, tools, and coaching.Serve as a strategic and operational partner across key forums, translating priorities into coordinated action across the broader Trust & Transparency organization.Amplify progress, milestones, and key advancements in ways that build understanding, credibility, and trust among internal and external stakeholders.

Marketing Transformation and Capability Development

Help shape the future of the marketing function by identifying capability needs and partnering with Learning & Development to deliver tools, training, and enablement solutions that drive adoption at scale.Translate strategic priorities into practical tools, resources, and content that accelerate adoption, reinforce best practices, and strengthen marketing excellence across the organization.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced business training preferred.5+ years of experience in marketing, commercial strategy, business operations, management consulting, or related fields, with a demonstrated ability to translate strategic priorities into cross-functional plans and execution.Experience in CPG or other complex, matrixed organizations strongly preferred, particularly in roles requiring cross-functional influence, structured planning, and operational excellence.

Experience / Skills

Proven ability to influence across levels and functions, building alignment and momentum in complex, matrixed environments without direct authority.Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect business insights and organizational priorities to practical solutions.Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, adapt to change, and deliver results in fast-paced environments.High degree of ownership and self-direction, with the ability to operate independently and move work forward with sound judgment.Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to tailor messages, facilitate alignment, and build credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional partners.Strong prioritization and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, bring structure to complex work, and consistently deliver high-quality outcomes.

Salary: $127,000.00 to $170,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1-800-321-6467.

rows.descriptionText:
About M&c Saatchi World Services

M&C Saatchi World Services is a full-service marketing company renowned for using commercial advertising to solve the world’s toughest challenges. World Services is a specialty branch of M&C Saatchi Group, and we provide strategic communications, behavior change, and marketing support to Public Sector clients with special emphasis on the US Federal Government and State, Local, Tribal, & Territorial leaders.

M&C Saatchi World Services US is seeking a highly analytical and intellectually curious Analyst. This role conducts research, monitoring, and analysis in support of communications, outreach, and stakeholder engagement initiatives, transforming complex information into actionable insights that inform strategy, strengthen decision-making, and support mission objectives across diverse audiences and operating environments.

THE ROLE

M&C Saatchi World Services is seeking a detail-oriented and analytically minded Analyst to support performance measurement, audience insights, and data-driven decision-making across a diverse portfolio of federal programs.

Working closely with communications, stakeholder engagement, digital, UX, and program teams, you will transform complex datasets into actionable insights that help optimize performance, improve audience engagement, and strengthen mission outcomes. You will play a key role in analyzing performance metrics, identifying trends, developing dashboards, and delivering reporting that supports strategic planning and operational decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with excellent communication skills and the ability to translate data into meaningful narratives. They are comfortable working with structured datasets, collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, and providing insights that drive measurable improvements across communications, outreach, and engagement activities.

This is a hybrid role; however, the ideal candidate will live in the District of Columbia, Maryland, and Virginia (DMV) region.

Key Responsibilities

 Analyze performance data across communications, outreach, stakeholder engagement, digital platforms, and program activities. Perform data analytics on quantitative and qualitative datasets, to include visualizing key findings in charts or graphics. Define, track, and evaluate key performance indicators, audience segments, and operational metrics that support organizational objectives. Develop dashboards, reports, visualizations, and performance summaries that communicate insights clearly to stakeholders and decision-makers. Conduct trend analysis, variance identification, forecasting, and performance assessments to support planning and continuous improvement efforts. Analyze digital channel performance, including web, email, social media, audience engagement, and campaign metrics. Analyze social media performance across owned and paid channels, evaluating audience growth, engagement, sentiment, content performance, platform trends, and campaign effectiveness to generate actionable insights and optimization recommendations. Perform open source and desk research in order to obtain audience insights, market analytics, and to identify research gaps. Support the creation and implementation of formative research plans to understand target audiences. Support the creation and implementation of evaluation strategies and activities. Identify patterns, opportunities, inefficiencies, and areas for optimization across programs and initiatives. Collaborate with communications, UX, stakeholder engagement, IT, and governance teams to align measurement approaches with business and mission needs. Support the development and refinement of KPI frameworks, taxonomies, reporting methodologies, and data models. Maintain data quality standards, metadata integrity, documentation, and reporting consistency across analytics activities. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting products, executive summaries, and performance insights. Support automation and streamlining of reporting workflows where appropriate. Translate quantitative findings into actionable recommendations that support strategic decision-making and program effectiveness.


Key Attributes

 Experience working in primary research, data analytics, business intelligence, performance measurement, marketing analytics, research, or related analytical disciplines. Strong analytical and quantitative reasoning abilities with the ability to interpret complex datasets and identify meaningful insights. Experience developing dashboards, reports, visualizations, and performance summaries for stakeholders and decision-makers. Experience utilizing AI-assisted research, media monitoring, social listening, and audience intelligence tools to support analysis and strategic recommendations. Curiosity in technology landscape and how AI is changing communications. Proficiency with analytics and business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, or similar tools. Strong understanding of KPI development, segmentation analysis, measurement frameworks, and performance reporting. Experience working with structured datasets, reporting systems, and data visualization methodologies. Familiarity with SPSS, SQL, Python, R, or other analytical tools is preferred. Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and translate data into compelling narratives and recommendations. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and consistency. Experience collaborating across communications, stakeholder engagement, digital, UX, technical, and program teams. Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple reporting cycles and priorities simultaneously. Experience supporting federal government, public affairs, stakeholder engagement, digital communications, or mission-driven programs is preferred. Location: Hybrid, able to commute regularly to the Washington DC office space. Language Requirements: Fluent written and spoken English required. Educational Requirements: BA/BS in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics, or a related field preferred.


Eligibility Requirements:

 U.S. Citizenship: Must be a United States Citizen (required by government contract). Clearance Eligibility: Must be able and willing to obtain a U.S. Government Secret or Top Secret security clearance immediately upon employment. Background Screening: Must be willing to submit to a rigorous federal background investigation, which includes an in-depth review of personal finances, criminal history, employment history, and drug use.


WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

 Work on impactful programs supporting federal and defense-related initiatives. Collaborate with high-performing cross-functional teams across communications, digital and analytics disciplines. Opportunity to shape strategic public engagement initiatives at enterprise scale. Flexible hybrid working environment. Exposure to complex, mission-driven stakeholder engagement challenges. Career development opportunities within a fast-growing global organization.


What You Get

 We offer a competitive salary and a benefits package designed to support your health, family life, financial wellbeing, and growth.


The salary range provided reflects the anticipated compensation for this role across our Washington, DC and New York locations. Actual starting salary will be determined based on geographic location, relevant experience, skills, and other job-related factors.

Family & parental support 

 12 weeks’ full pay for Primary Carers and 6 weeks for Secondary Carers (after one year of service; return requirements apply for subsequent leave) Applies to birth, adoption, and surrogacy Up to 10 days’ paid fertility leave per year (5 per cycle) 2 days’ paid leave for new grandparents $2,500 annual interest-free parental loan $6,000 interest-free fertility treatment loan

 Choice of three medical plans (HSA at $0 cost; EPO 75% employer funded; PPO 65% employer funded) 70% employer-funded dental and vision coverage Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, including an office closure between Christmas & New Year's Gym membership reimbursement and/or Wellhub subscription 401(k) with 5% employer match 24/7 mental health support through Self Space Social events, happy hours, professional development trainings, etc. Work from anywhere for up to 2 weeks per year (subject to approval)


Culture & development 

 $300 annual cultural stimulation allowance (accrued monthly; available after 90 days) Weekly Thursday happy hour Mentorship and Buddy programs

rows.title: Junior Palo Alto Integration Technician
rows.descriptionText:
VIATEQ Corporation is looking for a Junior Palo Alto Integration Technician to support enterprise network security operations and IT administrative and operational support services for a federal government client. This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a government background investigation, PIV credentials, and all requisite IT access authorizations prior to performing work. Primary work will be performed at the client site and approved remote/telework locations.

 


This role serves as an entry-level technical support function responsible for assisting in the administration, monitoring, and operational support of enterprise Palo Alto Networks security platform capabilities across a complex federal IT environment spanning on-premises infrastructure, cloud platforms, and hybrid network environments.

 


The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic and detail-oriented early-career network security professional with foundational knowledge of Palo Alto Networks technologies, enterprise networking concepts, and Federal cybersecurity compliance requirements. This individual must possess a strong desire to learn and grow within a dynamic federal IT security environment, a collaborative and disciplined work ethic, and the technical foundation necessary to support the administration and monitoring of enterprise Palo Alto Networks security infrastructure under the guidance of mid-level and senior engineers.

 


The Junior Palo Alto Integration Technician will serve as a supporting technical contributor within the program's network security team, assisting mid-level and senior Palo Alto Networks engineers in the day-to-day administration, monitoring, and operational support of enterprise Palo Alto Networks security infrastructure. This individual supports the protection of Government networks and systems through the monitoring of Palo Alto Networks platform health and security events, execution of routine administrative tasks, preparation of change documentation, and maintenance of platform operational records under established procedures and senior engineer guidance. 

 


Responsibilities:Platform Monitoring & Health Management

 Monitor Palo Alto Networks NGFW, Panorama, Prisma Access, and Cortex XDR platform dashboards and management consoles under the guidance of senior engineers, identifying and escalating platform health issues, service disruptions, and anomalous conditions in accordance with defined monitoring procedures and escalation thresholds.
 Monitor NGFW and Panorama system health indicators, including CPU utilization, memory usage, session table capacity, interface status, and high availability synchronization status, escalating threshold violations to senior engineers for investigation and resolution.
 Monitor log forwarding and data ingestion pipelines for Palo Alto Networks platforms, identifying and escalating log gaps, forwarding failures, and data quality issues that may impact security monitoring coverage or platform operational visibility.
 Generate and distribute routine Palo Alto Networks platform health and operational status reports, providing program leadership and Government stakeholders with accurate, current visibility into platform availability, performance, and security event activity.
 Assist in the monitoring of Panorama managed device connectivity and policy synchronization status, identifying and escalating managed device connectivity failures or policy push errors requiring senior engineer attention.
 Support the monitoring of Prisma Access service health and GlobalProtect connectivity status, escalating service disruptions and user connectivity issues to senior engineers for investigation and resolution.



Administrative Support & Routine Operations

 Execute routine Palo Alto Networks NGFW and Panorama administrative tasks under the direction and oversight of senior engineers, including policy backups, configuration exports, log archival activities, and administrative account management.
 Assist in the execution of approved firewall rule changes, security profile updates, and routine configuration modifications under direct senior engineer supervision, following defined implementation procedures and change management requirements.
 Support the management of Palo Alto Networks administrative user accounts, ensuring account provisioning, modification, and deprovisioning activities are completed accurately and documented in accordance with program access management procedures.
 Assist in the administration and maintenance of Palo Alto Networks platform certificates, including monitoring certificate expiration dates and supporting certificate renewal activities under senior engineer guidance.
 Support the execution of Palo Alto Networks platform software updates, security content updates, and application and threat signature updates under senior engineer direction, following defined maintenance windows and change management procedures.
 Assist in the maintenance of GlobalProtect remote access configurations, supporting routine administrative tasks related to gateway management, user enrollment, and agent deployment activities under senior engineer guidance.



Log Analysis & Security Event Monitoring

 Monitor Palo Alto Networks NGFW threat prevention logs, traffic logs, URL filtering logs, and WildFire analysis results under the guidance of senior engineers, identifying security events requiring escalation in accordance with defined monitoring procedures and escalation thresholds.
 Assist in the triage and initial analysis of Palo Alto Networks security alerts and threat prevention events, gathering relevant log data and contextual information to support senior analyst and engineer investigation and response activities.
 Support the development and maintenance of routine log analysis and alert monitoring procedures, contributing practical observations from daily monitoring activities to runbook and standard operating procedure improvement efforts.
 Assist in the identification of false positive alert patterns and routine security event noise, supporting senior engineers in refining alert thresholds and monitoring procedures to improve operational efficiency.
 Generate routine threat prevention and security event reports from Palo Alto Networks platforms and Panorama, supporting program security reporting and compliance documentation requirements.



Change Management Support

 Assist in the preparation of Palo Alto Networks change request documentation for Change Advisory Board (CAB) submission under senior engineer guidance, contributing to the development of implementation plans, technical impact descriptions, rollback procedures, and test step documentation.
 Support the scheduling and coordination of approved Palo Alto Networks platform changes, assisting in the organization of maintenance window activities and the communication of change schedules to relevant stakeholders.
 Assist in the execution of approved platform changes under direct senior engineer supervision, following defined implementation procedures and documenting execution steps and outcomes in change management records.

rows.title: Research Technician - Project Technical Resources (Temp-to-Hire)
rows.descriptionText:
Primary Work Address: 19700 Helix Drive, Ashburn, VA, 20147

Current HHMI Employees, click here to apply via your Workday account.

The Howard Hughes Medical Institute’s Janelia Research Campus is a pioneering research center in Ashburn, Virginia, where scientists pursue fundamental questions in the life sciences. Our integrated teams of biologists, computational scientists, and tool-builders innovate research practices and technologies to solve biology’s deepest mysteries. HHMI launched Janelia in 2006, establishing an intellectually enriching environment for scientists to do creative, collaborative, hands-on work. We share our methods, results, and tools with the scientific community.

About the Role:

The PTR-BioImage Analysis team within Project Technical Resources (PTR) is seeking three full-time technicians who want to engage in a variety of annotation and image analysis projects. This will include segmentation of 3D electron microscopy datasets or lightsheet images of expanded tissues, cell tracking in 4D light microscopy videos, and annotation of fish behavior. The combination of projects and emphasis may change over time, requiring agile adaptation to the specific requirements. Annotations will typically serve as ground truth for automated image processing pipelines that are being established in the context of AI@HHMI projects. Technicians will often be involved in at least two different projects. This job is ideal for somebody who likes to work with images and enjoys manual annotations/drawing; it is not suited for someone who wishes to develop computational pipelines.

Temp-to-hire applicants will be trained in all required techniques upon starting work. After training, technicians will work under supervision by the team’s manager and/or scientific project lead, collaborating with other team members, labs/project teams, and support groups. Please note: This is a 2-month temporary position with the potential to be extended or become permanent, dependent on successful training. Applicants with significant prior experience in relevant work may be considered for immediate HHMI employment.

What We Provide:

Gain research experience in a collaborative and supportive research environment. A diverse team looking forward to exploring how your unique background, talents, and interests could contribute to PTRs ability to support science at Janelia. 

What You'll Do:

Gain an in-depth knowledge of using commercial and custom annotation software Good spatial visualization skills and hand-eye coordination. Collect relevant data from multidimensional images and videos Review/correct automatically or manually generated annotations Provide feedback about image quality and/or software performance Provide feedback on annotation challenges and report biological observations Perform computer automated analysis and quality control on large data sets Perform preparative work for experiments or other routine lab chores as required 

What You Bring: 

Bachelor Degree or Associate Degree with equivalent experience in biology, biomedical engineering, or computer science Demonstrated proficiency with computers Work experience in a team-oriented environment and skills to be a good team-player Interest in engaging in ground-breaking research in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Good organizational skills Excellent interpersonal skills to communicate efficiently with collaborators 

Physical Requirements: 

Remaining in a normal seated or standing position for extended periods of time; reaching and grasping by extending hand(s) or arm(s); dexterity to manipulate objects with fingers, for example using a keyboard; communication skills using the spoken word; ability to see and hear within normal parameters; ability to move about workspace. The position requires mobility, including the ability to move materials weighing up to several pounds (such as a laptop computer or tablet). Work may involve possible exposure to malodorous vapors, low dose radiation, contamination by toxic chemicals and acids and presence of carcinogenic substances or other hazardous materials.

Good color vision, ability to visualize in 3D, ability to sit for several hours at a computer or microscope (with breaks), fine motor skills.

Persons with disabilities may be able to perform the essential duties of this position with reasonable accommodation. Requests for reasonable accommodation will be evaluated on an individual basis.

Please Note: 

This job description sets forth the job’s principal duties, responsibilities, and requirements; it should not be construed as an exhaustive statement, however. Unless they begin with the word “may,” the Essential Duties and Responsibilities described above are “essential functions” of the job, as defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Hiring Pay Range

Research Technician I (hourly): $18.31 - $22.88

Research Technician II (salary): $45,440.00 - $56,800.00

The posted range reflects HHMI’s good faith estimate of the anticipated hiring salary range for this role at the time of posting. Actual hiring compensation is determined by a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and internal equity.

Compensation And Benefits

Our employees are compensated from a total rewards perspective in many ways for their contributions to our mission, including competitive pay, exceptional health benefits, retirement plans, time off, and a range of recognition and wellness programs. Visit our Benefits at HHMI site to learn more.

HHMI is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We use E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

 Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron’s top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. Job Summary

The Relationship Manager (RM) I is a strategic, client-facing role within the Client Service department. The RM is designed to elevate the delivery of service excellence across the Wealth Management team. This role partners closely with Wealth Advisors to ensure that service commitments made to clients are implemented with precision, consistency, and care.

This role is responsible for overseeing the execution of the firm’s service model, ensuring that client experiences align with the firm’s standards and values. The Relationship Manager I plays a critical role in practice management, client retention, and business growth, serving as a key contributor to the success of the advisory team.

This role offers a clear career path to Relationship Manager II and III, with increasing levels of strategic influence, leadership, and client engagement.

Client Experience Oversight

Essential Job Functions for this role include:

Ensure the consistent delivery of service commitments made to clients, acting as a steward of the firm’s client experience standards.Manage service workflows and client touchpoints to ensure timely and accurate execution.Serve as a strategic liaison between clients and internal teams, resolving issues and identifying opportunities to enhance service delivery.Lead client follow-up initiatives post-meetings to ensure all action items are completed and documented.Other duties as assigned.

Advisor Partnership & Practice Management

Partner with Wealth Advisors to support client segmentation, service tiering, and strategic planning.Facilitate in implementing and refining the advisory team’s service model, including client communication strategies and engagement protocols.Track and report on client satisfaction metrics, service delivery KPIs, and retention trends.Collaborate with internal departments (e.g., financial planning, investment operations, compliance) to ensure alignment and efficiency.

Growth & Retention Support

Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships through proactive outreach and strategic engagement.Support business development efforts by helping advisors prepare for prospect meetings and onboarding new clients.Maintain a pulse on client needs and preferences, surfacing insights that inform advisor strategy and firm initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong understanding of wealth management processes and service models.Proven ability to manage complex client relationships and resolve issues effectively.Leadership and mentoring experience within a team environment.Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.Proficiency in CRM systems and workflow management tools.Strategic thinker and strong ability to influence and collaborate across teams.

Work Schedule

This professional role requires availability during standard business hours of Monday through Friday from 8AM to 5PM. At times, the role may have early or late hours to meet business tasks and deadlines for external and internal client needs.

All roles classified as a non-exempt are required to record working time into the timekeeping system daily at the start and end of each workday plus a 30-minute unpaid lunch period.

Working Conditions

This position may be in a professional office environment or a dedicated home office workspace which is free of interruptions. Whether position is in a dedicated office space or home office workspace, basic technology needs will be provided to satisfy position requirements. Routinely sitting and standing for periods of time. No heavy lifting over 10 lbs.

Actual base pay within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the applicant’s geographic location, relevant experience, education, skills and licenses/certifications. This position is also eligible to earn incentive compensation through one of Mercer Advisors’ incentive compensation programs.

Base Pay Range

$68,000 - $80,000 USD

Benefits

Mercer Advisors offers a competitive and robust benefit package to our employees. Our benefit programs are focused on meeting all of our employees and their eligible dependents health and welfare needs. We offer the following:

We are not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting.

At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The Customer Retention team drives targeted outreach to small and medium business owners. We focus on building meaningful engagement through personalized, multi‑channel communication. This role plays a key part in supporting the development, testing, and deployment of email and phone campaigns across Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) and Salesforce Sales Cloud.

Key Responsibilities

Development

Build, test, and deploy campaign journeys in SFMC for email and phone programs, including triggered, recurring, and ad‑hoc sends. Configure and maintain CloudPages, forms, and preference centers to support data capture and campaign functionality. Create and manage audience segmentation, synchronized data extensions, data entry events, and automations. Maintain campaign assets, templates, and shared data extensions across USPS Business Units, ensuring governance, naming standards, and quality control. Set up and manage end‑to‑end data integrations, including automated Databricks‑to‑SFMC data transfers, with thorough testing, validation, and monitoring. Build automated campaigns using real‑time or near‑real‑time triggers originating from Salesforce or Databricks. 

Quality Assurance (QA)

Conduct full QA across journeys, data flows, segmentation logic, CloudPages, and campaign assets. Troubleshoot automation errors, send issues, data discrepancies, and integration breaks across SFMC, Sales Cloud, SFTP, and APIs. Monitor email deliverability, IP warming processes, and compliance with CAN-SPAM and data privacy guidelines. Document build steps, maintain QA checklists, runbooks, and processes for repeatable execution. 

Functional / Operations

Partner with internal teams to conduct campaign reviews, deployment readiness checks, and production QA sign‑offs. Support campaign project planning, coordinate deployment timelines, and collaborate with both internal teams and external stakeholders. Monitor campaign performance post‑deployment; handle issue resolution and support analytics/reporting activities. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of all outbound marketing campaigns across channels. 

Required Experience & Skills

Experience managing Salesforce Sales Cloud integrations with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio). Proficiency with SFMC data management, SQL, and AMPscript. Familiarity with email deliverability practices and tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Validity Everest/Return Path). Strong understanding of campaign workflows, governance, and quality control across multiple brands or business units. Experience with Einstein features such as Send Time Optimization and Engagement Scoring, and ability to apply them in journey design. Exceptional attention to detail and strong troubleshooting skills. Ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple projects in a fast‑paced environment.
