rows.title: Watchlist Analyst JR
rows.descriptionText:
Purpose and Impact: 

Amentum provides warning and all-source analytical support to DIA’s Defense Combating Terrorism Office to drive DoD policy, planning, and operational decisions to counter regional and transnational terrorism threats. We conduct mission-critical counterterrorism analysis focused on operational and strategic effects against emerging terrorist threat networks and identities operating globally with intent to harm U.S. persons, facilities, and interests. Our work includes delivering national watchlisting support to the TIDE database, providing expert assessments for the Pentagon/Joint Staff, and 24/7/365 support to DoD and senior policy decision makers, as well as international and interagency partners, on predictive threat assessments regarding transnational and regional terrorist threats. Amentum analysts also support the Congressionally-mandated Prisoner of War/Missing in Action cell with analysis, collection, and 24/7 support to the U.S. government for global hostage threats or events against U.S. citizens.

Work Schedule: First Shift – 8 hours per day

Essential Responsibilities:

Systematically and deliberately reviews DoD datasets assessed as likely to contain identifying information for known or suspected terrorists. Identity, prioritize, and record information from known DoD datasets related to known or suspected terrorists as specified by the Government. Crosscheck/research known or suspected terrorists against other intelligence holdings to ensure completeness of information and to avoid duplicating data entries. Compile information into a nomination report format as specified by the Government. Correctly format, classify, and address reports. Ensure information contained within reports is intelligible, cogent, comprehensive, and understandable, and that all reports use proper grammar and spelling. Meet Terrorist Identity Nomination (TIN) production schedule. Correct and resubmit incorrect reports and prepare reports for dissemination as record message traffic or other dissemination methods as specified by the Government. Provide guidance and instruction for less experienced team members assigned to Watchlisting. Demonstrate general knowledge and understanding of IC organizations associated with CT operations, analysis, products, and information systems. Attend and participate in meetings, conferences, intelligence exchanges, roundtables, working groups, and other types of analytic exchanges in support or DIA’s Watchlisting mission. Possess general information systems experience working with select DoD datasets and intelligence reporting activities: demonstrate comprehensive mission knowledge in order to provide guidance related to National Terrorist Watchlisting policies and procedures. Demonstrate in-depth knowledge and understanding of terrorist organizations, to include group names and geographic location, leadership, activities, and ideology. 

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Watchlist Analyst – Performs all-source intelligence analysis of DoD datasets to identify and nominate known or suspected terrorists into the National Terrorist Watchlisting system. Develops DoD recommendations for the no-fly, selectee, or other national terrorist watch lists as appropriate, to fulfill the DoD component of Homeland Security Presidential Directives (HSPDs) 6 and 11 and reviews DoD datasets for identifying information of Known or Suspected Terrorists; and identifies, prioritizes, and records information from DoD datasets as specified by the Government. Produces analytic reports using DIA’s Watchlisting Data Organizer (WATCHDOG) and / or other internal DIA production tools. Prepares reports for dissemination by methods specified by the Government.

Security Clearance Required: 

TS/SCI POLY

Minimum Education: 

High School/GED 

Minimum Years of Experience:

2 years

Preferred Qualifications:

Desired Experience: 4 years of experience related to the specific labor category with at least a portion of the experience within the last 2 years. Desired Education: Bachelor’s degree in an area related to the labor category from a college or university accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. Demonstrates understanding of the 200 Series of ODNI’s ICDs: 203 - Analytic Standards, 206 – Sourcing Requirements for Disseminated Products, and 208 - Write for Maximum Utility. Produce formal written strategic counterterrorism and or all source intelligence assessments, products, graphics and briefings in accordance with ICD 203, DIA and ODNI standards as appropriate. Demonstrates ability to use research databases (e.g., Global Terrorism Database) and use quantifiable matrices in a professional setting to prepare written and oral products on complex topics.

rows.title: Research Inquiry Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join Us in Making a Difference in the Lives of Those Defending Our Nation!

Why SURVICE?

Come join the SURVICE Engineering mission to protect, enhance, and enable those who defend the United States. Since 1981, we have supported the DoD community, as well as Homeland Security, advanced technologies, environmental, and commercial markets. Our employees have backgrounds in engineering, physics, mathematics, chemistry, computer science, acquisition, technical writing, training, and other technical and administrative fields. And many of our personnel have DoD and/or operational military experience. If you're looking for a challenging and rewarding career with a leading organization, come see what we can offer you!

Position

Research Inquiry Analyst 

Location: Belcamp, MDSecurity Clearance: Active Clearance Required - U.S. citizenship requiredSalary: $65,000 - $75,000 Depending on Experience and EducationTravel: 10%Benefits: SURVICE Engineering offers a total rewards package to include competitive salaries, comprehensive insurance options, paid time off, 401k, flexible spending, tuition reimbursement.

Position Summary

SURVICE Engineering is currently seeking a Research Inquiry Analyst to support our DoD IAC Operation. You will accelerate your career and become an integral team member within the defense community.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities Of Research Inquiry Analyst

Research and respond to Technical Inquiries (TIs) on topics interrelated to any mixture of IAC's chartered focus areas: Software Data & Analysis; Cyber Security; Modeling & Simulation; Knowledge Management & Information Sharing; Advanced Materials; Autonomous Systems; Directed Energy; Energetics; Military Sensing; Non-Lethal Weapons; Reliability, Maintainability, Quality, Supportability, Interoperability (RMQSI); Survivability and Vulnerability; Weapon Systems; Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (C4ISR); Homeland Defense & Security; Critical Infrastructure Protection; Weapons of Mass Destruction; Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives (CBRNE) Defense; Biometrics; Medical; Cultural Studies; and Alternative Energy. Assist Functional Subject Area (FSA) leads and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with research and preparation of formal responses to technical inquiries, documenting sources and methodology used to satisfy the inquiry. Ensure that technical inquiries are closed out in a satisfactory and timely manner in accordance with the IAC contract and Quality Control plan. Support the population and management of the IAC Subject Matter Expert (SME) database. Conduct routine literature searches in the DTIC R&E Gateway and open source databases to support identification of emerging science and technology relevant to the IAC chartered focus areas above. Conduct data analysis to enhance the usefulness of IAC products and services in support of the DoD science and technology communities Assist with identification and processing of Scientific and Technical Information (STI), including technical reports and papers, for upload to the DTIC R&E Gateway. Support IAC web site and social media initiatives as requested. Gather information, experience, and lessons-learned to document and increase efficiency of IAC processes. Contribute to the preparation of the IAC products such as webinars, state of the art reports and news digests. Perform additional activities as requested by the IAC Management. 

Minimum Qualifications Of Research Inquiry Analyst

Science or Engineering Degree (A.A. in a Technical Discipline or comparable military background with tactical weapon systems + relevant experience may substitute) - 0+ years of relevant experience. Candidates are not required to possess all qualifications; is you possess some of the desired qualifications, please apply.

Desired Experience

Knowledge of science and technology developments with proficiency in conducting research and analysis leveraging a wide variety of technical tools including technical data repositories, technical publications subscriptions, and other research tools. Ability to quickly grasp advancing technology developments as applicable to DoD science and technology priorities.

About Us

SURVICE Engineering is a nationally recognized, single-source engineering service provider for Government and Industry organizations involved in all phases of the systems engineering process. Our employees are our most valuable asset, and they are proud to have supported the development, testing, analysis, and modeling and simulation (M&S) of many of the major U.S. air, land, and sea combat systems in the field today. They have also contributed their expertise to other vital national defense programs and technologies that involve survivability, cybersecurity, information technology/management, software engineering, unmanned aerial systems (UASs), and metrology/reverse engineering.

SURVICE Engineering is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

MITRE’s Data Science and Engineering department is looking for qualified applicants to bring their advanced data science, data engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and applied research skills to bear on solving problems of critical national importance. MITRE’s diverse work program provides opportunities to apply your expertise and creative thinking in challenging domains such as national security, intelligence, transportation, and healthcare. Employees may also participate in MITRE’s internal research and development program, which provides funding for innovative applied research that addresses our sponsors’ hardest problems.

Roles & Responsibilities:

The successful candidate for this position is a hybrid Data Scientist and Data Engineer who combines strong foundations in computer science, mathematics, and software engineering with hands-on experience designing data systems and applying advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve mission problems. This role requires practitioners who can operate across the full data lifecycle from data modeling, processing, and infrastructure engineering to statistical analysis, machine learning, experimentation, and operational deployment. Our organization values innovation and believes that keeping up with the latest research and technologies is essential.

The candidate should have hands-on experience in several of the areas specified below, however it is not required that a candidate has experience in all of these areas.

Advanced Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence

Machine Learning and Model Evaluation (e.g., supervised, unsupervised, deep learning, reinforcement learning)Statistical Analysis and Exploratory Data Analysis (e.g., descriptive statistics, regression, visualization)Large Language Models and AI-Assisted WorkflowsNatural Language Processing (e.g., summarization, classification, entity recognition, topic modeling)Anomaly Detection and Predictive ModelingGraph Analytics (e.g. centrality, similarity, link prediction) 

Data Engineering

Distributed Data Processing and Big Data Architectures (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, Ray, Dask, Kafka)Data Pipeline/ETL Development and Orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, NiFi)Batch and Streaming Data ProcessingData Modeling, Schema Design, and Data Quality AssessmentData Governance, Access Control, and Secure Data HandlingCloud-based Data Platforms and Storage Architectures 

Software Development and MLOps

Computer Programming and Databases – Proficiency in Python and SQL requiredSoftware Engineering Best Practices (e.g., version control, testing, modular design)MLOps and Model Operationalization (e.g., model deployment, monitoring, reproducibility, containerization)Linux-based Development Environments, Git, Containers, and Cloud Platforms

Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.This position requires a minimum of 3 days per week on-site.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Data Analyst Location: Hybrid Type: Full-Time 
Summary Weris is seeking a Data Analyst to support data-driven projects and initiatives through data analysis, reporting, visualization, and analytical modeling. This position will work with complex datasets to identify trends, evaluate performance, develop insights, and support informed decision-making. Working under the guidance of senior technical staff and project leadership, the Data Analyst will assist with data preparation, validation, analysis, visualization, and reporting. The position offers opportunities to work with a variety of analytical tools and technologies while contributing to the development of dashboards, models, automated processes, and other data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with the ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. This position will be working alongside and learning from a qualified technical team. 
Essential Duties & Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following: Collect, prepare, validate, and analyze large and complex datasets from multiple sources to support project objectives and organizational decision-making. Conduct trend, performance, comparative, predictive, and scenario-based analyses to identify patterns, anomalies, and key insights that inform strategic and operational decisions. Develop, maintain, and enhance recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, visualizations, and briefing materials using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and other reporting platforms. Collaborate with project teams, business stakeholders, and subject matter experts to understand analytical requirements, translate business questions into actionable analyses, and provide data-driven recommendations. Respond to data requests and deliver timely analytical support for project planning, performance monitoring, program evaluation, and decision-making activities. Communicate analytical findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences through presentations, reports, and data visualizations. Develop, refine, and maintain analytical models, methodologies, and statistical techniques used to evaluate performance, trends, relationships, risks, and potential outcomes. Maintain comprehensive documentation of data sources, analytical methods, assumptions, calculations, and results to ensure transparency, consistency, and reproducibility. Identify and implement opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and consistency of data collection, analysis, reporting, and visualization processes. Support the design, development, and use of automated data processing, reporting, and business intelligence solutions to enhance analytical capabilities. Explore, evaluate, and support the application of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and other emerging technologies to improve analytics, reporting, and decision support functions. Participate in project meetings, working groups, and cross-functional initiatives, and support the evaluation and testing of new analytical tools, technologies, and approaches in accordance with organizational requirements. 
Qualifications- Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities: Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or another quantitative or related field. Minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of previous applicable experience Strong Excel skills, including advanced data analysis, charting, and analytical model development. Experience using SQL and Python, including libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, to query, process, and analyze datasets. Experience developing dashboards and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Familiarity with statistical analysis, modeling, and techniques for identifying and evaluating performance trends. Familiarity with cloud technologies and AI-assisted analytics or automation tools is preferred. Ability to analyze complex or imperfect data and develop well-supported conclusions. Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to technical, non-technical, and leadership audiences. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and sound judgment. Ability to work collaboratively in a project-based environment while managing multiple priorities. 
Benefits Overview Weris, Inc. offers a comprehensive benefits package including employer contributed medical, dental, and vision insurance with plan options (available day 1 of employment), Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Professional Development Reimbursement, Employer paid Short Term Disability and Basic Life Insurance, 11 Observed Paid Federal Holidays, generous PTO accruals, and an employer matched 401(k) plan. rows.title: Construction Scheduling Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Summary

The Construction Schedule Analyst is a foundational role within the Clark Planning & Scheduling Department. This position is designed for a detail-oriented individual who excels at data manipulation and logical problem-solving. You will support the Project Schedulers by managing the flow of data into Primavera P6, using Excel to audit schedule health, and creating reports that track project milestones.

This role is part of a structured career path in construction planning and scheduling. No prior construction experience is required; we provide technical training for Primavera P6 for candidates who demonstrate high-level analytical potential and a "quick-study" approach to new software.

Responsibilities

Commit to an accelerated learning path to become a power user in Primavera P6.Work closely with Project Schedulers to explore the nuances of the Critical Path Method (CPM) and how it applies to complex construction sequencing.On Site support of project teams to update schedules, expand activity detail, adjust construction sequencing, and produce internal and contractually required reporting.Data Analysis and Advanced Reporting utilizing Primavera P6, Microsoft Excel, PowerBI and other industry specific tools. Calculate and report on Project Metrics Total Float and Schedule Performance metrics to help the department identify potential bottlenecks.Identify patterns in historical data to help Project Teams predict future project outcomes.Quality Control: Ensure all schedule data adheres to standards for naming conventions, activity coding, and organizational breakdown.

Basic Qualifications

Undergraduate or Associates degree in construction management, engineering, data analysis, mathematics, computer science, business, finance, accounting, or a related field Excel Proficiency An innate interest in troubleshooting data discrepancies and finding the "why" behind the numbers.Ability to summarize and communicate complex data findings 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Primavera P6Results Oriented - Experience in using data to anticipate and solve problems, manage risk and analyze business needs to deliver high quality outcomesSelf Motivated - Takes initiative and personal responsibility to deliver value and excellence in all that you do Team Player - Builds interpersonal relationships and collaborators with internal team members, trade partners, architects and clients. 

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.

The Physical Side of the Role: Given that a good portion of your day will be spent at a desk, you should be comfortable with prolonged periods of focused work, whether it's collaborating with colleagues, analyzing data, or developing strategies. The role demands effective communication and sharp visual acuity for reviewing complex documents and performing detailed computer work. Join the HJF Team!

HJF is seeking a Data Analyst I to provide analytic support to a team of pediatricians, epidemiologists, biostatisticians and research studies. The Data Analyst I will be responsible for data extraction, management, cleaning and analysis associated with pediatric research projects drawing upon military healthcare data, and will support other Pediatric projects as needed. The successful candidate will collaborate with principal investigators, epidemiologists, and other data analysts and managers to establish data requirements. They will structure, manipulate and clean and analyze data to meet research needs in SAS. Data quality control, data updates and merges, statistics, data queries, streamlining/ developing efficiencies for data processes, regulatory oversight, and scientific graphics are all key tasks. This position reports to Principal Investigators and receives daily supervision from team Epidemiologists. This is the first of three levels in the Data Analyst hierarchy.

This hybrid position supports the work of the Divisions of Military Child and Family Research and Health Systems Research and Clinical Epidemiology in the Department of Pediatrics at the Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences in Bethesda, MD.

The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine (HJF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing military medicine. We serve military, medical, academic and government clients by administering, managing and supporting preeminent scientific programs that benefit members of the armed forces and civilians alike. Since its founding in 1983, HJF has served as a vital link between the military medical community and its federal and private partners. HJF's support and administrative capabilities allow military medical researchers and clinicians to maintain their scientific focus and accomplish their research goals.

rows.title: Summer 2027 AI Applied Research Internship
rows.descriptionText:
The Nuclear Company is the fastest growing AI tech-startup in the nuclear and energy space, pioneering a fleet-scale approach to building the next generation of nuclear reactors. Through our design-once, build-many model, we're accelerating the deployment of safe, reliable, and affordable nuclear energy.

We operate with an AI-first mindset. Every employee is expected to leverage AI, technology, and the Nuclear Operating System (NOS) as integral components of their role to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We expect every team member to continuously identify opportunities to automate workflows, enhance decision-making, improve processes, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of NOS as a strategic operating capability that enables The Nuclear Company to scale with excellence.

We hire people who are driven by purpose, thrive in ambiguity, and are energized by building what has never been built before. Our team combines intellectual curiosity with high agency, embraces candid feedback and continuous learning, and holds themselves and others to exceptional standards. Our values—Trust, Responsibility, Unity, Scrappiness, and Tenacity—guide how we hire, collaborate, and make decisions every day. They are not words on a wall; they are the standard by which we operate. Trust is the foundation of our safety culture, fostering intellectual honesty, accountability, and open communication, while our values challenge every team member to execute with urgency, humility, resilience, and an unwavering commitment to our mission.

About The Role

The United States is building nuclear power again, at a scale not attempted in a generation, and The Nuclear Company is leading it. Our Applied Research and AI team works on the open problems that decide how a fleet of plants gets built: sequencing construction across many concurrent sites, allocating capital under deep uncertainty, and keeping a distributed critical infrastructure secure. These are hard problems with real operational stakes, and the work ships into systems that inform real decisions.

You will put reinforcement learning and optimization to work on problems that decide how a fleet of plants gets built: how to sequence construction across many sites, where to place capital under uncertainty, and how to keep a distributed site secure. As a Data Science & Machine Learning Fellow, you formulate the problem, build a simulation or optimization model, evaluate it rigorously, and help move it toward a deployed decision system. You work alongside nuclear industry experts to deliver solutions that inform real decisions and create business value.

This is a 12-week Summer 2027 fellowship (May to August), aligned to the academic calendar. Base location is Washington DC, on-site five days a week, with full housing and relocation for fellows outside the DC metro area.

Responsibilities

Problem formulation: translate operational processes (construction scheduling, portfolio sequencing, security operations) into well-defined modeling problems and make the case for the right approach. Simulation and evaluation: build environments that faithfully represent these processes so models can be trained, evaluated, and iterated on. Modeling: develop reinforcement learning, optimization, or forecasting models for schedule optimization, capital allocation under uncertainty, or anomaly detection and alert prioritization. Empirical research: design rigorous experiments, keep reproducible codebases, and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Production path: work with engineering on how models are served, monitored, updated, and safely overridden in production. 

Required Experience

Currently pursuing an MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Applied Math, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Returning to your MS or PhD program after the fellowship (expected graduation December 2027 or later). Production-quality Python and PyTorch, with solid machine learning fundamentals. Hands-on experience (coursework, research, or projects) with at least one of: reinforcement learning, mathematical optimization, simulation and modeling, or time-series forecasting. Able to translate a messy real-world process into a tractable formulation (an MDP with sensible state, action, and reward, or an optimization model) and explain the modeling choice. Running pre-built models on clean benchmarks is not enough. Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and evaluate experiments, with reproducible research practices (version control, testing). This position requires access to information and technology subject to U.S. export controls (including DOE 10 CFR Part 810 and NRC requirements). U.S. Person status (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident) is required, and TNC does not provide visa sponsorship for these roles. Willing and able to work on-site in Washington DC, five days a week, for the full 12-week program

Preferred Experience

Deep RL: policy gradient (PPO, SAC) or value-based (DQN, IQL) methods; offline / batch RL (CQL, IQL, TD3+BC, Decision Transformer). Combinatorial optimization with ML: graph neural networks for scheduling or routing, or neural combinatorial optimization. Multi-agent RL (MAPPO, QMIX) or stochastic / robust optimization (CVaR-constrained, chance-constrained, distributionally robust). Uncertainty quantification; a game-theory or behavioral-science perspective on decision-making. MLOps for models in production: serving, monitoring, retraining, and distribution-shift detection. Domain exposure: construction or infrastructure operations, energy or electricity markets, industrial control systems, or critical-infrastructure security. 

Benefits

Competitive compensation packages401k with company matchMedical, dental, vision plansGenerous vacation policy, plus holidays

Estimated Starting Salary Range

The estimated starting rate for this role is $25.00 an hour plus a $2,000 monthly housing stipend less applicable withholdings and deductions, paid on a bi-weekly basis. The actual pay offered may vary based on relevant factors as determined in the Company’s discretion, which may include experience, qualifications, tenure, skill set, availability of qualified candidates, geographic location, certifications held, and other criteria deemed pertinent to the particular role.

EEO Statement

The Nuclear Company is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an environment of inclusion in the workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We prohibit discrimination in all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, transfer, compensation, and termination.

Export Control

Certain positions at The Nuclear Company may involve access to information and technology subject to export controls under U.S. law. Compliance with these export controls may result in The Nuclear Company limiting its consideration of certain applicants.

Recruiting Fraud Alert

Your safety is our priority. We want to ensure your job search stays secure. Please note that the team at The Nuclear Company only communicates through official @thenuclearcompany.com email addresses. We will never ask for payments or sensitive financial information at any stage of our recruitment process. For your peace of mind, please verify all openings and submit your applications directly through our official careers page.

rows.descriptionText:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

About The Position

Dexis is seeking a Data Collector to support a large-scale Army test and evaluation program. The project provides data collection, technical writing, computer operations, range scheduling, and administrative support services necessary to execute the government’s test mission. Support encompasses testing of a wide variety of automotive, combat, electronic, general equipment, and ordnance materiel, with services including data collection and coordination, data compilation and processing, development and management of data collection forms, test monitoring, technical writing and editorial review, reporting, data and software administration, range scheduling, and related operational support.

The Data Collector is an entry-level position that develops practical knowledge of the equipment, procedures, and tools used in the data collection process through classroom and on-the-job training. The role assists with routine test projects by observing equipment and test instruments, recording and compiling test data, performing basic computations, and capturing image data.

Work will be performed primarily onsite in Aberdeen, Maryland, with travel to other locations within the Continental United States (CONUS) and Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS) as required by mission needs. This position is contingent upon contract award.

Responsibilities

Acquire practical knowledge of the characteristics, properties, and uses of equipment necessary to carry out the data collection process through formal and informal classroom and on-the-job training. Become familiar with detailed data collection procedures that are established or repetitive. Assist with visually examining equipment or test items for flaws or defects on routine projects. Observe equipment operation to detect apparent malfunctions. Observe simple test instruments and controls during tests and record related test data. Download test data from onboard instrumentation. Perform specified arithmetic computations. Extract and compile specified data, including detailed narrative information, from records and other sources such as specifications and drawings. Capture image data in support of test activities. Perform job functions at sites other than Aberdeen as required. 

Qualifications

One (1) year of experience using a computer and Microsoft software; OR successful completion of two (2) accredited computer classes. Must have a GPA of 2.5 or higher in each individual discipline of math and science and a GPA of 3.0 or higher in high school English or a GPA of 2.5 or higher in college English from an accredited high school or university. Must possess a high school diploma. Must be proficient in speaking, reading, writing, and understanding English. Must be able to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing. Must be proficient in the use of computers and Microsoft Office software. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance. Must be able to meet the physical requirements necessary to perform assigned functions, which may include working in extreme heat or cold, high humidity, blowing sand and dust, confined spaces, at heights, and walking distances over unimproved terrain while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE). Must be available to support work outside normal duty hours when required by mission needs. Must be willing and able to travel within CONUS and OCONUS as required. 

Dexis is on a mission to help solve today’s most pressing global political, social, and economic challenges and create a world where all people are safe and prosperous. As a Dexis employee, you will be challenged, empowered, and mentored. Our motto is “find a way or make a way” — that’s how Dexis goes “all in.” How will you?

If you are passionate about this opportunity, apply now! 

Only those applicants who meet the above criteria will be contacted for interview.

Dexis is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, pregnancy, disability, age, genetic information, military service, veteran status, ethnicity, citizenship, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, childbirth and related medical conditions, including lactation, or any other protected class under applicable law.

As part of a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, Dexis provides healthcare insurance in addition to other staff welfare benefits and perks.

rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The AI Foundations Specialist Models Data Science Team builds and ships state of the art scalable architecture, AI/ML solutions for Capital One’s award-winning mobile app. We partner with product, tech and design teams to deliver app features that delight customers with dynamic and personalized experiences, enable them to chat with Capital One’s digital assistant Eno, or search for useful contents. You will be the driving force to experiment, innovate and create next generation experiences powered by the latest emerging generative AI technologies.

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI powered products that change how customers interact with their money. Leverage a broad stack of technologies - Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Hugging Face, LangChain, Lightning, VectorDBs, and more - to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. Be the expert in Natural Language Processing (NLP) to harness the power of Large Language Models (LLMs), adapt and finetune them for customer facing applications and features. Build machine learning and NLP models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, and validation; partnering with engineering teams to operationalize them in scalable and resilient production systems that serve 80+ million customers. Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. 

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with advanced ML and DL technologies including language models and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience working with LLMs and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Influential. You are passionate about AI/ML and can bring along a cross functional team in breakthrough innovations. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences. You are experienced in training language models or large computer vision models as well as have expertise in one or more key subdomains such as: training optimization, self-supervised learning, explainability, RLHF. You have an engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in training data and inference volumes. You have experience in delivering libraries, platforms, or solution level code to existing products.

parsed.text: Aberdeen Proving Ground, MY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

About The Position

Dexis is seeking a Data Collector II to support a large-scale Army test and evaluation program. The project provides data collection, technical writing, computer operations, range scheduling, and administrative support services necessary to execute the government’s test mission. Support encompasses testing of a wide variety of automotive, combat, electronic, general equipment, and ordnance materiel, with services including data collection and coordination, data compilation and processing, development and management of data collection forms, test monitoring, technical writing and editorial review, reporting, data and software administration, range scheduling, and related operational support.

The Data Collector II follows test items through all phases of testing and independently records detailed operational and maintenance data. The role documents test conditions and equipment performance, evaluates technical information, and interviews test personnel to capture information related to safety, human factors, and maintainability.

Work will be performed primarily onsite in Aberdeen, Maryland, with travel to other locations within the Continental United States (CONUS) and Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS) as required by mission needs. This position is contingent upon contract award.

Responsibilities

Follow test items through all phases of testing and observe associated operations and maintenance activities. Record specific information on structured data sheets and/or laptop computers for processing. Maintain a detailed chronological record of operational and maintenance-related test data. Document operational information such as mission event descriptions and conditions, equipment configuration, test area, weather, hours of operation, personnel involved, and servicing actions performed. Document maintenance information including operational test life, malfunctions, discovery of test incidents, corrective actions, maintenance level, parts involved, and the time and steps required for repair. Personally observe test incidents and independently record required data in a complete, accurate, and timely manner. Read instructions, perform arithmetic computations, and review and evaluate technical manuals. Interview test personnel for comments related to safety, human factors, and design-for-maintainability problem areas. Perform routine Data Collector tasks as required. Perform job functions at sites other than Aberdeen as required. 

Qualifications

Associate’s degree in a technical area and six (6) months of experience performing data collection involving military or nonmilitary equipment and associated maintenance concepts; OR one (1) year of experience performing data collection involving military or nonmilitary equipment and associated maintenance concepts. Must have a GPA of 2.5 or higher in each individual discipline of math and science and a GPA of 3.0 or higher in high school English or a GPA of 2.5 or higher in college English from an accredited high school or university. Must possess a high school diploma. Must be proficient in speaking, reading, writing, and understanding English. Must be able to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing. Must be proficient in the use of computers and Microsoft Office software. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance. Must be able to meet the physical requirements necessary to perform assigned functions, which may include working in extreme heat or cold, high humidity, blowing sand and dust, confined spaces, at heights, and walking distances over unimproved terrain while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE). Must be available to support work outside normal duty hours when required by mission needs. Must be willing and able to travel within CONUS and OCONUS as required. 

Dexis is on a mission to help solve today’s most pressing global political, social, and economic challenges and create a world where all people are safe and prosperous. As a Dexis employee, you will be challenged, empowered, and mentored. Our motto is “find a way or make a way” — that’s how Dexis goes “all in.” How will you?

If you are passionate about this opportunity, apply now! 

Only those applicants who meet the above criteria will be contacted for interview.

Dexis is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, pregnancy, disability, age, genetic information, military service, veteran status, ethnicity, citizenship, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, childbirth and related medical conditions, including lactation, or any other protected class under applicable law.

As part of a competitive benefits package for eligible employees, Dexis provides healthcare insurance in addition to other staff welfare benefits and perks.

About The Role

Colgate-Palmolive is undergoing an exciting strategic pivot toward omnichannel demand generation. As our Omnichannel Search Specialist, you will be at the heart of this evolution. You’ll spearhead digital initiatives that accelerate brand expansion, reporting directly to the Director of Digital Transformation, Northern Europe.

Your work will be pivotal in maintaining high visibility and brand integrity across Amazon, Google, and retailer platforms. You will pioneer Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies, ensuring our brands thrive in AI-driven search environments. You won’t just be analysing data; you’ll be telling the story behind it to influence our search mindset and culture across the Northern Europe Hub.

What You Bring

A passion for the evolving search landscape and a curious mind—especially regarding Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and optimising for LLM-based platforms. The ability to bridge the gap between technical data and human behavior, looking beyond traditional clickstream metrics. Experience in search, digital analytics, or performance marketing (agency or client side). A "can-do" attitude! Beyond building robust data solutions, you'll partner closely with business stakeholders, architects, and analytics teams to translate business needs into technical solutions, influence how data is structured and consumed, and help shape engineering standards across the team. About The Job

The Senior Product Owner – Supporting Functions is responsible for defining and driving the product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization for a portfolio of products supporting key enterprise functions, including FP&A, Danone Business Services (DBS), Human Resources (HR), and General Services (GS).

Partnering closely with business leaders, IT & Data teams, and external providers, this role translates business needs into scalable digital solutions that enhance operational efficiency, process standardization, data quality, employee experience, and business performance.

As the strategic owner of a medium-to-high complexity product domain, the Senior Product Owner balances competing priorities, manages cross-functional dependencies, and ensures the successful delivery and adoption of products that drive measurable business value. The role requires strong stakeholder management, product leadership, and the ability to connect diverse functional needs with technology-enabled solutions across a regional and global environment.

About You

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Data, or a related field. 5–8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Enterprise Applications, Technology Delivery, or related business partnering roles. Experience managing products or platforms supporting Finance, HR, Shared Services, Corporate Functions, or other enterprise business processes. Proven experience working in agile environments, managing backlogs, roadmaps, and cross-functional delivery teams. Experience operating in regional or global organizations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. 

Technical & Functional Skills

Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and value delivery. Experience with enterprise platforms and ecosystems supporting Finance, HR, workflow, reporting, governance, and shared services. Familiarity with ERP, HRIS, planning, reporting, analytics, service management, document management, and integration platforms. Strong understanding of business process optimization, data quality, system integrations, user adoption, and change management principles. Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Power BI, or comparable enterprise solutions. Ability to evaluate solution alternatives, dependencies, technical constraints, and business impacts to drive informed product decisions. 

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

Strong business acumen and ability to understand complex functional priorities across Finance, DBS, HR, and General Services. Proven ability to translate business needs into product strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. Excellent communication, influencing, stakeholder management, negotiation, and facilitation skills. Strong leadership through influence with a collaborative and servant leadership mindset. Ability to make informed trade-offs balancing business value, user needs, cost, complexity, and delivery timelines. Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities and results orientation. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. Customer- and user-centric mindset with a strong focus on adoption, experience, and value realization. 

Language Requirements

Fluent English required. Spanish preferred. Portuguese is a plus. 

About us

At Danone Mexico, we work with a deep conviction people's health and the health of the planet are connected. Under our global vision One Planet. One Health., we build a healthier future through food and beverages that are part of the daily lives of millions of families worldwide.

In Mexico, with more than 15,000 employees, 35 plants, and over 100 distribution centers across the country, we are a diverse and highly committed community driving iconic brands such as Danone, Activia, Oikos, Danonino, Bonafont, and Silk. Every person who joins us brings a key piece to continue evolving and innovating.

At Danone, you will find an environment where you can grow with purpose and be authentic. We value what each person contributes, and it is this combination of experiences, talents, and perspectives that strengthens our culture and drives us to achieve extraordinary results. Here, you will have the freedom to propose, create, and bring ideas to life that generate real impact.

We foster your development through continuous feedback, clear objectives, agile methodologies, and learning tools designed to accelerate your professional growth. We want you to move forward with confidence and find a path that inspires you. Your well-being is also fundamental to us. That’s why we offer flexible benefits, comprehensive health programs covering physical, emotional, and financial well-being, support platforms, exclusive discounts, and benefits above the legal requirements—supporting you at every stage of your life.

We are proudly a B Corp certified company, reflecting our commitment to responsible practices, conscious decisions, and a positive impact on people, communities, and the planet.

If you are looking for a place where you can contribute, grow, and be part of a community driven by purpose, we invite you to explore our opportunities and discover for yourself everything you can build at Danone. Your next big professional step could start here.

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Supply

Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen. If you're looking for a career in supply chain, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. You could join our Global Supply Planning team to develop and implement our global supply strategy, or work with our Procurement Centre of Excellence team to negotiate and manage our supplier relationships. Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers.

In this role, you will lead identification, prioritization, and execution of value-added projects and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to business growth, operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and cost optimization. Supply Chain Management, Business Partnership, Collaboration and partnership building, Relationship Management, Business accumen, Productivity management, Improve business processes, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Planning, Logistics Management.

Job Description:

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Shopper Marketing Manager to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food maker with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. Founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry across three major geographic regions.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here's The Scoop – Summary

We are seeking a strategic and commercially driven Shopper Marketing Manager to lead the development and execution of customer-specific shopper marketing strategies across key retail partners in the US.

This role will be responsible for translating brand and consumer strategies into impactful omnichannel activations across in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital touchpoints to drive conversion.

The ideal candidate brings deep CPG experience, strong commercial acumen, retail media expertise, and a proven ability to partner cross-functionally across Sales, Brand, Category, and Digital teams.

We are looking for a highly collaborative leader with strong retailer understanding, agency management experience, and a passion for building best-in-class shopper programs that deliver measurable business results.

What a typical day looks like:

Develop Customer-Specific Shopper Marketing Strategies. Build annual shopper marketing plans aligned to brand priorities, customer strategies, and channel growth objectives. Lead Retail Activation Planning & Execution. Design and execute omnichannel shopper activations across in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and key shopper touchpoints to drive conversion. Partner Closely with Sales / Key Account Teams. Act as a strategic business partner to Sales, developing customer-selling stories, retailer-specific programs, and Joint Business Plans (JBPs). Translate Consumer Insights into Shopper Activations. Leverage shopper, consumer, and category insights to identify purchase barriers/opportunities, translating them into impactful programs that influence path-to-purchase behavior. Lead agency partners & Activation Development. Develop strategic briefs and lead external shopper marketing, creative, and retail media partners to build integrated activations that drive shopper conversion. Manage Retail Media & Digital Commerce Integration. Partner with retail media, eCommerce, and merchandising teams to build integrated shopper campaigns across retailer ecosystems, ensuring alignment across the full shopper journey. Oversee Merchandising & Promotional Programs. Develop and optimize promotions, display strategies, and merchandising initiatives to maximize incremental sales. Measure ROI and Performance Effectiveness. Track activation performance using KPIs such as sales lift, ROI, incrementality, conversion, TDP growth, and promotional efficiency. Manage Shopper Marketing Budget & Investment Allocation. Own budget planning, spend tracking, and optimization to ensure efficient investment across customers and channels. Collaborate Cross-Functionally. Partner with Brand, Category Management, Sales, and Supply to ensure aligned, scalable, and executable programs. Build Best-in-Class Retailer Relationships. Develop strong relationships with retailer marketing and commercial teams to unlock shopper activation opportunities, better placements, and joint growth opportunities. 

What are we looking for?

10+ years of experience in CPG, preferably across Shopper Marketing, Customer Marketing, Brand Marketing, and/or Trade Marketing. Proven experience developing and leading omnichannel shopper marketing programs, integrating in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital activation to drive conversion and brand growth. Strong experience integrating shopper marketing into customer business plans, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), innovation launches, and channel growth strategies, with the ability to influence customer and internal commercial agendas. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to connect shopper activations to business outcomes including revenue growth, incrementality, ROI, TDP gains, velocity, and promotional efficiency. Hands-on experience developing and leading retail media campaigns, with strong understanding of audience strategy, media optimization, attribution, and lower-funnel conversion. Strong analytical and shopper insights capabilities, including proficiency in syndicated and retailer data sources such as Nielsen, Circana, panel data, loyalty data, and point-of-sale analytics. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, partnering effectively across Brand, Sales and Digital teams to drive alignment and execution. Experience working directly with major US retailers and their marketing/commercial teams, with strong understanding of customer-specific activation principles. Experience managing shopper marketing budget including investment planning, allocation, and management.

Job Description

Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.

The Opportunity:

If you are passionate about applied materials science, energized by solving real consumer problems, and driven to modernize how work gets done through digital innovation, this role is for you. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD in Materials Science & Engineering, Chemistry, Polymer Science, or a related discipline to join the Feminine Care R&D organization at P&G in Cincinnati, OH. As a Material Development Scientist-PhD, you will utilize deep technical mastery to make meaningful, hands‑on contributions to the business. You will work in a collaborative, supportive R&D environment where your work directly influences product performance, sustainability, supply resilience, and speed of innovation.

This R&D assignment offers a unique opportunity to work across disciplines internally and with external partners, building both technical depth and system level understanding early in your career. The role also provides the opportunity to innovate across a range of material technologies including but not limited to Adhesives, Nonwovens, and Films to name a few. The role is well suited for scientists who enjoy connecting fundamental understanding to practical applications, and who are motivated to improve not only what we develop, but how we develop it.

The Ideal Candidate Has: 

A strong foundational understanding of materials science with the ability to apply fundamentals to solve real‑world problems. Ability to understand product performance requirements, material feedstocks, and manufacturing processes, and translate this holistic understanding into innovative material solutions.Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to leverage data to connect insights across disciplines, develop technically sound solutions, and influence technical direction on projects.Passion for hands‑on experimental work, with a demonstrated ability to design, execute, and interpret experiments; test technical hypotheses; and translate data into clear, actionable insights and models.A self‑leadership and ownership mindset, including the ability to independently understand complex technical problems, proactively drive problem solving, and collaborate with project teams on technology development.Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multifunctional teams within P&G and with external partners such as suppliers, universities, and technical service providers.Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and results through written reports and verbal discussions.Demonstrated curiosity and innovation mindset, including interest or experience in using digital, data, or automation tools to simplify workflows, improve decision‑making, and accelerate materials innovation.Learning agility and adaptability, with the ability to rapidly learn new technical areas, tools, and processes in a dynamic, evolving business environment.

This is a fast‑paced, highly impactful role focused on developing new materials and material innovations to deliver superior, sustainable products through best‑in‑class execution and supply solutions.

Partner with Product Development teams to translate consumer needs and unmet problems into material innovations to deliver superior and differentiated product solutions.Work closely with manufacturing plants to diagnose and resolve raw‑material technical issues, enabling robust, reliable product performance.Collaborate with external suppliers to develop, qualify, and sustain best‑in‑class raw‑material supply chains for a global business.Lead and support new raw‑material qualifications, cost‑optimization initiatives, and Business Continuity Plans to strengthen resilience and competitiveness while meeting quality, safety, and compliance requirements.Apply digital and data‑driven approaches to simplify workflows, improve decision‑making, and accelerate the pace of materials innovation.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Shopper Marketing Manager to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food maker with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. Founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry across three major geographic regions.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here's The Scoop – Summary

We are seeking a strategic and commercially driven Shopper Marketing Manager to lead the development and execution of customer-specific shopper marketing strategies across key retail partners in the US.

This role will be responsible for translating brand and consumer strategies into impactful omnichannel activations across in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital touchpoints to drive conversion.

The ideal candidate brings deep CPG experience, strong commercial acumen, retail media expertise, and a proven ability to partner cross-functionally across Sales, Brand, Category, and Digital teams.

We are looking for a highly collaborative leader with strong retailer understanding, agency management experience, and a passion for building best-in-class shopper programs that deliver measurable business results.

What a typical day looks like:

Develop Customer-Specific Shopper Marketing Strategies. Build annual shopper marketing plans aligned to brand priorities, customer strategies, and channel growth objectives. Lead Retail Activation Planning & Execution. Design and execute omnichannel shopper activations across in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and key shopper touchpoints to drive conversion. Partner Closely with Sales / Key Account Teams. Act as a strategic business partner to Sales, developing customer-selling stories, retailer-specific programs, and Joint Business Plans (JBPs). Translate Consumer Insights into Shopper Activations. Leverage shopper, consumer, and category insights to identify purchase barriers/opportunities, translating them into impactful programs that influence path-to-purchase behavior. Lead agency partners & Activation Development. Develop strategic briefs and lead external shopper marketing, creative, and retail media partners to build integrated activations that drive shopper conversion. Manage Retail Media & Digital Commerce Integration. Partner with retail media, eCommerce, and merchandising teams to build integrated shopper campaigns across retailer ecosystems, ensuring alignment across the full shopper journey. Oversee Merchandising & Promotional Programs. Develop and optimize promotions, display strategies, and merchandising initiatives to maximize incremental sales. Measure ROI and Performance Effectiveness. Track activation performance using KPIs such as sales lift, ROI, incrementality, conversion, TDP growth, and promotional efficiency. Manage Shopper Marketing Budget & Investment Allocation. Own budget planning, spend tracking, and optimization to ensure efficient investment across customers and channels. Collaborate Cross-Functionally. Partner with Brand, Category Management, Sales, and Supply to ensure aligned, scalable, and executable programs. Build Best-in-Class Retailer Relationships. Develop strong relationships with retailer marketing and commercial teams to unlock shopper activation opportunities, better placements, and joint growth opportunities. 

What are we looking for?

10+ years of experience in CPG, preferably across Shopper Marketing, Customer Marketing, Brand Marketing, and/or Trade Marketing. Proven experience developing and leading omnichannel shopper marketing programs, integrating in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital activation to drive conversion and brand growth. Strong experience integrating shopper marketing into customer business plans, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), innovation launches, and channel growth strategies, with the ability to influence customer and internal commercial agendas. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to connect shopper activations to business outcomes including revenue growth, incrementality, ROI, TDP gains, velocity, and promotional efficiency. Hands-on experience developing and leading retail media campaigns, with strong understanding of audience strategy, media optimization, attribution, and lower-funnel conversion. Strong analytical and shopper insights capabilities, including proficiency in syndicated and retailer data sources such as Nielsen, Circana, panel data, loyalty data, and point-of-sale analytics. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, partnering effectively across Brand, Sales and Digital teams to drive alignment and execution. Experience working directly with major US retailers and their marketing/commercial teams, with strong understanding of customer-specific activation principles. Experience managing shopper marketing budget including investment planning, allocation, and management. 

What can you expect from Champion?

Safety: a strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.Earnings: Salary range from USD$105,000 to USD$144,000, 401k with Company, and donation matching.Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistance Programs to meet your individual or family needs.Continuing Education: In House & Online Learning & Development, as well as an Education Assistance Program.Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.Other Perks: Free Bag of Premium Pet Food each month, Free Parking and more!

What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of your race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other creed, you are wanted here.

Job Description:

The Senior Manager Global Workforce & Organizational Effectiveness Intelligence is a key member of the Organization Effectiveness and Workforce Planning Center of Excellence (COE). This is a high-impact position for an experienced workforce analytics consultant with functional expertise who excels at translating strategic business challenges into structured workforce intelligence and executive action. This role serves as the lead analytical and consulting partner to the COE, bridging the gap between strategic business questions and the workforce intelligence required for executive decision-making.

The successful candidate possesses deep domain knowledge in workforce planning, organization effectiveness, and workforce intelligence, combined with key consulting skills such as structured problem-solving and executive communication. You will be responsible for defining what to measure and how to measure it, interpreting complex data to tell a compelling business story, and advising senior leaders on workforce and org effectiveness implications. This position plays a critical role in establishing enterprise-wide standards for workforce and org effectiveness metrics and monitoring organizational health.

Operating in a decentralized, multi-business unit organization, you will partner with P&O (people & operations or HR), finance, and business leaders at the enterprise and business-unit level. You will serve as a bridge between the COE, business-units, P&O (HR) technology teams, corporate finance, and commercial teams.

What we are looking for? 

Bachelor's degree; Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., I/O Psychology, MBA, HR, Business Analytics) is preferred.8 years of experience across strategic workforce planning, org design / operating model, and organization effectiveness analyticsMinimum of 6 years of experience in Management Consulting (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, or specialized boutique human capital firm) advising large, complex organizations on organization effectiveness, operating models, and workforce planning OR 6 years of in-house experience at a global, multi-business unit company, serving either in a corporate Center of Excellence for Workforce Planning / Org Effectiveness, or in a similar headquarters role for a major business unitMinimum of 6 years of experience with Workday as well as workforce planning and org effectiveness tools (e.g., Orgvue, Visier, Workday Adaptive, Anaplan). This includes functional proficiency and strategic command of these tools, with an emphasis on how organizational data is represented and modeledDeep functional expertise in organization effectiveness and strategic workforce planning frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks - including leading practices, operational complexities, and risksProven experience establishing enterprise-level workforce and OE metrics for large organizations, including advising on P&O (HR) and finance metrics integrationAdvanced Microsoft Excel and data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau) capabilities for ad-hoc modeling, data blending, and scenario explorationProven expertise in translating abstract business questions into structured workforce planning and org effectiveness analytical plans, with a proven track record of delivering high-impact insights that influence executive decisionsDemonstrated ability to serve as a translator between senior P&O (HR), finance, and commercial leaders, aligning disparate stakeholder groups around a shared understanding of the strategic implications of workforce dataExposure to how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is changing SWP and OE, including: familiarity with emerging AI-driven metrics and enhanced workforce intelligence, including skills-based organization design, and measuring AI-human productivityWorking knowledge of data querying concepts (e.g., SQL) and data architecture paradigms (e.g., data lakes) to facilitate effective partnership with P&O (HR) technical teams

What will be your key responsibilities?

 Strategic ConsultingAssist with designing and leading the COE’s Workforce Intelligence agenda to enable workforce planning and monitor organizational health, productivity, and effectivenessAdvise on workforce planning and org effectiveness benchmarks and assist with developing targetsProvide thought leadership on the continued impact of AI transformation on workforce planning and org effectiveness metricsServe as a thought partner, translating ambiguous executive workforce planning and org effectiveness questions into hypotheses and structured analysisDevelop and deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership that clearly articulate workforce and org effectiveness trends, risks, and opportunities, influencing data-driven decisions Enterprise Workforce Intelligence & Org Effectiveness IntelligenceDesign and conduct workforce planning and organizational effectiveness analysis, synthesizing disparate data points (P&O / HR, financial, commercial, external) to proactively identify insights and risksMonitor organizational health, complexity, and productivity. Proactively identify and investigate anomaliesLead and enhance enterprise headcount reporting, including integration with finance and commercial teamsAnalyze the impact of operating model changes and large-scale transformations on organizational effectivenessServe as the COE’s lead consultant on time-sensitive executive inquires, delivering data-driven, executive-level insightsProvide data-backed insights on future workforce trends, conduct workforce risk analysis, and support capability forecasting Enterprise Metrics & GovernanceLead the development, definition, and consistent application of enterprise workforce planning and organization effectiveness metricsPartner with stakeholders to integrate metrics into core strategy, financial planning and risk management processesServe as a functional workforce planning and org effectiveness analytics expert on enterprise people data governance, technology, and analytics initiativesGenerate enterprise functional requirements for workforce intelligence and org design tools (e.g., OrgVue, Workday Adaptive Planning)Ensure enterprise workforce planning and org effectiveness tools (e.g., Workday reports, OrgVue models) and dashboards are strategically relevant and aligned with and leading practices

Work with over 140,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles. Join a purpose driven company, where we are striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today. Who We Are

Join L'Oréal: As the world's #1 beauty company, with a presence in over 150 markets, we are embarking on a transformative journey that embraces sustainability, digital innovation, and societal progress. We are dedicated to shaping the future of beauty by harnessing the power of technology, data, and science to tackle global challenges while staying true to our social and environmental commitments.
