Most Innovative Companies - Fast Company, 2023Top 5 - Most Attractive Companies Worldwide Among Business Students - Universum, 2023Top 25 World's Best Companies - TIME, 2023 Top Companies for Executive Women - Seamount, 2023Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion - Disability Equal Index, 2023

With 86,000 dedicated employees spread across 150 countries, L'Oréal leads the global beauty industry and pioneers’ beauty technology. Our portfolio comprises 36 international brands grouped into four divisions. For over a century, we've been committed to making beauty accessible to all, and our goal is to reach another billion consumers worldwide through innovation.

Now, it's your moment to shine. If you are experienced, embrace challenges, value continuous learning, and want to create a positive impact, we invite you to join our diverse teams. Whether you're an industry veteran or a seasoned professional, we are always on the lookout for exceptional talents to contribute to our mission.

At L'Oréal Professional Products Division, we have more than 110 years of avant-garde to define the present and shape the future of professional beauty. We are an open space for innovation and technology while we take care of the planet, creating more hope and less waste, we create as unique experiences in every channel, just as unique as you are as you are. We are the cutting edge. If you are passionate about beauty, technology and sustainability; motivated by data, disruptive, creative and a great team player, I will be thrill to talk to you about this opportunity.

A Day in the Life

The AVP, Head of Global Digital & Media Strategy directs and holds ultimate global accountability for Color WOW’s end-to-end digital ecosystem, steering full-funnel media strategy, unified analytics, search optimization, lifecycle CRM, e-commerce content, and cutting-edge digital services innovation. Acting at the intersection of brand vision, digital transformation, and multi-market commercial execution, this executive leader partners cross-functionally across DMI, CDMO, and international zone leadership to build brand equity, accelerate consumer acquisition, maximize customer lifetime value, and drive sustainable global business growth.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Digital Media, Business Administration, or related discipline.Years of Experience: 10–12+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital marketing, full-funnel media strategy, e-commerce, or CDMO roles, preferably within beauty, luxury, or prestige consumer goods.Job Specific Experience/Skills:Proven track record of directing, scaling, and governing a comprehensive global digital ecosystem (Paid/Owned/Earned Media, Performance Analytics, Lifecycle CRM, B2B/B2C E-Commerce).In-depth expertise in Retail Media networks, digital shelf optimization, affiliate marketing, brand seeding, and community management platforms.Demonstrated mastery of Global Engine Optimization (GEO) / SEO strategies, search content architecture, and multi-market master asset syndication (including US English-to-Spanish localization).High-level executive leadership managing top-tier global agency partners, MarTech/AdTech vendors, and matrixed international market teams.Technical Skills: Proficiency with enterprise digital analytics suites, media buying/ad platforms, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), e-commerce platforms, and MS Office Suite.Physical Requirements: Physical in-office presence required (up to 2 days per week required in the Color Wow Office in Wilton, CT; remaining time aligned with company hybrid policy); standard executive office activities (sitting, standing, computer work).
Preferred Qualifications

Master’s / MBA or advanced degree in relevant field.Experience integrating emerging Beauty Tech / Consumer AI solutions (e.g., AI hair diagnosis, virtual try-on tools, conversational AI companions).

Responsibilities

Digital Ecosystem Governance: Direct and hold ultimate global accountability for Color WOW’s digital footprint across all core pillars: Full-Funnel Media & Content Formats, Analytics & Insights (Paid/Owned/Earned), E-Commerce B2B & B2C (Content & Activations), GEO Search Strategy, DDX Lifecycle CRM (Triggers & Journeys), and Digital Services.Media Strategy & Alignment: Coordinate the overarching global media strategy with Marketing and Content leads to ensure fit-for-format asset development across all funnel stages; establish divisional Rules of Engagement (ROE) and provide strategic steering for Retail Media investments tied directly to designated Hero SKUs.Analytics & Insights (A&I) Leadership: Oversee the global A&I strategy, including unified multi-touchpoint digital analytics, brand seeding, creator affiliate programs (closely integrated with E-Commerce), and community management technologies.GEO & Global Search Strategy: Define strategic global search territories in close partnership with Marketing; lead English master search content creation, manage specialized agency partners, and syndicate master assets to regional markets for localization (e.g., US English-to-Spanish adaptation).Lifecycle CRM (DDX): Direct global CRM architecture and retention strategy, designing automated consumer lifecycle triggers and personalized multi-channel journeys across both direct consumer (B2C) and salon professional (B2B) touchpoints.Digital Services & Beauty Tech Innovation: Serve as the primary DMI liaison to the division’s "Digital Services Factory" to pilot, commercialize, and scale next-generation consumer-facing technologies (AI hair diagnosis, virtual try-ons, conversational AI companions).People & Operational Leadership: Lead, develop, and mentor direct team members while maintaining a close operational partnership with the Head of E-Commerce (Primary Deputy) and cross-functional DMI leaders.

Job Dimensions 

Operating Budget: Global Digital & Media OPEX / Working Media & Technology GovernanceNumber of Direct Reports: up to 3 direct reports (Digital Media, A&I, CRM, Search/Digital Services leads)Total Staff / Scope: 1 FTE (Direct) with extensive global matrix leadership across international zonesArea of Impact: Global Brand Strategy, DMI, Multi-Zone Commercial & Digital PerformanceNature of Impact: Strategic direction, governance, cross-zone coordination, and multi-market deliveryOther Key Metrics: Media ROI / ROAS, E-Commerce Growth, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Share of Voice (SOV), Organic & Paid Search Visibility, Retention / Repeat Purchase Rate, Digital Service Engagement

What We Offer

Your Future Team

At L’Oréal, our Digital team is an opportunity to be at the center of L'Oréal's digital transformation. We are determined to be pioneers in the new beauty tech world, and by incorporating digital into everything that we do, we are creating a better relationship with our consumers. When beauty and tech collide, the impossible can happen! Come join our dynamic team!

We Are Committed and Engaged

rows.title: Principal, R&D Digital Enablement
rows.descriptionText:
Kenvue Is Currently Recruiting For a

Principal, R&D Digital Enablement

What We Do

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent.

Who We Are

Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. For more information, click here.

Role Reports To

Assoc Director, R&D Digital Capabilities

Location:

North America, United States, New Jersey, Summit

Work Location:

Hybrid

What You Will Do

The Principal, R&D Digital Enablement will accelerate product development by identifying and deploying materials informatics and automation solutions to scientific and business problems. Combining chemistry and product-development expertise with data-science literacy and business-analysis skills, this individual will assess opportunities, define requirements, connect R&D teams with technical experts, guide implementation and adoption, and demonstrate measurable value. The role applies and guides computational modeling approaches — from statistical and mechanistic models to cheminformatics and machine learning — partnering with specialists for deep model development while remaining accountable for scientific framing, model fitness, and interpretation. With appropriate attention to scientific, regulatory, quality, and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Identify and Apply Scientific Modeling and Materials Informatics Solutions

Apply systems thinking and structured problem framing to identify product-development problems that could be addressed through materials informatics methods—including predictive modeling, machine learning, simulation, and advanced analytics—or through decision-support tools, workflow automation, and simpler digital interventions.Evaluate materials informatics and automation opportunities based on the scientific question, data readiness, workflow maturity, integration needs, technical feasibility, validation requirements, adoption considerations, risk, and expected scientific and business value.Use business-analysis practices to define scientific and business problems, map current processes and decision points, develop use cases and requirements, identify data dependencies, establish success measures, and plan value realization.Partner with data scientists, computational scientists, chemists, engineers, Tech & Data, external partners, and R&D leadership to evaluate solution options and deploy scalable, supportable capabilities.Guide implementation, adoption, and value measurement for selected solutions, ensuring they remain scalable, supportable, and aligned with scientific and business needs.

Enable Product Development Excellence

Embed within R&D project teams and use chemistry and product-development expertise to understand scientific challenges, development risks, experimental workflows, and decision points where computational methods or automation could improve outcomes.Improve experimental efficiency, prediction quality, first-time-right execution, cycle time, knowledge reuse, and evidence-based decision-making across new product development programs, deepening formulation and process understanding through structure–property relationships, ingredient compatibility and interaction, stability prediction, and formulation optimization.Support teams from concept generation through commercialization by matching scientific and business needs with fit-for-purpose solutions, ranging from workflow automation and analytics to predictive models, machine learning, simulation, and decision-support tools.

Shape Materials Informatics and Automation Opportunities

Lead opportunity discovery, problem definition, data-readiness assessment, technical feasibility evaluation, and evidence-based prioritization for potential computational and automation solutions.Determine when a problem calls for mechanistic or statistical modeling, cheminformatics, simulation, machine learning, advanced analytics, decision support, or simpler workflow automation, avoiding unnecessary technical complexity.Translate scientific problems into clear use cases and partner with technical experts who design, build, validate, and maintain predictive models, simulations, machine-learning solutions, and other computational capabilities.Translate product, consumer, healthcare professional, business, and market needs into well-defined scientific problems, computational use cases, data requirements, solution requirements, and implementation plans.Guide responsible technology exploration and disciplined learning cycles, including appropriate consideration of data quality, model performance, explainability, validation, monitoring, change control, and human oversight.

Strengthen Data and Knowledge Foundations

rows.title: Planogram Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

The Planogram Specialist partners with Category Leadership Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to influence, build, validate, and execute merchandising solutions that support category growth. The role co-owns planogram development, planogram specific reporting, database maintenance, and ad hoc category analytics while evolving toward stronger process leadership, standardized ways of working, and scalable tools that improve speed, quality, and consistency across divisions. The role also contributes to assortment and layout thinking by applying shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights to strengthen shelf construct recommendations, planogram testing, heat mapping, and best-practice deployment.

Responsibilities

Planogram Development & Execution

 Builds multiple versions of planograms based on pre-established assortment, clustering nuances, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, and retailer-specific requirements, while simultaneously developing customer-specific Gold Standard POG recommendations that optimize product flow, brand blocking, adjacencies, capacity, and execution feasibility to drive immediate merchandising objectives and support long-term category growth, shopper navigation, and strategic retailer goals. Reviews, validates, and revises planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture /labor realities, and execution readiness. Manages relay execution for assigned categories, including workload forecasting, project coordination, deadlines, and issue resolution required for successful implementation. Provides planogram support for display merchandising where applicable, including virtual store environments, 3D product builds, video tours, promotional concepts, and customer-facing visual assets that communicate the merchandising story.

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy Support

 Supports assortment and layout strategy development by translating shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights into informed shelf recommendations. Contributes to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternatives, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes. Provides analytical support for innovation, renovation, and new item/segment display considerations as needed.

Reporting, Analytics & Decision Support

 Conducts ad hoc analytics to answer business questions from Customer Merchants, Category Advisors, Category Leadership Managers, and non-advising teams. Supports business reviews and insights development using available resources such as JDA/Blue Yonder, retailer data, and internal reporting. Measures effectiveness of planogram, assortment, and shelving actions by connecting execution outputs to performance indicators where available.

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement

 Helps develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources. Identifies opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, and execution efficiency. Supports onboarding, training content, and best-practice sharing for analysts, field category teams, and partners using planogram or space planning tools. Maintains strong relationship with Acosta, Shopper MX, and key internal stakeholders to optimize merchandising tools, data integrity, digital assets, and operational processes, driving efficiencies, improving execution quality, and identifying scalable, cost-effective solutions that advance category management capabilities and customer outcomes.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

 Acts as an efficient collaborator by sharing reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams. Brings forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, and scalable process improvements that support total Nestlé growth. Builds trusted relationships with Category Leadership, Space Planning Management, field sales, and cross-functional partners to improve quality, speed, and alignment.

Requirements

Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2+ years of experience in Sales, Analytics, Space Management, Category Management, or a related manufacturer/retailer role; CPG and/or food industry experience a plus, with demonstrated ability to influence merchandising recommendations through buyer-facing storytelling, cross-functional partnership, and category strategy application.

Technical & Analytical Skills

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel; advanced analytical aptitude and ability to develop business and category knowledge, including the expertise to simplify complex data into clear visuals, shelf stories, and executive-ready recommendations. Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management preferred; ability to use SQL, Python, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, or planogram workflows a plus. Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations.

Core Capabilities

 Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment. Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into clear recommendations. Demonstrated initiative, tenacity, curiosity, and problem-solving; willingness to challenge current ways of working and help build future-state capabilities. Ability to collaborate across Category Leadership, Field Sales, and cross-functional partners while sharing knowledge and best practices.

Travel

Approximately 15–25% to include national meetings, local customer meetings, store visits, and other business needs.

77205124

Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to background, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location of the position.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits.  6+ years of experience in marketing operations, integrated marketing, or cross-channel marketing roles. If so, a role in Analytics & Insights (A&I) could be a great fit. In A&I, we combine analytics and insights to shape business strategy, product innovation, pricing, media investments, retail execution, and go-to-market plans.

We use our boundless curiosity to discover what consumers want, why they want it, and how we can influence them through immersive exploration, in-depth analysis, and good research. We use state of the art analytics tools to dig deep in the data, identifying key business drivers and assessing the impact of investments like advertising and in store promotions. We use big data sources and analytics to understand consumers, markets, and retailers.

Working closely with cross-functional partners across Brand Management, Finance, Sales, R&D, and other teams, you will identify and unlock new opportunities for business growth. Success in this role requires a unique blend of analytical expertise, strong interpersonal skills, and integrative thinking to translate research findings into actionable recommendations for key stakeholders. We are seeking a Director to join our Analytical Chemistry team in our state-of-the-art Clark, New Jersey research facility, leading our end-to-end R&I stability programs and managing the Analytical Innovation & Expertise team. In this role, you will provide strategic operational and scientific leadership to ensure robust stability, regulatory compliance, and data-driven insights for our OTC and beauty care portfolios, while continuing to champion analytical capability building and innovation. You will be responsible for the management, development, and technical upskilling of the team.

Ensure strict adherence to FDA, Health Canada, GMP, GLP, and ICH guidelines.Team Leadership & Upskilling: Manage the daily functional work of the analytical Innovation & Expertise team (7 direct reports with diverse expertise, including trace and surface science), mentoring and upskilling the team in new digital and analytical techniques.Cross-Functional & Métier Partnership: Partner closely with key métiers, process development, formulation, manufacturing, QA, and regulatory affairs teams to manage testing expectations, resolve project bottlenecks, and align analytical strategies with business priorities.Strategic Leadership: Be a creative and strategic leader with passion for innovation and show ability to build a forward-thinking outlook, remove barriers, develop people, and continuously thrive to raise the technical skills/expertise of the staff members.CRO Management: Oversee external contract research organizations and contract manufacturing partners regarding vendor selection, qualification, and analytical contracting.Capability Development: Guide assay, trace, impurity, and degradation product analysis, ensuring robust method development, validation, and transfer (internally and externally), ensuring compliance with relevant ICH, GMPs, and regulatory guidelines.

Education: A PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific/engineering discipline is required.Experience: 7+ years of relevant industry experience in analytical chemistry supporting OTC and/or stability programs.Strong, demonstrated experience managing end-to-end stability programs from product development to launch in a GMP/OTC environment is a must.Strong knowledge and practical experience in statistics, predictive analytics/modeling (e.g., chemometrics, stability kinetics/Arrhenius Law), and data visualization.Strong regulatory knowledge of FDA, Health Canada, ICH guidelines, and compendial standards pertaining to OTC products, quality systems, and method validation.Experience overseeing and working with contract research organizations (CROs) and external vendors.Strong experience managing direct reports in a laboratory setting, with a track record of innovation, capability building, and upskilling technical teams.Strong experimental background in chromatography (LC/GC), mass spectrometry and LC/GC-MS-based systems (QTrap LC-MS/MS, TripleTOF LC-MS/MS, etc.) to guide expert teams effectively.Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage expectations across diverse business métiers.Highly effective organizational planning, project management, and problem-solving skills.The ability to be onsite, in the office/laboratory at least 5 days a week, as this is an essential function of the position (required).Authorization to work in the United States is required. No sponsorship is offered for this role. (required).The ability to lift 25 lbs (11.3 kg) (required).

A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’OréalAn environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!A place where you can contribute to something bigger! About The Job

The Senior Product Owner – Supporting Functions is responsible for defining and driving the product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization for a portfolio of products supporting key enterprise functions, including FP&A, Danone Business Services (DBS), Human Resources (HR), and General Services (GS).

Partnering closely with business leaders, IT & Data teams, and external providers, this role translates business needs into scalable digital solutions that enhance operational efficiency, process standardization, data quality, employee experience, and business performance.

As the strategic owner of a medium-to-high complexity product domain, the Senior Product Owner balances competing priorities, manages cross-functional dependencies, and ensures the successful delivery and adoption of products that drive measurable business value. The role requires strong stakeholder management, product leadership, and the ability to connect diverse functional needs with technology-enabled solutions across a regional and global environment.

About You

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Data, or a related field. 5–8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Enterprise Applications, Technology Delivery, or related business partnering roles. Experience managing products or platforms supporting Finance, HR, Shared Services, Corporate Functions, or other enterprise business processes. Proven experience working in agile environments, managing backlogs, roadmaps, and cross-functional delivery teams. Experience operating in regional or global organizations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. 

Technical & Functional Skills

Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and value delivery. Experience with enterprise platforms and ecosystems supporting Finance, HR, workflow, reporting, governance, and shared services. Familiarity with ERP, HRIS, planning, reporting, analytics, service management, document management, and integration platforms. Strong understanding of business process optimization, data quality, system integrations, user adoption, and change management principles. Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Power BI, or comparable enterprise solutions. Ability to evaluate solution alternatives, dependencies, technical constraints, and business impacts to drive informed product decisions. 

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

Strong business acumen and ability to understand complex functional priorities across Finance, DBS, HR, and General Services. Proven ability to translate business needs into product strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. Excellent communication, influencing, stakeholder management, negotiation, and facilitation skills. Strong leadership through influence with a collaborative and servant leadership mindset. Ability to make informed trade-offs balancing business value, user needs, cost, complexity, and delivery timelines. Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities and results orientation. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. Customer- and user-centric mindset with a strong focus on adoption, experience, and value realization. 

Language Requirements

Fluent English required. Spanish preferred. Portuguese is a plus. 

About us

At Danone Mexico, we work with a deep conviction people's health and the health of the planet are connected. Under our global vision One Planet. One Health., we build a healthier future through food and beverages that are part of the daily lives of millions of families worldwide.

In Mexico, with more than 15,000 employees, 35 plants, and over 100 distribution centers across the country, we are a diverse and highly committed community driving iconic brands such as Danone, Activia, Oikos, Danonino, Bonafont, and Silk. Every person who joins us brings a key piece to continue evolving and innovating.

At Danone, you will find an environment where you can grow with purpose and be authentic. We value what each person contributes, and it is this combination of experiences, talents, and perspectives that strengthens our culture and drives us to achieve extraordinary results. Here, you will have the freedom to propose, create, and bring ideas to life that generate real impact.

We foster your development through continuous feedback, clear objectives, agile methodologies, and learning tools designed to accelerate your professional growth. We want you to move forward with confidence and find a path that inspires you. Your well-being is also fundamental to us. That’s why we offer flexible benefits, comprehensive health programs covering physical, emotional, and financial well-being, support platforms, exclusive discounts, and benefits above the legal requirements—supporting you at every stage of your life.

We are proudly a B Corp certified company, reflecting our commitment to responsible practices, conscious decisions, and a positive impact on people, communities, and the planet.

If you are looking for a place where you can contribute, grow, and be part of a community driven by purpose, we invite you to explore our opportunities and discover for yourself everything you can build at Danone. Your next big professional step could start here.

rows.title: Regional Planner
rows.descriptionText:
Because your perspective shapes trends.

Innovate, your way.

Merchandising at Primark

Our merchandising team turn strategic goals into vast opportunities. Here, your insights will maximise our growth as a business and ensure we continue to stay at the forefront in the world of retail fashion.

As a Regional Planner, you will lead the product range strategy across our Iberia store portfolio, ensuring ranges reflect local customer needs and market trends. Partnering with Buying, Merchandising and Design teams, you will use data-driven insights to influence product decisions and optimise performance. What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension, and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Bring 

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

5+ years’ experience in Product Merchandising or Branch Merchandising, operating at Merchandiser level with end-to-end category ownership, ideally within a fast-paced fashion retail environment.Strong expertise in grading, range building, forecasting and trading analysis, with advanced Excel skills and experience using merchandising, planning and analytics systems.Proven ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders across Buying, Merchandising and Design, using data-driven insights to shape product strategy and commercial decisions.Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data and market trends into clear, compelling recommendations.Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities, delivering high-quality outcomes in a dynamic retail environment.A proactive and collaborative approach, with the credibility to build strong cross-functional relationships, drive alignment and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Excited? Good. Because it’s energising to put your skills to work, in a growing global business committed to encouraging people to express themselves – and feel a sense of belonging. Apply to be part of Primark’s future, today… and enjoy career growth, our way.  

About Primark 

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business a over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

rows.descriptionText:
Contract: 12 month FTC

Location: Islington, London (2 days in the office per week)

Recruitment Partner: Frankie McCallister-Lyas

About The Role

We’re looking for a skilled, user-focussed Digital UX Copywriter to join our team. As Boots Online Doctor expands rapidly into new clinical areas and scales existing services, this role will play a pivotal part in shaping the end-to-end patient journey. Sitting at the intersection of UX, clinical messaging, and digital content, your primary focus will be designing and writing intuitive product flows, consultation journeys, service emails, and product pages. You will translate complex medical and regulatory information into clear, empathetic, and actionable digital copy that builds trust and guides patients seamlessly through our services.

While the core focus will be product and service copywriting, you will also collaborate closely with senior copywriters and design partners to support broader marketing campaigns, brand initiatives, and promotional copy when needed

This role also builds strong relationships with the Boots Marketing team, media partners and platform providers, ensuring Boots Online Doctor benefits from industry best practice, emerging opportunities and innovative approaches to customer acquisition.

Key Responsibilities

 Write intuitive, engaging copy across our website, patient consultation flows, checkout journeys, app screens, and product pages. Partner directly with design and development to ensure messaging aligns with interface components to maximise completion rates and reduce patient drop-off. Lead copywriting delivery for high-profile new clinical service launches and ongoing enhancements to fast-growing existing services. Work closely with Clinical and Legal/Compliance teams to translate complex medical guidelines into plain, human, accessible language while maintaining accuracy and regulatory compliance. Write and optimise transactional service emails, onboarding sequences, system notifications, and patient support messaging to build trust throughout the care pathway. Collaborate with the Clinical team to audit existing clinician-to-patient messaging and build an ongoing process for optimising clinical communications. Input into wireframing, messaging frameworks, and user testing, working with the optimisation team to test and refine copy based on A/B testing, patient feedback, analytics, and clinical updates. Act as a brand guardian for service messaging, ensuring all product touchpoints strictly adhere to the Boots and Boots Online Doctor Tone of Voice (TOV) and editorial guidelines. Provide flexible copywriting support across promotional landing pages, PPC search ads, and marketing campaigns to support wider business growth objectives.

What You’ll Need To Have

 Proven digital/UX copywriting experience writing for e-commerce, digital products, apps, or complex user journeys (product flows, wireframes, system emails). Demonstrated ability to turn complex medical, technical, or regulatory details into clear, empathetic, and engaging plain English. Meticulous attention to detail with exceptional editing and proofreading skills in a regulated environment where accuracy is critical. Solid understanding of digital user experience (UX) principles, accessibility, and how copy interacts with UI components. Strong stakeholder management skills, with confidence communicating and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams including product designers, clinical experts, and marketing leads. Strong organisational and project management skills, with the adaptability to handle multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Familiarity with using LLMs for ideation, copy drafting, refining, and process simplifications within copy generation workflows. Experience working within healthcare, health-tech, or another regulated sector is desirable. The ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively, taking initiative independently while partnering closely with cross-functional team members

 Pension membership Partial paid maternity leave Discretionary annual bonus Generous employee discounts Flexible benefits scheme

You’ll be right in the heart of the action—you’ll partner closely with Marketing and CRM Managers on marketing campaigns to turn raw data into actionable insights and clear performance reports. You’ll be right in the heart of the action—you’ll partner closely with Marketing and CRM Managers on marketing campaigns to turn raw data into actionable insights and clear performance reports. Essentially, you’re our ambassador for personalisation; you’ll champion the customer’s perspective and use data to make sure every interaction we have is brilliant, relevant, and effective.

We all own making the Partnership somewhere we belong. Embracing our differences and creating an environment where we’re free to be ourselves and can THRIVE. Growing ourselves individually, and as a collective.

As Partners, we make all the difference. And, we all own it.

rows.title: Insight Analyst – Market Insights
rows.descriptionText:
Because your new ideas are our way new ways of working. Evolve, your way.

The Global Insights Team at Primark

We are a newly formed team within Primark, at the start of an exciting journey to integrate insights into the business to drive performance.

Our mission is to drive insight-led decision making for maximum impact in helping Primark achieve its strategic goals.

The team is structured across pillars covering Brand & Marketing, Consumer Journey, Product Category, and Performance & Growth. This role sits within Performance & Growth, interpreting the market and consumer to tell the performance story for a set of priority countries.

Key Responsibilities: 

Build and own the consumer and market story for your priority countries, producing the fact-packs, competitive analysis and consumer-behaviour synthesis that guide local strategy and growth, with direction from the Performance & Growth Insights Manager.Interpret how consumers behave and how each market is moving, connecting Primark’s sales and customer data to the wider market picture to explain what is driving performance.Act as the day-to-day owner of Primark’s external research and data provider relationships, making sure the business gets the insight it needs, when it needs it.Feed consistent, comparable country inputs into the KPI frameworks and scorecards used across Strategy, Finance and Leadership.

Data Sources & Vendor Management

Own the day-to-day relationship with Primark’s external research and consumer data panels, briefing requests, tracking deliverables and quality-checking outputs.Combine syndicated market data, sales data and primary research into a single, clear view per market, covering brand health, value and price perception, market share and consumer trends.Keep source definitions and processes current so market views stay consistent and comparable across countries.

Reporting, Dashboards & Storytelling 

Produce clear, persuasive insight deliverables, including fact-packs, presentations and commentary, that get to the “so what” and the recommendation rather than reporting numbers.Present findings to country and central stakeholders in a way they can act on, helping answer “how we win with customers” for each market.Bring the analysis to life in clear visuals, using Excel and Power BI (or a similar tool) to make the story easy to follow, partnering with Data/Tech teams where heavier automation is needed.

Market & Competitor Tracking

Track competitor moves, pricing and market indicators across your markets, using Edited as a tool, flagging opportunities and risks early enough for local teams to act on them.Maintain a genuine finger on the pulse of each market through self-initiated desk research and competitive monitoring.

Essential knowledge, education, skills and experience:

2–4 years in consumer or market insight, market research or category insight, within retail, fashion, ecommerce or consumer goods.Hands-on experience with syndicated market data (Kantar/Worldpanel, and ideally GlobalData, GWI, Circana/NIQ or Oxford Economics), and comfortable combining it with sales data and primary research.A strong storyteller who interprets data, lands the “so what” and the recommendation, and holds the attention of senior, non-technical audiences.Experience owning or coordinating external research and data providers, briefing them and quality-checking what they deliver.Genuinely curious about consumers, competitors and markets, with the discipline to keep sources, definitions and processes organised.Confident in Excel and comfortable using Power BI (or a similar tool) to present analysis clearly. You don’t need to be a data engineer; you do need to make numbers tell a story.Comfortable working across markets and with a geographically dispersed team.Working proficiency in Spanish, Italian or French is a plus, given the country focus of the role.

Personal Attributes:

Genuinely curious about why consumers behave as they do, and about what competitors are doing.Highly organised and detail-oriented, able to prioritise across projects and deliverables while meeting deadlines.Articulate, with clear presentation skills and the ability to make complex information understandable to different audiences.Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills and high emotional intelligence.Resilient, able to work independently and proactively in a fast-paced, international environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Excited? Good. Because it’s energising to put your skills to work, in a growing global business committed to encouraging people to express themselves – and feel a sense of belonging. Apply to be part of Primark’s future, today… and enjoy career growth, our way.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle.

Let’s talk lifestyle: 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

About Primark

Primark was founded on a mission that everyone deserves to look and feel good – without paying more. We stand for great value without compromise, offering affordable fashion and everyday essentials that are made to last. Founded in Ireland in 1969, Primark is now an international fashion retailer with more than 470 stores across 18 countries in Europe, the US and the Middle East, employing more than 80,000 colleagues. Millions of shoppers trust Primark every week for everything from everyday essentials like t-shirts and socks, to the latest fashion trends – all at unbeatable prices. 

Primark is built on a belief and passion for physical stores – helping to bring high streets and retail centres to life and creating joyful, social experiences. The company is focused on driving positive change by giving clothing a longer life, protecting life on the planet and supporting the livelihoods of the people who make Primark clothes.

Requirements

Who we are

Drive implementation of major AI initiatives, ensuring scalable, reliable, secure, and cost-effective AI solutions across the enterprise.  Demonstrate expert-level coding proficiency by developing critical components of AI platforms, ML infrastructure, and production AI systems when hands-on technical leadership is required.  Partner with enterprise architects, product team, and the Data and AI team to shape company-wide AI architecture, providing deep technical expertise on implementation feasibility, operational considerations, scalability, and long-term maintainability.  Lead technical design of foundation model services, generative AI solutions, and agentic frameworks,  Challenge and improve existing AI architectures by identifying platform limitations, technical risks, and opportunities for innovation, proposing solutions that advance enterprise AI capabilities. Drive enterprise-wide AI/ML engineering practices including model lifecycle management, experimentation standards, evaluation methodologies, observability, reliability, and responsible AI controls.  Influence product strategy and business investment decisions through technical insights on AI feasibility, value realization, scalability, and organizational impact.  Drive engineering productivity and AI adoption across multiple teams through platform enhancements, reusable AI capabilities, automation, and reduction of systemic technical barriers.  Mentor Senior and Staff engineers while developing the next generation of AI technical leaders across the organization.  Represent lululemon externally through industry conferences, technical publications, open-source contributions, and participation in the broader AI community. 

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience; Master's preferred.  11-15+ years of progressive software engineering and AI/ML engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating enterprise-scale AI systems and platforms, or equivalent.  Expert-level coding ability with a track record of developing production-grade AI/ML systems, platforms, and infrastructure that solve highly complex technical and business challenges. Retail experience preferred.  Deep expertise across system design for complex ML solutions, model deployments, batch and real-time services, and evaluation frameworks.  Proven experience defining implementation strategies and execution approaches for complex, cross-organizational AI initiatives with measurable business impact.  Demonstrated ability to evaluate and guide adoption of emerging AI technologies  Deep experience analyzing complex technical trade-offs involving model quality, latency, reliability, scalability, cost optimization, privacy, and governance requirements.  Recognized expertise in implementing AI solutions combined with the ability to assess enterprise-wide implications and influence long-term technology direction.  Experience collaborating with applied science, product, architecture, security, and engineering leadership teams to deliver enterprise AI capabilities.  Advanced experience with implementing AI/ML engineering solutions using python , Spark, Airflow, MLFlow , feature stores, vector databases, model serving platforms, cloud AI services, Kubernetes, and modern MLOps tooling. 

Must haves

 Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.  Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results.   Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same.   Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.   Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.   Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.  

Additional Notes

Please note: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from $266,720 - $350,070   annually  ; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

EA’s CFO organization comprises a broad group of finance disciplines. Our common goal is partnership with business teams delivering strategies and providing our players with amazing experiences. All of our finance teams assist the business in achieving profitable creativity by providing financial insight, reporting and guidance.

We use progressive tools to analyze and visualize data, telling the story of financial drivers, performance, risks and opportunities. We value attributes like collaboration and learning. We celebrate inclusion by creating a place where you can come to work and be yourself.

Role Overview: 

Our Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) team provides strategic and financial partnership to EA’s Leadership team. We achieve this through engaging with our partners to influence and help deliver our broad strategy, providing strategic decision support and insights to guide EA’s performance.  

This Sr. Finance Director will lead business support for our central EA Studios organizations, serving as:

An embedded and trusted senior advisor to Studio & Franchise businesses & teams; andAn experienced & demonstrated leader in the Global Finance organization, contributing to strategic functional initiatives and transformation.

Supported by a team of ~10 employees, you will report to the Vice-President of FP&A, EA Studios, while partnering closely with EA Studios central leadership. You will work a hybrid work model defined as 3 days a week in an EA office.

Responsibilities

You will partner with senior leaders across the business, including our SVP / General Managers, Heads of Operations & Publishing, Executive Producers and their leadership teams to support all financial elements associated with the successful strategy execution of our central EA Studios organizations, including Central Development Partners (CDP), Central Technology and TRACAB. Job Summary

Product Operations Educators are experts in organization and efficiency, executing inventory processing and other product operations, as directed and according to the company’s standards. Product Operations Educators receive and process shipments, organize product within the store (the retail floor and the back of house) as directed, and complete other inventory-related tasks to maximize profitable product sell-through. Support guests on the retail floor by providing service or connecting the guest to another team member.

Core Responsibilities Of The Job

Organize and clean the inventory workspace to maximize efficiency and maintain a safe store environment. Execute inventory processing plan established by the Product Operations Lead, including accurate RFID inventory counts according to company standards. Receive and process product deliveries according to the company’s standards, such as folding, sorting, and hanging product to optimize space and productivity. Reconcile, prepare, package, and ship product to appropriate locations according to company standards (e.g., damages, consolidations). Execute product display adjustments, daily restocking and destocking, or product moves on the floor according to company standards to maintain store organization and presentation. Execute market-relevant omnichannel programs (e.g., buy online/pickup in store and ship from store options) according to company standards. Interact with guests or facilitate connection with another team member to provide service on the retail floor and support the guest’s experience. Contribute to a respectful and inclusive team environment to ensure a supportive and engaging experience for all team members and guests. Use in-store technology to support store operations and provide positive guest experiences.

Work Context (e.g., environment, interactions, physical)

Work involves moving through the store, sometimes on the sales floor with bright lights and loud music, and sometimes in areas with no windows or natural lightWork is accomplished as part of a team, sometimes independently, and sometimes using a computer or other technologyWork may involve moving boxes weighing up to 30 lbs (13.6 kg) or using ladders to reach materials

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. That includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

The Enterprise Data & AI team is a strategic and operational driver of growth for lululemon, owning and building the data and AI platforms and products that enable the enterprise to operate with intelligence at scale. The team leads the design and delivery of a trusted unified data foundation, advanced analytics capabilities, and AI solutions across lululemon’s vertically integrated retail ecosystem, embedding strong data governance and responsible AI practices from the very beginning. By applying AI to critical business challenges and creating new, transformative AI solutions, the team helps reshape how lululemon operates. Through deep partnership with product, technology, and business teams, Enterprise Data & AI accelerates product innovation, unlocks measurable value, elevates guest and educator experiences, and drives enterprise efficiency.

Core Responsibilities

As an Applied AI/ML Scientist, you design, develop, test, and optimize AI/ML solutions that address defined business problems, with an emphasis on applied modeling, experimentation, and translating advanced AI research into scalable, production-ready solutions. You work independently to design and adapt AI/ML approaches to build prototypes, and improve model performance, reliability, and efficiency. You use domain knowledge and collaborate with stakeholders and product teams to map the business problem to the right model and AI/ML solution approach. You own the AI solution implementation and partner with engineering teams to integrate solutions into the broader engineering system. You contribute to solution enhancements, validate outcomes, and continuously improve models based on real world performance.

Examples of projects could be

Designing and deploying machine learning and predictive/generative AI models for demand forecasting, optimization, personalization and search, intelligent automation, and multimodal content creation and enrichment Applying NLP, computer vision, multimodal, or time series modeling techniques to enterprise-scale datasets that are a mix of structured and unstructured dataDeveloping experimentation frameworks and evaluation approaches to measure business impact of AI solutions in productionCollaborating with product and engineering teams to embed AI models into end to end business workflows

Select Responsibilities Include

Translate business challenges into AI/ML approaches by working with key SMEs and stakeholders to understand problems and map them to the right AI/ML solution approach. Design experiments and establish success criteria aligned with business goalsDevelop AI/ML solutions for complex business problems applying advanced techniques to deliver measurable business impact, building production-ready models, and ensuring solutions scale effectivelyDevelop prototypes and conduct rigorous experimentation, design evaluation plan to analyze model performance, and iterate to improve accuracy, generalization, interpretability, and business impactDevelop end-to-end working AI/ML solutions for assigned use cases from data ingestion through inference, and partner with AI/ML engineers and software engineers to ensure seamless integration into production workflows and processes

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, or related field, Masters preferred4-8 years of experience building and optimizing AI/ML solutions, or equivalent research experience, including educational experience (e.g., Master's or PhD degree)Demonstrated experience in evaluating and applying state-of-the-art AI/ML models and methods to develop practical, high-performing solutions to specific use-cases. Experience designing AI/ML approaches, conducting experiments to evaluate performance, iterating on solution design to improve performance, and translating AI-ML driven insights into business goalsProven ability to navigate technical complexity within assigned solutions including data transformation and preparation, model training and fine-tuning, latency constraints, and integration requirements within established architectural patternsExperience with ML implementation using commonly used tools such as Python, pyTorch, cloud ML platforms and libraries, open-source toolkits.

Must haves

Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results. Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same. Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously.

Additional Notes

Please note: Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from   $146,830-$192,720   annually  ; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

At Lululemon, Investing In Our People Is a Top Priority. We Believe That When Life Works, Work Works. We Strive To Be The Place Where Inclusive Leaders Come To Develop And Enable All To Be Well. Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth

rows.title: Lead Integrations Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
We’re Pret: proud makers of freshly made food, organic coffee, and big ideas. Across 750+ shops and 20+ countries, our teams are shaping the future of Pret through innovation, inclusion, great customer service and a shared passion for doing the right thing. We’re growing fast on our mission to be the employer of choice in hospitality, everywhere we operate – so this an exciting time to hop on board.

We Believe in Growing Good Things

Growth is at the heart of everything we do. From the freshly hand-made food we create every day, to supporting our teams, we help our people grow in confidence, skills and to pursue their unique paths. Pret is where passionate, hardworking, wonderful people (like you!) find what they need to shine. And the proof is in the pudding – over 80% of our Managers started on the shop floor! So did 20% of our Support Centre teams, including our CEO, Pano.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for passionate team players to bring joy to our customers every day. As a Lead Integrations Engineer, you’ll set the standards and patterns the Integrations Engineers follow across our Azure integration stack (APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid), line-manage the team, and personally deliver the most complex and highest-risk flows in the estate. All new integration assets at Pret are being built on Azure; the legacy MuleSoft Anypoint estate is in a controlled wind-down through this programme. You will own that migration end to end and keep the legacy MuleSoft flows safely operational and well-led until they retire. Expect to spend roughly half your week in code, building, debugging, reviewing pull requests, pairing with engineers and the other half on architecture, standards, vendor conversations, team leadership and stakeholder engagement.

This is the key technical leadership role for integrations at Pret. Reporting to the Head of Data & Integrations, you will lead Pret's Integrations team and own the target architecture that connects our SaaS platforms, including Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite and e-commerce systems, with our data, finance and operational platforms.

You will also be responsible for building the team's most complex integrations yourself, using the same tools and technologies as the rest of the team. We are not looking for a hands-off manager.

This role is for a senior engineer who has grown into leadership without losing their technical edge. You will have led an integrations team working across both MuleSoft and Azure and understand first-hand what it takes to migrate an integration estate from one platform to the other without disrupting the business.

If your last hands-on Azure integration build was three years ago, this is probably not the role for you. But if you still enjoy tackling a challenging Function App on a Friday afternoon while also developing and mentoring a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

Act as the technical owner for the integration’s estate: the single accountable engineering voice on integration architecture, standards and delivery, reporting to the Head of Data & Integrations. Line-manage the Integrations Engineers (FTE and FTC): own performance, development, one-to-ones, and the team's engineering culture. Own the integration architecture for Pret's SaaS source systems and internal services, including Workday, Oracle Symphony, NetSuite, ecommerce platforms and others. All new build is on Azure. Personally design and build the hardest, highest-risk integrations on the Azure integration stack (APIM, Logic Apps, Function Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid). Lead the team through the controlled wind-down of the legacy MuleSoft Anypoint estate: keep it safely operational while in use, sequence and migrate flows onto the Azure stack on the programme timeline and decommission cleanly. Define and enforce integration patterns and standards across the team: API design, event-driven flows, retry / error handling, idempotency, observability, security all anchored on Azure-native services. Produce reference implementations on the Azure stack that the team builds from APIM API templates, Function App patterns, Service Bus topologies, deployment pipelines. Run a healthy engineering practice in the team: review every non-trivial pull request, pair on the hardest pieces, unblock the team in code where needed, and grow more junior engineers. Build and maintain the team's engineering toolchain on Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, test frameworks, observability dashboards in Application Insights and Log Analytics. Work with the Data Engineering on the boundary between integration and data engineering, which data lands where, in what shape, on what cadence. Define and maintain the API and integration catalogue: what we have, who owns it, what it does, what SLA it runs to. Manage supplier and vendor relationships across the integration stack, including Microsoft, the MuleSoft wind-down, and any third-party connectors. Be the senior technical voice in vendor and SaaS conversations on integration capability. Act as senior technical escalation point and on-call backstop for major integration incidents, including evenings and weekends where required. Expect to be the one in the flow on Sunday night when a Workday-to-NetSuite job has fallen over. Report progress, risks and architectural decisions clearly to the Head of Data & Integrations and to programme leadership. Stay current with developments in Azure integration services and bring practical, working recommendations back to the team ideally as proof-of-concept code. 

Essential

Experience and Skills required

6+ years' experience in integration / API engineering, with a recent track record of personally designing AND building production integrations on Azure. This is a builder-manager role. Proven experience leading an integrations team across both MuleSoft and Azure — line-managing or technically leading a team of integration engineers through the delivery and operation of a real estate on both platforms, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers. Demonstrable experience leading an integration estate off MuleSoft Anypoint and onto Azure: sequencing the migration, keeping the legacy flows stable and supported through the transition, and decommissioning cleanly. Note: our MuleSoft estate is in a controlled wind-down. We need someone who can lead and operate it safely to retirement, not someone whose primary strength is new MuleSoft build. Experience personally building Azure integrations with Workday, Oracle Symphony or NetSuite. Experience migrating an integration estate off another legacy platform (BizTalk, Tibco, Boomi or similar) as well as MuleSoft. Experience with event-driven architectures at scale on Azure. Experience defining Azure landing-zone or platform-level standards (networking, identity, observability) for an integration estate. Experience in retail, hospitality, QSR or omnichannel. 

About You

 Be kind, honest and generous: bring genuine warmth and your authentic self to work every day. Bring your passion: share our passion for food and exceptional customer service. Spread joy every day: small acts of kindness are a big part of what makes the Pret experience special.

 Competitive Salary and 20% bonus potentialGold Card: We love making people’s day through our food and drinks. That goes for our teams too. That’s why everyone gets a Gold Card. Our values

 Happy Teams Happy Customers  Amazing Standards Every day  Never Standing Still  Doing The Right Thing 

 The interview journey 

Every interview process at Pret begins with the same two stages. First, you’ll have a relaxed 30-minute conversation with our recruitment team so we can get to know you and your experience. Next, you’ll be invited to a one-hour, in-person interview with the hiring manager at our Head Office in London Victoria.

Depending on the role and function, there may be additional stages. These could include time spent in one of our shops, completing a task, or meeting a senior leader.

This role is based at Pret’s Support Centre in London Victoria, where we work in a hybrid way - typically three days a week in the office.

rows.title: Senior Manager II, Global Analytics (Hybrid: Chicago, Illinois)
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We have a global commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion as we believe in the undeniable strength that diversity brings to our business, employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

Advanced Analytics is the tip of the spear of our Global Solutions team within Circana. The team works with senior management at some of the world’s largest and most successful consumer packaged goods, retail, general merchandise, and over-the-counter health care companies, as well as for Private Equity firms.

You will be dedicated to one of our marquee clients within the Beverage Alcohol space. Along with digging into data and building statistical models from scratch, you will translate the outputs from the models into actionable, analytic insights.

You will work directly with the client as a trusted business partner to derive the “why of consumer behavior. You will translate Circana analytical expertise into actionable, measurable insights to drive Circana clients’ business performance. You will leverage existing and new, innovative approaches to address potential new clients’ business challenges and market opportunities (i.e. brand equity, trade marketing, pricing and promotions). You’ll develop and maintain a deep understanding of clients’ businesses cross-functionally and a strong knowledge of new and emerging analytic solutions (both CIRCANA and industry) that anticipate and strategically position Circana client for success.

You will participate in the development of new service offerings by building and enhancing the value and breadth of the current analytical solutions. You will have a strong working knowledge of current trends in the Marketing, Market Research, and CPG Industries including Trade, Pricing and Promotion and other analytic techniques that will be the foundation to drive actionable insights. You’ll apply superior business savvy and consultative sales capabilities to client engagement in order to convert insights into revenue and margin contributions to Circana Analytics. Additionally, you will develop best practices, templates and deliverables around the data.

Job Responsibilities 

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Demonstrate ability to analyze and interpret analytics solutions and models and translate it into meaningful solutions for clients. Deliver Insight – Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Approach client with coherent, actionable and fact-based data/recommendations appropriate to their business needs. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. Continually provide analytical solutions and business insights to address any business gaps and/or opportunities and create value for the client. Identify business issues and opportunities and suggest the appropriate level analytic solution/approach. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Consultative Selling: Apply knowledge of the business, industry and domain to identify, create and close business opportunities:Target and sell services that address unexpressed and underlying client needs; ask questions to identify the root causes of issues versus symptoms. Ask questions to test assumptions and challenges the status quo. Synthesize information on a variety of issues; translate the information into a project framework that ultimately provides solutions for clients. Build Strategic Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations, including decision-makers and influencers. Impactful Presence: Demonstrate strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills; present a professional image:Become trusted by client, Circana cross functional organizations and considered a domain expert and business partnerEducate the client on analytic methods, shape their thinking and influence the decisions they makeDemonstrate a flexible approach to communication; adapt messages quickly to the appropriate level or function with poise and polishChampion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Client Focus: Consistently act with client satisfaction in mind and follow through on commitments to ensure the needs of the client are met:Develop and maintain a deep understanding of customer needs and requirementsHelp customers identify solutions to problems they did not know they hadRegularly and proactively communicate with the client-facing teams, including soliciting feedback to continually improving the relationshipTrack and organize multiple work streams against multiple clients, and manage time and resources against changing priorities
Requirements

2-4 Years of experience in CPG industry. Previous professional application of statistical analysis across multiple clients. Consultative application of analytic solutions to solve business issues. Able to engage in a consultative manner across multiple levels. Ability to present to VP+ level managers within and outside Circana. Demonstrable ability to coach and lead teams. Intellectual curiosity. Exceptional problem-solving skills and high-level business savvy. Demonstrated ability delivering results (i.e. financial, client satisfaction). Ability to code in r, SAS and/or python. Preferred, not required. Ability to glean and integrate insights from a variety of data sources. Demonstrated ability to manage projects and balance competing client priorities. Highly organized. A Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative discipline is required. An advanced degree is preferred. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questionsSeek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire actionOwn the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choicesCenter on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customersBe a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvementChampion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect and integrityCommit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone

Location

This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid in Greater Chicagoland Area. Must be on-site in the client's Chicago office.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. Company Description

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Product Manager to drive the evolution of our loyalty execution platform. This role sits at the intersection of product management, customer loyalty strategy, customer analytics, artificial intelligence, client engagement, and market intelligence. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in shaping our loyalty technology roadmap by gathering market insights, understanding client and prospect needs, and translating those inputs into innovative product capabilities that deliver measurable value.
