rows.title: Product Specialist - Rentals

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
What is Bilt?

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

What’s the role?

As a Product Specialist on the Rentals pod, you will be the dedicated customer advocate for the resident rent payment experience and the housing platform that powers our multifamily partners. This role exists to make sure the products we ship are not only thoughtfully designed and launched, but continuously maintained and improved through tight feedback loops between our internal teams, our property manager partners, and residents.

You will sit at the intersection of product operations, product analysis, and quality assurance, working across the end-to-end leasing journey — from a resident finding and signing a lease to paying rent every month. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and Support to pressure-test flows, track performance, and surface the insights that make the experience better for both residents and the operators who serve them.

In this role, you will… 

Represent residents and property manager partners in Rentals pod discussions and decision makingRun full product journeys end to end — leasing, onboarding, and monthly rent payment — to understand the real experienceTest new features, enhancements, and partner integrations across environments as the first line of defense for product qualityDocument, prioritize, and drive bugs and usability issues to resolution in Linear alongside engineering and productMonitor core product and business metrics tied to adoption, usage, and payment success across the Rentals platformAnalyze resident and partner behavior to identify trends, edge cases, failure points, and improvement opportunitiesPartner directly with multifamily operators to understand how each partner's business works, and translate that into product feedbackSurface downstream implications for internal teams, partners, and residents before and after launchTranslate learnings from testing, support signals, and experimentation into clear, prioritized recommendationsBuild and refine AI workflows using tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude to speed up testing, analysis, and documentation

In Terms Of Qualifications, We’re Seeking

2+ years of experience in a product role — product operations, product analytics, QA, consulting, or similarDeeply obsessive about user experience and product quality, with natural attention to detail and strong product intuitionGenuine curiosity — you dig into how something works and why it broke rather than logging it and moving onStrong partnering skills: able to work directly with external partners, understand their business, and map what you learn onto product feedbackStrong analytical skills and comfort working with product and business dataAbility to synthesize quantitative signals and qualitative feedback into actionable insightsExcellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate issues and recommendationsHigh comfort using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude in day-to-day work, and the ability to design and iterate on AI-driven workflowsNice to have: Experience in proptech, multifamily, or real estate technologyExperience working closely with engineering and design teamsFamiliarity with analytics tools or SQLExperience supporting both consumer and partner-facing products
Benefits

Compensation - We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus programHealth insurance for you (& your loved ones) from day one - Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.401k plan with a match - Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.Commuter FSAs - We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.UNLIMITED PTO - Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points - We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.Team Events - We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes - should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

The salary range for a Product Specialist is $70,000 - 120,000 and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance-based bonus.

rows.title: Principal, Product Management - Loyalty Execution Platform
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Company Description

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Product Manager to drive the evolution of our loyalty execution platform. This role sits at the intersection of product management, customer loyalty strategy, customer analytics, artificial intelligence, client engagement, and market intelligence. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in shaping our loyalty technology roadmap by gathering market insights, understanding client and prospect needs, and translating those inputs into innovative product capabilities that deliver measurable value.

This individual will identify emerging trends in customer loyalty and engagement. They will anticipate future market needs. They will help define how customer data and analytics improve the loyalty experience by building more personalized, relevant, and effective interactions. The successful candidate combines deep loyalty marketing expertise with a strong background in SaaS product development and execution. This position will also require a solid understanding of customer analytics and innovative use of first- and third-party data to create personalized experiences for consumers.

Candidates will ideally be located in the Dallas, Chicago, or Denver metropolitan areas. Boston and New York may also be considered locations.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap Development

rows.title: Client Sales & Insights Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

As innovators in Big Data, Circana seeks passionate client advocates with strong analytic skills to advance solutions that best build the client's strategic vision. The Foodservice Team at Circana works with some of the most innovative companies in the industry. This role reports to the Director in Client Development and will contribute to our clients' engagement, satisfaction, and growth by providing value-added insights for decision making. The position provides the opportunity to make an impact, leveraging fact-based insights and analysis, while developing the knowledge and skills required for continued success in market research solutions.

Job Responsibilities

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Manage the Sales Cycle: Lead end-to-end sales processes including prospecting, needs assessment, solution development, negotiation, and closing. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in [retail, CPG, or general merchandise] to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor. Build Strategic Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations, including decision-makers and influencers. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Achieve Revenue Targets: Meet or exceed individual and team sales goals through disciplined pipeline management and strategic account planning. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Support Innovation and Feedback: Provide market feedback to internal teams to help refine offerings and contribute to product development. Overview

Company Description

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Product Manager to drive the evolution of our loyalty execution platform. This role sits at the intersection of product management, customer loyalty strategy, customer analytics, artificial intelligence, client engagement, and market intelligence. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in shaping our loyalty technology roadmap by gathering market insights, understanding client and prospect needs, and translating those inputs into innovative product capabilities that deliver measurable value.

This individual will identify emerging trends in customer loyalty and engagement. They will anticipate future market needs. They will help define how customer data and analytics improve the loyalty experience by building more personalized, relevant, and effective interactions. The successful candidate combines deep loyalty marketing expertise with a strong background in SaaS product development and execution. This position will also require a solid understanding of customer analytics and innovative use of first- and third-party data to create personalized experiences for consumers.

Candidates will ideally be located in the Dallas, Chicago, or Denver metropolitan areas. Boston and New York may also be considered locations.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Roadmap Development

Serve as a key contributor to the strategic direction and roadmap of the loyalty execution platform.Find opportunities for new features, functionality, and platform enhancements that improve client outcomes and drive business growth.Develop cases, product requirements, and implementation plans for new capabilities.Prioritize initiatives based on customer value, market demand, strategic fit, and business impact.

AI & Personalization Strategy

Help define and complete the company's vision for incorporating AI, customer strategy, and analytics throughout the loyalty experience.Find opportunities for technology-powered capabilities that enable clients to deliver more personalized customer journeys, communications, offers, rewards, and experiences using Epsilon’s proprietary customer data assets.Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and market developments to determine their applicability within the loyalty platform.Partner with product, engineering, data, analytics, and customer teams to translate AI & personalization concepts into scalable product functionality.Develop use-cases and requirements for predictive, recommendation, segmentation, and personalization capabilities that create measurable client value.Find opportunities to integrate Epsilon’s differentiated data, activation, identity, and digital assets into the loyalty platform.

Market & Industry Intelligence

Stay current on trends, innovations, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies within the customer loyalty, customer engagement, AI, and marketing technology industries.Monitor industry developments and see opportunities to strengthen the platform's competitive position.Anticipate future client needs and evolving market requirements to inform long-term product strategy.

Customer & Prospect Insights

Establish ongoing processes for collecting and analyzing feedback from clients, prospects, sales teams, and customer-facing collaborators.Conduct customer interviews, discovery sessions, and market research to identify unmet needs and opportunities.Translate customer insights into actionable product enhancements and roadmap initiatives.

Product Development & Execution

Partner with engineering, UX/UI, data, and business partners throughout the product development lifecycle.Create detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation documentation.Use design and prototyping tools to develop working, proven prototypes of product functionality.Lead cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch and post-launch optimization.Ensure solutions are aligned with customer needs, business goals, and platform architecture.Communicate product strategy and enhancement releases throughout the organization to inform sales, engineering, leadership, and other groups.

rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com

Role Overview

We are seeking an exceptional operator and trusted advisor to serve as Chief of Staff to Circana’s Chief Strategy Officer (CSO) and to lead our new Strategy Enablement team which will centralize strategic planning, coordination, and execution support across the Corporate Strategy team. You will be the connective tissue across Circana’s Executive Leadership Team (ELT), Commercial leadership, and the Corporate Strategy team, running the annual strategic planning and deployment cycle, supporting the ELT’s operating cadence, and leading strategic projects and initiatives directly on behalf of senior leaders. Reporting directly to the CSO, you will be a key member of Circana’s strategy leadership team, trusted to represent the CSO in rooms where strategy meets day-to-day execution.

As a leader within Circana, you will work closely with the ELT, Commercial leadership, and the CEO’s office to keep the strategic planning process, executive operating rhythm, and key leadership moments running smoothly. The successful candidate will interact daily with the CEO, CCO, and other executive team members, acting as an extension of the CSO — anticipating needs, protecting priorities, and making sure the right work reaches the right owner at the right time.

Circana is also rebuilding how the strategy function itself works, using AI tools like Claude as part of the day-to-day toolkit for synthesis, planning, and content creation. You will be expected to work fluently with these tools, not just strategize them, and to help the broader team build repeatable habits and workflows around them.

This is a critical leadership position within Circana. The ideal candidate will operate with sound judgment, discretion, and a calm, steady presence under pressure — someone who can move fluidly between the boardroom and the spreadsheet, and who makes the CSO’s job smaller, not bigger. They will have the maturity, confidence, and real-world experience to earn trust quickly across the ELT and to lead and develop a small, high-impact team. This candidate must have a genuine passion for enabling others’ success — translating strategy into action and consistently putting the mission of the team and the company ahead of personal credit.

Job Responsibilities

Strategy Deployment & Annual Planning: Own and run Circana’s annual strategic planning and deployment cycle (heaviest September–December), partnering with the CSO and pillar pod leads to turn strategic priorities into an executable annual plan, with clear tracking and reporting cadence throughout the year Strategy Enablement: Lead a small Strategy Enablement team that centralizes planning, coordination, governance, and execution support for the company’s highest-priority strategic initiatives. ELT Operating Cadence: Drive the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Executive Leadership Team, including agendas, materials, attendee coordination, and follow-through, so the ELT’s time is focused on the right priorities. Executive Strategic Projects: Lead strategic projects and initiatives sponsored by the CEO, CCO, CSO, and Commercial leaders, from time-sensitive requests to multi-week, cross-functional efforts, bringing judgment, discretion, and a steady hand to each. Chief of Staff Partnership: Act as a trusted sounding board and extension of the CSO, representing their priorities and voice in day-to-day interactions across the organizationInitiative Tracking & Reporting: Maintain visibility into strategic initiative progress across the organization, keeping reporting and tracking tools current so the ELT and CSO always have an accurate, real-time pictureBoard-Level Content Preparation: Work closely with the CSO and senior management to coordinate and develop Board decks and Board letters in support of key strategic outputsAI-Enabled Ways of Working: Use AI tools (e.g., Claude) as part of the daily toolkit for synthesis, planning, and content creation, and help build repeatable playbooks that the broader strategy team can reuse. 

Requirements

5+ years of experience in a Chief of Staff, executive operations, corporate strategy, transformation, program leadership, or consulting role, ideally supporting a C-suite or senior executive leader. Candidates with different levels of experience may be considered based on the depth, pace, and relevance of their background. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or other advanced degree a plus, but not required Experience in consumer products, consumer services, retail, software, analytics, or business intelligence is a plus; candidates from other complex, strategy-intensive industries will also be considered. Strong program/project management skills — able to scope, sequence, and drive complex, cross-functional initiatives (such as an annual planning cycle) to a deadline with minimal oversight Excellent people and leadership skills, with the ability to earn trust and credibility with senior executives quickly and lead and develop a small, high-performing team. Prior direct people management or comparable experience leading teams and complex work through influence is preferred. Hands-on fluency with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) as part of a daily workflow for synthesis, drafting, and planning — comfort building and reusing AI-enabled workflows is expected. Experience managing multiple concurrent programs across a large, cross-functional, global organizationUnquestionable discretion and judgment in handling sensitive, confidential, or politically-charged informationStrong financial and business acumen, with the ability to use Excel, PowerPoint, AI, and other tools to analyze information and develop executive-level reporting and presentations. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including executive storytelling — able to distill complex or ambiguous topics into clear, ELT- and Board-ready narratives An entrepreneurial, creative thinker with an action-oriented approach characterized by speed and productivityAn ability to operate at the highest ethical levels and project this integrity to customers and employeesA calm, steady presence under pressure and tight, shifting timelines — particularly during the September–December planning cycle

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, US with a strong preference for candidates located in the New York or Chicago areas.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $180,000 USD. This role is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 65% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. That’s just the tip of the iceberg…or as we might say, one “slice” of the pie! If this sounds like a brand you’d like to be a part of, consider joining our team!

Job Description

The International Pricing & Revenue Management Director partners with Master Franchisee (MFZ) organizations and Domino’s Pizza International (DPI) teams to define, influence, and support pricing strategies that maximize revenue, profitability, and long-term market competitiveness.

This role will leverage data analytics, consumer insights, and competitive intelligence to optimize menu pricing, promotions, and value positioning while balancing brand perception and traffic. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor, the Director helps shape Domino’s international point of view on Pricing and Revenue Management, builds scalable knowledge and tools, and leads a high performing international pricing consulting team.

The ideal candidate will have a proven history of driving revenue growth through data-driven pricing strategies. and showcasing exceptional leadership, collaboration, and influencing abilities at senior levels across diverse markets. The role operates within a broad collaboration network, working alongside International Markets leadership, Business Teams, Brand and Digital COEs, and external aggregator partners.

General Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing & Revenue Management:

Support international markets in defining, refining, and optimizing pricing strategies to optimize revenue and profitability across all menu categories and channels. Provide hands‑on strategic pricing consulting to priority markets, from opportunity assessment through execution support. Leverage competitive benchmarking, market trends, and economic factors to inform pricing decisions. Collaborate with finance, marketing, operations, and supply chain teams to align pricing strategies with business objectives. Lead A/B testing and price elasticity studies to assess the impact of price changes on demand and profitability. Drive menu optimization initiatives to enhance overall value perception and sales mix. Utilize data analytics and modeling to evaluate pricing effectiveness and identify growth opportunities. Develop and track key pricing performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success. Conduct margin analysis to ensure price adjustments align with cost structures and profit goals while balancing long-term market share growth. Monitor industry trends, competitor pricing, and consumer behavior to stay ahead of market dynamics. Assess macroeconomic factors such as inflation, commodity costs, and wage trends to adjust pricing strategies. Lead and continuously improve consumer research methodologies to assess willingness to pay and to optimize menu pricing and coupon / offer constellation

Knowledge Development and Deployment:

Develop and evolve pricing guidelines and frameworks to drive customer-centric and competition-aware pricing strategies and decisions in our international marketsConsolidate learnings and best practices from U.S. and international markets into scalable frameworks, playbooks, and guidance. Develop and maintain standards, tools, and resources that enable markets to define consumer-validated and competition-informed pricing strategies and execute consistently and effectively across channels. Facilitate structured knowledge‑sharing forums to accelerate learning and adoption within DPI and across International Markets

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

Serve as the pricing thought leader, influencing senior executives and franchise partners. Oversee and develop partnerships with external Pricing or Revenue Management consulting firms or service providers. Work closely with marketing in DPI and MFZ organizations to align pricing with brand positioning, value messaging, and promotional strategy. Lead and recruit a strong team of pricing analysts and develop talent by offering constructive and actionable feedback and creating opportunities for learning. Foster a collaborative culture and lead with a unified and ambitious vision. Recognize, engage, and motivate team members. Encourage transparent communication and mutual respect among team members and stakeholders. 

Qualifications

Strong academic credentials, Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Business Administration or other related field, Masters or MBA strongly preferred15+ years of experience in pricing strategy, revenue management, or analytics, preferably in QSR, retail, or consumer goods. Strong analytical and financial acumen, with expertise in SQL, Excel, or similar data tools. Proven track record of driving revenue growth through data-driven pricing strategies:Experience with price elasticity modeling, A/B testing, and machine learning-driven pricing optimization is a plus. Experience designing, running and analyzing customer quantitative surveys to determine pricing strategies is advantageous. Demonstrated ownership to drive content and action through proactive problem-solving, pragmatism, and the ability to handle ambiguity with a continuous learning mindset. Solid project management skills and attention to detail. A history of leading and developing high-performance teams. Ability to thrive in a collaborative, complex cross-functional team environment. Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and franchise partners. Experience working across multiple Geographies and Regions

Additional Information

Benefits:

 Paid Holidays and Vacation   Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents Childcare tuition discounts No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs Fertility benefits Adoption assistance 401k matching contributions   15% off the purchase price of stock   Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Domino’s Pizza, which began in 1960 as a single store location in Ypsilanti, MI, has had a lot to celebrate lately: we’re a reshaped, reenergized brand of honesty, transparency and accountability – not to mention, great food! In the rise to becoming a true technology leader, the brand is now consistently one of the top five companies in online transactions and 85% of our sales in the U.S. are taken through digital channels. The brand continues to ‘deliver the dream’ to local business owners, 90% of which started as delivery drivers and pizza makers in our stores. Job Description

The International Aggregators Business Manager supports Domino’s Pizza International’s Aggregator Center of Excellence (COE). The mission of the role is to help international markets define and execute strategies that drive incremental sales on third-party aggregator platforms while reinforcing Domino’s brand positioning across channels.

This role partners closely with International Markets, Business Teams, and cross-functional COEs to support effective aggregator strategies that are commercially impactful, operationally sound, and aligned with broader market priorities across channels including Carryout and 1P Delivery. The Manager helps translate best practices and market learnings into practical tools, recommendations, and execution support for priority markets.

Responsibilities

Aggregator Strategy Consulting

Support international markets in defining, refining, and optimizing aggregator strategies that drive sales growth while reinforcing Domino’s brand positioning. Provide hands-on support to priority markets, helping move initiatives from opportunity assessment through execution. Advise markets on best practices for balancing aggregator growth with long-term business sustainability across owned and third-party channels. Identify risks, dependencies, and operational constraints related to aggregator initiatives and partner cross-functionally to help address them. Support test-and-learn initiatives across the aggregator experience to improve conversion, customer satisfaction, and overall performance. 

Knowledge Development and Deployment

Help capture, organize, and evolve Domino’s international point of view on third-party aggregators through market learnings, examples, and best practices. rows.title: Product Specialist - Concierge

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
What is Bilt?

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

What’s the role?

We're hiring a Product Specialist to own whether Bilt's AI concierge says the right thing — on every vertical (rentals, dining, travel, payments, mortgages, CX) and every surface (app, web, SMS, email). Sitting on the Concierge Services pod and reporting to the GM (Kush Parikh), you'll run the daily quality loop: monitor conversations in the concierge analytics dashboard, diagnose the ones that went wrong down to the layer that caused them (prompt, knowledge, tool output, or an upstream service), ship the fix, and validate it by replaying real conversations.

This is one of the most cross-functional seats at Bilt. Nearly every pod in the company builds on the concierge, and they come to you — dining, rentals, property, travel, mortgage, payments and more. You'll be the person who teaches those teams to own their concierge surface, decides what belongs in knowledge versus prompt versus tool, and turns anything you do twice into an automation. You don't need to be an engineer, but you will operate git with AI tooling, review bot-authored PRs, and edit prompt YAML and knowledge files from week one — a real appetite for that is essential.

In this role, you will… 

Monitor concierge conversation quality daily across all verticals and surfaces, using quality flags, judge verdicts, and the issues tracker to spot bad patterns before an internal customer reports themDiagnose flagged conversations to the correct layer — prompt, knowledge, tool output, or an upstream backend bug — and drive fixes to completion, including in services owned by other teamsShip fixes to prompt YAML, knowledge markdown, and tool-output shaping, validating each by replaying real conversations before opening the PRReview concierge PRs as a codeowner, including bot-authored and contributor PRs from other podsField and triage internal asks from dining, rentals, property, travel, mortgage, payments, and CX — "can the concierge do X on our surface" and "why did it say Y"Enable pods to own their concierge surface: how to add features and prompt for their audience, what belongs in knowledge versus prompt versus tool, and how to triage conversations in the analytics dashboardBuild automations and repo skills that convert recurring manual work — investigations, monitoring, knowledge updates — into systems that keep running when priorities shiftTest in staging before ship, including daily SMS/iMessage and email checks, cross-channel tracing, and cross-pod QA on surfaces outside the concierge podWatch for regressions on model changes that don't show up in aggregate scores, and design escalation logic when the concierge should hand off to a humanProvision phone numbers, email addresses, and DNS for new merchants going live on SMS or email

In Terms Of Qualifications, We’re Seeking

Around 3 years of relevant experience — we're also open to candidates with about a year if they bring a proven technical backgroundGenuine technical appetite: comfort operating git with AI tooling, reviewing PRs, and editing structured files like YAML and markdown (or a demonstrated ability to pick this up fast)Strong diagnostic instincts — the ability to trace a problem across multiple systems and land on the actual root cause, not the nearest symptomExceptional written and verbal communication — you'll work with nearly every pod at Bilt and need to say "no" or "not that way" and have it land wellExperience working with LLM-powered products, prompting, or conversational AIAbility to own a daily operating loop end to end with minimal supervision, and to prioritize by frequency and blast radiusNice to have: Experience building automations or agent workflows (Devin, Claude Code, or similar)Fintech, rewards, or loyalty experienceStartup experienceQA or test-plan writing experience
Benefits

Compensation - We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus programHealth insurance for you (& your loved ones) from day one - Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.401k plan with a match - Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.Commuter FSAs - We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.UNLIMITED PTO - Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points - We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.Team Events - We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes - should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

The salary range for a Product Specialist is $70,000 - 120,000 and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance-based bonus.

Requirements

1-2+ years’ experience in analytical or market research role. Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Experience in consumer, POS, custom and/or syndicated research is an asset. Experience accurately interpreting data and clearly articulating findings into cohesive and succinct stories. Detail-oriented, organized, and proactive in task-management skills. Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, USA.

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $56K to $67K.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

Partner closely with IT and business stakeholders to implement and enhance systems, improve data quality, and develop scalable solutions that support efficient revenue operations and financial reporting. Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development to global revenue operations, revenue accounting, and collections teams while evaluating organizational effectiveness and supporting future-state operating models. Develop and execute a multi-year global Revenue Operations transformation strategy. Evaluate opportunities to leverage AI, workflow automation, shared services, and outsourced support models to improve scalability, efficiency, and global consistency.

Deep working knowledge of NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management and NetSuite Billing required, including an understanding of system capabilities, reporting, workflows, and downstream process impacts. Experience partnering effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, including Commercial, Sales Operations, Legal, Treasury, IT, FP&A, and regional controllership teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence, challenge constructively, and collaborate effectively at all levels of the organization. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy. BenefitsRoku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. The Roku CultureRoku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. The role

In this role, you will have the opportunity to champion our sources of truth as well as plan, lead and unify the cross channel delivery of test & learn agendas.
Sitting at the intersection of our media channel leads and our analytics specialists, you will ensure our Marketing Mix Models (MMM) are fed with the right data and that our Test & Learn ideas are translated into rigorous, actionable experiments. 
Main responsibilities
MMM Operations 
 As the primary point of contact for all data sharing and queries from MMM partners, you will manage a timely process of gathering, cleaning, and formatting media delivery and performance data for our econometric models.Accuracy & Quality Assurance: Ensuring all shared data is accurately formatted and reflects the reality of our media activity across all platforms.  Experimentation rollout

In which we will detail our test and learn priorities that you will spearhead as the year goes on.Learning Prioritisation: Own the rollout of the experimentation and measurement roadmap. Ensuring the tests deemed most important are executed in timely and rigorous manners.The "Knowledge Bank": Maintain the central test & learn log. Documenting every outcome, and sharing those with wider stakeholders to ensure that learnings are actively used to ameliorate media plans.Technical Translation: Collaborate with specialists and analysts to take ambitious ideas from Channel Leads (owned and paid), and translate them into technical briefs for specialists to build. Initiative Support: Design and set up cross-channel Test & Learn initiatives, including A/B testing, Meta/Google Lift studies, and regional Geo-tests across both owned and paid media.

Have demonstrable experience within a media business. Either agency (Data/Analytics/Planning/ Transformation) or an in-house effectiveness operations role.Experience with both paid and owned media with an ability to evidence the nuances in their measurement challenges.Proven experience working across multiple media channels.Proven experience working with, Marketing Mix Modeling, Multi-Touch Attribution, and Incrementality Testing.Familiarity with the “plumbing” of measurement - how pixels, APIs and Clean Rooms function to collect data.Experience managing relationships with third-party measurement partners.

rows.title: Deputy Head of Video
rows.descriptionText:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism, and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals, and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.
We are looking for a deputy head of video to join the Guardian. This role reports to and supports the UK head of video in delivering our video strategy, overseeing daily editorial operations and ensuring the production of high-quality, impactful journalism.
The deputy head of video has particular responsibility for the Guardian's video news features, leading the delivery of ambitious original journalism on YouTube, establishing a distinctive video proposition that expands the reach and impact of our journalism.
Examples of the video news features team's work include the Green Line series and the On The Ground series, which sees our journalists reporting right from the heart of the action.
This position is offered on a permanent, full-time NUJ contract.
About the roleLead and line manage producers in the video news features teamWork closely with the head of video and the head of documentaries to help coordinate the commissioning and production of all longform features and documentaries produced by the GuardianWork with the head of shortform video in delivering the Guardian's video strategy across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok as well as the Guardian's own platformsAct as a senior editorial decision-maker for video content, deputising for the head of video and attending meetings on behalf of the department as requiredEnsure video output reflects the organisation's editorial values, standards and brandWork with editors and reporters throughout the Guardian to identify stories and reporting that can be developed into distinctive video news featuresDrive audience growth, engagement and watch time on YouTubeMonitor performance and audience insights to inform commissioning decisions and strategyEnsure efficient workflows and effective resource allocation within the news features video team to ensure projects are kept within budget at all timesCoordinate commissioning, production schedules and publishing priorities for news features videoSupport the head of video in coaching and developing the video department, helping to set best practicesFoster a collaborative, inclusive, dynamic and high-performing team culture.Collaborate with audience, social teams and marketing to maximise reach and engagement, and identify opportunities for experimentation and growthPromote video-first thinking and work with Project Berger teams on programmes which enable colleagues to develop video skillsThis is an office based role and will not involve regular on the ground shooting
About youSignificant experience in video journalism, digital publishing or broadcast newsSignificant experience as an executive producerStrong editorial judgment and understanding of journalistic standardsExperience managing editorial teams and production workflowsSignificant experience of shooting and editing videoProven track record of delivering a varied portfolio of high-quality long form video content for broadcast or digital audiencesStrong understanding of YouTube analyticsExcellent organisational, communication and leadership skillsAbility to make sound decisions under pressure and manage multiple competing priorities and deadlinesExperience commissioning freelancers and managing production budgetsActively demonstrate inclusive leadership by promoting equity, valuing diverse perspectives, and addressing barriers that affect your teamIdeally, you'll have a demonstrable ability to bring a diverse perspective to this role
We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media.
We operate in a hybrid environment working at least three days a week from our offices in King's Cross in London.
Job share applications are welcome. If you are keen to apply jointly with someone else as a job share, you should make a single application and combine your application documents.
How to applyTo apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you'd love to take on this role, and why you're a great match for what we're looking for. The application form will also ask you to share examples of relevant work that you have executive produced.
We appreciate the time taken to prepare each application we receive. We do not use AI-assisted technology to review applications; every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team. Thank you for bearing with us during the screening process.
The closing date for applications is Wednesday September 23 2026.
All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs.
Benefits at the GuardianYou'll have six weeks of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.
You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.
We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.
Culture and wellbeingWe want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.
We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Learning and developmentWe encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.
We value honesty in your application.AI generated content must not be presented as your own work. Please review our guidance on the use of AI in your application here.

rows.title: Chief People Officer
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DETAILS

Band: ExCo

Contract type: 1 x continuing (permanent) role

Location: Salford, Birmingham, Cardiff, Belfast, London, Glasgow

Important - Application Process 

The BBC has engaged an executive search firm, Korn Ferry, to manage the selection process for this role. Please be aware that your application will be managed by Korn Ferry, who will have access to your CV and personal details for the purpose of this vacancy only. 

Should you want any further information about the role, or to speak with someone, please contact Ellie Filler of Korn Ferry, at the following email address: BBCCPO@kornferry.com

JOB INTRODUCTION

This is a rare opportunity to join the BBC at a defining moment. As a member of the Executive Committee, the Chief People Officer will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of one of the world's most recognisable and trusted organisations.

As Chief People Officer, you will lead the BBC's people and culture agenda, driving organisational transformation as the business accelerates its evolution into a digital-first media organisation. You will help build a future-ready workforce, strengthen organisational effectiveness, and ensure the BBC continues to attract, develop and empower exceptional talent in an increasingly competitive and fast-changing landscape.

Combining strategic influence with operational leadership, the successful candidate will lead large-scale cultural and organisational change, helping the BBC navigate an evolving funding and media environment while preserving the creative excellence, innovation and public service values that make it unique.

Your Key Responsibilities And Impact

KEY PRIORITIES

Re-shaping the organisation to achieve a leaner BBC with an effective, agile, and process-light operating model and working culture that is fit for the future and embeds creative and editorial excellence. Leading industrial and employee relations strategy through enterprise-wide transformation, building constructive, trusted relationships with recognised trade unions and employee representatives, to enable sustainable organisational change.  Setting a path for how people can both start a career in the creative industry as well as develop exciting career and development pathways at the BBC.   Supporting the continued alignment of the talent pipeline to ensure succession, retention, attraction, diversity and inclusion objectives are achieved.   Upholding a culture that is values-led, focused on maintaining the highest creativity and editorial excellence, and which reinforces the strategy to create a modern BBC.  

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Lead the people strategy underpinning a multi-year transformation programme, reshaping the organisation's operating model and workforce to deliver substantial cost efficiencies, organisational simplification and enhanced organisational effectiveness. Drive cultural transformation across the organisation, embedding a high-performance, accountable and values-led culture that supports innovation, agility, editorial and operational excellence. Design and execute workforce restructuring and organisational redesign initiatives, including the delivery of significant headcount reduction programmes, ensuring business continuity and alignment with long-term strategic priorities with a view to re-organising how the corporation operates, as opposed to consistent restructuring programmes.  Provide executive leadership of employee relations across a highly unionised and publicly scrutinised environment, leading collective consultation processes, workforce engagement and negotiations with recognised trade unions and employee representatives.  Partner with the Director-General, Board and Executive Committee to define the future workforce required to support the BBC’s strategic evolution, including workforce planning, capability assessment and skills transformation.  Lead enterprise-wide change management activity, ensuring leaders are equipped to communicate, implement and sustain large-scale organisational change while maintaining colleague engagement and performance.  

ARE YOU THE RIGHT CANDIDATE?

The BBC’s next CPO will be a transformational, Board credible executive, adept at navigating complex, high-scrutiny organisations either as the sitting CPO, or as a strong number two with sufficient Executive and Board level experience and ready for a step up. The successful candidate must bring the following expertise. 

Key Experience

The Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate

Enterprise Transformation – has led large-scale organisational transformation, including operating model redesign, strategic workforce planning, technology-enabled change and cultural evolution, delivering sustainable improvements in organisational effectiveness, agility and performance.   Executive and Board Credibility – has advised CEOs, Executive Committees and Boards on sensitive People, Succession, Reward, reputational and governance matters, with an ability to coach and influence senior peers strategically and effectively.  Commercial and Operational Excellence – works closely with Leadership Teams and Boards to align people strategy with organisational priorities, delivering measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution, operational excellence, stakeholder engagement and technology enabled solutions.  Industrial and Employee Relations – has led industrial and employee relations strategy in complex, highly unionised and publicly scrutinised environments, building constructive partnerships with recognised trade unions, employee representatives and external stakeholders. Demonstrates the ability to navigate significant organisational change, manage workforce and reputational risk, and secure sustainable outcomes that balance organisational priorities with colleague experience.  Leadership of a Modern People Function – has transformed People functions through technology, service redesign, data and analytics, operational efficiency, improved employee experience and stronger business insight. Brings experience of major HR technology implementation and building a culture of AI experimentation and functional cost management.  

Key Behaviours and Characteristics

Strong interpersonal, coaching and listening skills with an ability to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively across all levels of a complex organisation.  Action-oriented and pragmatic, able to translate strategy into execution and deliver outcomes in a fast-moving, operationally complex environment. Exceptional judgement and credibility, with a strong track record of identifying, developing and enabling talented leaders and high-performing teams.  High levels of empathy, self-awareness and situational judgement, with the ability to influence, engage and bring others with them through periods of uncertainty and change.  Enterprise thinker, able to balance immediate priorities with long-term organisational outcomes and navigate competing stakeholder interests effectively.  Curious and externally focused, bringing insight from leading organisations and adapting emerging trends, technologies and ways of working to organisational needs.

Description

Why Join DAZN?

Demand for sports has never been higher, however with fragmented media ecosystems and soaring costs – teams, leagues, and fans – are forced to reconsider their options. DAZN wants to provide a differentiated, digital first alternative that will modernize the regional sports network model for the ’26 – ’27 basketball and hockey season. 

This role will own how DAZN US shows up across social platforms, from always-on publishing and live-event coverage to talent, creators, original formats and major brand moments. You’ll lead a US team and work closely with Brand, Content, Editorial, PR, Partnerships and local market teams to turn the biggest moments in sport into conversation, fandom and growth.

Salary Range: Up to $130,000.00

What You'll Be Doing:

Social Strategy & LeadershipLead the social and digital content strategy for DAZN’s growing portfolio of U.S. regional sports properties, developing a unified approach to audience growth, engagement, programming, and distribution.Lead and manage the New York-based social team, including social media managers, programmers, producers, editors, and creators.Establish the strategic vision, priorities, workflows, and operating model for the team, while empowering managers and team leads to own day-to-day execution.Develop platform-specific strategies across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, and emerging platforms.Serve as the senior social leader for the U.S. regional sports business, partnering closely with DAZN leadership and teams across content, marketing, production, analytics, product, commercial, and partnerships.Content Strategy & ProgrammingDevelop and oversee social programming strategies across live sports, highlights, studio programming, original content, talent, and on-demand programming.Create programming frameworks that balance real-time sports coverage with original, social-first, evergreen, and audience-driven content.Identify opportunities to turn existing sports rights and programming into differentiated social franchises, recurring formats, and audience growth engines.Develop scalable programming models that can be applied across new teams, leagues, markets, and regional sports partnerships as DAZN's U.S. portfolio expands.Ensure social strategy and distribution are integrated into the content development process from the outset.Audience Growth & Fan EngagementDevelop strategies to grow and deepen DAZN's relationship with local sports fans, using social as a key driver of awareness, engagement, and audience acquisition.Build strategies that extend the reach of existing regional sports audiences while introducing DAZN content and programming to new audiences.Partner with marketing and growth teams to align organic social programming with broader audience acquisition and subscription objectives.Develop innovative approaches to community building, fan participation, creator partnerships, and talent-led programming.Stay ahead of platform changes, emerging formats, creator trends, and evolving fan behaviors to continuously improve DAZN's social approach.Live Sports & Tentpole ProgrammingEstablish best-in-class social strategies around live games, major sporting moments, breaking news, and tentpole events.Oversee real-time programming across game days, including pre-game, live, post-game, highlights, analysis, talent, and fan engagement.Develop differentiated strategies for maximizing the social value of major events and extending audience engagement beyond the live window.Coordinate coverage across teams, rights holders, talent, production, and DAZN's broader social organization to maximize reach and impact.Original Content & IP DevelopmentLead the development of new social-first programming, original series, franchises, and talent-led formats designed to connect with local sports audiences.Identify opportunities to leverage athletes, talent, personalities, archives, and existing programming to create differentiated social content.Oversee creative development from concept through launch and ongoing programming, ensuring formats are repeatable, scalable, and optimized for social platforms.Partner with internal production teams and external partners on creative direction, talent relationships, production priorities, and delivery.Build a pipeline of original concepts that can evolve from social formats into larger content franchises.Performance, Analytics & OptimizationEstablish KPIs and performance benchmarks across platforms, properties, franchises, and content verticals.Lead regular analytics and performance reviews, translating audience data and platform insights into actionable programming and creative decisions.Continuously optimize content strategy, packaging, posting cadence, distribution, and investment based on performance.Establish a culture of testing and experimentation, identifying successful formats and scaling them across properties and platforms.Partner with analytics and insights teams to connect social performance to broader audience, engagement, and business outcomes.Commercial & Revenue OpportunitiesPartner with commercial, sales, and brand teams to develop social and content opportunities for advertisers and partners across DAZN's regional sports ecosystem.Oversee the strategy and creative development of branded social and longform content, ensuring integrations are authentic to the audience and platform.Develop relationships with key social platforms, agencies, creators, and external partners to unlock new audience and commercial opportunities.Cross-Functional LeadershipBuild strong working relationships across DAZN's content, production, editorial, marketing, product, analytics, commercial, and partnerships teams.Partner with regional sports networks and team partners to align social strategy, content priorities, distribution, and audience objectives.Establish scalable processes for integrating new rights, teams, and regional sports properties into DAZN's social ecosystem.Represent the social organization in senior leadership discussions and contribute to broader decisions around content, audience growth, marketing, and product strategy.

What You'll Bring:

8+ years of experience in social, digital, content or audience development, with significant senior leadership experience.A track record of building social strategies for major sports, entertainment, media or consumer brands.Deep understanding of sports fandom and how fan behaviour differs by platform, market and generation.Strong editorial instincts and the ability to identify the story or cultural angle that will make people care.Experience leading large, multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.Strong relationships within the social ecosystem, including platforms, creators, publishers and talent.Experience developing creator and influencer strategies at scale.Comfortable operating in the speed and unpredictability of live sport.Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how social contributes to audience and subscriber growth.The ability to balance global brand consistency with authentic local-market execution.

Benefits

Benefits include access to DAZN, up to 15 days of paid time off, health benefits (including dental & eye care), a sick time package, parental leave offering, voluntary benefits (such as basic life term, personal accident and short and long-term disability covering) and a 401(k) retirement plan. You’ll also find a family friendly community and learning and development resources.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About The Role 

The Corporate Data Team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help define and measure the success of Hearst's enterprise data products. This role will develop analytical products and measurement frameworks spanning audience intelligence, identity resolution, content performance, AI content consumption, and data product adoption. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders, this individual will transform complex data into scalable insights that drive strategic decision making across Hearst Consumer Media. This role will play a key part in measuring how Hearst content is discovered, consumed, and utilized across emerging AI ecosystems, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI search, and content licensing initiatives.

This hybrid role is based in New York City and will report into the VP of Audience Analytics.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop scalable audience insights across brands, platforms, and distribution channels using first-party identity, behavioral, and contextual data.  Analyze audience composition, engagement, overlap, and growth opportunities to support personalization, advertising, subscriptions, and content strategy.  Build reusable audience measurement products that enable self-service analytics across the enterprise.  Design measurement frameworks to understand how Hearst content is utilized across AI platforms, including LLM training partnerships, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-powered search experiences, and emerging content licensing models.  Develop dashboards and analytical products that quantify AI-driven content discovery, attribution, engagement, and business impact.  Lead the development and execution of data analyses across a diverse range of domains, from digital product performance, to understanding advertising effectiveness across media channels. Utilize data visualizations and presentations to effectively communicate these findings and the team's business impact to a diverse set of technical and executive stakeholders.  Develop, build, and maintain reports and dashboards to measure key performance indicators related to identity resolution efforts. Conduct detailed audience segmentation and analysis to inform targeting strategies and content optimization.  Act as a trusted advisor, cultivating and strengthening relationships with data, product, and engineering leads across Hearst Consumer Media 

Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in a relevant field of study  5-8 years of experience in a data role, including business intelligence, analytics, data science and/or data engineering  Experience defining business KPIs and measurement frameworks for digital products, audiences, and AI-driven experiences.  Expert-level proficiency in SQL, with extensive experience in data mining and working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift, BigQuery)  Advanced skills in creating reports and dashboards with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau) and translating insights into actionable recommendations  Experience with digital publishing, audience measurement, first-party data, identity resolution, content metadata, SEO, AI search, or digital advertising ecosystems is strongly preferred.  Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and storytelling abilities, with excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills. Proficiency in leveraging data visualizations effectively  Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, lead cross-functional initiatives, and influence stakeholders at all levels  Familiarity with the digital media and publishing landscape, including media research tools (e.g., Nielsen, Comscore) and knowledge of the CTV/digital advertising ecosystem, programmatic media, and cross-platform measurement 

Compensation & Benefits

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York City. The reasonable estimate, if hired in New York City, is $126,000 to $140,000  .  Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York City. For candidates outside New York City, the salary range will be aligned with the specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, certifications, and education. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more.
