rows.title: Senior Manager, Audience Strategy & Activation

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

 About the Role 

The Hearst Corporate Data Team is seeking a Senior Manager, Audience Strategy & Activation to serve as the strategic link between Hearst's enterprise audience platform and the commercial teams that bring its value to market. Reporting to the VP, Audience Analytics, this role will partner closely with Ad Sales and the Corporate Data Team to develop scalable audience products, enable revenue-generating sales opportunities, and operationalize enterprise audience activation across Hearst's advertising ecosystem.

As Hearst continues to expand its enterprise identity and audience capabilities, this role will ensure those capabilities are translated into advertiser-ready solutions. You will identify audience opportunities, develop standardized audience offerings, create sales enablement materials, coordinate audience activation, and work across business and technical teams to maximize the commercial value of Hearst's audience assets.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in audience strategy, advertising technology, and cross-functional program management with a strong understanding of digital advertising, consumer data, and audience activation platforms.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Partner with Ad Sales, and client-facing teams to identify advertiser needs and develop scalable audience solutions that support revenue growth.  Develop and maintain a portfolio of enterprise audience products, including standardized audience definitions, audience packages, and reusable audience segments that can be leveraged across Hearst's consumer divisions.  Create compelling sales enablement materials—including audience one-pagers, audience profiles, methodology documentation, and pitch materials—that clearly communicate audience composition, scale, insights, and business value.  Collaborate with the VP, Audience Analytics to evaluate audience performance, identify new audience opportunities, and optimize audience offerings based on advertiser demand and campaign outcomes.  Coordinate the activation of enterprise audiences across advertising platforms (GAM), clean rooms, demand-side platforms (DSPs), data management platforms (DMPs), and other activation technologies.  Serve as the primary liaison between Audience Analytics, Ad Sales, Product, and Engineering, to ensure audiences are accurately built, documented, governed, and delivered.  Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise audience products, including intake, prioritization, governance, documentation, activation, and ongoing optimization.  Establish best practices, documentation standards, and governance processes for enterprise audience development and activation across Hearst. 

 Qualifications 

 6–10 years of experience in audience strategy, advertising technology, marketing technology, customer analytics, audience development, sales strategy, or digital media.  Strong understanding of digital advertising ecosystems, audience segmentation, identity resolution, audience activation, and consumer data products.  Experience partnering with Ad Sales, Sales Strategy, Marketing, Product, or Analytics teams to develop advertiser-facing solutions and support revenue-generating initiatives.  Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into scalable audience products and operational workflows.  Experience working with ad sales and other audience activation platforms, including CDPs, DMPs, DSPs, clean rooms, identity platforms, or other advertising technology solutions.  Strong analytical skills with experience evaluating audience performance, campaign effectiveness, and audience utilization.  Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives across business and technical teams.  Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating executive presentations, sales collateral, and client-facing documentation.  Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.  Preferred experience in publishing, digital media, advertising technology, audience measurement, first-party data strategies, or enterprise audience platforms. 

Compensation & Benefits

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York City. The reasonable estimate, if hired in New York City, is $180,000to $200,000. Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York City. For candidates outside New York City, the salary range will be aligned with the specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, certifications, and education. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more.

rows.title: IT Resilience & Assurance Analyst

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

The IT Resilience and Assurance Analyst supports Hearst Technology Services’ Organizational Resilience team by helping strengthen enterprise technology resilience, operational maturity, governance practices, and continuous improvement across critical technology services.

This position is designed for individuals early in their technology careers who want practical exposure to the disciplines that keep enterprise technology services reliable, resilient, well-governed, and continuously improving, including business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational assurance, change management, quality assurance, operational risk management, technology governance, and AI-enabled operational improvement.

Working alongside experienced technology professionals, the analyst will help develop resilience capabilities, evaluate operational effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and build innovative AI-powered solutions that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, enhance decision-making, and increase the value delivered by Hearst Technology Services.

Role Summary

The role combines operational resilience activities, including business continuity planning, disaster recovery, crisis management, and operational readiness, with operational assurance activities that evaluate governance, documentation, operational controls, service maturity, and continuous improvement opportunities.

Equally important, the analyst will help identify practical opportunities where artificial intelligence, automation, and modern technologies can improve Organizational Resilience services.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Resilience

 Support Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery planning activities.  Assist with Business Impact Analyses and operational risk assessments.  Participate in disaster recovery exercises, tabletop exercises, and crisis management activities.  Help develop and maintain business continuity plans, disaster recovery plans, recovery procedures, and operational documentation.  Support incident response activities and post-incident improvement initiatives.  Research emerging technologies and best practices that strengthen organizational resilience. 

Operational Assurance

 Participate in Operational Assurance reviews across HTS technology services.  Collect, organize, and validate documentation, operational evidence, reports, dashboards, and supporting artifacts.  Compare documented processes with actual operational practices and identify opportunities for improvement.  Assist with operational maturity assessments using established methodologies.  Evaluate governance, operational controls, documentation quality, ownership, and reporting effectiveness.  Help identify operational risks, process gaps, and recommendations that improve service quality and consistency. 

AI Innovation & Solution Development

 Assist with and learn the design, prototyping, building, and continuous improvement of AI-powered solutions that streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and increase operational efficiency.  Assist in developing AI assistants, copilots, knowledge bases, intelligent workflows, and automation solutions using approved enterprise AI platforms and low-code technologies.  Assist with dashboards, operational scorecards, and AI-enabled analytics that provide meaningful business insights.  Learn about and help evaluate emerging AI technologies and help recommend practical use cases that create measurable business value.  Assist with measuring the effectiveness of AI solutions and help improve them based on user feedback and operational outcomes.  Collaborate with technology teams to ensure AI solutions align with enterprise governance, security, and responsible AI practices. 

Governance & Continuous Improvement

 Assist in developing operational standards, procedures, playbooks, and documentation.  Support technology governance and operational consistency initiatives.  Participate in process improvement projects across Hearst Technology Services.  Track remediation activities and continuous improvement initiatives.  Collaborate across Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Enterprise Applications, and Service Management teams.  Support executive reporting and operational metrics. 

What You Will Learn

This position provides hands-on experience across multiple enterprise technology disciplines, including:

 Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery  Crisis Management  Operational Assurance  Technology Governance  Organizational Resilience  Enterprise Risk Management  AI Solution Development  AI Automation & Workflow Design  AI Assistants & Copilots  Prompt Engineering & AI Orchestration  AI Governance & Responsible AI  Executive Reporting & Operational Analytics  Process Improvement 

Education & Experience

Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in a technology- or business-related discipline, including but not limited to:

 Information Technology  Computer Science  Information Systems  Cybersecurity  Business Administration  Business Analytics  Data Analytics  Risk Management  Emergency Management  Operations Management  Industrial Engineering  Management Information Systems 

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a motivated individual who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies, collaborating across teams, and continuously improving how technology services are delivered.

Prior professional experience is not required. We value analytical thinking, creativity, initiative, adaptability, strong communication skills, and a passion for using artificial intelligence and automation to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, and deliver greater value to the organization.

Skills, Coursework & Experience

 Internship, coursework, research, or project experience related to technology operations, cybersecurity, business continuity, operational resilience, enterprise risk, quality assurance, IT governance, or business process improvement  Experience using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies.  Interest in designing AI-powered solutions, automations, or intelligent workflows.  Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, Power Automate, Python, or low-code development platforms is a plus.  Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, or similar collaboration platforms is a plus.  Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.  Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.  Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.  Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies. 

Entry-Level Certifications Considered a Plus (Not Required)

 ITIL® 4 Foundation  COBIT® Foundation  Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900)  Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)  CompTIA Security+  CompTIA Data+  AWS Cloud Practitioner 

This role is intended to develop early-career technology talent while strengthening Hearst Technology Services’ resilience, assurance, governance, and AI-enabled operational improvement capabilities. The analyst will contribute to practical work across business continuity, disaster recovery, operational assurance, reporting, documentation, and solution development, with an emphasis on learning through meaningful enterprise initiatives.

Position Type / Schedule

Part-Time Schedule: This benefits-eligible, part-time role is 21 hours per week across three flexible workdays, mutually agreed upon based on business needs and the employee’s academic or personal schedule.

Work Location: This is an in-person role based at Hearst’s New York City office.

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in New York City. The reasonable estimate, if hired in New York City, is $35.00/Hour - $41.00/Hour. Please note this information is specific to those hired in New York City. If this role is open to candidates outside of New York City, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education. Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more.

About Us

Hearst is a leading global, diversified information, services, and media company dedicated to innovating, informing audiences and leading with purpose, integrity and a culture of care.

Our portfolio includes more than 360 businesses worldwide. On the consumer side, we operate 35 television stations, 28 daily newspapers and publish more than 200 magazine editions featuring many of the most iconic brands in media. We also hold ownership stakes in leading cable networks such as A&E, HISTORY, Lifetime and ESPN. On the business-to-business side, our companies include Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information and analytics; Hearst Health, which provides intelligence and software that improve care outcomes; and Hearst Transportation, which delivers data and software for aviation, automotive and trucking.

Our strength lies in our people. We value the diverse perspectives that move us forward. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex or gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability, military or veteran status or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. We also provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees consistent with applicable law.

About The Team

Our Corporate Teams deliver essential programs and services that support the entire Hearst enterprise. Spanning communications, employee benefits, finance, learning and development, legal, technology, and more, these teams lead initiatives that advance Hearst’s mission to inform and inspire. Here, you’ll find opportunities to grow, collaborate and make a lasting impact.

rows.title: Director of Performance Marketing Analytics and Data Science
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

About Entain

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.

Job Description

This is a hybrid role. As a Director of Marketing Analytics & Data Science, you will be responsible for bringing together performance marketing analytics, customer value analytics and marketing data science into a single, high-performing function. You'll shape the strategy, operating model and priorities for the team, ensuring data-driven insights translate into meaningful commercial decisions across customer acquisition, marketing investment and long-term customer value.

Reporting to the Group Analytics Director, you will be part of the Group Analytics Leadership Team, leading a team of approximately 15-20 analysts, data scientists and team leads. You will set the direction for the function, connect performance measurement, experimentation and customer value analytics, and provide actionable recommendations to Marketing, Commercial and Finance stakeholders. You will also play a key role in developing leaders, creating a culture of accountability and empowering teams to make effective decisions with confidence.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead a well-established team with strong foundations, a modern data platform and direct influence over major commercial decisions across multiple brands and regulated markets. You'll work closely with senior and executive stakeholders, championing data-led thinking and helping shape how Entain invests in growth. If you're passionate about building high-performing teams and turning analytics into measurable business impact, could this be your next leadership challenge?

You Will:

Lead and unify Performance Marketing Analytics, Customer Value Analytics and Marketing Data Science into a single operating model with clear priorities, ownership and accountability.Define the strategy and roadmap for the function, focusing resources on the highest-value opportunities to drive commercial impact.Shape the analytical frameworks that guide marketing investment decisions, including attribution, experimentation, customer value, incrementality and optimisation, turning insight into clear business recommendations.Partner with Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Technology and Data leadership to ensure analytics is embedded in decision-making and delivers measurable outcomes.Establish robust governance for analytical products and models, including ownership, validation, monitoring and ongoing performance management.Work closely with Data Engineering and Technology teams to develop the data foundations required for effective measurement, optimisation and customer insights.Lead organisational design, talent development, succession planning and performance management across the function, building a high-performing leadership team.Manage the function's budget, tooling and vendor relationships, making strategic build-versus-buy decisions that maximise value.Present recommendations and outcomes to executive stakeholders, translating complex analysis into clear commercial actions.Champion the responsible use of customer data, ensuring compliance with regulatory, privacy and safer gambling requirements.

Qualifications

You Have:

Proven experience leading analytics, data science or marketing effectiveness teams, including managing managers and senior specialists.Strong expertise across marketing, customer and commercial analytics, including measurement, experimentation, forecasting and optimisation.Track record of building high-performing teams and operating models with clear accountability and prioritisation.Demonstrated ability to influence commercial decisions through data-driven insights and recommendations.Experience partnering with senior Marketing, Commercial and Finance stakeholders across complex organisations.Technical fluency in modern analytics environments, including cloud data platforms, SQL, Python and/or R.Experience working with digital marketing data, attribution, customer identity, conversion and acquisition metrics.Experience operating across multiple markets, brands or business units in a fast-paced consumer-focused environment. Experience in gaming, ecommerce, subscription, travel, fintech or other high-volume consumer businesses is advantageous. Regulated industry experience is a plus but not essential.

Competencies / Behaviours

Commercial judgement: focuses on decisions and outcomes rather than analytical activity.Clear ownership: creates explicit accountability and does not allow important questions to be passed between teams.Leadership range: can go deep enough to make a call, then delegates execution and develops others to lead.Constructive challenge: is comfortable disagreeing with senior stakeholders and changes position when the evidence changes.Clarity: explains complex methods, uncertainty and trade-offs in straightforward business language.Pragmatism: chooses approaches that are proportionate, maintainable and usable, not simply technically impressive.Collaboration: builds strong cross-functional relationships without creating vague shared ownership.Integrity: handles customer data, commercial decisions and regulatory obligations responsibly.

What Success Looks Like In Year One

The three capabilities operate as one function, with a single roadmap and clear decisions on what is owned centrally, locally or by partner teams.Marketing, Commercial and Finance use the function's recommendations in planning and investment decisions, with assumptions and outcomes visible.Attribution, customer value, experimentation and data science outputs are connected into a coherent decision processAnalytical products and models have named owners, validation and monitoring standards, and practical support arrangements.Team leads make more decisions independently and there is a credible succession and capability plan for the function.

Benefits

Additional Information

At Entain, We Know That Signing Top Players Requires a Great Starting Package, And Plenty Of Support To Inspire You. Join Us, And a Great Compensation Package Is Just The Beginning. You Can Expect To Receive Benefits Like:

A regular bonus and great pension.25 days annual leave and all Bankholidays.Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.Life assurance and Income Protection.Private healthcare and wellbeing support.A stake in our success through our ShareSave scheme.

Equal Opportunities.

If you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.

We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.

We're an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.

We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally

rows.title: Portfolio Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.

Job Description

The Portfolio Lead is accountable for delivery performance across a sub-domain of 4-6 pods (Engineering, Quality, Product). They lead the flow of value from idea to production, ensuring pods deliver with pace, predictability and understanding to outcomes.

They combine hands-on delivery leadership with AI-augmented ways of working and data-driven decision-making. They do not prescribe a single framework - instead they adapt approaches that best serve each pod's context.

They partner with Engineering and Product leadership to reduce waste, improve throughput and help pods achieve Autonomy, Accountability and Agreement to value outcomes.

What You Will Do

Pod Performance & Accountability

You are responsible for pod delivery performance across the sub-domain.

You will lead and communicate delivery health, risks and performance to leadership

Ensure pods operate as, self-organising units delivering value outcomes

Support pod leads with coaching, facilitation and conflict resolution

Ensure cross-pod agreement on priorities, dependencies and shared goals

Facilitate communication and collaboration between pods to promote knowledge sharing

Problem Solving

You will be an expert; deploy root cause analysis, systems thinking and structured techniques to analyse and guide out resolutions.

Be an escalation point for cross-pod blockers and systemic impediments

Identify patterns across pods that indicate deeper organisational or process issues

AI-Augmented Delivery

Champion AI agent adoption across pods - including coding agents, test generation, story creation, board health and deployment automation

Identify opportunities where AI can reduce toil, accelerate delivery or improve decision-making

Apply AI to improve delivery effectiveness, including workflow insights, risk prediction, and automation of reporting

Track and demonstrate the impact of AI on delivery performance

Flow & Efficiency

Monitor and improve delivery flow (lead time, cycle time, WIP, throughput) using Kanban and lean principles

Ensure WIP limits are respected and surface ageing items through Board Walks

Identify bottlenecks, ageing work and sources of delay across pods.

Improve through regular assessment and experimentation.

Support teams in breaking down work into deliverable, value-driven increments

Agile Ways of Working

Support and evolve the agile operating model for a pod-based environment focused on pace, not ceremony.

Adapt delivery approaches (Kanban, flow-based, lean) appropriate to each pod's needs

Ensure consistency of practice across pods without being prescriptive

Promote outcome-driven delivery vs output-driven activity

Guide teams to operate with autonomy and accountability

Metrics & Reporting

Define and maintain delivery metrics: cycle time, flow efficiency, lead time of initiative, PDLC compression, dependency reduction, rework rate, team satisfaction, and AI effectiveness

Build dashboards (cumulative flow diagrams, throughput charts, WIP ageing) that provide leadership visibility and lead informed decision-making

Analyse performance data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement

Use data to facilitate conversations and coach pods — not just track output

Stakeholder Management

Partner with Engineering and Product leadership at sub-domain level

Represent delivery health and risks in leadership forums

Build trusted relationships that allow fast decision-making

Communicate delivery performance to both technical and non-technical audiences

Commercial Awareness

Understand the commercial context of the sub-domain

Connect delivery decisions to revenue, cost, and customer impact

Support prioritisation trade-offs with a business lens

Capacity Planning

Forecast capacity across pods based on team composition, skills mix and upcoming demand

Identify resourcing gaps and support hiring/allocation decisions

Balance workload across pods to prevent burnout and underutilisation

Support realistic planning by ensuring pods have clear understanding of available capacity

Risk & Dependency Management

Manage risks through regular assessment and execution of controls

Ensure cross-pod dependencies are visible, tracked and managed

Track dependency cost (time blocked, items affected) and lead mitigations such as contract-first development and feature flags

Support issue escalations, ensuring intervention by the dependency escalation protocol

Coach & Capability Development

Provide hands-on coaching at pod level

Build capability in workflow management, flow thinking, estimation, planning, and data-led decision-making

Support teams in understanding and improving their own performance

Strengthen a culture of continuous improvement and learning

Outcome & Value Focus

Align delivery to always ensure outcomes and value.

Help teams understand the why behind their work and how their outputs contribute to value

Challenge work that does not link to outcomes

Support measurement of delivery against OKRs and value indicators

Centre of Excellence (CoE) Contribution

Be an active contributor to the CoE

Share best practices, delivery insights and improvement opportunities from pods

Support adoption of standards, playbooks and tools

Help evolve delivery practices based on experience

Qualifications

Specialist Experience

You will have 7+ years in delivery/agile roles, with at least 3 years operating across multiple teams simultaneously in a technology environment

Expert in flow-based delivery approaches (Kanban, lean, continuous delivery) — not limited to Scrum

Experience enabling multiple teams/pods simultaneously at scale

Strong understanding of AI tooling and its application to software delivery (coding assistants, automation, intelligent analytics)

Experienced in capacity planning, demand forecasting and resource optimisation across multiple teams

Use data to solve complex problems; can interpret and communicate complex data sets clearly

Previous experience of organisational transformation and change management

Good knowledge of Objectives and Key Results (OKR) strategy

Experience in a regulated industry (gaming, fintech, or similar) desirable

Competencies & Behaviours

You will embody the Maker Dimensions - selecting for capability, not just competence. We are looking for people who are versatile, curious, and able to operate with autonomy in a high-trust environment.

AI Fluency uses AI tooling; experiments; iterate with AI as a collaborator

Agency & Accountability Owns outcomes, not just tasks; directs itself.

Systems Thinking Sees patterns across pods and addresses causes, not symptoms

Stakeholder Engagement Builds working relationships across pods and leadership

Improve Performance Raises the bar through data and experimentation

Cross-functional Versatility Comfortable operating beyond their primary discipline

Product Sense Connects their work to customer and outcomes

Build Capability Invests in developing pods, individuals and self

Additional Information

At Entain, we know that signing top players requires a great starting package, and plenty of support to inspire peak performance. Join us, and a competitive salary is just the beginning.

Depending on your role and location, you can expect to receive benefits like

A regular bonusHealthcare supportA stake in our success through our ShareSave schemeGreat development opportunitiesWellbeing support, and so much more.

And outside of this, you'll have the chance to turn recognition from leaders and colleagues into amazing prizes, join a winning team of talented people and be a part of an inclusive and supporting community where everyone is celebrated for being themselves.

Should you need any adjustments or accommodations to the recruitment process, at either application or interview, please contact us.

Excellent communication and customer engagement skills Innovators Mentality - An innovator and change agent who keeps up to date with the latest trends and developments in data engineering and cyber security to ensure our strategies remain at the forefront of the industry.

Understanding of the emerging threats within Cyber Security

rows.title: FinCrime Risk Manager (Fraud)
rows.descriptionText:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for a Senior Financial Crime Risk Manager to partner directly with Product, Operations, Compliance, and Engineering teams to design, test, and optimise fraud prevention strategies.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning jurisdiction-level fraud risk, and acting as the primary point of contact for fraud escalations and governance in-marketPerforming end-to-end fraud risk assessments for existing and new products and servicesAdvising and partnering with Product, Operations, Compliance, and Engineering on fraud risk exposure, scalable control design, and oversight of outsourced operational componentsSupporting the development of tech-enabled fraud prevention and detection solutions that can be deployed globallyReviewing fraud performance data to identify emerging typologies, attack patterns, and control gapsDriving root-cause analysis and remediation of high-loss scenarios or escalated fraud-related complaintsBalancing fraud loss reduction with positive customer outcomes and friction minimisationDelivering fraud MI, dashboards, and insights that support risk-based prioritisation and decision-makingConducting QA and scenario testing of fraud interventions to drive continuous improvementShaping jurisdiction-specific governance, performance metrics, and early leadership practices to enable the function to scale

What You'll Need

7+ years of experience in fraud risk within a 1LoD or product advisory functionExpertise in fraud typologies, detection strategies, and key customer risk indicators across retail and business bankingDemonstrated success driving measurable fraud loss reduction and control effectiveness improvementsFamiliarity with fraud analytics, detection models, rule design, or scenario tuningThe ability to convert fraud risks into tech-informed controls embedded into product experiencesSolid partnership skills with a track record of influence across Product, Data, Operations, and Compliance teamsExperience within a global bank or high-growth fintechA proactive, analytical mindset and to be comfortable making decisions in ambiguous situationsThe ability to mentor others and manage a local fraud team

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Experience working closely with design and product teams to identify and prioritise the right research questions.Able to create research roadmaps and plans to keep the team on track, helping set both short-term objectives and strategic direction.Deep qualitative research experience using techniques such as usability testing (moderated and unmoderated), concept testing and depth interviews.Synthesise insights in an impactful and actionable manner to generate a shared understanding of user needs and opportunities.Able to communicate and influence wider business stakeholders with clarity and conciseness, including confidently presenting research findings, recommendations and strategic implications to senior and executive-level audiences.Experience combining qualitative and quantitative methods.Ethnographic experience (such as contextual enquiry or diary studies).Experience triangulating research and data from different sources to tell compelling customer stories.Experience working collaboratively with Service Design and other disciplines to develop a joined-up understanding of customer and colleague experiences across end-to-end journeys.Able to operate effectively in environments where research practices are still developing, building trust in insights and increasing the adoption of evidence-led approaches.Passionate about championing and evangelising the value of Design Research, helping to embed evidence-led decision making and customer-centred thinking across teams and the wider organisation.Experience with accessibility research and/or vulnerable customers. We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. Whilst this job advert may reference specific years of experience, we recognise that skills are developed in many ways, so if you have relevant, transferable experience, we encourage you to apply.  This is a place for you: Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities, and we're committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop. We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative. We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme. We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.  We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes: A generous pension contribution of up to 15% An annual performance-related bonus Share schemes including free shares Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping 30 days' holiday, with bank holidays on top A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies  Ready for a career where you'll learn and thrive? Apply today and find out more.

rows.title: Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

About Entain

There's nothing like a career at Entain. We're a leading, global sports betting and gaming company and we're upping the excitement and increasing player safety. We're a FTSE company with iconic brands including Ladbrokes, Coral, BetMGM, Eurobet and bwin, and we have an energy that drives us to perform at the height of our potential. Whether you're an engineer, marketer or retail specialist, a career here is a complete game changer.

Job Description

This is a hybrid role. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and building scalable, resilient data solutions that power analytics, marketing effectiveness measurement, and decision-making across Entain's industry-leading digital brands. You'll work at the heart of our data ecosystem, creating the platforms and datasets that enable teams to generate insights, optimise performance, and drive commercial growth.

Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you will be part of the Group Analytics Data Engineering Team, who build and maintain the data products and infrastructure that support analytics, econometric modelling, marketing optimisation, and regulatory reporting across the business. Working closely with analysts, data scientists, econometricians, and marketing stakeholders, you'll help deliver robust data solutions that improve budget allocation, campaign performance, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

Data and Analytics play a transformational role in how we create value today and shape our future. We have a bold ambition to become a world-class data and analytics organisation, helping our teams make smarter decisions and deliver better outcomes for our customers. This is an exciting opportunity to join a team that combines deep technical expertise with real business impact, working on large-scale data challenges that directly influence how we invest, grow, and innovate. If you're passionate about building high-quality data products and want to help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at Entain, we'd love to hear from you. Could this be your next challenge?

You Will:

Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines, transforming complex internal and external data into reliable, business-ready data products.Develop and enhance data quality frameworks, monitoring and validation processes to ensure accurate, timely and trusted data.Partner with business, marketing and technology teams to translate requirements into effective data solutions and challenge assumptions where needed.Contribute to solution architecture and technical design, owning delivery from discovery through to implementation and ongoing support.Collaborate with central data, platform and engineering teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and strategic objectives.Drive continuous improvement across processes, datasets and tools, increasing efficiency, reliability and business value.Communicate technical concepts and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.Champion engineering best practices in testing, observability, documentation and maintainability to deliver scalable, resilient solutions.Evaluate new data sources, technologies and approaches to expand analytical capabilities and shape the future data landscape.Thrive in a fast-paced environment, helping define requirements and deliver pragmatic solutions where processes and ownership models are evolving.

Qualifications

You Have:

Strong experience building and maintaining data pipelines using SQL, Python, or similar technologies.Experience with modern cloud data platforms, ideally Snowflake, or alternatives such as Databricks, Redshift, Synapse, BigQuery, or Azure Data Lake.Experience developing cloud-based solutions, with AWS preferred, or equivalent experience in Azure or GCP.Familiarity with data transformation and ELT frameworks, ideally dbt.Experience implementing data quality, testing, monitoring, and observability solutions, with tools such as Monte Carlo.Experience with workflow orchestration tools, preferably Prefect, or alternatives such as Airflow, Dagster, or Azure Data Factory.Understanding of event-driven architectures, distributed data processing, and large-scale data platforms.Experience with source control and CI/CD practices, ideally using GitLab, GitHub, or Azure DevOps.Familiarity with containerisation technologies such as Docker or Podman, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform.Strong understanding of data modelling, warehousing, and analytics engineering best practices.Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Benefits

Additional Information

At Entain, We Know That Signing Top Players Requires a Great Starting Package, And Plenty Of Support To Inspire You. Join Us, And a Great Compensation Package Is Just The Beginning. You Can Expect To Receive Benefits Like:

A regular bonus and great pension.25 days annual leave and all Bankholidays.Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.Life assurance and Income Protection.Private healthcare and wellbeing support.A stake in our success through our ShareSave scheme.

Equal Opportunities.

If you need any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.

We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.

We're an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.

We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally

rows.title: Business Risk Read Across Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Business Risk Read Across Lead

Make a real impact across the bank by leading the identification, assessment, and coordination of Commercial & Institutional (C&I) reviews across risk, control, conduct, and regulatory themesGain visibility and ensure lessons learned, emerging risks, and control improvements are applied consistently across Business Banking, Commercial Mid-Market, Corporate and Institutional Banking, NatWest Markets, RBS International, Products, and Operations as appropriatePlay a key role in supporting the bank’s success by enabling safe growth in line with strategic goals, transformation, and consistent delivery of good customer outcomes

What you'll do

As a Business Risk Read Across Lead, you’ll define, implement, maintain, and own the C&I read across and lessons learned process, providing effective governance and oversight to help prevent potential control failures across the C&I business. You’ll also lead the assessment of potential impacts across franchises, products, customer segments, and legal entities, while ensuring emerging risk exposures, control weaknesses, and thematic issues are escalated in a timely manner with recommendations that support safe growth and good customer outcomes.

Moreover, you’ll oversee the review of risk events, audit findings, regulatory observations, control failures, and incidents to identify read across opportunities by highlighting recurring issues, emerging trends, and intervention areas. Partnering with C&I functions, you’ll also lead thematic and targeted reviews to address control deficiencies, present findings to relevant Executive Committee members and governance forums, and drive the development of a read across and lessons learned repository.

In Addition, You’ll Be

Executing the C&I read across and lessons learned process, ensuring the accurate and timely assessment of potential impacts across franchise, products, customer segments, and legal entitiesChallenging outcomes and responses to identify root causes and ensure proportionate management actions are delivered to enable safe growth and good customer outcomesDeveloping, implementing, and maintaining a read across and lessons learned repository, ensuring the accuracy of source data used to measure process effectivenessProducing high-quality read across reporting for the read across forum and other committees, driving effective read across and resulting actions that enable safe growth and good customer outcomesDriving continuous improvement in risk management by identifying and implementing standardisation, simplification, and consistency opportunities that reduce duplication of effort across the franchise

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for someone with subject matter expertise across Commercial Banking, coupled with strong critical thinking skills and proven experience leading reviews and large-scale responses across Commercial Banking areas. You should also have the ability to identify weak signals, trends, and interconnected themes, while balancing commercial objectives with risk management outcomes.

To succeed in this role, you must be able to think beyond individual issues to understand broader franchise-wide implications and drive informed decision-making.

In Addition, You’ll Need

Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence and engage stakeholders to ensure high-quality reviews are communicated to and understood by senior managementStrong analytic skills, with experience turning risk data into concise and actionable executive insightsProven experience using AI to transform processes

rows.title: Early Talent Strategy Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as an Early Talent Strategy Manager

We’ll look to you to manage the enterprise early talent strategy, building future-ready talent pipelines aligned to our strategic workforce needs across our graduate, intern, and apprenticeships programmesInfluence and lead the enterprise-wide apprenticeship strategy and external ecosystem, maximising levy utilisation, and managing key external partnershipsThis is an opportunity to make a lasting impact by leading the graduate and intern strategy across attraction, university engagement, recruitment, and developmentThis is a full-time, hybrid position so you'll work from home some of the time, coming into the office at least two days per week to collaborate closely with your colleagues

What you'll do

As an Early Talent Strategy Manager, you’ll manage the enterprise-wide strategy, standards, and guardrails for all early talent pathways, including interns, apprentices, and graduates. You’ll ensure these pathways integrate seamlessly with wider talent ecosystem and strategic workforce plans, strengthening the overall talent pipelines and building future skills. By setting clear definitions, minimum criteria, and programme design principles, you’ll also drive consistency, quality, and commercial discipline across all early talent programmes.

Alongside this, you’ll provide strategic challenge and guidance to human resources business partners and leaders on early talent investment decisions, supporting choices on which programmes to create, expand, reduce, or close.

In Addition, You’ll Focus On

Ensuring the early talent experience strengthens development outcomes, boosts conversion and retention, and builds a high-performing alumni communityAligning early talent investment and programme focus with strategic workforce priorities, future skills needs, and critical talent pipelinesMaintaining deep market insight and managing relationships with industry bodies, government groups, and education and training partners, representing the bank in key forumsDeveloping enterprise-level insights and benchmarking to inform strategy and measure programme effectiveness across conversion, retention, performance, diversity, and cost-to-hire outcomesOptimising our Apprenticeship Levy investment, aligning it with our commercial ambitions and driving high-quality programmes that build future skills while delivering measurable value to the business

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for someone with deep expertise in shaping enterprise-wide early talent strategies, including graduate programmes and apprenticeships. A strong understanding of labour market trends and future workforce needs is also essential, enabling you to anticipate how critical roles will evolve.

In Addition, You’ll Need

Knowledge of apprenticeship policy, funding models, and levy utilisation, with the ability to optimise pipeline effectivenessExperience working with universities, government groups, industry bodies, and education partners to establish strong external relationships and generate valuable market insightA strong analytical and commercial mindset, with the ability to link early careers investment to measurable business outcomesExperience leading multi-functional end-to-end graduate and intern strategies, including designing attraction, recruitment, and development approaches to build future leadership pipelines

rows.title: Senior Data Engineer I (Data Platform)
rows.descriptionText:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

Location: London office / Hybrid (2 days per week in the office)

Reporting to: Data Engineering Manager

The Role

Millions of people visit the Rightmove website every month. We have a huge amount of data about how people use the site, and what this means to our customers.

You’ll be joining our growing Data Engineering & Infrastructure team, a collaborative, high-performing group of engineers that uses this data to build the infrastructure that powers the UK’s favourite property site.

In this role, you will take ownership of the systems and infrastructure that ingest, process, and serve data across Rightmove. You will be responsible for the infrastructure, tooling, and engineering practices that power our data ecosystem, including data ingestion, orchestration, storage, and the developer experience for data producers and consumers.

You will bring strong hands-on expertise to our GCP-based data platform, design reusable patterns and tools, write robust Python and SQL, and deploy infrastructure with Terraform, while influencing the standards and technical decisions that the wider data engineering team works to.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be a technical leader and multiplier within the data platform team. You will own the infrastructure, frameworks, and internal tooling that power Rightmove’s data ecosystem. You will contribute to the technical direction for how data is ingested, processed, and served across the business, and consistently apply and promote engineering best practices that raise the quality of the team’s work.

Join an inclusive and collaborative engineering culture where you'll work alongside talented engineers, tackle complex technical challenges, and continue to grow your skills. You'll leverage a modern GCP stack and apply your data engineering expertise to build products and services used by millions across the UK every day.

What You’ll Be Doing

Define the technical approach to our most complex and ambiguous data challenges, setting direction where others would wait for clarity, making high-quality architectural decisions, and ensuring the right trade-offs are made for the long-term health of the platformOwn the end-to-end technical leadership of cross-functional projects, from shaping requirements with product owners and domain teams through to delivery. Take accountability for outcomes, not just the engineering contributionDesign and build data platform infrastructure and internal tooling, contributing to the architectural direction for how teams across Rightmove work with dataOwn the design and evolution of reusable batch and real-time data ingestion and processing frameworks, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and serve the needs of teams across the businessManage infrastructure, security and code deployment with Terraform and CI/CD pipelinesOptimise performance, scalability, and cost efficiency of our data platformChampion engineering best practices across the team, including testing, documentation, and observability, share knowledge and support others through code reviews and technical discussions, helping raise the bar and embed standards in how the team worksPartner with engineers, data scientists, and analytics teams to enable self-service data workflows, acting as a technical enabler and setting the patterns others follow

We're Looking For Someone Who

Has a strong track record of delivering significant impact in data engineering or data platform engineering, with deep experience building and operating large-scale, cloud-based data platformsThrives in ambiguity, able to define the problem, identify the right technical approach, and drive complex cross-functional projects to completion without needing fully formed requirementsIs a strong Python and SQL engineer, with mastery of software engineering fundamentals, and is able to raise the standard across the teamHas deep, hands-on experience with GCP (or comparable cloud platforms) and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform, and can influence how the team approaches cloud engineeringHas a strong track record of designing, building, and operating production-grade data pipelines and real-time processing frameworks at scaleHas built and managed CI/CD pipelines for data and infrastructure, and can lead the team in adopting reliable, automated deployment practicesHas a track record of raising the technical bar across the team through introducing better practices, leading technical reviews, and driving engineering improvements that outlast individual projectsHas knowledge of GDPR and data security best practicesUnderstands data storage, data modelling principles, best practices and tools (e.g. dbt)Communicates with clarity and confidence, able to lead design discussions, articulate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and build alignment across teamsIs curious, self-directed, and proactive, identifying problems before they are assigned, and drives improvements to the platform without being asked

About Rightmove

Our vision is to give everyone the belief that they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust and belief to make it happen.

We're home to the UK's largest choice of properties, and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what's on the market.

Despite This Growth, We’ve Remained a Friendly, Supportive Place To Work, With Employee #1 Still Working Here! We’ve Done This By Placing The Rightmove Hows At The Heart Of Everything We Do. These Are The Essential Values That Reflect Our Culture, And Include

We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact.

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 88% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work, we’re clearly doing something right!

Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.Contributory stakeholder pension.Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.Competitive compensation package.Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. 

At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success., We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve.

By applying, you confirm that you are aged at least 18 or over and that you’ve read and understood our Privacy Policy, which explains how we handle and protect your personal information during the recruitment process.

rows.title: Business Risk Insights Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a C&I Business Risk Insights Lead,

Play a key role by developing and delivering actionable non-financial risk insights to support proactive data-led risk insights within the Commercial & Institutional First Line of Defence (1LOD)Work with business leaders to enable a data-driven risk culture and embed risk insights into day-to-day decision-makingLead a team, and expand your expertise by elevating static reporting and leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation to predict emerging risks and automate risk intelligence reporting

What you'll do

As a Business Risk Insights Lead, you'll be responsible for leveraging advanced analytics, AI-driven automation, and industry-leading visualisation tools to enhance strategic risk decision-making, drive risk awareness, and embed risk frameworks across the bank. You'll also play an important part in translating complex risk information into meaningful narratives and business intelligence to ensure risk insights are clear, contextual, and relevant, enabling senior leaders and frontline teams to make informed risk-based decisions.

In Addition, You’ll Be

Developing next-generation risk insights, building intuitive, interactive risk solutions that enable business users to self-serve risk intelligence in real-time, rather than waiting on periodic reportsTransitioning from raw data production to contextualised insights, writing compelling risk narratives, and helping drive informed business actionsWorking closely with risk owners in 1LOD to ensure insights drive tangible risk actions and business impactDeveloping narratives that help businesses understand, prioritise, and mitigate non-financial risks effectivelyEngaging with business leaders to ensure they understand and act on risk intelligence, rather than treating risk data solely as a compliance exerciseCollaborating across the First, Second, and Third Lines of Defence (1LOD, 2LOD, and 3LOD), to ensure risk insights align with regulatory requirements, supervisory expectations, and regulatory reporting

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with the ability to influence senior business leaders and ensure risk insights translate into practical business decisions, backed by strong knowledge of Non-Financial Risk and Risk Management Frameworks. You must also bring a robust ability to convert complex data into meaningful, actionable narratives for business leaders, along with deep knowledge of data analytics, for risk management.

In Addition, You’ll Need

A solid understanding of AI, and automation tools for risk intelligenceExperience designing real-time, dynamic risk dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or QlikThe ability to train and upskill business teams in using data-driven risk insights effectively

rows.title: Senior Data Governance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Purpose of Role:
The Senior Data Governance Analyst helps shape how trusted data is governed and used across Baillie Gifford.
You will take ownership of one or more core Data Governance areas:
- Governance by Design, Data Products & Technology Enablement- Federated Ownership, Data Quality & Adoption- Enterprise Governance, Risk & Assurance
You will lead colleagues within your sub-team, strengthen data ownership and quality, and embed practical governance across Data Products, modern data platforms, analytics and AI-enabled change. Substantial Data Governance experience, sound judgement and stakeholder influence are essential.
Responsibilities:
Portfolio Leadership and DeliveryLead one or more core Data Governance areas, setting priorities, maintaining a roadmap and tracking risks, dependencies and outcomes.Lead governance work from problem definition through implementation and adoption, coordinating business and technology colleagues.Build trusted stakeholder relationships, make proportionate recommendations and escalate material issues early.Governance Framework and Embedded DeliveryDevelop and embed practical governance policies, standards and controls, translating them into procedures and decision routes teams can apply consistently.Embed governance requirements in Data Products, change initiatives, modern data platforms, analytics and AI-enabled use cases, including input to data models and integrations.Shape governance tooling and automation where processes and accountabilities are clear.Data Quality, Ownership and AssuranceStrengthen Data Owner and Data Steward accountability, supporting decisions on definitions, quality, access and remediation.Define scalable data-quality rules and thresholds, lead complex investigations and agree proportionate fixes with accountable owners.Produce reporting and assurance evidence showing whether governance is working and where action is required.Leadership and Continuous ImprovementLead your sub-team to deliver agreed priorities, review work quality and build capability through coaching and meaningful ownership.Maintain repeatable methods, clear documentation and effective cross-cover, using management information and feedback to improve outcomes.
What Success Looks Like:
Clear ownership and delivery across your Data Governance area, with predictable engagement routes, prioritised outcomes and useful measures.Governance that is easier to apply, with practical standards and timely support reducing uncertainty, rework and avoidable escalation.Improved ownership and trust in priority data, with visible quality rules, issues, decisions and remediation.A resilient, capable sub-team with reusable methods, strong documentation and effective cross-cover.
Your Knowledge and Experience:
Substantial hands-on Data Governance experience, with expert knowledge of governance frameworks and developing and applying policies, standards and controls.Strong knowledge of data ownership, data quality, metadata and lineage.Practical understanding of data models, databases, integrations, reporting and the data lifecycle.Experience with governance, metadata or data-quality tooling such as Informatica, Collibra, Talend Data Fabric or equivalent.Understanding of Data Products and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, including how governance is embedded across their lifecycle.Working knowledge of DAMA-DMBOK principles and their application to Data Governance and Data Management.Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives, with strong planning and delivery-management skills.Able to investigate issues across multiple data sources or systems, define quality rules and thresholds, and drive resolution.Experience creating reporting, controls or assurance evidence to support decision-making.Able to manage competing priorities effectively.Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.Experience influencing governance adoption and helping stakeholders embed new ways of working.Confident influencing senior stakeholders and explaining complex requirements in practical language.Experience leading and mentoring colleagues, reviewing work and establishing repeatable methods.CDMP certification or another recognised Data Management or Data Governance qualification (Preferred)Analytics or AI Data Governance experience. (Preferred)Restricted or licensed data controls. (Preferred)
The type of candidate that we’re looking for:
You’ll be an experienced Data Governance professional who combines strong technical knowledge with a practical, collaborative approach. You’ll be comfortable working across business and technology teams, turning governance requirements into clear, workable solutions and helping stakeholders embed good data practices. You’ll also be confident managing competing priorities, influencing senior colleagues and driving improvements across data quality, ownership, metadata and controls.

Data LiteracyNurture relationshipsAdaptabilityDigital effectivenessImprovement mindsetSystems thinking

Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.

rows.title: Website Product Owner
rows.descriptionText:
Website Product Owner | Barclays.

The Website Product Owner will define and deliver the vision, strategy and roadmap for PBWM's web estate, managing the websites as a strategic digital product that enhances client experience, supports business growth and drives digital transformation.

The role will lead PBWM's evolution towards a modern, scalable headless CMS architecture, establishing the platform, governance and capability required to support reusable content, faster publishing, personalisation and future multi-channel content delivery.

Working across Marketing, Technology, UX, Content, Analytics, SEO and Compliance, the role will prioritise and optimise the website ecosystem, balancing client needs, commercial objectives, operational efficiency and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Delivery

Own the website product vision, strategy, roadmap and backlog, aligned to business, digital and transformation objectives.

Translate client, business and regulatory requirements into prioritised initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, servicing and efficiency.

Customer Experience & Optimisation

Own end-to-end website journeys, championing customer-centric design, accessibility and continuous improvement.

Partner with UX, Analytics, Technology and Marketing teams to improve usability, personalisation, experimentation and performance.

Own and manage the CRO function and roadmap.

Website Transformation & Platform Evolution

Lead the primary website transformation initiative – migration to a headless CMS.

Define the ongoing digital experience platform roadmap alongside Architecture and Engineering teams.

Provide technical leadership across CMS architecture, APIs, templates, components and integrations to support scalable, future-ready solutions.

Team Leadership & Line Management

Lead, coach and develop website product, content operations or delivery colleagues as the function evolves, setting clear objectives, priorities and performance expectations.

Build capability within the team by upskilling to meet capability gaps, embedding effective ways of working, clear ownership, documentation and knowledge-sharing.

Content & SEO

Partner with Content and Marketing teams to improve content effectiveness, discoverability and performance across SEO/GEO/AEO.

Establish content governance and publishing standards across global markets.

Governance, Risk & Cross-Border Delivery

Ensure website activity complies with regulatory, legal, privacy, accessibility and governance requirements.

Work with Compliance, Legal and Risk to support cross-border digital marketing and jurisdiction-specific requirements, balancing global consistency with local needs.

Performance & Analytics

Define and monitor website KPIs, business outcomes and non-functional requirements, including performance, resilience, security, scalability and site speed.

Use analytics and customer insights to inform prioritisation, investment decisions and ongoing optimisation.

Essential Experience

Experience as a Website Product Owner, Digital Product Manager or Digital Experience Product Owner within Financial Services.

Must have: Significant hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM Sites).

Must have: Experience with Headless CMS platforms and architectures.

Experience managing large-scale public websites within regulated environments.

Strong product management expertise across strategy, roadmap ownership, Agile delivery, backlog management and stakeholder engagement.

Deep understanding of digital customer journeys, UX, content strategy, SEO, conversion optimisation and web analytics.

Proven people leadership and capability-building experience.

Highly Desirable Experience

Experience managing global, multi-jurisdictional websites and cross-border marketing requirements.

Experience leading website transformation and modernisation programmes.

Knowledge of SEO/GEO/AEO, personalisation, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Target and Adobe Journey Optimizer.

Experience managing agencies, technology partners and vendors.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role will preferably be based in London.

Purpose of the role

rows.title: Account Representative, Uber Eats, UK - South Asian Restaurant Specialist (Tamil Speaker)
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

As a South Asian Restaurant Specialist Account Executive for Uber Eats, you will drive marketplace growth by acquiring independent South Asian restaurant partners onto the platform. You will use your language skills, understanding of the restaurant market and relationship-building skills to build trust with merchants over the phone, managing the full outbound sales cycle from prospecting through to closed partnership.

This is a specialist inside sales role within a fast-paced SMB sales team. You will succeed by mastering your pipeline, leveraging data to drive territory growth, and using your language capability to reach and engage merchants who are harder to acquire through traditional sales channels.

What You'll Do

Specialist Outbound Activity: Drive a high volume of daily cold calling, using your target language where relevant to build trust and engage merchants, while consistently progressing deals through every stage of the sales cycle. Territory Ownership: Execute a structured operational plan to hit acquisition quotas. Map market data and local business intelligence to identify high-value targets within South Asian cuisine categories. Rigorous Data and Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain accurate data in CRM with diligent follow-ups, detailed meeting notes, and clear next steps. Monitor dashboards to ensure consistent engagement, preventing deals from becoming inactive. Account Management and Partner Optimisation: Act as a strategic partner to merchants during and post-onboarding; evaluate business impact, manage initial partner health, and use upsell frameworks to introduce additional Uber products that maximise mutual value. Forecasting and Reporting: Partner with leadership to review pipeline health, deliver accurate performance forecasting, and maintain complete business visibility. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with internal teams to streamline the merchant launch experience. Share insights on objection patterns, merchant needs and what works to help shape our approach to underserved cuisine categories. 

Basic Qualifications 

Language Capability: Fluency in English & TamilExperience and Track Record: Sales or business development experience in an outbound or target-driven environment with a track record of hitting or exceeding targets. Sales Cycle Capability: Proven ability to manage the full end-to-end cycle, from proactive prospecting to identifying needs, negotiating commercial structures, and transitioning relationships into early-stage account management. Soft Skills and Drive: Excellent communication, active listening, and presentation skills. Must be a resourceful problem-solver who can overcome objections with creative perseverance in a fast-paced environment. Product Expertise: Confidently handle routine product questions and platform objections by demonstrating deep marketplace expertise. Deal Structuring: Propose basic commercial deal structures and follow existing upsell frameworks to maximise the mutual value of the partnership from day one. Relationship Building: Ability to build trust quickly with independent business owners and adapt your communication style to different merchants. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience in the food delivery, hospitality, or e-commerce marketplace industries. Extraordinary listening and communication skills, with the ability to adjust your style to a wide variety of audiences. A resourceful and persistent attitude, with a relentless drive to achieve goals and overcome objections. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
