rows.title: Payment Operations Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Payment Operations Analyst

You’ll be able to showcase your knowledge and enthusiasm as you deal with a variety of payment related queries

What You'll Do

You'll be responsible for day to day processing manual payments accurately, efficiently, and in line with scheme guidelines.

You'll also:

Handle payment investigations across multiple products—including missing payment queries and redirected payments—with direct customer contact. Process Indemnity Claims (DDIC), Challenges. Reviewing, BACS Reports such as ADDACS, ARUDD and AUDDISManage Credit Payment Recovery (CPR), bulk bank error recoveries, and international payment recalls. Collaborate with external partners (other banks, debt management companies, and Pay.UK) as well as internal teams (Operations, Product, Engineering, and Risk) to streamline the customer journey. Assist in creating and maintaining operational processes, knowledge base resources, and training new joiners. Identify and mitigate operational risks while contributing to a collaborative, high-performing team culture. Demonstrate strong practical ability with spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets) to analyse data

The Skills You'll Need

We're looking for someone with strong payment operations experience who can provide an excellent customer service experience to our customers and colleagues.

You’ll also demonstrate:

A proven background in payment operations covering domestic schemes (FPS, Bacs, Cards) and/or international payments, with exceptional attention to detail. Confidence investigating issues across various Financial Products i.e. business bank accounts, loans, and savings products. A solid understanding of UK payment scheme rules and procedures. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with hands-on customer service experience. The ability to work independently, draft new workflows, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and leverage data to solve operational problems. 

It would be great if you also had:

Direct experience with Credit Payment Recovery (CPR). Hands-on experience using the Payment Services Website (PSW) for ADDACS, ARUDD, AUDDIS, or DDICBasic SQL Skills

rows.title: Business Risk Insights Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a C&I Business Risk Insights Lead,

Play a key role by developing and delivering actionable non-financial risk insights to support proactive data-led risk insights within the Commercial & Institutional First Line of Defence (1LOD)Work with business leaders to enable a data-driven risk culture and embed risk insights into day-to-day decision-makingLead a team, and expand your expertise by elevating static reporting and leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation to predict emerging risks and automate risk intelligence reporting

What you'll do

As a Business Risk Insights Lead, you'll be responsible for leveraging advanced analytics, AI-driven automation, and industry-leading visualisation tools to enhance strategic risk decision-making, drive risk awareness, and embed risk frameworks across the bank. You'll also play an important part in translating complex risk information into meaningful narratives and business intelligence to ensure risk insights are clear, contextual, and relevant, enabling senior leaders and frontline teams to make informed risk-based decisions.

In Addition, You’ll Be

Developing next-generation risk insights, building intuitive, interactive risk solutions that enable business users to self-serve risk intelligence in real-time, rather than waiting on periodic reportsTransitioning from raw data production to contextualised insights, writing compelling risk narratives, and helping drive informed business actionsWorking closely with risk owners in 1LOD to ensure insights drive tangible risk actions and business impactDeveloping narratives that help businesses understand, prioritise, and mitigate non-financial risks effectivelyEngaging with business leaders to ensure they understand and act on risk intelligence, rather than treating risk data solely as a compliance exerciseCollaborating across the First, Second, and Third Lines of Defence (1LOD, 2LOD, and 3LOD), to ensure risk insights align with regulatory requirements, supervisory expectations, and regulatory reporting

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with the ability to influence senior business leaders and ensure risk insights translate into practical business decisions, backed by strong knowledge of Non-Financial Risk and Risk Management Frameworks. You must also bring a robust ability to convert complex data into meaningful, actionable narratives for business leaders, along with deep knowledge of data analytics, for risk management.

In Addition, You’ll Need

A solid understanding of AI, and automation tools for risk intelligenceExperience designing real-time, dynamic risk dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or QlikThe ability to train and upskill business teams in using data-driven risk insights effectively

rows.title: Lead Pricing Data Analyst - BPL
rows.descriptionText:
As a Lead Pricing Data Analyst within the Data & Analytics team, you’ll play a key role in shaping the pricing strategy for Barclaycard Payments’ . You’ll combine data-driven insight with commercial understanding to support pricing decisions that drive growth, profitability, and customer value. Working closely with stakeholders across Product, Finance, Commercial, and Analytics teams, you’ll help develop and refine pricing approaches that ensure the business remains competitive in a dynamic payments market.

You’ll be responsible for the creation, development, and maintenance of pricing models, using deep analysis of customer behaviour, transaction trends, and competitor activity to generate actionable insights. You’ll lead performance reviews of pricing initiatives, monitoring outcomes and identifying opportunities for optimisation. With strong stakeholder engagement skills, you’ll also oversee model governance activities, ensuring pricing methodologies are robust, well-controlled, and clearly documented. This is a highly visible role where your ability to translate complex data into meaningful commercial recommendations will directly influence the success of Barclaycard Payments’ pricing strategy.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients.

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments (BPL) brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years.

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield, please visit Barclays.com.

To be successful as a Lead Pricing Data Analyst, you must have the following essential skills:


Degree in a relevant analytical discipline, such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Data Science, or a related fieldExperience working with large and complex datasets, including proficiency in tools such as SQL, Python, and Cloud(AWS) to support data analysis and modellingExperience developing data visualisations and delivering commercial insights, with the ability to influence decision-making through clear, data-driven recommendations and stakeholder engagement

rows.title: Early Talent Strategy Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as an Early Talent Strategy Manager

We’ll look to you to manage the enterprise early talent strategy, building future-ready talent pipelines aligned to our strategic workforce needs across our graduate, intern, and apprenticeships programmesInfluence and lead the enterprise-wide apprenticeship strategy and external ecosystem, maximising levy utilisation, and managing key external partnershipsThis is an opportunity to make a lasting impact by leading the graduate and intern strategy across attraction, university engagement, recruitment, and developmentThis is a full-time, hybrid position so you'll work from home some of the time, coming into the office at least two days per week to collaborate closely with your colleagues

What you'll do

As an Early Talent Strategy Manager, you’ll manage the enterprise-wide strategy, standards, and guardrails for all early talent pathways, including interns, apprentices, and graduates. You’ll ensure these pathways integrate seamlessly with wider talent ecosystem and strategic workforce plans, strengthening the overall talent pipelines and building future skills. By setting clear definitions, minimum criteria, and programme design principles, you’ll also drive consistency, quality, and commercial discipline across all early talent programmes.

Alongside this, you’ll provide strategic challenge and guidance to human resources business partners and leaders on early talent investment decisions, supporting choices on which programmes to create, expand, reduce, or close.

In Addition, You’ll Focus On

Ensuring the early talent experience strengthens development outcomes, boosts conversion and retention, and builds a high-performing alumni communityAligning early talent investment and programme focus with strategic workforce priorities, future skills needs, and critical talent pipelinesMaintaining deep market insight and managing relationships with industry bodies, government groups, and education and training partners, representing the bank in key forumsDeveloping enterprise-level insights and benchmarking to inform strategy and measure programme effectiveness across conversion, retention, performance, diversity, and cost-to-hire outcomesOptimising our Apprenticeship Levy investment, aligning it with our commercial ambitions and driving high-quality programmes that build future skills while delivering measurable value to the business

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for someone with deep expertise in shaping enterprise-wide early talent strategies, including graduate programmes and apprenticeships. A strong understanding of labour market trends and future workforce needs is also essential, enabling you to anticipate how critical roles will evolve.

In Addition, You’ll Need

Knowledge of apprenticeship policy, funding models, and levy utilisation, with the ability to optimise pipeline effectivenessExperience working with universities, government groups, industry bodies, and education partners to establish strong external relationships and generate valuable market insightA strong analytical and commercial mindset, with the ability to link early careers investment to measurable business outcomesExperience leading multi-functional end-to-end graduate and intern strategies, including designing attraction, recruitment, and development approaches to build future leadership pipelines

rows.descriptionText:
The base location for this role can be Northampton, Knutsford or Glasgow.

Key Responsibilities


Lead Senior Manager engagement (to MD-level) regarding oversight and escalation of control environment matters for Fraud and Financial Crime.Provide leadership relating to control design and execution for priority Risk Reduction Programmes.Accelerate strategic control investigation and remediation initiatives by enabling expanding use of data analytics tools to identify emerging control weaknesses.Support BUs with their responses to regulatory exams and formulation of external communications with regulators.Demonstrate ability to align control activities with BU business/commercial priorities.

Purpose of the role

To assess the integrity and effectiveness of the banks internal control framework to support the mitigation of risk and protection of the banks operational, financial, and reputational risk.

Accountabilities


Knowledge of business areas, products, processes and platforms to be able to assess riskCollaboration with various stakeholders across the bank and business units to improve overall control effectiveness through detailed documentation of control assessments, procedures, and findings.Identification and investigation of potential weaknesses and issues within internal controls to promote continuous improvement and risk mitigation aligned to the bank’s control framework, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations.Development of reports to communicate key findings from risk assessment including control weaknesses and recommendations to control owners, senior management, and other stakeholders.Execution of reviews to determine the effectiveness of the bank's internal controls framework aligned to established and evolving policies, regulation, and best practice.Implementation of adherence to the Barclays Controls Framework and set appropriate methodology of assessing controls against the Controls Framework.

To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..They manage the direction of a large team or sub-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub-function.Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.Focus on the external environment, regulators, or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up-to-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.

rows.title: Account Representative, Uber Eats, UK - South Asian Restaurant Specialist (Bengali Speaker)
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

As a South Asian Restaurant Specialist Account Executive for Uber Eats, you will drive marketplace growth by acquiring independent South Asian restaurant partners onto the platform. You will use your language skills, understanding of the restaurant market and relationship-building skills to build trust with merchants over the phone, managing the full outbound sales cycle from prospecting through to closed partnership.

This is a specialist inside sales role within a fast-paced SMB sales team. You will succeed by mastering your pipeline, leveraging data to drive territory growth, and using your language capability to reach and engage merchants who are harder to acquire through traditional sales channels.

What You'll Do

Specialist Outbound Activity: Drive a high volume of daily cold calling, using your target language where relevant to build trust and engage merchants, while consistently progressing deals through every stage of the sales cycle. Territory Ownership: Execute a structured operational plan to hit acquisition quotas. Map market data and local business intelligence to identify high-value targets within South Asian cuisine categories. Rigorous Data and Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain accurate data in CRM with diligent follow-ups, detailed meeting notes, and clear next steps. Monitor dashboards to ensure consistent engagement, preventing deals from becoming inactive. Account Management and Partner Optimisation: Act as a strategic partner to merchants during and post-onboarding; evaluate business impact, manage initial partner health, and use upsell frameworks to introduce additional Uber products that maximise mutual value. Forecasting and Reporting: Partner with leadership to review pipeline health, deliver accurate performance forecasting, and maintain complete business visibility. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong relationships with internal teams to streamline the merchant launch experience. Share insights on objection patterns, merchant needs and what works to help shape our approach to underserved cuisine categories. 

Basic Qualifications 

Language Capability: Fluency in both English and Bengali Experience and Track Record: Sales or business development experience in an outbound or target-driven environment with a track record of hitting or exceeding targets. Sales Cycle Capability: Proven ability to manage the full end-to-end cycle, from proactive prospecting to identifying needs, negotiating commercial structures, and transitioning relationships into early-stage account management. Soft Skills and Drive: Excellent communication, active listening, and presentation skills. Must be a resourceful problem-solver who can overcome objections with creative perseverance in a fast-paced environment. Product Expertise: Confidently handle routine product questions and platform objections by demonstrating deep marketplace expertise. Deal Structuring: Propose basic commercial deal structures and follow existing upsell frameworks to maximise the mutual value of the partnership from day one. Relationship Building: Ability to build trust quickly with independent business owners and adapt your communication style to different merchants. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience in the food delivery, hospitality, or e-commerce marketplace industries. Extraordinary listening and communication skills, with the ability to adjust your style to a wide variety of audiences. A resourceful and persistent attitude, with a relentless drive to achieve goals and overcome objections. Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. Proven track record of meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets. 

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. rows.title: Business Risk Read Across Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Business Risk Read Across Lead

Make a real impact across the bank by leading the identification, assessment, and coordination of Commercial & Institutional (C&I) reviews across risk, control, conduct, and regulatory themesGain visibility and ensure lessons learned, emerging risks, and control improvements are applied consistently across Business Banking, Commercial Mid-Market, Corporate and Institutional Banking, NatWest Markets, RBS International, Products, and Operations as appropriatePlay a key role in supporting the bank’s success by enabling safe growth in line with strategic goals, transformation, and consistent delivery of good customer outcomes

What you'll do

As a Business Risk Read Across Lead, you’ll define, implement, maintain, and own the C&I read across and lessons learned process, providing effective governance and oversight to help prevent potential control failures across the C&I business. You’ll also lead the assessment of potential impacts across franchises, products, customer segments, and legal entities, while ensuring emerging risk exposures, control weaknesses, and thematic issues are escalated in a timely manner with recommendations that support safe growth and good customer outcomes.

Moreover, you’ll oversee the review of risk events, audit findings, regulatory observations, control failures, and incidents to identify read across opportunities by highlighting recurring issues, emerging trends, and intervention areas. Partnering with C&I functions, you’ll also lead thematic and targeted reviews to address control deficiencies, present findings to relevant Executive Committee members and governance forums, and drive the development of a read across and lessons learned repository.

In Addition, You’ll Be

Executing the C&I read across and lessons learned process, ensuring the accurate and timely assessment of potential impacts across franchise, products, customer segments, and legal entitiesChallenging outcomes and responses to identify root causes and ensure proportionate management actions are delivered to enable safe growth and good customer outcomesDeveloping, implementing, and maintaining a read across and lessons learned repository, ensuring the accuracy of source data used to measure process effectivenessProducing high-quality read across reporting for the read across forum and other committees, driving effective read across and resulting actions that enable safe growth and good customer outcomesDriving continuous improvement in risk management by identifying and implementing standardisation, simplification, and consistency opportunities that reduce duplication of effort across the franchise

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for someone with subject matter expertise across Commercial Banking, coupled with strong critical thinking skills and proven experience leading reviews and large-scale responses across Commercial Banking areas. You should also have the ability to identify weak signals, trends, and interconnected themes, while balancing commercial objectives with risk management outcomes.

To succeed in this role, you must be able to think beyond individual issues to understand broader franchise-wide implications and drive informed decision-making.

In Addition, You’ll Need

Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence and engage stakeholders to ensure high-quality reviews are communicated to and understood by senior managementStrong analytic skills, with experience turning risk data into concise and actionable executive insightsProven experience using AI to transform processes

The role also supports internal governance and controls so disclosures are evidence-based, traceable and audit ready. Success looks like clear and balanced publication-ready disclosures that reflect evolving industry guidance and regulatory expectations.  Bring knowledge or strong interest in financed and facilitated emissions reporting including PCAF-aligned approaches and Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 boundaries  Demonstrate strong writing capability that translates complex methodologies, calculations and limitations into clear external disclosure language  Manage stakeholders across methodology, data analytics, finance, risk, legal, investor relations and assurance to resolve disclosure wording and materiality judgements  Apply strong attention to detail to ensure disclosures are accurate, consistent and supported by evidence and governance decisions  Support first line of defence (1LOD) controls and second line of defence (2LOD) oversight through documentation, version control and evidence management  Own operational use of core programme tooling such as Helios, GMIS and EIM to keep governance processes effective and audit ready  Manage competing priorities across disclosure deadlines, governance reviews and stakeholder feedback cycles while maintaining quality  Bring substantial experience in finance, risk, sustainability, reporting, strategy or a related discipline  Demonstrate critical thinking by improving the clarity and robustness of financed emissions disclosures through constructive challenge

Join us on an Off Cycle Internship for 3-6 months working within one of our Quant focused business areas. Immerse yourself in our work and culture and gain invaluable insights with this longer internship.

Why the Quant Off-Cycle Internship Programme?

As an intern with Barclays you’ll be embedded with one of our Quant teams, we’ll expect you to have a tangible impact on our business from day one, using the latest AI tools to work on algorithmic trading strategies, researching and developing models or producing data analysis tools for valuation and risk management.

Our teams are an integral part of the bank, managing algorithmic trading strategies, researching and developing models and producing data analysis tools for valuation and risk management across various business areas at Barclays.

We're seeking an experienced Financial Crime professional with deep Merchant Acquiring expertise to join our BPL Financial Crime Policy & Advisory team.

This is a Second Line of Defence role responsible for providing oversight, challenge and strategic advice across the Payments Acquiring business. Working closely with key stakeholders, you will help shape the financial crime framework supporting merchant relationships, ensuring emerging risks are effectively managed while enabling sustainable business growth.

You will act as a trusted advisor on complex financial crime matters, influence key business decisions, oversee significant change initiatives and remediation programmes, and drive enhancements to policies, controls and risk management practices across the merchant lifecycle. This role requires a strong understanding of the Financial Crime risks unique to Merchant Acquiring, including customer onboarding, payment facilitators, marketplaces, high-risk merchant sectors, transaction flows, sanctions exposure, fraud typologies and evolving regulatory expectations. This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping the Financial Crime strategy and control environment of a dynamic Merchant Acquiring business. You'll work at the forefront of emerging Financial Crime risks in payments, partnering with senior leaders to influence decisions, strengthen controls and help protect both our customers and the Bank.

Key Accountabilities

To be successful as a Merchant Acquiring Financial Crime Policy & Advisory VP, you should have:


Significant Financial Crime experience within banking, payments or financial services.Deep Merchant Acquiring experience is essential, with a strong understanding of merchant onboarding, payment acceptance, card acquiring, customer lifecycle management and associated Financial Crime risks.Extensive knowledge of AML, Sanctions, Anti-Bribery & Corruption and broader Financial Crime regulatory requirements.Demonstrable experience operating within a Second Line Financial Crime, Compliance or Risk function.Strong ability to provide effective challenge whilst maintaining constructive relationships with senior stakeholders.Experience overseeing complex remediation programmes, regulatory reviews and control enhancement initiatives.Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets and translate them into meaningful risk insights and actions.Exceptional stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills.

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years. 

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield (programme ‘Gaia’), please visit Barclays.com. 

Purpose of the role

To provide data-led expert oversight and check and challenge on business and compliance matters to evidence that the organisation is operating in a compliance with Barclays legal, regulatory and ethical responsibilities.

Accountabilities


Identification and assessment of compliance risks through thorough reviews of business activities, changes, processes, testing and systems to.Identification and investigation of potential market abuse, including but not limited to, Insider Dealing, Unlawful Disclosure, Market Manipulation or Anti-Competitive Conduct.Conduct investigation of compliance risk events or breaches. Oversight and check and challenge of corrective actions and preventative measures to avoid future occurrences.Implementation of compliance policies and procedures in line with regulatory requirements and ensuring that the bank’s internal policies are aligned with international standards, including jurisdictional requirements.Collaboration with 1LOD, other relevant Compliance teams and legal, and relevant risk management functions to facilitate a comprehensive approach to compliance and risk management.Identification, investigation and oversight of potential money laundering, terrorist financing or other financial crime.

To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. rows.title: Quantitative Analytics Associate Graduate Programme 2027 London
rows.descriptionText:
Graduate Programme Overview

If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge and connections to shape your career.

Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. To put it simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next.

Our graduates are a vital part of our success and we welcome applications from people from all walks of life. Whoever you are and wherever you want to join us, if you’re curious, creative and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

Why the Quantitative Analytics Associate Graduate Programme?

Our industry-leading group provides model development, analytics and valuable quantitative advice to businesses across the bank.

Applying to our programme means the opportunity to join one of our specialist teams, including:

Markets Quants

Consisting of specialised modellers and developers, the team directly supports the Capital Markets division of the bank. Team members are responsible for researching, innovating, developing, testing, implementing and supporting all quantitative models used for front-office pricing, valuation adjustments, along with market and counter-party credit risk management across all asset classes.

Joining a group that partners with trading, structuring and risk management functions across the bank, you’ll gain broad exposure to a variety of classic and contemporary financial engineering modelling techniques and markets instruments to help drive business strategy.

Statistical Modelling Quants 

Comprised of data scientists, developers, data engineers and researchers. The team directly supports the Finance, Treasury, Fraud Surveillance, Stress Testing, Climate Risk, as well as the Wholesale and Retail Credit Risk operations within the bank.

Team members deliver solutions to develop, test, implement and support all statistical and econometrics models for the estimation of default probabilities, recovery rates, exposures at default, forecasting models for net revenue, balance sheet projections, scenario generation/expansion, operational risk, climate change, economic capital models and machine learning models for fraud detection, all while using the latest model development approaches and advancements in technology.

The chance to make an impact

As a Quantitative Analytics Graduate, your experience at Barclays will begin with several weeks of intensive training, covering product and business knowledge as well as other skills you’ll need for a successful start. After training, you’ll join a specific desk and collaborate with colleagues on active projects, giving you ample opportunities to grow and learn.

Quantitative Analytics at Barclays

Barclays Quantitative Analytics team is a global organisation of highly specialised modellers and developers responsible for researching, innovating, developing, testing, implementing, and supporting all quantitative models used for valuation and risk management across all asset classes.

Who We're Looking For

To be considered for this programme, you must have completed (or be in the final year of) a postgraduate qualification, Masters or higher, in a technical discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Economics, Statistics, Calculus, Computer Science, or other STEM subjects.

Ideally, You Would Also Have


Mathematical and programming skills (ideally in C++, or Python)Logical thinking and problem-solving abilitiesExcellent communication skills and a team-oriented attitudeFluent written and spoken EnglishPassion to learn about the banking sector, financial services industry, and capital markets 


Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa. Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from either February OR August 2027 (the month which will apply to you will be dependent on your chosen intake date) to August 2028.

Working in London

If you love the buzz of city life, our global HQ is the place to be. Our London hub is in Canary Wharf, at the heart of London’s financial district. Here, you won’t just be perfectly placed to explore the nation’s capital; you’ll be in a place where you can explore all the many functions and opportunities of a global financial giant. And if you’re technically minded, you’ll get more from your tech career by collaborating with other brilliant minds on game-changing innovations that are redefining the future of finance.

Purpose of the role

Bringing quantitative and analytical expertise to bear across the full spectrum of our Markets and Risk businesses. Our Early Careers colleagues are expected to play an important role in the design and development of risk management and trading strategies, through the use of quantitative analysis, mathematical modelling, and technology, with the aim of optimising trading processes, development practices, systems and infrastructure as well as identifying growth and investment opportunities.

Accountabilities


Develop and implement quantitative models and strategies to enhance decision-making, pricing, and risk management. Design and maintain high-performance trading platforms and risk systems, integrating new features to improve reliability and user experience. Conduct research and data analysis to uncover market trends and drive innovation through advanced methodologies and technologies. Collaborate with traders, sales teams, and stakeholders in Risk and Finance to deliver customized solutions and translate business needs into scalable tech tools. Work cross-functionally with compliance, IT, and strategy teams to resolve system issues and continuously improve trading infrastructure.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes.If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc). to solve problems creatively and effectively.Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

rows.title: Business Risk Insights Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a C&I Business Risk Insights Lead,

Play a key role by developing and delivering actionable non-financial risk insights to support proactive data-led risk insights within the Commercial & Institutional First Line of Defence (1LOD)Work with business leaders to enable a data-driven risk culture and embed risk insights into day-to-day decision-makingLead a team, and expand your expertise by elevating static reporting and leveraging AI, machine learning, and automation to predict emerging risks and automate risk intelligence reporting

What you'll do

As a Business Risk Insights Lead, you'll be responsible for leveraging advanced analytics, AI-driven automation, and industry-leading visualisation tools to enhance strategic risk decision-making, drive risk awareness, and embed risk frameworks across the bank. You'll also play an important part in translating complex risk information into meaningful narratives and business intelligence to ensure risk insights are clear, contextual, and relevant, enabling senior leaders and frontline teams to make informed risk-based decisions.

In Addition, You’ll Be

Developing next-generation risk insights, building intuitive, interactive risk solutions that enable business users to self-serve risk intelligence in real-time, rather than waiting on periodic reportsTransitioning from raw data production to contextualised insights, writing compelling risk narratives, and helping drive informed business actionsWorking closely with risk owners in 1LOD to ensure insights drive tangible risk actions and business impactDeveloping narratives that help businesses understand, prioritise, and mitigate non-financial risks effectivelyEngaging with business leaders to ensure they understand and act on risk intelligence, rather than treating risk data solely as a compliance exerciseCollaborating across the First, Second, and Third Lines of Defence (1LOD, 2LOD, and 3LOD), to ensure risk insights align with regulatory requirements, supervisory expectations, and regulatory reporting

The skills you'll need

We're looking for someone with the ability to influence senior business leaders and ensure risk insights translate into practical business decisions, backed by strong knowledge of Non-Financial Risk and Risk Management Frameworks. You must also bring a robust ability to convert complex data into meaningful, actionable narratives for business leaders, along with deep knowledge of data analytics, for risk management.

In Addition, You’ll Need

A solid understanding of AI, and automation tools for risk intelligenceExperience designing real-time, dynamic risk dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or QlikThe ability to train and upskill business teams in using data-driven risk insights effectively

rows.title: Application Developer - Atlassian
rows.descriptionText:
About the Role At Uber, we don't just use tools; we build the engines that power global movement. As an Application Developer for Work Management, you are at the heart of our productivity, designing and building the Atlassian-based systems that keep thousands of Uber employees aligned and moving fast.

This isn't just about managing Jira tickets-it's about engineering intelligent, integrated ecosystems. The pace here is intense, the systems are massive, and the stakes are high. You'll navigate complex technical debt and architect solutions for problems that don't have a playbook. We need a systems-level thinker with the grit to dive into enterprise-scale configurations and the curiosity to leverage GenAI and Rovo Agents to redefine what's possible. If you stay calm under pressure and care deeply about building tools that actually work at scale, this is where you'll thrive.

What You'll Do

Build and Scale: Design and optimize Jira and Confluence environments that support how our teams move in the real world-where performance and reliability are non-negotiable. Develop Custom Solutions: Build secure, scalable cloud applications directly within the Atlassian ecosystem, where your hands-on experience with Atlassian Forge app development and the Forge platform will be a distinct advantage. Navigate Complexity: Solve messy, high-impact problems across the Atlassian toolchain (Structure, JEMH, EazyBI, ScriptRunner) when the playbook doesn't exist. Automate the Future: Build and maintain AI-powered applications and Atlassian Rovo Agents to automate workflows and eliminate manual friction. Integrate Deeply: Develop robust integrations using Atlassian REST and GraphQL APIs, ensuring seamless data flow across our global tech stack. Own the Outcome: Drive projects end-to-end-from initial requirement gathering with stakeholders to debugging production issues when the stakes are high. Unblock Teams: Champion engineering best practices to work through technical debt and shifting priorities, even when time is tight. Collaborate and Influence: Partner across Product, Engineering, and Operations to navigate tension, influence without authority, and ship practical, high-speed solutions. 

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of combined experience in software engineering and/or Atlassian platform administration and development (Jira/Confluence Cloud or Data Center). Deep proficiency in Jira workflows, custom fields, schemes, permissions, and advanced enterprise configurations. Hands-on experience with Atlassian Forge app development and the Forge platform. Experience using ScriptRunner for complex automation and workflow enhancement. Experience working with Atlassian REST and GraphQL APIs for third-party integrations. Experience managing and configuring Atlassian marketplace apps (e.g., Structure, JEMH, EazyBI). Demonstrated use of AI-powered developer tools in daily engineering workflows (e.g., AI-assisted coding or debugging). 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing AI-enabled solutions using Atlassian Rovo Agents and LLM integrations. Expertise in prompt engineering and defining agent actions within enterprise workflows. Proven ability to design enterprise-scale dashboards and analytics using EazyBI. Experience supporting large, complex organizations with rigorous governance requirements. Strong systems thinking and the ability to thrive in high-ambiguity environments. 

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $153,000 per year - USD $170,000 per year.

For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $153,000 per year - USD $170,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. rows.title: Manager, Earner Marketplace
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

We are seeking a highly strategic and outcomes-oriented Strategic Operations Manager to join the Earner Marketplace & Matching team within Uber's US & Canada Mobility business.

This team owns some of Uber's most important marketplace optimization challenges, shaping the strategies behind driver pricing, incentives, matching, positioning, and other marketplace levers that together determine marketplace reliability, efficiency, and long-term supply health. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations teams to define strategies for solving complex marketplace challenges, influencing the evolution of Uber's marketplace technology and operations to deliver meaningful business impact.

As a senior operations leader for Earner Pricing and Matching, you will identify the highest-impact opportunities across the marketplace, develop long-term strategy, and drive complex cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation. You'll turn ambiguous business challenges into clear strategies, align stakeholders around a shared direction, and drive execution to improve outcomes for drivers, riders, and Uber.

This role requires someone who can operate at multiple altitudes: setting long-term strategic direction while diving deep into complex marketplace problems to identify structural opportunities, evaluate difficult tradeoffs, and develop data-driven solutions. You'll be expected to lead through ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, and deliver lasting marketplace and business impact.

What You'll Do

Strategic direction: Define and drive the long-term strategy for Earner Pricing and Matching, identifying the highest-impact opportunities to improve marketplace performance. Define strategic priorities, influence Tech roadmaps, and drive cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to improve reliability, marketplace efficiency, and earner outcomes. Deep marketplace expertise: Synthesize insights across pricing, matching, incentives, positioning, and quality to develop a holistic view of how these marketplace levers collectively drive outcomes. Use this perspective to identify structural opportunities, diagnose complex marketplace challenges through deep dives, and develop cohesive strategies that improve marketplace performance. Strategic problem solving: Lead the team's most complex and ambiguous work, framing problems, developing business strategy, and translating analytical insights into clear recommendations. Build compelling business cases, navigate difficult tradeoffs, and drive high-impact initiatives from concept through implementation. Strategic influence & communication: Champion the team's strategy through clear, compelling, and data-driven communication. Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and leadership, influence key decisions and long-term priorities, and represent the team's perspective in high-impact forums. 

Basic Qualifications 

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus. Experience: 7+ years of experience in operations, product operations, analytics, strategy, management consulting, product management, or a similar role. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Strategic thinking & business acumen: Demonstrated ability to develop long-term strategies, evaluate complex business tradeoffs, and identify high-impact opportunities in ambiguous environments. Analytical problem solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience structuring complex problems, synthesizing large volumes of data, and translating insights into actionable recommendations. Marketplace mindset: Ability to connect insights across complex systems, understand how they interact to drive marketplace outcomes, and translate those insights into cohesive business strategies. Communication & influence: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment and influence senior stakeholders through clear, data-driven narratives. Execution & leadership: Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution, driving results in fast-paced, highly collaborative environments. 

For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $162,000 per year - USD $180,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

rows.title: 2027 Quantitative Analytics Analyst Graduate Program New York

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
If you're a recent graduate or soon-to-be graduate, join us and unlock a world of carefully curated experiences, knowledge, and connections to shape your career. Along the way, you can expect all the training and support you need to make your mark on the world. Put simply, we’ll empower you to help determine how we do things and where we go next. Our graduates are a vital part of our success. If you’re curious, creative, and ambitious, this is a world in which you can truly belong.

Our Expert Program

You'll join our expert program, a 1 year targeted, fast-track program designed to give you depth and breadth of experience. Participating in job-based bespoke training from the start enabling you to go fully-equipped into your role as you develop specialist technical expertise.

Why the Quant Graduate Program? 

Our team is an integral part of the bank, researching and developing models and producing data analysis tools for valuation and risk management across various business areas at Barclays.

Risk Quantitative Analytics (Risk QA) 

As a Graduate in Risk Quantitative Analytics (Risk QA), you will join a group of specialised modellers and developers powering Barclay’s ability to manage financial risk. From day one, you’ll be part of a team that uses statistical methods, AI techniques, and coding strategies to build the tools and models Barclays uses to make big decisions. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across risk, finance, global markets, and technology - gaining exposure to how different parts of the business come together to navigate market shifts and meet regulatory demands.

The chance to make an impact

We’ll provide you with challenging projects and opportunities to grow and learn. We’ll keep you motivated with encouragement, feedback and support as you build your technical know-how, business acumen and leadership skills. We’ll help you connect with mentors, and network with colleagues and senior leaders alike.

To be considered for this opportunity, you will have completed or be in your final year of a postgraduate degree (Masters degree, equivalent or higher) and have a GPA of 3.4 or above. You will be completing your studies in a technical discipline such as Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Calculus Physics, Economics, Computer Science, Machine Learning or other similar subjects.

You'll have strong mathematical and programming skills (ideally in C++, or Python), some financial knowledge (regarding financial instruments, asset simulation or pricing models) and a passion to learn more about the banking sector, the financial services industry and capital markets.

You’ll be great at communicating and collaborating – driven to identify the best solution to a problem and then motivated to deliver that solution at pace.

You’ll also be ready to develop a deep understanding of what we do, why we do it, and how your role impacts our business outcomes.

These are qualities people at Barclays have in abundance, and we’ll help you further develop them from the day you arrive.

Barclays will not offer or consider offering sponsorship for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for individuals, now or in the future, unless such individuals are enrolled in or graduate with a degree in a field of study that the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Education consider to be a science, technology, engineering or mathematics (STEM) field of study for purposes of the 24-month STEM OPT extension. This includes for any internship, post-graduation program, or permanent employment, now or in the future.

Working in New York

Join us at our Americas Headquarters, located at 745 Seventh Avenue—right in the heart of Times Square. This iconic 37-story tower offers more than just a prime Manhattan address. Inside, you’ll find a vibrant workplace with a modern cafeteria, a fully equipped fitness center, and cutting-edge LED signage lighting up the skyline. It’s a dynamic space designed to energize your day and inspire your best work.

Salary / Rate Minimum: $125,000

Salary / Rate Maximum: $125,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is September 28. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Purpose of the role

Bringing quantitative and analytical expertise to bear across the full spectrum of our Markets and Risk businesses. Our Early Careers colleagues are expected to play an important role in the design and development of risk management and trading strategies, through the use of quantitative analysis, mathematical modelling, and technology, with the aim of optimising trading processes, development practices, systems and infrastructure as well as identifying growth and investment opportunities.

Accountabilities


Develop and implement quantitative models and strategies to enhance decision-making, pricing, and risk management. Design and maintain high-performance trading platforms and risk systems, integrating new features to improve reliability and user experience. Conduct research and data analysis to uncover market trends and drive innovation through advanced methodologies and technologies. Collaborate with traders, sales teams, and stakeholders in Risk and Finance to deliver customized solutions and translate business needs into scalable tech tools. Work cross-functionally with compliance, IT, and strategy teams to resolve system issues and continuously improve trading infrastructure.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomesIf the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

About The Role

We are seeking a dynamic and analytical Sr Strategic Operations Associate to join the Earner Marketplace & Matching team within Uber's US & Canada Mobility business.

The Earner Marketplace & Matching team tackles some of Uber's most interesting marketplace optimization challenges. We shape the earner side of the marketplace through driver pricing, incentives, positioning, matching, and other marketplace levers-balancing reliability and efficiency today while supporting a healthy driver experience and sustainable supply over the long term.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of marketplace strategy, analytics, and technology. Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations, you will help launch and optimize sophisticated pricing and matching capabilities, investigate complex marketplace dynamics, and identify opportunities to improve how the marketplace works for drivers, riders, and Uber.

This is a highly analytical role in a complex, interconnected marketplace where changes in one area can have meaningful effects elsewhere. You will dig into large datasets, develop hypotheses, evaluate experiments and tradeoffs, and turn your findings into recommendations that shape real business and technology decisions. The ideal candidate enjoys getting deep into difficult problems, connecting the dots across systems, and working with others to turn insights into impact.

What You Will Do

Driver Pricing & Matching: Play a key role in shaping how Uber's Driver Pricing and Matching capabilities evolve and perform. Support major launches, identify opportunities to improve marketplace efficiency and reliability, and partner with Product and Tech teams to turn marketplace insights into meaningful improvements for drivers and riders.

Marketplace performance: Develop a deep understanding of marketplace health and the performance of Driver Pricing and Matching. Spot emerging trends and opportunities, lead deep-dive investigations to understand what's driving them, and translate your findings into clear recommendations and action.

Data-driven decision making: Use data to unpack complex marketplace dynamics, test hypotheses, and inform important decisions. Evaluate experiments and rollout plans, understand how pricing, matching, incentives, and other marketplace levers interact, and anticipate the broader effects of changes across the marketplace.

Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations to bring new marketplace capabilities to life and continuously improve existing ones. Bring a strong business and Operations perspective to technical problems, help teams navigate tradeoffs, and drive initiatives from analysis through execution.

Basic Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus. Experience: 5+ years of experience in Operations, Product Management, Analytics, Strategy, or a related field. Experience in fast-paced, high-growth environments is a plus. Analytical skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data and analytical tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, or BI tools to derive actionable insights and inform decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications:

Problem solving: Enjoys tackling complex, ambiguous problems, structuring them clearly, and developing thoughtful, data-backed recommendations. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear to technical and non-technical audiences. Stakeholder management: Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships, influence without formal authority, and drive progress across multiple teams. rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The People Partner team provides HR support to Uber's leaders, managers, and employees, especially in the moments that matter. The team helps drive engagement, strengthen the employee experience, and support Uber's growth through regional and global People initiatives.

We're looking for a seasoned People Partner to support employees across US&C Mobility & Delivery organizations.This person will act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on people matters including performance, engagement, employee relations, organizational health, and broader People priorities.

The ideal candidate is data-driven, organized, adaptable, and passionate about improving processes and the employee experience in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

 Provide high-judgment advice to managers on handling complex performance issues, team conflicts, and local labor standards  Act as a HR advisor, mentor, and partner to employees, managers, and leaders, and manage risk mitigation and de-escalating/resolving HR matters.  Provide HR guidance, managing clients, business, and company needs against risks, to solve HR problems, build relationships, and increase manager, and leader capability..  Use data and insights to identify trends, inform decisions, and drive continuous improvement in HR delivery.  Partner with cross-functional People teams, including ER, Benefits, People Operations, Systems, Analytics, and HRBPs, to deliver a consistent employee experience.  Support key People processes and initiatives, including talent reviews, performance cycles, organizational changes, and local priorities.  Build scalable ways of working by simplifying, improving, and automating processes where possible. 

REQUIREMENTS

 7+ years of relevant HR experience, for example as an HR Generalist, People Partner, Advisor, Business Partner, or project/program manager.  Experience advising managers and employees on complex or sensitive HR matters, including employee relations and performance.  Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and coaching skills.  Ability to operate with sound judgment, influence without authority, and execute effectively in a fast-moving environment. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 Experience coaching managers and peers on HR processes, leadership capability, employee relations, investigations, or complaints.  Strong project management skills, with HRIS, Oracle, JIRA, or ServiceNow experience considered a plus.

rows.title: Sr Software Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

Engineering at Uber means building for real-world impact under real-world constraints. As a Senior Software Engineer (Data & Backend), you will architect mission-critical systems that power the foundation of trust across our global marketplace - from ensuring millions of earners are paid accurately and on time to scaling the simulation platforms that drive billions in pricing decisions. You will work on uniquely ambitious projects where performance, reliability, and scale cannot be separated.

The problems here are complex, the systems are massive, and the pace is fast. You'll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information and own your work end-to-end: from the first design doc to debugging production issues when the stakes are highest. We are looking for technical powerhouses who think in systems, stay calm under pressure, and care about building things that actually work. If you're energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact-this is where you'll grow.

Rate of Pay: $202,000 to $246,000 per Year

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered other types of comp. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link https://www.uber.com/careers/benefits.

Design, develop, and test software applications. Design, develop, and/or test software applications using company technology stack. Apply technical knowledge to evaluate complex data, developments, and projects in order to provide recommendations to resolve technical issues. Support the company's business operations and improve engineering productivity. Build software components that can be integrated into a fully functional software system. Solve production issues in product and system reliability. May telecommute.

Employer will accept a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field. rows.title: Lead Product Manager, Consumer Affordability
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber Eats is on a mission to deliver almost anything to our customers and we're looking for a visionary and strategic consumer experience leader to join our dynamic and fast-paced team. As a Lead Product Manager on the Uber Eats Consumer Experience team, you will be directly responsible for aspects of the core consumer journey for the Uber Eats app that serves millions of users globally every day and is growing fast. You'll set strategy and vision for the experience, align with cross-functional partners and executive leaders across the company, and lead a team responsible for driving that vision forward daily.

In this role, you'll work closely with Product Design, Data Science, Engineering, Business teams and other partners across Uber's businesses and geographies. You will lead with deep customer insights and empathy, relying on data and UXR to make informed decisions grounded in strong product intuition. You'll be both creative and bring deep expertise in consumer product to the table, as well as analytically rigorous, driving experimentation and knowing your metrics. You'll operate with an owner's mindset, obsessing over every detail of the end-to-end experience.

What The Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points

---- What the Candidate Will Do ----

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Design, Data Science, Engineering and Ops, to identify opportunities to make the experience better and drive business outcomes. Distill the vision and strategy for the team and effectively present and communicate to cross-functional partners and executive leadership to generate enthusiasm and drive alignment. Develop and execute a roadmap of product initiatives, and implement data-driven experiments to improve the core consumer experience for Uber Eats. Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent the team from delivering on operational, product, and business objectives. 

 Basic Qualifications

5+ years of Product Management experience delivering highly successful and innovative products with your fingerprints all over them. You should be familiar with systems thinking, analytics and experiment design, and have a solid understanding of software development processes and concepts. Leadership. Extensive experience setting and delivering on a strategy you crafted, where you were accountable for the outcomes. Customer obsession. You have a knack for taking on complex product challenges and finding elegant solutions that are delightfully simple for our users. Consumer product experience with a track record of delivering highly successful and innovative products with your fingerprints all over them. Experience building and leading scaled businesses, including ownership and optimization of business performance metrics. Experience leading geographically distributed cross-functional teams in an energetic, high-octane environment

 Preferred Qualifications

A "Driver" mindset. You are biased toward action, a great collaborator, a master disambiguator/simplifier, and constantly pushing toward clarity and delivery. You never hesitate to roll up your sleeves and tackle something hands-on. Attention to detail. Obsess over every pixel and underlying detail that drives the way users experience Uber Eats. No problem is too big or to small. Finger-tippiness with data. You find a way to get the data you need and whip it into an insightful story with no help. You know how to demonstrate this data to make decisions without getting stuck in analysis paralysisA high bar across the board -- from your own contributions to the people you work with, to the products you work onA true passion for Uber's mission, our products, and the company's hybrid technology/operations natureA never-ending desire to grow and learn

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Artificial Intelligence is at the heart of Uber's products: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision and Generative AI power many user experiences in the Eater, Rider and Earner apps, as well as efficient marketplace and pricing algorithms, powerful safety mechanisms as well as personalization.

The Applied AI team at Uber is a multidisciplinary team of ML Engineers, Applied Scientists, Researchers, Backend Engineers, Mobile Engineers and AI Product Managers responsible for building compelling AI-driven user-facing experiences, and leading innovation in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Personalization & Recommendations, Marketplace Optimization and Generative AI.

As an PM focusing on Core Personalization, you will be driving innovative AI-driven product experiences in close partnership with a variety of product teams across Uber, while building the foundation personalization layer that unifies user understanding & experiences across business verticals.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Develop, articulate and execute a bold and visionary product strategy and roadmap for AI-driven personalization products and experiences that supports Uber's unified agent context, retrieval and ranking optimization, analytics and more  Work closely with cross-functional teams to define product requirements (PRDs), prioritize features, and deliver high-quality AI products that meet user needs and drive business objectives  Collaborate with engineering, data science and design teams to deliver high-quality, well-designed products that meet user needs and exceed business objectives  Stay up-to-date with the latest AI industry trends and emerging technologies and be an AI thought leader and drive innovation across Uber 

 Basic Qualifications 

 5+ years of true technical Product Management experience delivering highly successful AI products at scale  A Computer Science or Engineering degree (preferrable Masters degree)  Strong technical background in AI/ML and GenAI space. You should feel comfortable discussing deep technical topics with engineering teams and the platform users. This includes AI/ML systems and their trade-offs and designing evals. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Previous experience as an ML Engineer or Data Scientist highly preferred.  Ability to thrive in cross-functional environments and work backward from the needs of your customers to build solutions that scale.  Data-driven decision-making ability and a "driver" personality for pushing toward clarity and balancing the need for great collaboration.  High attention to detail and proven track record to multi-task and manage competing priorities.  Very strong communication skills, both written and verbal.  A passion for Uber's mission and technology-driven culture, along with a deep desire to grow and learn!
