rows.title: Senior Product Manager - Autonomous Delivery
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

At Uber, we're building a future where autonomous vehicles and human drivers seamlessly work together to make transportation more reliable, affordable, sustainable, and safer. Our vision is one of a hybrid future, with AVs operating alongside drivers and couriers, each bringing their unique capabilities to the table. As the largest on-demand mobility and delivery platform in the world, with our deep expertise in marketplace management, fleet utilization, and local operations - Uber is uniquely positioned to help AV companies deploy and scale their technology globally.

As the Senior Product Manager for Autonomous Delivery Experiences, you will sit at the forefront of human machine interaction. You will be responsible for defining and delivering the end-to-end consumer journey for how consumers order and receive autonomous deliveries from sidewalk robots, on-road autonomous vehicles, and aerial drones.

You will turn a high-tech logistical interaction into an intuitive, delightful, and trustworthy experience. You will solve novel UX challenges, including how Merchants and Eaters smoothly rendezvous with AVs to load and receive their orders.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Deeply Understand Users: dive deep into user archetypes and how they interact with autonomous delivery form factors  Define the Product Vision: Own the product roadmap for the Eater-facing autonomous delivery lifecycle, including discovery, education, tracking, and the physical handoff  Build Trust Through UX: Design intuitive experiences that meld robotic capabilities with Eater expectations  Handle the Unexpected: Architect resilient "unhappy paths" and recovery flows which ensure that, when something goes wrong, consumers have a path to make things right.  Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the connector between the Engineering, Design, Operations, and external AV Partner teams. 

Basic Qualifications

 Minimum 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping consumer-facing mobile products.  Bachelor's degree or equivalent  User-Centricity: Deep empathy for the user and experience working closely with Product Designers to solve complex UI/UX interactions.  Technical Fluency: Ability to discuss API constraints, hardware-software integration, and latency issues with engineering teams and external Partners. You don't need to be a roboticist, but you must be able to speak their language.  Strategic Execution: Proven ability to break down ambiguous problems into actionable milestones and ship them while working with numerous cross-functional teams.  Data-Driven: Experience using data to drive product prioritization, setting success metrics, and iterating based on results. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Prior experience in robotics or autonomous vehicles  Strong understanding of multi-sided marketplaces  Ability to iterate quickly, test hypotheses, be incorrect, and adapt based on results  A strong consumer intuition where your best guess proves to be correct much more often than not 

For New York, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD$190,000 per year - USD$211,000 per year. Working in Science at Uber means solving complex problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. You'll turn massive amounts of unstructured data into focused plans of execution, navigating ambiguity to build technologies that directly influence every decision made in our marketplace. This isn't just about building models; it's about making smart decisions with imperfect information and owning the outcomes in an environment where speed and scale can't be separated.

In this role, you'll be the bridge between technical depth and business impact, solving messy, high-priority problems that don't always have a textbook solution. You'll thrive here if you possess an owner's mindset, stay calm under pressure, and have the grit to drive projects through their entire lifecycle from idea inception to production. We're looking for someone who thinks critically and moves with urgency to shape the future of how people and things move in the real world.

rows.title: Product Marketing Manager, Consumer Growth Marketing
rows.descriptionText:
Summary

Yelp's mission is to connect people with great local businesses. As a trusted source of information on local business, millions of people turn to Yelp every day to make decisions about where to spend their money — from where to eat, shop or stay, to which home or local service provider to use, and beyond.

Yelp's Growth Marketing team is dedicated to driving user acquisition, activation, and long-term engagement across the full consumer lifecycle. As a Growth Marketing Manager, you will own the strategies and execution for consumer onboarding, retention and re-engagement, and acquisition across our Services and Restaurant, Food & Nightlife (RFN) verticals.

You will focus on building high-impact onboarding experiences for users acquired through owned and partner channels, developing reacquisition strategies to win back lapsed users, and driving Services acquisition through paid media channels. We are also looking for someone with strong content strategy skills to build engaging educational content that will fuel social, lifecycle, and AEO initiatives.

In this highly cross-functional role, you will partner closely with Marketing Operations, Growth Science, Creative Design, Marketing Technology, and Product teams to build and optimize lifecycle programs. You will be responsible for ensuring the right touchpoints are in place for the growing volume of users acquired through new channels.

We are looking for a data-driven strategist and hands-on executor who is passionate about understanding user behavior, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering measurable business impact through personalized, channel-optimized marketing.

Our team is passionate about data, experimentation, and the power of new technology, including AI, to drive innovation. We are especially interested in candidates who bring direct experience with lifecycle or growth marketing at scale, and who demonstrate curiosity and enthusiasm for leveraging AI and emerging technologies to advance marketing effectiveness.

We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes. This is a full-time remote role based in the United States.

What You'll Do

Design and optimize onboarding journeys to nurture new users, identifying user needs and improving early engagement to deepen retention.Build segmentation frameworks to identify at-risk and lapsed user cohorts, and design personalized reacquisition journeys based on prior behavior and vertical affinity.Lead content strategy for consumer campaigns and optimize content for AEO/GEO discoverability.Lead mid-funnel marketing to acquire new Services users through off-platform channels and drive qualified users deeper into the funnel.Lead targeted engagement strategies for Services and RFN users across core growth channels to increase retention and deepen engagement throughout the user journey.Lead the development, execution, and ongoing optimization of growth experiments using A/B testing, segmentation, and analytics.Measure campaign performance and iterate on strategies to improve efficiency.Partner with Marketing Technology and Operations teams to build new marketing capabilities, behavioral signals, and channel optimizations that drive engagement and revenue.Demonstrate strong organizational and interpersonal skills — set priorities, problem-solve, multitask, and work independently in a rapidly changing environment.Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance consumer insights, marketing strategies, and campaign effectiveness.

What It Takes To Succeed

5-8 years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, or related roles.Proven experience building and optimizing onboarding and lifecycle programs across owned channels (i.e., email, push, in-product).Direct experience developing winback or re-engagement strategies that drove measurable reactivation.Experience with content strategy, including integration of UGC content and content development for social, lifecycle, or SEO/AEO channels.Hands-on experience with marketing platforms to oversee campaign execution, develop audience segmentation, and ideate new behavioral signals.Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills. Must be comfortable analyzing campaign performance, extracting insights from data, and applying them to real-world execution and optimization.Experience working with paid acquisition or performance marketing teams is desirable.Demonstrated ability to manage performance monitoring across a large portfolio of campaigns, with a bias toward action and continuous optimization.Excellent organizational, project management, cross-functional collaboration, and prioritization skills in fast-paced, dynamic settings.Strong communication skills with the ability to summarize complex concepts to an executive audience.Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).Experience with, or strong enthusiasm for, applying AI solutions in growth marketing.

What You'll Get

Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holidayUp to 14 weeks of parental leaveMonthly wellness subsidyWork from home reimbursementFlexible spending account401(k) retirement savings planEmployee stock purchase planCompensation range for this position is $106,000- $198,000 annually. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Closing

At Yelp, we believe that diversity is an expression of all the unique characteristics that make us human: race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, and education — and those are just a few. We recognize that diverse backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our teams and our product. The foundation of our diversity efforts are closely tied to our core values, which include “Playing Well With Others” and “Authenticity.”

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition or disability.

Actual salary offered may vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to, an individual's location and experience. 

We will consider for employment qualified candidates with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable law (including, for example, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for roles based in San Francisco, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for roles based in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County, and the California Fair Chance Act for roles based in California).

Where required by law, a criminal background check will not be conducted until after a conditional offer of employment is made, and any evaluation of a candidate's criminal background check will be subject to an individualized assessment that takes into account the candidate's specific criminal records and the responsibilities and requirements of the particular role.

rows.title: 2027 Compliance Analyst Summer Internship Program New York

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Why the Compliance Summer Internship program? 

As one of the world’s largest and most respected full-service banks, Barclays has a huge responsibility, to millions of people, to do the right thing. That’s why the work we do in Compliance really matters. A broad-ranging, multi-disciplinary function, Compliance oversees the way Barclays does business. This means satisfying the ever-evolving demands of the banking regulators, as well as maintaining our own standards and codes of conduct and protecting our reputation in the world. Compliance is essential to every business, every function, every team and every location. rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

As a Product Manager on the Customer Obsession (CO) team, you will be responsible for improving the developer and user experience for Uber's AI-powered conversational support surfaces. This role bridges the gap between the underlying tech and intuitive user design. You will be responsible for the UX and the foundational platform capabilities that power these interactions. A key part of your mission will be democratizing innovation: you'll build the infrastructure and governance that allows cross-functional teams across Uber to contribute to a shared UX library, ensuring our next-generation AI assistants remain cohesive yet adaptable across different business units. You will leverage modern technologies (including AI/machine learning and conversational interfaces) and strong design partnerships to help scale high-quality support experiences across Uber.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Product thinking: Contribute to the roadmap and execution of the conversational UX component library. Make tradeoff decisions with guidance, balancing user needs, technical constraints, and business impact  Champion the customer experience: Champion the end-user by blending design thinking, user research, and data into compelling 'user impact' stories.  Execution & ownership: Build the tech and persona-agnostic UX foundations required for a best-in-class experience. Partner with UXR to get quick feedback, Design for interface crafting, and Engineering to ship the underlying platform logic.  Drive developer adoption: Own the Developer Experience for our agentic UX library. You'll ensure frictionless discovery, previewing, and debugging, while building the "code agents" and tools that make it easy for teams to adopt and contribute.  Data-driven impact: Partner with Data Science to track user behavior changes following UX updates. Use these insights to drive prioritization and secure stakeholder buy-in by 'closing the loop' on performance.  Executive communication: Present clear and compelling progress updates to senior leadership, aligning stakeholders and securing support. 

Basic Qualifications

 Experience: Bechelors degree in Computer Science or similar AND 3+ years of product management experience (including high-impact internships). You have a foundational understanding of the product lifecycle and have successfully contributed to shipping digital features or products.  UX affinity & design partnership: A strong "product sense" with a deep appreciation for user experience. You are eager to partner closely with Design and User research to translate complex AI behaviors into intuitive, human-centric interactions.  Technical literacy: Comfortable navigating the technical side of AI and LLMs. You understand how conversational agents work and care about the Developer Experience - ensuring the tools and libraries you build are easy for other engineers to adopt. We don't expect you to code, but you should feel comfortable discussing deep technical topics with engineering teams and the platform users.  Collaborative execution: Proven ability to work in the trenches with cross-functional teams. You are organized, detail-oriented, and capable of driving projects forward in a fast-paced environment.  Communication & storytelling: Ability to clearly articulate the "why" behind a feature. You can translate user pain points into technical requirements and communicate progress effectively to both technical and non-technical teammates. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience working on mobile experiences and consumer products.  Phenomenal track record of working with engineering, analytics and design teams, with proven examples to prioritize work across the team.  Grittiness: you never hesitate to roll up your sleeves and tackle something hands-on.  Proven track record of growing and scaling a product.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

Working in Science at Uber means solving complex marketplace problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. You will be joining the Rider Pricing and Incentives Science team, which owns our automated real-time pricing systems. You'll turn massive amounts of unstructured marketplace data into focused algorithmic strategies, navigating ambiguity to build technologies that directly influence every ride decision made across our global mobility marketplace.

In this role, you'll serve as the vital bridge between technical depth and real-world business impact. We are looking for experienced candidates with strong quantitative expertise across data science, operations research, statistics, and economics. You will thrive here if you possess an owner's mindset, combine algorithmic rigour with practical execution, and excel at driving complex initiatives through close cross-functional collaboration with product and engineering partners.

What You'll Do

 Build, scale, and optimize statistical, mathematical programming, and ML models for dynamic pricing applications.  Generate data insights to identify opportunities to enhance algorithm performance.  Develop novel experimentation and causal inference methodologies tailored to complex, highly interconnected marketplace settings.  Collaborate deeply across disciplines with Product, Engineering, and Operations to identify growth opportunities, align on key success metrics, and drive systems end-to-end from ideation to production.  Translate granular marketplace data and complex optimization results into clear, actionable business strategies for leadership.  Unblock technical and operational barriers by designing robust diagnostic tools, logging infrastructure, and marketplace metrics. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 Ph.D., M.S., or Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or equivalent quantitative field.  5+ years of professional industry experience as an Applied Scientist, Data Scientist, Economist, or equivalent (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).  Strong foundation in at least one key domain: control theory, mathematical optimization, statistical inference, machine learning, econometrics.  Proficiency in Python/R and SQL for large-scale data analysis and algorithmic prototyping.  Experience in designing, analyzing, and interpreting complex experiments across key marketplace performance indicators. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 6+ years of industry experience applying data science, optimization, or economics in dynamic marketplace or pricing environments.  Demonstrated success partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations partners to deploy algorithms into production.  Hands-on experience building large-scale pricing, auction, advertising, or supply-demand matching algorithms.  Proven track record of navigating ambiguity and communicating technical concepts clearly to non-technical business partners.

About The Role

The Uber Global Relocation & Immigration team is looking for a Manager to own the U.S. Immigration program from strategy through execution. In this role, you will define the strategic direction, governance framework, and long-term roadmap for Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.

The U.S. immigration program is a critical enabler of Uber's talent strategy, supporting the hiring, retention, and mobility of foreign national employees while ensuring compliance with evolving U.S. immigration regulations.

The U.S. Immigration Manager will report directly to the Head of Global Relocation & Immigration and sit on the GRI leadership team. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, business leaders, immigration counsel, and external service providers to ensure Uber's immigration program effectively supports business objectives while delivering an exceptional stakeholder experience.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Own the strategy, governance, and execution of Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.  Lead end-to-end U.S. immigration programs, including H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, L-1, O-1, F-1 OPT/STEM OPT, E-2, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Adjustment of Status, Consular Processing, and ongoing work authorization compliance requirements.  Serve as the primary strategic partner to Talent Acquisition, Legal, HR, and business leaders on immigration solutions, workforce planning, talent retention, and organizational growth.  Define and drive the U.S. immigration strategy, policies, governance frameworks, and program roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve scalability, compliance, stakeholder experience, efficiency, and business outcomes.  Own immigration vendor governance, including strategic relationship management, performance accountability, compliance oversight, commercial stewardship, and executive business reviews.  Own governance of U.S. immigration escalations, providing senior decision-making for high-risk, high-visibility, and complex immigration matters, while leveraging escalation trends and root cause insights to drive continuous program improvement.  Monitor regulatory developments and emerging immigration trends, assessing business impact and proactively advising stakeholders on readiness and risk mitigation strategies.  Define immigration program success metrics, compliance outcomes, vendor governance expectations, and strategic KPIs, using data and insights to drive continuous improvement and measurable business impact.  Leverage technology, automation, AI, and analytics to drive strategic improvements, optimize program performance, and shape the future-state immigration technology roadmap in partnership with the GRI Experience Program Manager.  Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance immigration programs and deliver measurable business impact across the employee lifecycle.  Prepare and deliver strategic recommendations, program insights, and performance updates to senior leadership.  Own the U.S. immigration budget, including forecasting, financial planning, vendor spend management, and budget-to-actual reviews.  Build and maintain strong partnerships with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, and business leaders, influencing decisions and positioning immigration as a strategic enabler of Uber's talent objectives.  Lead, coach, and develop the U.S. Immigration Specialist (L4), providing strategic direction, prioritization, performance management, and career development. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of U.S. business immigration experience, demonstrating deep expertise in employment-based immigration laws, regulations, and compliance requirements.  5+ program management experience, with the ability to lead complex initiatives from strategy through execution.  5+ years operating in complex, matrixed organizations, partnering with Senior level stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives.  5+ years of experience managing and developing high-performing team members. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities, with a track record of developing scalable programs and delivering measurable business impact.  Experience managing external immigration vendors, including governance, performance management, commercial oversight, vendor selection, and contract management.  Strong analytical skills, with experience leveraging data, technology, and automation to improve program effectiveness and stakeholder experience.  Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions at all levels of the organization. About The Role

Uber is seeking a highly strategic and technically sophisticated Senior Performance Marketing Manager to lead our Earner team within the Paid Search organization, who can lead a team of highly talented individuals and run initiatives across global markets. This role will be responsible for driving growth through advanced bidding strategies, large-scale experimentation, and continuous optimization across search platforms, while further developing and mentoring the team.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in paid search with strong analytical rigor, operational excellence, and a proven ability to independently lead complex projects in a fast-paced environment. This individual should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing multiple priorities simultaneously, and partnering cross-functionally to unlock incremental growth.

Responsibilities

 Own and scale Earner programs across major paid search platforms (SEM, UAC, DemandGen), driving earner acquisition and business growth.  Lead and develop a team of currently three channel managers.  Be forward thinking and set and execute the overall Earner strategy going forward.  Design, execute, and analyze large-scale bidding experiments to improve efficiency, volume, and overall campaign performance.  Develop advanced bidding frameworks that extend beyond platform-native automation and Smart Bidding capabilities.  Lead rigorous testing programs across ad creatives, messaging, landing pages, and conversion funnels to drive incremental performance improvements.  Build measurement frameworks and experimentation roadmaps to evaluate marketing effectiveness and business impact.  Manage multiple high-impact initiatives simultaneously while adapting to changing business priorities.  Independently identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and execute projects with minimal oversight.  Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, and Creative teams to develop scalable growth solutions.  Leverage AI and automation technologies to improve campaign management workflows, reporting, optimization, and operational efficiency.  Translate complex performance data into actionable business recommendations for senior stakeholders. 

Basic Requirements

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Economics, Statistics, Business, Engineering, or a related field.  Deep understanding of advanced bidding methodologies.  Strong knowledge of incrementality testing, experiment design, statistical significance, and performance measurement.  Extensive experience running creative, messaging, landing page, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) testing programs at scale.  7+ years of experience managing large-scale performance marketing channel programs for high-growth consumer or technology businesses.  Demonstrated expertise in paid search strategy, campaign management, and performance optimization.  Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience interpreting large datasets and experimentation results.  Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Hands-on experience building AI-powered tools, workflow automations, or machine learning-driven solutions to improve marketing operations and performance.  Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and executive audiences.

rows.title: Sr Scientist, Tech - Science
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role And Team

Working in Science at Uber means solving complex marketplace problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. You will be joining the Rider Pricing and Incentives Science team, which owns our automated real-time pricing systems. You'll turn massive amounts of unstructured marketplace data into focused algorithmic strategies, navigating ambiguity to build technologies that directly influence every ride decision made across our global mobility marketplace.

In this role, you'll serve as the vital bridge between technical depth and real-world business impact. We are looking for experienced candidates with strong quantitative expertise across data science, operations research, statistics, and economics. You will thrive here if you possess an owner's mindset, combine algorithmic rigour with practical execution, and excel at driving complex initiatives through close cross-functional collaboration with product and engineering partners.

What You'll Do

 Build, scale, and optimize statistical, mathematical programming, and ML models for dynamic pricing applications.  Generate data insights to identify opportunities to enhance algorithm performance.  Develop novel experimentation and causal inference methodologies tailored to complex, highly interconnected marketplace settings.  Collaborate deeply across disciplines with Product, Engineering, and Operations to identify growth opportunities, align on key success metrics, and drive systems end-to-end from ideation to production.  Translate granular marketplace data and complex optimization results into clear, actionable business strategies for leadership.  Unblock technical and operational barriers by designing robust diagnostic tools, logging infrastructure, and marketplace metrics. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 Ph.D., M.S., or Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or equivalent quantitative field.  5+ years of professional industry experience as an Applied Scientist, Data Scientist, Economist, or equivalent (or 3+ years with a Ph.D.).  Strong foundation in at least one key domain: control theory, mathematical optimization, statistical inference, machine learning, econometrics.  Proficiency in Python/R and SQL for large-scale data analysis and algorithmic prototyping.  Experience in designing, analyzing, and interpreting complex experiments across key marketplace performance indicators. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 6+ years of industry experience applying data science, optimization, or economics in dynamic marketplace or pricing environments.  Demonstrated success partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations partners to deploy algorithms into production.  Hands-on experience building large-scale pricing, auction, advertising, or supply-demand matching algorithms.  Proven track record of navigating ambiguity and communicating technical concepts clearly to non-technical business partners.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Delivery Manager – VP. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. In this role, you will join the Barclays Digital Platform (XDP) team as we embark on a transformative journey to build a unified digital platform for the bank. This platform will deliver a modern, innovative, and AI-powered experience across Barclays’ digital channels, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to redefine how customers interact with our services. As part of the Infrastructure and AI team, you will play a key role in designing, delivering, and evolving the foundational infrastructure that powers the platform, while enabling AI-driven capabilities that create new and enhanced customer journeys. You will collaborate with teams across Barclays Technology to drive the successful delivery of strategic programs, business outcomes, and critical platform capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to apply and expand your expertise in large-scale infrastructure, platform engineering, and emerging AI technologies within a highly collaborative environment.

To be successful as a Senior Delivery Manager - VP, you should have:


Proven experience leading and delivering large-scale, enterprise-wide infrastructure programs that require coordination and alignment across multiple teams and stakeholdersAmple proficiency with Jira, including advanced planning and portfolio management capabilities such as Advanced Roadmaps, for effective cross-team work tracking and delivery managementSolid experience working within Agile/Scrum environments, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, execution, and stakeholder communicationExperience leveraging AI tools and prompt engineering techniques to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and improve delivery outcomes, including tools such as Microsoft CopilotConsiderable understanding of public cloud platforms and infrastructure services, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with experience supporting cloud-based solutions and enterprise environments

Demonstrated hands-on experience implementing and managing Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and similar automation frameworksGood understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices, with experience integrating security, automation, and quality controls throughout the software delivery lifecycleProficiency in business intelligence and data visualization tools, including Tableau, with the ability to develop automated dashboards and reporting solutions that support data-driven decision-makingExcellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to engage, influence, and effectively communicate complex technical concepts to senior leaders, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in our Whippany, NJ office.

rows.title: 2027 Internal Audit Analyst Summer Internship Program Whippany
rows.descriptionText:
Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Why the Internal Audit Internship program? 

Barclays Internal Audit (BIA) plays a key role in our business worldwide. Independent assurance and insightful challenge are at the heart of what we do, helping to protect Barclays' assets, reputation, and sustainability, while supporting the management of current and emerging risks in an increasingly digital, technology-driven world.

We're an independent control function that provides objective, reliable, and insightful assurance to the Board and Executive Management. Known as the "third line of defence", we work closely with the business to help strengthen governance, risk management, and controls. We do this by regularly reviewing and assessing business areas across the bank, evaluating how effectively risks are managed and whether controls are operating as intended. We then report our findings and work with stakeholders to help drive meaningful improvements and ensure issues are resolved effectively.

Barclays Internal Audit is a leader in Data Analytics and other specialist areas, using innovative approaches and technology to enhance the way we provide assurance. We've built a strong reputation in the financial services industry for our expertise, fresh thinking, and forward-looking approach.

This is your chance to work in an area that has a real impact across the bank, gain unique insight into how Barclays operates, and work alongside experts who will help you build the skills, knowledge, and experience needed for a successful career.

To be eligible for this opportunity, you must be graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 and have a GPA of 3.2 or above. While a STEM degree (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) can be a great fit for the analytical nature of Internal Audit, it’s not essential. We value diverse perspectives and encourage students from any field of study to apply.

Ideally, you’ll also be naturally analytical, eager to learn, and ready to take on new challenges. You know how to manage your time, build strong relationships, and thrive in a team.

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate program, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

Barclays will not offer or consider offering sponsorship for work visas or offer any employment-based immigration sponsorship for individuals, now or in the future, unless such individuals are enrolled in or graduate with a degree in a field of study that the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Education consider to be a science, technology, engineering or mathematics (STEM) field of study for purposes of the 24-month STEM OPT extension. This includes for any internship, post-graduation program, or permanent employment, now or in the future.

Working in Whippany

Our next-gen workplace in Whippany is where passionate, down-to-earth colleagues connect daily. With modern workspaces, cafés, pool tables, and a gym, it’s a place that feels like home.

Off campus, you’re minutes from historic Morristown and just a short trip to the buzz of Manhattan—Whippany offers the best of both worlds.

rows.title: Commercial Program Manager - Grocery & Retail

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

Grocery and Retail is a startup within Uber, focused on building the future of on-demand commerce. We power delivery across groceries, alcohol, convenience, pet, pharmacy, retail, and more-combining the speed and innovation of a startup with the scale of Uber's global platform.

Our commercial organization supports a diverse portfolio of merchants, ranging from strategic Enterprise partners to thousands of small and medium-sized businesses. Successfully serving both requires a combination of high-touch relationship management and scalable commercial programs.

We're looking for a Commercial Program Manager who will directly own a portfolio of Enterprise merchant relationships while also leading programs that improve how we support, engage, and grow our long-tail SMB business.

About The Role

As a Commercial Program Manager, you will operate across two critical areas of our commercial organization: Enterprise Account Management and SMB Program Management.

You will directly manage a select portfolio of Enterprise merchants, owning the commercial relationship, business performance, and long-term growth strategy for those partners. You'll develop joint business plans, identify growth opportunities, lead business reviews, navigate operational challenges, and work cross-functionally to strengthen each partnership.

At the same time, you will lead programs designed to improve how Uber manages thousands of SMB merchants at scale. Rather than directly managing the SMB long tail, you'll build and optimize the programs, processes, segmentation strategies, reporting, automation, and commercial playbooks that enable Account Managers and Account Coordinators to effectively manage large books of business.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong commercial and relationship-management skills with structured program management, analytical thinking, and operational problem solving. Success requires the ability to move seamlessly between strategic merchant conversations and building scalable solutions for a complex commercial organization.

What You'll Do

 Enterprise Account Management & Growth - 30% 

 Own a select portfolio of Enterprise merchant partners, serving as the primary commercial point of contact and trusted advisor.  Develop joint business plans focused on growing sales, improving operational performance, and strengthening long-term partnerships.  Identify and execute growth opportunities across promotions, advertising, merchandising, product adoption, and other commercial levers.  Lead regular business reviews using performance data and marketplace insights to identify opportunities and establish clear action plans.  Lead commercial conversations and negotiations while balancing merchant objectives with Uber's broader business priorities.  Partner cross-functionally across Operations, Product, Marketing, Sales, and other teams to resolve merchant challenges and unlock growth. 

 SMB Program Management & Commercial Strategy - 45% 

 Own programs that improve how Uber supports, engages, and grows thousands of long-tail SMB merchants.  Lead commercial initiatives from strategy through execution, defining objectives, workstreams, stakeholders, timelines, and success metrics.  Develop merchant segmentation and prioritization strategies that help commercial teams focus resources on the highest-impact opportunities.  Build programs across merchant growth, lifecycle management, demand generation, operational performance, inventory and catalog health, and merchant engagement.  Develop scalable engagement strategies that enable Account Managers and Account Coordinators to effectively manage large books of business.  Partner cross-functionally across Operations, Product, Strategy, Marketing, Sales, and Analytics to launch and scale SMB initiatives. 

 Process Improvement, Automation & Enablement - 15% 

 Identify recurring operational challenges across the SMB long tail and develop scalable solutions that improve commercial execution.  Standardize workflows, playbooks, and operating processes across large merchant portfolios.  Identify opportunities to automate repetitive or manual work and improve Account Manager and Account Coordinator productivity.  Build tools, playbooks, and resources that enable commercial teams to spend more time on high-value merchant engagement and growth.  Partner with Product and Engineering to advocate for tooling and product enhancements that improve scaled merchant management. 

 Data, Reporting & Commercial Insights - 10% 

 Use merchant and marketplace data to identify trends, segment opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and inform commercial strategy.  Develop reporting that provides visibility into merchant health, engagement, growth, and operational performance.  Establish success metrics for SMB programs and measure their impact on merchant and business outcomes.  Translate insights from Enterprise account management and SMB performance into clear recommendations for commercial leadership. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 4+ years of experience in Account Management, Partner Management, Sales, Commercial Operations, Program Management, or a related commercial role.  4+ years of direct client-facing experience managing merchant, customer, or partner relationships , with demonstrated ability to build relationships, identify growth opportunities, and navigate complex commercial conversations. rows.title: Senior Manager, Launch Excellence

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

At Uber, great products are only as good as the experiences they create - and customer experience doesn't begin when a ticket arrives. It begins the moment a new feature or product launch decision is made.

Ensuring that customer experience is at the forefront of the design and build of every new product feature, enhancement, or net new launch means we must influence product design upstream - before painful experiences occur or support issues arrive at our doorstep.

This is the foundational belief behind this role. The Senior Manager, CX Launch Excellence - Mobility, will be the single point of contact responsible for defining the governance model and best practices to enable the right PoCs from CommOps to be embedded as a strategic partner across the Product Development Lifecycle. From PRD through go-to-market to hypercare, this person ensures that a consistent process is followed for every product, feature, and operational change so that the change and/or rollout ships with a customer experience that is excellent from day one - at every maturity level.

This is not a reactive support role. The primary accountability for this role is launch governance and CX readiness standards - defining the frameworks, gates, and operating model that determine how customer experience teams engage in the product development process.

What You'll Own

 Build the Definitive Playbook for CX Participation in the Product Development Lifecycle: Define and own the end-to-end standard for how Community Operations engages across every stage of product development - from PRD through product development checkpoint reviews to launch and hypercare for Mobility. 

Design a tiered engagement model that distinguishes the right level of CX involvement based on product portfolio type: core product lines, growth initiatives, or emerging bets. Every product that ships a customer experience must meet the bar - and this role sets that bar.

Build and maintain the master playbook covering intake criteria, readiness gates, go/no-go frameworks, escalation triggers, and accountability structures. So there is never ambiguity about where CX stands in the process. Establish clear principles: CX is not a reviewer at the end of the pipeline but a co-designer from the beginning.

 Own and Govern the Intake Process - The "Front Door" for Cross functional partners : Design and operate the intake and triage system that captures all customer-impacting changes across Mobility - product launches, feature iterations, quality testing, platform rollouts. Define the criteria and guardrails that determine which changes require full CX readiness reviews, which require lightweight checkpoints, and who is accountable for driving each gate. Create the organizational mechanisms - forums, decision rights, SLAs, tooling - that ensure every change traverses a standard readiness process with full visibility, no matter how fast the business moves. This person is the single point of accountability for XFN partners (including Product) knowing exactly when to loop in CX and what to expect when they do.  Embed CX as a Strategic Partner in Every Launch: Act as the primary counterpart for Mobility Customer Experience, Product Insights & Rollout, Product Ops, and Customer Obsession teams as they seek to not only review launches, but to shape them. Establish clear engagement rules, decision paths, and escalation protocols so upstream teams know exactly how and when to plug in CX - making the partnership predictable, high-trust, and efficient. Build relationships with product/product ops teams to drive this forward.  Define and Drive Support Readiness Standards Across the Portfolio: Translate every upstream product, ops, and policy change into concrete CX readiness requirements: content, macros, workflows, training, tooling, escalation paths - with clear owners and delivery timelines. Track and ensure CX feedback has been formally acknowledged and resolved before launch gates are cleared. Hold go/no-go authority at defined readiness gates with clear escalation paths to senior leadership when standards are not met, ensuring CX readiness is never treated as optional, including structured pre-launch testing protocols that validate support readiness before go-live.  Partner with Analytics and S&P: Work with the Analytics and Insights team to build dashboards and alerting that make launch health and readiness gaps visible to leadership - and actionable before they become incidents. Advocate for customer experience metrics to be embedded in product launch success criteria from the outset. Use data, agent feedback, and customer signals to systematically identify structural upstream causes of defects - and drive resolution through product and policy, not just support responses.  Lead Through Influence and Build Organizational Capability: Operate as a senior leader who drives clarity, builds structure, and governance standards across Product, CX, Product Insights & Rollout/Product ops - primarily without direct authority. Build and govern a networked model of CX readiness owners across personas; set the standards and ways of working while enabling execution. Scale "launch excellence" as an organizational capability - not just a team function - by embedding frameworks, tools, and habits across Community Operations. 

Why This Role Matters

Every product in Uber's Mobility portfolio ships a customer experience. And right now, CX is too often looped in too late - after the design is locked, the product development checkpoint reviews process is well underway, and the support readiness is not embedded into the design. This role changes that permanently.

The person who fills this seat will build the infrastructure - the playbook, the intake process, the governance model, the standards - that ensures CX is never an afterthought. They will be the reason Mobility launches are smoother, right CX inputs are shared during design and build so features are desgined to be defect free, and customers feel the quality of what we build from day one.

Basic Qualifications

 Minimum 6 years of experience in technical program management, product ops, product management, strategy & operations, or similar roles  Bachelors Degree 

Preferred Qualifications

 10+ years of experience in technical program management, product operations, or strategy & operations, specifically within customer support or service operations supporting platforms with >10M active users.  Track record of building and deploying at least 2 end-to-end launch governance frameworks or operational playbooks from 0-to-1 (initial build through full operational rollout).  Prior experience at a consumer technology, mobility, marketplace, travel, or e-commerce company with >$500M in annual revenue or equivalent operational scale.  Governance, Launch Gates & Cross-Functional Operations  Demonstrated management of go/no-go launch gate decisions across 10+ major product feature rollouts.  Experience engaging upstream during the Product Requirement Document (PRD) or initial design phase for at least 50% of managed product launches.  Proven track record of leading cross-functional alignment across 5+ distinct stakeholder departments (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Operations, and Product Ops) without direct report authority.  Experience authoring metric frameworks and partnering with analytics teams to build executive-facing dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, SQL-based tools) for tracking launch health KPIs.  Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience configuring, deploying, or managing content governance for AI-powered support tooling (e.g., LLM virtual assistants, intelligent routing, or agent-assist systems).  Experience reviewing technical design documents, system flowcharts, and architecture specs with Engineering and ML/AI teams to extract support readiness requirements.  Experience writing executive-level decision memos, QBRs, or go/no-go scorecards presented directly to VP-level leadership

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. Marketing Studio Intelligence is building the intelligence layer behind HubSpot’s next-generation marketing platform. We bring together campaign performance, marketing assets, CRM data, and AI to help marketers understand what’s working, uncover opportunities, and discover what to do next.

This is a deeply customer-focused space, where we work closely with marketers to understand real problems and turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into simple, trustworthy experiences that deliver meaningful value.

As a Staff Technical Lead, you’ll lead a small team of 2 - 3 engineers while staying deeply hands-on. You’ll partner closely with Product and UX to shape and build AI systems at scale, tackling ambitious problems across agentic systems, intelligent decisioning, AI quality, and evaluation.

What You’ll Do

Lead a small team of 2 engineers, setting technical direction and helping the team deliver against shared product and engineering goals.Design, build, and evolve backend services that power campaign integrations, measurement, automation, and intelligent capabilities across Marketing Studio.Stay hands on with development, contributing production quality Java code and working directly on the team’s most important technical challenges.Lead technical design for integrations between Marketing Studio, HubSpot campaign systems, marketing assets, CRM data, and other platform capabilities.Build scalable systems that support campaign performance reporting, attribution, analytics, and intelligent recommendations.Help shape backend capabilities for AI powered experiences that use campaign context, CRM data, and engagement history to generate insights and recommendations.Break complex initiatives into clear technical plans and help engineers navigate architecture decisions, dependencies, tradeoffs, and delivery risks.Coach and mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, feedback, and day to day technical guidance.Partner with Product and UX to shape priorities and translate customer problems into technical approaches that balance speed, quality, and long term system health.Drive alignment across engineering teams when work spans shared services, campaign infrastructure, data systems, integrations, or Studio platform capabilities.

What You’ll Bring

Significant experience designing, building, and operating backend software systems in production environments.Strong Java development skills and experience building production grade backend services, as well as Kafka, MySQL or comparable backend technologies. Experience technically leading a small engineering team while remaining an active contributor to the codebase.Experience coaching and mentoring engineers and helping others grow their technical skills and ownership.Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, performance, fault tolerance, testing, and observability.Experience designing and delivering AI-powered products, agentic workflows, AI agents, recommendation systems, decisioning systems, personalization, or next-best-action experiences.Experience building the backend orchestration, services, APIs, and feedback loops that connect AI or ML models to real customer actions and outcomes.Experience working with complex, high-volume data and ensuring AI outputs are relevant, explainable, trustworthy, and useful to customers.Experience defining evaluation, monitoring, and learning mechanisms to assess the quality and impact of AI-generated recommendations or insights.Ability to partner effectively with ML and data science teams to integrate and productionize models, without necessarily owning model training or core ML infrastructure.Strong product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to identify which insights will create genuine value and how they should be presented to customers.Ability to communicate complex AI concepts clearly and influence Product, Engineering, UX, Design, and business stakeholders.

Nice To Have Qualifications

Direct experience with recommendation systems, decisioning, personalization, ranking, experimentation, or next-best-action products.Experience integrating CRM, marketing, campaign, advertising, or customer data across multiple systems.Experience in marketing technology or other domains where products help customers make data-informed decisions.Experience with Python or another transferable backend language in addition to, or instead of, Java. Check out our engineering blog to learn more.

Direct marketing or recommendation-system experience is a plus, but not required. We also welcome candidates with transferable experience building customer-facing AI products in areas such as customer support, prospecting, content, advertising, or other decision-support domains.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

rows.title: Mgr, Pricing & Assortment, Trading Cards

parsed.text: Salt Lake City, UT, United States

rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team

eBay is the leading Collectibles marketplace worldwide, catering to millions of customers across the globe. Our mission is to be the most trusted and beloved destination for collectors of trading cards, memorabilia, comics, and more.

The Trading Cards team ranks as one of the quickest growing segments at eBay. We seek a business leader to lead monetization, pricing, and assortment approaches to boost GMV growth and grow marketshare. The role aims to build buyer and seller ust and keep our selection appealing to collectors worldwide. This position offers high visibility and requires close cooperation with senior leaders in Collectibles and frequent contact with GM-level executives.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Manager, Pricing & Assortment Strategy to identify, prioritize, and complete growth levers across pricing, assortment mix, and monetization opportunities. This role blends critical thinking with hands-on analysis and requires strong cross-functional collaboration with Product, Analytics, Marketing, Monetization, Finance, and Category Management teams. You will regularly present findings and recommendations to Collectibles executives, including the GM, and ensure their work directly informs high-impact business decisions.

Responsibilities

Pricing Strategy: Develop and implement scalable frameworks and pricing strategies that improve revenue while maintaining marketplace competitiveness and appeal to sellers.Assortment Strategy: Develop strategies to attract seller supply, identify whitespace opportunities, and improve selection breadth, depth, and quality.Pricing Insights: Lead pricing analyses and test-and-learn initiatives to assess price elasticity, promotional efficiency, and marketplace competitiveness.Competitive Research: Monitor competitive and industry trends across trading cards and adjacent marketplaces, assessing pricing, differentiated services, and customer experience to find opportunities and inform recommendations.Identify Growth Opportunites: Discover and quantify GMV and revenue opportunities throughout the trading cards ecosystem, presenting clear and actionable suggestions for leadership.Executive Engagement: Partner directly with Collectibles leadership, preparing and delivering executive-ready presentations that drive alignment on strategy and priorities.Business Reporting: Collaborate with Analytics to build and improve dashboards, reports, and benchmark frameworks that track critical levers and inform business decisions.Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Analytics, Marketing, Product, Finance, Monetization, and Operations to drive high-impact initiatives.


Qualifications

Required:

8+ years of experience in strategy, category management, pricing, or business operations, with experience in ecommerce, retail, or consumer tech preferred.Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to ask the right business questions and translate complex data into actionable insights.Advanced skills in Excel or Google Sheets, shown by working with complex datasets and collaborating with Analytics/Data Science teams to develop and refine sophisticated models.Proven track record in pricing strategy, monetization, or revenue optimization.Demonstrated ability to build and deliver executive-level presentations and influence senior collaborators.Demonstrated ability to leverage LLMs and AI tools for deep research, modeling and analysis, and developing business proposals and recommendations.Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.BA/BS degree or equivalent.


Preferred

Experience in marketplaces, collectibles, or interest-based categories.Experience using SQL, Python, or other programming languages to analyze data, generate insights, and support business decision-making.Familiarity with assortment strategy, pricing elasticity modeling, and benchmark optimization.MBA or advanced degree.


The Impact You Will Make

By becoming a member of the Trading Cards team, you will:

Build pricing and assortment strategy for one of the most exciting and high-growth categories at eBay.Develop strategies and drive work that brings joy to collectors and enthusiasts around the world, helping them discover, buy, and sell the items they love.Act as a trusted partner to Trading Card leaders and other senior leaders, ensuring that your insights and recommendations inform category-wide strategy.Present your work at the executive level, seeing across the business and influencing strategic priorities.Help eBay stay the leading destination for collectors, while ensuring we provide a balanced, trusted, and profitable ecosystem!


Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$103,600 - $177,800

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

rows.title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
rows.descriptionText:
Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,000+ employees and 24,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Chief of Staff role

We are seeking a high-performing individual to serve as Chief of Staff to our CEO, Reggie Aggarwal. This individual will work closely with our CEO and executive team to help drive business priorities, improve cross-functional alignment, and shape Cvent’s strategic direction. This is a highly visible and impactful role requiring exceptional data and analytical acumen, strategic problem-solving capabilities, and interpersonal intelligence. You’ll operate as a trusted partner and force multiplier to the CEO —bringing clarity to complexity, coordinating high-stakes initiatives, and enabling efficient decision-making at the highest level.

This role is not just about supporting the CEO—it’s about accelerating the impact of Cvent’s leadership, driving clarity through complexity, and being a central architect of strategic execution. If you're energized by high-stakes decision-making, thrive on both data and relationships, have the ability to prioritize and follow through on requests, this is your opportunity to operate at the heart of a company that is shaping the future of meetings and events.

Strategic Execution & Decision Support

Serve as a high impact thought partner to the CEO, helping translate vision into operational plans and tangible outcomes.Leverage data and market intelligence to drive executive insights and scenario analysis; prepare reports, dashboards, and decision-making frameworks.Manage key strategic initiatives from ideation through execution—ensuring alignment, momentum, and accountability.

Organizational Effectiveness

Optimize internal operating rhythms: manage the corporate calendar of strategic planning cycles, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and executive offsite meetings.Improve interdepartmental communication and eliminate organizational silos by acting as a conduit between senior leadership and broader teams.Drive continuous improvement in internal processes that enable speed, clarity, and collaboration across the enterpriseDrive cross-functional alignment of key strategic initiatives across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and G&A functions.Own delivery of special projects and strategic initiatives (e.g., M&A integration, organizational redesign, GTM transformation).Serve as a liaison with Blackstone and manage requests and inquiries while working with the Senior Management team where appropriate. Enhance operational efficiency through integration of people, process, technology and AI-driven strategies promoting efficiency, improve decision-making speed, and empower teams to focus on higher-value work while maintaining engagement and motivation.

Leadership Enablement

Anticipate the CEO’s needs and proactively provide information, perspective, and structure that enhances leadership effectiveness.Represent the CEO in internal and external meetings as needed; synthesize key takeaways and ensure follow-through on action items.Maintain oversight of key programs, special projects, and strategic partnerships on behalf of the CEO.

People, Culture & Influence

Monitor organizational health and team morale; be a trusted confidant on culture, employee experience, and team dynamics.Develop deep working relationships across all levels and functions to gather insights and build consensus on complex issues.Lead initiatives that foster executive team alignment, leadership development, and culture-building.Bachelor’s degree in business, economics or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.10+ years of progressive external experience in strategy, consulting, business operations, or high-growth environments; direct experience supporting a founder or CEO is highly desirable.Demonstrated fluency with data analytics, KPI development, business acumen, and financial modeling to support executive decisions.Proven ability to manage ambiguity, adapt quickly, and lead cross-functional projects with minimal oversight.Outstanding communication, influencing, and interpersonal skills; able to command executive presence and manage sensitive topics with discretion.Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills—exceptional attention to detail without losing the big picture.A natural systems thinker and creative problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

rows.title: Affiliate Marketing Manager (contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

US based remote role***

Job Summary

Hilton has an exciting opportunity for an experienced performance marketing professional to join the Americas Media Activation – Acquisition team. This hybrid role combines performance marketing strategy, partner management, and operational execution to support the planning, execution, and optimization of the Affiliate channel across brands and markets. Working cross-functionally with Planning, Regional Marketing, Content, Analytics, and external partners, this individual will help manage day-to-day affiliate operations, publisher relationships, and performance reporting while supporting broader customer acquisition and revenue objectives. This is a highly hands-on role requiring strong project management, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment with limited oversight.

Responsibilities

 Drive day-to-day execution and optimization of affiliate programs to support customer acquisition, revenue, and ROI objectives Manage relationships with affiliate networks, key publisher partners, and technology providers Oversee campaign setup, tracking, testing, and optimization across affiliate platforms, ensuring accuracy and compliance with brand guidelines Collaborate cross-functionally to support affiliate initiatives from end-to-end, including promotions, content partnerships, and brand launches Analyze performance data to evaluate publisher effectiveness, commission structures, and promotional impact, translating insights into actionable recommendations Maintain campaign timelines, promotional calendars, budgets, and performance trackers to ensure on-time delivery and financial accuracy Communicate ongoing performance, risks, opportunities, and recommendations to leadership and key stakeholders Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scale the channel, and test new affiliate models or partnerships Ensure compliance with contractual terms, regional regulations, and internal policies across affiliate activity Support post-campaign and quarterly reviews, applying learnings to future optimization efforts Own and maintain detailed project plans, promotional calendars, partner trackers, and operational documentation to ensure seamless execution across multiple initiatives Manage and grow relationships with editorial content partners, commerce publishers, creators, and affiliate-focused influencers to drive incremental customer acquisition and revenue Identify, evaluate, and scale content commerce and creator-led affiliate opportunities, developing activation plans that align with brand, audience, and commercial objectives Partner with Content, Influencer, Social, and Brand teams to support affiliate-enabled content strategies and creator monetization initiatives

Skills

 Strong understanding of affiliate marketing, performance media, and publisher-based acquisition models Strong understanding of content commerce, editorial publisher monetization models, and affiliate creator ecosystems Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with internal teams and external partners Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity, solve problems proactively, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret performance data and recommend optimizations Strong attention to detail, particularly related to tracking, reporting, and financial management Experience working with affiliate networks and platforms such as CJ, Impact, Rakuten, or similar Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience creating performance reports, tracking documents, and data-driven business recommendations required Experience evaluating and optimizing content-driven affiliate partnerships, including editorial placements, product recommendations, creator content, and commerce-focused campaigns Knowledge of evolving affiliate trends, including creator commerce, influencer monetization, and publisher content strategies Global or multi-market marketing experience is a plus

Experience

 3+ years of hands-on experience managing affiliate marketing programs, including campaign execution, partner management, reporting, tracking validation, and operational program management Experience managing editorial content monetization, commerce content publishers, creator affiliate programs, influencer monetization initiatives, or similar content-driven affiliate partnerships required Experience working with editorial publishers such as commerce media, review sites, travel content publishers, or creator-led affiliate programs preferred Experience managing large-scale or global affiliate programs preferred Familiarity with financial reconciliation, invoicing, and commission structures preferred Demonstrated success building and scaling partnerships that monetize content through affiliate relationships, product recommendations, sponsored commerce content, or creator-driven acquisition strategies preferred

This is a remarkable opportunity to join one of the world's most recognized and celebrated hospitality brands, contributing to a high-impact performance marketing channel that drives measurable growth across the Americas. You will gain exposure to a dynamic, cross-functional environment where your work directly influences customer acquisition and revenue outcomes at a global scale. If you are passionate about affiliate marketing, thrive on data-driven decision-making, and are eager to make your mark within a world-class marketing organization, this role offers the platform to do exactly that.

Pay Rate Range

43 - 53 USD hourly

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity:

Chewy seeks a motivated and independent Senior Financial Analyst to provide financial leadership to an exciting and fast-paced Fulfillment Center (FC). This is an essential position at one of the network’s fulfillment centers located in Phoenix, AZ. As the company grows, this role within the Finance organization represents a fundamental building block in Chewy’s enterprise performance management and profitability improvement efforts. As Senior Financial Analyst, you will be located at the fulfillment center, working with the leadership team on-site to improve performance and meet or exceed financial commitments.

Deliver business insight, reporting, and analysis to the General Manager and their management team as well as the regional leadership teamParticipate in the ongoing management of the business and influence decision-making through solid relationships built with your cross-functional business partnersPursue continuous improvement in all areas of the business with an emphasis on Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and FinanceContribute to the strategic planning, target setting, and annual planning processes, and perform risk and opportunities analyses to support resource allocationsManage the planning process for variable labor within the fulfillment center, ensuring Chewy can exceed customer expectations at the lowest possible costCollaborate with data source providers and technology teams to ensure that critical decision data is accurate and timelyPartner with peers at other locations to support network initiatives that may require you to visit or partner with management teams at different locationsOversee the FC’s monthly close process, ensuring books and records are accurately maintained following Chewy’s policies and proceduresSupport Capital Planning process, including financial analysis, cost/benefit tracking, and business case development

rows.title: Manager, Analytics Engineering, Data & AI Foundations
rows.descriptionText:
POS-33330

Manager, Analytics Engineering, Data & AI Foundations

HubSpot's mission is to Help Millions of Organizations Grow Better. HubSpot's Operations team is core to this goal by supporting the HubSpotters who drive growth and serve HubSpot's customers. Our goal in Operations is to embed advanced analytics and algorithmic intelligence into the DNA of decision-making across HubSpot. Flexible, well connected, well architected data are the backbone of our strategy, along with the Analytics Engineers who create that landscape.

In this role, you'll join the Data & AI Foundations team and lead Analytics Engineers responsible for the shared data foundations, platform capabilities, and AI enabled workflows that make HubSpot's Analytics Engineering organization more effective and scalable. You'll work across Analytics Engineering managers, analysts, analytics committees, and technical platform partners to understand workflows, identify friction, and turn feedback into a clear strategy and prioritized roadmap. You'll combine people leadership, technical judgment, change management, and hands on problem solving to help the organization adopt new ways of working.

In This Role, You'll Get To
