Job Summary

The Sr Manager, Product Management - Unified Experience Layer (UXL) is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for Marriott's Unified Experience Layer (UXL), a shared technology capability that powers customer, product, developer, consumer, and contributor experiences across Digital and Enterprise products. This role serves as the product leader for UXL and is accountable for driving platform adoption, product innovation, operational excellence, and value realization while ensuring alignment with enterprise business and technology objectives.

The Sr Manager partners closely with Digital, Enterprise, Engineering, Architecture, Experience Design, Operations, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, evaluate investments, and deliver scalable capabilities that improve customer experiences, accelerate development velocity, and enhance platform performance. This position owns the integrated multi-year UXL product roadmap and is responsible for balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical dependencies, platform modernization efforts, technical debt, and operational considerations.

As a strategic product leader, this role is accountable for the full product lifecycle, including product discovery, roadmap planning, business case development, prioritization, delivery oversight, adoption strategy, performance measurement, and continuous optimization. The Sr Manager leverages customer feedback, platform analytics, and stakeholder insights to make data-driven investment and prioritization decisions while ensuring successful delivery of measurable business outcomes.

The successful candidate brings a strong product mindset, platform-thinking approach, and experience leading API-based products and shared platform capabilities. This role requires exceptional stakeholder management skills, the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization, and a proven track record of driving product adoption, alignment, and business value at scale. The candidate should also demonstrate exposure to or proficiency in Artificial Intelligence (AI), including the ability to leverage AI and automation to improve product management practices, introduce process efficiencies, accelerate decision-making, enhance product insights, and identify opportunities to create customer and business value through AI-enabled solutions.

This position serves as a product champion for UXL, promoting platform capabilities, responsible AI adoption, product best practices, and customer-centric thinking across Marriott's Digital and Enterprise ecosystem.

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

Required

Education and Experience 

8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Digital Product Delivery, Technology Strategy, or related technology disciplines. 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional teams, initiatives, products, or product portfolios in a matrixed environment. Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience/certification. Experience leading digital products, API products, shared platforms, or enterprise technology capabilities. Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies and tools, including JIRA. Demonstrated experience developing product vision, roadmaps, business cases, and investment recommendations. Proven ability to translate business objectives and customer needs into scalable product capabilities. Experience defining and measuring KPIs, product adoption metrics, platform performance metrics, and business outcomes. Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders across business and technology organizations. Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage technical teams, executives, and business stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities. Understanding of API technologies, service-based architectures, and platform products. Experience leading shared products, enterprise platforms, or reusable technology capabilities. Exposure to or proficiency in AI, Generative AI, and automation capabilities, with the ability to identify and apply AI-enabled solutions to improve product management practices, product operations, discovery, prioritization, analytics, stakeholder engagement, or process efficiencies. Familiarity with responsible AI principles, governance considerations, and adoption practices for enterprise use of AI-enabled tools and solutions. 

Preferred

Experience with GraphQL technologies and API governance practices. Experience managing platform adoption and consumer enablement programs. Understanding of digital customer experience journeys and channel ecosystems. Experience developing KPI frameworks, product reporting, and value realization dashboards. Familiarity with product discovery techniques, customer research, and experimentation methodologies. Experience partnering with Architecture, Engineering, Design, Operations, Security, and Enterprise teams. Experience managing roadmap dependencies across multiple products and teams. Knowledge of modern product management practices and Product Operating Models. Experience supporting digital transformation, enterprise modernization, or platform transformation initiatives. Experience using AI-powered productivity, analytics, collaboration, or product management tools to improve team effectiveness and decision quality. Strong facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES 

Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership

Defines and executes the vision, strategy, goals, and roadmap for the Unified Experience Layer (UXL). Establishes and maintains a multi-year roadmap aligned to Digital and Enterprise business objectives. Identifies opportunities to improve platform capabilities, adoption, scalability, developer experience, and operational effectiveness. Evaluates product opportunities and prioritizes investments based on customer value, business impact, risk, and technical feasibility. Partners with leaders across Digital, Enterprise, and Technology organizations to align priorities and drive product direction. Balances innovation, operational needs, platform modernization, and technical debt considerations within the roadmap. Develops product business cases and supports investment recommendations and prioritization decisions. Evaluates emerging AI capabilities, industry trends, and technology innovations to identify opportunities that accelerate product outcomes and create business value. 

Product Lifecycle Management

Leads the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. Drives product discovery efforts by gathering stakeholder feedback, customer needs, platform insights, analytics, and market trends. Defines product requirements, epics, features, and acceptance criteria to support successful delivery. Partners with Product Owners, Engineering, and Architecture teams to ensure roadmap execution aligns to strategic objectives. Oversees backlog health, prioritization, and roadmap alignment across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups. Ensures delivered capabilities achieve intended business, customer, operational, and platform outcomes. Uses AI-enabled tools and automation, where appropriate, to improve product discovery, documentation, insights generation, requirements refinement, prioritization, and product operations. 

UXL Product Adoption & Consumer Enablement

Drives adoption of UXL products across Digital and Enterprise channels to expand usage and measurable value. Improves onboarding, consumer readiness, contributor effectiveness, and engagement with UXL capabilities. Partners with consumers and contributors to identify enhancements that improve usability, delivery efficiency, and product value. Serves as a product advocate for UXL capabilities, GraphQL/API products, and reusable experience-layer offerings. Streamlines enablement, intake, onboarding, reporting, and stakeholder communications through automation and AI-assisted workflows. 

Stakeholder Leadership & Governance

Serves as the primary product lead and strategic point of contact for UXL stakeholders. Facilitates prioritization discussions and drives alignment across multiple business and technology organizations. Presents roadmap updates, investment recommendations, KPIs, product performance metrics, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior leadership. Establishes governance practices, intake frameworks, and prioritization processes to support effective decision-making. Identifies risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and decision points and drives timely resolution. Partners with stakeholders to incorporate AI-enabled capabilities into product roadmaps, business processes, and customer experiences where appropriate. 

Product Performance & Analytics

Defines and manages key performance indicators (KPIs), success metrics, and value realization measures for the UXL products. Uses adoption, engagement, performance, reliability, operational, and customer experience metrics to guide product decisions and roadmap priorities. Monitors product health and identifies opportunities for optimization and continuous improvement. Regularly communicates product performance, platform impact, adoption trends, and business outcomes to leadership and stakeholders. Uses AI and analytics capabilities, where appropriate, to identify patterns, synthesize insights, forecast needs, and improve decision-making quality. 

Leadership & Product Excellence

Provides leadership, coaching, and mentorship to Product Owners, Product Analysts, and other team members. Promotes product management best practices, customer-centric decision-making, data-driven prioritization, and responsible AI adoption. Contributes to the evolution of Marriott's Product Operating Model and product management discipline. Fosters collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, experimentation, and operational excellence across the product organization. Champions the responsible adoption of AI across product management processes and encourages practical experimentation with AI-powered tools to improve team productivity, insights generation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement. Maintains awareness of emerging industry trends, technologies, and practices relevant to AI, API products, platform products, and digital experiences. 

Demonstrating and Applying Discipline Knowledge

Demonstrates expertise in Product Management, API platforms, shared capabilities, and digital product delivery. Maintains knowledge of emerging technologies, industry trends, AI-enabled product practices, and modern product management methods. Applies sound judgment and strategic thinking to complex business and technology decisions. Acts as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders. Leverages insights and best practices to continuously improve product performance, customer outcomes, and operational effectiveness.

rows.title: Functional Developer II – Oracle ERP Finance
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity

Every order a pet parent places at Chewy eventually becomes a financial transaction: a tax calculation, a cost calculation, a rebate accrual, an invoice match, a vendor payment, and an accounting entry. FinTech team owns the platforms that get all of it right, across billions of dollars in annual net sales and millions of transactions a month. That includes inventory adjustments streaming in from our warehouse management systems, and for our growing B2B business the full order-to-cash lifecycle, which we brought live recently and are still shaping.

We are hiring a Functional Developer II – Oracle ERP Finance to design and build on that platform. You will work deep in Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash Management, Cost Management, and Fixed Assets and across the ecosystem that surrounds it: Coupa for procure-to-pay, Vertex for tax determination, and a growing layer of APIs, microservices, and event streams that extend Oracle ERP well past what it does out of the box.

This is not a keep-the-lights-on configuration seat. Our roadmap includes standing up the finance and tax architecture for Chewy’s new initiatives, migrating acquired businesses off legacy ERPs onto Oracle Fusion, modernizing how ERP data reaches the rest of the enterprise, and putting Oracle’s new AI and agentic capabilities to work on real close, reconciliation, and payables processes. You will own workstreams across all of it from the whiteboard through go-live and stabilization.

And if you know Oracle Financials deeply and you know tax Oracle Fusion Tax, Vertex, Indirect tax determination in a high-volume retail and e-commerce environment you will go straight to the top of our list.

What You’ll Do

End-to-end functional solution design across Oracle Fusion Financials: requirements, process design, configuration, functional specifications, data and integration requirements, testing, documentation, and production readiness.The partnership with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Product, and Engineering — translating complex accounting requirements into scalable solutions, and evaluating the accounting, operational, control, and downstream impacts of every design decision.Implementation of new Oracle modules and capabilities, plus continuous modernization of existing ones as the business grows and requirements change.Extending Oracle beyond standard functionality alongside Engineers and Architects REST APIs, microservices, event-driven and file-based integrations including the data mappings and accounting rules behind purchase orders, receipts, invoices, payments, journals, and cash receipts.Oracle BI Publisher reports and data models supporting Finance reporting, reconciliations, integrations, and daily operations.Merger and acquisition support: assessing acquired companies’ finance systems and processes, then designing and executing their migration into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.Finding and eliminating manual work simplifying processes, automating what should be automated, strengthening financial controls, and driving adoption of native Oracle capability over custom workarounds.Functional testing through SIT, UAT, and regression, plus defect resolution, deployment, and post-production stabilization with solutions that hold up to audit, data integrity, and segregation-of-duties requirements.Oracle Fusion quarterly releases and upgrades from the functional side: impact assessment, regression testing, new-feature evaluation, and adoption planning. When production breaks, you drive root cause with Oracle Support and internal Engineering.Evaluation of emerging Oracle Fusion capabilities AI, automation, and agent-based features and bringing the ones that actually matter into Finance and Accounting processes.

What You’ll Need

3+ years working with enterprise ERP or financial systems in functional consulting, implementation, solution delivery, or support including 3+ years hands-on with Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials.Deep functional expertise across multiple Fusion Financials modules — Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, General Ledger, Cash Management, Cost Management, Fixed Assets — and a real command of how transactions flow from subledgers into the General Ledger.A track record of turning complex Finance and Accounting requirements into configurations, functional specifications, workflows, integrations, and reports that survive contact with production.Experience defining functional requirements and data mappings for integrations between Oracle ERP and upstream and downstream enterprise applications.Hands-on experience building and supporting Oracle BI Publisher reports and data models.Experience across ERP implementations, module rollouts, upgrades, or migrations, plus production support — troubleshooting functional and data issues and working service requests with Oracle Support.Command of testing methodology (functional, integration, regression, UAT) and the discipline to design for financial controls and auditability from the start, not as a retrofit.Strong communication across Finance, Accounting, business, and Engineering teams, and the ability to independently own a workstream from requirements through production in a fast-paced Agile environment.Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.

Bonus

Oracle Fusion Tax, Vertex, or other indirect tax engines integrated with Oracle Fusion ERP or enterprise commerce platforms. This one counts for a lot on our team.M&A ERP integrations, financial-system consolidations, or migrations from legacy ERP platforms onto Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.REST APIs, FBDI, ADFdi, and other Oracle integration frameworks from a functional design perspective.OTBI, Financial Reporting Center, and the broader Oracle reporting and analytics stack.Finance automation work: three-way matching, reconciliation, cash application, landed cost, or complex accounting integrations.One or more Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certifications.Retail, e-commerce, marketplace, supply chain, or other high-volume transaction environments.

rows.title: 2027 Merchandising Internship - Portland
rows.descriptionText:
JOB DESCRIPTION 

We designed our program to be a game-changing first step in kicking off your career journey. We're looking for the next generation of home merchandisers who can bring fresh ideas and perspectives to our brands. During this 10-week program, you'll develop your skills alongside a team of supportive mentors and inspiring leaders.

Merchandising blends creativity, analytics, and marketing  to drive customer engagement and profitability. As an intern, you'll work closely with a team for a specific category (ex: furniture, tabletop, bath, etc) to get behind the scenes insight on how they create product strategies, manage pricing, and interpret data. You'll use this to develop your own new product recommendations.

ABOUT YOU


 Passionate about product, home decor, and retail  Keep up with home design trends  Currently in your junior year of an undergraduate program  Minimum GPA of 3.5  Able to work onsite at one of our brands in Portland  Know how to prioritize and move quickly to react to our ever-changing business  Think strategically and critically to solve problems  Have Excel experience: vlooks-ups, pivot tables, etc… 


OUR PROGRAM

Our program is designed for undergraduate students graduating in 2028. During your internship, you will be a part of an intern cohort working for Rejuvenation in Portland. Throughout the program, you will attend business critical meetings, lead projects, gain experience working with cross-functional teams, attend professional trainings, and have the chance to brainstorm with our leadership team.

At the end of the program, you are given the opportunity to pioneer a new idea and present it to our executive leadership team. Many of our interns' project proposals have been implemented in new business strategies, as we value the fresh perspective our interns bring to the business.

Of course, we also leave time for a little fun by hosting social and networking opportunities with your fellow interns such as cohort lunches, and social hours.

WHEN

Our 10 week program runs June 7th - August 13th (start date is flexible for students on the quarter system).

WHERE

Portland, OR. Onsite 4x a week.

ABOUT US

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is a global, multi-channel retailer of home furnishings and housewares (our family of brands includes Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn teen, west elm, Rejuvenation, GreenRow and Mark & Graham), but we operate within smaller teams, giving each person an opportunity for hands-on experience. Together, our brands represent a strong, diverse and growing portfolio that allow us to reach customers in a new way every day - and we'd love your help.

About The Role

The Senior Analyst, Loyalty Marketing will play a key role in developing, implementing, and measuring marketing initiatives that drive customer loyalty and elevate the customer experience across the Williams-Sonoma, Inc. family of brands. This role will support The Key Rewards loyalty program by helping bring cross-brand marketing campaigns to life across email, digital, site, store, print, and other customer touchpoints.

Reporting to the Loyalty Marketing team, this person will partner closely with internal cross-functional teams, Capital One, external vendors, and analytics partners to develop campaigns, build customer journeys, and evaluate performance against Loyalty KPIs. The Senior Analyst will also bring strong data skills to the team, using SQL and analytical tools to help investigate loyalty program trends, validate & clean data, and translate results into actionable marketing recommendations.

Through this work, the Senior Analyst, Loyalty Marketing will help accelerate membership growth, deepen customer engagement, drive incremental spend, and unlock the value of WSI’s cross-brand portfolio. rows.title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk - Audit and Assurance
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

Our Internal Audit team plays a strategic role in helping the business navigate risk while enabling growth and innovation. Working across global operations with colleagues based throughout the U.S. and Singapore, we bring diverse perspectives and deep expertise to deliver independent assurance, practical insights, and meaningful improvements across technology, finance, operations, and compliance.

About The Role

Technology is transforming every aspect of our business—from cloud computing and AI to digital commerce and cybersecurity. As Senior Manager, Technology Risk - Audit and Assurance , you will play a critical role in providing independent assurance over the company's technology risks, governance, and control environment while helping strengthen confidence in how technology enables our business.

Reporting to the VP of SOX & Internal Audit, you will lead our Technology Risk & Assurance program, including oversight of our global IT SOX program and risk-based technology assurance activities across modern technology environments. This role combines deep technical expertise with sound business judgment to evaluate technology risks, assess the effectiveness of controls, and provide meaningful insights that support executive leadership and the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors.

More than a traditional audit role, this position offers the opportunity to influence how technology risk is understood and managed across the organization. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Information Security, Product, Enterprise Technology, Finance, and external auditors to provide independent perspectives that strengthen governance while supporting innovation and business objectives.

We're looking for a collaborative leader who is intellectually curious, energized by emerging technologies, and passionate about continuously improving how assurance is delivered through automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Responsibilities

Lead Technology Risk & Assurance


 Lead the company's Technology Risk & Assurance program, including technology audits, technology risk assessments, and oversight of the global IT SOX program.  Develop and execute a risk-based assurance plan focused on areas including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), cybersecurity, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise applications, AI governance, data privacy, and emerging technologies.  Perform assessments executed in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and professional standards while delivering practical, risk-focused insights.  Oversee the scoping, rationalization and execution of efforts over the SOX ITGCs and ITACs supporting SOX compliance. 


Deliver Strategic Risk Insights


 Evaluate technology processes, risks, and controls to identify opportunities to strengthen governance, improve operational effectiveness, and reduce risk.  Provide independent, pragmatic recommendations that balance risk management with business objectives.  Monitor emerging technology, cybersecurity, regulatory, and AI-related risks and incorporate them into assurance activities.  Translate technical findings into clear business insights for executive leadership and the Audit Committee. 


Build Trusted Partnerships


 Develop strong relationships with leaders across Engineering, Information Security, Product, Enterprise Technology, Finance, and Compliance while maintaining Internal Audit's independence.  Serve as a trusted advisor by providing independent perspectives on technology initiatives, system implementations, cloud migrations, and process changes.  Coordinate effectively with external auditors and other assurance providers to optimize assurance coverage and reduce duplication of effort. 


Drive Innovation Within Internal Audit


 Advance the Technology Risk & Assurance function through automation, continuous monitoring, AI-enabled audit techniques, and data analytics.  Identify opportunities to improve audit quality, increase efficiency, and enhance risk coverage through innovative approaches and technology.  Champion continuous improvement initiatives that modernize Internal Audit's capabilities and ways of working. 


Develop Talent


 Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team, fostering an environment of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning. 


Criteria


 9+ years of progressive experience in Technology Risk, Technology Assurance, IT Audit, Cyber Risk, or IT SOX, including experience leading complex technology assurance engagements. A combination of public accounting and industry experience is preferred.  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; CISA, CISSP, CISM, CPA, or other relevant certifications are preferred.  Strong knowledge of SOX compliance, IT General Controls (ITGCs), IT Application Controls (ITACs), technology risk management, and industry frameworks including COBIT, NIST, and ISO 27001.  Experience assessing modern technology environments, including cloud platforms, cybersecurity, identity and access management.  Familiarity with AI governance, AI risk, and assurance considerations related to emerging technologies is highly desirable.  Excellent project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives.  Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills, including experience presenting technology risk and assurance topics to senior leadership.  Demonstrated ability to think strategically while remaining hands-on in executing complex assurance engagements.  A collaborative leadership style, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a passion for mentoring and developing others.  This role is based in our Rocklin office, with onsite collaboration Monday through Thursday and flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. 


Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of Technology Risk & Assurance within a dynamic, technology-driven organization.

You'll work closely with senior technology leaders while maintaining the independence necessary to provide objective assurance and meaningful risk insights to executive leadership and the Audit Committee. You'll help modernize how assurance is delivered through data analytics, automation, and AI while evaluating some of the company's most significant technology initiatives and emerging risks.

If you're energized by technology, passionate about continuous learning, and motivated by the opportunity to influence governance and risk at the highest levels of the organization, we'd love to hear from you.

Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits

Continued Learning

rows.title: Staff Data Eng, Data Systems, TCGplayer
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

TCGplayer, an eBay company, powers a marketplace for buyers, sellers, hobby shops, and collectors across the trading card community. For many people, TCGplayer is more than a marketplace. It is part of how they discover, enjoy, and stay connected to the hobby they love! The Data Engineering team helps make that experience possible by building the systems, standards, and partnerships that make data easier to trust, easier to work with, and easier to scale across TCGplayer Technology.

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will join our Data Engineering team and server as a technical leader, helping shape technical direction across warehouse and application-facing systems. You will work closely with engineering, platform, and analytics teams to strengthen data governance, improve confidence in data-related changes across distributed environments, and guide sound decisions around datastores, data movement, and system design. This is a highly collaborative Staff Data Engineer role with broad influence across TCGplayer, with the opportunity to raise engineering standards, support long-term platform health, and help teams build with greater clarity and confidence.

What You Will Accomplish

Serve as a technical leader in data systems, setting direction and raising the bar for engineers through architecture guidance, standards, and hands-on partnership across TCGplayer Technology.Strengthen Snowflake governance, access controls, security, observability, and cost management so warehouse workloads are more reliable, efficient, and easier to scale.Improve how teams validate and test data-related changes across distributed environments, increasing release confidence in systems that span warehouse, services, and application-facing platforms.Guide datastore and architecture decisions across operational and warehouse systems, helping teams make strong tradeoff decisions based on reliability, scale, maintainability, and product needs.Lead cross-application datastore initiatives, including migrations and platform upgrades, with emphasis on security, governance, and alignment with architecture standards.Partner with application and platform teams to bring greater clarity to data ownership, service boundaries, and data movement across transactional products, microservices, and event-driven systems.Enable teams to move faster by providing guidance on Postgres design, performance, and datastore decisions, increasing consistency and engineering leverage across the organization.


What You Will Bring

10+ years of experience designing, improving, or supporting production platforms across data warehousing, operational datastores, distributed systems, or data architecture.Hands-on experience with Snowflake in production environments, including governance, access controls, security, observability, performance, reliability, and cost management.Strong experience with relational databases, ideally Postgres, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, transactions, scaling, and production troubleshooting.Experience guiding datastore and architecture decisions across technologies such as Postgres, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, and similar platforms.Experience with microservices and event-driven systems (Kafka and Debezium preferred), including retries, idempotency, ordering, and change data capture.Strong communication and technical judgment, with a track record of influencing across teams and improving reliability, testing, governance, observability, or engineering practices in complex environments.


Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$136,000 - $228,600

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Remote roles are not eligible for U.S. visa sponsorship.

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center and AI Hiring Guidelines.

rows.title: Senior Data Analyst, CS Commercial Operations
rows.descriptionText:
POS-26210

The HubSpot Customer Success Strategy and Operations team is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our team.

In this role, you will combine deep data insights with business expertise to deliver comprehensive solutions that tackle critical challenges and enhance operational efficiency and strategic outcomes. You will work directly with global leaders across HubSpot to deeply understand business performance while driving growth and productivity through data-driven decisions and strategic insights. You will develop innovative go-to-market and operational strategies, including business/pricing model transformation, retention-driving plays, and supporting our annual Customer Success revenue plan.

Data Analysts act as the technical backbone of the operation, exercising a high degree of technical autonomy to navigate enterprise-scale environments. You will be responsible for architecting scalable, reproducible data assets that serve as the single source of truth for the organization.

In this role, while you operate with a high degree of autonomy - leveraging AI tools to elevate analytical standards and drive strategic impact - you’ll benefit from the support of the Operations Analytics community, sharing ideas, debating approaches, and receiving feedback.

We Are Looking For People Who Have

Academic or professional experience with a heavy quantitative, analytical focus. Track record as a go-to expert for the business, playing a pivotal role in driving data-driven decision-making and shaping strategic decisions.Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to build deep relationships and present strategies and outcomes to C-suite executives.Passion for fostering a high-performing culture, participating in the analyst community and providing coaching and mentorship to junior analysts.Experience working with large datasets, particularly regarding data mining, manipulation, and exploration in a fast-paced environment.Experience using AI to elevate analytical standards and scale project execution without sacrificing rigor.Ability to write performant, complex SQL queries and perform analysis in code-based or notebook environments to ensure workflows are reproducible and efficient.Experience building commercial models (e.g., ROI, LTV) and forecasting trends to inform near-term operational decisions.

In This Role, You Will

Be a driving influencer on the use and application of analysis; deliver what’s needed, and show what’s possible. Partner with stakeholders to understand your team’s data and business needs; become an expert in translating these needs into specific analyses with actionable insights. Conduct quantitative analysis of user behavior to uncover issues or opportunities to improve our customers’ experience. Collaborate across teams and business functions to infuse strategic, open ended research with quantitative insights. Communicate insights to your stakeholders with a data-driven point of view and plan for action. Navigate an enterprise-scale data environment and own the development of scalable assets that drive efficiency and data consistency.Inform specific, near-term operational decisions and product roadmaps, leveraging reproducible analysis to ensure stakeholders act on high-integrity data.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range

Sr. Product Manager - Technical, Offers CRM Communications

About The Team And Role

This role is part of eBay’s Buying Conversion team and will lead the Buyer and Seller Initiated Offers CRM Communications portfolio. You will serve as the portfolio lead across strategy, roadmap, experimentation, execution, and measurable business impact for customer-facing communications that help buyers and sellers move through offer-based shopping moments.

Offers are one of eBay’s most important marketplace conversion mechanics. These experiences span email, push notifications, in-app notifications, and emerging CRM channels.

In this highly visible role, you will develop how eBay delivers the right offer, right message, and right timing to customers while balancing conversion growth, customer relevance, marketplace health, and notification fatigue. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Build, Analytics, CRM, Data Science, and cross-functional product teams across the customer experience to improve the intelligence, quality, and efficiency of offer communications.

This is a product role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, customer psychology, lifecycle communications, experimentation, and technical systems. You will help define how Offers experiences should leverage customer intent, offer signals, personalization, trigger logic, contact strategy, recommendation inputs, and platform capabilities to drive better customer and business outcomes.

If you are passionate about marketplace negotiation, customer-centric growth, and performance optimization, this is an outstanding opportunity. You can help build communications that guide customers to confidently take the next best action and influence how eBay’s offer-based conversion experiences evolve.

What You Will Accomplish

Lead the Offers CRM Communications area, including vision, strategy, roadmap, experimentation, performance, and measurable business outcomes.Build and deliver customer-facing CRM experiences across email, push notifications, in-app notifications, hub, and future owned-channel surfaces. These experiences support buyers and sellers navigating promotions and deal-based shopping interactions.Lead roadmap planning and prioritization across multiple programs and features, balancing customer value, conversion impact, operational complexity, technical feasibility, marketplace dynamics, and long-term strategic value.Partner with Engineering, data analysis, insight generation, CRM, Build, and partner product teams to improve offer signal quality, trigger logic, audience eligibility, ranking, suppression, frequency capping, send-time optimization, channel orchestration, and measurement.Translate customer problems, marketplace opportunities, and portfolio priorities into clear product requirements, MVPs, experiments, and execution plans; create PRDs, manage dependencies, and drive execution from discovery to launch.Lead and mentor PM partners, helping them increase their impact, sharpen product judgment, and deliver high-quality outcomes across the Offers roadmap.


What You Will Bring

7–9 years of product management experience, including experience in technical product management, growth product management, lifecycle/CRM communications, marketplace products, personalization, conversion optimization, or user behavior-based trigger systems.Experience owning complex customer-facing product portfolios with measurable business outcomes, ideally in a marketplace, e-commerce, consumer technology, or large-scale digital platform environment.Proven experience building or optimizing lifecycle communications across email, push, in-app, hub, or similar owned channels, including audience strategy, trigger logic, messaging, experimentation, and measurement.Strong customer and product judgment, showing proficiency in grasping buyer and seller needs, customer fatigue, offer dynamics, urgency, marketplace incentives, and conversion trade-offs.Solid understanding of AI/ML-powered product systems, with the ability to partner effectively with Data Science, Analytics, Recommendations, and Engineering teams on signal quality, model or rules-based decisioning, inputs and outputs, performance measurement, and governance.A growth mindset and proven track record to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical partners, influence without authority, and turn ambiguity into actionable strategy and execution.


Location: Bellevue/Seattle, WA; San Jose, CA; or New York, NY

rows.descriptionText:

About The Team

eBay is the leading Collectibles marketplace worldwide, catering to millions of customers across the globe. Our mission is to be the most trusted and beloved destination for collectors of trading cards, memorabilia, comics, and more.

The Trading Cards team ranks as one of the quickest growing segments at eBay. We seek a business leader to lead monetization, pricing, and assortment approaches to boost GMV growth and grow marketshare. The role aims to build buyer and seller ust and keep our selection appealing to collectors worldwide. This position offers high visibility and requires close cooperation with senior leaders in Collectibles and frequent contact with GM-level executives.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Manager, Pricing & Assortment Strategy to identify, prioritize, and complete growth levers across pricing, assortment mix, and monetization opportunities. This role blends critical thinking with hands-on analysis and requires strong cross-functional collaboration with Product, Analytics, Marketing, Monetization, Finance, and Category Management teams. You will regularly present findings and recommendations to Collectibles executives, including the GM, and ensure their work directly informs high-impact business decisions.

Responsibilities

Pricing Strategy: Develop and implement scalable frameworks and pricing strategies that improve revenue while maintaining marketplace competitiveness and appeal to sellers.Assortment Strategy: Develop strategies to attract seller supply, identify whitespace opportunities, and improve selection breadth, depth, and quality.Pricing Insights: Lead pricing analyses and test-and-learn initiatives to assess price elasticity, promotional efficiency, and marketplace competitiveness.Competitive Research: Monitor competitive and industry trends across trading cards and adjacent marketplaces, assessing pricing, differentiated services, and customer experience to find opportunities and inform recommendations.Identify Growth Opportunites: Discover and quantify GMV and revenue opportunities throughout the trading cards ecosystem, presenting clear and actionable suggestions for leadership.Executive Engagement: Partner directly with Collectibles leadership, preparing and delivering executive-ready presentations that drive alignment on strategy and priorities.Business Reporting: Collaborate with Analytics to build and improve dashboards, reports, and benchmark frameworks that track critical levers and inform business decisions.Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with Analytics, Marketing, Product, Finance, Monetization, and Operations to drive high-impact initiatives.


Qualifications

Required:

8+ years of experience in strategy, category management, pricing, or business operations, with experience in ecommerce, retail, or consumer tech preferred.Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to ask the right business questions and translate complex data into actionable insights.Advanced skills in Excel or Google Sheets, shown by working with complex datasets and collaborating with Analytics/Data Science teams to develop and refine sophisticated models.Proven track record in pricing strategy, monetization, or revenue optimization.Demonstrated ability to build and deliver executive-level presentations and influence senior collaborators.Demonstrated ability to leverage LLMs and AI tools for deep research, modeling and analysis, and developing business proposals and recommendations.Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills.BA/BS degree or equivalent.


Preferred

Experience in marketplaces, collectibles, or interest-based categories.Experience using SQL, Python, or other programming languages to analyze data, generate insights, and support business decision-making.Familiarity with assortment strategy, pricing elasticity modeling, and benchmark optimization.MBA or advanced degree.


The Impact You Will Make

By becoming a member of the Trading Cards team, you will:

Build pricing and assortment strategy for one of the most exciting and high-growth categories at eBay.Develop strategies and drive work that brings joy to collectors and enthusiasts around the world, helping them discover, buy, and sell the items they love.Act as a trusted partner to Trading Card leaders and other senior leaders, ensuring that your insights and recommendations inform category-wide strategy.Present your work at the executive level, seeing across the business and influencing strategic priorities.Help eBay stay the leading destination for collectors, while ensuring we provide a balanced, trusted, and profitable ecosystem!

rows.title: Sr Asset Protection Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity:

At Chewy, we want all Chewtopians to feel safe, secure as they work, learn and grow as members of our Chewy team! Chewy is seeking a Sr. Asset Protection Manager to support the Chewy Fulfillment Core & Rx Network teams. This role will lead in the development and continuous improvement of the Asset Protection Program in partnership with Site Operations and EHS, including policy development, mitigation strategies, investigations, and security systems. In addition, they will provide direct oversight of Chewy Asset Protection compliance programs along with coordinating and participating in annual compliance audits. The successful candidate must demonstrate the ability to communicate, coordinate, recognize, and handle inventory control shrink, risk assessment, assets, physical security, and asset protection standard of operating procedures (SOP) on a multi-state, multi-region level. Must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and loss prevention data analysis. This individual will also be responsible for collaborating with Learning and Legal teams to review loss prevention training and standard processes based on trends to ensure that all Chewy Asset Protection policies and processes remain compliant and current.

What You'll Do

Support the development and management of the Asset Protection Program (strategy, policy, and procedures) for Chewy’s Fulfillment Centers and Pharmacy. Partner with site leadership, human resources, and internal customers to ensure internal policies and procedures are developed, improved, and adhered to. Work with internal customers and Site leadership to develop physical security and loss-reduction strategies. Conduct ongoing risk assessments and outline corrective measures. Monitor and report statistical data relating to Chewy inventory comprehensive audits in compliance with Chewy and industry standards. Review and analyze activities and records to determine compliance with Chewy policies and SOPs. Support and monitor third-party security staffing standard work execution and findings.Initiate, conduct, and support confidential internal/external investigations involving company assets and Team Members. Assist with incident investigations; prepare investigation reports including recommendations on corrective and preventive actions; and monitor implementation. Ensure Fulfillment Centers and Pharmacy compliance with all laws and workplace standards. Participate as a member of the Fulfillment Management team in the planning, formulating, and implementing risk control strategies in line with the Fulfillment Centers’ missions and goals. Advise Site Environmental Health and Safety team on matters related to Physical Security and Loss Prevention. Detect, resolve, and mitigate situations involving team member theft, abuse, or unsafe acts involving company assets, policies, or procedures. Ensure that all physical security systems are operational (i.e., alarms, CCTV, etc.). Assist with developing and conducting facility and compliance program audits and inspections. 

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in related field (criminal justice, loss prevention and asset protection) or equivalent work experience or military service. 8+ years of loss prevention, asset protection, or law enforcement experience. 3 -5 years of experience in a role supporting fulfillment, distribution centers, manufacturing plants, and multiple stores focused on progressive Asset Protection and Audit roles or equivalent combination of experience and education. Proficiency and experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Microsoft Office, Tableau, Service Now, or Smartsheet. Strong communication, partnership, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills. Working knowledge of Wicklander – Zulawski Interview/Investigation techniques. Ability to train and empower associates and delegate tasks and duties to staff in a fast-paced fulfillment center environment. Excellent written, verbal and negotiation skills to effectively communicate with a diverse workforce. Effective people management, project management and time management skills. Ability to effectively problem solve by analyzing situations and applying creative and timely solutions. Change Management – Adaptable to a fast-paced, shifting work environment; willing to remain flexible to accommodate changing business conditions, work requirements, and customer scheduling needs. Detail Oriented – Attention to detail, ability to focus on the task, adherence to Company policies and requirements while consistently delivering error-free results. Demonstrate the ability to work independently and efficiently under pressure while handling challenging demands and tight deadlines. Experience leading changes in multiple site environments and implementing asset protection policies and procedures. Required to live within a commutable distance from the Fulfillment Center Must be willing to travel up to 40%. 

Does this sound like you? We would love for you to apply!

The base salary range for this role is $96,000 - $153,000.00.

The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to the candidate’s relevant experience, education, and work location. In addition, this position is eligible for 401k and a new hire and annual equity grant. C08+ positions may also be eligible for annual bonus.

We offer different types of insurance and benefits, such as medical/Rx, vision, dental, life, disability, hospital indemnity, critical illness, and accident. We offer parental leave, family services benefits, backup dependent care, flexible spending accounts, telemedicine, pet adoption reimbursement, employee assistance program, and many discounts including 10% off pet insurance and 20% off at Chewy.com.

Exempt salary team members have unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval. Team members will receive six paid holidays per year. Team members may be eligible for paid sick and family leave in compliance with applicable state and local regulations.

rows.title: Senior Manager, Technology Risk - Audit and Assurance
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

Our Internal Audit team plays a strategic role in helping the business navigate risk while enabling growth and innovation. Working across global operations with colleagues based throughout the U.S. and Singapore, we bring diverse perspectives and deep expertise to deliver independent assurance, practical insights, and meaningful improvements across technology, finance, operations, and compliance.

About The Role

Technology is transforming every aspect of our business—from cloud computing and AI to digital commerce and cybersecurity. As Senior Manager, Technology Risk - Audit and Assurance , you will play a critical role in providing independent assurance over the company's technology risks, governance, and control environment while helping strengthen confidence in how technology enables our business.

Reporting to the VP of SOX & Internal Audit, you will lead our Technology Risk & Assurance program, including oversight of our global IT SOX program and risk-based technology assurance activities across modern technology environments. This role combines deep technical expertise with sound business judgment to evaluate technology risks, assess the effectiveness of controls, and provide meaningful insights that support executive leadership and the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors.

More than a traditional audit role, this position offers the opportunity to influence how technology risk is understood and managed across the organization. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Information Security, Product, Enterprise Technology, Finance, and external auditors to provide independent perspectives that strengthen governance while supporting innovation and business objectives.

We're looking for a collaborative leader who is intellectually curious, energized by emerging technologies, and passionate about continuously improving how assurance is delivered through automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Responsibilities

Lead Technology Risk & Assurance


 Lead the company's Technology Risk & Assurance program, including technology audits, technology risk assessments, and oversight of the global IT SOX program.  Develop and execute a risk-based assurance plan focused on areas including cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), cybersecurity, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise applications, AI governance, data privacy, and emerging technologies.  Perform assessments executed in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and professional standards while delivering practical, risk-focused insights.  Oversee the scoping, rationalization and execution of efforts over the SOX ITGCs and ITACs supporting SOX compliance. 


Deliver Strategic Risk Insights


 Evaluate technology processes, risks, and controls to identify opportunities to strengthen governance, improve operational effectiveness, and reduce risk.  Provide independent, pragmatic recommendations that balance risk management with business objectives.  Monitor emerging technology, cybersecurity, regulatory, and AI-related risks and incorporate them into assurance activities.  Translate technical findings into clear business insights for executive leadership and the Audit Committee. 


Build Trusted Partnerships


 Develop strong relationships with leaders across Engineering, Information Security, Product, Enterprise Technology, Finance, and Compliance while maintaining Internal Audit's independence.  Serve as a trusted advisor by providing independent perspectives on technology initiatives, system implementations, cloud migrations, and process changes.  Coordinate effectively with external auditors and other assurance providers to optimize assurance coverage and reduce duplication of effort. 


Drive Innovation Within Internal Audit


 Advance the Technology Risk & Assurance function through automation, continuous monitoring, AI-enabled audit techniques, and data analytics.  Identify opportunities to improve audit quality, increase efficiency, and enhance risk coverage through innovative approaches and technology.  Champion continuous improvement initiatives that modernize Internal Audit's capabilities and ways of working. 


Develop Talent


 Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team, fostering an environment of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning. 


Criteria


 9+ years of progressive experience in Technology Risk, Technology Assurance, IT Audit, Cyber Risk, or IT SOX, including experience leading complex technology assurance engagements. A combination of public accounting and industry experience is preferred.  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; CISA, CISSP, CISM, CPA, or other relevant certifications are preferred.  Strong knowledge of SOX compliance, IT General Controls (ITGCs), IT Application Controls (ITACs), technology risk management, and industry frameworks including COBIT, NIST, and ISO 27001.  Experience assessing modern technology environments, including cloud platforms, cybersecurity, identity and access management.  Familiarity with AI governance, AI risk, and assurance considerations related to emerging technologies is highly desirable.  Excellent project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives.  Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills, including experience presenting technology risk and assurance topics to senior leadership.  Demonstrated ability to think strategically while remaining hands-on in executing complex assurance engagements.  A collaborative leadership style, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a passion for mentoring and developing others.  This role is based in our San Francisco office, with onsite collaboration Monday through Thursday and flexibility to work remotely on Fridays. 


Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of Technology Risk & Assurance within a dynamic, technology-driven organization.

You'll work closely with senior technology leaders while maintaining the independence necessary to provide objective assurance and meaningful risk insights to executive leadership and the Audit Committee. You'll help modernize how assurance is delivered through data analytics, automation, and AI while evaluating some of the company's most significant technology initiatives and emerging risks.

If you're energized by technology, passionate about continuous learning, and motivated by the opportunity to influence governance and risk at the highest levels of the organization, we'd love to hear from you.

Our Culture & Values 

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First 

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health 


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University  Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities  Resources for self-development  Advisor (Mentor) program  Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series 


 WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration). 

 This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

 The expected starting pay range for this position is $170,000 - $190,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors. 

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

Senior Manager, Trust Strategy & Operations – Shipping Protections Strategy & Execution

About The Team

At eBay, trust is fundamental to how our marketplace works. Millions of buyers and sellers rely on us not only to enable transactions, but to protect them when something goes wrong.

Shipping Protections are a critical part of that promise. As eBay expands the protections available across different shipping solutions, markets, and customer experiences, we need a clear strategy for how those protections should evolve, where we should invest, and how we deliver them in a way that is simple for customers, operationally scalable, and financially sustainable.

The Trust Strategy & Operations team works across Shipping, Product, Risk, Analytics, Customer Support, Finance, Policy, and regional teams to define that strategy and turn it into execution.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Trust Strategy & Operations to help define and implement the long-term strategy for Shipping Protections across eBay.

Responsibilities


 Own the product lifecycle for inventory management from ideation through adoption, continuously measuring business outcomes, incorporating customer and stakeholder feedback, and evolving the product roadmap to maximize business value.  Drive the adoption of AI, machine learning, automation, and decision-support capabilities to improve planning quality, accelerate product delivery, reduce manual effort, and enable smarter business decision making. Partner with Analytics and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI use cases across the Inventory Management domain.  Leverage generative AI and modern product management tools to improve product discovery, requirements development, backlog quality, documentation, and team productivity while championing responsible AI adoption across the product domain.  Lead end-to-end product discovery by partnering with business stakeholders to define strategy, prioritize opportunities, and translate business needs into product roadmaps, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.  Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, and Program Management to execute product roadmaps, manage tradeoffs and dependencies, and deliver high-quality capabilities through Agile delivery.  Lead product strategy across demand forecasting, assortment planning, merch financial planning, allocation, replenishment, and inventory optimization to improve forecast accuracy, inventory productivity, service levels, and financial performance.  Advance merch financial planning capabilities that improve visibility into inventory investments, sales, margin, receipts, turn, open-to-buy, and related financial planning metrics.  Drive allocation and replenishment capabilities that improve product placement, inventory availability, inventory productivity, sell-through, and customer fulfillment outcomes.  Identify and prioritize opportunities to reduce manual work, spreadsheet dependency, process fragmentation, and operational friction across planning and inventory workflows.  Partner with Analytics and Technology teams to deliver advanced forecasting, optimization, decision-support, and automation capabilities through the most appropriate combination of internally developed products, commercial Inventory Management packaged solutions, platform extensions, data products, and other technology approaches.  Define product success metrics and measurement plans tied to forecast accuracy, in-stock performance, inventory productivity, sell-through, margin, planning cycle time, adoption, exception reduction, and operational efficiency.  Provide clear recommendations on roadmap priorities, sequencing, tradeoffs, dependencies, risks, solution alternatives, and value realization to business partners and senior Technology leadership.  Support organizational change management for new planning and inventory capabilities, including stakeholder alignment, process documentation, training, UAT, readiness, hyper-care, and adoption tracking.  Establish and maintain strong product management practices and documentation across Jira, Confluence, and related product management tools to improve backlog quality, transparency, knowledge sharing, and team productivity.  Ensure product capabilities are designed with appropriate controls, data quality, role-based access, audit considerations, and operational governance.  Remain current with retail, supply chain, planning, forecasting, allocation, replenishment, AI, and inventory optimization trends, and apply relevant external practices to WSI’s product strategy. 


Criteria


 10+ years of related experience in Product Management, Inventory Management, Merch Financial Planning, Demand Forecasting, Assortment Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, Supply Chain, retail technology, or a related techno-functional discipline, with demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-scale planning, inventory, merchandising, or supply chain capabilities.  Deep understanding of retail planning and inventory management, including financial planning, demand forecasting, assortment planning, allocation, replenishment, inventory optimization, and exception management.  Strong product management discipline, with demonstrated ability to translate complex business processes and customer needs into product strategy, roadmaps, requirements, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes; experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar product management tools.  Strong analytical and business orientation, with the ability to use data, business metrics, financial impact, and operational performance to shape product decisions, prioritize investments, and measure value realization.  Experience applying AI, machine learning, automation, optimization, or advanced analytics to improve planning, product management, operational efficiency, or customer outcomes, with the ability to identify and prioritize high-value AI-enabled capabilities.  Demonstrated experience modernizing fragmented or manual planning processes into scalable, governed, system-enabled capabilities, including the ability to evaluate build, buy, extend, partner, and retirement options based on business value, architecture, risk, cost, and speed to value.  Strong cross-functional leadership and influence, with the ability to partner effectively with senior business, Analytics, Engineering, Architecture, and Program Management stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, manage tradeoffs and dependencies, and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.  Experience in large-scale, multi-channel or omnichannel retail environments strongly preferred, including experience with internally developed products, commercial Inventory Management packaged solutions, or hybrid technology approaches. Relevant retail planning consulting experience is also desirable.  Strong communication and delivery discipline, with experience across Agile, Scrum, Lean, and/or waterfall delivery models and the ability to clearly communicate product strategy, priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and business outcomes to stakeholders at all levels.  Bachelor’s degree or more in Supply Chain, Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field or equivalent work experience.  This role requires being onsite in the San Francisco CA office Monday through Thursday.  Some travel may be required to WSI corporate, store, distribution, care center, manufacturing, or supply chain locations within the United States. 


Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands  A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities  Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer  Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits  Tax-free commuter benefits  A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

This is your chance to be on our Development team who play a large part in driving Hilton's growth strategy through the addition of new hotels to our ever-growing portfolio! As a Senior Manager, Development Operations, you will lead the Sales Analyst team and partner closely with our Developers to grow our managed and franchised hotel estate. On the Development Operations team reporting to the VP Global Development Operations, with a dotted line to the SVP Development US & Canada, you will be responsible for tracking planning initiatives, leveraging data to draft clear and compelling communications and presentations, and working on initiatives to secure deals and identify and close business performance gaps.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Lead a team of analysts who support new hotel project leads and pitches. Responsibilities include: RFP support, lead generation and owner analysis, and delivering ad hoc analysis, reports, and visual presentations tailored to Developer needs.Partner with the Development Analytics and Strategy teams to support regional Development leaders in identifying and closing business performance gaps.Collaborate closely with the VP Global Development Operations to monitor rolling performance and recommend solutions to meet NUG goals.Support the VP Global Development Operations and the SVP Development US & Canada in tracking and executing key strategic initiatives and leading the creation of meeting agendas and follow up deliverables to ensure leaders have the organized information they need to do their jobs.

Collaborate effectively with Developers, Development Analytics, Marketing, AD&C, and Strategy teams to assist the Development team to help shape and refine Development strategy.Partner with Developers globally to understand and proactively anticipate operational needs, delivering targeted support that enhances Development effectiveness.Partner closely with the Americas Development Leadership Team, VP Global Development Operations, and cross functional stakeholders throughout the organization (e.g. Human Resources, Corporate Development, GBCS planning leads, etc.) to foster alignment, communication, and team engagement.

Projects You'll Take Ownership Of

Identifying, executing, and tracking to a lead generation strategy that aligns with our Enterprise growth strategy and yearly goals.Create meeting agenda, communications, analyses, reports, and visual presentations that proactively meet Developer needs.Champion improvements for processes related to deal signing, cross-functional collaboration, and Development incentive goal setting.Planning and content development for Leadership Team meetings, offsites, cross functional initiatives, and follow-up action plans that drive focus on the priorities, create strong team alignment, and as well as support new team member onboarding.Collaborate closely with Development Marketing to maximize the power of our data and investments to generate results.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

Seven (7) years of work experience in Hotel Development, Advanced Analytics, Reporting, Sales/RFPs or a closely related fieldFive (5) years of experience in strategy, analysis, or project management working in the Real Estate or Hospitality IndustryStrong analytical skills in using data to drive strategy and key decisionsHigh proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPointExperience with Salesforce, STR, Costar, ArcGIS, Tableau, and complex databasesTravel up to 30%Onsite in McLean, VA

It Would Be Useful If You Have

BA/BS/Bachelor's DegreeExperience working in a heavily matrixed environmentA solid understanding of and a passion for Development and the Hospitality industry

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:
