rows.title: Sr. Category Manager-Live New Verticals
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

eBay Live is a new way to sell on eBay, where sellers and buyers interact live on video. eBay sellers build buyer trust, expand their customer base, and grow repeat business through consistent and engaging live streams on eBay Live.

We are looking for a strong leader to drive discovery for Category Expansion on eBay Live. Live Category Managers own the P&L for their live commerce categories, driving GMV by spearheading seller acquisition, development, and a pipeline of innovative live events. Apply strategic business knowledge with a creative approach to innovate content and establish standard methodologies.

Visit https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive/ to sample past events and to see what’s coming up next!

What You Will Do

Category Growth & P&L Management:Deliver GMV targets through strategic category plans, continuously refined by learnings from new content and format trials.Seller Ecosystem & Success:Set the strategy for recruiting, onboarding, and cultivating a portfolio of high-potential live sellers, brands, and creators.Create a playbook to coach sellers on all aspects of live selling: from assortment and developing innovative run-of-show/format ideas to on-camera performance, live audience engagement, and using analytics for growth.Live Content & Programming Innovation:Develop a pipeline of engaging live events, fostering creative show concepts and encouraging sellers to test new, interactive "shoppertainment" formats.Drive an editorial standard to elevate content quality and viewer experience.Performance Analysis & Best Practice Development:Track category performance and analyze outcomes from pilot programs and new format trials to identify key growth drivers.Actively contribute to defining meaningful KPIs and scalable best practices for the evolving live commerce landscape.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operations:Partner with internal teams (marketing, product, operations) to champion seller needs, share insights, and drive platform success.Lead category-specific budgets and operational aspects efficiently.


What You Will Bring

Minimum of 6+ years in Category Management BA/BS required, post-graduate business degree (for example MBA) a plusA point of view on what eBay Live needs to do to win in this marketExcellent analytical skills; you must be able to pull insights from data with facility, create and test hypotheses and read out your results and generally put together qualitative and quantitative data to drive forward a learning agendaThe hunger to work in a very fast paced startup environment with rapid iteration and flexibility to work extended hours if neededThe creativity required to work around product gaps to grow this businessBroad functional experience with proven success in leading teams with varied strengths including marketing, product, operations, customer insights, and seller/account managementExcellent decision-making skills, focused on identifying and prioritizing the highest impact opportunities with imperfect information using the data availableStrong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to tell an elegant story backed by data and provide leadership-ready recommendationsInterest and/or experience in the Motors segment a plus


Additional Details

The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below:

$103,600 - $177,800

Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employees will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. rows.title: Staff Software Engineer, Logistics Microservices
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

About the Team

The Logistics Technology team at Williams-Sonoma, Inc. builds and supports the platforms that move product across our supply chain — from distribution center operations and warehouse management to transportation and delivery for brands including Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Rejuvenation. We partner closely with Supply Chain, Distribution Center operations, and third-party vendors to deliver scalable microservices that keep fulfillment fast, accurate, and cost-effective. It is a hands-on, high-ownership team where engineers work end to end — designing systems, integrating with WMS and TMS platforms, and applying automation and AI to improve how our distribution network runs every day.

About The Role

The Staff Software Engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade, scalable microservices applications supporting Logistics and Warehouse Management Systems. This role requires strong technical leadership, hands-on development expertise, and close collaboration with cross-functional business and technology teams, including third-party vendors such as Manhattan Associates.

Responsibilities


Provide technical leadership for the Logistics domain — designing, developing, and leading delivery of scalable, enterprise-grade microservices.Drive hands-on development of Java and Spring Boot services, RESTful APIs, and event-driven integrations using Kafka.Define and enforce engineering standards for secure coding, unit testing, Git branching strategy, and code quality.Lead deployments and CI/CD automation on containerized platforms, including automated testing and release readiness.Own application health in production — monitoring, alerting, incident triage, and root-cause resolution.Lead integrations across Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, Slotting, and Labor Management systems and Distribution Center operations.Partner with business stakeholders and third-party vendors such as Manhattan Associates to translate logistics requirements into scalable technical solutions.Identify and deliver AI and automation opportunities that improve Logistics operations, production support, and business-user productivity.Drive Agile delivery — sprint planning, estimation, and delivery tracking — and mentor engineers to raise the bar across the team.


Criteria

Experience

rows.title: Associate Buyer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Associate Buyer will elevate Macy’s competitive position by buying merchandise to drive sales and profitability across stores and online for your family of business. You will work closely with existing vendors to curate a distinguished Macy’s assortment, as well as seek out new and differentiating vendors to satisfy our customer demand. The Associate, Buyer will focus on achieving sales, gross margin, turn over and pricing execution in your assigned area of the business. You will develop and implement strategies by vendor, collaborating with planning to analyze and respond to sales trends.

An Associate Buyer is known as a trusted, collaborative, and results-oriented leader, serving as a key business partner and change agent with the ability to lead through influence. Demonstrating professional maturity and industry credibility, the ideal candidate must navigate and lead effectively through significant complexity. A crucial aspect is the candidate's comfort and effectiveness in promptly evaluating and phasing out legacy approaches that no longer align with the current strategy. Equally valued is the candidate's reputation for visionary thinking and a strong commitment to swift decision-making.

What You Will Do

Make all purchasing decisions independently of Buying Director that satisfies the customer demand to achieves sales, turn and margin plan.Understand competitive marketplace and pursues white space opportunities that align with company strategy.Competitive shop and determine the action necessary to address competitive challenges. Identify any product opportunities and provide suggestions and input in product development to vendors.Support Buying Director to drive in-season business effectively by influencing promotional strategies based on current business needs.Attend Market appointments prepared with strategic assortment plans and an understanding of product to support customer preferences.Set the vision and determine call to action for assortment-building opportunities in partnership with Planning, Pricing and Cross Functional partners. Collaborate with planning partner to develop and execute assortment strategy.Develop pre-season assortment vision that ties to company key priorities and insights from Digital and Planning Director counterparts.Partner with Financial Planning to ensure department-level financial targets support assortment strategy.Decide on in-season changes for the department and vendors based on sales, margin, and turn forecast from Financial Planning.Support the Financial Planning and Buying Director in building seasonal strategy components based on targets.Provide Buying Director with category, class, and item performance analysis to assist in determining in-season item-level changes to make.Maintain an industry presence that allows for connections, new business opportunities, and ideas at Macy’s. Represent and support the Macy’s brand while maintaining this presence.Communicate with vendors to ensure timely collection of MDAs/markdowns/RTVs and partner with Financial Planning to ensure alignment with in-season VMT input.Rely on data analytics (PE and dynamic pricing) to develop POS and Perm pricing strategy and ensure execution is as intended, hitting financial metrics and driving sales and profitability. Review discount rate and sales performance in promo planner, making adjustments as needed to hit financial sales and margin goals.Execute both POS pricing in promo planner, using dynamic recommends, and work with the associate buyer on permanent markdown execution in UPM.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communities.In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Financial Business Acumen: Ability to understand and analyze financial aspects to make informed strategic decisions.

Retail Strategy and Tactics: In-depth knowledge of market trends, customer behaviors, and competitive landscapes..

Change Management: Comfort and effectiveness in leading teams through change ensuring successful adaptation.

Visionary Thinking: Ability to be a forward thinking and innovative leader with a vision to drive transformative strategies propelling family of business to new heights.

Communication Skills: Effective communication with candor, valuing open debate to bring the best ideas to life.

Growth Mindset: A growth-oriented mindset, coupled with the ability to coach teams in embracing growth opportunities.

Strategic Planning: Experience in driving strategies and plans supporting a compelling core and curated assortment.

Collaboration and Coordination: Skill in partnering closely with General Business Managers (GBMs) and Digital Directors for coordination and alignment across digital strategy and families of business.

Who You Are

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 3+ years of direct experience. Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference; apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs. 

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discountsPerformance-based incentivesAnnual merit reviewEmployee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial adviceTuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. 

MERCH00

This position may be eligible for performance-based incentives/bonuses. Benefits include 401k, medical/vision/dental/life/disability insurance options, PTO accruals, Holidays, and more. Eligibility requirements may apply based on location, job level, classification, and length of employment. Additional benefit details are available at macysJOBS.com.

rows.title: Senior Marketing Operations Support Analyst (contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Please note that this is a contract role providing services to Hilton through Talent Solutions. If you are selected for this role, you will be employed by Talent Solutions and will not be an employee of Hilton. Contract workers are not employees of Hilton or any of its subsidiaries, nor will they be eligible for Hilton benefits.

US based remote role with a preference for a candidate near McLean, VA or in ET or CT***

Job Summary

This is an exciting opportunity to play a meaningful role within a dynamic Marketing Operations team that powers one of the world's most recognized hospitality brands. In this individual contributor contract role, you will serve as a front-line support and enablement resource for team members across Marketing and Loyalty, helping them get the most out of a shared work management platform. You will translate real business needs into practical, system-supported solutions, build and maintain instructional and onboarding content, and ensure that users across teams can work efficiently, consistently, and with confidence. By identifying patterns, improving processes, and delivering reliable operational support, you will help drive adoption, governance, and operational excellence across a large and collaborative marketing organization.

Responsibilities

 Partner with Marketing Operations team members and business stakeholders to understand process needs, translate them into system-supported ways of working, and reinforce consistent adoption across teams. Build and update work management system elements, including bases, interfaces, dashboards and reporting views, automations, and other process tools that improve efficiency and effectiveness for Marketing, Loyalty, and Luxury teams. Provide prompt front-line support for functionality and how-to questions, issue reports, access questions, training needs, and process guidance requests. Triage support requests before escalation, supplying the next support tier with the context, examples, screenshots, expected outcomes, and troubleshooting details needed to resolve each request efficiently. Develop and maintain onboarding, training, and enablement materials, including quick-reference guides, onboarding content, support-channel resources, and application adoption communications. Support configuration, quality assurance, enhancement testing, automation support, and documentation for new builds and system improvements. Serve as a backup resource for access requests, including adding users, updating access, and maintaining user records in accordance with licensing, budget, security, and governance guidelines. Support monthly license audits, ad-hoc user-management reporting, support-request tracking, and training or adoption metrics where available. Identify common questions and recurring pain points, document patterns, recommend improvements, and help teams apply work management system best practices consistently. Build strong working relationships with Marketing Operations team members, cross-functional business stakeholders, system users, and technical support partners. Explain system functionality and process guidance clearly, using little to no technical jargon, and present practical guidance virtually to a mix of small and large groups. Work independently with minimal oversight while communicating priorities, risks, open questions, and escalation needs in a timely and service-oriented manner.

Skills

 Strong experience creating work management solutions within Airtable or comparable operational platforms, including bases, interfaces, dashboards, and automations. Solid understanding of basic database concepts, work intake, workflow design, and operational governance. Demonstrated ability to support user adoption, training, onboarding, enablement, or change management, including creating clear user guidance, instructional content, and process documentation. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an approachable, authentic, and confident style and the ability to build productive working relationships quickly. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including the ability to maintain accurate records and operational documentation. Resourceful, self-motivated, and service-oriented approach, with the ability to adapt to changing business needs and manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder requests simultaneously. Comfort presenting virtually to small and large groups and translating technical concepts into practical, accessible user guidance. Familiarity with agile and waterfall work processes, no-code or low-code automation, and AI tools and concepts is a plus. Comfort with advanced reporting, support-request tracking, and operational data quality is a plus.

Experience

 3+ years of professional experience, including 2+years supporting or administering an Airtable-based work management or project management system, database, marketing technology, or comparable operational platform is required. 2+ years of experience supporting work management, project management, marketing operations, databases, or no-code or low-code platforms is preferred. 1+ years of experience supporting system adoption, documentation, and training for cross-functional users or teams is preferred. Experience with Airtable's Enterprise version is preferred.

This role offers a rare opportunity to make a visible and lasting impact within a globally recognized brand by helping an ambitious marketing organization work smarter and more consistently. You will gain hands-on experience with enterprise-scale marketing operations, build meaningful cross-functional relationships, and contribute directly to the tools and processes that keep a high-performing team running at its best. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment and take pride in delivering clear, practical solutions that genuinely help people do their jobs better, this is the role for you.

Position Summary

Marriott International is seeking a strategic and execution-focused leader to serve as Senior Director, AI Data within the Data Services organization. Reporting to the Managing Vice President, Data Services, this role will lead the design and delivery of the AI-ready data foundation on which enterprise AI products, analytics, personalization, and intelligent experiences depend.

This leader will be responsible for transforming Marriott data into trusted, contextualized, reusable, and safely consumable assets for both human users and AI systems. The role brings together enterprise semantic models, knowledge graphs, metadata, data products, feature and context services, and governed access patterns that allow AI systems to discover, interpret, and use enterprise information with confidence.

This is a build-and-transform mandate within Data Services, requiring strong partnership across Data Platform, Data Engineering, Data Governance, AI/ML, Digital, Loyalty, Operations, Commercial, and corporate functions. The Senior Director will help define a multi-year roadmap for AI Data and deliver the capabilities sequentially with measurable business impact.

Expected Contributions

Enterprise Ontology & Semantic Layer

Define and govern the shared vocabulary of the enterprise so systems, models, analytics, and AI agents operate from consistent definitions of core concepts such as guest, property, stay, transaction, loyalty interaction, reservation, and operational event. Lead the development of business-aligned semantic models and common data definitions that improve interoperability, reuse, and decision consistency across Marriott. Partner with domain leaders and governance teams to ensure semantic assets are owned, maintained, and embedded into data products and consumption experiences. 

Connected Knowledge Graph

Move beyond rows-and-tables thinking toward a relationship-first intelligence layer that connects guest signals, property attributes, loyalty behavior, digital interactions, commercial activity, and operational events. Lead the design and delivery of knowledge graph capabilities that allow AI systems and analysts to reason across relationships, context, and enterprise entities. Prioritize high-value graph use cases that support personalization, service recovery, operational intelligence, marketing effectiveness, and decision automation. 

Agent-Discoverable Metadata

Create metadata capabilities that make data assets machine-readable, discoverable, trusted, and usable by AI systems with appropriate human oversight. Expand metadata coverage across business glossary, lineage, freshness, ownership, quality, usage, and access classifications. Partner with Data Governance and Data Platform teams to embed metadata as a core service for AI, analytics, and enterprise data consumption. 

MCP Servers & Agent APIs

Shape governed interfaces through which internal and partnered AI agents can query enterprise knowledge, retrieve context, and trigger approved actions. Partner with AI, platform, security, privacy, and architecture teams to establish Model Context Protocol patterns, agent APIs, auditability, and policy controls. Ensure AI consumption patterns are designed for scale, transparency, access control, and responsible enterprise use. 

Real-Time Knowledge Movement

Advance event-driven and freshness-aware data capabilities so knowledge assets and downstream AI consumers reflect current reality rather than stale snapshots. Partner with engineering and platform teams to reduce batch dependencies where near-real-time context is required for AI and business decisioning. Drive standards for freshness, observability, reliability, and operational readiness across priority AI Data assets. 

AI Data Products & Context Services

Establish reusable AI-ready data products, features, embeddings, vectorized assets, and context services that accelerate delivery of GenAI, ML, personalization, analytics, and agentic solutions. Promote domain-oriented ownership and lifecycle management for data products used by AI and advanced analytics teams. Reduce duplication and improve speed-to-market by standardizing how context and reusable intelligence assets are created, managed, and consumed. 

Candidate Profile

Education And Experience Required

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, Business, or a related field. Ten or more years of experience in knowledge engineering, enterprise data, analytics, applied-AI platforms, data architecture, or related disciplines. At least five years of experience owning end-to-end delivery of enterprise-scale data, AI, analytics, or platform capabilities. Demonstrable experience designing, delivering, or operating one or more of the following: enterprise ontologies, semantic layers, production knowledge graphs, metadata platforms, feature stores, or real-time data infrastructure. Experience leading cross-functional teams and complex transformation efforts in a large, matrixed, global organization. Working fluency with the agentic-AI stack, including model context interfaces, retrieval architectures, vector stores, graph stores, metadata-driven systems, and enterprise governance patterns. Experience with AI-ready data capabilities such as context layers, semantic models, vectorized data assets, feature stores, knowledge graphs, and governed APIs. 

Preferred Qualifications

Strong understanding of data privacy, security, access controls, lineage, data quality, stewardship, and responsible AI practices. Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and communicate with clarity on data strategy, AI readiness, risk, architecture, and business value. Comfort operating with senior stakeholders including executives, audit, risk, legal, privacy, owners, franchise partners, and business leaders. Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical, product, and data talent. Governed agent access patterns support responsible, auditable, and scalable AI consumption across internal and partnered use cases.

rows.title: GM, VAS Partnerships
rows.descriptionText:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About EBay

eBay is a global commerce leader that connects millions of buyers and sellers around the world. We exist to enable economic opportunity for individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and organizations of all sizes. Our culture encourages people to think big, be curious, act with integrity, and be courageously inclusive. If this sounds compelling, come join us.

About Value Added Services (VAS)

Value Added Services (VAS) extend eBay’s core marketplace experience by adding services that increase convenience, peace of mind, and expertise for our customers. VAS powers a scalable services ecosystem across eBay’s buyer and seller journeys, including offerings such as shipping and logistics solutions, warranties and protection plans, authentication and grading, installation and repair, and other service partnerships attached to items and transactions. VAS has already driven meaningful incremental GMV and service revenue, and is a key growth pillar for the company as we deepen trust and engagement on the platform.

About The Role

We are seeking a GM of VAS Partnerships to lead the commercial strategy and partner ecosystem for Value Added Services at eBay. This role reports to the Head of Advertising within the Services Business Unit and will own the end-to-end partnerships and commercial model for the VAS portfolio, building and scaling a services ecosystem that delivers tangible customer value while driving incremental GMV and service revenue.

This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, strategy, and P&L ownership. You will be responsible for defining the partner strategy, sourcing and structuring high-impact deals, managing ongoing partner performance, and collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and category teams. You will also work in close partnership with Ads, Services Product, and Focus Categories teams to create integrated commercial offerings and attach services to core experiences.

The ideal candidate is an experienced commercial and partnerships leader who is comfortable moving from long-term strategy to detailed deal execution, can navigate complex internal and external stakeholder environments, and has a track record of building and scaling partner-driven businesses.

What You Will Accomplish

VAS commercial and partnership strategy: Define a multi-year commercial strategy for VAS partnerships that is tightly aligned with eBay’s broader Services, Ads, and Focus Categories priorities. Segment and prioritize service domains such as logistics, protection, authentication, installation, and financial services, along with specific partners, based on customer needs, economics, and strategic fit. Develop clear theses on where to build versus partner, where to consolidate versus expand partners, how to differentiate eBay’s services ecosystem in the market, and translate this into a focused roadmap of initiatives with explicit objectives, economics, and timelines.

Partner ecosystem building and deal execution: Source, evaluate, and close high-impact partnerships with service providers across priority domains and markets to strengthen eBay’s VAS ecosystem. Lead end-to-end deal structuring and negotiations, including commercial terms, revenue-sharing models, incentives, SLAs, data and reporting expectations, and governance frameworks. Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Privacy to ensure deals are structured responsibly for sustainable scale, and codify repeatable playbooks and standard frameworks so the team can execute recurring partnership models faster and more consistently over time.

P&L ownership and performance management: Own the commercial performance of the VAS partner portfolio, with accountability for service revenue, incremental GMV, attach rates, and unit economics. Define, track, and report on KPIs across services, partners, and markets, analyzing performance drivers and prioritizing actions that move the most important levers. Continuously optimize economics through pricing, packaging, and yield management, and lead regular business reviews with partners and internal leadership to surface insights, opportunities, and risks with clear recommendations

Cross-functional leadership and integration: Work hand-in-hand with VAS Product and Engineering to integrate partner services into the VAS platform and buyer/seller experiences in a scalable, high-quality way. Partner with category and regional teams to tailor VAS offerings to vertical and market needs, supported by the right GTM and merchandising plans. Collaborate with Ads and other Services lines of business to design integrated offerings (for example Ads + VAS bundles and campaigns) and serve as a key VAS voice in cross-functional forums that connect commercial objectives with product roadmaps, marketing plans, and operational capabilities.

Team leadership and ways of working: Build and lead a high-performing VAS Partnerships team that may include partnership managers, commercial managers, and analysts. Establish clear goals, operating rhythms, and decision mechanisms that enable the team to move quickly while staying aligned with broader company priorities. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer-centricity grounded in data-driven decision making and rigorous follow-through, and represent VAS Partnerships in executive forums with concise, insight-rich updates on strategy, performance, and upcoming decisions.

rows.title: Inventory Planner
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Inventory Planner (Omni)

Overview Of The Inventory Planner (Omni) Role

The Inventory Planner (Omni) is responsible for supporting inventory planning and execution for our Omni services, including Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Buy Online Ship From Store (BOSFS), and Buy Online Ship to Store (BOSTS).

This role partners with Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Distribution, Store Operations, E-commerce, and IT to help maximize sales, optimize inventory turn, support in-stock goals, and deliver a best-in-class customer experience across Omni fulfillment channels.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, curious, and comfortable using data to identify business trends, support recommendations, and help improve inventory outcomes across stores and digital channels.

Responsibilities


 Support inventory planning for Omni services, including BOPIS, BOSFS, and BOSTS, to help drive sales, improve inventory productivity, and support customer fulfillment goals.  Review Corporate Open-To-Buy plans submitted by Inventory teams, along with historical Omni performance, to help build store-level forecasts for BOSFS and BOPIS labor planning.  Analyze Omni sales, inventory availability, fulfillment trends, backorder opportunities, cancellation risk, and store performance to identify risks and opportunities.  Support BOSFS inventory strategies that help maximize sales, leverage available store inventory, reduce aged or clearance inventory, and mitigate backorder risk.  Partner with Store Operations to monitor store fulfillment performance and identify opportunities to improve on-time service, reduce delays, and support customer experience goals.  Partner with Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Visual, and Store Operations to review floor set plans, key-item representation, presentation minimums, and safety stock needs to help protect in-store selling and display quantities.  Leverage historical data to identify key learnings around product, pricing, seasonality, inventory, and Omni fulfillment behavior, and apply those learnings to future planning decisions.  Prepare recurring reporting and analysis to support Omni planning conversations, business reviews, and cross-functional decision-making.  Partner with Distribution, Inventory, and IT teams to help troubleshoot Omni inventory, reporting, fulfillment, and process issues.  Support standardized processes, documentation, and reporting routines that improve visibility, reduce manual work, and create consistency across Omni inventory planning workflows.  Use approved AI tools, automation, reporting tools, or planning systems to support analysis, improve recurring workflows, and identify opportunities to work more efficiently.  Operate a computer and communicate via telephone.  Transport materials and equipment and lift, move, and carry objects up to 50 pounds on a limited basis. 


Criteria


 Data-driven individual with a curious, analytical, and collaborative mindset.  Minimum two years of experience in Inventory Management, Inventory Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, Merchandise Planning, E-commerce Planning, or a related retail function.  Omnichannel, e-commerce, store fulfillment, or retail inventory experience preferred.  Proven ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear business recommendations.  Proficiency in retail math, including sales, inventory, turn, receipts, margin, markdowns, and open-to-buy concepts.  Experience supporting forecasts, reporting, inventory analysis, or recurring business review processes.  Strong proficiency in MS Excel; experience with planning systems, reporting tools, dashboards, or data visualization tools preferred.  Curious and proactive in adopting approved AI tools, automation, and reporting enhancements to improve analysis, reduce manual work, and support better decision-making.  Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Inventory, Merchandising, Store Operations, Distribution, E-commerce, and IT.  Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize workload, manage deadlines, and follow through on multiple tasks.  Flexible and adaptive to changing priorities, business needs, and process changes. 


Our Culture & Values

We believe that taking care of our people is vital to our success, and we strive to offer equitable and transparent practices for all. We prioritize connection, growth, and wellbeing.

People First

Putting People First means investing in overall well-being and opportunities to grow and advance within the organization. Depending on the position and location, here are a few highlights of what benefits may be available:

Benefits


 A generous discount on all WSI brands A 401(k) plan and other investment opportunities Paid vacations, holidays, and time off to volunteer Health benefits, dental and vision insurance, including same-sex domestic partner benefits Tax-free commuter benefits A wellness program that supports your physical, financial and emotional health


Continued Learning


 In-person and online learning opportunities through WSI University Cross-brand and cross-function career opportunities Resources for self-development Advisor (Mentor) program Career development workshops, learning programs, and speaker series


WSI will not now or in the future commence an immigration case or "sponsor" an individual for this position (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration).

This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Williams-Sonoma, Inc. will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, or other applicable state or local laws and ordinances.

The expected starting pay range for this position is $75,000-$85,000. Applicable pay ranges may differ across markets. Actual pay will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. In addition to competitive pay, compensation may include a variety of other components like benefits, paid time off, merit, and bonus opportunities.

About Us

Our Company

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of high-quality products for the kitchen and home in the United States. Our family of brands are Williams Sonoma, Williams Sonoma Home, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, Pottery Barn Teen, Rejuvenation, West Elm, Mark & Graham, Outward, and GreenRow. These brands are among the best known and most respected in the industry. We offer beautifully-designed, stylish and functional products for every area of the home, including the kitchen, living room, bedroom, home office, closet, laundry room and even outdoor spaces. We've seen some big changes since our first brick-and-mortar store opened more than half of a century ago. What hasn't changed is our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, and enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities where we operate. Today, we're a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

Job Summary

The Director, Luxury Intelligence leads the intelligence capability that supports Marriott International's Luxury Group across brands, customers, competitors and commercial strategy. Working within the Customer Domain inside Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI, the Director partners closely with Luxury leadership, partner disciplines, and continent teams to translate data and research into insight that informs enterprise decision-making.

The role delivers analytical depth across the Luxury customer landscape, the competitive environment, and the commercial and distribution channels that shape performance. The Director is expected to bring both analytical rigor and business judgment, communicate complex findings clearly to senior audiences, and build strong working relationships across a matrixed organization.

This is a leadership role within a growing function, offering the opportunity to contribute to how Marriott builds and applies customer and market intelligence in one of its most strategically important segments.

CANDIDATE PROFILE 

Required

Education and Experience 

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or related discipline.8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, intelligence, strategy, or a closely related field, with demonstrated ability to build subject-matter expertise quickly in a complex domain. Demonstrated quantitative rigor and ability to translate complex analysis into clear, decision-useful narratives for senior audiences. 

Preferred

 Advanced degree preferred but not required. Prior experience in luxury hospitality, luxury retail, private banking, luxury goods, or luxury travel distribution (e.g., Amex Platinum / Centurion, Virtuoso, Fine Hotels & Resorts). Experience partnering with senior stakeholders in environments where business context, judgment, and differing viewpoints shape decisions. Experience within an enterprise-level intelligence, insights, or strategy function that integrates multiple analytical disciplines (e.g., customer segmentation, lifetime value, and commercial performance). 

Non-negotiable attributes

Intellectual courage and comfort holding an informed position in the face of differing views. Genuine curiosity about customers, competitors, and markets. Strong collaborator who works well within a team and brings a clear point of view while remaining open to being convinced by better arguments. 

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES 

Leads the Luxury Intelligence capability within the Customer Domain, proactively delivering insight across customer, competitive, commercial, and distribution dimensions. Positions the function as a strategic thought partner to the Luxury Group from the ideation stage of key business questions. Owns the enterprise Luxury Intelligence narrative and connects Luxury-specific insight to broader enterprise decisions. Develops distribution intelligence across wholesale, travel advisors, GSO, consortia, and bank programs, quantifying incrementality and net revenue impact. Applies the Customer Domain operating principles in day-to-day work: rigorous single-slide storytelling, disciplined prioritization, and effective partnership with Agile delivery teams. Manages and develops direct reports; attracts, retains, and coaches talent. Serves as the face of Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI for the Luxury Group and operates as a trusted, senior counterpart to leadership across the discipline.

Bringing that to life takes exceptional leaders.

Leadership at Chewy is guided by our Operating Principles, which define how we lead, make decisions, develop talent, serve our customers, and grow our business. We value leaders who think strategically, stay close to the customer, and aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves alongside their teams. They solve complex challenges, build high-performing organizations, and partner closely with senior leaders to shape the future of Chewy.

Our Opportunity

Chewy is seeking a Director, Broad-Based Compensation to join our Total Rewards team, reporting directly to the Head of Total Rewards. This leadership opportunity is ideal for an experienced compensation executive who enjoys building high-performing teams, partnering with senior business leaders, and shaping compensation strategy in a fast-growing, evolving organization. This leader will oversee Chewy's Broad-Based Compensation function, leading a team of compensation professionals responsible for supporting enterprise compensation strategy, market competitiveness, and compensation programs across the organization.

What You'll Do

 Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of compensation professionals while creating an environment focused on collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional client service. Drive the evolution of Chewy's broad-based compensation philosophy, programs, and practices to ensure they remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with business strategy. rows.title: Vice President, Regional Operations - eCommerce Fulfillment and Light Manufacturing
rows.descriptionText:
Role Overview

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

The Vice President of Operations leads a large-scale ecommerce fulfillment, distribution, and light manufacturing operation across multiple US sites, reporting to the Chief Supply Chain & Manufacturing Officer.

This is both a strategic and hands-on role. The VP sets multi-year direction, manages P&L impact, drives continuous improvement, optimizes network performance, partners with vendors and develops a strong leadership bench while staying close to daily execution, ensuring critical peak period performance, improving cost-to-serve and delivering reliable customer service.

The ideal candidate brings experience in high-volume e-commerce and small-parcel fulfillment with the technical, analytical, and people-leadership capabilities needed to scale operations, strengthen process discipline, reduce costs, improve quality, and deliver superior customer experience.

What You’ll Do

Lead Regional Operations


 Own regional site performance across safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, inventory accuracy, and customer experience. Translate business growth objectives into scalable operating models, staffing plans, facility strategies, process standards, and performance systems. Build short-, mid-, and long-term operating plans that align capacity, labor, systems, automation, service levels, customer promise, and cost structure. Oversee and develop Site Operations, Engineering, Safety, and Operational Excellence leaders.


Drive E-commerce Fulfillment, and Small-Parcel Performance


 Lead high-volume ecommerce fulfillment including order flow, pick-pack-ship, sortation, returns, exception management, and on time ship and customer service performance Improve order cycle time, dock-to-stock performance, units per labor hour, cost per order, cost per shipment, inventory accuracy, damage rates, returns handling, and carrier performance. Partner with Transportation, Customer Experience, Merchandising, Planning, Finance, IT, and external providers to ensure fulfillment performance supports customer expectations and business growth. Own peak readiness: capacity planning, labor modeling, inventory positioning, contingency planning and disciplined execution. Manage parcel carrier, 3PL, packaging, automation and maintenance vendor relationships.


Scale Light Manufacturing and Technical Operations


 Lead light manufacturing and personalization across Softline and Hardlines merchandise, including packaging, quality control, production planning, and value-added services. Apply engineering, Lean, Six Sigma, and process design principles to improve flow, reduce variation, eliminate waste, and increase repeatability. Partner with Engineering and Facilities on layout, material flow, equipment reliability, ergonomics, automation readiness, and capital projects. Evaluate and implement new technologies, equipment, systems, and automation that improve speed, quality, labor efficiency, and scalability.


Build Operational Excellence


 Lead an operating system grounded in Lean, Six Sigma, standard work, visual management, root cause problem-solving, daily management, and disciplined KPI review. Establish scorecards across safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, inventory, and customer outcomes. Sponsor major transformation initiatives including facility redesign, WMOS/ERP implementation, automation deployment, systems integration, process standardization, and network optimization. Create a culture of operational discipline where leaders use data, facts, and root cause analysis to solve problems, improve performance, and sustain results.


Own Financial and Strategic Performance


 Own operating budgets, labor plans, productivity commitments and cost improvement plans. Manage P&L-impacting decisions across labor, supplies, freight, parcel, packaging, maintenance, inventory accuracy, quality defects, and vendor spend. Build business cases for capital investments, automation, facility changes, technology upgrades, outsourcing, insourcing, and network changes. Partner with Finance on cost-to-serve models, productivity targets, and operating reviews


Develop People and Culture


 Build a high-performing leadership bench across directors, senior managers, operations managers, engineers, safety leaders, and analysts. Create a culture grounded in safety, accountability, respect, communication, recognition, development, and measurable performance. Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, succession planning, leadership capability, engagement, retention, change management, training, and organizational design. Lead through complexity, ambiguity, growth, turnaround, peak periods, systems change, and operational transformation.


Required Qualifications

What We’re Looking For


 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, Business, or related field. 12+ years of progressive operations leadership in ecommerce direct-to-consumer fulfillment, distribution, logistics, small-parcel operations, light manufacturing, supply chain, or related environments. 5+ years leading Directors, Senior Managers, General Managers across multi-site/multi-function operations. Demonstrated results improving safety, service, quality, productivity, cost, and inventory accuracy in high-volume environments. Strong financial acumen: budgeting, labor planning, cost reduction, and P&L impact. Experience with WMS, ERP, LMS, labor planning, inventory and parcel shipping, and operational dashboards. Track record leading capital projects, technology implementations, equipment/technology deployment or large-scale operational transformation. Builds cross-functional partnerships: Supply Chain, Transportation, Finance, HR, IT, and Customer Experience.


Preferred Qualifications


 Engineering or technical degree; MBA or advanced degree a plus. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Master Black Belt, PMP and/or APICS/ASCM certification. Experience with e-commerce, omnichannel retail, high-SKU operations, parcel shipping, light manufacturing, assembly, customization, packaging, kitting, or personalization. Experience with automation, robotics, conveyor/sortation systems, warehouse control systems, or advanced analytics. Experience managing 3PLs, parcel carriers, automation vendors and outsourced labor providers. Proficiency in SQL, Power BI, Tableau, advanced Excel, data visualization, or similar analytics tools. Background in startups, turnaround, rapid scaling, or facility launch environments.


How We Lead

We hire and develop leaders who role model our WSI Leadership Behaviors. The VP is expected to be:


 Strategic and hands-on: able to set regional direction while understanding what is happening on the floor. Data-driven: uses KPIs, root cause analysis, and financial modeling to make decisions. Customer-focused: understands that operational performance directly affects delivery promise, brand trust, and repeat purchase behavior. Technically credible: able to work effectively with engineering, systems and process design teams. People-centered: develop leaders, create an engaging culture, and build accountability. Change-capable: experienced in leading transformation, process standardization, systems implementation, and performance turnarounds. Commercially sharp: understands cost-to-serve, P&L impact, capital ROI, labor leverage, and service tradeoffs.


What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means:


 Measurable improvement in service, quality, cost, inventory accuracy and customer delivery. Stronger peak readiness and labor planning discipline with operational consistency. rows.title: Senior Program Manager - Payment Operations - Healthcare
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Location: Bellevue, WA, Boston, MA, or Plantation, FL

Hybrid: 3 days/week in office

Our Opportunity

Chewy's mission is to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents and partners everywhere. We view pets and pet parents as family and are obsessed with meeting their needs and exceeding expectations through every interaction. Within Chewy, the Payments team improves the customer and care team experience by launching better ways to pay, increasing payment success, strengthening reliability, and reducing the cost and friction of payments.

Chewy is hiring a Senior Program Manager, Payment Operations - Healthcare in Bellevue, WA, Plantation, FL, or Boston, MA to lead payment health, readiness, and optimization across Chewy Healthcare. In this role, you will be the senior operational owner for in-clinic, digital, and recurring payments used by customers and clinic care teams, and internal operators. You will manage performance, partner escalations, and cross-functional execution for capabilities that are critical to customer experience and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced payments and operations leader who has owned outcomes in a scaled retail, fintech, ecommerce, marketplace, subscription, or omnichannel environment. This person combines payments depth with senior program leadership and can move between strategic planning and hands-on issue resolution. They have improved one-time and recurring payment experiences, including authorization performance, stored credentials, tokenization, retry strategies, and decline recovery. They can quickly build credibility, simplify complex topics, identify customer and business impact, and lead partners across Product, Engineering, Clinic Operations, Customer Care, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Legal/Compliance, and external payment providers.

What You'll Do

Own the operational roadmap for Healthcare payments across in-clinic, digital, and recurring workflows.Define, monitor, and improve payment metrics such as success rate, authorization performance, recurring payment recovery, terminal reliability, refund/void quality, decline trends, incident volume, and SLAs.Strengthen recurring payment operations, including stored credential health, tokenization, card lifecycle events, payment retries, decline recovery, account updater processes, and payment method reliability.Lead Healthcare payment launches, enhancements, defect resolution, and operational readiness across Product, Engineering, Clinic Operations, Customer Care, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Legal/Compliance, and external partners.Identify payment defects and reliability risks, quantify customer and financial impact, and drive prioritized resolution.Build and improve operating mechanisms such as dashboards, runbooks, escalation paths, incident response processes, post-incident reviews, partner reviews, and readiness checklists.Manage external payment providers, terminal providers, gateways, processors, and other third parties against SLAs, roadmap dependencies, issue resolution, and improvement plans.Lead incident response and root-cause analysis in partnership with internal and external teams; convert learnings into durable prevention and monitoring mechanisms.Develop executive-ready narratives, business reviews, and recommendations that connect payment performance with customer experience, care team experience, cost, risk, and business impact.Serve as a payments subject matter expert for card-present, card-not-present, recurring payments, terminal, refund, reconciliation, and operational support workflows across Healthcare.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in business, finance, operations, technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years of experience in payments, payment operations, fintech, ecommerce, retail, healthcare operations, marketplace operations, subscription/recurring payments, or another scaled operational environment.5+ years leading complex cross-functional programs with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Customer Care/Operations, Legal/Compliance, and external partners.Track record owning payment KPIs and operational outcomes such as payment success rate, authorization rate, decline rate, terminal availability, refund/void performance, dispute rate, reconciliation quality, cost of payments, or SLA performance.Direct experience with card-present and card-not-present payment flows, including gateways, processors, acquirers, issuers, card networks, digital wallets, payment terminals, stored credentials, tokenization, settlement, refunds, disputes, and reconciliation.Experience with recurring or subscription-like payment programs, including stored credentials, payment retries, decline recovery, account updater/card lifecycle management, payment method lifecycle events, or recurring billing reliability.Experience supporting omnichannel, healthcare, clinic, field, retail, marketplace, ecommerce, or service-oriented environments where both customer and operator workflows matter.Strong analytical capability with the ability to use payment data, processor reporting, decline trends, defects, and customer/care team feedback to identify root causes and drive action.Proven ability to operate in ambiguity, dive into details, and lead issue resolution without direct authority.Strong vendor and partner management experience, including performance reviews, escalations, SLA management, roadmap alignment, and operational improvement plans.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing executive-level narratives, business reviews, and decision recommendations.Ability to deliver time-sensitive initiatives while maintaining strong attention to detail and follow-through.Ability to travel up to 15% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with payment terminals, order management, point-of-sale systems, ecommerce, or healthcare/clinic payment workflows.Experience launching or scaling payment capabilities across physical locations, field operations, or distributed teams.Experience improving payment observability, incident response, support models, or partner performance in a high-volume environment.Experience with digital wallets, debit routing, account updater/card lifecycle management, or payment optimization strategies.

Success in This Role Looks Like

Healthcare payment workflows are reliable, measurable, and supported by clear operating mechanisms across in-clinic, digital, and recurring experiences.Customer, clinic, and care team friction is identified quickly, quantified clearly, and resolved through strong cross-functional ownership.Payment partners are managed through business reviews, escalations, SLAs, and improvement plans.Payment incidents have clear response paths, root-cause ownership, durable prevention actions, and improved monitoring.Senior leaders have a clear view of payment performance, risks, tradeoffs, and investment needs across Chewy Healthcare.

Job Description

We are hiring fantastic humans, and we hope that includes you!

Are you looking for more than just a job? At Chewy, you’ll find yourself on a career path alongside other incredible people, like yourself. You’ll join a team that values everything you do, who you are, and the goals you’ve set for your career. We want to give you the opportunity to grow, earn competitive pay, and be happy while you do it. Sounds simple, but we love it.

Our Opportunity

Chewy’s mission is to be the most trusted and convenient destination for pet parents, equine professionals, and partners everywhere. We view pets, pet parents, and the equine community as family and are obsessed with meeting their needs and exceeding customer expectations through every interaction.

As part of Chewy’s SmartPak business, the Associate CRM Marketing Manager is responsible for executing promotional marketing campaigns and optimizing lifecycle marketing campaigns that strengthen customer engagement, retention, and loyalty. This role supports CRM strategy through campaign deployment, audience segmentation, quality assurance, reporting, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver personalized customer experiences that drive business results.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, collaborative, and comfortable managing multiple campaign priorities at once. This role will partner closely with Marketing, Creative, Merchandising, Technology, and business stakeholders to ensure CRM campaigns are delivered accurately, on time, and aligned to SmartPak and Chewy business priorities.

What You’ll Do

Email Campaign Execution

Support CRM and Retention efforts through daily email campaign building and scheduling, ensuring timely delivery of emails.Ensure creative, offers, and copy are properly integrated into campaigns.Partner with cross-functional teams to align email execution with promotions and brand initiatives.Identify and execute A/B testing opportunities to improve overall business performance.Build modular, reusable email templates and components, including headers, footers, product grids, hero blocks, and UGC sections using table-based HTML.Implement responsive layouts, including fluid and hybrid layouts, and dark-mode-safe styles. rows.title: Senior Director, Marketing Performance and Growth
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

The Senior Director, Marketing Performance and Growth will lead a new team responsible for ensuring Hilton's marketing investments are driving optimal brand and commercial outcomes. This is a critical leadership role designed to move Hilton from insight-rich reporting to faster optimization across paid media, digital direct commerce, creative, and growth channels.

This role has accountability for optimization across multiple teams with the goal of reducing the time it takes to move from insight to action. This leader will establish a dedicated performance and optimization hub within Marketing, creating a new operating system with clear ownership, tighter decision-making, and measurable impact on ROI, brand health, channel growth, and digital direct commerce performance.

The Senior Director will be accountable for building the team, operating cadence, cross-functional model, and performance discipline needed to continuously improve how Hilton invests, learns, reallocates, and grows.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

Lead the Marketing Performance & Optimization team, establishing the vision, operating model, governance, and day-to-day ways of working for a new embedded optimization capability.Build a faster insight-to-action model that turns performance signals into concrete recommendations, budget shifts, channel adjustments, creative learnings, and measurable outcomes.Optimize paid media investment and performance across major channels, partnering with media, regional marketing, finance, analytics, and agency teams to ensure spend is continuously evaluated and redeployed toward the highest-value opportunities.Diagnose and improve digital direct commerce performance, identifying opportunities across web, mobile, CRM, media, and other growth channels to accelerate revenue and conversion outcomes.Define, test, and scale growth channels by establishing a disciplined test-and-learn agenda, clear measurement frameworks, and repeatable playbooks for scaling what works.Establish a clear operating cadence for the team, including daily performance signal reviews and anomaly detection, weekly optimization recommendations and budget-shift discussions, and monthly channel role and investment recalibration.Build and maintain marketing tagging and tracking methodology in partnership with Marketing Technology team.Create accountability against goal delivery, ensuring optimization work is tied directly to business outcomes rather than reporting activity alone.Translate complex performance data into clear executive narratives and recommendations that help senior leaders make decisions about marketing investment, channel strategy, and growth opportunities.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Partner closely with Strategy, Insights & Analytics, Finance, Media teams, Regional Marketing leaders, and Agencies to ensure measurement, investment decisions, and optimization actions are connected and aligned.Build and develop a high-performing team with the specialized skills required to drive continuous optimization across analytics, media performance, creative insights, and growth strategy

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

Own end-to-end accountability for improving the performance of Hilton's marketing investments, with a focus on paid media efficiency, digital direct commerce growth, channel performance, and commercial return.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

Twelve plus (12+) years of experience in marketing performance, media strategy, digital commerce, growth marketing, marketing analytics, or related commercial leadership roles.Demonstrated experience managing or influencing large-scale marketing investment decisions across paid media, digital, CRM, mobile, web, or performance channels.Strong understanding of marketing ROI, incrementality, attribution, media measurement, audience strategy, and performance optimization.Experience turning data and insights into practical actions that improve business outcomes.Experience building or leading cross-functional operating models across marketing, analytics, finance, agencies, and commercial teams.Simplify complex performance topics and influence senior stakeholders.Demonstrated leadership of teams, including building new capabilities, setting priorities, and creating accountability in matrixed organizations.Comfort operating in ambiguity and standing up new ways of working where roles, processes, and decision rights need to be clarified.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

Experience in hospitality, travel, retail, loyalty, ecommerce, or another multi-channel consumer business.Experience working in a global or regionally matrixed organization.Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, incrementality testing, media optimization tools, customer data platforms, and agency performance management.Experience connecting creative testing and media optimization to commercial outcomes.

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel programOwn a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial futurePaid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parentsPersonalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved onesCrisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional careMental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters mostHealth & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family coveredFinancial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's nextBenefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $175,000 – $230,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, and the Company's long-term incentive plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

The location for this position is virtual/remote

This is your chance to be part of a Corporate Human Resources team at a top global hospitality company! As a Senior Director, HR Technology Products, you will partner with our business leaders to attract, retain, and develop Hilton's most important asset, our Team Members. On the HR Technology team reporting to the VP of HR Technology & Innovation, you will lead Hilton's global HR Technology Product organization, overseeing the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of our Human Capital Management platforms. You will translate enterprise priorities into product roadmaps and technology capabilities that promote an exceptional Team Member experience while supporting Hilton's global HR strategy.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

Partner with HR Centers of Excellence to understand evolving business priorities and translate them into scalable product capabilities and technology solutions.Collaborate with Global HR Operations and Service Delivery teams to improve product adoption, operational effectiveness, and the Team Member experience.Work with Enterprise Technology, Information Security, Architecture, Data & Analytics, and Integration teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and technical strategy.Partner with the Vice President, HR Technology & Innovation on strategic planning, technology modernization initiatives, and product investment recommendations.Build trusted relationships with senior HR and business leaders to align product priorities, communicate technology capabilities, and support organizational transformation.Collaborate with strategic technology partners, including Oracle and Cornerstone, to maximize platform capabilities and influence future product enhancements.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

HR Technology product roadmaps across Core HR, Recruiting, Learning, and Talent platformsOracle Cloud HCM product lifecycle managementOracle Recruiting Cloud product strategy and optimizationCornerstone Learning platform roadmap and enhancementsProduct governance framework and prioritization processesQuarterly release planning, readiness, and adoption strategyPlatform modernization initiatives, including Redwood adoptionProduct performance, adoption, and customer experience metricsVendor performance management and product roadmap alignmentDevelopment Hilton's HR Technology Product Management organization

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

The pay range for this role is $190,000 - $255,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.
