Description & Requirements

Bloomberg runs on data. Our products are fueled by powerful information. We combine data and context to paint the whole picture for our clients, around the clock - from around the world. In Data, we are responsible for delivering this data, news, and analytics through innovative technology - quickly and accurately. We apply problem-solving skills to identify workflow efficiencies and implement technology solutions to enhance our systems, products, and processes.

Our Team

The Entities Data Management Team owns the core entity data that underpins Bloomberg’s financial products, including corporate hierarchies, risk attribution, and issuer relationships across public and private markets. We’re modernizing how this data is sourced, extracted, processed, and governed—especially from company filings, annual reports, regulatory disclosures, third-party documents, unstructured content, and internal systems.

We are building scalable, automated pipelines and human-in-the-loop workflows to ingest and transform data from high-value documents with the accuracy, transparency, and governance that Bloomberg clients expect. As part of this effort, we are implementing new architecture for document-driven data acquisition, automated extraction, validation, lineage, observability, and quality measurement.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Automation Engineer who operates at the intersection of data engineering, document intelligence, and data product strategy. You’ll help design and build automated ingestion pipelines that extract, normalize, validate, and prepare entity data from company filings, annual reports, regulatory documents, and other structured and unstructured sources.

This role requires someone with a strong understanding of entity and reference data, as well as the technical acumen to design and operate scalable data pipelines for complex document-based workflows. You’ll be expected to profile source documents and extracted datasets, evaluate quality and consistency, and improve automation workflows with a strong focus on data lineage, observability, governance, and human-in-the-loop oversight.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineering, and cross-functional data teams to ensure our platform is extensible, transparent, and aligned to business and client needs. You’ll play a key role in shaping how AI, LLMs, rules-based extraction, and workflow automation are used responsibly to accelerate ingestion while maintaining the quality and auditability expected of Bloomberg data.

We’ll Trust You To

 Design and build automated ingestion pipelines for extracting entity data from company filings, annual reports, regulatory disclosures, third-party documents, and internal sources. Develop scalable workflows for document parsing, data extraction, normalization, validation, enrichment, and publishing readiness. Implement human-in-the-loop processes that allow data specialists to review, validate, correct, and approve extracted data efficiently. Conduct data and document profiling to identify extraction challenges, quality gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for process improvement. Implement data lineage, observability, monitoring, and quality measurement frameworks to ensure transparency, traceability, and reliability across ingestion workflows. Collaborate with Engineering and Product to define and evolve platform requirements, technical architecture, workflow design, and data quality standards. Apply a data product mindset—balancing automation, operational efficiency, data quality, client needs, and long-term maintainability. Support the integration of AI/LLM-based tools, rules-based logic, and other automation techniques as part of a broader document intelligence and data enrichment strategy. Partner with domain experts to design feedback loops that continuously improve extraction accuracy, workflow efficiency, and confidence in automated outputs.

You’ll Need To Have

 Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional work experience 4+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, data automation, or document processing roles. Experience working with financial data, especially within reference, entity, issuer, or company data domains. Strong proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Java, or Scala, and experience with modern data tooling such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, or equivalent technologies. Strong SQL skills for data transformation, validation, quality analysis, and reconciliation. Demonstrated experience working with large-scale datasets and complex data pipelines, ideally in domains such as reference or entity data. Experience building automated ingestion or extraction workflows from structured, semi-structured, or unstructured sources. Understanding of document processing concepts, such as parsing, extraction, normalization, validation, metadata capture, and exception handling. Experience designing or operating human-in-the-loop workflows for data review, quality control, or operational oversight. Deep understanding of data governance, quality frameworks, metadata management, lineage, and auditability. Strong analytical mindset and experience with data profiling, validation techniques, and root-cause analysis. Proven ability to work independently and cross-functionally in a fast-evolving environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical decisions to stakeholders with varying levels of technical knowledge. Experience applying rules-based logic, AI/ML, or LLM-based tools to automate data extraction, classification, validation, or enrichment workflows.

We’d Love To See

 Familiarity with financial documents such as company filings, annual reports, prospectuses, regulatory disclosures, or issuer documentation. Experience with document AI, OCR, NLP, LLM-based extraction, prompt evaluation, or model-assisted data workflows. Familiarity with frameworks like DCAM or DAMA-DMBOK. Experience working in AWS and/or Azure for cloud-native data processing and storage. Proficiency with Git and CI/CD pipelines for reliable, production-grade deployments. Familiarity with cloud data services such as S3, EMR, Glue, ADLS, Data Factory, or Databricks. Experience implementing data observability tools such as Monte Carlo, OpenLineage, or custom solutions. Experience building feedback loops, annotation workflows, or quality review tooling to improve automated extraction outcomes over time.

Apply! If you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know the next steps!

Our Team

Description & Requirements

Index Relationship Manager, Insurance Solutions

Bloomberg is a global leader in business and financial information, news and insight. We use innovative technology to deliver trusted data and bring transparency to the financial markets. Customers around the world rely on Bloomberg for the information and tools they need to make critical investment decisions and remain connected across the financial community.

The Bloomberg Financial Solutions department is at the forefront of ensuring success for our customers and employees alike. Our team comprises several key pillars, including sales, service, operations, culture and brand. We are united by a common goal: creating meaningful client relationships by understanding their needs and delivering exceptional end-to-end support—from the initial sale and implementation through the ongoing relationship with Bloomberg.

Bloomberg offers a broad range of fixed income, commodity, currency, equity and multi-asset index solutions. With extensive asset-class coverage, a strong history of innovation, and objective and transparent rules, Bloomberg indices are widely used for portfolio construction, performance comparison and the creation of financial products. Our capabilities include custom index development, investable index solutions, index administration and calculation-agent services. Bloomberg indices are powered by the same trusted reference data, pricing and analytics used throughout the investment process.

What’s the role?

We are seeking an experienced Index Relationship Manager to expand Bloomberg’s relationships across the insurance market and drive awareness and adoption of Bloomberg Index solutions.

You will engage with a broad range of stakeholders across insurance organizations, including teams involved in annuity products such as Registered Index-Linked Annuities, or RILAs, and Fixed Indexed Annuities, or FIAs, as well as general-account investment, portfolio management, asset-liability management, risk and related functions.

You will develop a strong understanding of your clients’ priorities, identify opportunities where Bloomberg indices and related capabilities can support their businesses, and bring together the appropriate Bloomberg product and subject-matter experts.

We are looking for an accomplished relationship manager who is intellectually curious, commercially minded and comfortable navigating complex organizations. What’s it like to work here?

We work hard. We are ambitious and set challenging business goals. We are a meritocracy where everyone has a voice, regardless of job title. Working with people you trust, respect and can collaborate with is more important than titles or position.

Things move quickly, and we want people who enjoy working in a dynamic environment and feed off its energy. But it is not all about work. Giving back is one of our core values, and there are many ways to get involved in philanthropic initiatives—from helping local students develop their reading skills to cleaning up parks and waterways.

Apply if you are an experienced relationship manager who is energized by building senior client partnerships, uncovering commercial opportunities and learning how Bloomberg’s index capabilities can support the evolving needs of insurance companies.

Introduction 

The Optimizely Legal team's mission is to serve as a trusted business partner in support of Optimizely's software sales revenue, while sharing responsibility for leading the Company's risk management. We apply both legal acumen and business judgment to deliver sound, practical decisions across every function in the organization.

This role sits within Legal and can be shaped around two tracks, depending on the successful candidate's background and experience. As Counsel, you would provide broad legal advisory support to internal clients and lead contract negotiations across an assigned region or line of business. As a Contracts Specialist, you would focus on drafting, negotiating, and managing SaaS and related commercial agreements, and on building out the contracts function and its processes.

We are hiring for the right person, and will calibrate the title, level, and scope of the role to the successful candidate's experience — whether that is an experienced attorney ready to take on Counsel responsibilities, a more junior lawyer developing into that role, or a contracts professional with deep SaaS agreement expertise.

Regardless of track, you will collaborate with internal clients across Finance, Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, Sales and Deal Operations, Customer Success, Partner Organization, and Marketing & Communications. You will develop strong working relationships with your Legal colleagues, contribute to the Company's strategic vision, and work under the direction of your Regional Manager and in support of the General Counsel's vision for the Team.

rows.title: Manager, Global Private Equity Group (PEG) Training and Adoption
rows.descriptionText:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITHThe Global PEG training and adoption team is part of Bain’s Global Private Equity practice and supports implementation of practice strategic priorities. Training and upskilling is a critical priority for PEG, bringing the best of Bain to our clients. The Global training and adoption team is responsible for all training across the PEG ringfence, from interns to Senior PEG Partners, including e-learns, classroom programs, and leadership development. 
This is a connected, cross-regional role. You will be the link between Global PEG training and the regions, working day to day with regional PEG training leads, regional Talent and Practice/Operations teams, and PEG Program Managers. You will also partner with digital learning stakeholders from Bain’s global training function to share innovation and best practices.
WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM This is a hands-on role that turns the Global PEG training and adoption strategy into uptake on the ground. You will be the regional face of PEG training: launching new products, answering the questions that come in from the frontline, and making sure that Bain’s regions know what is available and why it matters.Driving engagement. You will own the regional engine behind learner engagement, from scheduling and mobilizing core curriculum training to spotting where uptake is lagging and building the tactics to lift it. You will bring data and a creative mindset in equal measure, using attendance tracking data and learner feedback to inform what happens next.Supporting priorities and change. You will help land PEG’s priority topics, such as AI and diligence solutions, and support the internal communications and change management that help new ways of working stick. Throughout, you will look for opportunities to grow your own L&D skills and to collaborate with peers across regions.
WHAT YOU’LL DO 
Learning ambassadorLaunch and socialize new Global PEG training products with regional officesAct as a learning ambassador, testing and reviewing new training products, developing new initiatives, and contributing to Global PEG training projectsAct as a key regional point of contact/front line for responding to training queriesRepresent PEG training on local and regional calls, for example presenting to PEG Program Managers or providing an LT updateOpportunistically build personal L&D skills, for example by attending trainings designed for L&D professionals, or attending conferencesCollaborate with other regional training leads on projects to maximize training benefit to global PEG
Learner engagement and classroom schedulingProvide training monthly attendance data for input into the team dashboard Identify regional "hotspots" and develop tactics to boost training uptake with hotspot officesBring an innovative mindset to the Global PEG training team, creating new ideas and opportunities to boost learning engagement Mobilize core curriculum training, source trainers and collate feedback for AC-AP training, according to regional and global rollout schedules
PEG training prioritiesSupport training rollout of key PEG priority topics such as AI and diligence solutionsProactively promote and support the uptake of priority training at a regional levelBuild and leverage internal Bain networks to identify regional trainers for priority trainings Summarize key regional training feedback themes to influence and feed into priority training designUpdate PEG onboarding content to reflect evolving business priorities, liaising with SMEs from the PEG practiceEnsure PEG training page is maintained and currentDraft training content for implementing current business priorities
Change management and communicationsSupport internal practice comms and change management on evolving practice priorities 
ABOUT YOU
RequiredBachelor’s degree or equivalent; strong academic credentialsExperience in professional services, private equity, or a learning and development / training environmentA genuine passion for learning and development, and for coaching and upskilling othersStrong organizational skills across scheduling, tracking, and basic data analytics, with the ability to turn data into actionable insightStrong written and verbal communication, including to more senior audiencesComfort working in a fast-paced, virtual, cross-regional environment with a degree of ambiguityInterest in AI and learning technology, and a willingness to experimentEagerness to collaborate across regions and the broader Bain ecosystem
PreferredPrior experience in Bain’s Private Equity Group, or familiarity with the PEG frontline and diligence workflowBackground in L&D, talent development, or training program design and deliveryExperience in driving change management for scale programs Familiarity with modern learning tools and digital delivery channels such as Zoom, e-learn, and classroom
WORK MODEL / TRAVELThis role follows a hybrid model, requiring in-office presence at least one day per week. 
U.S. COMPENSATION INFORMATIONCompensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).
Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range to be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:
In Dallas, Austin, and Houston, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $104,500 - $125,500In Boston, Los Angeles, Seattle, and Washington, DC, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $114,500 - $137,500In New York, San Francisco, and Silicon Valley, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $124,500 - $149,500In Atlanta, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $99,000 - $119,500In Chicago, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is between $109,500 -$131,500Annual discretionary performance bonusThis role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date
Bain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family.Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheckGenerous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidaysFully vested 401(k) company contributionPaid Life and Long-Term Disability insuranceAnnual fitness reimbursements
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.For all other locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates for this role and will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to experience, education, licensure/certifications, training and skill level.

rows.title: Manager/Assistant Manager Digital Forensics, Forensic & Financial Crime
rows.descriptionText:
Connect to your IndustryFraud, bribery and corruption – it’s just another day at the office for our Forensic Technology experts.
As a technical practitioner in the field of Digital Forensics, this is your opportunity to become a part of a thriving, industry leading Forensic Technology team. As a multinational organisation we can offer you the breadth and depth of experience you are looking for. We can provide you with access to state-of-the-art technology, labs and the opportunity to work with clients on high-impact matters, both in the UK and abroad.
Today’s highly complex investigation and litigation environments, along with technological evolutions in areas such as big data, cloud and the pervasiveness of social media, continue to present challenges to the Digital Forensics practitioner. Delivering quality services to our clients in an ever-changing environment will demand you to continually craft and adapt bespoke solutions for our clients. Often, we need to go ‘above and beyond’ the technologies and techniques that are readily available in the Forensic Technology marketplace. As a member of our team, you will actively seek to meet such challenges with energy, creativity and enthusiasm. This all means that you will find numerous opportunities to grow your own portfolio of skills and excel at what you do best. Away from project work, we offer both formal and informal support for continuous professional development, to accelerate your career progression.
Connect to your career at Deloitte Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Connect to your opportunityAs a Manager within the Digital Forensics team, you will play a pivotal role in leading and undertaking forensic investigations for our clients in both the commercial and public sectors within our ISO 17025 accredited laboratory. You will be responsible for overseeing projects from the initial scoping phase and data acquisition, through to in-depth analysis and reporting. This role expects an experienced individual who can operate independently, manage multiple concurrent projects, and support the development of junior team members.
Technical:Lead and manage digital forensic investigations, including scoping, data collection, preservation, processing, analysis, and reporting.Conduct forensic examinations of digital devices, including computers, servers, mobile devices, and cloud based sources.Utilise standard forensic tools and techniques to extract, analyse, and interpret digital evidence.Maintain chain of custody and ensure the integrity of evidence throughout the investigation lifecycle.Prepare detailed and comprehensive forensic reports that clearly articulate findings and conclusions.
Project Delivery:Act as a primary point of contact for clients, leading discussions and providing clear, concise updates on investigation progress and findings.Manage and prioritise multiple concurrent investigations, ensuring that all work is completed to the highest quality standards and within agreed deadlines and budget.Manage risk and compliance procedures for new investigations, ensuring effective risk management and adherence to regulatory standards.
Team Management & Development:Mentor and develop junior team members, providing guidance and support across technical and professional matters.Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement within the team.Support business development activities including contributing to proposals, presentations, and bids.
Connect to your skills and professional experienceThis position would be well suited to experienced digital forensics professionals with proven experience within a professional services or law enforcement environment.To be considered, you must have the following skills and experience:Extensive experience and knowledge in the use of industry standard digital forensic tools and techniques for performing forensic acquisitions and analysis (e.g. Cellebrite, Axiom, FTK Imager, EnCase, or equivalent).Thorough understanding of evidence handling and chain of custody best practices.Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly and concisely.Proven ability to manage complex digital forensics investigations and support multiple concurrent investigations, ensuring delivery to agreed deadlines and budgets.Ability to support occasional short-notice (typically next day) incident response investigations on client sites or in-lab.

Essential Technical KnowledgeSQL or equivalent data-querying experience.Understanding of APIs, integrations and system interfaces.Understanding of data flows, source-to-target mappings and information management principles.Understanding of solution architecture concepts and enterprise systems landscapes.Understanding of non-functional requirements including security, privacy, accessibility and operational support.
Desirable skills:If you have skills or experience or qualifications in any of the following areas, it’s advantageous but not critical:Power BI, Tableau or similar analytics and visualisation platforms.Experience analysing enterprise applications, SaaS platforms or cloud-based solutions.Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse or equivalent technology platforms.Data governance, metadata, lineage or master-data concepts.API specifications and integration design patterns.BPMN, UML or other modelling approaches.Process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Lean Six Sigma.Workflow automation, process automation or orchestration platforms.Awareness of how AI, automation or analytics can support business analysis, including the need to validate outputs and handle information responsibly.Experience of sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues or contributing to a professional community.Relevant professional qualifications or structured learning in business analysis, such as BCS, IIBA or an equivalent, is advantageous but not essential.Developing and contributing to proportionate business cases by defining the problem or opportunity, assessing options, and articulating expected benefits, costs, risks and evidence to support investment decisions.Ability to work across multiple pieces of work concurrently, prioritising activities, managing competing demands and communicating proactively were timelines, capacity or dependencies may affect delivery.

rows.title: Senior Statistician
rows.descriptionText:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.

From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.

10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.

But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.

If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.

Find us on Instagram: @optimizely

Introduction

Rigorous statistical analysis is a core to all experimentation products at Optimizely. You will get on customer calls to articulate how we maintain statistical accuracy in our products as well as triage questions around statistical inference. You will educate internal and external stakeholders about fundamental as well as cutting edge statistics concepts via webinars, speaking engagements, blog posts, and white papers. You will also have the opportunity to work with our product and engineering teams to build new statistics/ML features for all of Optimizely’s products. You will have also have the opportunity to partner with experts in academia and research to explore and identify the latest trends and next great innovations that Optimizely should invest in.

Job Responsibilities

Product and Feature Development

Collaborate with product managers and engineering teams to design and implement new statistical and machine learning features across Optimizely’s product suite. Conduct rigorous testing and validation of new statistical methods and ensure seamless integration into the platform. Analyze product performance data to optimize existing features and provide actionable recommendations for improvement. Leverage AI agents to deploy new statistical capabilities. 

Research and Innovation

Partner with academic and industry researchers to explore cutting-edge statistical methods and machine learning innovations. Identify emerging trends in experimentation and statistics that could enhance Optimizely’s offerings. Propose and prototype advanced statistical techniques to solve challenging business problems faced by customers. 

Quality Assurance and Compliance

Develop and enforce statistical standards and best practices for all experimentation processes. Monitor and evaluate statistical algorithms to ensure accuracy, reliability, and scalability. Provide internal stakeholders with guidance on statistical compliance and methodologies to safeguard the credibility of experiment results. 

Education and Thought Leadership

Develop and deliver educational content on statistics, including webinars, blog posts, white papers, and public speaking engagements. Simplify complex statistical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences to promote understanding of experimentation best practices. Represent Optimizely at conferences and industry events, showcasing expertise in experimental design and statistical analysis. 

Customer Engagement and Support

Conduct customer calls to explain how statistical accuracy is maintained across Optimizely’s experimentation products. Triage and resolve customer inquiries related to statistical inference and experimentation methodologies. Assist customers in designing statistically valid experiments tailored to their needs and objectives. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with sales, customer success and onboarding teams to offer statistical expertise during customer onboarding and key engagements. Serve as a statistical advocate within the organization, fostering a culture of rigorous data-driven decision-making. Collaborate with marketing teams to showcase Optimizely’s statistical capabilities in external communications. 

Knowledge And Experience

3+ years of industry or educating experience with experimentation, data science, analytics, etc. Understanding of and ability to explain experimentation, randomized control trials, and inference, particularly aspects of high throughput testing such as multiple hypothesis testing, sequential testing, reinforcement learning, robustness, data mining of experiments Demonstrable experience of at least one of the following subjects: Classical statistical inference (fixed horizon tests, sequential tests); Bayesian statistical inference; Causal inference (potential outcome framework, randomized controlled trials, observational studies) and experiment design; Reinforcement learning (e.g., multiarmed bandit). Demonstrable working experience of python and SQL, (knowing R is also helpful). Experience collaborating on applied statistical research or designing commercial statistical features/applications Experience with AI applications 

Education

Advanced degree in Statistics, Computer Science or a closely related field such as bioinformatics, econometrics, economics or applied mathematics

Competencies

Communicating Effectively

Driving Continuous Improvement

Driving for Results

Interacting with People at Different Levels

Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Specific responsibilities include:Business and Solution AnalysisInvestigate business problems and opportunities by considering people, processes, technology, information and data.Work with stakeholders to understand business objectives, define outcomes and establish measures of success.Elicit, analyse, document and validate business, functional, technical and data requirements.Translate business needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process models and solution requirements.Support solution design, delivery, testing and business acceptance activities.Clarify and refine requirements throughout delivery as new information emerges.Support prioritisation decisions and help stakeholders balance scope, value and delivery constraints.Evaluate delivered solutions against agreed business outcomes and success measures.Contribute to continuous improvement of analysis practices, standards and reusable artefacts.Assess business, operational and technical impacts of proposed changes, ensuring stakeholders understand implications, dependencies and risks.

Essential Technical KnowledgeSQL or equivalent data-querying experience.Understanding of APIs, integrations and system interfaces.Understanding of data flows, source-to-target mappings and information management principles.Understanding of solution architecture concepts and enterprise systems landscapes.Understanding of non-functional requirements including security, privacy, accessibility and operational support.
Desirable skills:If you have skills or experience or qualifications in any of the following areas, it’s advantageous but not critical:Power BI, Tableau or similar analytics and visualisation platforms.Experience analysing enterprise applications, SaaS platforms or cloud-based solutions.Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse or equivalent technology platforms.Data governance, metadata, lineage or master-data concepts.API specifications and integration design patterns.BPMN, UML or other modelling approaches.Process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Lean Six Sigma.Workflow automation, process automation or orchestration platforms.Awareness of how AI, automation or analytics can support business analysis, including the need to validate outputs and handle information responsibly.Experience of sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues or contributing to a professional community.Relevant professional qualifications or structured learning in business analysis, such as BCS, IIBA or an equivalent, is advantageous but not essential.Developing and contributing to proportionate business cases by defining the problem or opportunity, assessing options, and articulating expected benefits, costs, risks and evidence to support investment decisions.Ability to work across multiple pieces of work concurrently, prioritising activities, managing competing demands and communicating proactively were timelines, capacity or dependencies may affect delivery.

rows.title: Senior Specialist, Digital Marketing, Content & UX Strategy
rows.descriptionText:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:
Bain & Company is recognized as one of the top international management consultancy firms. We assist major corporations worldwide with strategy, acquisitions, organizational design and performance improvement.
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities, and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.
Position Summary
The Senior Specialist, Digital Marketing, Content & UX plays a critical role on the Bain & Company marketing team and is primarily responsible for commercial content production and optimization, and ongoing support for our core digital property, Bain.com. They create engaging web experiences for commercial programs including digital proposals and web personalization. They serve as an internal go-to resource for our content management system (CMS) for local markets, digital brand building for Bain leadership profiles, and web support for our commercial development opportunities. This individual keeps the audience at the forefront of content creation through digital storytelling best practices, user data analysis and an adherence to Bain’s brand standards and best digital practices. 

The ideal candidate has experience in web, B2B development and digital marketing. They have a natural intellectual curiosity to understand digital audiences. In this role, they will optimize the user experience on public bain.com content as well as digital proposal websites. They will analyze effectiveness, usage trends and available data to inform actionable recommendations and present reports to various internal stakeholders. They will also liaise with global colleagues to understand their digital objectives and present solutions that ensure web best practices are being implemented at all times.
The person in this versatile role is detail-oriented with strong project and process management skills. They are able to mobilize quickly when needed for a short sprint, coordinate across team members and communicate effectively with stakeholders of all levels across a global, matrixed organization.

An advocate for Bain’s digital channels, this person turns observations into clear, actionable feedback for non-digital audiences including marketers, consultants, and senior firm leaders.

Responsibilities
Bain.com commercial development program support
Own the day-to-day operational delivery on bain.com, supporting web programs such as personalization, digital proposal sites, and other commercial contentDevelop and project manage digital proposal sites, with support of Senior Manager, ensuring alignment with Bain brand standards, best digital practices, and the narrative needs of the client audienceApply UX judgment to review content and structure, identifying opportunities to improve clarity, flow, and impact; collaborate with other experts to shape recommendations for proposal teamsPartner with local market representatives, regional marketers, and proposal teams to scope, prioritize, and execute digital requests, translating business needs into web solutions 
Content Creation & Digital Brand Building
Collaborating with other marketing colleagues, create and maintain web content across Bain.com using the firm’s CMS, Optimizely, ensuring accuracy, brand alignment and content qualityOwn the digital brand building program for Bain leadership profiles to review, optimize, and maintain profile pages that reflect current positioning, messaging hierarchy, and UX best practices[A1] Analyze web data and user behavior to help solve problems and identify recommendations to improve the overall bain.com user experience  
Stakeholder Management & Communication
Deliver excellent customer/client service through effective and timely communication, and consistent demonstration of digital and web expertiseManage incoming digital requests with strong project management discipline: scoping work, setting expectations, communicating status, and closing the loop in a timely and professional mannerCollaborate with a global internal client base, bringing awareness of and sensitivity to diverse cultures, regional market priorities, and varying levels of digital fluency 
Analytics & Systems Expertise
Collect, document and form analysis of traffic data for Bain digital assets using Google Analytics and other tools for various reporting cyclesProactively suggest data-driven process improvements or content updatesOwn review/approval step in CMS workflow for updates submitted by light users (i.e. local office, account marketing managers, etc.)Support training and enablement for local teams and consultants on CMS usage, best practices and processes 
Innovation & Web Optimization
Research latest web optimization techniques and recommend use cases for BainProactively discover new ways to test and learn web functionalities such as personalization and user testing, and utilize findings to make recommendations that align with overall firm and department objectives 
Experience
Experience in digital marketing, web content management, or a closely related field, ideally within a professional services firm, B2B, or large matrixed organizationDemonstrated experience supporting proposal, business development, or campaign materials in a digital context; experience collaborating with senior team members on these digital assetsApplied UX, content strategy or content quality judgmentProven data analysis, problem solving and customer service skills. Ability to digest, synthesize and distill information into concrete recommendations for stakeholdersExperienced project management skills, working in or alongside a global team, with ability to mobilize a quick sprint when needed Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation programs; web accessibility standards, SEO or AEO fundamentals, personalization platforms or marketing automation systems A strong grounding in HTML, Google Analytics and AI tools (Claude, Chat GPT, etc)Proficiency with MS Office applications suite and digital collaboration tools
ABOUT US
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 63 offices in 38 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. Our 10-year commitment to invest more than $1 billion in pro bono services brings our talent, expertise, and insight to organizations tackling today’s urgent challenges in education, racial equity, social justice, economic development, and the environment. We earned a gold rating from EcoVadis, the leading platform for environmental, social, and ethical performance ratings for global supply chains, putting us in the top 2% among other consulting firms. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

Introduction

The Senior Director of Technical Account Management (TAM) and Subscription Services is a strategic leadership role within Expert Services with a clear north star: driving product GRR (gross revenue retention) and NRR (net revenue retention). Everything this role builds - the go-to-market strategy, packaging, pricing, team, and delivery model - exists to ensure customers adopt, retain, and expand their use of Optimizely's product portfolio. This is not a services-for-services'-sake role; it's a product retention and expansion engine delivered through subscription-based technical engagements.

As Optimizely's product portfolio expands - including the rapid growth of Opal AI and agentic capabilities - this role will ensure the TAM and subscription services model evolves in lockstep with the business, creating new service tiers, defining delivery frameworks, and scaling operations globally. A critical part of this role is partnering with regional Customer Success and Sales leaders to make subscription services a natural, embedded part of the sales process for strategic accounts - directly contributing to the company's ability to retain and grow product revenue. The ideal candidate is equal parts strategist, operator, and people leader who understands that recurring technical services are the lever that moves product GRR and NRR.

We're looking for someone with a strong management consulting or advisory background - the kind of structured, analytical thinking you develop at firms like Deloitte, Accenture, McKinsey, or similar. You know how to build a business case, design a service offering from scratch, and bring the rigor of consulting methodology to an in-house leadership role. You've likely transitioned from consulting into SaaS services leadership and understand how to apply that foundation to drive scalable, repeatable outcomes.

Job Responsibilities

Go-to-market strategy, packaging, and pricing

Own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for TAM and subscription services, including positioning, packaging, and pricing across all tiers (Essential, Enhanced, Advanced). Continuously refine service packages based on market feedback, competitive benchmarking, and customer adoption data - always optimizing for the packages that most directly improve product retention and expansion. Build and maintain financial models and business cases for new service offerings, applying the structured analytical approach expected of a consulting-caliber leader. Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to align pricing models with Optimizely's broader commercial strategy and GTM motion. Develop sales enablement materials, scoping guides, and ROI frameworks that make it simple for Account Executives to position and close subscription services deals within 24 hours. 

Scaling the business and driving adoption

Build and execute a scalable operating model for TAM and subscription services delivery, balancing dedicated and shared engagement models across customer segments and deal sizes. Own the P&L for the TAM and subscription services practice, including revenue targets, margin management, utilization, and headcount planning. Define and track key performance indicators with product GRR and NRR as the primary north star metrics. Secondary KPIs include subscription services attach rate, product adoption scores, customer satisfaction (CSAT/NPS), time-to-value, and churn correlation analysis linking TAM engagement to retention outcomes. Drive predictable, recurring revenue growth by expanding subscription services penetration across the installed base and embedding TAM and subscription services into multi-product and platform deals - with a direct line of sight to how each engagement improves product G RR and N RR. Partner with regional Customer Success and Sales leaders to ensure the subscription services motion is a natural part of the sales process for strategic accounts - driving growth, expansion, and long-term customer value through proactive service attach. Partner with regional delivery leaders across North America, EMEA, and APJ to ensure consistent service quality and capacity planning at a global scale. 

Strategic advisory and product value realization

Establish a customer engagement methodology anchored in scoping, planning, and optimization cycles - designed to systematically increase product adoption, reduce churn risk, and create measurable uplift in GRR and NRR. Define the subscription services strategic advisory framework: capability reviews, solution architecture assessments, program governance, and maturity model progression. Embed Opal AI adoption into the subscription services motion - ensuring TAMs identify high-impact AI use cases, conduct enablement sessions, design agent workflows, and surface expansion opportunities. Act as the voice of the customer back into Product and Engineering, providing structured feedback on platform gaps, feature requests, and adoption blockers. Create a competitive moat by ensuring customers receive ongoing strategic and technical value that deepens platform adoption, strengthens product stickiness, and directly reduces logo and revenue churn. 

Knowledge And Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in management consulting, technical account management, professional services, customer success, or solutions consulting within SaaS, digital experience, or enterprise software. 4+ years in a leadership role with direct responsibility for building or scaling a recurring services business, including go-to-market strategy, service design, packaging, and pricing. Proven track record of owning or significantly influencing a services P&L, with demonstrable evidence that your work directly improved product GRR and NRR - not just services revenue in isolation. Strong consulting or advisory background - you've worked at a top-tier management consulting firm (e.g., Deloitte, Accenture, McKinsey, BCG, PwC, EY, KPMG, Bain) or can demonstrate equivalent consulting rigor through advisory or professional services leadership. Deep understanding of the martech and digital experience ecosystem, with hands-on familiarity across CMS, experimentation, content management, and AI-driven tools. Experience designing and operationalizing tiered service models (shared, dedicated, and specialist overlays) across multiple geographies. Exceptional executive presence with the ability to influence C-level stakeholders - both internally and with enterprise customers. Data-driven mindset with fluency in building business cases, financial models, and using customer health analytics to inform strategy. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field required. 

Education

Bachelors or higher equivalent

Want to be on a team with some of the most diverse backgrounds in the industry - financial analysts, developers, business analysts, attorneys and accountants? This is the place for you!

The Team

National Federal Tax Services (NFTS) is a national practice within Deloitte Tax LLP made up of a number of tax service offerings. Each NFTS service offering has been developed and built as a result of a tax planning idea, marketplace needs, or a technological innovation - all with the purpose of delivering results for our clients. Our people are entrepreneurial in spirit and have always had the work-hard/play-hard mentality. NFTS service lines provide tax planning and compliance support for the largest organizations across all industries.

One of our fast-growing, unique service offerings is our Tax Analysis & Information Reporting for Debt Investments (TARDI) practice. Those pursuing investment opportunities in corporate/government debt, MBS, and ABS markets are consistently challenged to properly address the tax planning and compliance that can apply. This quickly becomes a task that is often heavily dependent upon effective data management and a knowledge of financial products and tax principles. Through a combination of tools developed by Deloitte's Securitization and Partnerships Solutions practices, we can assist with the complex tax and reporting needs of large portfolios of fixed income investments.

As a Senior in this group, you will manage relationships, ensure timely reporting of milestone and dependency status, monitor risks and issues to escalate, and execute day-to-day management activities. You'll oversee asset-level diligence and analysis on debt investments, preparation and/or review of debt taxable income calculations, preparation and/or review of debt taxable income reports, communicating with clients, their servicers and/or administrators and lead client resources. Specific responsibilities of the PSG - TARDI team include:

Calculate and/or review taxable income on debt investments including OID, market discount, premium, gain / loss, tax basis, and other items using Deloitte's proprietary TARDI software and tools.Calculate and/or review taxable income on equity and derivative investments including wash sales, QDI & DRD, REIT & RIC reallocations, PFICs, constructive sales, straddles, section 1256, swaps, and other items using Deloitte's proprietary security trading analysis platform. Leverage proprietary software, third party data providers, and credit agreements to research asset level debt origination terms for corporate bond portfolios, mortgage-backed security portfolios, and mortgage loan pools.Maintain, enhance, and provide production support for Deloitte's proprietary regulated investment company tax compliance platform. Lead client engagement: communicate with client and/or internal tax teams, manage and support professionals on our team, develop a game plan to execute on the client engagement and review deliverables.Perform tax research to address tax technical issues that arise related to debt investment related transactions. Train younger professionals on the technical issues that are applicable in our business.Develop requirements for system enhancements and ongoing testing of system calculations, processes, and reporting.Support pursuit of new client opportunities through review of prospective client debt holdings, development of marketing decks, and analysis of industry public filings.Work within a team and supporting and mentoring junior staff.

rows.title: Strategic Designer
rows.descriptionText:
Locations: New York, NY | San Francisco, CA

What Makes Us a Great Place To Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll join our Design & Research experts within the AI, Insights & Solutions team. This team is part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You’ll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.

WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM

As a Strategic Designer, you’ll help lead human-centered innovation efforts—from research and insight development to concept creation, prototyping, and experimentation. You won’t just design solutions—you’ll bring a consulting mindset to navigate complex case contexts, contribute to strategy definition, and make pragmatic design choices that add value quickly.

What You’ll Do

Lead the end-to-end strategic design process, from framing and research to experimentation and delivery.Conduct qualitative research and synthesize insights into compelling artifacts, such as personas, journeys, and opportunity maps.Co-lead ideation sessions and conceptualize new experiences and business models in collaboration with case teams.Build storytelling assets and prototypes to bring ideas to life in fast, iterative ways.Run light experiments to test the desirability, feasibility, and viability of new solutions.Collaborate with case teams, GPs, and client stakeholders, demonstrating ownership and design leadership.Adapt design approaches based on project goals, balancing structured frameworks with practical flexibility.Model strong communication and tradeoff thinking, clearly articulating the rationale and implications behind design decisions.Contribute to the AIS community through coaching, recruiting, IP development, and cultural initiatives.

About You

You’ll be a strong fit for this role if you have:

1-2 years of hands-on experience in digital product, service, or venture design.Proven ability to navigate strategic ambiguity and co-create direction in complex, fast-changing contexts.A strong grasp of design thinking, human-centered design, and agile ways of working.Fluency with tools such as Figma, Miro, and Adobe Creative Suite, as well as working comfort with GenAI tools that support design research, ideation, prototyping, and storytelling.Intellectual curiosity and a consulting mindset, with an interest in understanding case context, contributing to business strategy, and delivering design with clear intent and rationale.Strong communication and collaboration skills with both designers and non-designers.Comfort with approximately 30% travel for client work.Advanced proficiency in English.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable Includes

Experience in consulting or client-facing roles.Familiarity with product management concepts and/or feasibility and viability discussions.Working Spanish skills.

This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.

Travel is required (50%). This position requires regional travel away from your home office/primary working location. Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs.

Us Compensation Information

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).

Role

Some local governments in the United States require a good-faith, reasonable salary range to be included in job postings for open roles. The estimated annualized compensation for this role is as follows:

In New York and California, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time salary range for this role is $142,551.Annual discretionary performance bonus.This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation.4.5% 401(k) company contribution, which increases after 3 years of service and is 100% vested upon start date.

Bain & Company's comprehensive benefits and wellness program is designed to help employees achieve personal independence, protection and stability in the areas most important to you and your family.

Bain pays 100% individual employee premiums for medical, dental and vision programs, offering one of the most comprehensive medical plans for employees without impacting your paycheck.Generous paid time off, including parental leave, sick leave and paid holidays.Fully vested 401(k) company contribution.Paid Life and Long-Term Disability insurance.

Please submit your portfolio and CV to be considered.

rows.descriptionText:
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:You will join the Architect experts within the Enterprise Technology team, part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice. In this multidisciplinary group, you’ll help clients modernize their tech strategy, architecture, and systems -- aligning technology with business goals to drive efficiency, agility, and innovation. You’ll develop enterprise-wide solutions, optimize cloud and data architectures, and integrate AI to enable scalable end-to-end digital transformations. 
WHAT YOU'LL DO (Essential Functions):Shape Architecture and Technology Strategy Lead the definition of enterprise data architecture strategies, target states, and roadmaps aligned with client business priorities and transformation outcomes. Architect scalable, resilient, and secure enterprise data platforms and solutions across cloud, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments. Define organizational strategies and operating models for a modern Data Office, including governance, ownership, platform, and delivery capabilities. Develop as-is and to-be architectures, reference models, migration options, and transition roadmaps for complex data transformations. Define enterprise integration and data-sharing standards across APIs, event streaming, data pipelines, and microservices-aligned architectures. Shape the data foundations required for analytics and AI, including data engineering, feature engineering, model data pipelines, and MLOps enablement. Assess, select, and integrate modern data platforms, vendor solutions, and hyperscaler services, including Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, Azure, and GCP. Translate complex business and technical requirements into clear architecture decisions, investment priorities, and executable plans.
Advise and Influence Senior Leaders Serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, and senior executives on cyber security strategy, architecture decisions, and technology trade-offs. Establish executive-level credibility and communicate effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders as part of client project leadership teams. Act as an independent design authority by reviewing and validating data architecture proposals, evaluating options, and providing delivery assurance. Influence, coach, and mentor client data and technology leaders and Bain teams to build sustainable architecture and Data Office capabilities.
Enable Transformation at ScaleLead high-impact data architecture workstreams within large-scale, multi-year transformation programs. Set direction and lead internal and external teams across complex, multi-million-dollar client engagements. Guide Bain consulting and client teams in executing architecture roadmaps, managing dependencies and risks, and embedding effective governance. Ensure architectures evolve through agile and MVP delivery while maintaining security, resilience, interoperability, scalability, and coherence. Partner with Bain consulting teams to integrate data architecture into broader business, technology, cloud, and AI transformations. Lead and mentor teams of architects and consultants to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing enterprise data platforms aligned with client outcomes. Collaborate with leaders across Vector guilds to bring the optimal combination of expertise to clients. Support recruiting, onboarding, and people development, and help create an environment that attracts and develops great architects. 
Advance Bain’s Reputation and Growth Define and create demand by co-creating differentiated points of view and go-to-market offerings in enterprise data architecture, data modernization, Master Data Management, Data Office design, and AI-enabled transformation. Support proposals, pursuits, and account expansion by bringing data architecture expertise into client discussions and solution shaping. Maintain market and vendor awareness, collaborate with ecosystem partners, and continuously evolve Bain's enterprise data architecture point of view. Contribute actively to client cases, intellectual property, publications, and architecture community engagement. Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and architecture communities.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING (Qualifications):10+ years of experience in data architecture and technology leadership, including large-scale transformation programs. Deep enterprise data architecture expertise across multiple industries, such as financial services, consumer, and technology. Demonstrated track record shaping enterprise data strategies, target architectures, platform roadmaps, and operating models. End-to-end lifecycle experience leading large, complex, multi-year data transformation programs from strategy and architecture through implementation and migration. Deep understanding of how data enables AI, with delivery experience across data engineering, feature engineering, model data pipelines, and MLOps enablement. rows.descriptionText:
The Team 

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation team is building the future of our business. This is the group responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and ultimately winning in new markets with new capabilities. We do not rely solely on what the firm has always done - we look to the future and invest where we believe growth will occur three, five, and ten years from now. The Innovation & Delivery Transformation team collaborates with Industries, Offering Portfolios, Growth, and Delivery Transformation to curate and scale our Innovation Portfolio, grow through our Strategic Growth Offerings, identify and incubate the next generation of technology through our Technology Offices, and more. We are also dedicated to fostering a leading talent experience within I&DT and across the firm.

The core focus of this role is the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. The Market Access AI platform is Converge for Life Sciences' initiative reimagining how life sciences companies manage payer contracting, formulary compliance, and gross-to-net performance by replacing fragmented manual processes with intelligent workflows built to scale.

Position Summary

As a Product Manager for Market Access AI, you will shape the strategic direction of a next-generation market access platform that is transforming how pharmaceutical and biotech commercial organizations operate. Sitting at the intersection of industry expertise and product vision, you will collaborate with the practice leaders in market access domain to shape where the product goes and why - driving measurable impact for life sciences companies navigating an increasingly complex payer landscape.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/26.

Work you'll do

Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:

Own and evolve the multi-horizon product roadmap for the Market Access AI platform, balancing near-term user needs with long-term market differentiation. Define and prioritize strategic bets across market access capabilities - spanning payer contract lifecycle management, agentic formulary validation, rebate compliance, GTN forecasting, copay program oversight, and script-level profitability analytics. Synthesize market signals, user feedback, competitive intelligence, and emerging AI trends into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership. Establish and maintain a product vision and narrative that aligns cross-functional teams - engineering, data science, UX, and go-to-market - around a shared north star. 

Market & Client Insight:

Conduct ongoing market research and competitive landscape analysis across the market access technology, managed markets, and life sciences commercial operations space. Build and maintain deep understanding of life science market access workflows - from pre-deal modeling and contract development through post-deal pull-through, rebate adjudication, and formulary monitoring - to ensure the product strategy addresses real, high-value pain points. Engage with current and prospective clients to validate strategic hypotheses and uncover unmet needs. Partner with functional SMEs and product owners to translate domain expertise and user insights into strategic product priorities. 

Go-to-Market & Commercial Enablement:

Collaborate with Deloitte practice leaders to define the go-to-market strategy for new platform capabilities, including positioning, messaging, and launch sequencing in partnership with marketing and sales leadership. Develop the product's value proposition and competitive differentiation narrative for use in pursuits, RFP responses, and executive briefings. Support high-priority sales cycles by providing strategic framing and credible industry context to differentiate the Market Access AI platform against competing solutions. Identify and evaluate partnership, integration, and ecosystem opportunities - across contract management systems, rebate platforms, formulary data providers, and syndicated payer data - that expand the platform's strategic value and market reach. 

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

Cross-Functional Leadership:

Act as a strategic thought partner to Product Management, Engineering, UX, and Delivery leaders, ensuring strategic intent is preserved through execution. Facilitate strategic planning sessions, roadmap reviews, and prioritization forums with senior stakeholders across Deloitte and ConvergeHEALTH. Contribute to practice-building efforts, including points of view, whitepapers, and conference presentations, to establish Deloitte as a thought leader in AI-driven market access transformation. Leverage rapid prototyping and AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Lovable, N8N) to bring strategic concepts to life as demonstrable ideas that accelerate alignment and feedback. 

Qualifications

Required: 

Bachelor's degree (Master's degree preferred) in life sciences, health economics, business strategy, computational biology, or related field. 4-5 years of experience working as an employee of a life sciences company (pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical products). 3-5 years of combined experience in Life Science market access environments and product management, management consulting, or technology product roles. Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software product organization in the life sciences, health tech, or pharmaceutical commercial operations space. Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate product strategy - including market sizing, competitive positioning, and roadmap rationale - to senior audiences. Deep familiarity with pharmaceutical market access workflows - including pre-deal modeling, deal strategy, contract development, contract execution, post-deal pull-through, and rebate adjudication. Proficiency with the key data assets that power market access decisions, including formulary and PDL data, covered lives, rebate and chargeback transaction data, GTN waterfall components (WAC, rebates, Medicaid best price, 340B, copay), script-level claims (e.g., IQVIA LAAD, Symphony Health), copay voucher data, hub and patient enrollment data, and syndicated benchmarks (e.g., SSR Health, CMS MDRP). Proven track record of synthesizing complex inputs (market data, user research, business context) into clear, actionable strategic recommendations. Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. 

Preferred:

Familiarity with AI/ML applications in market access operations, including automated contract compliance, formulary validation, and rebate leakage detection in pharmaceutical commercial environments. Familiarity with Agentic AI concepts and applications, including the use of AI agents to automate complex workflows, orchestrate multi-step market access processes, and enable autonomous decision-making in commercial operations. Comfort with modern data and cloud concepts (AWS or equivalent) sufficient to engage credibly with engineering and architecture teams.
