rows.title: Account Executive, Clinical Trial Planning & Feasibility SaaS

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

What you'll do: Sales Lead (Account Executive) will drive growth of the ZAIDYN Study Planning SaaS product within the Mid-size and Emerging Pharma / Biotech market segment. This role focuses on engaging with mid-sized to small pharma and biotech companies—including pre-commercial organizations—and guiding them through how ZS’s technology-enabled solutions can help them solve some of their most challenging obstacles to achieve clinical trial success. As an Account Executive, you will own new business development, manage multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and collaborate closely with solution consultants, product teams, and subject matter experts to shape high-impact client engagements. This is an exciting opportunity for a SaaS sales professional who thrives in a consulting-led, fast-paced environment and is eager to make an impact in life sciences innovation in the clinical space.

Drive new client acquisition and revenue growth in the Emerging and Mid Pharma territory.Manage complex B2B SaaS sales cycles, engaging multiple senior stakeholders across Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Data Science and IT functions.Partner with internal teams (solution consultants, product managers, SMEs) to translate clinical development and operational challenges into compelling ZAIDYN Study Planning solutions.Quantify business value by demonstrating how ZAIDYN Study Planning improves clinical timelines, reduces enrollment risk, and enhances study executionGenerate and qualify opportunities through outbound prospecting, industry events, referrals, account-based strategies, and networkingLead presentations, demos, and value-based discussions with Directors, VPs, and C-suite leaders.Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and activity tracking within CRM (Salesforce, Dynamics, etc.).Stay informed on industry trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving client needs within clinical planning & operations

rows.title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect (contract)
rows.descriptionText:
SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect to lead the design, architecture, and configuration of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions. This role will be responsible for defining finance transformation strategies, driving adoption of SAP leading practices, and ensuring scalable, compliant, and maintainable solutions across global finance organizations. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, including Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), Asset Accounting, Project Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Record-to-Report (RTR), and financial reporting. The architect will serve as the primary advisor for finance process design, configuration decisions, solution governance, and business transformation initiatives. Relevant SAP S/4 leading practices include standardized end-to-end finance processes, embedded analytics, integrated finance and controlling, and adoption of SAP Fiori user experiences.

Responsibilities

Solution Architect and Design

 Lead the end-to-end architecture and solution design for SAP S/4HANA Finance transformations. Define future-state finance operating models leveraging SAP best practices and standard functionality. Design scalable and maintainable solutions aligned with SAP Clean Core principles. Provide thought leadership on finance process transformation and ERP modernization initiatives. Evaluate business requirements and recommend optimal SAP standard capabilities before customizations.

Finance Process Leadership

 Serve as the functional architecture lead across key finance domains: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Project Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Consolidation and Financial Reporting, Treasury and Cash Management Lead finance process redesign workshops and drive adoption of SAP leading practices. Partner with Finance leadership to align business requirements with SAP solution capabilities.

SAP Configuration Leadership

 Lead and govern SAP S/4HANA Finance configuration activities. Define configuration standards for: Ledger Design, Company Codes, Chart of Accounts, Fiscal Year Variants, Posting Period Controls, Financial Statement Versions, Costing Structures, Parallel Accounting, Universal Journal (ACDOCA) Review and approve functional specifications, configuration documents, and solution designs. Ensure consistency across global deployments and member firm implementations. Ledger and accounting-principle design are critical tenant-level architecture decisions that affect reporting, compliance, and operational processes.

Reporting, Analytics & Controls

 Architect financial reporting solutions utilizing: SAP Embedded Analytics, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Financial Reporting Structures Design solutions that support regulatory, statutory, management, and operational reporting requirements. Ensure strong internal controls and auditability across financial processes. Support finance organizations with KPI frameworks and executive reporting capabilities. Embedded analytics and integrated FI/CO reporting are key SAP S/4HANA finance leading practices.

Stakeholder Leadership

 Facilitate executive and business stakeholder workshops. Serve as trusted advisor to CFO organizations and finance leadership teams. Collaborate closely with Enterprise Architects, Data Migration Teams, Integration Teams, Reporting, Teams, Security Teams, SAP Delivery Partners. Present recommendations and architecture decisions to leadership governance boards.

Delivery Leadership

 Provide solution governance across all project phases: Discover, Design, Build, Test, Deploy, Hypercare Support testing strategy, defect resolution, cutover planning, and production readiness activities. Mentor SAP FI/CO consultants, business analysts, and functional leads.

Qualifications

 Minimum ten years of recent SAP Finance consulting experience. Minimum five years serving as SAP Finance Lead or Solution Architect. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, information systems, computer science, or related discipline from an accredited college or university Multiple end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation programs. Extensive experience leading global finance transformation initiatives. Experience working directly with CFO organizations and Finance leadership. Deep expertise in: SAP S/4HANA Finance, Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO), Universal Journal (ACDOCA), Asset Accounting, Project Systems / Professional Services, Revenue Recognition, Margin Analysis (CO-PA), Group Reporting, Financial Close Processes, Embedded Analytics, SAP Fiori Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud configuration and core organizational and financial design concepts is highly desirable. Strong understanding of: Record-to-Report (RTR), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Project Financials, Revenue and Billing Processes, Internal Controls and Compliance, Professional Services Finance Operations. Possess business expertise, solid leadership skills, strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders. Resource should be located within commuting distance of Montvale, Dallas, or Chicago.

iterate information architecture, prompts, and flows to improve usability and outcomes.Contribute to client enablement and adoption through documentation, technical runbooks, training support, and change enablement activities.Stay current on Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, and Copilot roadmap and capabilities, share learnings and reusable assets within Slalom’s communities of practice.What You’ll BringExperience designing, developing, and administering SharePoint Online solutions, including modern sites, permissions, information architecture, and search.Hands‑on experience with SharePoint development and customization using SPFx, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and Microsoft Graph / REST APIs.Practical experience with Power Platform (Power Automate; As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

What you’ll do:

Collaborate with ZS internal teams and client teams to shape and implement high quality technology solutions that address critical business problems Develop a deep understanding of the business problems and effectively translate them into technical designs Lead modules and workstreams within projects while actively participating in hands on implementation Work with technical architects to validate the technical design and implementation approach Apply appropriate development methodologies and best practices to ensure exceptional client and project team experience Support the project lead in project delivery, including project planning, people management, staffing, and risk mitigation Manage a diverse team with various skill sets while providing mentorship and coaching to junior members Lead task planning and distribution among team members for timely completion of projects with high-quality results Guide the project deliverables such as business case development, solution vision and design, user requirements, prototypes, technical architecture, test cases, deployment plans and operations strategy 

What you’ll bring:

Candidates must either be in their junior year of a Bachelor's degree or in their first year of a Master's degree specializing in Business Analytics, Computer Science, MIS or related field with academic excellence 3+ 3+ years of relevant professional experience in delivering small/medium-scale technology solutions Ability to lead project teams, drive end-to-end activities, meet milestones, and provide mentorship/guidance for the team growth Strong understanding of RDBMS concepts, SQL, data warehousing and reporting Experience with big data concepts, data management, data analytics and cloud platforms Proficiency in programming languages like Python Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including expertise in algorithms and data structures 

Additional Skills:

Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to structure thoughts logically during discussions and presentations Capability to simplify complex concepts into easily understandable frameworks and presentations Proficiency in working within a virtual global team environment, contributing to the timely delivery of multiple projects Travel to other offices as required to collaborate with clients and internal project teams 

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Digital Products & Solutions team helps organizations in their digital transformation journey by transforming last-mile experiences. We are uniquely positioned to bring together deep domain, analytics, technology/platform, and consulting expertise, with a strong focus on innovation and design. The Salesforce service line focuses on redefining how life sciences organizations engage HCPs, patients, caregivers, and payers, and on reengineering the commercial, medical, and patient-services processes behind those journeys. Coach analysts and associates, review their work, and manage day-to-day client relationships with judgment about what to escalate. Contribute to practice building — proposals and RFP responses, reusable accelerators and demo assets, points of view, and recruiting.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, IT, engineering, or a related discipline; candidates with a life sciences or business background and strong technology aptitude are also encouraged to apply. rows.title: Market Access Consultant - Key Account Management

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

ZS’s Access, Strategy & Implementation (ASI) team delivers deep expertise on topics including business-to-business engagement, market access, pricing and value strategy with advanced analytics and build tailored market access solutions for pharma and life sciences companies. From strategy to execution, we help enable stronger relationships with clients largest customer, unlock patient access, optimize performance and drive market impact.

The B2B Engagement team is part of ZS’s Access, Strategy & Implementation (ASI) team. The business-to-business engagement team focuses on helping clients build and improve their B2B selling capabilities. Working across all types of clients, our B2B engagement team develops cross-functional business strategies to enable our clients to partner with their most important customers. Our team supports clients from strategy to execution, including developing the appropriate business case, selecting the right accounts to engage, developing new planning approaches and processes, selecting, hiring and training account managers and aligning on KPIs. As our clients’ customers evolve how they buy and who they buy from, we work side by side with our clients to help them evolve how they engage with their customers.

Market Access Consultant - Key Account Management

Strategy Insights & Planning Consultants within the ASI team deliver high-quality solutions for our clients. Consultants possess unstructured problem-solving skills as well as strong analytic, synthesis and communication skills. Consultants may work on multiple market access and pricing projects simultaneously. As Consultants advance in their career, they specialize in a particular industry, practice area and/or client relationship.

What You’ll Do: 

Work with project leadership to define project scope and develop approach. Lead project task execution by ensuring progress, organizing project data and coordinating team meetings. Conduct issue analysis and develop hypotheses on the key client issues. Design and execute qualitative and/or quantitative analyses to test and analyze hypotheses. Synthesize findings, develop recommendations, and communicate results to clients and internal teams. Provide thought leadership and innovation within projects and practice areas. Participate in business development. Contribute to internal firm activities. Coach and mentor junior team members. 

What You’ll Bring:

MBA with bachelor's (and often graduate) degrees with a strong academic record in business, economics, marketing, psychology, physical or life sciences, engineering, applied math, statistics, or related fields. Alternately, candidates may possess a PhD in marketing, economics, decision sciences or related field with a business application. In lieu of an MBA or PhD, 5-8 years of relevant work experience may substitute. Up to 3 years of post-MBA relevant work experience, and 3-5 years of pre-MBA work experience. Consulting experience in the healthcare and life sciences industry Demonstrated knowledge and experience in the US and / or global pharma market access and pricing domain.High motivation, good work ethic, maturity and personal initiative. Aptitude for, and enjoyment of, leading and managing teams. Effective oral and written communication skills that enable personal impact with senior-level decision makers. Strong attention to detail, with a quality-focused mindset. Analytic problem-solving skills, with a creative and innovative outlook; Client service orientation.Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

rows.title: Analytics Engineer (Contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As an Analytics Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and solutions that transform data from complex marketing and enterprise systems into reliable, well-structured datasets. You will work across APIs, cloud data platforms, and sources such as Salesforce to ensure data is accurately ingested, integrated, modelled, documented, and made available for downstream analytics, reporting, and advanced modelling. You will also leverage modern AI tools to enhance engineering workflows and help build well-documented, AI-ready data assets that support evolving business and technology needs.

Your Impact:

Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines that ingest and integrate data from marketing platforms, Salesforce, APIs, and other enterprise data sources.Develop data transformations and models that provide trusted, well-structured datasets for downstream analytics, reporting, dashboarding, and advanced modelling.Build and maintain API-based integrations and custom Python solutions to support reliable and automated data ingestion.Ensure data quality, integrity, and availability through validation, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and integrations.Create and maintain technical documentation, metadata, data definitions, and lineage to improve the discoverability, usability, and governance of data assets.Build and structure datasets and documentation to support AI and LLM use cases, while leveraging AI tools throughout development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation workflows. 

Qualifications

Your Skills & Experience

5+ years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar data-focused engineering role.Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.Hands-on experience with at least one modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.Experience integrating data through REST APIs and other programmatic data sources, including authentication, pagination, error handling, schema changes, and monitoring.Experience working with Salesforce data and understanding its underlying data structures and relationships.Experience working with marketing data and marketing technology ecosystems, including integrating data across CRM, campaign, digital, media, or customer platforms.Strong experience designing pipelines and data models specifically for downstream analytics, dashboarding, reporting, and analytical modelling.Understanding of data modelling, warehousing, data quality, governance, and production data engineering best practices.Experience with data validation, testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining reliable production pipelines.Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, metadata, data definitions, and lineage so datasets are understandable and discoverable.Proficiency with modern AI tools and demonstrated ability to incorporate them into day-to-day engineering work, including development, debugging, testing, analysis, and documentation.

Set Yourself Apart With:

Hands-on experience with Rivery and/or Boomi for data ingestion, integration, and pipeline development.Experience preparing datasets, metadata, documentation, or knowledge assets for consumption by AI/LLM applications, including RAG or agent-based use cases.Experience with BI and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.Experience with advanced analytics, predictive modeling, or machine learning.Experience with customer identity resolution, marketing attribution, campaign measurement, or other complex marketing data models.Experience with data privacy, consent management, and governance of customer/marketing data.

Salary Range: $140,000 - $180,000

The range shown represents a grouping of relevant ranges currently in use at Publicis Sapient. Actual range for this position may differ, depending on location and specific skillset required for the work.

Additional Information

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. rows.title: M365 Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Who You’ll Work WithAs a modern technology company, our Slalom Technologists are disrupting the market and bringing to life the art of the possible for our clients. We have a passion for building strategies, solutions, and creative products to help our clients solve their most complex and interesting business problems. We surround our technologists with interesting challenges, innovative minds, and emerging technologies. As a Modern Work consultant at Slalom, you’ll work with cross functional teams to design, build, and support modern collaboration and content solutions using Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and Copilot. You’ll partner closely with client stakeholders, architects, engineers, designers, and security teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, and ‑user-friendly SharePoint and ‑Copilot enabled‑ experiences.You’ll be part of Slalom’s Modern Work practice—an inclusive, collaborative group focused on delivering high impact Microsoft 365 solutions across collaboration, content, security, and ‑AI powered‑ ways of working, including Copilot agents and Power Platform solutions.Title: Consultant or Senior ConsultantWhat You’ll DoDesign, develop, and maintain SharePoint Online solutions, including modern sites, libraries, lists, pages, and navigation that support clients’ collaboration and content management needs.Build custom SharePoint components and solutions using SPFx, Power Automate, and Microsoft Graph / REST APIs.Administer and support SharePoint Online environments, including site collections, permissions, security groups, content types, term store, and search configuration.Design, build, and configure Copilot agents (using Copilot Studio or similar tools) that leverage SharePoint and other data sources to enable AI powered knowledge retrieval, self-service, and productivity scenarios.Implement governance, security, and compliance best practices across SharePoint and Copilot solutions, partnering with client IT and security teams to align with organizational policies.Integrate SharePoint with other Microsoft 365 services (Teams, OneDrive, Viva, Power BI) and line of business systems to create cohesive digital workplace experiences.Support implementation efforts across the delivery lifecycle, including solution design, configuration, customization, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.Monitor and optimize SharePoint and Copilot solutions using analytics and feedback; iterate information architecture, prompts, and flows to improve usability and outcomes.Contribute to client enablement and adoption through documentation, technical runbooks, training support, and change enablement activities.Stay current on Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, and Copilot roadmap and capabilities, share learnings and reusable assets within Slalom’s communities of practice.What You’ll BringExperience designing, developing, and administering SharePoint Online solutions, including modern sites, permissions, information architecture, and search.Hands‑on experience with SharePoint development and customization using SPFx, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and Microsoft Graph / REST APIs.Practical experience with Power Platform (Power Automate; Dataverse a plus) to extend and automate SharePoint and Microsoft 365 solutions.Demonstrated experience building or configuring Copilot agents or similar AI/chatbot solutions (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Virtual Agents), including connecting to SharePoint and other enterprise data sources.Understanding of Microsoft 365 security, compliance, and governance concepts (Entra ID/Azure AD, groups, conditional access, DLP, sensitivity/retention labels) and how they apply to SharePoint and Copilot.Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills across SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and integrations, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues.Ability to work directly with clients—gathering requirements, explaining options, and translating business needs into practical, human-centered technical solutions.Strong collaboration and communication skills, with comfort working across technical and nontechnical stakeholders in a consulting or client facing environment.A growth mindset, including curiosity about emerging Microsoft 365 and AI capabilities, willingness to learn, and openness to feedback.
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all. Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: The targeted base salary pay range for this role is listed below. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. East Bay, San Francisco, Silicon Valley:Senior Consultant: $158,000 - $193,500Consultant: $128,500 - $157,000San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County, Seattle, New Jersey, New York City, Westchester, Boston, Washington DC:Senior Consultant: $145,000 - $177,000Consultant: $118,000 - $144,000All other locations:Senior Consultant: $133,000-$162,500Consultant: $108,000 - $132,000
We will accept applicants until the position is filled.
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.title: Principal - Responsible AI
rows.descriptionText:
Role: AI Governance Strategist & Solution Architect: Principal 
 
Join Slalom's AI team as a Responsible AI Strategist or Responsible AI Technical Solution Architect. If you are passionate about sociotechnical approaches to technology enablement and possess strong critical thinking skills, and risk management experience, this is the role for you. rows.title: Principal - Responsible AI
rows.descriptionText:
Role: AI Governance Strategist & Solution Architect: Principal 
 
Join Slalom's AI team as a Responsible AI Strategist or Responsible AI Technical Solution Architect. If you are passionate about sociotechnical approaches to technology enablement and possess strong critical thinking skills, and risk management experience, this is the role for you. We are looking to build a cohort and a practice and seek passionate colleagues, collaborators, and team mates. As a Responsible AI technical consultant and architect, you will guide clients and deliver complex AI/ML strategies and solutions, with a focus on alignment with governance, oversight, and regulatory expectations. Ideal for those with a strong blend of technical, policy, risk management and business acumen, you'll leverage advanced AI technologies to create impactful solutions and help articulate their benefits to senior executives and delivery and sales teams in a dynamic, multidisciplinary environment. Position Overview:
 You will play a critical role in ensuring that AI technologies meet emerging regulatory expectations and realize multi-stakeholder value. This role requires close collaboration with various teams and partners to help customers efficiently and securely adopt AI technologies in a compliant and trustworthy manner. Given the complexities across the AI value chain, we welcome submissions from interested candidates across the diversity of sociotechnical interests and expertise, and can work with you to support your career growth through practical applications, team/project-based work and engagement with our leaders and industry experts. Key Responsibilities:Develop, implement, and integrate strategies, frameworks and guidelines for responsible AI and AI Governance.Conduct thorough assessments of AI systems to identify impacts and mitigate potential risks, limitations, biases and ethical concerns.Setting up robust policies, controls, standards, and risk frameworks in collaboration with clients and their risk partners to oversee and ensure AI initiatives agree with organizational values, regulatory requirements, and controls.Lead initiatives to enhance transparency and explainability of AI systems, making them more understandable and trustworthy for users.Select appropriate technologies from a pool of open-source and commercial offerings, considering deployment models and integration with existing tools. Understand and contribute to MLOps, LLMOps, AgentOps, and AI transformations to SDLC to deploy and manage machine learning models and large language models and AI systemsEnable the engineering of AI platforms and architecture with embedded controls, capability, and tooling for security, compliance, and auditability.Provide training and support to team members on responsible AI principles and practices.Represent Slalom and support the development of thought leadership by engaging with external stakeholders, including industry groups, academic institutions, and regulatory bodies.Foster partnerships with third-party vendors, delivery partners, contractors, industry groups, and institutions to ensure client and organizational needs are consistently met.Advocate for the importance of Responsible AI and Trust and Safety through speaking engagements, publications, and participation at industry events.Lead client engagements as a Subject Matter Expert in AI Risk Management and Ethics to solve customer problems and translate requirements into actionable solutionsWork within existing technology platforms and business operations to design effective record-keeping, human oversight, observability layers, integrated control architecture and systems of record for robust auditabilityRemains up-to-date on the emerging frameworks, standards, policies, technical approaches, AI landscape and related issues by participating in workshops, reading academic research and professional publications, maintaining personal networks, and participating in relevant events Qualifications:Advanced degree such as an MA or PhD degree in a qualitative or quantitative social science, ethics or philosophy, law, or policy or a technical background in large-scale computing, modeling, data science; or related field.At least 2 years of work experience on issues pertaining to artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, and responsible AI. Experience with generative AI is required.Experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Banking or any highly regulated industry or sector.Expertise in privacy, security, cyber, data analytics, risk management, research, accessibility, FinOps, risk modeling, environmental and carbon footprint modeling, software development/coding, or product development.Knowledge and experience operationalizing responsible AI topics such as evaluation and testing and control integration for AI systems. Expertise in socio-technical aspects of AI (e.g., equity and fairness, RAI red teaming, performance, ethics, safety, robustness, in the context of AI/ML).Practical experience with ML and generative AI development pipelines and tooling.The ability to lead with integrity, review and ensure the quality of outputs and outcomes, ensure the confidentiality of sensitive information and thrive in a fast-paced, intellectually demanding and service-oriented environment.Effective communication and written skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts and non-technical concepts to diverse audiences.Proven record of being an effective team player dedicated to collective successes in cross-functional teams.Ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt to rapidly changing environments and demands and work across multiple disciplines and cultures.Proven record of experimentation, creativity, and openness to feedback, learning from both successes and failures.
 What You’ll DoAI Risk Management Strategy and Delivery: collaborate and deliver solutions for AI governance, process, procedure, and control design, model development, testing, deployment, and product, utilizing standard and emerging best practices and frameworks across the development lifecycle (e.g. NIST, ISO, OWASP).Business Development: Lead business development activities to grow our AI team; identify opportunities & sell services to both new and existing clientsIndustry & RAI Subject Matter Expertise: You know the industry vocabulary, current regulatory and compliances context, associated with data privacy, security, sociotechnical risk, and emerging policy considerations.Market Presence & Thought Leadership: Establish market awareness and grow Slalom’s AI capabilities within your industry vertical.Partner Confidence: Work closely with our partner vertical leaders to develop joint thought leadership, GTM strategies and events as well as participate vertical account team planning and QBRs. What You’ll BringIndustry experience, preferably in a highly regulated sector Strong business acumen and critical thinking skills with ability to articulate AI benefits and risks to senior executivesAttention to detail, documentation, and evidence and experience in risk management and mitigationPassion regarding the potential of AI as well as the challenges and limitations of real-world AI implementations.Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and rapid changeProven ability to manage and prioritize multiple competing tasks Demonstrated ability to be resourceful and learn new concepts quickly Thoughtful collaboration, ability to work with and across diverse teams and stakeholders, kindness, and a harm-reductionist mindset and toolkit. 
 About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.  Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. rows.title: Analytics Engineer (Contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As an Analytics Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and solutions that transform data from complex marketing and enterprise systems into reliable, well-structured datasets. You will work across APIs, cloud data platforms, and sources such as Salesforce to ensure data is accurately ingested, integrated, modelled, documented, and made available for downstream analytics, reporting, and advanced modelling. You will also leverage modern AI tools to enhance engineering workflows and help build well-documented, AI-ready data assets that support evolving business and technology needs.

Your Impact:

Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines that ingest and integrate data from marketing platforms, Salesforce, APIs, and other enterprise data sources.Develop data transformations and models that provide trusted, well-structured datasets for downstream analytics, reporting, dashboarding, and advanced modelling.Build and maintain API-based integrations and custom Python solutions to support reliable and automated data ingestion.Ensure data quality, integrity, and availability through validation, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and integrations.Create and maintain technical documentation, metadata, data definitions, and lineage to improve the discoverability, usability, and governance of data assets.Build and structure datasets and documentation to support AI and LLM use cases, while leveraging AI tools throughout development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation workflows. 

Qualifications

Your Skills & Experience

5+ years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar data-focused engineering role.Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.Hands-on experience with at least one modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.Experience integrating data through REST APIs and other programmatic data sources, including authentication, pagination, error handling, schema changes, and monitoring.Experience working with Salesforce data and understanding its underlying data structures and relationships.Experience working with marketing data and marketing technology ecosystems, including integrating data across CRM, campaign, digital, media, or customer platforms.Strong experience designing pipelines and data models specifically for downstream analytics, dashboarding, reporting, and analytical modelling.Understanding of data modelling, warehousing, data quality, governance, and production data engineering best practices.Experience with data validation, testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining reliable production pipelines.Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, metadata, data definitions, and lineage so datasets are understandable and discoverable.Proficiency with modern AI tools and demonstrated ability to incorporate them into day-to-day engineering work, including development, debugging, testing, analysis, and documentation.

Set Yourself Apart With:

Hands-on experience with Rivery and/or Boomi for data ingestion, integration, and pipeline development.Experience preparing datasets, metadata, documentation, or knowledge assets for consumption by AI/LLM applications, including RAG or agent-based use cases.Experience with BI and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.Experience with advanced analytics, predictive modeling, or machine learning.Experience with customer identity resolution, marketing attribution, campaign measurement, or other complex marketing data models.Experience with data privacy, consent management, and governance of customer/marketing data.

Salary Range: $140,000 - $180,000

The range shown represents a grouping of relevant ranges currently in use at Publicis Sapient. Actual range for this position may differ, depending on location and specific skillset required for the work.

Additional Information

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

Responsibilities:

rows.title: Consulting Marketing Lead - Industry
rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

Growth Marketing Lead - Industry 

ZS is seeking a Growth Marketing Lead to support and expand our industry practices outside of healthcare by translating business priorities into differentiated industry positioning, thought leadership, content strategies, and go-to-market initiatives that drive awareness, engagement, and business growth.

You will operate at the intersection of strategy, execution, and analytics, partnering with business leaders and marketing & communications ecosystem partners to deliver coordinated, measurable marketing outcomes.

You will lead marketing strategy, industry positioning, and narrative development, holding accountability for messaging, market differentiation, and marketing's contribution to business growth, pipeline, and revenue.

The role will also shape ZS's external industry presence through strategic event participation, thought leadership activation, and executive engagement programs that strengthen brand visibility, client relationships, and growth opportunities.

This is a high-visibility role which requires strong interpersonal and team skills as well as abalance of strategic leadership, cross-functional influence, and operational excellence. You will exhibit strong external presence with industry stakeholders, and an ability to influence across the organization. You will ensure that ZS’s capabilities and assets resonate with the industry and target audience (accounts and personas) to increase ZS’s visibility, brand equity and trust.

What You’ll Do:

Industry go-to-market planning and execution

Develop a deep understanding of ZS’s industry capabilities and competitive landscape Partner with industry SMEs to manage plan and campaign deliveryTranslate business priorities, market opportunities, and client needs into industry positioning, growth strategies, and integrated go-to-market plans.Develop integrated event activation strategies that align event investments to industry growth objectives, account priorities, and campaign goals.Define industry-specific value propositions, messaging frameworks, and market narratives that differentiate ZS and support business growth.

Campaign & Content Activation

Shape industry marketing strategy and priority initiatives by defining narratives, content priorities, and engagement approaches that support growth objectives.Conduct market, customer, and competitive analysis to identify emerging trends and opportunities, and messaging recommendations.Develop and operationalize flagship POVs, articles, webinars, and conversion assets Partner with SMEs to translate complex industry topics into clear, compelling storiesDevelop positioning, messaging, sales enablement materials, and playbooks that support business development efforts and strengthen industry differentiation.Deliver high-quality campaign and asset execution with strong attention to detail Manage multiple workstreams with clear timelines and accountability Support activation of campaigns through sales channels and account-based motions Develop event-specific narratives, thought leadership themes, executive messaging, and content strategies that reinforce industry positioning and differentiation. Partner with SMEs and business leaders to shape speaking opportunities, session concepts, executive engagements, and client-facing experiences.

Performance Tracking & Insights

Monitor campaign performance against defined KPIs (awareness, consideration, conversion)Use insights to optimize targeting, messaging, and channel mixSupport reporting on marketing impact and ROIMaintain structured documentation of campaigns, assets and outcomes Maintain accountability for MyCRM utilization and reporting to ensure visibility into marketing-driven and influenced impact 

What You’ll Bring:

6+ years of marketing experience in B2B marketing, consulting, or related fieldStrong project management and ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneouslyComfort working cross-functionally in a matrixed environment, influencing without direct authority.Excellent relationship-building and communication skills, able to engage senior stakeholders internally and externally.Experience developing market positioning, value propositions, and executive-level messaging for complex B2B offerings.Demonstrated ability to influence business strategy through customer, competitive, and market insights.Ability to operate as a strategic advisor and thought partner to senior business leaders.Experience translating business objectives into marketing strategy, industry narratives, and growth initiatives.Ability to translate business objectives into structured marketing plansStrong analytical thinking and ability to solve ambiguous, cross-functional problemsProven experience delivering end-to-end marketing programs or campaignsAbility to develop clear, concise, executive-ready messaging and materialsSkilled in translating technical/complex topics into compelling narrativesDemonstrated ability to align event investments with business objectives, brand positioning, relationship development, and pipeline growth. Strong stakeholder management skills with experience coordinating across business leaders, sales teams, SMEs, external partners, and event organizers.Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Find Out More At:

www.zs.com

rows.title: M365 Consultant

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Who You’ll Work WithAs a modern technology company, our Slalom Technologists are disrupting the market and bringing to life the art of the possible for our clients. We have a passion for building strategies, solutions, and creative products to help our clients solve their most complex and interesting business problems. We surround our technologists with interesting challenges, innovative minds, and emerging technologies. As a Modern Work consultant at Slalom, you’ll work with cross functional teams to design, build, and support modern collaboration and content solutions using Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and Copilot. You’ll partner closely with client stakeholders, architects, engineers, designers, and security teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, and ‑user-friendly SharePoint and ‑Copilot enabled‑ experiences.You’ll be part of Slalom’s Modern Work practice—an inclusive, collaborative group focused on delivering high impact Microsoft 365 solutions across collaboration, content, security, and ‑AI powered‑ ways of working, including Copilot agents and Power Platform solutions.Title: Consultant or Senior ConsultantWhat You’ll DoDesign, develop, and maintain SharePoint Online solutions, including modern sites, libraries, lists, pages, and navigation that support clients’ collaboration and content management needs.Build custom SharePoint components and solutions using SPFx, Power Automate, and Microsoft Graph / REST APIs.Administer and support SharePoint Online environments, including site collections, permissions, security groups, content types, term store, and search configuration.Design, build, and configure Copilot agents (using Copilot Studio or similar tools) that leverage SharePoint and other data sources to enable AI powered knowledge retrieval, self-service, and productivity scenarios.Implement governance, security, and compliance best practices across SharePoint and Copilot solutions, partnering with client IT and security teams to align with organizational policies.Integrate SharePoint with other Microsoft 365 services (Teams, OneDrive, Viva, Power BI) and line of business systems to create cohesive digital workplace experiences.Support implementation efforts across the delivery lifecycle, including solution design, configuration, customization, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.Monitor and optimize SharePoint and Copilot solutions using analytics and feedback; iterate information architecture, prompts, and flows to improve usability and outcomes.Contribute to client enablement and adoption through documentation, technical runbooks, training support, and change enablement activities.Stay current on Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, and Copilot roadmap and capabilities, share learnings and reusable assets within Slalom’s communities of practice.What You’ll BringExperience designing, developing, and administering SharePoint Online solutions, including modern sites, permissions, information architecture, and search.Hands‑on experience with SharePoint development and customization using SPFx, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, and Microsoft Graph / REST APIs.Practical experience with Power Platform (Power Automate; Dataverse a plus) to extend and automate SharePoint and Microsoft 365 solutions.Demonstrated experience building or configuring Copilot agents or similar AI/chatbot solutions (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Virtual Agents), including connecting to SharePoint and other enterprise data sources.Understanding of Microsoft 365 security, compliance, and governance concepts (Entra ID/Azure AD, groups, conditional access, DLP, sensitivity/retention labels) and how they apply to SharePoint and Copilot.Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills across SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and integrations, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues.Ability to work directly with clients—gathering requirements, explaining options, and translating business needs into practical, human-centered technical solutions.Strong collaboration and communication skills, with comfort working across technical and nontechnical stakeholders in a consulting or client facing environment.A growth mindset, including curiosity about emerging Microsoft 365 and AI capabilities, willingness to learn, and openness to feedback.
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value. At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all. Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance. Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: The targeted base salary pay range for this role is listed below. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time. East Bay, San Francisco, Silicon Valley:Senior Consultant: $158,000 - $193,500Consultant: $128,500 - $157,000San Diego, Los Angeles, Orange County, Seattle, New Jersey, New York City, Westchester, Boston, Washington DC:Senior Consultant: $145,000 - $177,000Consultant: $118,000 - $144,000All other locations:Senior Consultant: $133,000-$162,500Consultant: $108,000 - $132,000
We will accept applicants until the position is filled.
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.title: Director, UKG
rows.descriptionText:
The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. Looking ahead, we anticipate continued evolution and success within the practice, fostering both personal and professional development, thereby creating new pathways for growth. In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, UKG> to join our Advisory Services practice.

Responsibilities:

Sell and deliver UKG transformations in one or more of the following UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group) products and modules: UKG Pro, UKG Ready, UKG Dimensions; sell and deliver strategy, transformation, and innovation projects that span aspects across multiple industries including WFMOwn and lead client projects focused on improvement, optimization and transformation; build strategic roadmaps and implement them with particular attention to Workforce Management (WFM); plan and facilitate strategic design sessions working with executives and leadership; develop high quality work products utilizing both qualitative and quantitative data as directed (written briefings, status reports, issues risks logs) for presentation to clients and demonstrate problem solving skills through critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, intellectual rigor and questioning when breaking down and analyzing complex issues and framing approaches for potential solutionsConduct proposal development and other new business activities including the development of go to market materials, creation of new solutions to take to market, leveraging new and existing relationships with client business leaders; display an appreciation for the complete cycle of work and understand the impact of assignments on the overall goal of projectsDeliver process improvement and transformation projects that span all aspects of operations within a Workforce Management system specifically with UKG; work as part of a team focused on solving complex operational issues utilizing market leading technology-enabled solutions and advanced analytics in conjunction with industry expertise in one or more industriesIndependently and collaboratively participate in client projects focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes aiming at quality, operational and financial improvements; conduct business requirements gathering, document review, data-driven insights, and process mappingAct with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Minimum twelve years of recent, relevant work experience related to one or more of the following areas: Strategy and Transformation, Organization Design and Effectiveness, Target Operating Model Strategy, Competencies and Skills Development, Performance Management, Workforce Management & Planning, Go To Market business development and creation of new solutions; preferred ten years of experience in advisory services within a major consulting firm; Big 4 experience a plusBachelor's degree from an accredited college/university; preferred concentrations include business administration, information technology, biology and life sciences, economics, finance, industrial engineering or a related field; Master's degree from an accredited college or university a plusSolid experience leading teams managing projects, leading meetings, drafting status reports, tracing issues, monitoring resources, workflow analysis and design; project experiences consisting of WFMProgressive experience with working on teams with some exposure to managing projects, leading meetings, drafting status reports, tracing issues, monitoring resources, workflow analysis and design; proven project experiences consist of clinical, quality, financial, information technology and operationalExperience with handling, analyzing, and evaluating large data sets (for example: Tableau, SQL, Excel, Access, Power BI) and Data Warehouse management along with Workforce Management, ideally UKG DimensionsProven expertise, including certifications, in one or more of the following UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group) products and modules: UKG Pro: Proficient in modules such as Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Recruitment, Talent Management, and Performance. rows.descriptionText:
KPMG is building a product organization designed to help transform decades of industry experience into innovative, software-powered businesses. Backed by the scale, resources, and market presence of a global network, this organization operates with the energy, ambition, and pace of a startup. We are assembling a founding team of builders, innovators, and problem solvers who are excited by the opportunity to create new products, shape new ways of working, and help define the future of technology-enabled business at KPMG. If you thrive in entrepreneurial environments, embrace ambiguity, and are motivated by the potential to make a lasting impact from the ground up, we invite you to consider joining us on this journey.

KPMG is currently seeking a Director, Platform Product Management to join our Product organization.

Responsibilities:

Shape the multi-year platform strategy and integrated roadmaps for an AI-native platform across multiple complex domains, aligning product, technology, and firm prioritiesOwn the capability inventory and assessment across advisory and relevant functions, identifying recurring workflows, agents, data models, and integrations that should become reusable platform assets — and harvest the best of them into the shared platform in collaboration with our engineering organizationLead cross-domain recommendations on shared versus product-specific capabilities and build, buy, partner, or harvest options for senior product and technology leadersAdvise engineering and architecture leaders on cross-platform architecture and integration decisions, prioritize technical debt, and ensure reusable capabilities meet scalability, reliability, security, regulatory, and technical standardsResolve major roadmap, dependency, reuse, and investment trade-offs across platform domains and product teams, using customer needs, technical feasibility, critical gaps, and platform value to guide decisionsSet platform adoption and reuse measures, using build-time, cost, reliability, and product-team outcomes; Drive internal adoption through evangelism, documentation and developer experience; Coach professionals and advance technical product-management practices across teamsAct with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum ten years of recent experience in product management for technical products or platforms, including owning a B2B or enterprise platform product end to endBachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred; Minimum of a high school GED is required; Minimum of twelve years of equivalent professional experience is requiredProven experience shaping platform strategy across complex technical products, platforms, or processes with results in platform adoption, cross product reuse, delivery speed, cost, or customer outcomes; experience in a complex or regulated environment is preferredDeep technical product management experience, including product lifecycle management, cross-product prioritization, analytics and experimentation, and defining non-functional requirements (NFRs) and service level objectives (SLOs). Demonstrated fluency in application programming interfaces (APIs), data models, AI and agent frameworks, integration patterns, and technical debt trade-off decisionsDemonstrated daily use of AI across working practice, and platforms or products that have shipped or shaped where AI and agent frameworks were core rather than decorative; ability to guide shared versus product-specific capability decisions and develop build, buy, partner, or harvest recommendationsAbility to operate with limited oversight, advise senior product and technology leaders, resolve complex cross-platform trade-offs, and coach professionals in leading technical product-management practices; preferred experience with developer or internal platforms (i.e. Agent orchestration, connector and integration architecture, or governed AI tooling) with audit trails and human-in-the-loop controls with application, data, or legacy modernization toolingApplicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)
